props.name: count
props.description: Total streaks across both depths, capped.

props.name: onSplash
props.description: Fires the { x, y } of each tap splash.

props.name: height
props.description: Pane height in px.

usageNotes: Cheap and gated — the rain pauses off-screen and when the tab is hidden, rebasing its clock.
Splashes pool to a fixed cap, so rapid taps stay light; each tap fires onSplash with its point.
Under reduced motion a few streaks freeze in place and a tap draws one static splash ring.

items.title: Sun Shaft
items.tagline: Move through the beam; the motes swirl in your wake.
items.description: A shaft of light crosses the atrium with dust motes drifting through it, brighter where they cross the beam; move the pointer through and the motes swirl into an eddy in your wake, settling back as you pass.

props.name: count
props.description: Dust mote count, capped for cheapness.

props.name: onStir
props.description: Fires as the pointer enters and leaves the beam.

props.name: height
props.description: Panel height in px.

usageNotes: The canvas is aria-hidden with a polite live region; the pointer spins a vortex through nearby motes.
The shaft pauses off-screen and when hidden, rebasing its clock so the drift never jumps.
Under reduced motion it paints one static lit frame with the motes at rest and no loop.

items.title: Firefly Field
items.tagline: Hold, and the fireflies gather to your hand.
items.description: Fireflies wander and blink at their own depths across a dusk meadow; press and hold and they gather to your hand, milling around it, then disperse back into the dark when you let go.

props.name: count
props.description: Firefly count, clamped to a cheap range.

props.name: onGather
props.description: Fires as the hold starts and stops.

props.name: height
props.description: Meadow height in px.

usageNotes: The canvas is aria-hidden with a keyboard Gather button (Space or Enter held), so it works without a pointer.
The field pauses off-screen and when hidden, rebasing its clock over the pause.
Under reduced motion it holds a calm static scatter with no wander or gather loop.

items.title: Vapor Ring
items.tagline: Click the air; a ring of vapor rolls out.
items.description: Click the still air and a ring of vapor puffs out, its turbulent edge expanding toward you and drifting up as it thins to nothing; the loop sleeps whenever the last ring has faded.

props.name: onPuff
props.description: Fires the { x, y } of each puff.

props.name: height
props.description: Surface height in px.

usageNotes: Rings pool to a fixed cap, so rapid clicks stay cheap; each click fires onPuff with its point.
The loop idle-stops the instant the last ring has faded and wakes on the next puff.
Under reduced motion a click draws one static ring, replaced on the next click, with no loop.

items.title: Gravity Well
items.tagline: Draw the well; fling fast to slingshot bodies free.
items.description: Bodies orbit a gravity well that follows the pointer — a softened pull holds them in ellipses, motion trails streaking their paths; flick the well fast and a stream slingshots free before the field draws it back.

props.name: count
props.description: Orbiting body count, capped for cheapness.

props.name: onFling
props.description: Fires when a fling slings bodies free and when it settles.

props.name: height
props.description: Field height in px.

usageNotes: The canvas is aria-hidden with a polite live region; the pointer is the well, easing back to center when it leaves.
The field pauses off-screen and when hidden, rebasing its clock so the orbits never jump.
Under reduced motion it paints one static frame of concentric orbital rings with no loop.

items.title: Paper Flight
items.tagline: Click the sky; a glider swoops across on its path.
items.description: Folded gliders drift across the hangar at their own depths; click the sky and one launches on a bezier flight, banking to face its path and scaling with the arc before it fades at the far edge.

props.name: count
props.description: Ambient drifting gliders, clamped to a cheap range.

props.name: onLaunch
props.description: Fires the launched flight index per launch.

props.name: height
props.description: Hangar height in px.

usageNotes: The canvas is aria-hidden with a keyboard Launch button, so a flight can be sent without a pointer.
Flights pool to a fixed cap, so rapid clicks stay cheap; each launch fires onLaunch with its index.
Under reduced motion the gliders pose at rest and a launch drops one static mid-flight glider, no loop.

items.title: Terrain Relief
items.tagline: Orbit the relief; a node reads its elevation.
items.description: A data heightmap drawn as a rotatable wireframe terrain — the grid projects into an oblique surface you orbit by dragging, strands painter-ordered by depth and fading into the distance, and hovering a node lifts a readout of its elevation.

props.name: data
props.description: Elevations by [row][col]; normalized internally.

props.name: onProbe
props.description: Fires the probed { row, col, value }, null on leave.

props.name: height
props.description: Chart height in px.

usageNotes: Drag orbits the surface; ArrowLeft/Right rotate and Home resets to the default oblique angle.
A node hover or focus fires onProbe with the elevation in original units and lifts a readout.
Under reduced motion the surface holds one static oblique frame while probing stays live.

items.title: Little Planet
items.tagline: Spin the planet; a section curves up to the top.
items.description: Sections wrapped around a tiny planet's rim — spin the planet and each curves up to the top slot, growing to full size as it surfaces while the far side tucks behind the horizon; release snaps the nearest section home.

props.name: sections
props.description: Sections spaced evenly around the planet rim.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial surfaced section id.

props.name: onSurface
props.description: Fires the section id once it settles at the top.

props.name: radius / height
props.description: Planet radius and stage height in px.

usageNotes: The planet is a focusable control — arrows spin one section to the top, Home returns to the first.
A release snaps the nearest section to the top the short way; the controlled value is honored.
Under reduced motion the sections sit in a static ring and surface with an instant jump.

items.title: Arc Routes
items.tagline: Hover a route; a rider arcs to its port.
items.description: Great-circle arcs lifting off a flat map — pins plot ports across the panel and each route bows a quadratic arc between two of them, arching higher the longer the hop; hovering or focusing a route brightens its arc and rides a marker along it from origin to destination.

props.name: pins
props.description: Ports plotted by normalized x, y across the map.

props.name: routes
props.description: Arcs between pins, referenced by from and to ids.

props.name: onRide
props.description: Fires the ridden route id, null when it ends.

props.name: height
props.description: Map height in px.

usageNotes: Routes ride from a legend of real buttons, so they are keyboard-reachable and announce on focus.
The rider is a bezier-derived marker travelling a tween from origin to destination while the route is active.
Under reduced motion no rider travels; the arc brightens and marks its midpoint instead.

items.title: Radar Scope
items.tagline: The sweep lights each contact; click to inspect.
items.description: A polar approach scope whose sweep beam rakes the display once a cycle, lighting each contact as it crosses its bearing and leaving it to fade in afterglow; click a contact to pin a callout, or reach every one through the keyboard list beside the scope.

props.name: blips
props.description: Contacts placed by bearing (deg) and range (0..1).

props.name: onInspect
props.description: Fires the inspected contact id, null when cleared.

props.name: sweepPeriod
props.description: Seconds per full sweep rotation.

props.name: height
props.description: Scope height in px.

usageNotes: The canvas is aria-hidden with a parallel button list, so every contact is inspectable from the keyboard.
The sweep pauses off-screen and when the tab is hidden, rebasing its clock so it never jumps on resume.
Under reduced motion the scope paints one static frame with every contact lit and no animation loop.

items.title: Fisheye Grid
items.tagline: Sweep the lens; tiles bulge up beneath it.
items.description: A magnifier you sweep across a grid — tiles under the lens bulge up and spread apart in a radial fisheye, the largest riding to the front while the rest ease back to rest, and the tile at the lens center reads out as you go.

props.name: cells
props.description: Tiles laid on a near-square grid under the lens.

props.name: onFocusCell
props.description: Fires the tile at the lens center, null off-grid.

props.name: lensRadius / strength
props.description: Lens reach in px and bulge magnitude.

props.name: height
props.description: Grid height in px.

usageNotes: On fine pointers the lens glides under the cursor; on touch it drags a puck; arrows move it a tile at a time.
Every tile derives its bulge from the shared lens value, so nothing writes state per pointer-move.
Under reduced motion the lens drops and a discrete focused tile scales up in place instead.

items.title: Section Cut
items.tagline: Drag the plane; a stratum opens at the cut.
items.description: Drag a cutting plane down through a layered core sample and the block above the plane clips away, opening each stratum at a hatched section face as the plane crosses it, its label called out and a depth readout tracking the cut.

props.name: strata
props.description: Bands top to bottom, each with a thickness and tone.

props.name: onCut
props.description: Fires the stratum at the cut face, null above grade.

props.name: height
props.description: Core height in px.

usageNotes: The plane is a role=slider — drag tracks 1:1, arrows step it, PageUp/Down jump a whole stratum.
onCut reports the intersected stratum, deduped; the depth readout derives from the plane, never a per-frame write.
Under reduced motion the plane and the clip resolve instantly with the same section semantics.

items.title: Compass Needle
items.tagline: Drag the dial; the needle wobbles to a point.
items.description: A bearing picker with a magnetic settle — the needle tracks the pointer bearing as you drag around the rose, then on release swings the short way to the nearest cardinal detent and wobbles home like a magnetized compass; the arrow keys step it point by point.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial bearing, 0 (N) clockwise to 359.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires the settled bearing once it snaps to a detent.

props.name: detent
props.description: Detent grid in degrees; 45 gives the 8-point rose.

props.name: height
props.description: Dial size in px.

usageNotes: The dial is a role=slider — arrows step one detent, Home returns to north, and the value text names the cardinal point.
Release snaps the short way to the nearest detent on the recoil spring, its two bounces reading as magnetism.
Under reduced motion the needle jumps to the pointer bearing and the detent with no wobble.

items.title: Blueprint Rise
items.tagline: Scroll the plan up into a standing model.
items.description: A flat floor plan that stands up as you scroll — the plan tilts from a top-down view to a three-quarter oblique while every wall extrudes off its floor line into a line-art model, a rise readout tracking the climb from plan to structure.

props.name: walls
props.description: Wall segments in 0..1 plan coordinates, with a height.

props.name: labels
props.description: Room labels on the floor plane.

props.name: journey / height
props.description: Scroll track length in stages and stage height in px.

props.name: onRise
props.description: Streams the rise 0..1, deduped to twentieths.

usageNotes: Pure SVG faux-3D — no CSS 3D — so the extruded model stays Safari-proof.
An sr-only line describes the plan; the region scrolls natively and the model is presentational.
Under reduced motion the model holds a mid-rise composition while the readout still tracks scroll.

items.title: Explode View
items.tagline: Toggle to fan the assembly apart, labelled.
items.description: A stacked assembly that separates on command — toggle it and the parts fan apart along an isometric axis in a staggered cascade, a leader line running from each part to its label; toggle back and they nest into one solid again.

props.name: parts
props.description: Assembly parts, ordered bottom to top.

props.name: exploded / defaultExploded
props.description: Controlled or initial exploded state.

props.name: onToggle
props.description: Fires the new state when the assembly is toggled.

props.name: height
props.description: Stage height in px.

usageNotes: Parts are focusable buttons — hovering or focusing one lights the part and its leader-lined label.
The separation staggers on a cascade so the outer parts lead; the controlled exploded prop is honored.
Under reduced motion the assembly swaps instantly between nested and fanned, leaders and all.

items.title: Matrix Rise
items.tagline: Toggle the grid up into a city of bars.
items.description: A heat grid that stands up into a bar city — toggle it and every cell extrudes into an isometric bar whose height tracks its value, the field rising in a diagonal cascade; toggle back and it lies flat as a heatmap again.

props.name: data
props.description: The value matrix; drives both color and bar height.

props.name: rowLabels / colLabels
props.description: Optional axis labels.

props.name: risen / defaultRisen
props.description: Controlled or initial raised state.

props.name: onToggle
props.description: Fires the new state when the grid is toggled.

usageNotes: The bars are clip-path faces, not CSS 3D, so the city stays Safari-proof.
Hovering or focusing a cell reads its value; the controlled risen prop is honored.
Under reduced motion the grid swaps instantly between heatmap and city.

items.title: Swing Door
items.tagline: Past the detent or slammed home.
items.description: A hinged door with handle physics — drag it past the detent and it swings wide on the glide spring; let go early and it slams home, shuddering the frame and puffing a dust line at the jamb.

props.name: children
props.description: What waits in the doorway.

props.name: doorFace
props.description: Artwork on the door; defaults to a minted panel.

props.name: open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled door state.

props.name: height
props.description: Frame height in px.

usageNotes: The handle is a real button with aria-expanded; Escape slams the door and focus returns to the handle.
Under reduced motion the door slides flat with no slam or shudder.

items.title: Hatch Board
items.tagline: Every lid rides its own spring.
items.description: A grid of spring-loaded hatches — every lid pops open on its own snap spring to reveal the well beneath, latches shut with a click pulse, and the whole board can cascade open or closed from a corner.

props.name: hatches
props.description: Four to nine hatches; the label names each disclosure.

props.name: openIds / defaultOpenIds / onOpenChange
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled open set.

props.name: columns / cellAspect
props.description: Board shape.

usageNotes: Each lid is a real disclosure button; wells are labelled regions, inert while shut, and the open count is announced.
Under reduced motion lids fade flat with no pops or cascade.

items.title: Gear Train
items.tagline: Ratios you can feel.
items.description: Three meshed gears with honest ratios — drag any wheel and the transmission carries your hand to a needle on the output shaft; teeth stay interleaved at every angle by construction, and releases coast on a velocity-seeded drift.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled needle value, 0-100; fires once per settle.

props.name: teeth
props.description: Drive, idler, and output tooth counts.

props.name: height
props.description: Stage height in px.

usageNotes: The train is one slider — arrows step by two, Page keys by ten, Home and End glide the rails, and every settle is announced by value.
Under reduced motion gears track the hand one-to-one with no coast; the tooth-tick blink remains as an opacity cue.

items.title: Commit Lever
items.tagline: Past the guard, then all the way.
items.description: A two-stage action lever — the pull stiffens at the guard notch and the flap swings aside as you push through to arm; full travel commits with a thunk, locks, and glides home after the reset.

props.name: onCommit
props.description: Required — fires exactly once per full travel.

props.name: onArmChange
props.description: Tracks the armed stage, deduped.

props.name: commitLabel / resetDelay / disabled
props.description: Wording, auto-return delay (0 holds), and the safety.

usageNotes: The grip is a real button — first press arms, second commits, Escape disarms; every stage is announced.
Under reduced motion the lever snaps between its three stations with no thunk or lamp blink.

items.title: Crank Reel
items.tagline: Wind forward; the freewheel only clicks.
items.description: A hand-crank that winds progress onto a visible spool — forward turns bank units with ratchet ticks while backward cranking just chatters on the freewheel; the drum trails the handle on the glide spring.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled wound units; fires per unit.

props.name: max / unitsPerTurn / reversible
props.description: Capacity, gearing, and whether backward unwinds.

props.name: onSlip / spoolLabel
props.description: Freewheel slip callback and the wound material's name.

usageNotes: The rig is one slider — arrows wind a unit, Home and End run the rails with a single batched announcement, and slips announce as freewheel.
Under reduced motion the crank and drum move instantly and the pawl kick becomes an opacity blink.

items.title: Pulley Lift
items.tagline: The counterweight lands the car.
items.description: A dumbwaiter on one honest travel value — haul the platform, the counterweight, or either rope fall, and the car settles to the nearest floor with an elastic arrival while the sheave turns by exactly the rope it passed.

props.name: floors
props.description: Two to four floors, ground first.

props.name: floor / defaultFloor / onFloorChange
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled floor; fires on settle.

props.name: height
props.description: Shaft height in px.

usageNotes: The frame is a vertical slider and every floor tab is a real button with aria-current; arrivals are announced by label.
Under reduced motion the car jumps between floors with no glide or bounce.

items.title: Combo Dials
items.tagline: Three dials, one agreement.
items.description: A combination lock of stacked cylinder dials — digits sweep the rim under your drag, settle into detents with a click, and when every dial agrees with the setting the bolt slides open.

props.name: length
props.description: Dial count, two to five.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled digits; fires per settled digit.

props.name: secret / onUnlock
props.description: The setting to match and the single-fire unlock callback.

usageNotes: Each dial is a spinbutton — arrows step with wrap, typing a digit glides straight to it, and settles are announced per dial.
Under reduced motion digits jump detent by detent and the bolt opens with a fast fade; near-misses never announce proximity.

items.title: Zipper Seam
items.tagline: The seam parts above the pull.
items.description: Fabric halves joined by a toothed seam — draw the pull down and they part in a V above it, teeth shearing aside along the edges, with a shiver when the yank lands fully open.

props.name: children
props.description: What lies in the seam.

props.name: progress / defaultProgress / onProgressChange
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled 0-100 opening; fires on settle.

props.name: height
props.description: Stage height in px.

usageNotes: The pull is a vertical slider — arrows step by five, Page keys by twenty, Home and End seal and open; ends snap and announce.
Under reduced motion the seam tracks the hand one-to-one with no snaps or shiver.

items.title: Trapdoor Drop
items.tagline: The long way down, on purpose.
items.description: A two-stage disposal platform — arming slides the bolts aside while the item wobbles, confirming swings both leaves down from their outer hinges, and the item accelerates into the well past blinking depth rings before the doors clap shut.

props.name: children / itemKey
props.description: The item on the doors; change the key to lower in the next one.

props.name: onDrop
props.description: Fires exactly once when the item has fallen through.

props.name: armLabel / dropLabel / disarmLabel
props.description: The two-stage wording.

props.name: height
props.description: Stage height in px.

usageNotes: Dismissal is always two presses — arm, then confirm — with Escape backing out; every stage is announced.
Under reduced motion the item fades instantly on confirm with the same two-stage semantics.

items.title: Drawbridge
items.tagline: Chains out, deck down, crossing proved.
items.description: A span between two content islands — lowering pays the chains out from the gantry as the deck swings down, thumps the far abutment on the recoil, and a runner crosses once to prove the connection before the far bank wakes.

props.name: near / far
props.description: The two banks; the far one is reachable only while bridged.

props.name: bridged / defaultBridged / onBridgedChange
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled span state.

props.name: lowerLabel / raiseLabel
props.description: Toggle wording.

props.name: height
props.description: Stage height in px.

usageNotes: One real toggle with aria-expanded; the far bank is inert and dimmed until the deck lands, and both states are announced.
Under reduced motion the deck fades between raised and bridged with no chains or runner.

items.title: Chip Cloud
items.tagline: Pick a chip; it flies to the tray.
items.description: A multi-select field split in two: a tray of what you have picked and a cloud of what is left. Picking a chip flies the very same pill out of the cloud and into the tray while the survivors close the gap; picking it again flies it home.

props.name: chips
props.description: The full roster; picked chips gather in the tray.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial picks, in pick order.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires the picked ids whenever the set changes.

props.name: label / placeholder
props.description: Group label, and the copy shown while the tray is empty.

usageNotes: Every chip is a real toggle button, so the field is operable with Tab and Space alone.
A picked chip changes container, which replaces its DOM node — the chip is re-focused as it lands so the keyboard never loses its place.
Under reduced motion chips reposition in a single frame; same picks, order, and announcements.

items.title: Rating Arc
items.tagline: Sweep the arc; the score fills to your thumb.
items.description: A rating that fills along a 220-degree arc — the fill draws itself and the thumb rides the curve rather than cutting across it, while sweeping the arc paints a ghost of the score you would commit.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial score, 0..max.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires the committed score.

props.name: max / step
props.description: Top of the scale and its granularity; 0.5 gives half marks.

props.name: label / readout
props.description: Accessible name, and whether to print the score beneath.

usageNotes: Reports as a slider — arrows step, Home and End jump the ends, and aria-valuetext reads the score rather than a bare number.
The hover ghost is driven straight off motion values, so sweeping the arc never costs a React render.
Under reduced motion the fill and thumb land in a single frame; same scale and commits.

items.title: Swatch Lock
items.tagline: The pick locks; the rest step back.
items.description: A grid of colour swatches where the pick locks in: a ring draws itself around the chosen chip while the rest ease back to let it stand alone. Locking is the whole affordance — you can see what is held without reading anything.

props.name: swatches
props.description: Each carries an id, a label, and any CSS colour.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial pick.

props.name: name
props.description: Renders a hidden native radio per swatch so forms post the pick.

props.name: columns
props.description: Grid columns; Up and Down step by exactly this many.

usageNotes: Full APG radio keyboard on a roving tabindex — Left and Right walk the roster and wrap, Up and Down step a row, Home and End jump the ends, Space selects.
Colour is never the only cue: every swatch carries a label, and the label is what assistive tech announces.
Under reduced motion the ring is simply there and the dim is a colour change; the first paint never animates.

items.title: Listbox Roster
items.tagline: A marker glides the roster; ticks draw in.
items.description: An always-open multi-select — a roster you scan rather than a menu you poke. One highlight marker glides between rows as focus moves, ticking a row draws its check, and a running count keeps score.

props.name: options
props.description: Each row has an id, a label, and an optional hint.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial selection.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires the selected ids whenever they change.

usageNotes: Follows the listbox pattern on a roving tabindex — Up and Down walk and wrap, Home and End jump, Space or Enter toggles, under aria-multiselectable.
The running count is announced politely.
Under reduced motion the marker and checks are placed without the glide or draw.

items.title: Tri Toggle
items.tagline: A switch with a considered middle.
items.description: A switch with a middle. One knob rides a three-stop track — off, a considered middle, on — gliding to the chosen stop on snap with a single crisp overshoot, keyed by a shared layoutId so the same knob travels rather than three knobs blinking.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial position.

props.name: options
props.description: Exactly three stops; defaults to off / auto / on.

props.name: name
props.description: Renders a hidden native radio per stop so forms post the value.

usageNotes: A radio group under the hood — a roving tabindex where Left and Right step without wrapping past the ends, Home and End jump to off and on, Space selects.
Exactly three positions; the knob glides between them on the snap spring.
Under reduced motion the knob swaps to its stop instantly, colour only.

items.title: Skeleton Weave
items.tagline: The placeholder weaves, then hands over.
items.description: A placeholder that holds the shape of what is coming, then hands over. A sheen sweeps each row on a diagonal, staggered down the stack so the block reads as one woven surface; when the content arrives the placeholder fades and the real thing rises the last few pixels into place.

props.name: loading
props.description: While true the placeholder holds the space.

props.name: rows
props.description: Placeholder row widths; longest first reads like prose.

props.name: children
props.description: The real content, revealed when loading turns false.

usageNotes: The placeholder is aria-hidden and the region is aria-busy, so assistive tech is told the state once rather than made to read decorative bars.
A polite live region announces the wait.
Under reduced motion the placeholder is a still surface and the content simply appears.

items.title: Stage Progress
items.tagline: See which stage is slow, not just a percent.
items.description: Progress that admits it has parts. Each stage owns a segment: the ones behind you are filled and ticked, the one in flight fills to its own fraction or breathes when it cannot say, and the ones ahead wait as empty track — so you can see which stage is slow.

props.name: stages
props.description: The ordered stages; each owns a segment and a label.

props.name: current
props.description: Index of the stage in flight; earlier ones have landed.

props.name: progress
props.description: 0..1 within the current stage; omit for indeterminate.

usageNotes: Fills ride scaleX off a left origin rather than an animated width, so the bar never triggers layout.
The strip reports as one progressbar whose aria-valuetext names the stage, not a percentage.
Under reduced motion fills land in a frame, the tick is simply there, and the indeterminate stage holds steady.

items.title: Alert Bar
items.tagline: A notice that takes its own space, by severity.
items.description: An inline notice that takes its own space rather than floating over the work. Opening glides the row down from zero height while a severity stripe draws itself down the leading edge; dismissing collapses it back and the space closes behind it, so nothing below jumps.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: Controlled or initial visibility.

props.name: severity
props.description: Sets the stripe, the title tone, and how loudly it speaks.

props.name: title / children
props.description: The heading and an optional body.

usageNotes: Severity sets the role: warnings and failures mount as an assertive alert; info and success report politely and wait their turn.
Colour is paired with a title tone, never asked to carry the meaning alone.
Under reduced motion the row and its stripe are simply present or gone.

items.title: Status Pip
items.tagline: Presence that breathes, and morphs its colour.
items.description: A presence dot that stays alive without shouting. Live states breathe a slow halo out and fade it; changing state morphs the dot's colour rather than cutting to it, and the status name always travels with the dot so colour is only ever a reinforcement.

props.name: status
props.description: The current state; sets the colour and the announced name.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible text beside the dot; omit and the status name is read.

props.name: pulse
props.description: Force the halo on or off; defaults on for live states.

usageNotes: Reports through a polite live region, so a change from Online to Busy is announced once.
Colour is always paired with the status name, never the only cue.
Under reduced motion the halo drops and the colour simply changes.

items.title: Retry Pulse
items.tagline: Fail shakes, retry spins, success stamps.
items.description: An action that carries its own outcome. Failing snaps the button sideways once, then offers the retry; retrying spins a bearing where the label was; succeeding stamps a check that draws itself and lands on the recoil spring — all through one slot, so the control never changes width.

props.name: status
props.description: The controlled state driving the button.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Fired on activation while idle or errored.

props.name: label / retryLabel
props.description: The idle label and the errored label.

usageNotes: Reports aria-busy while it works and each outcome through a polite live region, so the state is spoken.
The four states swap through one fixed slot, so the button never changes width under the cursor.
Under reduced motion the shake, spin, and draw drop; the icons are simply there.

items.title: Type On
items.tagline: Types itself out, un-types on the swap.
items.description: A line that types itself out behind a caret and un-types when it is replaced. One motion value holds the revealed length and the shown substring is derived from it, so the whole run costs a single render however long the line; swapping the text backspaces the old and types the new.

props.name: text
props.description: The line to type; changing it de-types then re-types.

props.name: speed
props.description: Characters per second.

props.name: as / caret
props.description: The wrapper element and whether the caret blinks.

usageNotes: The full line is always present for assistive tech and search; only the animated copy is aria-hidden, so a screen reader is never fed one character at a time.
The substring is derived off the motion value, so a long line never costs per-character renders.
Under reduced motion the whole line prints at once with a steady caret.

items.title: Highlight Sweep
items.tagline: The marker sweeps in as the phrase arrives.
items.description: A highlighter that draws itself across a phrase the moment it scrolls into view. The marker is a wash behind the text scaled from a left origin, so it fills the way a pen would rather than fading in; it runs once, then holds.

props.name: children
props.description: The phrase to highlight.

props.name: tone
props.description: The marker wash colour.

usageNotes: The text is the content and the wash is decoration, so nothing changes what a screen reader reads.
The sweep runs once on view via an in-view trigger, then holds.
Under reduced motion the wash is placed without the sweep.

items.title: Gradient Title
items.tagline: A headline whose sheen tracks your pointer.
items.description: A heading painted with a sheen that follows the pointer. The gradient is clipped to the glyphs and oversized, so moving the pointer only slides its position — one motion value, no re-render — while the weight leans heavier under your hand and eases back when you leave.

props.name: children
props.description: The heading text.

props.name: as
props.description: The semantic wrapper element.

usageNotes: Real text inside a real heading element — structure and search are untouched; the sheen is decoration.
The sheen slides off one motion value, so a pointer move never costs a render.
Reduced motion or a coarse pointer holds the sheen centred and the weight steady.

items.title: Redact Reveal
items.tagline: The bar wipes back to reveal the words.
items.description: Text under a redaction bar that wipes away to show the words. The bar scales off its left edge, so the line is uncovered left-to-right like a marker pulled back rather than a fade; covering it again wipes the bar closed.

props.name: children
props.description: The words under the bar.

props.name: revealed
props.description: Controlled reveal; omit to let the trigger drive it.

props.name: revealOn
props.description: Uncover while hovered/focused, or toggle on a press.

usageNotes: The words underneath are always real text, readable to assistive tech whether or not the bar is drawn — the redaction is purely visual.
In press mode the field is a real toggle button; in hover mode it uncovers on hover or focus.
Under reduced motion the bar swaps in and out with no wipe.

items.title: Balance Quote
items.tagline: A balanced quote that rises word by word.
items.description: A pull-quote that sets itself well and arrives in order. The lines are balanced so no widow is left hanging, and on the way in the words rise and resolve one after another in a tight cascade — the eye is walked through the sentence rather than shown all of it at once.

props.name: children
props.description: The quotation, as plain text.

props.name: cite
props.description: Attribution shown beneath.

usageNotes: The whole quotation is one block of real text, so it reads as a sentence to assistive tech; only the per-word rise is decoration.
The cascade runs once on view via an in-view trigger, then rests.
Under reduced motion the quote is set in place with no cascade.

items.title: Split Pane
items.tagline: Drag the divider; it snaps to thirds.
items.description: Two panes with a divider you can move. Dragging tracks the handle one to one; on release it eases to the nearest snap — the thirds and the half — if it is close, and stays put otherwise. The grabber swells while hovered or held so the hit target announces itself.

props.name: start / end
props.description: The two pane contents.

props.name: defaultSplit / min / max
props.description: Start width and travel limits, in percent.

props.name: snap
props.description: Targets the divider settles to on release, within 4%.

usageNotes: The divider is a real separator with a value — arrows nudge, Shift jumps, Home and End go to the limits, and it reads its position aloud.
Drag is one to one; the snap glides only on release.
Under reduced motion the snap lands without the glide.

items.title: Masonry Flow
items.tagline: Filter the wall; the tiles FLIP to fit.
items.description: A masonry that keeps its tiles when the set changes. Columns are laid by the browser so the count follows the width for free; when a filter drops or adds tiles, each survivor FLIPs from its old box to its new one while the ones leaving fade down and the ones arriving fade up.

props.name: items
props.description: Tiles keyed by a stable id so motion tracks them across reflows.

props.name: minColumnWidth
props.description: Column width; the browser fits as many as span.

usageNotes: Tiles are keyed by a stable id, which lets motion follow the same tile across a reflow rather than cross-fading unrelated boxes.
The parent controls the filtered set; the component animates whatever it is handed.
Under reduced motion the FLIP and fades drop; tiles appear in their new places.

items.title: Expander Tree
items.tagline: Open a branch; the children cascade in.
items.description: A nested disclosure that opens with a little procession. Expanding a node glides its panel to height while a guide line draws down the indent and the children arrive one after another, so the hierarchy reads as it unfolds rather than snapping open.

props.name: nodes
props.description: The tree; each node has a label and optional children.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Node ids expanded on first render.

usageNotes: Each parent is a real disclosure button carrying aria-expanded over the region it controls, so the tree is walked and toggled with Tab and Space.
The guide line and the per-child cascade are decorative; the structure is the list.
Under reduced motion panels open and close instantly with no draw or cascade.

items.title: Sticky Stack
items.tagline: Headers stack at the top, then peel away.
items.description: Scroll a run of sections and their headers stack up at the top instead of one replacing the next. Each header sticks a header-height lower than the last, piling into a legible ledger of where you are; when a section scrolls past, its header releases and peels away, uncovering the one beneath.

props.name: sections
props.description: Each carries a title and its content.

props.name: headerHeight / height
props.description: Header height (the stack step) and the viewport height, in px.

usageNotes: Pure sticky positioning — no scroll listeners, no transforms, nothing per frame — so it is inert under reduced motion and cheap on a long list.
The scroll region is a labelled, keyboard-focusable landmark.
Headers stack by an increasing sticky offset, then peel with their section when it ends.

items.title: Cursor Lens
items.tagline: A glass that magnifies under your pointer.
items.description: A round glass that follows the pointer and magnifies whatever is beneath it. The magnified copy scales about the exact point under the cursor and a fixed circular clip travels with it, both driven off two motion values — so the glass tracks the cursor without a single render.

props.name: children
props.description: The content under the glass; keep it presentational.

props.name: zoom / size
props.description: Magnification and lens diameter in px.

usageNotes: The lens tracks the pointer off motion values, so moving it never costs a render.
A fine-pointer instrument: on touch it steps aside and the content is left plain; the magnified copy is aria-hidden, so it is read once.
It has no ambient motion — it moves only when you do — so it needs no reduced-motion pathway.

items.title: Cursor Label
items.tagline: The cursor names what it is over.
items.description: A cursor that says what a thing does. Inside the region it rides a small dot that trails the pointer; cross an element tagged with a verb and the dot morphs into a pill carrying that word, snapping back to a dot on the way out — the guidance lives with the element.

props.name: children
props.description: The region; tag any element with data-cursor="Verb".

usageNotes: The pill is decoration and aria-hidden; the real elements keep their own roles, focus, and hit areas.
A fine-pointer flourish — on touch the region renders plain.
Under reduced motion the pill tracks and morphs without the trailing spring.

items.title: Trail Ink
items.tagline: Ink that follows your hand, then dries.
items.description: A brush that lays wet ink under the pointer and lets it dry away. Each sample is stamped with a birth time; the loop tapers every segment by how fast you were moving and fades it as it ages, so a fast flick leaves a thin quick line and a slow drag a heavier one, then the whole stroke dries to nothing.

props.name: height
props.description: Panel height in px.

props.name: fade
props.description: Seconds a stroke takes to dry and fade.

usageNotes: A disciplined canvas: DPR capped at 2, ResizeObserver, IntersectionObserver + visibility gating, and it idle-stops the moment the last stroke has dried.
Colours are read from the theme and re-resolved on a light/dark flip.
Under reduced motion there is no drying loop — the pointer leaves a still mark and moves on.

items.title: Reveal Stagger
items.tagline: Children rise into view, one after another.
items.description: Wrap a group and its children arrive in sequence as it scrolls into view — each rising a little and resolving, stepped by a stagger that tightens automatically so a long list never reads as lag. It runs once, then stays put.

props.name: children
props.description: The group; each direct child gets its own entrance.

props.name: step
props.description: Seconds between children; auto-tightens under the budget.

usageNotes: Children are rendered exactly as given, each in its own layer, so markup and reading order are unchanged.
The entrance runs once on view via an in-view trigger.
Under reduced motion every child is placed at once with no rise.

items.title: Marquee Swap
items.tagline: Lines roll upward through one slot.
items.description: One line at a time, rolling upward. The current line lifts out the top as the next rises from the bottom into the same clipped slot, so a run of phrases reads as a single rolling display rather than a stack.

props.name: items
props.description: The lines to roll through, in order.

props.name: interval
props.description: Seconds each line holds before the next rolls up.

usageNotes: The live line is announced politely, so the rotation is not lost to a screen reader.
The slot is clipped, so only the live line shows.
Reduced motion is deliberately still — it holds the first line and does not auto-roll.

items.title: Progress Scrub
items.tagline: A progress bar you can also scrub.
items.description: A reading bar that both reports and drives. As you scroll the region its fill tracks how far through you are; grab the bar and you scrub the other way — the region scrolls to wherever you drag, so the same control shows progress and seeks with it.

props.name: children
props.description: The scrollable content.

props.name: height
props.description: Scroll region height in px.

usageNotes: The bar is a real slider — it carries its position for assistive tech, and arrows, Home, and End step and jump the scroll.
Scrolling and scrubbing are two-way bound onto the same control.
Under reduced motion a seek jumps straight to the target instead of gliding.

items.title: Sticky Reveal
items.tagline: The stage pins; scenes cross-fade on scroll.
items.description: A stage that stays put while the story scrolls through it. The panel pins to the top and the scroll drives which scene is lit — each cross-fades in as its stretch of the track arrives while a rail of dots marks the position, so a short sequence plays out in place.

props.name: scenes
props.description: The ordered scenes, one lit at a time.

props.name: height
props.description: Pinned stage height in px.

usageNotes: The scroll region is a labelled, keyboard-focusable landmark, and off-scene panels are hidden from assistive tech.
Reduced motion refuses the pin: it lays the scenes out as a plain stacked list, all readable.
Nothing is gated behind the scroll animation.

items.title: Confetti Pop
items.tagline: A press throws confetti that rains back down.
items.description: A burst of confetti with real fall to it. Each bit is thrown from the press point with a seeded spread, then pulled down by gravity, slowed by drag, spun, and faded — so the spray arcs up and rains back. Colours come from the theme, and it is deterministic: the same press throws the same shape.

props.name: count
props.description: Bits per burst.

props.name: onPop
props.description: Fires on each burst.

props.name: height
props.description: Panel height in px.

usageNotes: The canvas is DPR-capped, ResizeObserver-sized, IntersectionObserver + visibility gated, and idle-stops the instant the last bit has fallen.
The trigger is a real button (Enter and Space); the canvas is decorative and aria-hidden.
Under reduced motion a press lays a single still spray instead of raining.

items.title: Sound Toggle
items.tagline: The waves draw out; the slash strikes in.
items.description: A mute switch whose sound is visible. Turning it on draws the waves out of the speaker in a quick outward stagger; muting retracts them and strikes a slash across in their place, so the state is legible at a glance without reading a word.

props.name: on / defaultOn
props.description: Controlled or initial sound-on state.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires the new state on toggle.

usageNotes: A real switch — checked and labelled, toggles on Enter and Space, state announced.
The waves and slash carry the state visually so colour is never the only cue.
Under reduced motion the waves and slash swap in place with no draw.

items.title: Sticker Peel
items.tagline: Grab a corner; it curls, then lifts clean off.
items.description: A sticker you can actually peel. Drag it and the grabbed corner curls up off the surface, a shadow pools beneath, and the card tilts away; release before the threshold and it snaps back into place, or past it and it lifts clean off to bare the dashed slot underneath. A paired button peels and re-sticks it for keyboard and pointer-free use.

props.name: children
props.description: The sticker face.

props.name: width / height
props.description: Sticker size in px.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Drag distance in px past which a release removes it.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the sticker and its control.

props.name: onPeel / onRestore
props.description: Fire when the sticker lifts off or re-sticks.

usageNotes: Drag any corner to peel; release short of the threshold and it recoils back into the slot.
The paired button peels and re-sticks it, so the interaction is never drag-only.
Under reduced motion the lift is a plain fade with no curl, tilt, or spring.

items.title: Boop Mascot
items.tagline: Boop it — the whole head squashes and springs back.
items.description: A small face that reacts. Its eyes follow the pointer on a drift spring, and a click, tap, or Enter/Space boops it — the whole head squashes and springs back, the eyes pinch shut, the smile rounds into an open O, and the cheeks flush for a beat before it settles.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the toy.

props.name: size
props.description: Rendered pixel size of the square face.

props.name: onBoop
props.description: Fires on every boop.

usageNotes: A real button — boops on click, tap, and Enter or Space, with an accessible name.
Eye-tracking only engages for a fine pointer; touch just boops.
Under reduced motion it still boops the face and cheeks but skips the squash and the eye spring.

items.title: Popover Menu
items.tagline: Unfolds from the trigger; the arrow keeps its aim.
items.description: A trigger-anchored menu that unfolds from its button on a single crisp overshoot, a small arrow tracking the trigger. It flips side or alignment when the viewport runs short so it never spills off-screen, and carries full menu semantics: roving arrow keys, Home and End, Escape and outside-click to close, and focus returned to the trigger on select.

props.name: items
props.description: The menu rows — id, label, optional icon, disabled, onSelect.

props.name: items[].children
props.description: One flyout level. A row with children opens on hover, click, or ArrowRight; ArrowLeft steps back, and Escape steps out before it closes the menu.

props.name: children
props.description: Trigger label / content.

props.name: side
props.description: Preferred side; flips when the viewport is tight.

props.name: align
props.description: Preferred horizontal edge; flips on overflow.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the menu surface.

usageNotes: Open with click or ArrowDown; move with the arrow keys, Home, and End; select with Enter.
The panel flips side and alignment to stay on-screen, and the arrow re-aims at the trigger.
Escape or an outside click closes it and returns focus to the trigger.
Under reduced motion it appears without the unfold or the row cascade.

items.title: Context Menu
items.tagline: Springs from the right-click; cascades into submenus.
items.description: A menu that springs from the point you right-click. It clamps to the viewport — flipping up or left near an edge — cascades its rows in, and opens nested submenus to the side on hover or ArrowRight. Full keyboard control: the Menu or Shift+F10 key opens it from the focused region, arrows and Home/End move, ArrowLeft steps back out of a submenu, Escape and an outside click dismiss, and focus returns to the region.

props.name: items
props.description: Rows — id, label, icon, shortcut, disabled, separator, nested items, onSelect.

props.name: children
props.description: The region that owns the menu.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the menu surface.

usageNotes: Right-click the region, or focus it and press the Menu key or Shift+F10.
Arrows and Home/End move; ArrowRight opens a submenu, ArrowLeft steps back out.
Escape or an outside click closes it and returns focus to the region.
Under reduced motion it appears without the spring or the row cascade.

items.title: Hover Card
items.tagline: A preview that floats up from an inline anchor.
items.description: A rich preview that expands from an inline anchor. Hovering the trigger — or focusing it — floats a card in on a single overshoot with a small arrow; the pointer can cross into the card without it closing, and it retracts a beat after you leave. The card flips above the anchor when the space below runs short.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Inline anchor — a link, name, or chip.

props.name: children
props.description: Rich card content; may be interactive.

props.name: side / align
props.description: Preferred placement; side flips when the viewport is tight.

props.name: openDelay / closeDelay
props.description: Hover open delay and the grace period before closing, in ms.

usageNotes: Opens on hover after a short delay, or immediately on keyboard focus.
The pointer can move onto the card to interact without it closing.
Escape closes it; the card flips above the anchor when the space below is short.
Under reduced motion it cross-fades in place with no scale or travel.

items.title: Spotlight Tour
items.tagline: A moving spotlight walks the eye through each step.
items.description: A guided onboarding tour. A dimming scrim cuts a moving spotlight over each target in turn while a popover explains it, gliding from one step to the next; the highlighted element stays lit through the dark. Arrow keys and the buttons step through, Escape or the close control ends it, focus is trapped in the popover, and the spotlight re-tracks its target on scroll and resize.

props.name: steps
props.description: Ordered steps — id, a target ref, title, and body.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the tour is running (controlled).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires when the tour opens or closes.

props.name: onFinish
props.description: Fires when the last step is completed, not merely dismissed.

usageNotes: Point each step at an element via a ref; the spotlight scrolls it into view.
Arrow keys move between steps, Escape or the close button ends the tour.
Focus is trapped in the popover and the scrim traps clicks behind it.
Under reduced motion the spotlight jumps between steps instead of gliding.

items.title: Gauge Cluster
items.tagline: Needles sweep up to value; the red zone bites.
items.description: A row of needle gauges. On mount each needle sweeps up from rest to its value while the arc fills in behind it, and any reading in the red zone turns its arc and readout to the danger colour. Each dial reads as a meter to assistive tech.

props.name: gauges
props.description: Dials — id, label, value, min, max, unit, and an optional redline.

usageNotes: Each dial exposes role=meter with min, max, and the current value.
A reading at or above its redline flips the arc and number to the danger colour.
Under reduced motion the needles and arcs land at value with no sweep.

items.title: Bar Race
items.tagline: Bars overtake each other as the numbers move.
items.description: A ranked bar chart that races. When the values change the bars grow or shrink and the rows swap places with a FLIP glide, so a lead change reads as one continuous overtake rather than a redraw. Presented as a list for assistive tech.

props.name: items
props.description: Current standings — id, label, value, optional color.

props.name: max
props.description: Fixed scale ceiling; defaults to the current leader.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the trailing readout.

usageNotes: Feed a new items array and the rows re-rank and resize toward it.
Colours are keyed to each item's id so they stay put through a reorder.
Under reduced motion the bars resize and re-rank without the glide.

items.title: Donut Breakdown
items.tagline: Slices draw in; hover pops one and reads its share.
items.description: A donut whose segments draw themselves in around the ring in turn. Hovering a slice — or focusing its legend entry — pops it outward and swaps the centre readout to that slice's share; the legend carries the full data for assistive tech.

props.name: segments
props.description: Slices — id, label, value, optional color.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the centre and legend readouts.

props.name: totalLabel
props.description: Heading for the default centre readout.

usageNotes: Hover a slice or focus its legend button to pop it and read its share.
The legend buttons are the keyboard path and announce each slice's percent.
Under reduced motion the ring lands whole with no draw or pop.

items.title: Heat Calendar
items.tagline: A year of days, warming cell by cell.
items.description: A contribution heatmap. Cells wash in on a short diagonal cascade, and moving across the grid — by pointer or the arrow keys — floats a readout of that day's tally. Roving focus keeps the whole grid to a single tab stop.

props.name: days
props.description: Chronological days — date and count — laid out in columns of seven.

props.name: max
props.description: Scale ceiling for the four levels; defaults to the busiest day.

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit shown in the hover readout.

usageNotes: Arrow keys move a single roving focus across days; the readout follows.
Levels bucket each count into four filled shades against the ceiling.
Under reduced motion the cells appear filled with no cascade.

items.title: Breadcrumb Trail
items.tagline: The trail draws itself; the middle folds away.
items.description: A breadcrumb whose separators draw themselves in as a connected trail. When the path outgrows its width the middle folds into an ellipsis that expands the hidden crumbs back in on click, and the last crumb is marked as the current page.

props.name: items
props.description: The path — id, label, optional href.

props.name: maxVisible
props.description: Crumbs shown before the middle collapses into an ellipsis.

props.name: onNavigate
props.description: Called on activation; prevents default navigation when set.

usageNotes: Past maxVisible the middle collapses to an ellipsis that expands on click.
The last crumb is the current page and is never a link.
Under reduced motion the trail and any reveal appear without drawing.

items.title: Pagination Rail
items.tagline: The active pill slides; each page previews on hover.
items.description: A pager with a lively active pill. Changing pages slides the filled indicator from the old number to the new one on a single overshoot, and hovering or focusing any page floats a preview above it. Prev and Next clamp at the ends.

props.name: total / page
props.description: Total pages and the current 1-based page.

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Fires with the requested page.

props.name: siblingCount
props.description: Pages kept either side of the current before an ellipsis.

props.name: preview
props.description: Content for the hover/focus preview over a page.

usageNotes: The filled indicator is a shared element that slides between pages.
Hovering or focusing a page floats its preview; Prev and Next disable at the ends.
Under reduced motion the pill jumps and previews cross-fade without travel.

items.title: Stepper Flow
items.tagline: Connectors fill, cleared steps stamp a check.
items.description: A wizard stepper. As the active step advances, the connector into each cleared step fills and its node stamps a check on a springy landing; the current node holds a ring and any earlier node can be clicked to step back.

props.name: steps
props.description: The steps — id, label, optional description.

props.name: current
props.description: Active step index; steps before it read as complete.

props.name: onStepChange
props.description: Fires when a completed or current step is clicked.

usageNotes: Cleared steps stamp a check and their inbound connector fills.
Earlier steps are clickable to go back; upcoming steps are disabled.
Under reduced motion the fills and checks land with no draw.

items.title: Newton's Cradle
items.tagline: The end ball pops out; the middle holds still.
items.description: A Newton's cradle rendered in SVG. The end ball falls, the line holds still, and the momentum pops out the far ball — a perpetual, deterministic transfer. The swing eases in on the fall and out on the rise so it reads as gravity, and the inner balls never move.

props.name: count
props.description: Number of balls, clamped to 3–7.

props.name: period
props.description: Seconds per full left-right cycle.

usageNotes: The swing eases in on the fall and out on the rise for a gravity feel.
Rendered as an image with a descriptive label; the inner balls stay put.
Under reduced motion it holds one ball drawn aside, mid-transfer.

items.title: Gooey Blob
items.tagline: Metaballs that chase the pointer, merging and splitting.
items.description: A cluster of metaballs that behave like one gooey mass on canvas. The lead blob chases the pointer; the others hold a loose ring and get drawn in when it passes, necks stretching between them and snapping as they part — merge and split with no seams. The union is a single filled path of circles bridged by tangent-matched bezier necks over a lightly damped spring.

props.name: count
props.description: Blobs including the pointer follower, clamped to 3–7.

props.name: height
props.description: Stage height in px when standalone.

props.name: children
props.description: Overlay content above the canvas.

usageNotes: The lead blob follows the pointer and pulls the others in as it passes.
DPR-capped canvas, ResizeObserver-sized, the loop pauses offscreen or when hidden.
Under reduced motion it paints one settled arrangement and never animates.

items.title: Plinko Drop
items.tagline: Pegs scatter the drops; the bins bell out.
items.description: A Galton board on canvas. Balls drip from the top, glance off a lattice of pegs with a deterministic left-or-right nudge at each hit, and drop into the bins below — where the tally settles into a bell curve. Click the board to drop one where you point. Each ball's path is seeded from its drop index, so the whole run is reproducible.

props.name: rows
props.description: Peg rows, clamped to 5–12.

props.name: height
props.description: Stage height in px when standalone.

props.name: children
props.description: Overlay content above the canvas.

usageNotes: A steady drip fills the bins; clicking the board drops a ball where you point.
Each ball's bounces are seeded from its index, so the run is reproducible.
Under reduced motion it paints one settled board with a filled histogram.

items.title: Range Dual
items.tagline: Two thumbs that shove each other, never crossing.
items.description: A dual-thumb range where the thumbs collide and shove. Drag one into the other and it carries the second along instead of stopping, so the span never inverts; the filled bar tracks between them and a value bubble lifts over whichever thumb is live. Both thumbs are real sliders — arrows, Home/End, and PageUp/Down all push the same way.

props.name: value
props.description: Current low and high pair.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the new pair.

props.name: min / max / step
props.description: Bounds and increment.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the bubble and aria-valuetext.

usageNotes: Dragging a thumb past the other pushes it along instead of stopping.
Each thumb is a slider — arrows, PageUp/Down, and Home/End all apply.
Under reduced motion the bubbles and thumbs settle without spring.

items.title: Stepper Number
items.tagline: Hold to accelerate; the readout rolls like an odometer.
items.description: A number spinner with weight to it. Hold a button and it accelerates from a tick to a blur; each change rolls the readout like an odometer, up or down with the direction of travel; and a push past the limit nudges and bounces back instead of doing nothing. A real spinbutton — arrows, PageUp/Down, and Home/End all work.

props.name: value
props.description: Current value (controlled).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the new value.

props.name: min / max / step
props.description: Bounds and increment.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the display and aria-valuetext.

usageNotes: Press and hold a button to accelerate; the readout rolls with the direction.
A real spinbutton: arrows step, PageUp/Down jump by ten, Home/End clamp.
Under reduced motion the readout swaps with no roll or bounce.

items.title: Tag Field
items.tagline: Type, Enter, chip. Paste a list, it splits.
items.description: A field that turns text into tokens. Type and press Enter or comma to chip a tag in on a spring; paste a delimited list and it splits into several at once; backspace on an empty field lifts the last one back off. Removing a chip reflows the rest with a FLIP glide, and duplicates are ignored.

props.name: value
props.description: Current tags (controlled).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the new tag list.

props.name: maxTags
props.description: Optional cap on the number of tags.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Input placeholder.

usageNotes: Enter or comma commits the current token; paste a delimited list to add many.
Backspace on an empty field removes the last tag; each chip has a remove button.
Under reduced motion chips appear and leave with no spring or reflow.

items.title: Gradient Drift
items.tagline: Soft blobs drift behind the content — no canvas.
items.description: An ambient backdrop of soft gradient blobs that drift and breathe past each other — pure CSS and transforms, no canvas or WebGL. Each blob follows its own slow mirrored loop at a different tempo, so the field never visibly repeats, and heavy blur melts them into a single wash behind your content.

props.name: height
props.description: Stage height in px when standalone.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered above the wash.

usageNotes: Pure CSS and transforms — no canvas or WebGL, safe to layer widely.
Each blob loops on its own tempo so the field never visibly repeats.
Under reduced motion the blobs hold a fixed, composed arrangement.

items.title: Particle Network
items.tagline: Nodes thread together; the pointer pulls the web in.
items.description: A drifting mesh of nodes that link up when they come close — the nearer two nodes, the brighter the thread between them. The pointer draws the nearest nodes toward it, tightening the web, then lets them wander off. Rendered flat on canvas, distinct from any 3D field.

props.name: count
props.description: Node count, clamped to 20–90.

props.name: height
props.description: Stage height in px when standalone.

props.name: children
props.description: Overlay content above the canvas.

usageNotes: Nodes link when close, the thread brightening as they near; the pointer gathers them.
DPR-capped canvas, ResizeObserver-sized, the loop pauses offscreen or when hidden.
Under reduced motion it paints one settled web.

items.title: Flow Field
items.tagline: Particles comb along an invisible current, trailing tails.
items.description: Streaks combed by an invisible current. Each particle reads a smooth, slowly-evolving angle field and drifts along it, trailing a fading tail; when one runs off the edge or ages out it respawns elsewhere, so the field keeps flowing. The field is a closed-form sum of sines — deterministic, no noise tables.

props.name: count
props.description: Particle count, clamped to 40–240.

props.name: height
props.description: Stage height in px when standalone.

props.name: children
props.description: Overlay content above the canvas.

usageNotes: Particles follow a closed-form angle field and respawn as they age or exit.
A sim-time clock advances only while running, so pauses never jump the field.
Under reduced motion it paints one settled comb of trails.

items.title: Volley Thread
items.tagline: Each turn lands under its own weight.
items.description: A conversation where each turn arrives under its own weight. A message enters from the side that owns it, rides in on the glide spring, and settles; consecutive turns from one speaker stagger against each other on the cascade budget, so a burst reads as a run of thought rather than a dump. Speaker is carried three ways — the side it sits on, a mono label above each run, and a screen-reader name on every bubble — never by colour alone.

props.name: messages
props.description: Turns to render, each with an id, a role, and content.

props.name: pending
props.description: Held open at the foot of the thread while a reply forms.

props.name: follow
props.description: Follow the newest message as it lands.

usageNotes: Runs of one speaker stagger on the cascade budget; a change of speaker restarts it.
The list is a log with polite live semantics, so additions announce without taking focus.
Under reduced motion the travel is dropped and turns resolve in place.

items.title: Prompt Well
items.tagline: Deepens as the thought gets longer.
items.description: A composer that deepens as the thought gets longer, growing line by line to a row cap and then holding and scrolling so the send control never walks down the page. Typing @ opens the sources it can draw on and / opens the commands it can run, filtered as you type; the list rises on snap, arrow keys move, Enter or Tab takes one. The field is a combobox over that list with an active descendant, so the highlighted row is announced without the caret leaving the text.

props.name: attachments / onAttach / onRemoveAttachment
props.description: A chip row above the field and a paperclip in the tool row; all optional.

props.name: queued / credits
props.type: string[] · { used: number; limit: number; label?: string }
props.description: Messages waiting while busy, and a small usage pill in the tool row.

props.name: sources
props.description: Offered after @, anywhere a word can start.

props.name: commands
props.description: Offered after /, and only when it leads the prompt.

props.name: busy
props.description: Swaps send for stop and blocks submission.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Rows the well grows to before it scrolls.

props.name: models / model / onModelChange
props.description: A cycling model chip in the footer — the current choice is always printed, never hidden in a menu.

props.name: onDictate
props.description: Offers a dictation control beside send; the well never records audio itself.

props.name: shape
props.description: The container silhouette.

usageNotes: A trigger only counts at the start of a word and a space closes it, so prose never opens the list.
Enter sends and Shift+Enter breaks the line; Escape dismisses the list without clearing the field.
Under reduced motion the list appears in place and the control swaps without travel.

items.title: Code Lathe
items.tagline: Turned out one line at a time.
items.description: A listing turned out line by line, the way an agent actually writes one — each line landing a beat behind the one above so the block builds at a readable pace instead of appearing whole. Highlighting is a single deterministic pass over comments, strings, numbers, and words: enough to read a snippet by, with no parser and nothing to load. In diff mode a leading plus or minus becomes a gutter marker and a tinted row, and is stripped from what gets copied.

props.name: code
props.description: The source to display.

props.name: stream
props.description: Turn the listing out line by line instead of whole.

props.name: diff
props.description: Read a leading +/- as an edit and mark the gutter.

props.name: perLine
props.description: Seconds per line while streaming.

usageNotes: Every line is in the DOM from the first frame and only dimmed while it waits, so copy and screen readers always see the whole source.
Highlighting is regex-only and language-agnostic; it never ships a grammar or a worker.
Under reduced motion the listing is simply there, complete and still.

items.title: Work Lamp
items.tagline: A wait with a clock on it is a report.
items.description: The lamp that says the bench is busy: one of four honest faces — a shimmering pixel grid, breathing dots, an orbiting pair, a sweeping bar — beside the work's name and a ticking elapsed readout. A wait with a clock on it is a report; a wait without one is a hope. Time starts at mount, never the wall clock at render, so server and client always agree.

props.name: face
props.description: Which lamp is lit.

props.name: label
props.description: What the bench is doing, in a word or two.

props.name: elapsed
props.description: Externally-owned seconds; omit and the lamp keeps time from mount.

props.name: showElapsed
props.description: Show the ticking readout beside the label.

usageNotes: The elapsed numeral is plain tabular figures, not a rolling readout — at ten ticks a second a carry-roll is noise.
Under reduced motion the faces hold still but the clock keeps ticking: elapsed time is information, not decoration.
aria-live is off by design; a loader that announces every tick talks over the answer it precedes.

items.title: Train of Thought
items.tagline: Reasoning available, never performed.
items.description: The agent's working shown as a trace: a quiet summary chip — Thought for 4 seconds — that opens into the steps it actually took, cascading in as plain clauses, searches with hit counts, and mono tool lines. The chip is the honest default: reasoning is available, never performed at the reader, and the active step carries a breathing marker so a live trace reads as live.

props.name: summary
props.description: The chip line, e.g. "Thought for 4 seconds".

props.name: steps
props.description: The trace: plain steps, searches with counts, mono code lines; one may be active.

props.name: open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled disclosure.

usageNotes: Default closed on purpose — the trace is for the reader who asks, not a performance for everyone.
Mark at most one step active; its breathing dot is what makes a live trace read as live.
Under reduced motion the drawer opens instantly and steps print in place.

items.title: Source Stream
items.tagline: Provenance at the point of assertion.
items.description: An answer that streams in with its sources landing inline: prose arrives word by word, and when a claim finishes, its citation chip drops into the sentence right where the claim was made — provenance at the point of assertion, not footnoted at the end. A sources tray sums the run, and follow-up asks appear only once the stream is done.

props.name: segments
props.description: The answer in claim-sized pieces; a segment's source chip lands when its words finish.

props.name: followUps / onFollowUp
props.description: Suggested next asks, offered after completion.

props.name: rate
props.description: Words per second while streaming.

props.name: immediate
props.description: Print whole at once (reduced motion forces this too).

usageNotes: The stream is a mount-driven tick, never the wall clock — a re-render never re-streams.
The live region announces once, at completion; a per-word live region reads the answer out dozens of times.
Segment at claim boundaries: the chip belongs to the sentence that needed it.

items.title: Countersign
items.tagline: Asked before acting, never after.
items.description: The questions an agent asks before it acts, paged one at a time: pick an option, then press Continue — picking never advances on its own, because a card that moves the moment you touch it cannot be reconsidered, and these are precisely the decisions that deserve a second look. Skip is always offered; a human-in-the-loop card that cannot be declined is a form wearing a question's clothes.

props.name: questions
props.description: Each with a prompt and its option pills; answered as a radiogroup.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Fired once at the end; skipped questions are absent from the record.

props.name: heading / skipLabel / continueLabel / doneLine
props.description: The card's fixed copy.

usageNotes: Selection never auto-advances — Continue is the countersignature.
Skip is per-question and honest: a skipped answer is absent, not defaulted.
The finished card reads back every decision, so the sign-off is inspectable after the fact.

items.title: Tool Trace
items.tagline: The run at chip height.
items.description: A tool run folded into a chip: collapsed, one line says what happened — 4 tool calls, 2 messages — and open, the run replays as its parts: a thinking note, a code write on the lathe, a command with its checks printing, a read with what was seen. File-change chips close the run with +/− counts and an honest overflow. The point is proportion: agents work loudly, and a transcript that prints every tool call at full height buries the answer the run was for.

props.name: calls
props.description: Thinking, write, run, and read parts, in order.

props.name: changes / maxChanges
props.description: File chips with +/− counts; the rest fold into +N more.

props.name: summary / defaultOpen
props.description: The collapsed line, and whether the run starts open.

usageNotes: The code write composes code-lathe (whole, diff gutters on), so the snippet is copyable and complete for assistive tech from first paint.
Collapsed is the honest default — the answer matters more than the machinery that fetched it.
The overflow count is real: chips beyond maxChanges are counted, never dropped silently.

items.title: Run Sheet
items.tagline: Failures shown, not folded in.
items.description: The agent's task list as a working document: parent tasks carrying a rolling count, child rows carrying their own verdicts — done ticks, a breathing running dot, failures shown red rather than folded into a success number. Two faces: capsules for a panel, a flat list for a transcript. Statuses are carried by word and mark together, never by colour alone.

props.name: tasks
props.description: Parents with counts and their child items, each with a status.

props.name: face
props.description: Capsule cards for a panel, a flat rail for a transcript.

usageNotes: Counts roll on the readout — they are the part that changes while you watch.
A failed child stays red under a done parent; hiding it inside an aggregate is how trust is lost.
Every status is announced by word for screen readers; the mark alone is never the message.

items.title: Counsel Card
items.tagline: Sureness stated, or nothing.
items.description: One suggestion, offered rather than executed: the counsel in a sentence with its subject carried as a chip, an honest tri-state confidence meter — high, needs review, no signal — and the alternatives kept a fold away with their own confidence attached. The meter is the card's spine: a recommendation that cannot say how sure it is will be trusted exactly once.

props.name: counsel / subject
props.description: The sentence and the entity chip carried inside it.

props.name: confidence
props.description: The tri-state meter — bars and words together.

props.name: alternatives
props.description: Each with its own confidence, kept a fold away.

props.name: onAccept
props.description: Fired once; accepting seals the card so nothing executes twice.

usageNotes: Alternatives carry their own meters — a list of options without confidence is a menu, not counsel.
Accepting seals the card in place; the accepted state reads back what happened.
The meter pairs bars with words, so confidence is never carried by colour alone.

items.title: Source Shelf
items.tagline: What the model was given, on the shelf.
items.description: The retrieved context, shelved in plain sight: each chunk carries its title, the excerpt itself, a character count, and the document it came from typed by kind — so what the model was given is inspectable, not implied. The count header admits how much of the working set is off-shelf. An answer's context is part of the answer; a system that hides its retrieval asks to be trusted twice.

props.name: chunks
props.description: Title, excerpt, pre-counted characters, and a typed source document.

props.name: total
props.description: The full working set, including chunks not shown.

usageNotes: Character counts are pre-counted data, not derived from the excerpt — the excerpt is a cut, the count is the whole.
State the off-shelf remainder via total; a shelf that looks complete when it is not is a quiet lie.
Source kind chips are text, not icons, so a new file type needs no asset.

items.title: Redline Table
items.tagline: A per-row veto on wholesale edits.
