props.description: The month's budget.

props.name: day
props.description: Day of the month, 1-based; places the pace mark on the ring.

props.name: daysInMonth
props.description: Length of the month.

props.name: readout / defaultReadout
props.description: Controlled or initial centre figure.

props.name: onReadoutChange
props.description: Fires from the click or key that changed the centre figure.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every money figure; defaults to an explicit en-US currency formatter.

props.name: size
props.description: Ring diameter in px, applied as a maximum — the ring shrinks with its container rather than overhanging it.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the ring; printed above it and used for assistive technology.

usageNotes: A role="meter" whose aria-valuetext reads the month as a sentence, plus a two-stop radio group with a roving tabindex: Arrow keys move and select, Home and End jump, Space selects.
The pace mark walks the circle as a dash on the ring's own geometry, so no trigonometry reaches an attribute and nothing can differ between the server's markup and the browser's.
Under reduced motion nothing springs, but the arc still fills and the mark still walks, because where the month stands is the information.

items.title: Category Bars
items.tagline: Where the money went.
items.description: A month's spend sorted heaviest first, each bar drawing in from its left origin on glide under a cascade() stagger so the board settles inside the choreography budget. Bars are scaled against the largest category rather than the total, which keeps the smallest one legible, and the total above them rolls its digits on snap whenever the figures change. Pressing a row unpacks its merchants: a ResizeObserver measures the panel and the frame glides to that height rather than reserving one, while the rows arrive on snap from a nudge of travel; Arrow Up and Down walk the headers, Home and End jump to the ends, Enter and Space toggle.

props.name: categories
props.description: { id, label, amount, merchants? } — sorted internally, heaviest first.

props.name: expanded / defaultExpanded
props.description: Controlled or initial open category id.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Fires from the click or key that opened or closed a row.

props.name: total
props.description: The figure that rolls above the board; defaults to the sum of the categories.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every amount; defaults to an explicit en-US currency formatter.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the board; printed above it.

usageNotes: The disclosure pattern: every header is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls and stays in the tab order, while Arrow Up and Down walk between them and Home and End jump to the ends.
The merchant panel's height is measured with a ResizeObserver, so a category with two merchants takes the room two merchants need and nothing reserves space for a state.
Under reduced motion the bars still fill and the panel still opens — that is the information — but without stagger, travel, or spring.

items.title: Forecast Line
items.tagline: Where the balance is heading.
items.description: A balance chart whose line changes character at today: solid for what happened, the same stroke dashed for what is only projected, because a forecast is a claim and should not be drawn like a fact. Toggling a scheduled bill re-prices the plan and a clip rectangle sweeps open from today's dot to the end of the month on glide, which is what lets the redraw keep its dashes; the closing figure counts through a motion value on snap and today's dot holds a slow drift breath. Every bill is a real switch in the tab order, and a projection that crosses zero shades the band below the axis and marks the day in danger.

props.name: history
props.description: Actual closing balances for day 1 through today, in order.

props.name: bills
props.description: { id, label, day, amount } — future outflows the forecast may include.

props.name: enabled / defaultEnabled
props.description: Controlled or initial ids of the bills in the plan; defaults to every bill.

props.name: onEnabledChange
props.description: Fires from the click or key that toggled a bill.

props.name: onProjectionChange
props.description: Fires from the same event with the newly priced plan: points, closing balance, and the first short day.

props.name: days
props.description: Days on the x axis; the forecast runs from the end of the history to here.

props.name: dailyBurn
props.description: Average daily spend carried through the forecast, on top of the bills.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every money figure; defaults to an explicit en-US currency formatter.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in px; the width is fluid.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the chart; printed above it.

usageNotes: Each bill is a button with role="switch" and aria-checked in the tab order; Enter and Space toggle it, and a polite status announces the new projection once per action rather than once per frame.
The module also exports projectBalance, the pure walk the chart uses, so a host can price a plan for a summary line without mounting a second chart to ask.
Under reduced motion the forecast swaps rather than sweeps and today's dot does not breathe, but the line still moves where the money moves it.

items.title: Spend Alert
items.tagline: A warning that arrives softly.
items.description: Crossing the warning threshold slides an alert pill in from a shift above its rail on glide — no overshoot, because a warning that celebrates is a warning nobody believes — and a halo behind its icon breathes between two keyframes on drift, reversing forever. Crossing the limit is a different state rather than a louder one: the copy and the colour turn danger and the breath stops, since a breach is a fact and not an ambient condition. Dismissing slides the pill away on the exit ease and leaves a smaller dot arriving on snap; Escape from inside the pill dismisses it and hands focus to that dot, which is a real button that brings the pill back.

props.name: category
props.description: The category the alert is about; named in the copy and in both labels.

props.name: spent
props.description: Money spent in the category so far.

props.name: limit
props.description: The category's cap.

props.name: warnAt
props.description: Share of the limit at which the pill arrives.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: Controlled visibility, which overrides both the threshold and the dismissal; defaultOpen false starts dismissed.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires from the click or key that dismissed or restored it.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats both amounts; defaults to an explicit en-US currency formatter.

props.name: showDot
props.description: Leaves a dot behind on dismissal; false removes the alert outright.

usageNotes: Renders absolutely inside the nearest positioned ancestor — give the surface it warns about `relative` so the pill stays with its content.

A role="status" region rather than a dialog: it announces itself politely and never steals or traps focus, but Escape from inside it dismisses and hands focus to the dot so the keyboard never lands on nothing.

A dismissal is remembered against the level it was made at, so putting away a warning does not silence the breach that follows; under reduced motion nothing slides and nothing breathes, while the meter still fills and every word still changes.

items.title: Merchant Cluster
items.tagline: Bubbles sized by what they take.
items.description: A month's merchants as bubbles sized by what they took. The pack settles on snap in a cascade, each bubble growing out of the cluster's centre, and pressing one expands it: the chosen bubble glides to the middle at triple its radius while the rest part onto a ring around it, and the panel underneath opens to that merchant's transactions on a measured height. Bubbles carry a roving tabindex in spend order where arrows step, Home and End reach the largest and smallest, Enter and Space toggle and Escape collapses.

props.name: merchants
props.description: Merchants with id, name, amount and transactions; bubbles are area-proportional to the amount.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial expanded merchant id; null is the resting cluster.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the press, Enter, Space or Escape that expanded or collapsed a bubble.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every amount in the cluster and the panel.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the cluster for assistive technology.

usageNotes: Bubbles are buttons with a roving tabindex in spend order: arrows step, Home and End reach the largest and smallest, Enter and Space toggle, Escape collapses.
The panel's height comes from a ResizeObserver, so a closed panel reserves no space and an open one is exactly as tall as its rows.
Under reduced motion the pack appears in place and the expansion swaps without travel, while the transactions still open — they are the reading, not the flourish.

items.title: Week Strip
items.tagline: Seven days, seven bars.
items.description: A week of spend, seven bars in one plot. The bars draw up from the baseline on glide in a cascade — a quantity settling, so no overshoot — while today's column keeps a ring that breathes on a mirrored opacity tween and stops when the tab is hidden. Swiping changes week: the pointer is captured only after 4px of travel, the strip follows the finger with rubber-band resistance at the ends, and on release the same seven bars keep their identity and glide to the new week's heights while the strip springs back on snap. Left and Right step days, Home and End reach the ends of the week, PageUp and PageDown change week, Enter and Space select.

props.name: weeks
props.description: Weeks oldest first; each carries seven days and an optional todayIndex.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial week id.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the swipe, the chevrons, or PageUp and PageDown that changed week.

props.name: onDayChange
props.description: Fires from the press or keypress that selected a day.

props.name: dailyBudget
props.description: Draws a dashed guide across the plot; bars above it read warn.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every amount.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the strip for assistive technology.

usageNotes: Roving tabindex across the seven bars: Left and Right step days, Home and End reach the ends of the week, PageUp and PageDown change week, Enter and Space select a day.
Every bar is scaled against the tallest day in every week, so changing week is a comparison rather than a rescale.
Under reduced motion the bars still fill on a tween, today's ring holds still, and the strip commits the week without following the finger.

items.title: Goal Thermometer
items.tagline: A goal you can watch fill.
items.description: A vertical thermometer for a spend cap whose mercury is the sum of the entries, so the fill rises with each expense: the column's height animates on glide and the total counts up on the same spring through a motion value. Every expense leaves a tick on the rail at its cumulative height, the newest carrying a chip that lands with a snap and then rides upward with the meniscus; past warnAt the tube turns warn and the bulb glows on a mirrored tween that stops when the tab is hidden, and past the cap it turns danger without bouncing. It is a meter whose aria-valuenow stays inside the cap while aria-valuetext names the overage, with a hidden list of every expense.

props.name: entries
props.description: Expenses in the order they landed; their sum is the fill and each leaves a tick.

props.name: cap
props.description: The cap the tube tops out at.

props.name: warnAt
props.description: Fraction of the cap where the tube warns and the bulb glows.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the goal, printed above the tube and read as the meter's label.

props.name: marks
props.description: Tick labels printed up the scale.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Fires from the effect that sees a threshold cross, never during render.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the total, the cap, the scale and every chip.

usageNotes: A meter, not a control: aria-valuenow stays inside the cap, aria-valuetext carries the sentence including the overage, and a visually hidden list keeps every expense readable.
Threshold crossings announce once through a polite live region rather than once per expense.
Under reduced motion the fill still rises and the total still counts, on a tween, and the bulb's halo holds a static ring.

items.title: Subscription List
items.tagline: Everything that charges you.
items.description: A standing list of everything that charges the account, ordered by next charge, where the soonest row keeps a live countdown that ticks once a second from an interval and stops while the tab is hidden. Cancelling a row calls back from the press; when the host drops it the row slides left as its ResizeObserver-measured height closes on the exit ease, and the monthly total rolls its digit columns to the new figure on snap, counting a yearly plan as a twelfth of itself. Every cancel is a real button named for its service, so Tab reaches each one and Enter or Space fires it, while the countdown sits in an aria-live="off" timer that can be queried instead of announced every second.

props.name: items
props.description: The subscriptions: id, name, plan, amount, cycle and dueInSeconds. The soonest charge leads the list and gets the countdown.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Fires from the press on a row's cancel; remove the item to play the slide-out.

props.name: onTick
props.description: Fires once a second from the countdown interval with the seconds left on the soonest charge.

props.name: format
props.description: Turns an amount into its printed string. The default pins an explicit locale so server and client agree.

props.name: running
props.description: Runs the countdown. False holds it where it stands, and it also stops while the document is hidden.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the list and the monthly total for assistive technology.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: The designed empty state; no height is reserved for it.

usageNotes: Every row's cancel is a real button labelled with its service, so Tab reaches it and Enter or Space fires it; focus moves to the next row's cancel afterwards rather than falling to the body.
Under reduced motion the cancelled row closes without travel and the total's digits swap in place — the countdown still ticks and the total still changes, because both are information.
The countdown runs from a prop, pauses when the document is hidden, and reports each second through onTick; nothing reads the clock during render.

items.title: Invoice Build
items.tagline: Lines that add themselves up.
items.description: An invoice that does its own arithmetic in front of you: a new line opens from zero to a ResizeObserver-measured height on glide while its content slides in from 16px, and the subtotal, tax and total roll their digit columns to the new figures on snap. Removing a line closes the same measured height on the exit ease, which accelerates away rather than springing back, and the figures roll down as it goes. Every remove is a real button carrying its line's description, and removing the row you are standing on hands focus to the next one, so a keyboard run of deletions never dumps focus on the body.

props.name: lines
props.description: The lines: id, description, qty and unitPrice. Adding one slides it in; removing one collapses it.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Fires from the press on a line's remove button; drop the line to play the collapse.

props.name: taxRate
props.description: Fraction of the subtotal charged as tax; the rate is printed as a percentage in the tax label.

props.name: format
props.description: Turns an amount into its printed string. The default pins an explicit locale so server and client agree.

props.name: onTotalChange
props.type: (total: number, subtotal: number, tax: number) => void
props.description: Fires from the effect that observes a settled change of the three figures.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the line list and the totals for assistive technology.

props.name: note
props.description: A quiet caption under the totals — the account or the terms.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: The designed empty state; no height is reserved for it.

usageNotes: Each line's remove is a real button named for its line, so Tab reaches it and Enter or Space fires it; focus lands on the next remove button afterwards.
Under reduced motion rows appear and leave at full height on an opacity change and the digit columns swap in place — the arithmetic still updates, because the arithmetic is the point.
Amounts are counted in whole cents and printed through format in tabular-nums, so a rolling column never nudges the column beside it.

items.title: Due Badge
items.tagline: Due, overdue, paid.
items.description: One pill that carries an invoice's whole standing. Changing status runs a wash — a tinted layer wipes across from the left on the base tween while the pill's colour transitions beneath it — and the label swaps by sliding, the old words leaving upward on the exit ease as the new words rise on snap, with the pill's width gliding to a measured target so a long label closes rather than snapping. Overdue is the only state given ambient motion, a ring that breathes on drift; paid stamps, drawing its tick with pathLength on flick and landing the pill from 1.06 to 1 on recoil, and the whole standing is spoken once through a polite live region.

props.name: status
props.description: The standing. Changing it runs the wash, the label slide and that state's own motion.

props.name: days
props.description: Whole days until the due date, or since it when overdue; drives the generated label.

props.name: amount
props.description: Optional figure printed after the label and named in the announcement.

props.name: format
props.description: Turns the amount into its printed string. The default pins an explicit locale so server and client agree.

props.name: labels
props.description: Overrides the generated label for any state.

props.name: size
props.description: The 24px row badge or the 28px card badge; both keep one radius.

props.name: name
props.description: What the badge is about ("Invoice 4821"), spoken before the state.

props.name: announce
props.description: Keeps the polite live region that reads the new state once it settles.

usageNotes: Colour never carries the state alone: each state has its own glyph and its own words, and the pill's visuals are hidden from assistive technology so the standing arrives as one sentence rather than three fragments.
Under reduced motion nothing pulses, wipes or recoils — the colour transitions, the label cross-fades in place and the tick appears already drawn.
A display control with no pointer gesture: it is not focusable and owes no keyboard path; drive it from the state that owns the invoice.

items.title: Payment Plan
items.tagline: Split it into instalments.
items.description: A total, a slider, and the plan it makes: the knob glides between whole instalment counts on snap while the rail and stop ticks follow, and the headline per-payment figure rolls its digit columns on the same spring. Changing the count rebuilds the plan — new rows open from a ResizeObserver-measured height in a cascade on glide, rows that leave close on the exit ease — and the split is done in whole cents so the rows sum to the charge exactly, with the remainder handed to the earliest payments and named in the caption. It is a real role="slider": arrows step, Page keys move by three, Home and End take the ends, and a drag captures the pointer only after 4px so a plain click still lands on the stop it hit.

props.name: total
props.description: The amount to split, in major units.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial instalment count.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the drag, click or key that changed the count.

props.name: min / max
props.description: The fewest and most instalments the slider allows.

props.name: cadence
props.description: Spacing of the instalments; names the row labels and the per-payment caption.

props.name: feeRate
props.description: Fraction of the total added as a plan fee; above zero it adds a fee line and raises what is charged.

props.name: format
props.description: Turns an amount into its printed string. The default pins an explicit locale so server and client agree.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the slider and the plan for assistive technology.

usageNotes: Left and Down step down an instalment, Right and Up step up, PageUp and PageDown move by three, Home is min and End is max; a pointer drag captures only after 4px of travel, so a plain click lands on the stop it hit.
Under reduced motion the knob and the rail move without spring, rows appear and leave at full height on an opacity change, and the per-payment digits swap in place.
The announcement holds while the knob is being dragged and catches up on release, so a drag never babbles at a screen reader.

items.title: Retry Schedule
items.tagline: When we will try again.
items.description: A failed charge and the plan for trying it again: spent attempts are struck dots, the next one is ringed and breathing on drift, and the connector into it is the countdown made visible, filling at a linear rate while the mm:ss beside it ticks from an interval that stops when the tab is hidden and holds while an attempt is in flight. Retry now fires the attempt early from the press, and a settled attempt lands — a failure strikes its dot on flick, a success draws its tick on flick and lands the dot on recoil, the one place two bounces are earned. The schedule is an ordered list whose items carry sentences, so the drawn rail stays decorative and the countdown sits in an aria-live="off" timer that is queried rather than announced every second.

props.name: attempts
props.description: The schedule: id, label and status of "failed", "pending" or "succeeded". The first pending attempt is the next one.

props.name: waitSeconds
props.description: Seconds until the next attempt; the countdown and the connector fill run across it.

props.name: amount
props.description: The amount that failed, in major units.

props.name: format
props.description: Turns the amount into its printed string. The default pins an explicit locale so server and client agree.

props.name: reason / method
props.description: The decline line and the quiet caption naming the method that failed.

props.name: running
props.description: Runs the countdown. It also stops while the document is hidden or while busy.

props.name: busy
props.description: The attempt is in flight: the button reads Trying, its ring spins, and the countdown holds.

props.name: onRetryNow
props.description: Fires from the press on Retry now.

props.name: onElapse
props.description: Fires from the interval when the wait reaches zero, so the host can run the attempt.

props.name: onTick
props.description: Fires once a second from the interval with the seconds left.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the schedule for assistive technology.

usageNotes: Retry now is a real button carrying aria-busy while an attempt is in flight; it stays focusable rather than going disabled, so starting an attempt never throws the keyboard back to the top of the card.
Under reduced motion nothing breathes, spins or recoils — the connector still fills and the tick appears already drawn, because a countdown and an outcome are information.
The countdown runs from a prop, pauses when the document is hidden or while busy, and reports each second through onTick; nothing reads the clock during render.

items.title: Receipt Drawer
items.tagline: Every receipt, filed.
items.description: A filing drawer for receipts. The front is a disclosure that pulls the drawer open on glide to a height a ResizeObserver measured, each receipt inside is a card that expands where it stands on glide with its lines arriving on a cascade, and searching filters the cards with a FLIP: survivors travel to their new rows on glide while the ones that leave fade on the exit ease. The front and every card are real aria-expanded buttons; Up and Down move between cards, Escape closes an open card and returns focus, and Escape in a non-empty search clears it.

props.name: receipts
props.description: Each receipt carries an id, merchant, a pre-formatted date, its total, its line items and an optional note.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: Controlled or initial drawer state; onOpenChange fires from the press on the front.

props.name: query / defaultQuery
props.description: Controlled or initial search text; onQueryChange fires from the input event.

props.name: expandedId / defaultExpandedId
props.description: Which receipt is open; onExpandedChange fires from the press or Escape that changed it.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every amount. Defaults to a fixed en-US currency formatter so server and client print the same string.

props.name: label
props.description: The drawer's title and accessible name.

props.name: searchLabel
props.description: Label for the search field.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Shown when the search matches nothing.

usageNotes: The front and every card are aria-expanded buttons: Enter and Space toggle, Up and Down move between cards, Escape closes an open card and returns focus to it, and Escape in a non-empty search clears it. The body is inert while the drawer is closed.
Under reduced motion the drawer and the cards swap height instantly and filtering only fades — no FLIP travel, no line-item offsets.
matchReceipt(receipt, query) is exported so a host can mirror the filter for its own count.

items.title: Tax Split
items.tagline: What is yours and what is the tax.
items.description: A stacked bar that splits an amount into net and tax around a fixed marker for the amount you entered. In exclusive mode the tax continues past the marker; switching to inclusive slides the bar's end back to it and the tax inside, both segments travelling on glide, while the net, tax and total figures roll their digits on glide without shifting layout. The mode switch is a radio group whose knob rides a shared layoutId on snap: Left and Right step, Home and End jump, Space selects.

props.name: amount
props.description: The entered amount in major units.

props.name: rate
props.description: Tax rate as a fraction; 0.2 is twenty percent.

props.name: mode / defaultMode
props.description: Controlled or initial mode; onModeChange fires from the press or key that switched it.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every figure. Defaults to a fixed en-US currency formatter.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the control and its radio group.

props.name: netLabel / taxLabel / totalLabel
props.description: Captions for the three figures; default Net, Tax and Total.

usageNotes: The switch is a radio group with a roving tabindex: Left and Right step between inclusive and exclusive, Home and End jump, Space selects. The bar is an image whose label reads net, tax and total; a status line reports each switch.
Under reduced motion the segment widths tween on the base duration, the digits swap in place and the knob swaps without travelling.
splitTax(amount, rate, mode) is exported and works in whole cents, so net plus tax always equals the total.

items.title: Proration Bar
items.tagline: Only the days you used.
items.description: A billing period as a bar split by the plan-change date: the days before fill in the primary colour, the days after are hatched because they come back as credit. The split is a real slider thumb — a key press or a track click slides it on glide, a drag follows the pointer directly — and the used and credit figures beneath roll on glide from whole cents. Left and Right move a day, Page Up and Page Down a week, Home and End reach the period's ends.

props.name: periodStart / periodEnd
props.description: The period's first day and the day the next one begins, as YYYY-MM-DD. Day arithmetic is in UTC and never reads a clock.

props.name: price
props.description: The period's charge in major units; used and credit are split from it in whole cents.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial days used; onValueChange fires from the pointer, key or click that moved the split.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats both figures. Defaults to a fixed en-US currency formatter.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the slider.

props.name: usedLabel / creditLabel
props.description: Captions for the two figures; default Used and Credit.

usageNotes: The thumb is role=slider: Left and Right move a day, Up and Down the same, Page Up and Page Down a week, Home and End reach the ends, and aria-valuetext speaks the change date with both figures. The pointer is captured only after four pixels of travel, so a plain click on the track still sets the day.
Under reduced motion the split tweens on the base duration with no mount fill, and the digits swap in place.
prorate(price, daysUsed, days), periodDays(start, end) and dayLabel(start, offset) are exported so a host can print the same figures.

items.title: Dunning Steps
items.tagline: Reminders, escalating.
items.description: A vertical rail of reminder emails that escalate. Sent steps are stamped with a tick that lands on recoil, the next step wears a ring that drains linearly across intervalMs while the rail segment leading to it fills at the same rate, and when the ring runs out the send is reported and the next ring begins. Pause freezes the rail where it stands, with the Paused word arriving on snap, and Resume continues from the remainder; the clock runs only while running is true and stops while the tab is hidden.

props.name: steps
props.description: Each step carries an id, a title, an optional detail line and the day after the due date it goes out.

props.name: sent / defaultSent
props.description: Controlled or initial count of steps that have gone out; onSentChange fires from the countdown's completion, and onStepSent(index, step) alongside it.

props.name: running
props.description: The clock. Only a prop or a host's button starts it; while false the ring shows full.

props.name: paused / defaultPaused
props.description: Controlled or initial pause; onPausedChange fires from the Pause or Resume press.

props.name: intervalMs
props.description: Milliseconds each ring takes to drain.

props.name: label
props.description: Heading and the list's accessible name.

props.name: pauseLabel / resumeLabel
props.description: Copy on the pause control; default Pause and Resume.

usageNotes: An ordered list whose next step carries aria-current=step; every state is a visible word (Sent, Next, Paused, Upcoming), never a colour alone. The pause control is a real aria-pressed button: Tab to it, Enter or Space toggles. A status line announces each send and each pause or resume.
Under reduced motion the ring and the rail still drain, because a countdown is information; the stamp appears without its bounce and the status word fades in place.
The countdown lives in an effect with cleanup, pauses while the document is hidden and resumes from where it stood, and never reads a clock during render.

items.title: Credit Note
items.tagline: Money owed back to you.
items.description: A credit note beside the next invoice. Pressing Apply lifts a chip carrying the amount to be applied from the credit figure and slides it into the invoice's total on glide; when it lands the total and the credit line roll to their new values on glide and the applied share of the credit bar hatches in from the left while the remainder stays solid. Remove reverses the flight. Apply and Remove are one real button, held disabled while a chip is in flight, and a status line reports each landing.

props.name: credit
props.description: The credit note's full value in major units.

props.name: invoiceSubtotal
props.description: The next invoice's amount before credit, in major units.

props.name: applied / defaultApplied
props.description: Controlled or initial credit already applied, clamped to the lesser of the credit and the subtotal; onAppliedChange fires from the Apply or Remove press.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every amount. Defaults to a fixed en-US currency formatter.

props.name: creditLabel / creditReference
props.description: Title and small reference on the credit card; the title defaults to Credit note.

props.name: invoiceLabel / invoiceReference
props.description: Title and small reference on the invoice card; the title defaults to Next invoice.

props.name: applyLabel / removeLabel
props.description: Copy on the action button; default Apply credit and Remove credit.

usageNotes: The credit bar is role=meter whose value is the remaining credit and whose text names applied and remaining. Apply and Remove share one real button: Tab to it, Enter or Space presses; it is disabled while a chip is in flight and reads Nothing to apply when the credit or the invoice is zero.
Under reduced motion there is no flight: the figures swap on the press, the hatch tweens on the base duration, and the button re-enables at once.
All arithmetic is in whole cents, so applied plus remaining always equals the credit and subtotal minus applied always equals the total due.

items.title: KYC Steps
items.tagline: Identity, one step at a time.
items.description: A verification stepper whose steps unlock in sequence: only the current step is open, its body gliding open on glide from a measured height, and every later one stays locked until the step above is approved. Approval stamps the node on recoil, draws its tick on flick and fills the connector on glide as the next step unlocks; rejection shakes the card on a symmetric tween with no spring and reopens it with the reason. The only control is the open step's real button, reached by Tab and pressed with Enter or Space; every state arrives through the status prop, so the stepper never invents time.

props.name: steps
props.description: { id, title, description } in order; later steps stay locked until every earlier one is approved.

props.name: status / defaultStatus
props.description: Per-step status, review, approved or rejected; a step absent from the map is pending.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Fires from the Submit press with the step moved to review.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Fires from the Submit or Resubmit press; the host does the work and sets status.

props.name: reasons
props.description: Rejection reason per step id, shown under a rejected step as an alert.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible heading; omit it and pass aria-label.

usageNotes: Tab reaches the open step's Submit button; Enter and Space press it. Locked and approved steps have no control, and each step's aria-label sentence names its state.
A reviewing button carries aria-busy and keeps its name; approvals are announced once by a visually hidden role="status", and a rejection reason is a role="alert".
Under reduced motion the body still changes height on a tween, the check appears at rest, the ring holds still beside the words, and a rejected step turns danger without shaking.

items.title: Doc Scan
items.tagline: Hold the document still.
items.description: A viewfinder for a hand-held identity document. Idle, the procedural card sits off centre and breathes; Capture settles it on glide while four corner brackets snap in from the frame's corners onto the card's on snap, then a bar sweeps the card on a linear tween and hands the capture to the host. Captured flashes once and stamps a check on recoil; blurred is the nudge, a filter blur, a sideways shake with no spring, released brackets and a Retry. One real button carries the whole flow for the keyboard, and the brackets are placed in percentages so the frame is sized by its container and never measured.

props.name: status / defaultStatus
props.description: Controlled or initial phase: idle, finding, scanning, captured or blurred.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Fires from Capture (to finding), from the brackets landing (to scanning) and from Retry.

props.name: onScanned
props.description: Fires when the scan bar reaches the bottom; the host judges the capture and sets captured or blurred.

props.name: title
props.description: Printed on the procedural card and in the frame's accessible name.

props.name: holder
props.description: Name line on the procedural card.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible heading; omit it and pass aria-label.

usageNotes: Tab reaches the Capture button; Enter and Space press it. The same button reads Scanning (aria-busy) while the frame works, Retry after a blurred capture and Captured, aria-disabled, at the end.
The frame is a role="img" whose label names the document and the phase; phases are announced once by a visually hidden role="status", and the blurred prompt is a role="alert".
Under reduced motion the card sits centred from the start, the brackets fade in at the corners, the bar still sweeps and the blur still blurs, and nothing shakes or bounces.

items.title: Selfie Ring
items.tagline: Look into the ring.
items.description: A liveness check drawn as a ring around a procedural face. Each prompt slides up into the caption on snap while the ring fills one more segment on glide, and the face answers: features glide left or right, the eyes blink on a tween. Passing the last prompt closes the ring: the arc completes, the ring tightens onto the face on recoil and a check disc stamps at the top; failure drains the ring on glide with no bounce. The ring is a progressbar whose valuetext names the prompt, one real button starts or retries the check, and the host advances step and status so the ring owns no clock.

props.name: prompts
props.description: The prompts in order, one ring segment each; prompts that mention left, right or blink move the face.

props.name: status / defaultStatus
props.description: idle, checking, passed or failed.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Fires from the Start and Try again presses with checking.

props.name: step
props.description: Index of the prompt being held while checking; earlier prompts count as done.

props.name: onStart
props.description: Fires from the Start or Try again press; the host runs the camera check.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible heading; omit it and pass aria-label.

usageNotes: Tab reaches the Start button; Enter and Space press it. While checking it reads Checking with aria-busy, and after a failure it returns as Try again.

The ring is a role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow, min, max and a valuetext that names the current prompt; the caption is a role="status" so each prompt is announced once, and Face lost is a role="alert".
Under reduced motion prompts swap in place, the face holds still, the ring still fills segment by segment on a tween, and the close neither tightens nor bounces.

items.title: OTP Cells
items.tagline: Six digits, verified as they land.
items.description: Six real inputs, one digit each, that behave as one field. A paste, from the clipboard or from a value that arrives several digits at once, lands the digits in a cascade, each popping in on snap staggered by cascade(); the last digit triggers verification from a timer once the cascade has landed, and while the host holds verifying a dash runs around the last cell at a constant rate. Verified stamps a tick badge onto the last cell on recoil; failed shakes the row on a symmetric tween with no spring, clears it and returns focus to the first cell. Left and Right move, Home and End jump, Backspace clears and steps back.

props.name: length
props.description: Number of cells.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial code, digits only; longer input is truncated.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from typing, paste and the clear after a failure.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Fires once from a timer after the last digit lands; re-arms when the code shrinks.

props.name: status
props.description: idle, verifying, verified or failed, set by the host once onComplete has fired.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: The alert line under the row while status is failed.

props.name: label
props.description: Group name for assistive technology.

props.name: hint
props.description: Visible line under the label, e.g. where the code was sent.

usageNotes: Tab enters the row at the first empty cell; digits type and advance, Backspace clears and steps back, Delete clears in place, Left and Right move, Home and End jump. A paste into any cell fills from there.

The group carries aria-busy while verifying and a visually hidden role="status" announces Verifying and Verified once each; the error line is a role="alert" wired by aria-describedby, and the inputs are read-only once verification starts.
Under reduced motion digits appear in place with no stagger, the dash holds still and the words carry the state, the badge appears at rest, and a failure clears the row without shaking.

items.title: Device Trust
items.tagline: This device, remembered.
items.description: A card for one signed-in device with a single control that grants or revokes trust. Approval stamps a round seal onto the card on recoil, the two bounces of a stamp on paper, with an impact ring spreading from under it and its tick drawing on flick. Hovering or focusing Revoke lifts the seal's edge on glide so the peel is previewed, and revoking peels it away: the seal rotates off its left edge on the exit ease with perspective and fades, with no bounce on the way out. The button is the only control, busy while the host is pending, and trust changes are announced once.

props.name: trusted / defaultTrusted
props.description: Controlled or initial trust.

props.name: onTrustedChange
props.description: Fires from the Revoke press with false; granting goes through onTrust.

props.name: onTrust
props.description: Fires from the Trust press; the host approves and sets trusted.

props.name: pending
props.description: The host is approving: the button turns its ring and is aria-busy.

props.name: device
props.description: { name, platform, location, lastSeen, kind: "laptop" | "phone" }; lastSeen is a static string.

props.name: days
props.description: How long a trusted device is remembered; printed in the footer line.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible heading; omit it and pass aria-label.

usageNotes: Tab reaches the one button; Enter and Space press it. It reads Trust this device, Approving with aria-busy while pending, and Revoke trust once trusted; hovering or focusing Revoke lifts the seal's edge.
The card is a role="group" named by the heading or the device; the seal is decorative, and a visually hidden role="status" announces Trusted for n days and Trust revoked once each.
Under reduced motion the seal appears at rest with its tick drawn and no impact ring, the ring holds still beside the word, the lift is skipped, and revoking fades the seal out.

items.title: Risk Hold
items.tagline: Held for a look, then released.
items.description: A payment held for review. The notice beneath the row drains a review ring across the window and releases at zero, or sooner when a reviewer presses Release: the notice slides away on the exit ease while its height closes, and the row's chip turns to Sent with a tick drawn on flick. Escalate stops the ring and turns the notice amber by colour alone; the notice itself arrives on glide, and both controls are real buttons one Tab apart.

props.name: status / defaultStatus
props.description: Controlled or initial state of the hold.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Fires from the press, or from the ring running out with cause "timer".

props.name: amount
props.description: The held sum, in symbol.

props.name: symbol
props.description: Asset code shown after the amount.

props.name: payee
props.description: Who the payment goes to.

props.name: reason
props.description: Why it was held.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the amount; defaults to a two-decimal number format.

props.name: reviewMs
props.description: The review window; the ring drains across it and releases at zero.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible heading; omit it and pass aria-label.

usageNotes: Release and Escalate are real buttons: Tab reaches each, Enter or Space presses. Escalate becomes aria-disabled once escalated so the keyboard can still read why it will not move.
Under reduced motion the ring still drains and the readout still counts; the notice fades and closes without sliding, and the amber turn is instant.
The ring pauses while the tab is hidden and resumes from where it stood; a status change is announced once through a polite status region, never per second.

items.title: Two Factor
items.tagline: The second key, arriving.
items.description: A sign-in confirmation with two routes on a tablist: a code, or an approval on a device. The knob slides between them on snap while the panel glides to a measured height; the code field's next empty cell holds a caret that pulses while the prompt waits and each digit lands on flick, and the device route draws a phone whose screen breathes on drift until approval lights it. Either route ending in verified stamps a chip into the header on recoil; a wrong code nudges the cells on snap, raises an alert and clears.

props.name: method / defaultMethod
props.description: Which route is showing.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The code, digits only. A controlled host clears it after a failure.

props.name: status / defaultStatus
props.description: The outcome; the host decides it. A submit moves the component to checking.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Fires when the last digit lands, or Enter is pressed on a full code.

props.name: length
props.description: Digits in the code.

props.name: deviceName
props.description: Named in the device route and its announcements.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: The alert line under failed.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible heading; omit it and pass aria-label.

usageNotes: The routes are real tabs: Left and Right, Home and End move and select. The code is one real numeric input under the cells, so typing, Backspace, paste and Enter all work; the last digit submits.
Under reduced motion the caret is solid, digits appear in place, the panel swaps height instantly with a cross-fade, the device screen lights by colour, and the stamp fades in.
The caret pulse and the screen's breathing rest while the tab is hidden. Outcomes are announced politely once; a failure is an alert.

items.title: Session List
items.tagline: Everywhere you are signed in.
items.description: A list of signed-in sessions where the one reading the list breathes: its chip's dot wears a halo that swells and settles on drift, mirrored, resting while the tab is hidden. Signing one out slides the row aside by a shift while its measured height closes on the exit ease, so the rows below glide up; signing out all cascades the exits top to bottom on cascade(), the order carried through AnimatePresence's custom to rows already removed. Every Sign out is a real button named after its device.

props.name: sessions
props.description: { id, device, kind: "phone" | "laptop" | "tablet", place, seen, current? } — the host owns the list.

props.name: onSignOut
props.description: Fires from the row's button; the host removes the session and the row leaves.

props.name: onSignOutAll
props.description: Fires from the footer with every non-current id; their rows leave in a cascade.

props.name: label
props.description: List heading.

props.name: currentLabel
props.description: Chip text on the live row.

props.name: signOutAllLabel
props.description: Footer control.

usageNotes: Tab reaches each Sign out and the footer; Enter or Space presses. After a sign-out, focus is handed to the next row or the footer before the row leaves.
Under reduced motion the live dot sits inside a still ring, rows fade and close without sideways travel, and the cascade keeps its order as fades.
The live row is named in words — the chip says This device — so presence never rests on colour or motion alone; sign-outs are announced once through a polite status region.

items.title: Liveness Dots
items.tagline: Follow the dot.
items.description: A liveness check where a dot travels on glide to each of N stops and waits; catching it there — the pointer entering it, a press, or Space and Enter while it holds focus — stamps the stop with a ring that lands on recoil and stays, while a stop left uncaught is marked with a still dashed ring. When the last stop resolves, a clean run draws a closed loop through every stop with pathLength on glide and a tick lands at the centre; any miss ends in a plain count and a Try again.

props.name: positions
props.description: Where the dot stops, in order, as 0–100 percentages of the stage; six seeded stops by default.

props.name: windowMs
props.description: How long the dot waits at each stop before moving on.

props.name: status / defaultStatus
props.description: Controlled or initial state of the check; setting running starts a fresh run.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Fires from the press or the timer that moved the check.

props.name: onResolve
props.description: Fires as each stop is caught or missed.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible heading; omit it and pass aria-label.

usageNotes: The dot is a real button that takes focus when the check starts and keeps it as it travels: Space or Enter at each stop is the keyboard path, and the pointer entering the dot counts as a catch.
Under reduced motion the dot swaps between stops, the rings and the loop appear in place, and the wait window is unchanged.
The window lives in an effect with cleanup and waits while the tab is hidden; each stop and the outcome are announced once through a polite status region.

items.title: Verified Seal
items.tagline: Checked, and it says so.
items.description: A profile header that wears a rosette seal beside the name once verified. The moment the fact turns true the seal stamps on recoil from 1.6× and −14°, and when the stamp settles a highlight sweeps across it once on a slow tween: the glint. Hovering or focusing the seal opens a strip beneath the header to a measured height on glide, listing what was verified and when with each tick drawn on flick in a cascade; a press pins it, Escape closes it, and revoking lifts the seal away on the exit ease.

props.name: verified
props.description: The fact. Turning true stamps the seal; turning false lifts it away. A profile that mounts verified does not stamp.

props.name: checks
props.type: { id: string; label: string; at: string }[]
props.description: What was verified and when, preformatted.

props.name: verifiedAt
props.description: When the seal was granted, preformatted, shown at the head of the strip.

props.name: name
props.description: Profile name; its first letters fill the avatar unless initials is given.

props.name: handle
props.description: Secondary line under the name.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: Controlled or initial pinned state of the detail strip; hover and focus open it on their own.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires from the seal press or Escape.

props.name: sealLabel
props.description: The seal's name for assistive technology.

usageNotes: The seal is a real button with aria-expanded: Tab to it and the strip opens, Enter or Space pins it, Escape closes it and keeps focus on the seal.
Under reduced motion the seal fades in and out with no rotation, scale or glint; the strip swaps height with a cross-fade and the ticks appear complete.
The strip is only rendered while open, so nothing reserves space; the name's line height matches the seal's box, so the row never jumps when the seal lands.

items.title: Loan Slider
items.tagline: Borrow more; pay more each month.
items.description: One slider for the amount and a row of chips for the term, with the cost of the answer printed live beneath them. The thumb tracks a drag with no lag and takes a click, a key or a term chip on snap; the monthly payment counts to its new value on glide through a motion value, and the cost rail — principal in cobalt, total interest in warn, scaled against the dearest loan on offer — grows on glide as the amount rises and lengthens its warn share as the term stretches. Arrows step the slider, Page keys move ten, Home and End reach the ends; the terms are a radio group with a roving tabindex.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial loan amount.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the drag, click or key that moved the amount.

props.name: min
props.description: Smallest amount on offer.

props.name: max
props.description: Largest amount on offer; also scales the cost rail.

props.name: step
props.description: Amount per arrow key and drag snap; Page keys move ten.

props.name: terms
props.description: Term chips, in months.

props.name: term / defaultTerm
props.description: Controlled or initial term in months.

props.name: onTermChange
props.description: Fires from the click or key that picked a term.

props.name: apr
props.description: Annual rate in percent; drives the amortised payment.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every amount the control prints.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the slider; printed above it.

usageNotes: The track is a role="slider" with a money aria-valuetext: arrows step, Page keys move ten steps, Home and End reach the ends. The term chips are a radio group with a roving tabindex where Left and Right step without wrapping and Space selects.

Under reduced motion the thumb and the term knob take their positions without springs, the monthly figure sets instead of counting, and the rail segments tween their widths — the cost still shows, because what a loan costs is information.
Pointer capture is taken only after 4px of travel, so a plain click on the track sets the amount; the status sentence holds its last settled quote during a drag and catches up on release.

items.title: Repayment Arc
items.tagline: How far through the loan you are.
items.description: The whole cost of a loan — principal plus every scheduled interest charge — drawn as one 240° arc that fills clockwise with what has actually been repaid: principal in cobalt from the start and interest in warn continuing from where the principal ends, both shares animated together on glide. Their sum places the frontier, a marker riding the arc with the next due date just outside it; the date swaps only once the spring has settled, so the label never names a date the arc has not yet reached, and the centre figure counts on glide. Nothing takes focus: it is a role="meter" driven by its props.

props.name: total
props.description: Principal plus every scheduled interest charge; the full arc.

props.name: paidPrincipal
props.description: Principal repaid so far; the cobalt share.

props.name: paidInterest
props.description: Interest paid so far; the warn share.

props.name: paidCount
props.description: Instalments made.

props.name: count
props.description: Instalments in the schedule.

props.name: nextDue
props.description: The next due date in its own words, printed at the frontier.

props.name: nextAmount
props.description: The next instalment, printed under the arc when given.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every amount the arc prints.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the meter; printed above the arc.

usageNotes: A role="meter" whose aria-valuetext reads paid of total, the principal and interest split, the instalments made and the next due date; the legend names the split in words so colour is never the only carrier. Nothing here takes focus.

Under reduced motion the two shares set their lengths on a short tween, the frontier jumps to its place and the date swaps at once — the arc still fills, because how far through you are is information.
Every trigonometric coordinate is rounded to three decimals before it reaches the markup, so the server and the browser agree on the frontier.

items.title: Credit Dial
items.tagline: A score with a needle.
items.description: A 240° dial banded from poor to excellent whose needle sweeps to the score on glide and settles without a wobble; the figure under the hub is derived from the same motion value, so it counts exactly as fast as the needle turns. While the needle moves the band label is withheld; when the spring settles the band fades in on the enter ease and, given a previous reading, a change chip arrives beside it on snap — the same physics up or down. It is a role="meter" that announces the settled reading once; nothing takes focus.

props.name: score
props.description: The reading the needle sweeps to.

props.name: previous
props.description: The last reading; given it, the change chip shows the move.

props.name: min
props.description: Floor of the scale.

props.name: max
props.description: Ceiling of the scale.

props.name: bands
props.description: Ascending { label, from, tone } bands; each colours its own segment of the arc.

props.name: sweepOnMount
props.description: Sweep up from the floor on first paint rather than starting at the score.

props.name: onSettle
props.description: Fires when the needle has settled on a score.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the meter; printed above the dial.

usageNotes: A role="meter" whose aria-valuetext reads the score of the ceiling, the band and the move since the previous reading; the settled reading is announced once through a status line, and the move is spoken in words rather than carried by colour alone.
Under reduced motion the needle and the counting figure set to the score at once, the band label swaps by opacity and the chip appears in place without travel.
Every trigonometric coordinate is rounded to three decimals before it reaches the markup, so the server and the browser agree on the dial.

items.title: Limit Raise
items.tagline: Ask for more room.
items.description: A credit limit drawn as a bar against the most the issuer could grant — the current limit a solid cobalt segment with the balance used drawn darker inside it — and a stepper beneath that names the limit you would like, its tick sliding along the bar on snap. Requesting draws the ask as a hatched extension that grows from the limit's end on snap and marches while the request stands; approval fills it, the solid segment gliding out over the hatch as the figure rolls to the new limit and an Approved chip lands on recoil, while a decline turns the hatch danger and says so in words. The readout is a role="spinbutton": arrows step, Page keys move five, Home and End reach the ends.

props.name: limit
props.description: The current limit; the solid segment. Raise it when a request is approved.

props.name: used
props.description: Balance already used; drawn inside the limit.

props.name: ceiling
props.description: The most that can be asked for; the full track.

props.name: step
props.description: Amount per stepper press or arrow key; Page keys move five.

props.name: proposed / defaultProposed
props.description: Controlled or initial ask; the uncontrolled ask resets to limit + step when the limit changes.

props.name: onProposedChange
props.description: Fires from the press or key that changed the ask.

props.name: status
props.description: Where the request stands; the parent decides.

props.name: onRequest
props.description: Fires from the Request button with the ask.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every amount the bar prints.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the meter; printed above the bar.

usageNotes: The bar is a role="meter" of the balance against the limit whose aria-valuetext names the room and the state of any request; the ask readout is a role="spinbutton" beside real − and + buttons, and the verdict is printed and announced in words, never colour alone.

Under reduced motion the extension, the tick and the fill take their widths on a short tween, the hatch stands still and the chip fades in place — the fill still fills, because the new room is information.
The parent plays issuer: on approval raise `limit` to the ask and set status to approved, and clear the status back to idle when the ask changes so a stale verdict never stands beside a new question.

items.title: APR Compare
items.tagline: Two offers, side by side.
items.description: Two loan offers as two cards in one row, each reading its lender, its APR, the monthly payment it implies for the amount being borrowed, and a cost bar. The APR and monthly figures are odometer columns that roll on snap when the amount or the quotes change; each cost bar is principal in cobalt plus interest in warn, scaled against the dearer offer's total and settling on glide, and the cheaper card says so in words. Picking an offer lifts it a nudge on snap with a raised shadow and dims the other by opacity; the cards are a radio group where the arrows move the pick, Home and End jump, and Space or Enter picks.

props.name: offers
props.description: The two offers, left and right: { id, lender, apr, term, fee? }.

props.name: amount
props.description: The principal both offers are costed against.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial picked offer id; nothing picked when omitted.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the click or key that picked an offer.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every amount the cards print.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the group; printed above the cards.

usageNotes: A role="radiogroup" of two role="radio" cards with a roving tabindex: Left and Right move the pick without wrapping, Home and End jump, Space and Enter pick. Each card carries an aria-label sentence with its lender, rate, term, monthly and total, and the status line announces the pick and the difference.
Under reduced motion the digits swap in place, the bars and totals set on a short tween, and picking changes the border and dims the other card by opacity with no lift.
Both cost bars share one scale — the dearer offer's total — so the same pixel means the same money on either card.

items.title: Amortise Stack
items.tagline: Interest first, then principal.
items.description: A loan as one stacked bar per payment, interest over principal, whose boundary slides down period by period. The bars rise on glide in a cascade; scrubbing across the chart moves a cursor on snap and the split beneath rolls its digits on snap while a ratio bar re-proportions on glide. It is a slider: Left and Right step a period, Home and End jump, Page keys move a year.

props.name: principal
props.description: Amount borrowed, in major units.

props.name: rate
props.description: Annual interest rate as a percentage.

props.name: periods
props.description: Number of monthly payments; one bar each.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial period index, 0-based.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the pointer or key event that moved the cursor, with that period's interest, principal, balance and payment.

props.name: format
props.description: Turns an amount into its printed string.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the chart for assistive technology.

usageNotes: The chart is one role="slider" over the periods: Left and Right step, Home and End jump to the first and last, PageUp and PageDown move twelve; hovering or dragging scrubs the same value, and aria-valuetext reads the split.
Under reduced motion the bars stand at full height with no cascade, the cursor swaps to its period, the digits swap in place, and the ratio bar re-proportions with a short tween.
Every amount passes through format; the three figures are left-aligned in equal columns so a figure gaining a digit never shifts its neighbours.

items.title: Overdraft Line
items.tagline: Below zero, but how far.
items.description: A balance line over a chart whose zero sits above the floor: the space down to the limit is the overdraft band. Scrubbing reveals the series up to a day on glide; below zero the line turns danger and a red fill drops from the zero line to that day's depth on glide, while the balance and the fee accrued roll their digits on snap. It is a slider: Left and Right step a day, Home and End jump.

props.name: points
props.description: End-of-day balances in major units, oldest first; negative is overdrawn.

props.name: limit
props.description: The overdraft limit as a positive amount, the band's floor.

props.name: feeRate
props.description: Annual rate charged on the overdrawn amount, as a percentage, accrued per day over 365.

props.name: day / defaultDay
props.description: Controlled or initial count of days revealed, 1 to points.length.

props.name: onDayChange
props.description: Fires from the pointer or key event that moved the day, with that day's balance, overdrawn depth and fee.

props.name: format
props.description: Turns an amount into its printed string.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the chart for assistive technology.

usageNotes: The chart is one role="slider" over the days: Left and Right step, Home and End jump, hovering or dragging scrubs; the pointer is captured only after four pixels of travel so a click still focuses.
Under reduced motion the reveal, the fill and the marker jump to their positions; the red fill still fills with a short tween, because how far below zero is the information.
readOverdraft(points, day, feeRate) is exported so a host can print the same balance and fee the chart shows without waiting for an event.

items.title: Paydown Plan
items.tagline: Which debt first.
items.description: A list of debts and the order to clear them. A two-stop control picks smallest-first or highest-rate-first and the rows reorder with a FLIP layout move on glide, their rank numerals cross-fading in place; a range input sets the extra paid each month, and the projected debt-free date rolls its year on snap while the month fades over and the total interest rolls with it. Arrows move the order control, the range is native.

props.name: debts
props.description: { id, name, balance, rate, minimum }, rate as an annual percentage.

props.name: strategy / defaultStrategy
props.description: Controlled or initial order: smallest balance first, or highest rate first.

props.name: onStrategyChange
props.description: Fires from the press that changed the order.

props.name: extra / defaultExtra
props.description: Controlled or initial extra monthly payment on top of the minimums.

props.name: onExtraChange
props.description: Fires from the range input's change event.

props.name: maxExtra
props.description: Top of the extra-payment range.

props.name: step
props.description: Range step.

props.name: start
props.description: The first payment's month (1 to 12); passed explicitly so the render never reads the clock.

props.name: onProjectionChange
props.description: Fires from the effect that observed a changed plan, with months, interest, the payoff month and each debt's clearing month.

props.name: format
props.description: Turns an amount into its printed string.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the plan for assistive technology.

usageNotes: The order control is a radio group with a roving tabindex: Left, Right, Up and Down move and select, Home and End jump, Space selects; the extra payment is a native range input labelled Extra each month.
Under reduced motion the rows swap places without travelling and the date, month and interest figures swap in place; the order still changes, because the order is the information.

projectPaydown(debts, strategy, extra, start) is exported: minimums go to every debt each month and the extra, plus any minimum freed by a cleared debt, goes to the first debt still open in the chosen order.

items.title: Autopay Toggle
items.tagline: Paid on the day, every time.
items.description: A switch that puts a bill on autopay. The knob rides its track on snap and a calendar glyph beside it turns over on the same spring, from a dash to the pay date's day; below, the upcoming schedule is an ordered list into which the autopay payment slides on snap at its dated place while the rows around it glide apart and the list grows to its measured height. Space and Enter toggle the switch.

props.name: checked / defaultChecked
props.description: Controlled or initial switch state.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Fires from the press that flipped it.

props.name: label
props.description: What is being paid; names the switch.

props.name: amount
props.description: The payment autopay will make.

props.name: nextDate
props.description: The next pay date, month 1 to 12; passed explicitly so the render never reads the clock.

props.name: schedule
props.description: Other upcoming payments: { id, label, month, day, amount }, in any order.

props.name: format
props.description: Turns an amount into its printed string.

usageNotes: A role="switch" button labelled by the bill and described by the line that names the date and amount, so Space and Enter toggle and a reader hears what on means; a status line announces the change.
Under reduced motion the knob swaps position, the glyph's faces cross-fade instead of turning, the row fades in place, and the list height changes with a short tween.
The list's height is measured with a ResizeObserver, never reserved; switching off sends the autopay row out on the exit ease and the list closes up.

items.title: Grace Timer
items.tagline: Days left before it counts.
items.description: A grace period as a bar that drains linearly from where it stands to empty, only while running and the tab is visible, with the days remaining stepping down on snap from the tick that crosses each day. Inside the last days the bar and figure turn warn; at zero interest applies. Pay stops the drain where it stands and a PAID seal stamps into the figure's place on recoil. Pay is a real button; the bar is a meter.

props.name: days
props.description: Length of the grace period in days.

props.name: daysUsed
props.description: Days already elapsed when the timer mounts.

props.name: running
props.description: Runs the drain; false holds it where it stands.

props.name: secondsPerDay
props.description: Real seconds per simulated day.

props.name: warnDays
props.description: Days remaining at which the bar turns warn.

props.name: paid / defaultPaid
props.description: Controlled or initial paid state.

props.name: onPaidChange
props.description: Fires from the Pay press.

props.name: onDaysChange
props.description: Fires from the tick that crossed into a new day.

props.name: onExpire
props.description: Fires from the tick that reached zero.

props.name: amount
props.description: The statement balance the Pay button settles.

props.name: format
props.description: Turns an amount into its printed string.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the timer.

usageNotes: The bar is a role="meter" of days left with aria-valuetext; Pay is a real button that disables once paid or expired; a status line announces the warn window, expiry and payment rather than every day.
Under reduced motion the bar still drains because a countdown is information, the figure swaps instead of rolling, and the seal appears without scaling or bouncing.
The drain runs only from the running prop, pauses while the document is hidden, and never reads the clock during render; remount with a key to reset it.

items.title: Goal Pot
items.tagline: Coins in, pot fills.
items.description: A savings pot whose liquid is the share of the goal already saved. Each increase mints a coin above the lip that drops in and lands on recoil, and only when it lands does the level rise on glide and the figure count up on the same spring; landing at the goal turns the lip success and glints it once. The pot is a meter with a spoken value text, the quick-add controls are real buttons reached by Tab and pressed by Enter or Space, and each add is announced.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial amount in the pot.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the quick-add press that changed the amount.

props.name: goal
props.description: The target; the pot is full here and the lip glints when reached.

props.name: steps
props.description: Quick-add amounts rendered as buttons under the readout. An empty list hides the row.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every amount. The default pins an explicit locale so server and client agree.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the pot; printed above the readout and read as the meter's label.

usageNotes: Tab reaches each quick-add button and Enter or Space presses it; the pot itself is a role="meter" whose value text says how much is saved and how much is left, and a status line announces each add and the moment the goal is reached.

Under reduced motion the coin fades in on the surface instead of falling, the level and the count move on a tween, and the lip turns success without the travelling glint — the fill still fills, because that is the information.
A lower value drops the level on glide with no coin: a withdrawal is never celebrated.

items.title: Round Up
items.tagline: The change, saved.
items.description: A purchase card whose spare change is saved. When a new purchase arrives with the switch on, the change chip lifts out of the card on snap and glides into the savings figure above, shrinking as it goes; on arrival the figure rolls its digits on snap and a tag names what landed. The switch is a real role="switch" that Space and Enter flip, the figure reads as one string, and each landing is announced.

props.name: purchase
props.description: { id, merchant, amount, note? }. A new id is a new purchase; when enabled its change lifts and flies.

props.name: saved / defaultSaved
props.description: Controlled or initial round-up total.

props.name: onSavedChange
props.description: Fires when a lifted change lands in the figure, with the new total and the amount that landed.

props.name: enabled / defaultEnabled
props.description: Controlled or initial switch state.

props.name: onEnabledChange
props.description: Fires from the press that flipped the switch.

props.name: roundTo
props.description: The unit a purchase rounds up to.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every amount. The default pins an explicit locale so server and client agree.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the savings figure.

usageNotes: The switch is a button with role="switch" and aria-checked; Tab reaches it and Space or Enter flips it. The figure is a labelled group whose rolling columns stay hidden behind an sr-only amount, and a status line announces each landing and each flip.
Under reduced motion the chip fades on the card instead of travelling — its fade still commits the total and fires onSavedChange — and the digits swap in place.
A purchase arriving mid-flight mounts a second flyer rather than interrupting the first, so every lifted change still lands and still counts.

items.title: Interest Drip
items.tagline: Watch it grow, slowly.
items.description: A savings balance with the interest accruing in front of you. While playing, a timer compounds the balance by fractions of a cent per tick with a soft colour pulse, the cent column rolls on snap when a whole cent turns, and a projection line beneath extends on glide as simulated days pass. Hovering or focusing the figure shows the daily rate; Tab reaches the figure, Enter pins the card and Escape dismisses it.

props.name: principal
props.description: The balance at day 0.

props.name: rate
props.description: Annual percentage yield as a fraction — 0.0305 for 3.05%. Changing it morphs the projection on glide.

props.name: playing
props.description: Runs the accrual timer. It pauses itself while the tab is hidden.

props.name: tickMs
props.description: Milliseconds between ticks.

props.name: stepDays
props.description: Simulated days advanced per tick — an hour by default, so the drip is fractions.

props.name: horizonDays
props.description: How far the projection line looks ahead.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the balance and the daily rate. The default pins an explicit locale so server and client agree.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the balance.

props.name: onTick
props.description: Fires from each timer tick with the compounded balance and elapsed days.

usageNotes: The figure is a button described by the rate sentence: hover or focus shows the card, Enter or Space pins it, Escape and blur dismiss it. The projection is an image whose name states the projected balance at the horizon.

Under reduced motion the pulse is already colour only; the cent column swaps instead of rolling, the card fades without travel, and the line's length swaps on a tween. The drip still drips, because the accrual is the information.
The live region reports each whole simulated day and each pause, never every tick, and the timer never reads a clock — time is counted from the ticks.

items.title: Goal Timeline
items.tagline: When you will get there.
items.description: A timeline from now to a horizon with a marker planted where the goal is met at the current monthly contribution. Moving the contribution slider slides the marker earlier or later on glide, the filled run stretching behind it on the same spring, while the flag cross-fades to the new month and the months figure rolls in on snap. The thumb is a real slider: Arrow keys step, PageUp and PageDown take ten steps, Home and End jump, and the projection is announced when the slider settles.

props.name: saved
props.description: Already in the goal.

props.name: goal
props.description: The target amount.

props.name: monthly / defaultMonthly
props.description: Controlled or initial monthly contribution.

props.name: onMonthlyChange
props.description: Fires from the pointer or key that moved the slider.

props.name: min / max / step
props.description: Slider range and step.

props.name: start
props.description: The timeline's first month (month 1–12). Seeded, never read from a clock.

props.name: horizonMonths
props.description: How far the track looks ahead; a goal past it parks the marker at the end.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the amounts and the slider's value text. The default pins an explicit locale so server and client agree.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the goal; heads the instrument and labels the slider.

usageNotes: The thumb is a focusable role="slider" with aria-valuetext naming the contribution and the months to go; pressing the track jumps to that value and dragging scrubs it, capturing the pointer only after 4px so a tap stays a tap.
