props.description: Controlled or initial state of the name list.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires as the list opens and closes, by pointer or by key.

props.name: onCountChange
props.description: Fires once per change of the figure, with the signed step.

usageNotes: The figure is a button whose accessible name is a sentence — the count, the step and the window; Enter or Space pins the name list open and Escape closes it.
A pointer opens the list softly and a press pins it, so moving the pointer away cannot snatch a pinned list back.
Under reduced motion the digits swap in place, the bars take their height where they stand and the list's room swaps on a tween, but the count, the graph and the names still update.

items.title: Away Timer
items.tagline: Back in ten.
items.description: Going away dims the disc, hangs a clock on its corner in place of the presence dot, and draws a ring that drains linearly across the period, because a minute is a minute and no easing may borrow from it. The remainder lives in one motion value the ring reads and the mm:ss figure steps from, so the two can never disagree and no clock is read during render. Expiry returns the presence dot with a pop from 0.4 on recoil, and coming back early plays the same pop.

props.name: name
props.description: The member, shown and spoken.

props.name: seconds
props.description: The away period counted from, in seconds. Changing it restarts the run.

props.name: away / defaultAway
props.description: Controlled or initial away state.

props.name: onAwayChange
props.description: Fires when away is set or cleared, including at expiry.

props.name: note
props.description: The away note shown beside the countdown.

props.name: warnSeconds
props.description: Remainder at which the ring and the figure warm to warn.

props.name: onExpire
props.description: Fires once when the remainder reaches zero.

props.name: onRemainingChange
props.description: Fires from the timer each time the whole second changes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Holds the control; the countdown still runs and still reads.

usageNotes: The state is a visible sentence — Away, the note and the remainder, or Online — so the ring, the dim and the dot are never the only signal; the figure is plain text rather than a live region, so nobody is read a number every second.
The period comes from the seconds prop and the run restarts when it changes or when away is set again; a hidden tab holds the run where it stands rather than spending time it never showed.
Under reduced motion nothing pops and nothing travels, but the ring still drains and the figure still counts, because a countdown is information.

items.title: Image Bubble
items.tagline: A picture, arriving.
items.description: A photo message that develops in the thread. The picture is drawn from its seed — three bands of sky, water and shore that stand from the first frame, with the sun, stars and rocks settling onto them as progress climbs — while the frame's blur clears and its saturation lifts on a slow tween, because blur and colour are tweens rather than physics. Pressing a sharp picture grows it into a viewer inside the component's own box on glide via a shared layoutId, with the frame's height measured by a ResizeObserver; Escape closes it and focus returns to the tile.

props.name: photos
props.description: The pictures in the thread, oldest first: id, from, seed, caption, progress and time.

props.name: peerName
props.description: The other person; every spoken sentence names them.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Fires when a picture opens in the viewer.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Fires when the viewer closes, from the control or from Escape.

props.name: onSharp
props.description: Fires once, the first time a picture's progress reaches 1.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the thread list for assistive technology.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer column.

usageNotes: Each picture is a button: it is disabled while it is still blurred, Enter or Space opens the viewer, focus moves to Close, Tab cycles inside the panel, and Escape closes it and returns focus to the tile it grew from.
Under reduced motion the blur still clears and the percentage still counts, on fast tweens, but no picture travels: the viewer cross-fades in and the frame's height moves on a tween.
The picture is procedural — a seeded harbour drawn in tokens, never an asset — and every coordinate is rounded to three decimals so it hydrates cleanly.

items.title: File Card
items.tagline: A file, and how far it has come.
items.description: A file in a thread, and the distance it still has to travel. One control carries the whole journey: a round button with a down arrow on offer, a ring whose dash offset follows progress on glide with the arrow cross-faded to a stop square so the same press cancels, and at 1 a pill that widens in place with layout while a tick draws on flick. Failure freezes the ring, states "Failed" in words beside the name and offers Retry; the type tile is drawn from the file's own name and every size goes through a format prop.

props.name: files
props.description: The files in the thread, oldest first: id, from, name, bytes, kind, progress, state and time.

props.name: format
props.description: Renders every size, so a host's own units win.

props.name: onDownload
props.description: Fires from the round control while the file is on offer.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Fires from the same control while it is loading.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Fires from the Open pill once the file has landed.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Fires from the Retry pill after a failure.

props.name: onSettle
props.description: Fires once, when a file first reaches "ready".

props.name: peerName
props.description: Names the sender under each card.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the thread list for assistive technology.

usageNotes: Plain Tab order — one control per card, Enter and Space activate it; the control's accessible name states the action and the state ("Cancel download of site-survey.pdf, 58 percent"), and an sr-only progressbar beside it carries the value.
Under reduced motion the ring still fills and the tick still appears, on tweens rather than springs, and the control swaps its width outright instead of gliding.
Failure is stated in words as well as colour, and a status region announces each settle once.

items.title: Link Unfurl
items.tagline: A link that unfolds its preview.
items.description: A pasted link that unfolds its preview inside the bubble. While the host reports "fetching" a skeleton the shape of the card mounts in the fold, which glides open to that measured height on glide while a highlight sweeps across on a linear tween; the card then cross-fades in over the skeleton from distances.step on snap, both stacked in one grid cell so the fold never collapses between them. Removing folds it back to zero on glide, the thumbnail is drawn from a seed rather than loaded, and the card is a button so a sweep cannot navigate away.

props.name: url
props.description: The address in the bubble, and the thing being previewed.

props.name: text
props.description: What was typed before the link.

props.name: from
props.description: Which side the bubble takes.

props.name: state
props.description: The fold's state, owned by the host.

props.name: preview
props.description: Title, description, invented domain and the seed that draws the thumbnail.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Fires from the preview card.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Fires from the card's remove control; set state back to "idle".

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Fires from Retry when no preview could be had.

props.name: onUnfurled
props.description: Fires once, when the card has finished opening.

props.name: time
props.description: Printed under the bubble, already formatted.

props.name: peerName
props.description: Names the sender under the bubble.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the thread list for assistive technology.

usageNotes: The card and its remove control are two sibling buttons, never nested: Tab reaches the preview then Remove, Enter and Space activate, and the fold carries aria-busy while it waits.
Under reduced motion the fold still opens and closes on a tween, because a preview appearing is the information, but the sweep gives way to a steady "Fetching preview" line.
A status region announces "Preview loaded", "No preview available" and "Preview removed", one frozen sentence per change.

items.title: Gallery Strip
items.tagline: Several pictures, one strip.
items.description: Several pictures in one message, without leaving the message. The strip is a real overflow-x-auto box inside the bubble with a fade at whichever end still holds pictures, each following a measured edge on a fast tween. Pressing a thumbnail opens a viewer in flow beneath it — the fold glides from 0 to a ResizeObserver-measured height on glide — where pictures cross-fade with a 4px nudge on snap whose direction follows the index delta, while the strip drives the active thumbnail to the centre with animate on glide. A roving tabindex steps the strip and Escape closes the viewer.

props.name: photos
props.description: The pictures in the strip's order: id, seed and caption.

props.name: openId / defaultOpenId
props.description: Controlled or initial open picture; null closes the viewer.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires when the viewer opens, moves or closes.

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: Fires as the cursor moves along the strip, viewer or not.

props.name: from
props.description: Which side the message takes.

props.name: text
props.description: A line above the strip.

props.name: time
props.description: Printed under the message, already formatted.

props.name: peerName
props.description: Names the sender under the message.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the thread list for assistive technology.

usageNotes: Roving tabindex across the strip: Left and Right step without wrapping, Home and End jump to the ends, Enter or Space opens the viewer, and Escape closes it and returns focus to the thumbnail it grew from; the open thumbnail also carries aria-current and a cobalt ring.
The viewer is a non-modal group in flow, so the strip stays live behind it and Left and Right move the picture while focus sits on Previous or Next.
Under reduced motion the viewer still opens and the strip still scrolls to the active picture, instantly, and pictures cross-fade without the nudge.

items.title: Sticker Pop
items.tagline: A sticker that lands with weight.
items.description: A sticker that lands with weight. Each figure is drawn — a waving hand, a five-point star from rounded polar coordinates, a cat, a bolt — and drops from 16px above at 0.86 scale on recoil, whose two visible bounces read as something dropped rather than placed, while the ellipse beneath widens and deepens on glide half a beat behind. Hovering or focusing nudges it 3px up with a seeded tilt on flick, and pressing replays the landing through animation controls rather than a remount, which would take the keyboard's focus with it.

props.name: messages
props.description: The thread, oldest first: id, from, art, an optional text for plain bubbles, seed and time.

props.name: peerName
props.description: The other person; every spoken sentence names them.

props.name: onLand
props.description: Fires when a landing finishes, on arrival and on every replay.

props.name: onReplay
props.description: Fires from a press, or Enter or Space, on a landed sticker.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the thread list for assistive technology.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer column.

usageNotes: Each sticker is a button named with a sentence ("Replay sticker: cat, from Marta") and the drawing inside is aria-hidden, so the picture is never read as a glyph; Enter and Space replay, and focus draws the same nudge hovering does.

Under reduced motion nothing drops and nothing tilts — the sticker fades in at rest — but a press is still answered by a ring that pulses once, because the acknowledgement is information even when the bounce is not.
Arrivals announce themselves once from a sentence frozen at the change, so a parent re-render never re-announces a sticker that landed long ago.

items.title: GIF Loop
items.tagline: Loops until you look away.
items.description: A looping picture that plays only where it can be seen. Each clip is drawn rather than fetched — a seeded hash turns the clip's seed and frame index into a skyline, ground stripes and a marker arcing across the frame — and an IntersectionObserver rooted on the thread's own scroll box stops the tick when a clip falls below the visible threshold, landing a play badge on snap behind a fading scrim while a rail head travels one loop's width on a linear tween. Space or Enter pauses a clip by hand, aria-pressed carries that state, and under reduced motion nothing plays itself: the button becomes a frame step, one press per frame.

props.name: clips
props.description: The thread, oldest first: id, side, title, seed, frame count, time and delivery.

props.name: paused / defaultPaused
props.description: Controlled or initial ids of clips paused by hand.

props.name: onPausedChange
props.description: Fires from the press or key that pauses or resumes a clip by hand.

props.name: onFrameChange
props.description: Fires on each frame a clip advances to.

props.name: onLoop
props.description: Fires as a clip wraps past its last frame, with its running loop count.

props.name: onInViewChange
props.description: Fires with the first reading and whenever a clip crosses the threshold.

props.name: fps
props.description: Frames a second while a clip plays.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Visible share a clip must hold in the viewport to keep playing.

props.name: viewportHeight
props.description: Height of the thread's scroll viewport, in pixels.

props.name: viewportRef
props.description: Hands the scroll viewport to the host so it can scroll the thread itself.

props.name: peerName
props.description: Names the other side in delivery and clip sentences.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the scrollable thread region for assistive technology.

usageNotes: Each clip is a button whose accessible name is a sentence — "Looping clip from Rui, Bay 3 door cycle, paused, out of view" — with aria-pressed carrying the hand pause; Space or Enter toggles, and the scroll region is focusable so a keyboard can move the thread.
Under reduced motion nothing plays itself: every clip holds a still frame with the badge up and the press steps exactly one frame, the caption reading frame N of M.
The tick also stops while the document is hidden, so a backgrounded tab never animates a thread nobody is looking at.

items.title: Audio Wave
items.tagline: A message you can hear.
items.description: An audio attachment in a thread, with a seeded waveform that fills bar by bar. As the position crosses a bar that bar wakes to its full level and colour on flick, the fastest spring in the set, so the fill arrives like the sound passing rather than a wipe sliding over a picture, while the head follows on a linear tween matched to the host's tick. The rate control rolls a column of faces one face on snap; the wave is a real slider where Left and Right step five seconds, Up and Down one, and Home and End jump.

props.name: clips
props.description: The thread, oldest first: id, side, title, seconds, seed, time and delivery.

props.name: playingId
props.description: The clip the host is playing; playback lives in the host, never in the component.

props.name: positions
props.description: Seconds played per clip id; a clip with no entry sits at zero.

props.name: onPlayRequest
props.description: Fires from a transport press; the host decides what plays.

props.name: onSeek
props.description: Fires from a scrub, a tap on the wave, or an arrow key, in whole seconds.

props.name: speed / defaultSpeed
props.description: Controlled or initial playback rate; one of speeds.

props.name: onSpeedChange
props.description: Fires as the label rolls to the next rate.

props.name: speeds
props.description: The rates the control cycles through.

props.name: bars
props.description: Bars drawn per waveform; the profile is seeded, so it never changes shape.

props.name: followMs
props.description: How long the head takes to reach a new position; match the host's tick.

props.name: peerName
props.description: Names the other side in the group and delivery sentences.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the thread list for assistive technology.

usageNotes: The wave is a role="slider" reading mm:ss of mm:ss: Left and Right step five seconds, Up and Down step one, Home and End jump to the ends, and a pointer scrub captures only after 4px of travel so a tap still seeks where it landed.
Under reduced motion the bars still fill and the head still moves, because position is information: the wake becomes an instant swap and the rate label changes without rolling.
Each bubble is a role="group" whose label is a sentence — "Audio from Marta, Roof deck walkthrough, 2 minutes 41 seconds" — and delivery is an aria-label sentence rather than a colour.

items.title: Location Pin
items.tagline: Here, on a small map.
items.description: A place sent as a card, on a map that is drawn rather than fetched: a seeded hash lays out major roads, lanes, blocks, a park and a water bend. The pin drops the 16px shift onto its point on recoil, two visible bounces of an arrival, while its shadow scales up on the same spring; pressing expands the card in flow, the street group scaling toward the pin on glide and the detail animating to a ResizeObserver-measured height inside the card's own box. The toggle is a button with aria-expanded whose name carries the address and distance, and Escape collapses it and keeps focus.

props.name: places
props.description: The thread, oldest first: id, side, name, address, seed, metres, time and delivery.

props.name: openId / defaultOpenId
props.description: Controlled or initial id of the expanded card; one card opens at a time.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires from the press or key that expands or collapses a card.

props.name: onOpenPlace
props.description: Fires from the expanded card's Open control, so the host can take the place.

props.name: zoom
props.description: How far the street group grows when a card expands.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the distance chip; defaults to metres under a kilometre, one decimal above.

props.name: peerName
props.description: Names the other side in the card and delivery sentences.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the thread list for assistive technology.

usageNotes: The toggle is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls whose accessible name is a sentence carrying the place, the address and the distance; Space or Enter toggles and Escape collapses, leaving focus on the toggle.
The detail opens in flow at a ResizeObserver-measured height and is inert while closed, so nothing hidden is tabbable and no panel floats over what the host drew below.
Under reduced motion the pin appears at its point instead of dropping, and the height and the zoom swap on a tween rather than gliding.

items.title: Chat Poll
items.tagline: Vote, and watch the bars.
items.description: A poll sent into a thread, with the counts public from the first glance: every bar is already drawn, and every one re-flows the moment you vote, because your vote joins the total and drops everyone else's share. Bars take their new width on glide with a cascade delay so the re-flow reads top to bottom, the total rolls beneath on the same spring, and the leading rail travels between rows on snap through a useId-prefixed layoutId. The rows are a real radiogroup: arrows move focus without spending a vote, Home and End jump, Space or Enter casts, and pressing your own row again withdraws it.

props.name: poll
props.description: The poll message: id, side, question, options with their votes, time, delivery and a closing note.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial id of the reader's own vote.

props.name: onVote
props.type: (id: string | null, previous: string | null) => void
props.description: Fires from the press or key that casts, moves or withdraws a vote.

props.name: allowChange
props.description: Lets the reader move or withdraw a vote after casting it.

props.name: closed
props.description: Locks the rows, keeps the winner lit and lets the rest fall back.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every count and the rolling total; defaults to en-US thousands.

props.name: peerName
props.description: Names the sender in the delivery sentence.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the thread list for assistive technology.

usageNotes: A roving tabindex over a radiogroup: Up and Down (or Left and Right) step rows without wrapping, Home and End jump, and Space or Enter votes — arrows move focus without casting, because arrowing through a poll should not spend your vote.
Every row's aria-label carries its count and share, and the live region speaks the sentence frozen at the vote, so nothing rests on the bar's colour.
Under reduced motion the bars still re-flow — a share is information — on a tween with no cascade, the rail swaps rows without travelling, and the total lands on its new figure.

items.title: Code Snippet
items.tagline: Code that copies itself.
items.description: A block of code sent into a thread, built to be taken. A hand tokeniser colours each line — comment, string, number, keyword — while the gutter of line numbers stays put and the body scrolls sideways inside its own box. Pressing copy writes the text, a hairline sweep takes the block top to bottom on a linear tween, and Copied stamps over the control on recoil, out of 1.5 and −6 degrees; a refused clipboard selects the block's own text and asks for Control or Command C instead. Long blocks fold to a height measured from one ResizeObserver, so the fold lands exactly on a line, and unfold on glide.

props.name: snippets
props.description: The thread, oldest first: id, side, language, code, filename, time and delivery.

props.name: foldLines
props.description: Lines shown before a block folds behind its fade.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: Controlled or initial ids of unfolded blocks.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires from the disclosure that folds or unfolds a block.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Fires once the clipboard has taken a block's text.

props.name: onCopyFail
props.description: Fires when the clipboard refuses and the block falls back to selection.

props.name: copiedHold
props.description: Milliseconds the stamp stays before the control reads Copy again.

props.name: peerName
props.description: Names the other side in the block and delivery sentences.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the thread list for assistive technology.

usageNotes: Tab order runs copy, the disclosure, then the code region: the copy control names the file, the disclosure is a real aria-expanded button, and the scrolling region is focusable so a keyboard can move a wide line.
When the clipboard refuses, the block selects its own text and the live region asks for Control or Command C, so the copy is still one keystroke away.
Under reduced motion the sweep is replaced by a single wash that fades, and the fold swaps its measured height on a tween rather than gliding.

items.title: Channel List
items.tagline: Rooms, with their unread.
items.description: The rooms you are in, ordered by what just happened in them. Rows carry layout, so a room that receives a message climbs and every row it passes trades places on glide, while the badge replays a landing from scale 1.18 on recoil and muted rows dim to a hollow badge that still shows its count. The list is one tab stop: Down and Up step rows, Home and End jump to the ends, Right moves to the row's bell and Left comes back.

props.name: channels
props.description: The rooms. Each carries an id, name, optional preview, unread count, an activity rank and a muted flag.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial id of the open room; the default is the most active one.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from a row's click, Enter or Space.

props.name: onMuteToggle
props.description: Fires from a row's bell with the state the host should store.

props.name: onAnnounce
props.description: Fires once per frozen change sentence, for a parent's own status line.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the list for assistive technology.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Tallest the list grows before it scrolls inside its own box.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Drawn when there are no rooms.

usageNotes: One tab stop under a two-column roving tabindex: Down and Up step rows, Home and End jump to the ends, Right moves from the row to its bell and Left returns, Enter and Space open a room.
Under reduced motion the re-sort lands instantly and the badge does not bounce, but the count still changes and muted rows still dim, because what is unread is information.
Order comes from each room's `activity` rank, a monotonic number the host raises when a message lands — the component never reads a clock, so it renders the same on the server and the client.

items.title: Unread Line
items.tagline: New messages start here.
items.description: The rule that says where you stopped. The separator draws itself with a scaleX from its left origin on glide while the pill beside it arrives 4px up on flick, and as you read it keeps its key inside one AnimatePresence so the same rule travels to its new seat under layout while the messages re-seat around it. The pill is a real button that marks everything below it read, and when the last unread goes the rule fades and lifts away on the exit ease rather than springing.

props.name: messages
props.description: The thread, oldest first: id, author, text and a preformatted time.

props.name: readCount / defaultReadCount
props.description: Controlled or initial count of messages read from the top; the rule sits after them.

props.name: onReadCountChange
props.description: Fires when the rule's own pill advances the boundary.

props.name: onMarkAllRead
props.description: Fires from the pill, alongside onReadCountChange.

props.name: onAnnounce
props.description: Fires once per frozen change sentence, for a parent's own status line.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the thread for assistive technology.

props.name: dividerLabel
props.description: The pill's word.

props.name: upToDateLabel
props.description: What the header reads when nothing is unread.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Tallest the thread grows before it scrolls inside its own box.

usageNotes: The pill is the component's one control: Enter or Space marks everything below the rule read, and the thread's scroll box is focusable so the list can be read from the keyboard.
Under reduced motion the rule appears at full width with no draw and no travel, and it leaves on a plain fade — but the count still changes, because what is unread is information.
The header stacks "4 new messages" and "You are up to date" in one grid cell and cross-fades them, so no height is held for a state that is not showing.

items.title: Jump Latest
items.tagline: Back to the bottom.
items.description: The way back down. While the thread sits at its floor nothing shows; scroll up past revealDistance and a pill rises from the box's bottom edge on snap, counting the messages that landed while you were away with digits that roll on snap. Pressing it, or pressing End inside the thread, animates scrollTop to the floor on glide with every frame rounded, and the slide stops on unmount, on a new press, and when the document is hidden.

props.name: messages
props.description: The thread, oldest first: id, author, text, a preformatted time and an own flag.

props.name: onJump
props.description: Fires when a jump starts, from the pill or from End.

props.name: onNewCountChange
props.description: Fires when the count of messages that arrived while you were away changes.

props.name: onAtBottomChange
props.description: Fires as the box reaches or leaves its floor.

props.name: onAnnounce
props.description: Fires once per frozen change sentence, for a parent's own status line.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the thread for assistive technology.

props.name: jumpLabel
props.description: The pill's word when nothing new has arrived.

props.name: revealDistance
props.description: Pixels above the floor before the pill rises.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Tallest the thread grows before it scrolls inside its own box.

usageNotes: The thread is a focusable region: End slides to the floor — the same move the pill makes — and Home slides to the top; the pill itself is a real button that leaves the DOM at the floor rather than lingering as a focusable ghost.
Under reduced motion the pill fades in place and the jump lands in one step, but the count still rolls, because what arrived is information.
A thread already at its floor stays pinned there as messages land; one that is scrolled up is left where the reader put it and counts what it missed.

items.title: Pinned Bar
items.tagline: The important ones, up top.
items.description: The strip above the thread, holding everything pinned to it. One note shows at a time and pressing the bar cycles to the next with a slide in the direction of travel on snap, under AnimatePresence popLayout so the outgoing line leaves the flow while the incoming one sets the height a ResizeObserver hands the strip to glide to. The active tick travels its rail on a layoutId and the index digit rolls; unpinning fades the line out on the exit ease and collapses the strip, to nothing at all when the last pin goes.

props.name: pins
props.description: What the bar holds, most recently pinned first: id, author, text and a preformatted time.

props.name: index / defaultIndex
props.description: Controlled or initial index of the pin on show; clamped for display whenever the array shrinks.

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Fires from the body press and the arrow keys.

props.name: onUnpin
props.description: Fires from the unpin control or Delete; the host removes the note.

props.name: onAnnounce
props.description: Fires once per frozen change sentence, for a parent's own status line.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the bar for assistive technology.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: A word for the empty bar; unset, the bar collapses to nothing.

usageNotes: The body is one button: Enter and Space cycle forward, Right and Down step forward, Left and Up step back, Home and End jump to the ends, and Delete or Backspace unpins the note on show; the unpin control is the second tab stop.

Under reduced motion nothing slides — notes cross-fade, the strip's height changes on a tween and the tick is drawn on its new seat — but the count still changes, because which pin you are on is information.
The strip's height comes from a ResizeObserver on its inner column, so notes of different lengths never make it jump and an empty bar occupies nothing.

items.title: Search Inline
items.tagline: Find it in the thread.
items.description: Find in the thread, without leaving it. Every occurrence takes a wash that sweeps in from its left edge — scaleX on a layer behind the words, staggered by cascade and capped at the 600ms budget — while messages with no match recede on a tween, so the hits read as a set. Enter steps to the next match and the box slides to it on glide with every scroll frame rounded, Shift+Enter steps back, Escape clears the term, and the 3 / 7 readout rolls a digit at a time on snap.

props.name: messages
props.description: The thread, oldest first: id, author, text, a preformatted time and an own flag.

props.name: query / defaultQuery
props.description: Controlled or initial search term.

props.name: onQueryChange
props.description: Fires from every keystroke and from Escape's clear.

props.name: onMatchChange
props.description: Fires when the current match or the total changes; index is 1-based and 0 when there is nothing to step to. Memoise it.

props.name: onAnnounce
props.description: Fires once per frozen change sentence, for a parent's own status line.

props.name: caseSensitive
props.description: Match case.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the field for assistive technology.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text in the field.

props.name: threadLabel
props.description: Names the thread's scroll region.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Tallest the thread grows before it scrolls inside its own box.

usageNotes: Enter steps to the next match and Shift+Enter to the previous; Escape clears the term and keeps focus in the field; the two step buttons repeat the same moves and go aria-disabled when there is nothing to step to.

Under reduced motion nothing sweeps or slides — marks appear at full wash and the step sets the scroll in one move — but the count still changes and unmatched messages still recede, because both are information.
Matching is capped at 200 marks and the current match carries aria-current, so the position is never colour alone.

items.title: Folder Tabs
items.tagline: All, unread, mentions.
items.description: Three folders over one channel list. A single pill keyed by a useId-prefixed layoutId glides between All, Unread and Mentions on snap, and the filter it applies re-lays the list beneath it: the rows that stay travel to their new places on glide, the rows that no longer match leave on the exit ease, and the box animates to a ResizeObserver-measured height so a folder holding one row closes to one row. Each tab's count is a strip of digits that rolls on snap; Left and Right move and activate the folders, Home and End jump.

props.name: channels
props.description: Rows to filter: id, name, preview, unread and mentions decide which folders show them.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial folder: all, unread or mentions.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from a tab press or an arrow key.

props.name: activeChannel / defaultActiveChannel
props.description: Controlled or initial open channel id.

props.name: onChannelSelect
props.description: Fires from a row press with the channel that was opened.

props.name: labels
props.description: Tab copy; defaults to All, Unread and Mentions.

props.name: emptyLabels
props.description: The sentence a folder shows when it holds nothing.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Pixels the list grows to before it scrolls inside its own box.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the tablist and the list for assistive technology.

usageNotes: A real tablist with a roving tabindex: Left and Right move and activate the folder, Home and End jump to the first and last, and the panel is focusable so the list can be scrolled from the keyboard.

Every tab and every row is named by a single string — "Unread, 2 channels", "#returns, 2 unread, 1 mention. Marta: Two crates came back split." — and a status region reads the folder you switched to and the channel you opened.
Under reduced motion the pill appears under its tab without a layoutId, the rows stop travelling, the list height is set rather than glided, and the counts swap without rolling.

items.title: Mute Bell
items.tagline: Quiet, until you say.
items.description: A bell that goes quiet for a stated length of time. Pressing it unfolds a duration picker in flow below the row on glide against a ResizeObserver-measured height, and choosing one folds the picker, swings the bell on a four-keyframe tween and draws the slash across it on flick. A ring around the bell then drains a second at a time while the row's second line reads the time left in place of the topic, cross-faded in one grid cell; Escape folds the picker and returns focus to the bell.

props.name: channel
props.description: The channel's name, printed after a hash.

props.name: topic
props.description: The row's second line while notifications are on.

props.name: durations
props.defaultValue: 30 minutes / 1 hour / 8 hours / Until I say
props.description: The picker's stops; an ms of 0 means until it is turned back on.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: Controlled or initial picker state.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires from the bell, Escape, or a chosen duration.

props.name: onMuteChange
props.description: Fires with the chosen duration, or null when notifications come back on.

props.name: onExpire
props.description: Fires once when the countdown reaches zero.

props.name: speed
props.description: Countdown milliseconds per real millisecond; the demo runs it fast so the ring drains while you watch.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the channel in the spoken sentences; defaults to the hashed channel.

usageNotes: The bell is a disclosure while notifications are on — aria-expanded and aria-controls on the picker — and an action while they are off; Escape folds the picker and returns focus to the bell, and every chip is a real button named with a whole sentence.

The countdown lives in one interval with cleanup, pauses while the document is hidden, and never reads a clock during render; a status region says "Muted for 1 hour.", "Notifications are on." and "The mute ran out. Notifications are back on." as each happens.
Under reduced motion the picker's height swaps, the bell does not swing and the slash appears whole, but the ring still drains, because a countdown is information.

items.title: Archive Slide
items.tagline: Out of the way.
items.description: A channel list where a row can be pushed aside. Dragging a row left uncovers the one action parked under it, whose ink and glyph grow straight from the travel so the commit point is felt before the finger lifts; a short release returns the row on snap, and a release past the threshold hands the rest of the travel to a tween on the exit ease before the rows below close the gap on glide. An undo chip unfolds in flow at the foot of the list against a measured height, and every row keeps an archive button so Delete or Backspace archives without the gesture.

props.name: channels
props.description: The rows in list order: id, name, preview and an optional unread count.

props.name: archived / defaultArchived
props.description: Controlled or initial archived ids; those rows leave the list.

props.name: onArchivedChange
props.description: Fires with the next set from an archive or an undo.

props.name: onArchive
props.description: Fires when a row commits, from the gesture or the button.

props.name: onRestore
props.description: Fires from the undo chip with the channel that came back.

props.name: activeChannel / defaultActiveChannel
props.description: Controlled or initial open channel id.

props.name: onChannelSelect
props.description: Fires from a row press that was a press, not a drag.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Pixels of travel that commit the archive.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: The parked action's copy.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: The sentence shown when every channel has been put away.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the list for assistive technology.

usageNotes: Every row carries an archive button named "Archive #returns." and Delete or Backspace on a focused row archives it, so the gesture is a shortcut rather than the only path; after a row leaves, focus lands on the row that took its index, or on the undo chip when the list empties.

The pointer is captured only after 4px of horizontal travel, only when the drag is more horizontal than vertical, and inside try/catch, so a plain press still opens the channel and a vertical scroll still belongs to the page.
Under reduced motion the row still follows the pointer — direct manipulation is not animation — but nothing springs: a commit fades the row out where it stands and the gap closes without a FLIP.

items.title: Section Collapse
items.tagline: Fold a group of rooms.
items.description: A sidebar of sections that fold their own rooms. A header press joins the body to zero on glide against a height a ResizeObserver measured from the body's own content, the caret turns a quarter on snap, and the rows fade on a tween rather than sliding. What the fold hides comes back to the header: the unread inside rises into a badge from 4px on snap with its digits rolling, and unfolding drops it on the exit ease; Down and Up move between headers while Home and End jump.

props.name: sections
props.description: Each section is an id, a title and its channels; a channel carries an unread count and direct or muted marks.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: Controlled or initial ids of the unfolded sections.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires from the press or key that folded or unfolded a section.

props.name: activeChannel / defaultActiveChannel
props.description: Controlled or initial selected channel id.

props.name: onChannelSelect
props.description: Fires from a row press with the channel that was opened.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: The sentence shown inside a section that holds no channels.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the whole sidebar for assistive technology.

usageNotes: Each header is a real disclosure with aria-expanded, aria-controls and a name that is one sentence including the count — "Direct, folded, 2 unread inside." — so what a fold hides can be heard without unfolding it.

Down and Up move focus between headers and Home and End jump, while the headers stay ordinary tab stops so Tab still reaches the rows; a folded body is hidden from assistive technology and taken out of the tab order rather than merely clipped.
Under reduced motion the heights swap, the caret turns without a spring and the badge fades in place, but every count still updates, because what is waiting behind a fold is information.

items.title: Room Switcher
items.tagline: Jump by typing.
items.description: A room header with a switcher behind a hotkey. Ctrl or Cmd with K raises a panel inside the component's own frame that rises from 8px on snap behind a fading scrim, and typing filters the rooms: the matches carry layout and travel on glide while the rest leave on the exit ease, against a ResizeObserver-measured list height. Enter switches and the header slides — the room you left rises out while the one you chose arrives from below, both stacked in one grid cell and keyed by a jump counter — then focus returns to the trigger.

props.name: rooms
props.description: Every room: id, name, topic, its last line and who wrote it, plus optional direct and unread marks.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial room id; defaults to the first room.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from Enter or an option press.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: Controlled or initial panel state.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires from the hotkey, the trigger, Escape, the scrim, or a chosen room.

props.name: onQueryChange
props.description: Fires from every keystroke with the trimmed query and how many rooms matched.

props.name: hotkey
props.description: The key that raises the panel, pressed with Ctrl or Cmd.

props.name: hotkeyHint
props.description: What the trigger prints in its keycaps, space separated.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The field's placeholder, which also names it.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: The sentence shown when nothing matches.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the switcher, its dialog and its listbox for assistive technology.

usageNotes: The panel is a modal dialog raised by Ctrl or Cmd with K: Tab cycles inside it, Escape closes it, the scrim closes it, and focus returns to the trigger every time.

The field is a combobox with aria-activedescendant over a listbox — Down and Up wrap, Home and End jump, Enter switches — and the active option is scrolled into view with block "nearest" rather than focused, so the field keeps taking keystrokes.
Under reduced motion the panel and scrim fade in place, the options stop travelling and the header cross-fades between the two room names without either of them moving.

items.title: Call Bar
items.tagline: A call, ongoing, in the header.
items.description: A call, ongoing, in the header. The bar lives in flow: a wrapper glides its ResizeObserver-measured height from zero on glide while the row rides down from 8px, so a call arriving pushes the thread rather than covering it. Ringing pulses a halo behind Join on a repeating tween; joining stops it, swaps to a plain Leave, and starts an elapsed figure held in one linearly driven motion value that pauses with the tab. Escape declines a ringing call but never hangs up a joined one.

props.name: state / defaultState
props.description: Controlled or initial call state.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Fires from Join, Decline and Leave.

props.name: title
props.description: The room or caller the call belongs to; shown and spoken.

props.name: participants
props.description: Names already in the call; drives the count sentence and the disc.

props.name: startSeconds
props.description: Seconds already elapsed when the bar joins.

props.name: onElapsedChange
props.description: Fires once per whole second while joined.

props.name: onJoin
props.description: Fires after the state settles on joined.

props.name: onLeave
props.description: Fires after the state settles on none, with the run's final seconds.

props.name: joinLabel
props.description: Copy on the primary control while ringing.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Holds both controls; a running call still counts and still reads.

usageNotes: Tab reaches Join then Decline while ringing, and Leave alone once joined; Escape declines a ringing call but never hangs up a joined one, because leaving has to be deliberate.
Under reduced motion the bar's height still opens and closes — a call arriving is information — but on a tween, with no travel and no pulse; the elapsed figure counts exactly the same.
The mm:ss figure is plain text rather than a live region, so nobody is read a number every second; a polite status speaks one frozen sentence per change.

items.title: Mic Ring
items.tagline: Your voice, as a ring.
items.description: Your voice, as a ring. One motion value holds the level and everything reads from it: a halo behind the button grows with it on flick, the rim fills a level arc by strokeDashoffset, and a thinner outer arc holds the recent peak and falls back linearly to the live level. Muting closes the ring on snap while a slash draws across the glyph on flick, and unmuting retracts it on the exit ease. The button is a real switch, so Space and Enter toggle it and the level sits beside it as a meter that can be queried but never announces.

props.name: level
props.description: Input level, 0 to 1, clamped. Supplied by the host; the component never reads a device.

props.name: muted / defaultMuted
props.description: Controlled or initial mute state.

props.name: onMutedChange
props.description: Fires from the button, from Space and from Enter.

props.name: onPeakChange
props.description: Fires when the held peak changes, as a rounded percentage 0 to 100.

props.name: peakDecay
props.description: How fast a held peak falls back towards the live level, in level per second.

props.name: name
props.description: Whose voice it is; owns the spoken sentences and the meter's label.

props.name: showReadout
props.description: Draws the level and peak figures beside the button instead of the band word.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Holds the button; the ring still shows the level.

usageNotes: A real role="switch": Space and Enter mute and unmute, and no other key is stolen. The label names the microphone rather than its state, because aria-checked already carries on and off.
The level is a sibling role="meter" with an aria-valuetext sentence, deliberately not a live region — a level read aloud every frame is unusable. Only muting and unmuting are announced.
Under reduced motion the halo holds at one and carries the level as opacity, both arcs still fill because a level is information, and the slash swaps rather than drawing.

items.title: Speaker Grid
items.tagline: Whoever speaks, comes forward.
items.description: Whoever speaks, comes forward. The speaker is derived rather than declared — the loudest participant at or above threshold — and when that changes every tile travels to its new cell with FLIP on glide, because all tiles are siblings of one list and keep their identity across a re-lay. The speaking tile lifts by 4px and rings on snap with the ring's opacity following the level. It is a listbox: arrows step across and down, Home and End jump, and Enter or Space pins a tile to the front whatever the levels do.

props.name: participants
props.description: People on the call in join order, each with an id, a name, an optional 0–1 level and a muted flag.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Level at or above which a participant counts as speaking.

props.name: columns
props.description: Grid columns, clamped 1 to 4; also the stride Arrow Up and Down move by.

props.name: pinnedId / defaultPinnedId
props.description: Controlled or initial pin; a pinned tile holds the front cell whatever the levels do.

props.name: onPinnedChange
props.description: Fires from a click, from Enter and from Space.

props.name: onSpeakerChange
props.description: Fires when the derived speaker changes.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the grid for assistive technology.

usageNotes: A listbox with a roving tabindex: Arrow Left and Right step one tile, Arrow Up and Down move a whole row, Home and End jump to the first and last participant, and Enter or Space pins and unpins.

Speaking and muted are stated in words in every tile and in every option's label, so the ring and the lift are never the only signal; a polite status speaks one frozen sentence per speaker or pin change.

Under reduced motion the layout animation is switched off and tiles take their new cells instantly — the order is information and still changes — while nothing lifts and the ring appears on an opacity swap.

items.title: Hand Raise
items.tagline: A hand, raised.
items.description: A hand, raised. Pressing the control sends the glyph out of the button and into the queue rail on a shared layoutId prefixed by useId, travelling on recoil for ζ0.53's two visible bounces, while a chevron cross-fades into the slot it left and the label becomes Lower. The rail is an ordered list in flow whose height a ResizeObserver measures and glide opens from zero, and your place is frozen at the moment you raise, so later arrivals queue behind you and a hand lowering ahead moves you up.

props.name: queue
props.description: Everyone but you, in raise order, each with an id and a name.

props.name: raised / defaultRaised
props.description: Controlled or initial state of your own hand.

props.name: onRaisedChange
props.description: Fires from the button, from Space and from Enter.

props.name: onPositionChange
props.description: Fires with your 1-based place in the queue, or 0 once your hand is down.

props.name: youName
props.description: How your own entry is listed in the rail.

props.name: youId
props.description: The id your entry carries so a host can reconcile it.

props.name: maxVisible
props.description: Hands drawn before the rail folds the rest into a count; your own is never folded away.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Holds the button; the rail still lists and still reads.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the group for assistive technology.

usageNotes: A real toggle button: Space and Enter raise and lower, and the label carries your place — "Lower your hand. You are 3rd in line." Every rail entry prints its ordinal and repeats the whole place as one sr-only sentence, so a place in the queue never depends on reading order alone.
The button's two readings stack in one grid cell and cross-fade rather than swapping, so rapid presses cannot queue a stale label and the width never jumps mid-press.

Under reduced motion the glyph does not fly — it cross-fades between the button and the rail — while the rail's height still opens and the positions still renumber, because a place in a queue is information.

items.title: Share Frame
items.tagline: Your screen, shared.
items.description: Your screen, shared. Pressing Share opens the preview in flow, its height measured by a ResizeObserver and glided from zero, while the border grows rather than appearing: one rounded-rect path with a fixed command count drawn by pathLength on glide, retracting on the exit ease when you stop. The surface inside is drawn from a hash of the source's id rather than captured, and choosing another source cross-fades the window under a frame that holds its shape. The sources are a real radiogroup on a roving tabindex.

props.name: sources
props.description: What can be shared: an id, a name and an optional kind of screen, window or board, each drawn procedurally from its id.

props.name: sourceId / defaultSourceId
props.description: Controlled or initial chosen source; defaults to the first one.

props.name: onSourceChange
props.description: Fires from a chip, from the arrows and from Home and End.

props.name: sharing / defaultSharing
props.description: Controlled or initial sharing state.

props.name: onSharingChange
props.description: Fires from the Share and Stop sharing control.

props.name: viewers
props.description: How many people are watching; stated in words in the badge and in the frame's label.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Holds every control; a running share keeps its frame.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the group for assistive technology.

usageNotes: The sources are a role="radiogroup" on a roving tabindex: Left and Right step without wrapping past the ends, Home and End jump, and Space selects. Share is one aria-pressed button whose label is a whole sentence naming the surface.

The frame opens in flow with a measured height and reserves its own space with an aspect ratio, so it never floats over what the host wrote below and never holds room for a share that is not happening.

Under reduced motion the frame still opens and closes because a share starting is information, but on a tween, with the border swapping in rather than drawing and the badge holding a steady ring instead of a pulse.

items.title: Call Quality
items.tagline: How good the line is.
items.description: How good the line is, as a staircase of bars that rise and fall with the grade on flick — a level meter follows the signal rather than settling into it — leaving the steps it lost behind as hairline ghosts. A reconnecting line flattens the bars and spins a ring around them at a constant linear rate, because a wait turns at a constant rate; a lost line holds a broken arc in danger. The pill is a real disclosure whose detail panel opens in flow on glide at a ResizeObserver-measured height, and Enter or Space opens it.

props.name: level
props.description: Grade 0–4, clamped and rounded; 4 is a clean line.

props.name: state
props.description: The transport's own state; anything but live flattens the bars and shows the ring.

props.name: rttMs
props.description: Round-trip in milliseconds, printed in the pill and the panel.

props.name: lossPercent
props.description: Packet loss, printed with one decimal in the panel.

props.name: jitterMs
props.description: Jitter in milliseconds, printed in the panel.

props.name: dropNote
props.description: One sentence about the last drop, at the foot of the panel.

props.name: bars
props.description: Steps in the staircase.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: The detail panel, controlled or initial.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires as the panel opens and closes.

props.name: onGradeChange
props.description: Fires once per frozen change sentence, such as "The line dropped to poor".

props.name: label
props.description: Names the meter for assistive technology.

usageNotes: The grade is a role="meter" with an aria-valuetext sentence; the pill is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls, and Enter or Space opens the panel in flow rather than over the page.
Under reduced motion the bars still change height on a tween — a grade is information — and the reconnecting ring holds a static broken arc instead of spinning.
A polite status speaks each change once, frozen at the moment it happened, so a re-render cannot repeat a past drop.

items.title: Voice Row
items.tagline: Who is talking, by the wave.
items.description: Who is talking, read off the waves. Each row's strip is driven entirely by the levels the host passes — there is no microphone here — with a fixed per-person profile so a voice keeps its shape, and the bars track the level on flick while silent rows flatten to a hairline. The loudest voice above the threshold takes the turn: its name lifts and turns cobalt on snap. Down and Up step the rows, Home and End jump, and Enter pins a row so its strip grows and holds contrast while others speak.

props.name: participants
props.description: The people on the call as { id, name, muted? }, in the caller's order.

props.name: levels
props.description: Level 0–1 per id, from the host; a missing id sits at zero.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Level at or above which a row counts as speaking.

props.name: bars
props.description: Bars per strip.

props.name: pinnedId / defaultPinnedId
props.description: The pinned row, controlled or initial.

props.name: onPinnedChange
props.description: Fires as a row is pinned or unpinned.

props.name: onSpeakerChange
props.description: Fires once per frozen change sentence, such as "Marta Ferreira is speaking".

props.name: label
props.description: Names the row list for assistive technology.

usageNotes: Rows are toggle buttons under a roving tabindex: Tab reaches the list once, Down and Up step, Home and End jump, Enter and Space pin the focused row.
Each row's name is one sentence — "Rui Baptista, microphone muted. Pin Rui Baptista." — so speaking, silent and muted never depend on colour, and levels are never announced.
Under reduced motion bars still rise and fall on a tween and the active name takes colour and weight instead of lifting.

items.title: Mute All
items.tagline: Everyone, quiet.
items.description: Everyone, quiet — and a way back. Mute all commits every open microphone at once, because the state must never lag the promise, while each slash draws its pathLength on flick at a cascade() delay by row and a cobalt wash sweeps the list top to bottom. Undo restores exactly the microphones that sweep took, running the cascade bottom to top, so a mic somebody closed by hand stays closed. Down and Up step the mics under a roving tabindex and Space toggles one.

props.name: participants
props.description: The people on the call as { id, name, role? }, in the caller's order.

props.name: mutedIds / defaultMutedIds
props.description: The muted set, controlled or initial.

props.name: onMutedIdsChange
props.description: Fires from the sweep, the undo, and every row toggle.

props.name: onMuteAll
props.description: Fires after a sweep with the number of microphones it muted.

props.name: onUndo
props.description: Fires after an undo with the number it unmuted.

props.name: onAnnounce
props.description: Fires once per frozen change sentence, such as "Muted 4 microphones".

props.name: label
props.description: Names the roster for assistive technology.

usageNotes: The header control is one tab stop; the mic toggles share a roving tabindex where Down and Up step, Home and End jump, and Enter or Space toggles the focused microphone.
Every mic is a button with aria-pressed named "Mute Marta Ferreira" or "Unmute Marta Ferreira", so a closed microphone is never a red glyph alone, and counts are pluralised.
Under reduced motion nothing cascades and no wash travels: every slash swaps instantly, because which microphones are muted is information and the order they were taken in is flourish.

items.title: Call End
items.tagline: Hang up, with a moment.
items.description: Hanging up costs a moment. Holding End drives a motion value from 0 to 1 at a linear rate over holdMs, and that value is the ring's pathLength, so the ring fills at the honest rate of the hold; releasing early stops it, drains the ring on the exit ease and says the call is still up. The call ends from the animation's completion callback, the bar leaves on the exit ease, and the frame glides to the ended line at a ResizeObserver-measured height. Space or Enter held fills the ring, releasing or Escape cancels.

props.name: callName
props.description: The room, printed and spoken.

props.name: people
props.description: How many are on the call; printed and pluralised.

props.name: seconds
props.description: Elapsed seconds from the host; this component never reads a clock.

props.name: holdMs
props.description: How long End must be held.

props.name: ended / defaultEnded
props.description: The call's state, controlled or initial.

props.name: onEndedChange
props.description: Fires as the call ends and as it is rejoined.

props.name: onEnd
props.description: Fires once when a hold completes, with the elapsed seconds at that moment.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Fires when a hold is released before it completes.

props.name: onHoldChange
props.description: Fires as the hold starts and stops.

props.name: onRejoin
props.description: Fires from the Rejoin control on the ended line.

usageNotes: Space or Enter held fills the ring and a key repeat cannot restart it; releasing the key, Escape, moving the pointer off the control, or losing focus all cancel and the hint reports that it cancelled.
The ring is aria-hidden and progress is never announced — a live percentage would talk over the hold — while a polite status speaks one frozen sentence per change.
Under reduced motion the ring still fills, because it is the only signal the gesture is working; the bar cross-fades to the ended line instead of sliding, and nothing bounces.

items.title: Ringtone Pulse
items.tagline: Someone is calling.
items.description: Someone is calling, announced by light: this ringtone is a visual pulse and plays nothing. While the call is live, rings expand from the caller's procedural disc and fade on a repeating tween a third of a cycle apart, gated on document visibility so a hidden tab rings at nobody. Decline slides in from the left and Answer from the right on snap, a cascade(2) beat apart, because the choice should look like the choice; answering swaps the body to a connected line at a ResizeObserver-measured height, and Escape declines.

props.name: callerName
props.description: Who is calling; drives the procedural initials and every sentence.

props.name: roomName
props.description: The room the call comes from, printed under the name.

props.name: status / defaultStatus
props.description: The card's state, controlled or initial.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Fires from Answer, Decline and Escape.

props.name: onAnswer
props.description: Fires from the Answer control.

props.name: onDecline
props.description: Fires from the Decline control and from Escape.

props.name: rings
props.description: Expanding rings behind the disc.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the card for assistive technology; defaults to the calling sentence.

usageNotes: Answer and Decline are real buttons sharing one height; Escape declines from anywhere inside the card, and focus lands on the line that replaces them rather than being dropped.
The card is a group named in one sentence and sits in flow, never floating over the host's content; a polite status speaks each change once.
Under reduced motion no rings expand and nothing slides: the disc holds a steady ring, the two controls fade in together, and the words carry the state.

items.title: Report Sheet
items.tagline: Say what is wrong.
items.description: A report sheet that rises inside the component's own box. Pressing Report glides a ResizeObserver-measured height open on glide, the reasons arrive as radio chips from 8px on snap in a cascade stagger, and picking one unfolds a note field in that same measured height and hands it focus. Send stamps a mark that lands from 1.12x on recoil and lowers the sheet after a hold; arrows step the chips, Home and End jump, Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger.

props.name: message
props.type: { author: string; time: string; text: string }
props.description: The message under report, quoted at the top of the component.

props.name: reasons
props.description: The chips, in the order given; each carries a label and an optional hint sentence.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: Controlled or initial sheet state.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires from the trigger, Cancel, Escape, and the lower after a send.

props.name: reason / defaultReason
props.description: Controlled or initial reason id.

props.name: onReasonChange
props.description: Fires from a chip press or an arrow key, and with an empty string when the sheet lowers after a send.

props.name: note / defaultNote
props.description: Controlled or initial note.

props.name: onNoteChange
props.description: Fires from every keystroke in the note field.

props.name: onSubmit
props.type: (report: { reason: string; label: string; note: string }) => void
props.description: Fires once from Send with the frozen report.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Fires from Cancel and from Escape.

props.name: noteMaxLength
props.description: Characters the note field accepts.

props.name: holdMs
props.description: How long the stamp holds before the sheet lowers; the timer pauses while the tab is hidden.

props.name: triggerLabel
props.description: The trigger's word.

props.name: title
props.description: The sheet's heading, which also names the radio group.

props.name: sentLabel
props.description: The stamp's word.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the sheet for assistive technology.

usageNotes: The chips are a radio group with a roving tabindex: Left and Right (or Up and Down) step without wrapping, Home and End jump to the ends, Space selects and opens the note. Escape closes the sheet and returns focus to the trigger, and Send returns focus there too, so no key lands on a removed control.

Under reduced motion the sheet's height swaps on a fast tween, the chips appear in place with no stagger, and the stamp fades in rather than landing from 1.12x — the confirmation still shows, because it is information.
The sheet opens in flow with a ResizeObserver-measured height, never as a panel positioned over the page, so it can sit anywhere in a thread without covering what the host drew below it.

items.title: Block Fold
items.tagline: Blocked, and folded away.
items.description: Blocking a member folds their messages instead of tearing a hole in the thread. Each run of consecutive messages holds two faces in one box — the messages and a single folded line — and one ResizeObserver measures whichever is in flow, so the run glides between the two heights on glide while the messages leave on the exit ease. The folded line is a button that peeks that run open without unblocking anyone, and the roster switches read as sentences.

props.name: members
props.description: The roster, in the order given; each member gets a switch.

props.name: messages
props.description: The thread, oldest first; consecutive messages from one author form a run.

props.name: blocked / defaultBlocked
props.description: Controlled or initial blocked member ids.

props.name: onBlockedChange
props.description: Fires with the next set from either switch direction.

props.name: onBlock
props.description: Fires when a member is blocked.

props.name: onUnblock
props.description: Fires when a member is unblocked.

props.name: onPeekChange
props.description: Fires when a folded run is peeked open or folded back, and once per peek dropped by an unblock.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Tallest the thread grows before it scrolls inside its own box.

props.name: foldedNoun
props.description: The word the folded line counts; pluralised for anything but one.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the thread for assistive technology.

props.name: rosterLabel
props.description: Names the roster group.

usageNotes: Every roster control is a real switch with a sentence for a name ("Block Rui Baptista."), and the folded line is a button with aria-expanded that Enter or Space peeks open; folded messages are aria-hidden while they cannot be seen.
Under reduced motion the run's height swaps on a fast tween and nothing travels — the fold still happens and the counts still change, because what is hidden is information.
A polite status region speaks one frozen, pluralised sentence per change: "Rui Baptista is blocked. 3 messages are folded."

items.title: Slow Mode
items.tagline: One message a minute.
items.description: A slow-mode wait drawn on the control it is holding. A shutter fills the send button and drains on a linear tween one second per step while a mono countdown replaces the word, fed by a timeout that lives in an effect and never runs while the tab is hidden; when it empties the button wakes with one snap overshoot from 1.06x. Hovering or focusing Send swaps the hint line to the remainder — two readings in one grid cell, cross-faded — and Send stays in the tab order while held, with the wait spoken in its name.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial draft.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from every keystroke and from the clear after a send.

props.name: interval
props.description: The slow-mode window, in seconds; it also builds the default rule line.

props.name: remaining / defaultRemaining
props.description: Seconds left. Passing `remaining` hands the clock to the host; `defaultRemaining` is a plain number for the first paint, never a clock.

props.name: onRemainingChange
props.description: Fires on every tick, on a send, and on the wake, with whole seconds.

props.name: onSend
props.description: Fires from Enter or the Send button with the trimmed draft.

props.name: onWake
props.description: Fires once when the wait reaches zero.

props.name: ruleLabel
props.description: The rest reading under the composer. Built from `interval` by default: "One message a minute." at 60.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The textarea's placeholder.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Holds the composer and the button.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the textarea for assistive technology.

usageNotes: Enter sends and Shift+Enter breaks a line; an IME composition never sends. Send keeps its tab stop while held — it is aria-disabled with the wait in its name ("Send. Slow mode holds you for 6 seconds more.") rather than dropped from the order.

Under reduced motion the shutter still shows the remainder but steps once per second instead of draining, and the wake swaps colour without the overshoot; the countdown numerals change without rolling.
The countdown is one re-armed timeout inside an effect: it is torn down on unmount and stops while the document is hidden, and nothing reads a clock during render.

items.title: Hide Veil
items.tagline: Hidden until you choose.
items.description: A message a host has hidden, covered by a hatched bar that carries the reason. Revealing wipes the veil rather than fading it — the clip's left inset walks from 0% to 100% on a base tween on the move ease, so the message is uncovered left to right — and an IntersectionObserver rooted on the thread's own scroll box wipes the veil back when the message leaves the box, unless focus is still inside it. Show and Hide again hand focus to each other, so no key is stranded on a clipped control.

props.name: messages
props.description: The thread, oldest first; a message with a hiddenReason is veiled.

props.name: revealed / defaultRevealed
props.description: Controlled or initial revealed ids.

props.name: onRevealedChange
props.description: Fires with the next set from any change.

props.name: onRevealChange
props.description: Fires once per change, saying which message moved and whether a press or a scroll moved it.

props.name: reVeilOnScroll
props.description: Whether a revealed message re-veils when it leaves the scroll box.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Tallest the thread grows before it scrolls inside its own box.

props.name: scrollRef
props.description: A callback ref for the scroll box, so a host can jump the thread from outside it.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: The veil's control.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: The revealed message's control, which lives in the meta row.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the thread for assistive technology.

usageNotes: Show and Hide again are real buttons whose names are whole sentences carrying the reason, and pressing one moves focus to the other; the veiled text is aria-hidden while it cannot be seen, and the scroll box itself is focusable so a keyboard can scroll it.
Under reduced motion the veil swaps on a fast opacity tween with no clip travel; the re-veil on scroll still happens, because what is hidden is information.
The hatch is a procedural SVG pattern whose id is prefixed with useId(), so two instances on one page never collide, and it is sized entirely by the bubble it covers.

items.title: Warn Strip
items.tagline: A caution, before you read.
items.description: A content warning that is a door, not a fog. A warned message renders as a bubble that is entirely strip, carrying the reason in words and a Show control, and pressing it lowers the strip by its own height on glide while the box glides in the same beat to a ResizeObserver-measured message height — the strip does not vanish, it goes down and the words are what is left. The line it casts thins on a tween as it drops, and the Show and Cover controls hand focus to each other.

props.name: messages
props.description: The thread, oldest first; a message with a caution is covered by a strip.

props.name: shown / defaultShown
props.description: Controlled or initial ids whose strips are down.

props.name: onShownChange
props.description: Fires with the next set from either direction.

props.name: onShow
props.description: Fires when a strip is lowered.

props.name: onCover
props.description: Fires when a strip is raised again.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: The strip's control.

props.name: coverLabel
props.description: The meta row's control, which appears once the strip is down.

props.name: cautionLead
props.description: The word before the reason, on the strip and in the control's name.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Tallest the thread grows before it scrolls inside its own box.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the thread for assistive technology.

usageNotes: The strip's control is a button with aria-expanded whose name is a whole sentence carrying the reason; Enter or Space lowers it and focus moves to the Cover control in the meta row, and covering hands focus back.

While a strip is up the message text is aria-hidden — a caution a screen reader reads straight past is not a caution — and whichever face is out of flow is the absolutely positioned one, so the box is right on the first paint and no caution flashes the message it covers.
Under reduced motion the strip cross-fades instead of sliding and the box height swaps on a fast tween; the message still arrives and the box still fits it.

items.title: Timeout Ring
items.tagline: Muted, for a while.
items.description: A moderator's timeout hung on a member's avatar as an arc that retreats linearly across the span, ticked at each minute, while the disc dims on glide and a mute glyph takes the corner. Extend does not restart the run: the arc springs back out to its new share on glide and hands over to the drain from its own onComplete, and either ending clears the ring with a pop as the disc returns on recoil. Extend and Lift are real buttons in the tab order, the state is a visible sentence rather than a colour, and a polite region speaks one frozen line per change.

props.name: name
props.description: The member, shown and spoken.

props.name: handle
props.description: The member's handle, shown under the name.

props.name: room
props.description: Where the timeout applies; named in both sentences.

props.name: reason
props.description: The house rule cited on the row.

props.name: seconds
props.description: The timeout span. Changing it starts a new run.

props.name: active / defaultActive
props.description: Controlled or initial timeout state.

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: Fires when the timeout starts, is lifted, or runs out.

props.name: extendSeconds
props.description: Seconds Extend adds to the remainder.

props.name: onExtend
props.description: Fires from Extend with the new whole span.

props.name: onRemainingChange
props.description: Fires each time the whole second changes.

props.name: onExpire
props.description: Fires once when the remainder reaches zero.

props.name: onLift
props.description: Fires when a moderator ends the timeout early.

props.name: canModerate
props.description: False hides Extend and Lift, for a member reading their own timeout.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Holds both controls; the ring still drains and still reads.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the row.

usageNotes: Extend and Lift are ordinary buttons in the tab order, genuinely disabled when there is no run to act on, so focus survives a timeout clearing itself.
Under reduced motion the arc still drains and the figure still counts, because a remainder is information; nothing pops, nothing travels, and the extend grows on a fast tween instead of glide.
The run pauses while the document is hidden and the mm:ss figure is plain text rather than a live region, so nobody is read a number once a second.

items.title: Appeal Card
items.tagline: Ask for another look.
items.description: A removed message asking for another look. The review's stages stamp in turn — the disc lands from 1.5 on recoil, the tick draws its pathLength on flick, and the rail down to the next stage fills on glide — and the decision slides in from 8px on snap inside a ResizeObserver-measured height that opens in flow rather than floating. Approval restores with a wash that sweeps the quote once on a slow tween while the strike lifts; a refusal gets no wash and no bounce. A real textarea sends the appeal, and a polite region speaks one frozen sentence per change, never before the host has answered.

props.name: author
props.description: Whose message is under appeal.

props.name: messageText
props.description: The removed line, quoted on the card.

props.name: room
props.description: The room the message was removed from.

props.name: reason
