Give the list room for a preview: the card and its actions are kept inside the list's own box, and a preview body taller than the room left is clipped with a fade.

items.title: Fuse Button
items.tagline: The spark runs the edge; hold till it lands.
items.description: A hold-to-confirm button whose own border is a fuse: holding lights it at the top centre and a spark runs clockwise round the button's edge, leaving a charred thread with a short stretch still glowing behind it, while the face presses in on the flick spring. Letting go pauses it where it is, with the burnt part kept and the spark dimmed to a smouldering ember; completing the lap flares the whole edge, lands the face on the recoil spring and fires onConfirm, and Escape puts a lit fuse out as the char draws back on the glide spring. It is a native button: Space or Enter held burns it exactly as a held pointer does.

props.name: label
props.description: What holding it does: the button's text and accessible name.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Fires once, on the frame the spark completes its last lap.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Each change of state, with the share of the fuse burnt from 0 to 1. Never called per frame.

props.name: laps
props.description: How many times the spark goes round, 1 or 2. Two laps draw a second, inner strand and take twice as long.

props.name: burn
props.description: Seconds per lap.

props.name: spark
props.description: How fierce the spark is, 0 to 1: its glow and core, how many embers fly and how far, and how loud the sizzle and crackle are.

props.name: smoke
props.description: Smoke curls up off the burning spark, behind the button's face.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play the sizzle while it burns, its crackle, and the flare when it fires. Nothing plays, and no audio context exists, unless this is on.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims and disables the button and pauses a burning fuse.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the root's classes (the button and the frame its sparks stay inside).

usageNotes: A native button described by a hold hint: Space or Enter held burns the fuse for as long as it is held (repeats ignored) and letting go pauses it; a click from assistive technology, whose user cannot hold, burns it through; Escape puts a lit or paused fuse out; and a polite live region speaks each change once (paused at a percentage, confirmed, fuse out).

Under reduced motion the spark still runs the edge and the char still grows, because progress is the information, but there are no embers, no smoke, no smoulder and no pressed face, and the flare is a flash of colour.

A hold never selects text or opens the browser's menu, the button is touch-none so a resting finger is not taken for a scroll, and pointer cancel, window blur or a hidden page pause the fuse and stop the sizzle. Once fired and released, the fuse is re-laid after a moment.

items.title: Print Hold
items.tagline: Hold your thumb; the ridges light.
items.description: A hold-to-confirm pad drawn as a procedural fingerprint that reads nothing and says so: held, its ridges light along a spiral that unwinds from the press point on a linear read while a hum rises; lifted early they drain back into the press point, and a thumb that slides smears the read, so the pad shakes on a keyframed tween, flashes and buzzes. A complete read runs an optional verify, reports true, and once the value is confirmed every ridge condenses onto one ring on the glide spring while a tick draws inside it or a padlock's shackle springs open on snap. Space or Enter held is the hold, Escape cancels a read, and the caption under the pad says each step in words.

props.name: label
props.description: What holding the pad confirms, as a sentence: the pad's accessible name.

props.name: confirmed / defaultConfirmed
props.description: Whether a hold has been confirmed. Controlled pads condense only once the host sets it; set it back to false to arm the pad again.

props.name: onConfirmedChange
props.description: Fires with true from the completed hold (after verify, if given).

props.name: verify
props.description: Runs when a hold completes, before anything is confirmed. Return or resolve false to decline the read: the pad shakes, buzzes and drains. While a promise is pending the lit print pulses and the caption says Checking.

props.name: scan
props.description: Seconds a full read takes, 1 to 3. A re-press during a drain resumes from where the light is.

props.name: ridges
props.description: How many ridge lines the print has, 6 to 14: fewer is bolder, more is finer.

props.name: colour
props.description: The colour the ridges light in, and the confirmed ring and glyph.

props.name: feedback
props.description: What the lit ridges condense into: a ring with a tick (Confirmed), or a ring with a padlock whose shackle springs open (Unlocked).

props.name: sound
props.description: Play the rising scan hum, the chime on confirmation and the buzz on a failed read. Nothing plays, and no audio context exists, unless this is on.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the pad, blocks holds and ends one in progress.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the wrapper that holds the pad and its caption.

usageNotes: It is a native button named by label and described by its caption, a polite live region that says each step once (reading, checking, confirmed or unlocked, released early, moved, declined). Space or Enter held on the focused pad is the hold and never a click, Escape cancels a read, and a click from assistive technology runs a whole read. A confirmed pad is aria-disabled until the host resets it.

Under reduced motion the ridges still light and drain, from the core outward as a widening disc instead of a turning spiral; there is no dip, contact ring or shake (a failure flashes and the caption says why), and the ring and glyph cross-fade in. Sounds are unchanged.

A hold on a touch screen never selects text or opens the browser's menu (touch-action none, no callout, contextmenu prevented on the pad only), and the hum stops on lift, a slide, pointer cancel, window blur, a hidden tab, disable and unmount. A change of confirmed made by the host is silent.

items.title: Jiggle Mode
items.tagline: Hold one; they all get ready.
items.description: A grid of shortcut tiles with an edit mode entered by holding any one: the held tile sinks for the hold, pops back on the snap spring, and edit mode ripples outward from it, each tile starting to rock out of phase with its neighbours on a compositor animation and gaining a badge that pops in on snap. In edit mode a tile drags 1:1, lifts on flick, rubber-bands at the edges and parts the others on glide with a tick per slot, and a flick lands in the slot it was heading for; a remove badge takes a tile away with a pop, a check badge marks it for Done, and Undo brings the last removal back. Done or Escape settles every tile from wherever it is in its swing back to upright on snap; on the keyboard a held Space enters edit mode, Space picks a tile up, arrows move it and Delete does the badge's job.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; label: string; glyph?: ReactNode; tone?: "cobalt" | "signal" | "success" | "warn" | "danger" | "ink" }[]
props.description: Every tile that can appear. The label is shown under the tile and is its accessible name; the tile is a wash of its tone and the glyph is drawn in it.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The ids shown, in order.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the new order once per drop, removal, Done in check mode, or Undo.

props.name: editing / defaultEditing
props.description: Whether the grid is in edit mode.

props.name: onEditingChange
props.description: Fires when a hold enters edit mode, and when Done or Escape leaves it.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: A tile pressed outside edit mode: a tap, or a quick Space or Enter.

props.name: label
props.description: The grid's accessible name.

props.name: columns
props.description: Tiles per row, 2 to 6. Each column is 68px; four fit a 320px phone column.

props.name: wiggle
props.description: How far each tile rocks either side in edit mode, in degrees.

props.name: frequency
props.description: How fast the tiles rock, in cycles per second; each tile varies it by a few percent so neighbours drift apart.

props.name: badge
props.description: A minus badge that removes a tile at once, or a check badge that marks it (the tile dims) so Done removes every marked tile together.

props.name: delay
props.description: How long a hold takes to enter edit mode, in ms, for a finger or a held Space or Enter.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play the wobble as edit mode starts, a tick per slot and a pop per removal. Nothing plays, and no audio context exists, unless this is on.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the tiles and blocks presses, holds and drags; while disabled the grid is shown out of edit mode.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the wrapper that holds the grid and its toolbar.

usageNotes: Tiles are buttons in a list with one tab stop; arrows move between them and Home and End jump. A quick Space or Enter opens a tile and holding it for the delay enters edit mode. In edit mode Space or Enter picks the focused tile up, arrows and Home or End move it, Space or Enter drops it and Escape puts it back; Delete or Backspace removes it or toggles its mark; Escape with nothing picked up leaves edit mode. Badges are real buttons for pointers and screen readers, and a polite live region says each pick-up, move, drop and removal once.

Under reduced motion nothing rocks, ripples, lifts or glides: badges fade in, each tile gains a dashed ring, dragged tiles still follow the finger while the rest move straight to their slots, and removals fade. Sounds and announcements are unchanged.

A long press never selects text or opens the browser's menu (no callout, contextmenu prevented on the grid only). Outside edit mode tiles keep touch-pan-y so the page scrolls; in edit mode they are touch-none so they drag. The wiggle runs on the compositor, so it costs nothing in script or off-screen.

items.title: Drop Pin
items.tagline: Hold to drop a pin.
items.description: A location picker on an invented, procedurally drawn town with its own survey grid. Holding anywhere grows a shadow under the finger while an aiming ring closes on it; at the delay a pin falls from above the top edge on a gravity tween with a falling whistle, lands with a thock, squashes at its tip on snap and rebounds on a landing spring whose damping comes from bounce (the house recoil by default), reflected off the ground so it hops rather than sinks, and its grid reference fades up above it. The pin drags 1:1, lifting off its shadow on flick and landing where a flick would come to rest on glide; keyboard focus shows a crosshair the arrow keys move, Enter drops the pin there and Delete removes it.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Where the pin is, in map units (0 to 1200 east, 0 to 200 down from the top edge), or null for no pin. A value set by the host glides, falls or leaves silently.

props.name: onValueChange
props.type: (point: { x: number; y: number } | null) => void
props.description: Fires once per drop, once per drag on release (with where the throw comes to rest), and with null when the pin is removed.

props.name: label
props.description: The map's accessible name: what the pin marks.

props.name: delay
props.description: How long a press must be held before the pin drops, in ms.

props.name: bounce
props.description: How lively the landing is, 0 to 1: a thud with a small squash, the house recoil's two hops, or a rubber ball.

props.name: colour
props.description: The pin head, the aiming ring and the crosshair.

props.name: map
props.description: A warm street map that follows the page theme, or a dark map with lit streets in both themes.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play the falling whistle and the landing thocks. Nothing plays, and no audio context exists, unless this is on.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the map and takes it out of the tab order; holds, drags and keys do nothing.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the map box, which is 200px tall, full width up to 1200px.

usageNotes: The map is one focusable element (role application, described as a map) with a polite live region. Keyboard focus shows a crosshair: the arrow keys move it 10 units, 40 with Shift, and its cell is announced when it changes; Enter or Space drops the pin there with the same fall, landing and sounds as a hold; Delete or Backspace removes the pin. Escape is left to the page.

Under reduced motion nothing falls, bounces, lifts or glides: the hold's shadow only darkens, the pin fades in where it lands with the same thock and no whistle, a drag sets down where it is released, and the crosshair jumps.

The town, its street names and its survey grid (columns A to T, rows 1 to 4, easting and northing to one decimal) are invented and drawn from a fixed hash, 1:1, so a narrower box shows less of the town, centred. dropPinPlace(point) returns the same cell, easting, northing and text the callout shows. A long press never selects text or opens the browser's menu; the map keeps touch-pan-y so the page scrolls past it, and the pin is touch-none so it drags.

items.title: Node Wire
items.tagline: Drag a wire from one node to the next.
items.description: A node editor whose cables are real cables: drag from an output jack and a Verlet rope pays out 1:1 under the finger, every compatible input shows its capture ring, and within the snap radius the plug is caught, flicks into the jack and seats with a jack snap; let go anywhere else and the cable reels back into its output. Nodes drag by their headers and glide on springs.glide, carrying the release velocity to where a light throw would rest, while their cables swing behind them on a fixed-step loop that runs only while something moves. Enter picks up a cable, Arrow keys choose among the inputs that take it, Enter plugs in and Escape lets it reel back; on a node's grip, Arrow keys move the node.

props.name: nodes
props.description: The node cards: { id, label, x, y, inputs?, outputs? }, with x and y as fractions (0 to 1) of the free space and ports as { id, label, type }. Ids contain no dots.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The cables, each { from, to } written "node.port" from an output to an input. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the plug or unplug that changed the cables, with all of them. A plugged cable waits at its jack for a controlled host and reels back if the host does not take it.

props.name: canConnect
props.description: An extra rule on top of matching types, given "node.port" of each end.

props.name: label
props.description: The canvas's accessible name.

props.name: sag
props.description: Slack in each cable, 0 to 1: 0 is a straight wire, 1 hangs in a deep loop that lies on the canvas floor. In curve mode, the droop of the curve.

props.name: stiffness
props.description: 0 to 1: a limp string that swings long, up to a thick lead that arcs and settles fast (constraint passes, bending and damping). In curve mode, how hard the cable is pulled onto its curve.

props.name: snap
props.description: Capture radius around a compatible input, in px, 12 to 40, drawn as a ring while a cable is carried.

props.name: wire
props.description: rope hangs free under gravity; curve springs the same cable onto the tidy editor curve that leaves each jack horizontally.

props.name: height
props.description: Canvas height in px.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play the cable's synthesised sounds: a slither while a cable or a wired node moves, a detent when a ring catches the plug, a jack snap when it seats, a pop when it comes out. Nothing plays, and no audio context exists, unless this is on.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the canvas and blocks every drag, press and key.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the canvas's classes.

usageNotes: Every port and node grip is a real button with a one-string name that says what it is wired to. Enter or Space on an output picks up a cable and moves focus to the nearest input that takes it; Arrow keys move between those inputs with the plug gliding along, Enter plugs in, and Escape (or focus leaving the canvas) lets the cable reel back. Enter on a wired input unplugs it and carries it the same way; Delete unplugs it. Arrow keys on a grip move the node 8px, Shift 32px. Changes are announced in a polite live region.

Under reduced motion every cable is drawn straight onto its resting shape with no swing, a released node stays where it was dropped, a plug goes straight into its jack and a put-back cable disappears; rings, dimming, sounds and the wiring itself are unchanged.

The loop runs on requestAnimationFrame only while something moves, stops once every cable is still, and never runs while the page is hidden. Only ports of the same type join; each input holds one plug, and plugging into a wired input pulls the old one out.

items.title: Fling Sort
items.tagline: Throw it where it belongs.
items.description: A sorting tray you throw things into: grab the top chip of the inbox or of any bin and it lifts 1:1 under the finger; let go and it flies with the hand's speed on a real trajectory with gravity, air drag and spin, bouncing off rims, walls and the frame until it lands in the bin it reaches. The landing is heard, counted and reported on the frame the chip touches down with too little rebound to leave, then it docks into its pile on springs.glide carrying its landing speed, and the count rolls in on springs.snap. Number keys throw the focused box's top chip into that bin on a solved arc and 0 throws it back to the inbox.

props.name: items
props.description: Everything to sort: { id, label, detail? }. Keep labels to a word; detail is a short second line such as an amount.

props.name: categories
props.description: The bins, in order: { id, label }. The first `bins` of them stand on the floor.

props.name: bins
props.description: How many of categories are open, 2 to 4. Items filed under a bin that is not shown sit in the inbox.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The filing, item id to category id; an item that is absent is in the inbox. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.type: (value: Record<string, string>, change: { item: string; bin: string | null }) => void
props.description: Fires on the frame a throw is decided, with the whole filing and what changed (bin null: back to the inbox). A controlled chip docks wherever the host's value says once it settles, so a refused change flies home.

props.name: label
props.description: The tray's accessible name.

props.name: gravity
props.description: Downward pull in px/s², 800 to 3200: low values float long, lazy arcs; high ones drop the chip fast and short.

props.name: bounce
props.description: Restitution off the floor, rims and walls, 0 to 0.8: dead-stop landings at 0, lively rebounds near 0.8.

props.name: drag
props.description: Air drag per second, 0 to 3: at 0 a throw carries far, at 3 it dies in the air and drops short.

props.name: height
props.description: Tray height in px.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play the throw's synthesised sounds: a paper rustle on pickup, a whoosh by speed on release, a rim clang, a thunk on a bin landing and a thud on the floor. Nothing plays, and no audio context exists, unless this is on.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the tray and blocks throws and keys.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the tray's classes.

usageNotes: The inbox and every bin are buttons named by their contents ("Travel, 2 items, top: Taxi 24.80"). Number keys 1 to 4 throw the focused box's top chip into that bin on an arc that is flown through the same integrator and collisions as a real throw, so it lands where it was aimed; 0 or Backspace throws it back to the inbox. Each landing is announced politely.

Under reduced motion nothing flies: a release or a key works the throw out at once through the same physics and the chip fades into its place, while counts, the landing sound and the announcement are unchanged. Dragging still follows the finger.

The flight runs at a fixed 120Hz on requestAnimationFrame only while something is in the air, never while the page is hidden (hiding it lands every throw at once), and every throw stays inside the tray: its walls and ceiling bounce.

items.title: Sling Send
items.tagline: Pull it back; let it fly.
items.description: A composer whose send button is a slingshot: the draft rides as a bubble in the pouch of a rubber band, and pulling it back (and to one side to aim) stretches the band 1:1 with the finger, thinning and warming it as it goes, with a creak pitched by the stretch. Let go past a third of the way and the band fires as a real spring, the bubble leaves the pouch at that speed and flies out through the frame's own clipped edge while the band wobbles back on springs.recoil; a short pull snaps back on springs.snap carrying the release velocity, nothing sent. Enter in the text field sends with a full pull; on the bubble, Arrow keys pull and aim, Enter lets go and Escape lets the band down.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The draft. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires as the draft is typed, and with "" the moment the band fires.

props.name: onSend
props.description: Fires the moment the band fires, with the message.

props.name: label
props.description: The text field's accessible name.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown in the empty field and on the empty bubble.

props.name: stiffness
props.description: The band's spring, 0 to 1: a slack band pushes slowly and lobs the bubble, a stiff one fires it fast. It also sets the snap-back and the band's thickness.

props.name: maxStretch
props.description: How far the band pulls before it resists, in px, 60 to 140. The launch frame grows with it.

props.name: trajectory
props.description: How the bubble flies once it leaves the band: along the aim, under gravity so an angled shot curves, or turning upright so every shot leaves through the top.

props.name: trail
props.description: A fading streak behind the bubble in flight.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play the band's synthesised sounds: a creak pitched by the stretch while it moves, a twang when it fires, a whoosh as the bubble leaves, a slap when it snaps back. Nothing plays, and no audio context exists, unless this is on.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the composer and disables the field and the bubble.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the frame's classes.

usageNotes: The field is a real textarea: Enter (not Shift, not while composing) sends with a full pull — the band draws back on its own, then fires exactly as a release does, same sounds — and Shift+Enter is a newline. The bubble is a button named with its message: Enter or Space sends with a full pull, Arrow Down and Up pull back or ease off by a tenth, Arrow Left and Right aim by 10°, Enter then lets go (short pulls are put back), and Escape lets the band down. Outcomes are announced politely.

Under reduced motion the bubble still follows the finger and the band still stretches, but nothing travels on its own: Enter sends at once, a sent bubble fades where it was let go, a short pull jumps back to rest, the band returns without a wobble and there is no trail. Sounds and the send itself are unchanged.

The flight runs on requestAnimationFrame only while the bubble is in the band or the air and ends at once if the page is hidden; the bubble always leaves through the frame's own clipped edge. onSend is where the message is actually sent.

items.title: Snap Guides
items.tagline: Edges that find each other.
items.description: A small design canvas whose layers line themselves up: drag one and, within a few pixels, its edges and centre are pulled onto the edges and centres of the other layers and the artboard on a quick critically damped spring (the flick), with a guide drawn across both objects, a tick, and live labels measuring the gap to the nearest neighbour on each side. The layer is 1:1 under the finger when nothing pulls it, rubber-bands past the artboard's edge and glides back in carrying its release velocity. Arrow keys nudge the focused layer by 1 and Shift+Arrow by 10, with the same snapping and the same tick.

props.name: layers
props.description: The layers, in paint order: id, label (the accessible name), width and height in artboard px, and content, which scales with the artboard and never takes pointer events.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Where each layer sits, by id, in artboard px from the top-left corner. Controlled or uncontrolled; a layer with no entry starts at 0, 0.

props.name: onValueChange
props.type: (value: SnapGuidesValue, change: { id: string; x: number; y: number; alignedWith: string[] }) => void
props.description: Fires from the release or the key that moved a layer, with every position and the labels of the layers the moved one now lines up with. A controlled layer waits for the host: a refused move glides back.

props.name: boardWidth
props.description: The artboard's width in artboard px. The artboard keeps its aspect ratio and scales to fit its box.

props.name: boardHeight
props.description: The artboard's height in artboard px.

props.name: label
props.description: The artboard's accessible name.

props.name: snap
props.description: How close, in artboard px, a line must come before it pulls the layer into line, 2 to 16.

props.name: guides
props.description: Which lines snap and draw guides: left, right, top and bottom edges, the centres, or all of them.

props.name: distances
props.description: Live measurement lines and labels from the moving layer to its nearest neighbour, or the artboard edge, on each side.

props.name: grid
props.description: Shows an 8 px grid and, when no alignment is in reach, snaps the layer's corner to it, so it steps along the grid.

props.name: sound
props.description: Tick when an edge finds another: higher for centres, lower for the artboard, softest for grid steps. Nothing plays, and no audio context exists, unless this is on.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the artboard and stops every drag and nudge.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the artboard's classes.

usageNotes: Every layer is a native button in the tab order, named by its label and described by its position and the keys: arrow keys nudge it by 1 px and Shift+Arrow by 10, a nudge that lands within the snap distance of a line ahead of it finishes the move and ticks, and each move is announced ("Headline at 192, 24, in line with Photo."). Escape during a drag puts the layer back and is claimed.
Under reduced motion snaps and returns land in one step with no spring, while the guides, the distance labels and the ticks still show and sound, because alignment is information.
Layers are placed, not thrown: inside the artboard a release keeps the exact position; only a layer pulled past the edge glides back, carrying its release velocity.
The artboard is a coordinate space: positions and sizes are artboard px whatever the rendered width, so values stay stable across screens.

items.title: Meld Tags
items.tagline: Drop one on another; they merge.
items.description: Tags you group by hand with a liquid that does the grouping: drag one near another tag or group and a neck of liquid reaches out between them, drawn analytically as a metaball bridge from motion values each frame; let go and the neck draws it in on a spring that carries the release velocity, and it melds with a gloop while the row reflows on the glide. Drag a member out of its group and it stretches against the neck until it tears with a pop and snaps back as a droplet, the group closing the gap; an unseated member springs home on the recoil. The keyboard picks a tag up with Enter, chooses its new group with the arrows and drops it with the same sound.

props.name: tags
props.description: Every tag, with its id and the label shown and spoken.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The groups, in order, as arrays of tag ids; a tag on its own is a group of one. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.type: (value: string[][], change: { kind: "meld" | "free"; id: string; group: string[] }) => void
props.description: Fires from the drop or the key that changed the groups, with the new groups and what happened: the tag that moved and the group it is in now.

props.name: label
props.description: The set's accessible name.

props.name: goo
props.description: How thick the liquid runs, 0 to 1: a thicker neck, a longer stretch before a member tears free, and a slower, bouncier settle.

props.name: radius
props.description: The meld radius in px, 8 to 48: how near a dragged tag must come before the neck reaches out and a drop melds.

props.name: tint
props.description: Groups in neutral ink, or each group in its own hue from the theme.

props.name: maxGroup
props.description: The most tags a group takes, 2 to 6. A full group grows no neck and shows a dashed ring instead.

props.name: sound
props.description: A gloop when a tag melds (higher for bigger groups) and a pop when one tears free. Nothing plays, and no audio context exists, unless this is on.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the set and stops every drag and pick-up.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the panel's classes.

usageNotes: Every tag is a native button in one roving tab stop (Left, Right, Home and End move focus), named by its label and its group ("Refunds, grouped with Billing"). Enter or Space picks it up; Left and Right choose another tag or group, or on its own for a member; Enter or Space drops it with the same gloop or pop; Escape puts it back and is claimed. Focus follows the tag to its new place, and every change is announced.

Under reduced motion a drop lands in one step and the row reflows instantly; the neck is drawn only as a still connection while a target is in reach, and colours, counts, rings and sounds still answer.
Tags in one group read as alternatives in the demo (a pill matches any of its tags); the component only keeps the groups, so the meaning is the host's to give.

items.title: Corner PiP
items.tagline: Fling it; it finds a corner.
items.description: A floating player inside its own frame that you throw into a corner: it follows the finger 1:1 and rubber-bands past the edges, and on release its momentum is projected with a deceleration set by friction, the corner whose quadrant the projected centre lands in is where it goes, and a landing spring that takes the release velocity carries it there, overshooting more the more slippery it is. A throw off a side edge tucks it into a tab you pull or press to bring back. The grip is a button whose arrow keys move it corner to corner and into the edge, with the same flight, swish and soft thud.

props.name: player
props.description: What plays inside the floating player. Its own controls work as usual; a drag that starts on them still moves the player.

props.name: children
props.description: The screen behind the player: whatever the frame shows.

props.name: label
props.description: The player's name: its accessible label, and the names of its grip ("Move …") and tab ("Show …").

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Where the player sits: a corner, and whether it is tucked into that corner's side edge. Controlled or uncontrolled; a refused move flies back.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the throw or the key that moved the player, with its new place.

props.name: friction
props.description: How quickly a throw dies, 0 to 1. Low friction coasts further and overshoots the corner; high friction needs a hard fling and settles flat.

props.name: inset
props.description: The corner margin in px, 0 to 24.

props.name: tuck
props.description: A throw whose projection leaves through a side edge tucks the player into that edge, leaving a 22 px tab.

props.name: size
props.description: The player's width: 112, 144 or 176 px at 16:9, never more than 44% of the frame.

props.name: sound
props.description: A swish on a fast throw (higher and louder the faster) and a soft thud on the frame it lands. Nothing plays, and no audio context exists, unless this is on.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the frame and stops every drag and key.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the frame's classes; the frame is 2:1 unless an aspect class here says otherwise.

usageNotes: The player's grip is a button: Left and Right change column, Up and Down change row, pushing on through a side edge tucks it, and Enter or Space moves it clockwise to the next corner. While tucked, the player's contents are inert and the tab is a button that brings it back on click, Enter, Space or an inward arrow; focus moves to the tab when a key tucks it and back to the grip when a key brings it out. Every move is announced, and Escape during a drag puts it back.
Under reduced motion the player still follows the finger, but a release or a key places it in one step with a short dip in opacity, and the thud still sounds.
The player lives inside the frame and never uses fixed positioning, so it can sit in any panel, preview or card; its resting place is plain CSS, so the server markup is right at any width.

items.title: Level Vial
items.tagline: The bubble finds the value.
items.description: A two-sided slider drawn as a spirit level: dragging tilts the level 1:1 with the finger toward the end the value is heading for, and the bubble drifts after it through the liquid on a spring whose stiffness and damping are the viscosity, lagging, overshooting, stretching with its speed and flattening against the end of the vial. A release is projected from its velocity so a flick carries, and the level settles on the snap spring with the release velocity. It is a slider: arrows move a step, PageUp and PageDown go to the next graduation, Home and End to the extremes, each tilting the level and sending the bubble exactly as a drag does.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The value, between min and max. Controlled or uncontrolled; a value the host refuses glides back.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the gesture or key that changed it: once per step crossed while dragging, and once on release, tap or key.

props.name: min
props.description: The left extreme. The centre, halfway between min and max, is neutral.

props.name: max
props.description: The right extreme.

props.name: step
props.description: The value's resolution and what one arrow key moves, counted out from the centre.

props.name: label
props.description: What the level sets: the slider's accessible name, shown above it.

props.name: format
props.description: The reading beside the label and in the spoken value. Defaults to a signed offset from the centre.

props.name: ends
props.description: What the two sides are called in the spoken value, as in "L 20, left of centre."

props.name: viscosity
props.description: Thin spirit to thick oil, 0 to 1: how far the bubble lags, how much it overshoots and stretches, how far a flick carries, and the glug's pitch.

props.name: length
props.description: The level's length in px, 240 to 480; it shrinks to fit a narrower box. The ends always rise the same 10 px, so a longer level tilts less.

props.name: marks
props.description: Graduations on each side of the centre, 0 to 8, drawn across the glass and on the housing. PageUp and PageDown move to the next one.

props.name: tint
props.description: The liquid's colour; the bubble and its rim follow it.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a bubbly glug while the bubble moves, louder as it moves faster, pitched by the value and panned by its place. Nothing plays, and no audio context exists, unless this is on.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the level, takes it out of the tab order and ignores drags and keys.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the root's classes.

usageNotes: The level is a horizontal role="slider" named by its label, with a sentence in aria-valuetext ("L 20, left of centre." or "Level, at the centre."): ArrowRight/ArrowUp move one step up, ArrowLeft/ArrowDown one step down, PageUp/PageDown to the next graduation (a tenth of the range with no marks), Home and End to the extremes. Each key tilts the level and sends the bubble exactly as a drag would, glug included.

Under reduced motion the level stays flat and the bubble moves in one piece on a short tween with no lag, stretch or overshoot, while the reading, the spoken value and the centre lines lighting at neutral still answer.
A drag is touch-pan-y, so a vertical swipe over it still scrolls the page. A host changing value moves the bubble silently; only a gesture makes a sound.

items.title: Curve Slider
items.tagline: A slider that follows any line.
items.description: A slider whose track is any line (an arc, a wave or a spiral): the thumb goes to the point on the path nearest the finger by projection onto the sampled path, the value is arc length so equal steps are equal distances however the line bends, and the fill traces the path behind the thumb. A press away from the thumb chases it on the flick spring and then follows 1:1, the ends rubber-band out along their tangents, and a release is projected along the path so a flick carries on round the curve, gliding to its step on the glide spring with the finger's speed. Arrows move a step, PageUp and PageDown go to the next mark, Home and End to the ends, and the thumb glides along the path each time, ticking at every mark it passes.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The value, between min and max. Controlled or uncontrolled; a value the host refuses glides back along the path.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the gesture or key that changed it: once per step crossed while dragging, and once on release, tap or key.

props.name: min
props.description: The value at the start of the path.

props.name: max
props.description: The value at the end of the path.

props.name: step
props.description: The value's resolution and what one arrow key moves.

props.name: label
props.description: What the slider sets: its accessible name, shown above the path.

props.name: format
props.description: The reading beside the label and in the spoken value. Defaults to the number.

props.name: path
props.description: The line the track follows: a 240° arc, one and a half periods of a wave, or a spiral of 1.75 turns winding outward. All three project, measure and rubber-band the same way.

props.name: marks
props.description: Beads at equal steps of value along the path, 0 to 12. They turn to the accent as the thumb passes, tick as it crosses them, and are where PageUp and PageDown go.

props.name: fill
props.description: Trace the path behind the thumb in the accent colour.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Track weight in px, 2 to 14; the thumb and beads grow with it.

props.name: sound
props.description: Tick softly on the frame the thumb crosses a mark (or an end), pitched by its place along the path and panned by where it is. Nothing plays, and no audio context exists, unless this is on.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the slider, takes it out of the tab order and ignores drags and keys.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the root's classes.

usageNotes: The path is a role="slider" named by its label, with a sentence in aria-valuetext ("20 min, 33 percent along the spiral."): ArrowRight/ArrowUp move one step up, ArrowLeft/ArrowDown one step down, PageUp/PageDown to the next mark (a tenth of the range with no marks), Home and End to the ends. The thumb glides along the path and ticks at each mark it passes, exactly as a drag would. The focus ring is drawn round the thumb.
Under reduced motion the thumb and fill jump straight to their place with no chase, glide or swell, while the drag still follows the finger 1:1 and the reading, beads and ticks still answer.

Only the path and the thumb take a press: a press more than 26 drawing units from the line (the middle of an arc, the gaps of a wave) does nothing. On the spiral a drag keeps to the turn it is on rather than hopping to the next.

items.title: Ruler Tape
items.tagline: Throw the tape; it stops on a mark.
items.description: A length picker drawn as a tape measure: the tape is 1:1 under the finger beneath a fixed needle and rubber-bands past its hook and its cut end. Thrown, its landing is projected from the release speed with a rate set by friction and snapped to the nearest mark, then reached on a critically damped spring whose natural frequency is that friction's time constant, so the coast is an exponential slowdown that stops exactly on the mark; a throw off the end hits it on the snap spring instead, and a slow release catches on the nearest mark with the snap spring's small overshoot. A ratchet ticks as each mark passes the needle and a thunk lands when it stops. Arrows move a mark, PageUp and PageDown a numbered mark, Home and End to the ends, with the same ratchet and thunk.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The length under the needle, in unit. Controlled or uncontrolled; a value the host refuses slides back.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the gesture or key that changed it: per mark while dragging, and once with the landing mark on release, throw, tap or key.

props.name: min
props.description: Where the tape starts: its hook.

props.name: max
props.description: Where the tape ends.

props.name: step
props.description: The value of one mark; marks sit on whole multiples of it.

props.name: label
props.description: What is being measured: the slider's accessible name, shown above the reading.

props.name: unit
props.description: The scale printed on the tape and the reading. Uncontrolled, switching it converts the value so the same length stays under the needle; controlled, the host converts.

props.name: friction
props.description: How soon a thrown tape stops, 0 to 1: at 0 it coasts like a light reel (a time constant near 400 ms), at 1 it stops like a heavy one (near 100 ms).

props.name: spacing
props.description: Pixels between marks, 6 to 16: a denser or looser tape, and how much value one flick covers.

props.name: majorEvery
props.description: Marks per numbered mark, 2 to 10, with a medium mark halfway when it is even. Numbers thin out rather than collide when majors are close. PageUp and PageDown move by one numbered mark.

props.name: sound
props.description: A ratchet tick as each mark passes the needle (so its rate is the tape's speed; numbered marks tick lower and firmer) and a thunk when the tape comes to rest after a gesture. Nothing plays, and no audio context exists, unless this is on.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the tape, takes it out of the tab order and ignores drags and keys.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the root's classes.

usageNotes: The tape window is a horizontal role="slider" named by its label, with a sentence in aria-valuetext ("140 centimetres, 1 metre 40." or "55.1 inches, 4 feet 7.1 inches."): ArrowRight/ArrowUp move one mark up, ArrowLeft/ArrowDown one down, PageUp/PageDown to the next or previous numbered mark, Home and End to the ends. The tape slides there, ratchets past each mark and thunks, exactly as a throw would.
Under reduced motion the tape still follows the finger 1:1, but every settle, throw, tap and key jumps straight to its mark with no coast, while the reading and the sounds still answer.

The drawing is rebuilt from one motion value each frame and only near the needle, so a tape of any length costs the same, and the server renders exactly what the browser does. It is touch-pan-y, so a vertical swipe over it still scrolls the page.

items.title: Fader Sweep
items.tagline: Sweep across the faders in one stroke.
items.description: A bank of vertical faders joined by a smooth curve that you paint in one stroke: draw across the bank and every fader you pass takes the height where the stroke crossed it, the ones a fast stroke skips catching up on the flick spring, each playing a note pitched by its value so the sweep is heard as the shape it drew. Grab a knob instead and that one fader follows 1:1, rubber-bands past its ends and settles on the glide spring with the release velocity, while the brush's smoothing relaxes painted faders into a smooth contour behind the finger. Every fader is a vertical slider in one roving tab stop: Up and Down step it, Page keys, Home and End jump, Left and Right move between faders, and Shift with Left or Right carries the value along like a stroke.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: One value per band, each between -range and +range. Controlled or uncontrolled; an array of another length is resampled by relative position to the band count.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the stroke, drag or key that changed the bank, with every band quantized to step. While a stroke is live the host's echoes are ignored; on release the faders settle on whatever the host says.

props.name: bands
props.description: How many faders, 2 to 10. The values are resampled to the new count so the shape survives, and the faders glide to it.

props.name: smoothing
props.description: How soft the paint brush is, 0 to 1. At 0 each fader keeps exactly the height the stroke gave it; higher, faders behind the finger relax toward their painted neighbours and untouched faders beyond the stroke feather toward it. The fader under the finger is never smoothed.

props.name: curve
props.description: Draw the smooth response curve through the knobs, over a faint fill down to 0.

props.name: range
props.description: How far each fader reaches either side of 0. The scale labels follow it and values outside it are shown clamped.

props.name: step
props.description: The value's resolution and one arrow key's move.

props.name: label
props.description: The bank's accessible name.

props.name: labels
props.description: One name per band, printed under it and used as its accessible name. Defaults to log-spaced frequencies from 63 Hz to 16 kHz.

props.name: format
props.description: A band's spoken value, its aria-valuetext. Defaults to "Boosted by 3 decibels", "Cut by 1.5 decibels" or "Flat".

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a note per fader as the stroke catches it and as a moving fader crosses a scale step, pitched by value on a pentatonic scale and panned to its place. Nothing plays, and no audio context exists, unless this is on.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the bank, takes it out of the tab order and ignores strokes.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the root's classes.

usageNotes: Each fader is a vertical role="slider" with a sentence in aria-valuetext, inside a role="group" with one roving tab stop: ArrowUp/ArrowDown step, PageUp/PageDown move a quarter of the range, Home/End go to the ends, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight move between faders, and Shift+ArrowLeft/ArrowRight carry the focused fader's value into the next through the same brush, spring and note as a stroke. Escape during a stroke puts the bank back.

Under reduced motion the faders still follow the finger and the curve still redraws, but nothing springs: caught faders, settles and key steps land in one frame and the catch flash is a colour fade. The notes are unchanged.

Press on a knob to move one fader; press anywhere else in the bank to paint. A drag that leaves its knob's column by a whole column becomes a paint stroke from there, and a pointer stroke is announced once on release.

items.title: Stretch Slider
items.tagline: Pull past the end; it pulls back.
items.description: A slider whose track is a rubber band: in range the thumb is 1:1 under the finger and snap points catch it with a quiet detent, but pull past either end and the thumb lifts the band off its peg and stretches it longer and thinner, keeping its area and necking where the finger pulls, with a creak that rises with the tension. Let go and it snaps back on a spring that takes the release velocity and rings as long as the elasticity allows, with a twang pitched by how far it was pulled; a throw that runs into an end is caught by the band the same way. Arrow keys step, Page keys jump between snap points, Home and End go to the ends, and a key that would go past an end plucks the band instead.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The value, min to max. Controlled or uncontrolled; while a drag is live the host's echoes are ignored, and on release the thumb settles on whatever the host says.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the drag or key that changed the value, quantized to step.

props.name: min
props.description: The value at the left peg.

props.name: max
props.description: The value at the right peg.

props.name: step
props.description: The value's resolution and one arrow key's move.

props.name: label
props.description: What the slider sets: its accessible name, shown over the band.

props.name: format
props.description: The reading over the band, the captions under it and the spoken value. Defaults to the number itself.

props.name: elasticity
props.description: How rubbery the band is, 0 to 1: how far it gives for the same pull, and how it rings when let go, from one small overshoot to three or four bounces.

props.name: maxStretch
props.description: The furthest the band stretches past a peg, in px. Faint guides past each peg show the reach, and the track is inset by it so a stretch never leaves the box.

props.name: snapPoints
props.description: Equal divisions that carry magnetic detents and ticks under the band; PageUp and PageDown jump between them. 0 makes a plain precise slider.

props.name: thickness
props.description: The band's thickness at rest, in px.

props.name: sound
props.description: A creak while the band is stretched that rises with the tension, a twang on release pitched by the stretch, and a quiet detent on snap points. Nothing plays, and no audio context exists, unless this is on.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the slider, takes it out of the tab order and ignores drags.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the root's classes.

usageNotes: The band is a role="slider" with a sentence in aria-valuetext: ArrowRight/ArrowUp and ArrowLeft/ArrowDown step, PageUp/PageDown jump to the next snap point (a tenth of the range when there are none), Home/End go to the ends, and a key that would go past an end plucks the band with the same twang a pull past the end makes. Escape during a drag puts the thumb back.

Under reduced motion the band still stretches and thins under the finger, but nothing rings: a release puts it back on the peg in one short tween, a key's pluck is an accent flash with the twang, and throws and key jumps land in one frame.
The creak loop starts only when a drag leaves the pegs and stops when the thumb comes back into range, on release, on cancel, on window blur, on a hidden page and on unmount.

items.title: Clip Trim
items.tagline: Trim the clip from either end.
items.description: A trimmer over a procedural waveform: drag either handle to trim and everything outside it dims while the in point, kept length and out point update frame by frame; drag the middle to slide the whole window. Handles follow the finger 1:1, rubber-band against the clip's ends and against each other at the minimum length, spring back on snap with the release velocity and can be thrown, and with beat snapping every beat of the drawn grid is a detent the handle jumps to on flick with a tick. Space or a tap on the middle previews the kept part with a real-time playhead that blips on every beat; start, kept part and end are three sliders whose arrow keys move a step or a beat, Page keys a second or four beats, and Home and End jump to their limits.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The kept span in seconds from the clip's start. Controlled or uncontrolled; while a drag is live the host's echoes are ignored, and on release the handles settle on whatever the host says.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the drag or key that changed the span, on a beat or a step.

props.name: duration
props.description: The clip's length, in seconds.

props.name: bpm
props.description: The clip's tempo: the beat grid, the beat snaps, the preview's blips and the waveform's pulse.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the procedural waveform; the same seed always draws the same clip.

props.name: label
props.description: The clip's name; the start, kept part and end sliders are named after it.

props.name: step
props.description: The span's resolution when not snapping to beats, and one arrow key's move.

props.name: format
props.description: A time as printed under the strip. Defaults to m:ss.s.

props.name: onPreviewChange
props.description: Fires when the preview starts and when it stops, however it stopped.

props.name: minLength
props.description: The shortest the kept span can be, in seconds. The handles rubber-band against it.

props.name: snapBeats
props.description: Draw the beat grid and move the handles and the window in beats, each one a detent with a tick. Off, they move freely at step resolution.

props.name: handle
props.description: How the handles are drawn: a frame around the kept part with grips outside it, thin bars standing proud of the strip, or a hairline with a round tab under it.

props.name: density
props.description: The waveform's resolution in bars per second, from coarse blocks to fine texture.

props.name: sound
props.description: A tick when a handle is grabbed, finds a beat or is stepped by a key, and a blip when the preview starts and on every beat it crosses. Nothing plays, and no audio context exists, unless this is on.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the trimmer, takes it out of the tab order, ignores drags and stops a preview.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the root's classes.

usageNotes: Start, kept part and end are three role="slider" elements with sentences in aria-valuetext: ArrowLeft/ArrowDown and ArrowRight/ArrowUp move a step (a beat when snapping), PageUp/PageDown a second (four beats), Home/End jump to that slider's limits, Space starts or stops the preview and Escape stops it. A key that would pass a limit bumps against it. Escape during a drag puts the span back.

Under reduced motion the handles still follow the finger, but beat snaps, spring-backs, throws and key moves land in one frame; the preview's playhead still runs because it is progress, and the ticks and blips are unchanged.

The preview runs on one linear tween with no frame loop of its own, and stops on a drag, a value change, a hidden page, window blur, disable and unmount; preview starts and stops are announced politely.

items.title: Mood Swipe
items.tagline: Swipe the face from frown to grin.
items.description: A satisfaction input drawn as one face that you swipe from a frown to a grin: the mouth bends and opens, the eyes go from drooping half-moons to squinting crescents, the brows lift and the cheeks rise, all rebuilt each frame from one number on paths whose commands never change, so the morph is a real interpolation. It follows the finger 1:1, rubber-bands into a deeper frown or a wider grin past the ends, and a release is projected and lands on the nearest stop on the snap spring with its velocity (or coasts on the glide spring when snap is off), while a hum glides an octave with the mood and each stop rings a note. It is a slider: arrow keys step a stop, Page keys jump, Home and End reach frown and grin, with the same flight and sound.

props.name: label
props.description: The question being answered: the slider's accessible name.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The mood, 0 (frown) to 1 (grin). With snap on, a value between stops is shown and read at its nearest stop. Controlled or uncontrolled; a refused change flies back.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the swipe, tap or key that changed the mood, with the new value (a stop, or a score to 2 dp with snap off).

props.name: stops
props.description: How many detents from frown to grin, 2 to 9. The rail's dots, the words and the note scale follow.

props.name: labels
props.description: A word per stop, frown first. Used when there is exactly one per stop; otherwise built-in words (Awful, Poor, Okay, Good, Great for five).

props.name: face
props.description: A solid tinted disc with dark features, an outline face in the tint, or a tinted wash with outline features.

props.name: colour
props.description: The tint: travels from danger through warn to success with the mood, or stays the accent, or stays ink.

props.name: snap
props.description: Land on stops with one crisp overshoot. Off, the face coasts and rests wherever it stops, and the value is a continuous score.

props.name: sound
props.description: A hum that glides an octave with the mood while the face moves, and a note on a rising scale at each stop it reaches. Nothing plays, and no audio context exists, unless this is on.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the face, takes it out of the tab order and stops every swipe and key.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the outer wrapper.

usageNotes: The face is a role="slider" named by label, with aria-valuetext such as "Good, 4 of 5". Right and Up step a stop happier, Left and Down a stop sadder (5% steps with snap off), PageUp and PageDown jump, Home and End reach the frown and the grin. A value set by pointer is also spoken once through a polite live region.

Under reduced motion the face still follows the finger, but a release or a key sets it at its stop in one step, with no lean, no overshoot and no glide, while the note, the word and the value still change.

A tap on the rail goes to the nearest stop; a tap on the face nudges one stop toward the side tapped. The swipe claims only horizontal travel, so a vertical scroll that starts on the face still scrolls the page.

items.title: Day Strip
items.tagline: Flick through the week.
items.description: A horizontal strip of days you throw under a still centre lens. It follows the finger 1:1 and rubber-bands past the first and last day; on release the throw is projected with a deceleration set by friction to the day it would rest on, and the strip decays onto exactly that day with the throw's own momentum, then the lens catches it with a small swell on the recoil spring. The lens magnifies as a fisheye, a tick sounds for every day that passes it (a ratchet that slows as the throw dies), and taps glide a day to the lens on the glide spring. It is a listbox: Left and Right move a day, PageUp and PageDown a week, Home and End the ends, with the same flight and sounds.

props.name: start
props.description: The first day on the strip, as an ISO date (2026-09-28). Dates are handled in UTC arithmetic, so the server and the browser draw the same days.

props.name: days
props.description: How many days the strip holds.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.defaultValue: today if it is on the strip, else start
props.description: The ISO date under the lens. Controlled or uncontrolled; a refused change flies back.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the throw, tap, key or wheel that chose a day, with its ISO date — at release, before the strip has landed.

props.name: events
props.description: Event counts by ISO date: up to three dots are drawn under a day, and the count shows in the header and the day's accessible name.

props.name: today
props.description: The ISO date to mark as today: its date is drawn in the accent and its name says so.

props.name: label
props.description: The strip's accessible name.

props.name: friction
props.description: How quickly a throw dies, 0 to 1: a light strip coasts through a couple of weeks from a hard flick, a heavy one stops in a few days.

props.name: lens
props.description: The lens's magnification, 1 to 1.6. The day under it swells and its neighbours part to make room; at 1 the frame marks the day and nothing swells. The strip grows taller to fit.

props.name: visible
props.description: How many days fit across the strip, 3 to 15.

props.name: dots
props.description: Dots under days with events, and the event count in the header.

props.name: sound
props.description: A tick for every day that passes the lens, higher and louder the faster it goes, and a detent as a day lands. Nothing plays, and no audio context exists, unless this is on.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the strip, takes it out of the tab order and stops every throw, tap, key and wheel.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the outer wrapper.

usageNotes: The strip is a role="listbox" with one tab stop and aria-activedescendant on the day under the lens; every day is an option named in full ("Tuesday 6 October 2026, today, 2 events"). Left and Right move a day, PageUp and PageDown a week, Home and End the first and last day, and Escape during a drag puts the strip back.

Under reduced motion the strip still follows the finger, but a release, a tap or a key puts the chosen day under the lens in one step, with no coasting and no swell; the magnification, the header and the landing detent are unchanged.

The swipe claims only horizontal travel (a vertical scroll that starts on the strip still scrolls the page), and a sideways trackpad swipe or shift-wheel scrolls the strip and settles on the nearest day when it stops.

items.title: Slot Swipe
items.tagline: Swipe it into the slot.
items.description: An inbox whose rows sit between a mail slot and a drawer. Swipe a row toward the slot and the slit opens to meet it while the row feeds in edgewise, clipped at the slit and squashed thinner the deeper it goes; past the threshold (or thrown past it, by projection) it runs in on the snap spring with its release velocity and the slot shuts on the recoil spring with a thwup. Swipe toward the drawer and the drawer slides out with a clock that winds and ticks as you pull; the row drops in, the clock spins round to the snooze hour and the drawer shuts. A short swipe springs back, Delete and S do the same as the swipes with the same frames and sounds, and Undo brings the last row back out of wherever it went.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; from: string; subject: string; time?: string }[]
props.description: Every row that can appear.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The ids still in the inbox, in order. Controlled or uncontrolled; a row the host keeps after a swipe comes back out of the slot or drawer.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the swipe, key or Undo that changed the list, with the ids left — at the commit, while the row is still going in.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Fires with what happened to a row: into the slot (archive) or into the drawer (snooze).

props.name: onOpen
props.description: A row pressed without a swipe, or Enter or Space on it.

props.name: label
props.description: The list's name, shown in the header with the count.

props.name: snoozeHour
props.description: The hour the drawer's clock spins to, 0 to 23; also the time in the announcement and the header.

props.name: threshold
props.description: How far a row must go, or be thrown, as a share of its lane (0.2 to 0.6) before it commits. The slot and drawer are fully open, and light up, at this point.

props.name: side
props.description: Which end of each lane the slot is on; the drawer takes the other.

props.name: squash
props.description: How much a row squeezes to fit the slot or the drawer, 0 to 1: up to 60% thinner, and a little longer along the swipe.

props.name: undo
props.description: An Undo button in the header after each swipe, which brings the row back out of where it went.

props.name: empty
props.description: Shown when nothing is left.

props.name: sound
props.description: A detent as a row arms, paper as it feeds into the slot and a thwup as the slot shuts; the drawer's clock ticks as it winds and spins, and the drawer shuts with a clack. Nothing plays, and no audio context exists, unless this is on.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the rows and stops every swipe, key and Undo.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the outer wrapper.

usageNotes: Rows are buttons in a role="list" with one tab stop: Up and Down (and Home and End) move between them, Delete or Backspace sends the focused row into the slot, S into the drawer, and Enter or Space opens it. Focus moves to the next row (or Undo) as a row leaves, what happened is spoken once through a polite live region, and Escape during a drag puts the row back.

Under reduced motion the row still follows the finger and the slot and drawer still open with it, but a commit fades the row out in place and closes its lane in one step, the clock's hands jump to the snooze hour, and every sound and announcement is unchanged.
The swipe claims only horizontal travel, so a vertical scroll that starts on a row still scrolls the page; every lane clips its own row, so nothing draws outside the list.

items.title: Story Cube
items.tagline: Tap through; swipe to the next person.
items.description: A stories viewer on a real CSS 3D cube inside its own phone-shaped screen: a tap on the right steps forward and on the left steps back, a held press pauses, and the bars fill and advance on their own. A sideways swipe turns the cube to the next person 1:1 under the finger, projects the throw and lands on the glide spring with the release velocity, each face darkening as it turns away; a downward swipe lifts and shrinks the frame, and let go far enough it folds into a circle and glides back into that person's avatar in the tray, otherwise it snaps back. The viewer is a focusable group whose arrow keys step, Shift with them turns, Space pauses and Escape closes, with the same tick per story and whoosh per turn.

props.name: people
props.description: Everyone with stories, in the order the cube turns through them: { id, name, posted?, stories: { id, label, content, caption? }[] }. A story's label is its picture's accessible name; content is the picture.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Whose story is on show, by person id, and which of theirs. Controlled or uncontrolled; the cube turns when the person changes, whoever changed it.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the tap, swipe, key or autoplay that moved it, with the new position.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the viewer is open over the tray. Opening grows it out of the person's avatar; closing folds it back in. A refused close springs back.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires from the swipe, key, button, tray face or end of the last story that opened or closed the viewer.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds each story plays before the next one, 2 to 10.

props.name: depth
props.description: How deep the cube reads when it turns, 0 to 1: the perspective runs from four frame widths (almost flat) to 1.1 (steep), and the turning face darkens more.

props.name: bars
props.description: How progress is drawn: a bar per story, one bar notched at each story, or arcs around the avatar in the header.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Stories play on their own and advance when their bar is full. Off, each waits for a tap and its bar shows full to mark the place.

props.name: label
props.description: The tray's name, shown above it and used as its accessible name.

props.name: children
props.description: The screen under the tray: the host's feed, shown while the viewer is closed.

props.name: sound
props.description: A tick for every story a tap, key or open starts, climbing the scale, and a whoosh when a swipe, key or tap turns the cube (a low one when it closes). Automatic advances are silent. Nothing plays, and no audio context exists, unless this is on.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the screen, stops the bars, and ignores taps, swipes and keys.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the screen's classes; the screen is w-full at 9:16 unless an aspect class here says otherwise.

usageNotes: The viewer is a focusable group: Left and Right step through stories, Shift with Left or Right (or Page Up and Page Down) turns to the previous or next person, Space pauses and plays, and Escape closes, handing focus back to that person's face in the tray. The header's Pause and Close are real buttons, and each tap zone is a button a screen reader can press. New stories, pauses and closing are announced.

Under reduced motion nothing rotates, flies or shrinks: a sideways drag fades in a chip naming who is next and a release swaps with a short dip in opacity, a downward drag fades the frame, and opening and closing cross-fade. The bars still fill, the hold still pauses and the sounds still play.

The bars run only while the viewer is open, on screen and in a visible tab, and not while it is held, dragged or turning. On touch the viewer takes sideways and downward swipes while a finger moving up still scrolls the page.

items.title: Filter Swipe
items.tagline: Swipe across; the next look slides over.
items.description: A photo whose look changes as you swipe across it: the boundary between the current look and the incoming one sits under the finger 1:1 with the incoming look's name riding it, and a release that carries or throws it past the threshold runs on to the far edge on the glide spring with the release velocity, while a short one slides back. The incoming look is the same picture under another CSS filter, revealed by a mask that is crisp or feathered, and past the first or last look the picture rubber-bands. The looks are also a radio group of dots whose arrow keys slide each look in from the side a swipe would, with the same swish and click.

props.name: children
props.description: The picture. It is drawn twice, the look underneath and the look coming in, so keep ids out of it.

props.name: alt
props.description: What the picture shows: its accessible name, followed by the current look ("Coldbrook harbour at dawn, Harvest look").

props.name: filters
props.description: A built-in set of five looks, or your own list of named CSS filter values. Names must be unique.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The look on the photo, by index. Controlled or uncontrolled; a slide runs on while the value agrees with it and slides back when it does not.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the release, key or dot that chose a look, with its index and the look.

props.name: threshold
props.description: How far across the boundary must be carried, or thrown, to commit: 0.2 to 0.8 of the width, judged on the projected throw. Notches on the frame's edges mark it while dragging.

props.name: label
props.description: The incoming look's name rides the boundary in a pill that turns light once a release would commit, and the current look's name sits in the corner at rest.

props.name: edge
props.description: A crisp boundary with a light rule on it, or a feathered blend with no rule.

props.name: sound
props.description: A swish as a released slide sets off (higher and louder when it commits, low and soft when it goes back) and a click on the frame the new look lands. Nothing plays, and no audio context exists, unless this is on.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the photo and ignores swipes, dots and keys.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the frame's classes; the frame is w-full at 4:3 unless an aspect class here says otherwise.

usageNotes: The looks are a radio group of dots inside the frame with a roving tab stop: Arrow Right and Down choose the next look, Arrow Left and Up the previous one, Home and End the first and last, and a click on a dot chooses it. Each slides the look in from the side a swipe would bring it, with the same swish and click, and the chosen look is announced.

Under reduced motion the boundary never travels and the picture never rubber-bands: a drag fades the incoming look over the whole photo in proportion, with its name centred, and a release, key or dot cross-fades.
The frame takes horizontal swipes and leaves vertical ones to the page (touch-action pan-y), so it can sit in a scrolling feed.

items.title: Gesture Player
items.tagline: Swipe the picture to seek.
items.description: A player whose picture is the control: a sideways swipe seeks 1:1 with a time bubble riding the bar that shows where you are and how far you have jumped, and its release is projected and glides on the glide spring with the release velocity. Swipes up and down set volume on the right half and brightness on the left, a side meter filling and stretching a little past either end before it snaps back, and a double tap on a side skips with a ripple that adds up as you keep tapping. The host draws the picture from a motion value of the time, so a scrub moves the scene at frame rate without a render, and the focusable picture takes Space, the arrows and Shift with them along the same paths, with a tick per second scrubbed and a click per skip.

props.name: children
props.description: The picture, drawn from the playback time in seconds. Bind it with useTransform so a scrub moves the scene every frame without a render.

props.name: label
props.description: The clip's title: the player's accessible name.

props.name: duration
props.description: Length of the clip, in seconds.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Position in seconds. A new value from the host seeks there; the player reports every seek and skip, and each whole second as it plays.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the landing of every seek and skip, and with each whole second passed while playing.

props.name: playing / defaultPlaying
props.description: Whether it plays. Playback runs only while the page is visible and nothing is being scrubbed, and stops at the end.

props.name: onPlayingChange
props.description: Fires from the tap, key or button that played or paused, and with false at the end.

props.name: volume / defaultVolume
props.description: Volume, 0 to 1. Reported as a swipe moves it; after the release the meter settles on the host's value, so a refused change springs back.

props.name: onVolumeChange
props.description: Fires as a vertical swipe or an arrow key changes the volume.

props.name: brightness / defaultBrightness
props.description: Brightness, 0 to 1, applied as a CSS brightness from 0.4 to 1.4: 0.6 shows the picture as drawn.

props.name: onBrightnessChange
props.description: Fires as a vertical swipe on the left half or Shift with an arrow key changes the brightness.

props.name: sensitivity
props.description: How far a swipe goes, 0.5 to 2: a swipe across the picture seeks sensitivity × 90 seconds, and one of 80% of its height sweeps a level from end to end at 1.

props.name: zones
props.description: A brightness half on the left and a volume half on the right, the active half washed while it is set. Off, a vertical swipe anywhere sets the volume.

props.name: skip
props.description: Seconds a double tap or an arrow key skips, 5 to 15. Further taps on the same side while the ripple is up add another skip each.

props.name: hints
props.description: Faint glyphs over the paused, idle picture showing what it answers to: the skips on the sides and the levels at the top.

props.name: sound
props.description: A tick for every whole second a seek crosses (a ratchet at most every 35 ms, pitched and panned by position), a tick per tenth of a level, and a click per skip. Playback is silent. Nothing plays, and no audio context exists, unless this is on.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the player, holds playback, and ignores taps, swipes and keys.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the player's classes; it is w-full at 16:9 unless an aspect class here says otherwise.

usageNotes: The picture is a focusable group: Space or K plays and pauses, Left and Right (or J and L) skip, Shift with Left or Right seeks one second, Home and End jump to the start and end, Up and Down set the volume and, with zones, Shift with Up or Down sets the brightness. Each shows the gesture's bubble, meter or ripple and makes its sound. A real Play button sits in the bar, and settled results are announced.

Under reduced motion the bubble, meter and ripple appear and fade without travelling or swelling, a released seek or a skip lands at once, and levels settle without springing; the scrub still follows the finger and the readout still counts.
The picture takes both axes (touch-action none), as a full-bleed player does; a middle tap plays at once, while a lone tap on a side waits a moment for a second tap.

items.title: Hang Label
items.tagline: The label lifts and hangs on the edge.
items.description: A text field whose label lifts off the placeholder on the glide spring, flipping up on a hinge along its top edge as it travels, and lands on the field's top edge where it hangs and swings on an underdamped pendulum spring whose first swing peaks at the swing angle; the outline style cuts a notch in the border under it with a mask, so the field sits on any background. An error shakes the tag on a keyframe tween and a character budget fills as a thread under the field on glide. Tabbing into the field lifts and hangs the label exactly as a click does, and everything else, typing, selection, IME composition, paste and autofill, is the browser's own input.

props.name: label
props.description: What the field is for: the visible label (the hanging tag is the real label element) and the input's accessible name.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The text. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the new text on every edit: typing, paste, composition and autofill.

props.name: error
props.description: What is wrong, in a sentence. Shown under the field in a polite live region, sets aria-invalid, and shakes the label when it arrives or changes.

props.name: shakeKey
props.description: Change it to shake the label again with the same error, e.g. a form's submit count.

props.name: hint
props.description: Helper text under the field, replaced by the error while one shows.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: The character budget, also the input's native maxlength.

props.name: swing
props.description: How far the tag swings when it lands on the edge, in degrees, 0 to 10. A long label swings less, so its rising corner never leaves the component's box.

props.name: stiffness
props.description: The pendulum's spring stiffness, 60 to 600: low is a slow, lazy sway, high a quick, tight wobble.

props.name: style
