props.description: Platter speed: 33⅓ turns 200° a second, 45 turns 270°. It sets how fast the record spins and how much of the track one turn scrubs, and is lit on the deck and printed on the label.

props.name: grip
props.description: How hard a finger stops a spinning record, 0 to 1: at 1 it stops dead under the hand, at 0 it slides about 50° before it stops.

props.name: inertia
props.description: How heavy the platter is, 0 to 1: how long it takes to come back to speed or to rest (60 ms to 900 ms), and so how far a flick carries.

props.name: tonearm
props.description: Show the tonearm tracking the groove. Off, a thin ring around the platter fills with the position instead.

props.name: sound
props.description: A scratch while a hand is on the record, pitched by its angular speed and silent when still, and a whir while the motor spins it up or down after a gesture. Nothing plays, and no audio context exists, unless this is on.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the deck, takes it out of the tab order, lets go of any hand and ignores drags and keys.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the deck's classes.

usageNotes: The deck is a group named by the label. The record is a slider ("Position") whose value text reads "42 seconds of 3 minutes 24 seconds, stopped". ArrowRight/ArrowUp scrub a second forward and ArrowLeft/ArrowDown a second back (Shift five): the key holds the record, turns it on the glide spring with the same scratch, keeps scrubbing on repeat and lets go on key-up so the platter spins back up. PageUp and PageDown drop the needle ten seconds on or back, Home and End at either end, and Space or K start and stop; start/stop is also a real Play/Pause button.

Under reduced motion the record does not spin while it plays, and a release or a key lands at once with no coast or spin-up; the time still counts, the tonearm still tracks it, and the sounds still answer.

One frame loop drives the deck, and it runs only while the record is turning, held or playing, and only while the deck is on screen and the page is visible; coming back, the time catches up. Nothing sounds on mount, at the end-of-track stop, or when the host changes the state by itself.

items.title: Angle Pick
items.tagline: Set a direction by turning it.
items.description: An angle input for a design tool: a dial whose handle sits under the finger as it turns, a field that takes typed degrees, and a live gradient, shadow or arrow that follows the handle through every spring. Pressed away from the handle, it swings there the short way on the snap spring; dragged, it catches up on the flick spring and then holds 1:1; with Shift it jumps between snap marks on flick like detents; a real spin coasts to its projected landing on a critically damped spring, ticking past the marks, while a slow release stays put. Arrows turn a degree, Shift+Arrow and PageUp/PageDown to the next mark, Home and End to the ends, and the field's own arrows do the same.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The angle in whole degrees, clockwise from the top: 0 to 359, or −90 to 90 at range 180. Controlled or uncontrolled; a value the host refuses is turned back to.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the drag, tap, key, throw or typed entry that changed the angle.

props.name: label
props.description: What the angle sets: the group's and dial's name, shown over the preview (the field is "<label> in degrees").

props.name: snap
props.description: The Shift step and the PageUp/PageDown step in degrees, 5 to 45. The ring's marks and the ticks fall on it.

props.name: preview
props.description: What follows the dial: a gradient whose bright end is where the handle points, a card whose shadow falls that way, or an arrow over a small compass.

props.name: readout
props.description: Show the live angle in the dial's hub, counting through every spring. Off, the hub is a small cap.

props.name: range
props.description: A full turn, 0 to 359 and wrapping, or a half turn, −90 to 90 with 0 at the top, that rubber-bands past either end.

props.name: sound
props.description: A tick at every snap mark the handle passes, pitched up with the angle and a touch louder at 0°. Nothing plays, and no audio context exists, unless this is on.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the control, takes the dial out of the tab order, disables the field and ignores drags.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the root's classes.

usageNotes: The root is a group named by the label. The dial is a slider whose value text names the direction ("135 degrees, south-east"): ArrowRight/ArrowUp turn a degree clockwise, ArrowLeft/ArrowDown back, Shift+Arrow and PageUp/PageDown to the next snap mark that way, Home and End to the ends. The field commits on Enter or blur (360 wraps, 180 clamps) and turns the handle the short way; Escape restores it and is claimed so a surrounding dialog does not also close; its ArrowUp/ArrowDown step like the dial's.

Under reduced motion the handle still follows the finger 1:1, but taps, keys, typed values and the spring back from the ends jump straight to the value with one tick, and nothing coasts; the preview and readout still follow.
The dial is touch-none, since a rotary drag is two-dimensional, and captures the pointer only after 4px, so a tap is a tap.

items.title: Paper Slip
items.tagline: Printed, torn off, read.
items.description: Notices print out of a till printer as slips of paper: a new slip's lane opens a print line at a time, pushing the older slips up while the housing chatters, and its loose end curls toward you before relaxing on the drift spring. Pull a slip down and its body strains against the perforation with rubber-band give while seeded fibres stretch and snap one by one; past the tear the last fibres spring apart on the recoil spring, the body flutters out on the exit ease and the older slips drop into its place on glide, while a short pull springs back on snap. Slips share one tab stop where Up and Down move and Delete tears the focused slip through the same pull.

props.name: notices
props.type: { id: string; title: string; body?: string; tone?: "info" | "success" | "warn" | "danger" }[]
props.description: Every notice, oldest first. The newest stands at the printer's slot; only the newest `max` are on the paper.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Fires the moment a slip tears, from the pull, key or Tear button that tore it.

props.name: label
props.description: The list's accessible name, printed on the printer.

props.name: curl
props.description: How far the loose end of each slip rolls toward you, 0 to 1.

props.name: speed
props.description: Paper feed rate and how fast a torn slip falls, 0.5 to 2.

props.name: paper
props.description: The paper stock and its ink; warnings and alerts print in a second, red ink.

props.name: max
props.description: How many slips stand on the paper at once, 2 to 6; older ones are counted above.

props.name: sound
props.description: The tear, the flutter, and the print head's whir (heard only when a print follows the visitor's own press).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Slips can be read but not torn.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root; it is 416px tall by default and a height class resizes it.

usageNotes: Keyboard: slips are articles in one tab stop (the newest by default); Up and Down move between them, Home and End jump, and Delete or Backspace tears the focused slip with the same pull and flutter. Every stub carries a Tear button for assistive technology, and focus moves to the neighbouring slip at the tear.

Reduced motion: a print fades the slip in at rest with no chatter, the curl is still, and a tear fades the body out instead of fluttering; the paper still follows a pulling finger, and every sound and announcement is unchanged.

Controlled: onDismiss fires at the tear. Remove the notice and the slip finishes falling; keep it and the slip is printed back where it stood. New notices are announced politely (alerts assertively) once, and removals once the host has removed them.

items.title: Cork Notes
items.tagline: Pinned up where you'll see it.
items.description: Notices land on a framed cork board as small paper cards hanging at seeded angles: each card settles on the glide spring and its pushpin drops in after it on the exit ease, biting with the head taking the hit on the recoil spring as the card jolts, and hovering or focusing a card lifts it to the front on snap. Pull a pin up and away and it gives only a rubber-banded little in the cork, tugging the card's top, then comes out 1:1 with the pointer while the card flutters down off the board on the exit ease, swaying and turning over; a flick pulls, a short pull springs back on snap. Cards share one tab stop where the arrow keys move and Delete pulls the focused card's pin through the same code.

props.name: notices
props.type: { id: string; title: string; body?: string; tone?: "info" | "success" | "warn" | "danger" }[]
props.description: Every notice, oldest first. Only the newest `max` are pinned; the rest are counted on the frame.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Fires the moment a pin comes out, from the pull or the key that pulled it.

props.name: label
props.description: The board's accessible name.

props.name: tilt
props.description: How crooked the cards hang, in degrees, 0 to 12; each card's angle is seeded from its id.

props.name: pins
props.description: The pin each card hangs from: a glossy ball head, a brass thumbtack, or a tall push-pin.

props.name: cork
props.description: The board's cork and frame.

props.name: max
props.description: How many cards are pinned at once, 2 to 6.

props.name: sound
props.description: The pin's thock and the paper (an arrival's thock is heard only when it follows the visitor's own press).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Cards can be read but not taken down.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root; the board keeps an 8:5 aspect at the root's width.

usageNotes: Keyboard: cards are articles in one tab stop (the newest by default); the arrow keys move through them in pinning order, Home and End jump, and Delete or Backspace pulls the focused card's pin with the same pull and fall. Each pin is also a real button for assistive technology, and focus moves to the neighbouring card when a pin comes out.

Reduced motion: cards and pins fade in where they hang, hover lifts with shadow and order only, and a pulled card fades out in place; a dragged pin still follows the pointer, and every sound and announcement is unchanged.

Controlled: onDismiss fires when the pin comes out. Remove the notice and the card finishes falling; keep it and the card is pinned again. A card keeps its place on the board while it hangs, and new notices are announced once (alerts assertively).

items.title: Pneumatic Tube
items.tagline: Mail by air pressure.
items.description: Notices wait as capsules in the foot of a glass tube and are delivered one at a time: the next shoots up on an accelerating tween, turning with the tube round both bends while the glass fogs behind it and an air gauge's needle swings up on the snap spring, drops into the cup, lands squashing on the recoil spring, pops its cap on snap and unrolls its note on the glide spring. Tap the note and it rolls back up on glide, the cap shuts on flick and the capsule leaves down the return tube on the exit ease as the next one launches. The note and the waiting capsules share one tab stop: Up and Down move, Enter or Delete sends the note back, and Delete drops a waiting capsule unread.

props.name: notices
props.type: { id: string; title: string; body?: string; tone?: "info" | "success" | "warn" | "danger" }[]
props.description: Every notice, oldest first: the oldest is in the cup, the rest wait in the tube in order.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Fires when the reader sends a note back, or drops a waiting capsule unread.

props.name: label
props.description: The station's accessible name, shown at its top corner with the waiting count.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast capsules travel and drop, 0.5 to 2.

props.name: glass
props.description: The tubes' glass and the colour of the fog it holds.

props.name: capsule
props.description: The capsules' metal.

props.name: sound
props.description: The whoosh, the landing thud and the cap's pop (a delivery is heard only when it follows the visitor's own press).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Notes are still delivered and can be read, but not sent back or dropped.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root; the station keeps an 8:11 aspect at the root's width.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the note in the cup and the waiting capsules share one tab stop; Up and Down move, Home and End jump. Enter, Space or Delete on the note rolls it up and sends it back (focus waits on the station and moves onto the next note when it lands); Delete on a waiting capsule drops it out of the tube unread.

Reduced motion: nothing travels, squashes or fogs; a delivery fades the capsule into the cup and the whole note in, and sending back fades them out, while the queue updates in place; sounds and announcements are unchanged.

Controlled: onDismiss fires at the tap or key. Remove the notice and the capsule goes; keep it and it comes round again in its turn. A notice removed while it is in the cup is rolled up and sent back by itself. Arrivals are announced once (alerts assertively).

items.title: Beeper
items.tagline: It buzzes across the desk.
items.description: A pocket pager on the desk: a new notice buzzes it in pulses that say how urgent it is, and during each pulse it walks a seeded step across the surface and stays where it walked, while the backlight comes up and the message steps across a 14-segment display a whole character at a time. Pressing its one button acknowledges the message and loads the next on springs.flick; holding it charges a bar along the cells and clears everything at 900ms. The display is a focusable message named by its whole text — arrow keys read the others, Delete acknowledges, Shift+Delete clears — and Space or Enter on the button presses or holds it the same way a finger does.

props.name: notices
props.description: The messages waiting, oldest first: { id, title, body?, tone? }. The newest arrival is the one shown.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: A message was acknowledged: the button's press, or Delete on the display.

props.name: onClearAll
props.description: Every message was cleared by holding the button or Shift+Delete. Without it, onDismiss fires for each.

props.name: label
props.description: The pager's accessible name.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: What the display reads when nothing waits.

props.name: buzz
props.description: How hard it buzzes, 0 to 1: the shake, how far it walks and how loud. 0 is silent mode.

props.name: lcd
props.description: The display's glass.

props.name: scroll
props.description: How fast the characters step across the display, 0.5 to 2.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play the button and the buzz. An arrival is heard only when the visitor has just acted.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the button and the display off.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the desk the pager lies on.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the display is focusable — ArrowLeft/Up show a newer message, ArrowRight/Down an older one, Home/End the newest and oldest, Delete acknowledges, Shift+Delete clears all. On the button, Space or Enter pressed and released acknowledges; held for 900ms, it clears all.
Reduced motion: nothing shakes or walks; an arrival flashes the backlight once per pulse, and long messages page in twelve-character chunks instead of travelling across the cells.
Arrivals are announced politely and danger notices assertively; the marquee is a stepped timer that runs only on screen in a visible page, and the backlight goes out after seven quiet seconds.

items.title: Island Pill
items.tagline: Grows into whatever is happening.
items.description: A black island at the top edge of a screen that carries the live activity — a timer, an upload, a call — and is where notices arrive. Its width, height and corner radius each ride their own spring from one stiffness (the width leads, the height follows, the radius lags) and the body thins while the width travels fast, so it morphs like liquid rather than resizing; a notice grows it into a banner, a tap into a full card with the activity's actions and the notices, and a long press buds the actions off its bottom as droplets joined by metaball necks that pinch on springs.snap. Enter opens the card and focus follows it in, Escape or Shrink brings it back, and Shift+F10 or the menu key opens the quick actions as a menu the arrow keys move through.

props.name: notices
props.description: Notices waiting in the island, oldest first: { id, title, body?, tone? }. A new one arrives as a banner.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: A notice was dismissed from the open card: its ×, or Delete.

props.name: state
props.description: The live activity the island carries. Changing it morphs the island.

props.name: timer
props.type: { label: string; seconds: number; paused?: boolean }
props.description: The timer's label and the seconds on it; the host advances it.

props.name: upload
props.type: { name: string; progress: number; paused?: boolean }
props.description: The file going up and its progress, 0 to 1.

props.name: call
props.type: { caller: string; detail?: string; connected?: boolean }
props.description: The caller; once connected the call offers End instead of Decline and Answer.

props.name: onAction
props.description: An action chosen from the open card or the quick actions: pause, resume, lap, stop, cancel, decline, answer or end.

props.name: expand
props.description: Open as the full card. A new value opens or closes the island the way a tap does; taps, outside presses and Escape change it too.

props.name: onExpandChange
props.description: The visitor opened or closed the card.

props.name: stiffness
props.description: How stiff the liquid is, 200 to 600: slow and wobbly, or quick and firm.

props.name: glow
props.description: The halo in the live activity's colour, 0 to 1; it flares when a notice arrives.

props.name: label
props.description: The island's accessible name.

props.name: children
props.description: The screen the island floats over.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play the morphs and the actions.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Closes the island and takes no presses.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the screen box the island hangs in.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the island is a button — Enter or Space opens the card and focus moves to its first action; Escape or Shrink closes it and focus returns. Shift+F10 or the menu key opens the quick actions: arrows move, Home/End jump, Enter chooses, Escape or Tab closes. In the card, the notices are a list — arrows move, Delete dismisses.

Reduced motion: width, height and radius change on a short tween with no squash or overshoot, the call does not breathe, and droplets fade in place; the banner, the progress ring and the clock still update.
The call's breathing runs only on screen in a visible page; the island clips to its box and grows a spacer under the screen when the open card is taller than it.

items.title: Inbox Chute
items.tagline: Drops in, piles up.
items.description: An inbox you watch fill: each notice is a card that drops through a glass chute under gravity, solved on one linear clock, lands on the pile in the tray and hops with bounce, then tips to its own seeded lean while the pile gives and the tray's count rolls on springs.snap. A tap on the tray fans the pile into a readable list newest first on springs.glide, a cascade beat apart, and gathers it back with the same bounce; Clear all tips the tray about its right end and the pile slides off, then the tray drops back level on springs.recoil. The tray is a button — Enter fans the list and focus moves to the newest card; arrows move, Delete dismisses and Escape gathers the pile.

props.name: notices
props.description: The notices in the tray, oldest first: { id, title, body?, tone? }. A new one drops down the chute.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: A notice was dismissed from the fanned list: its ×, or Delete.

props.name: onClearAll
props.description: Clear all tipped the tray. Without it, onDismiss fires for each.

props.name: label
props.description: The inbox's accessible name.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: The Clear all button's text.

props.name: bounce
props.description: How lively a landing is, 0 to 0.8: a dead drop, or a card that hops.

props.name: lean
props.description: How untidy the pile is, 0 to 10 degrees.

props.name: tray
props.description: What the tray is made of: its look and the landing's voice.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play the landings, the fan and the clear. A landing is heard only when the visitor has just acted.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Folds the list and takes no presses.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the instrument's box.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the tray is a button with aria-expanded — Enter or Space fans the pile and focus moves to the newest card. In the list, ArrowUp/Down move, Home/End jump, Delete or Backspace dismisses (focus goes to the neighbour) and Escape gathers the pile and returns focus to the tray. Clear all is a real button.
Reduced motion: nothing falls, hops or tips; an arriving card fades in on the pile, fanning and gathering swap places under an opacity dip, Clear all fades the pile out, and the count still updates.
Arrivals are announced politely and danger notices assertively; the lean is seeded per card id, so server and client draw the same pile and a card keeps its angle as others come and go.

items.title: Ribbon Unfurl
items.tagline: A banner that rolls down and back up.
items.description: A banner notice on a spring roller along the top edge: the fabric drops on a spring whose bounce is the swing, the cloth sways to rest about the roller line, and a stitched leader above the message winds back in at 7px a second, so the time left is how much leader is still out. Dragged, the ribbon follows 1:1; a throw up rolls it away on an accelerating tween, a pull past full length catches a ratchet and pins it open on snap, and anything else glides back with the release velocity. ArrowUp, Delete or Escape rolls the focused ribbon away and ArrowDown pins it.

props.name: notices
props.type: { id: string; title: string; body?: string; tone?: "info" | "success" | "warn" | "danger" }[]
props.description: The notices, in the order they drop. One is on the roller at a time; the rest are counted beside it.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Fires as a ribbon starts to roll away: by the hand, a key, its button, or its time running out.

props.name: onPin
props.description: Fires when the visitor pins a ribbon open, or lets it go again.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds a ribbon stays down, 3 to 12. Also its leader: 7px of stitched fabric per second, capped to what fits the surface.

props.name: swing
props.description: How much the ribbon bounces and sways as it lands, 0 to 1. At 0 it drops without overshoot.

props.name: fabric
props.description: The cloth and its weight: light satin with a sheen and the most sway, heavy woven canvas, or stiff paper.

props.name: label
props.description: The notice region's accessible name.

props.name: children
props.description: The surface the roller is mounted on. The ribbon hangs over it, clipped to it.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a swish when the visitor rolls a ribbon away and a click when they pin or release it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The ribbon ignores the hand and the keys; its time still runs.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is the surface's box.

usageNotes: Each ribbon is a focusable group: ArrowUp, Delete, Backspace or Escape rolls it away (Escape is handled with preventDefault), ArrowDown pins or unpins it, and a visible button dismisses it. A dropping ribbon is announced once, politely, or assertively for a danger tone.

Under reduced motion there is no drop, bounce, sway or turning cap: the ribbon fades in and out at full length, and the countdown still shows as the leader's stitches fading from the roller end, one a second.
The countdown holds while the ribbon is hovered, focused, dragged or pinned, while the page is hidden and while it is off screen, so a notice is never timed out while nobody can see it.

items.title: Edge Tab
items.tagline: Peeking from the side.
items.description: Notices wait as cards tucked behind the edge of a surface, only a peek of each showing as a tone-coloured index tab, stacked by urgency or time and gliding to new places when the order changes. A tab follows the finger 1:1 as it is pulled out and a release past half-way lands it in view on snap with the throw's velocity; pushed back, the card tucks in on glide, clicks into a slot at the bottom and its band drains as a snooze timer, then it wakes with a nudge on snap. Arrow keys move between tabs, Enter or the arrow away from the edge pulls one out and focuses it, Escape puts it back, the arrow toward the edge snoozes and Delete dismisses.

props.name: notices
props.type: { id: string; title: string; body?: string; tone?: "info" | "success" | "warn" | "danger"; time?: string }[]
props.description: The notices, oldest first. Each waits as a tab at the edge.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Fires from the Done button or Delete, with the dismissed notice's id.

props.name: onSnooze
props.description: Fires when a card is pushed back to the edge and its timer starts.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: The card that came out, or null when it went back.

props.name: peek
props.description: How much of each tab shows, 8 to 32 px. The tone glyph shows from 22.

props.name: side
props.description: The edge the tabs wait at. Drag direction and arrow keys mirror with it.

props.name: stack
props.description: Order the tabs by urgency (danger first) or by time (newest first). Snoozed tabs sit below both.

props.name: snoozeFor
props.description: How long a pushed-back card sleeps, in seconds, shown as its band draining.

props.name: label
props.description: The notice region's accessible name.

props.name: children
props.description: The surface the tabs wait at the edge of. Cards are clipped to it.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a swish when the visitor pulls a card out or dismisses it, and a click when a snoozed card latches.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Tabs can be read but not pulled, snoozed or dismissed.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is the surface's box.

usageNotes: The tabs are a roving-focus set: ArrowUp and ArrowDown move, Home and End jump, Enter, Space or the arrow away from the edge pulls a card out and moves focus into it; inside, Escape puts it back (with preventDefault), the arrow toward the edge snoozes it and Delete dismisses it. Snooze and Done are real buttons.

Under reduced motion cards appear out and back in place with a short fade, reorders jump and a wake-up brightens the band instead of nudging; the snooze timer still drains, because the time left is information.

New notices, snoozes and wake-ups are each announced once in a polite live region; a danger notice is announced assertively. Snooze timers pause while the page is hidden or the component is off screen.

items.title: Quick Reply
items.tagline: Answer without leaving.
items.description: A message notification you answer in place: the sender types as three dots on a staggered tween, then the dots' pill opens into the message on glide as a clip over text already laid out, and Reply expands the notice to a measured height on glide with a real field and three suggestions that slide in on snap in a cascade. Sending lifts the reply off from where its words were and throws it out of the card on an exit tween, the composer folds and a tick draws on flick. Enter replies and Delete dismisses on the notice, Enter sends and Escape goes back in the field, and the suggestions are a toolbar driven by arrow keys.

props.name: notices
props.type: { id: string; title: string; body: string; tone?: "info" | "success" | "warn" | "danger"; time?: string; initials?: string }[]
props.description: The messages, front first: title is the sender, body the message. The first is answerable; the rest wait behind it.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Fires from the dismiss button or Delete on the front message.

props.name: onReply
props.description: The reply, sent from the field with Enter or the send button, or from a suggestion.

props.name: suggestions
props.description: Offer three suggested replies under the field.

props.name: typing
props.description: Show the sender typing for a beat before each new message.

props.name: tone
props.description: The suggestions' wording and colour: cool and brief, or warm.

props.name: suggest
props.description: Your own three suggestions for a message and tone.

props.name: label
props.description: The region's accessible name.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a pop on Reply, a whoosh as the reply flies and a tick as it lands.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The message can be read but not answered or dismissed.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the region.

usageNotes: The front message is a focusable group: Enter opens the reply and Delete dismisses it. In the field Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks a line and Escape closes it with preventDefault, returning focus to Reply; the suggestions are a toolbar with ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home and End.

Under reduced motion the dots fade in turn instead of bouncing, the message and chips fade in, heights change on a short tween and the reply fades where it was instead of flying; every state and sound still arrives.
Each message is announced once when it is revealed (a danger tone assertively), and a sent reply is announced once.

items.title: Live Activity
items.tagline: Your delivery, on its way.
items.description: A live activity card for something on its way: each reported position eases a van, car or plane along a route line with a tween paced by the distance while the travelled line fills behind it, stops light as the vehicle actually passes them with a ring that pulses out once, the stage name crosses on snap and the ETA counts down from now with its minutes rolling on snap. A tap opens a measured map strip on glide where the same route, seeded streets or a flight arc, is drawn up to the vehicle, rebuilt per frame from the same eased position. The card is a real button that toggles the map with Enter or Space and names its stage and time left; Delete dismisses it.

props.name: notices
props.type: { id: string; title: string; body?: string; tone?: "info" | "success" | "warn" | "danger"; progress: number; arrival?: number }[]
props.description: The activities: progress is the last reported position (0 to 1), arrival when it is due in ms. The first is in front; the rest wait as pills.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Fires from the dismiss button or Delete on the front card.

props.name: now
props.description: The current time, so the ETA renders the same on the server. Advance it to count down; without it the card keeps its own clock after mount.

props.name: stages
props.description: How many stops the route has, 3 to 5, named from the mode's five.

props.name: mode
props.description: What is travelling: a van on orthogonal streets, a car on rounded ones, or a plane on an arc over the sea.

props.name: expand
props.description: Whether the map strip is open. A tap toggles it; changing this prop moves it there.

props.name: onExpandChange
props.description: Fires from the tap or key that opened or closed the map.

props.name: labels
props.description: Names for the stops, first to last: exactly `stages` of them, or five to sample from.

props.name: label
props.description: The region's accessible name.

props.name: sound
props.description: Tick when the visitor opens or closes the map, and chime each passed stop as the route draws. Live updates stay silent.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The card still tracks but cannot be opened, switched or dismissed.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the region.

usageNotes: The card's main area is a real button with aria-expanded controlling the map: Enter or Space toggles it, Delete dismisses the activity, and its name carries the title, the current stage and the minutes left. The stops are also a list of reached, next and to come for assistive technology.

Under reduced motion the vehicle moves to each report at once, stops light without a ring, the minutes swap without rolling and the map opens on a short tween with its route drawn whole; the ETA still counts and the stages still light.
Each newly reached stage is announced once in a polite live region; the per-second ETA is never announced. Sounds only answer the visitor: a live update that reaches a stage lights it silently.

items.title: Tumbler Code
items.tagline: The pins line up when it's right.
items.description: A one-time-code field drawn as a pin-tumbler lock: each digit raises its spring-loaded pin stack on snap to a height set by the digit, the coil compressing above it, and a paste raises them left to right on a cascade. When check accepts the code every split glides onto the shear line and the plug turns a quarter on snap with a clunk, folding the key pins away; a refused code jiggles the pins on a tween and drops them on recoil so they bounce as they land. The cells are real inputs in one tab stop: digits type in and advance, Backspace and Delete remove, arrows and Home/End move, and paste or one-time-code autofill fills them all.

props.name: label
props.description: What the code is for: the visible label and the name of the group of cells.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial code: digits only, never longer than length.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the key, paste or refusal that changed the code, with the new digits.

props.name: length
props.description: How many digits, and so how many pins the cylinder has, 4 to 8.

props.name: brass
props.description: The metal of the housing, the plug and the face. The pins stay nickel over brass so the split always reads.

props.name: verify
props.description: Check the code when its last digit lands and turn or refuse the lock. Needs check; off, the field only collects the code.

props.name: check
props.description: The host's verifier. A promise holds the plug in a test turn until it settles; a rejected one leaves the pins where they are.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Fires from the key or paste that filled the last cell, with the whole code.

props.name: onResult
props.description: Fires once check has answered, before the lock turns or the pins drop.

props.name: name
props.description: The form field name; a hidden input carries the code under it.

props.name: hint
props.description: Helper text under the cells, wired to every cell with aria-describedby.

props.name: error
props.description: What is wrong, from the host: shown under the cells, marked on them with aria-invalid, and announced once.

props.name: wrongText
props.defaultValue: "That code didn't turn the lock. Try again."
props.description: What a refused code says.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks every cell required, so a form will not submit with an empty one.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play each pin's click, the plug's clunk and the refusal's shrug. Nothing plays, and no audio context exists, unless this is on; sounds only ever answer the visitor.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the field and dims it.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the root element's classes.

usageNotes: Each digit is a native input named "Digit n of N" inside a labelled group, with one tab stop on the next cell to fill: digits type straight in and advance, Backspace clears the digit before or under the caret, Delete clears in place, Left/Right move and Home/End jump, and a paste (or the platform's one-time-code autofill on the first cell) fills from the start.

Under reduced motion the pins take their digit heights, alignment and rest at once with no springs, no jiggle and no sweep, and the plug's open state is a swap; the words under the cells and the polite status ("Checking the code.", "Code accepted. The lock is open.", the refusal) are unchanged.
Controlled use reports every change from the key, paste or refusal that made it and then follows the host; a code the host sets itself moves the pins in silence and is not checked.

items.title: Vault Password
items.tagline: Every rule shoots a bolt.
items.description: A new-password field beside a vault door seen from the inside, one bolt per strength rule: meeting a rule shoots its bolt across the seam into the frame on snap with a thock as it hits its stop, and breaking it pulls the bolt back on glide, the linkage arms following every frame. With every bolt home the wheel spins a turn and a quarter on drift, clicking as its spokes pass, then the latch turns in the hub on flick and the lamp lights; the show/hide control is a peephole whose shutter swings aside on snap. The input, its label, hint, error and rules list are real form semantics, and a polite status speaks once per change of rule state.

props.name: label
props.description: What the password is for: the visible label and the input's accessible name.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial password.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the new password on every edit.

props.name: rules
props.description: How many rules the door enforces, taken in order, 3 to 6: one bolt each.

props.name: checks
props.defaultValue: 12+ characters, lowercase, uppercase, a number, a symbol, not a common password
props.description: The rules to take them from, each { id, label, test }.

props.name: door
props.description: The metal of the door, its frame and the peephole shutter.

props.name: spin
props.description: Spin the wheel before the latch drops once every bolt is home; off, the latch drops as the last bolt lands.

props.name: onLockedChange
props.description: Fires from the edit that shot the last bolt home (true) or pulled one back from a locked door (false).

props.name: name
props.description: The form field name of the native input.

props.name: hint
props.description: Helper text under the field, wired with aria-describedby.

props.name: error
props.description: What is wrong, from the host: shown under the field, marked with aria-invalid, and announced once.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The input's placeholder.

props.name: autoComplete
props.description: The input's autocomplete token.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the input required.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play the bolts' thocks, the wheel's clicks and the shutter. Nothing plays, and no audio context exists, unless this is on; sounds only ever answer the visitor.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the field and dims it.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the root element's classes.

usageNotes: The field is a native password input with a visible label; its description carries the hint, the rules list and any error. The peephole is a real toggle button (aria-pressed, "Show password") reached with Tab and pressed with Space or Enter, and the rules are a real list whose items say met or not met yet.

Under reduced motion the bolts, latch, lamp and shutter take their states without travel and the wheel never spins; the rules list, the status sentences and the sounds still answer typing, because met and unmet are information.

The status speaks one frozen sentence per change of rule state, never per keystroke — "A number: met. 3 of 4 rules met." or "All 4 rules met. The vault is locked." — and a host that clears the field moves the bolts in silence.

items.title: Globe Phone
items.tagline: Spin to the country.
items.description: A phone number field whose country picker is a small orthographic globe: choosing a country turns it there the short way round on a spring derived from drift and scaled by spin, the country's pin drops onto the centre on recoil, and the dial code rolls digit by digit on glide. The globe also follows a horizontal drag 1:1 and a throw comes to rest on the country nearest where it would stop; the number formats for its country as it is typed and keeps its caret. Pressing the globe opens a searchable combobox and listbox whose highlight previews each country on the globe; arrows move, Enter chooses, Escape closes and turns it back, and Left/Right on the globe step east and west.

props.name: label
props.description: What the number is for: the visible label and the input's accessible name.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial national number: digits only, without the country code.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the digits and the full international number on every edit.

props.name: country / defaultCountry
props.description: Controlled or initial country, by ISO code.

props.name: onCountryChange
props.description: Fires from the list, the throw or the arrow key that chose a country.

props.name: countries
props.defaultValue: thirty, from Argentina to the United States
props.description: The countries on offer, each { code, name, dial, pattern, lat, lon, alias? }; # in a pattern is a digit.

props.name: spin
props.description: How fast the globe turns to a country, 0.3 to 1.5; the whir runs higher with it.

props.name: grid
props.description: Draw the graticule: meridians and parallels every 30 degrees.

props.name: format
props.description: Format the number for its country as it is typed; off keeps bare digits.

props.name: name
props.description: The form field name; a hidden input carries the international number under it.

props.name: hint
props.description: Helper text under the field, wired with aria-describedby.

props.name: error
props.description: What is wrong, from the host: shown under the field, marked with aria-invalid, and announced once. A number short for its country is flagged on blur the same way.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the number input required.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play the globe's whir while it turns and the ticks of countries passing and dial digits landing. Nothing plays, and no audio context exists, unless this is on; sounds only ever answer the visitor.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the field and dims it.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the root element's classes.

usageNotes: The globe is a button with aria-haspopup="listbox" named for the country and its code: Enter, Space, Up or Down open the list with focus in its search box (a combobox with aria-activedescendant); Up/Down and Page keys move, Enter chooses and moves focus to the number, Escape closes with preventDefault and returns focus to the globe, and Left/Right on the globe turn it to the next country west or east — the keyboard path of the throw.
Under reduced motion the globe and the dial code change without travel and the list appears with a fade instead of a height glide; search, formatting and the chosen country behave the same.

The number input is a native tel input whose text is formatted for the country; Backspace or Delete over a space or bracket removes the digit beyond it, and the caret stays after the same digit through every reformat.

items.title: Swatch Mixer
items.tagline: Mix the colour you want.
items.description: A colour input you fill by mixing paint: a pigment dragged off its pot follows the pointer 1:1 and, let go over the well, sinks in with a ripple while the well lands on the recoil spring; a tap hops a blob in along a short arc. The colour is the parts-weighted average of the pigments in OKLab and it does not swap: the new pigment curls in as a streak, stir lines sweep round, and the paint travels from the old mix to the new one over a stir whose length is `swirl`, while the dish's rim, a ring of one segment per pigment, re-divides on the glide spring and a segment dragged out of the dish takes that pigment away. Each pot is a slider: Left and Right move between pigments, Up, Enter and Space add a part, Down takes one away, Delete or Home take the pigment out and End fills it.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The colour in the well as `#rrggbb`, or an empty string for an empty well. Controlled or uncontrolled; a value the host sets is shown exactly, with the nearest recipe the palette can make on the rim.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the drop, key or press that changed the mix, with the new colour.

props.name: label
props.description: The field's visible label and the accessible name of its group.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name; the colour rides a hidden input inside a surrounding form.

props.name: hint
props.description: Guidance under the well, wired to the field with aria-describedby.

props.name: error
props.description: An error from the host, shown under the well and announced once.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field required; once the visitor empties the well it says so unless the host passes its own error.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Stops every drag, key and press, and dims the field.

props.name: pigments
props.description: How many pigment pots the palette offers, 3 to 6: the primaries, then white, black and a green.

props.name: swirl
props.description: How much the well swirls as a part mixes in, 0 to 1: at 0 the colour simply cross-fades, at 1 the stir lasts about 1.4 s and the streak makes more than a full turn.

props.name: readout
props.description: The format of the readout beside the label and of the recent mixes' names.

props.name: sound
props.description: A plip as a part lands, pitched by the pigment's lightness, and a gloop as one is pulled out. Only ever in answer to the visitor.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the field's root.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the palette is one tab stop. Left and Right move between pigments; Up, Enter and Space add a part (the same hop and drop as a tap); Down takes one away; Delete, Backspace or Home take the pigment out, the same end state as dragging its rim segment out of the dish; End fills it to eight parts. Recent mixes are a toolbar reached with Tab, where Left, Right, Home and End move and Enter restores.

Reduced motion: nothing travels, swirls or bounces. A dropped blob vanishes where it was let go, a tap adds the part without the hop, and there is no streak, stir or landing; the rim still re-divides and the paint still cross-fades to the new mix in oklab, because the mix is the value.

The settled mix is announced once in a polite live region and kept in the recent strip after it has stood still for 700 ms; a value the palette cannot make exactly is kept as given, and the rim shows the closest recipe.

items.title: Folder Drop
items.tagline: Drop files, watch them go in.
items.description: A file field drawn as a paper folder: files dragged over it open its mouth, the front flap tipping toward you on the snap spring, and each accepted file falls in as a sheet of paper behind the flap on a cascade, after which the flap shuts and the folder lands on the recoil spring. A file it will not take, the wrong type, over `maxSize`, a duplicate or one too many, falls onto the shut edge, jumps and tumbles away and is listed with the reason, while every filed file gets a row whose swallowtail progress ribbon follows the host's upload progress on the glide spring. The folder is a real button over a real file input, so click, Enter or Space open the system picker and the picked files go through the same checks and the same fall.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The files in the folder: `{ id, name, size, type?, progress?, file? }`. Controlled or uncontrolled; the host owns `progress`, and files it adds itself fall in silently.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the drop, pick or removal that changed the list.

props.name: onReject
props.description: The files that bounced off a drop or pick, with the reason for each.

props.name: label
props.description: The field's visible label; with "Choose files" it names the folder button.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name for the real file input, whose files are rebuilt from the list after every change.

props.name: hint
props.description: Guidance under the folder. Defaults to what it takes and how large, such as "Images up to 10 MB."

props.name: error
props.description: An error from the host, shown under the folder and announced once.

props.name: required
props.description: The form needs at least one file; set on the file input while the folder is empty.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Refuses drops and picks and dims the field.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: The largest file it takes, in MB; a larger one bounces with its size and the limit.

props.name: accept
props.description: Which files it takes; also sets the picker's filter and the default hint.

props.name: folder
props.description: The folder's paper, the same in either theme.

props.name: maxFiles
props.description: How many files the folder holds; the rest of a drop bounces.

props.name: sound
props.description: A swish as sheets go in, a thud as the flap shuts and a shrug for each bounce. Only ever in answer to the visitor.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the field's root.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the folder is a button, so Tab reaches it and Enter or Space open the system file picker, the same end state as a drop. Each row's remove button is named by its file; removing one moves focus to the next row, or back to the folder when none are left.
Reduced motion: the flap swaps between shut and open and no sheet falls or bounces; rows and reasons still arrive, the ribbons still fill on a short tween and the count on the folder still changes.

Each drop is announced once in a polite live region, such as "1 file added. drone-pass.tif bounced: 12.4 MB, over the 10 MB limit.", and a finished upload once as "roof-east.png filed."; upload progress itself is the host's, passed back on each item.

items.title: Slug Field
items.tagline: Titles become tidy URLs.
items.description: A title and the URL slug that follows it: each new slug letter drops out of the title as a ghost of the character as typed, capital or accent and all, and becomes the lowercase letter as it lands in its cell on the flick spring, while characters a slug cannot hold fall away before they arrive and later letters slide to their new cells on the glide spring. Typing in the slug itself folds the text the same way and unlinks it from the title, snapping the tether and chain beside the label on the snap spring, and the Follow title toggle relinks it with the letters dropping in again. An availability check marks a taken slug and offers the first free numbered one; both fields are real inputs with the platform's own caret, selection and undo, reached with Tab, and every control is a button pressed with Enter or Space.

props.name: title / defaultTitle
props.description: The title the slug follows. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onTitleChange
props.description: Fires as the title is typed.

props.name: titleLabel
props.description: The title field's visible label.

props.name: titleName
props.description: Form field name for the title input.

props.name: titlePlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder for an empty title.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The slug. Controlled or uncontrolled; uncontrolled, it defaults to the title's slug.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the keystroke, press or offer that changed the slug, including a title keystroke while it is linked.

props.name: label
props.description: The slug field's visible label.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name for the slug input.

props.name: prefix
props.description: What comes before the slug, shown in the box and truncated first when space is short, such as "fernworks.journal/posts/".

props.name: linked / defaultLinked
props.description: Whether the slug follows the title. Uncontrolled, it starts unlinked when `defaultValue` differs from the title's slug.

props.name: onLinkedChange
props.description: Fires when a hand edit unlinks the slug or the toggle links or unlinks it.

props.name: separator
props.description: The character between words.

props.name: max
props.description: The longest slug the title makes, cut on a word boundary; hand typing past it is flagged, never blocked.

props.name: check
props.description: Check the slug with `isTaken` once it has stood still for 300 ms, and offer a numbered one when it is taken.

props.name: isTaken
props.description: The host's availability check, synchronous or not.

props.name: hint
props.description: Guidance under the slug. Defaults to what a slug may contain.

props.name: error
props.description: An error from the host, shown under the slug and announced once.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the slug input required.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables both inputs and every control.

props.name: sound
props.description: A tick as each letter lands and a pop when the slug relinks or takes a numbered offer. Only ever in answer to the visitor.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the field's root.

usageNotes: Keyboard: Tab moves from the title to the Follow title toggle (aria-pressed, Enter or Space) to the slug, and to the numbered offer when one is shown; both fields are native inputs, so selection, undo, paste and IME behave as the platform does.

Reduced motion: no letter flies, falls or slides and the tether and chain swap between joined and broken at once; letters fade into their cells, and the slug, the availability and the counter still update.
A polite live region says, once each, when a slug is taken and which number is free, when it is available, and when the slug stops or starts following the title; never per keystroke.

items.title: Coin Amount
items.tagline: The amount stacks up as you type.
items.description: A currency amount field that counts the cash out as you type: beside the figure a tray keeps one pile per place value — coins for cents and ones, notes for tens and hundreds, strapped bundles from thousands — each holding exactly its digit, and every new piece falls under gravity and lands with a squash on springs.recoil while the figure's own digits roll into place on springs.snap. Clearing sweeps the tray off to the right on the exit ease, and a conversion odometer under the field rolls on springs.snap. It is a real text input that places the grouping as you type and keeps the caret among the digits; Escape or the clear button empties it.

props.name: label
props.description: What the amount is for. The field's visible label.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The amount, controlled or initial; null is an empty field.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the key, paste or clear that changed the amount.

props.name: currency
props.description: The currency typed in: its symbol, grouping (lakh for rupees), notes and conversion pair.

props.name: convert
props.description: Show the live conversion to a second currency under the field.

props.name: stack
props.description: How loosely the cash piles, 0 to 1: squared-off stacks at 0, a casual heap that lands harder at 1.

props.name: convertTo
props.description: The currency converted to. Defaults to the usual pair: euros for dollars and pounds, dollars for euros and rupees.

props.name: rate
props.description: Units of convertTo per unit of currency. The default is an illustrative fixed rate; pass a live one.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale that groups and formats the figure. Defaults to the currency's own.

props.name: min
props.description: The least amount accepted. Checked, never enforced while typing.

props.name: max
props.description: The most accepted. Checked, never enforced while typing.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name; a hidden input carries the amount with two decimals.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown in an empty field.

props.name: hint
props.description: Helper text under the field.

props.name: error
props.description: An error from the host; replaces the hint and marks the field invalid.

props.name: required
props.description: An empty field is invalid once it has been left.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the field off.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play the coins and notes landing and the sweep. Only the visitor's own edits are heard.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root.

usageNotes: Keyboard: it is a text input — digits and one point ("." or ",") type in, the grouping is placed for you, any delete works across it, a pasted "1.284,35" or "$1,284.35" lands as 1284.35, and Escape (or the clear button) empties the field and sweeps the tray.
Reduced motion: nothing falls, rolls or sweeps — pieces fade onto and off their piles and digits change in place; the piles and the conversion still follow the figure.
Validation never blocks typing: over max or under min shows an error that is announced once; nine whole digits and two decimals are the format limit.

items.title: Catalog Select
items.tagline: Flip through the drawer.
items.description: A select whose options are index cards in a catalog drawer: opening pulls the drawer out on springs.glide (or by hand, 1:1, committing by projection), the card being read stands tipped toward you, and moving on makes it fall forward over its bottom edge while the file glides a place nearer — moving back flips the last fallen card up on springs.snap, and jumps riffle card by card on cascade(). Choosing lifts the card up into the field on springs.glide as the drawer shuts under it. It is the select-only combobox pattern: focus stays on the field, arrows, Page keys, Home and End move, typing jumps by first letters, Enter chooses and Escape shuts.

props.name: label
props.description: What is being chosen. The visible label and the listbox's name.

props.name: options
props.description: The cards: { value, label, detail?, disabled? }. The label is the card's heading and tab and what typing jumps by.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The chosen option's value, controlled or initial.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the key, click or tap that chose a card.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the drawer is pulled out, controlled or initial.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires from the key, pull or press that opened or shut the drawer.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown in the field before anything is chosen.

props.name: drawerLabel
props.description: The label in the holder on the drawer's front. Defaults to the first and last initials, "A – Z".

props.name: cards
props.description: How many cards stand in view in the open drawer, 4 to 12: wide tabs at 4, a packed file at 12.

props.name: drawer
props.description: The drawer's material: grained oak with brass, brushed steel, or kraft board.

props.name: flip
props.description: How far the card being read tips toward you, 0 to 1; the paper is louder with it.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name; a hidden input carries the chosen value.

props.name: hint
props.description: Helper text under the drawer.

props.name: error
props.description: An error from the host; replaces the hint and marks the field invalid.

props.name: required
props.description: Shutting the drawer with nothing chosen shows "Choose one to continue."

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the field and the drawer off.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play the paper of each flip and the drawer's thock. Heard only just after the visitor's own input.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root.

usageNotes: Keyboard: on the field, Down, Enter or Space opens the drawer on the chosen card, Up and Home open on the first, End on the last, and typing opens and jumps by first letters. Open: Up and Down flip a card, PageUp and PageDown a drawer-full, Home and End jump (disabled cards are skipped), Enter, Space or Alt+Up choose, Tab chooses and moves on, Escape shuts without choosing.
Reduced motion: the drawer opens and shuts in one step, cards change places without falling or flipping, and choosing updates the field without the flight.

Pointer: the drawer's front can be pulled out and pushed back by hand; the wheel over the open drawer flips a card per notch, a vertical drag riffles, a click on a card or tab chooses it and a press on the fallen pile flips one back.

items.title: Ink Checklist
items.tagline: Ticked by hand.
items.description: A checklist on a notepad where each tick is drawn by a pen: a filled outline rebuilt every frame from a stroke with pressure — light where the nib lands, heaviest at the corner, lifting to a hairline as it flicks — on springs.flick, followed by a wavering pen line through the words at the pen's own pace, struck line by line when they wrap. Unticking rubs both out with a small eraser that leaves a fading smudge, and a margin bar fills with ink to the share done on springs.glide. Every item is a native checkbox in a fieldset, so Tab reaches each box and Space ticks it exactly as a press does.

props.name: label
props.description: What the list is for. The fieldset's legend.

props.name: items
props.description: The items: { id, label, disabled? }.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The ids of the ticked items, controlled or initial.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the press or key that ticked or unticked an item, with every ticked id in list order.

props.name: ink
props.description: The pen.

props.name: strike
props.description: Strike an item's words through when it is ticked.

props.name: wobble
props.description: How unsteady the hand is, 0 to 1: the boxes' corners, the tick's path and the strike's waver.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name; each ticked item submits its id under it.

props.name: hint
props.description: Helper text under the legend.

props.name: error
props.description: An error from the host; replaces the hint.

props.name: required
props.description: Every item must be ticked before the form submits; a refused submit says how many are left.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the whole list off.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play the pen's tick and scratch and the eraser's rub. Only the visitor's own ticks are heard.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the pad.

usageNotes: Keyboard: every item is a native checkbox — Tab reaches each box and Space ticks or unticks it with the same drawing or rubbing out as a press; the focus ring sits on the box itself.
Reduced motion: no drawing or rubbing — the tick and strike appear whole with a short fade and leave with one, with no eraser or smudge; the margin bar and the count still change.
Every stroke is seeded from the item's id, so the server and the browser draw the same hand; progress ("3 of 5 done.") and a required list's error are announced once each in a polite live region.

items.title: Mail Field
items.tagline: Catches the typo before you do.
items.description: An email field that checks as you type and catches a slipped domain: when the domain looks finished but sits an edit or two from a known one (a swap counts as one), a row folds open under the field at its measured height on springs.glide, and using the fix morphs the address in place — kept letters slide on springs.glide, swapped letters trade places with one arcing over the other, a wrong letter drops out as the right one drops in on springs.snap, one after another on cascade(). A committed valid address is stamped with a postmark that lands on springs.recoil. The fix is the next thing Tab reaches, Enter or Space uses it, and Escape in the field declines it.

props.name: label
props.description: What the address is for. The field's visible label.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The address, controlled or initial.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the key, paste or accepted fix that changed the address.

props.name: onStamp
props.description: Fires when a valid address is stamped: the field was left, Enter pressed, or a fix used or declined.

props.name: suggest
props.description: Offer a fix when the domain looks like a slip of a known one.

props.name: stamp
props.description: Stamp a committed valid address; off, it gets a quiet check.

props.name: domains
props.description: Which built-in (invented) domains the field knows and suggests: personal mail hosts or company domains.

props.name: knownDomains
props.description: The host's own known domains, in place of the built-in list.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name; the input itself carries the address.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown in an empty field.

props.name: hint
props.description: Helper text under the field.

props.name: error
props.description: An error from the host; replaces the hint and marks the field invalid.

props.name: required
props.description: An empty field is invalid once it has been left.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the field off.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play the letters landing and the stamp. Only the visitor's own actions are heard.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root.

usageNotes: Keyboard: when a fix is offered, Tab from the field reaches "Use it" (then "Keep mine"); Enter or Space uses it and returns focus to the field with the caret at the end; Escape in the field declines it. Enter or leaving the field stamps a valid address.

Reduced motion: no letters travel — the corrected address replaces the old one at once with its changed letters tinted and fading to ink, the suggestion row opens without travel, and the stamp fades in without the bounce.

Certain mistakes (a space, a second @, a character an address cannot hold) are said at once; an unfinished address only once the field is left; the suggestion, errors and the stamp are each announced once in one polite live region.

items.title: Ribbon Tabs
items.tagline: Tabs that hang like ribbons.
items.description: Tabs drawn as lengths of fabric hanging from a rail: the chosen ribbon drops further on a spring set by the cloth and its colour deepens on a tween, while every ribbon is a pendulum that the change of tab tugs into a swing, the new one hardest, with a wave of smaller kicks running along the rail and each tail lagging so the cloth bends. The panel below cross-fades in the direction of travel and its height glides; brushing the pointer across the ribbons sets them swinging, and a ribbon pulled down like a cord follows the hand 1:1 and is chosen past half its drop. It is a real tablist: arrow keys move and choose with the same sway, Home and End jump.

props.name: tabs
props.type: { id: string; label: string; content: ReactNode; disabled?: boolean }[]
props.description: The ribbons, left to right, and what each one's panel shows.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The chosen tab's id, controlled or initial.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the tap, tug or key that chose a tab, with its id.

props.name: label
props.description: The tab list's accessible name.

props.name: sway
props.description: How freely the ribbons swing, 0 to 1: 0 hangs rigid, 1 swings long and lazily.

props.name: fabric
props.description: The cloth: glossy satin with a swallowtail, matte linen with a stitched hem, or heavy velvet with a pointed end. Sets the look, the cut and the weight of the swing.

props.name: length
props.description: How much further the chosen ribbon drops than the rest, in px (24 to 64).

props.name: color
props.description: The fabric's colour, any CSS colour; the pale and deep shades are drawn from it at fixed lightness.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a swish when the visitor changes tab, and a soft one when a fast brush crosses a ribbon.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Every ribbon can be read but not chosen, tugged or brushed.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which holds the rail and the panel.

usageNotes: A role="tablist" of role="tab" buttons with roving tabindex: ArrowLeft and ArrowRight move and choose (wrapping, skipping disabled tabs), Home and End jump, Enter and Space choose the focused tab; the panel is a labelled, focusable role="tabpanel".
Under reduced motion nothing swings, drops or brushes: the chosen ribbon's length switches at once and its colour still deepens on a short tween, and the panel cross-fades in place without sliding.
Ribbons pull down with touch-action pan-x, so a vertical drag on them tugs rather than scrolls; a sideways brush never chooses a tab.

items.title: Cabinet Menu
items.tagline: Drawers within drawers.
items.description: A nested menu drawn as a filing cabinet: each top item is a drawer that slides out toward you on its runners, the front coming down and growing a hair nearer while the inside is revealed above it with walls, runners and hanging folders, and at depth 3 a folder opens on the glide spring to fan out its sheets. The slide is one spring per drawer set by runners, from wooden slides that stop dead to ball-bearing slides that bump the end-stop and rebound when shut hard, with a thock timed to the stop; the pull follows the hand 1:1 and a throw is projected open or shut. It is a vertical menubar: Up and Down walk a level, Right, Enter or Space open and step in, and Left or Escape push the innermost drawer or folder home one at a time.

props.name: drawers
props.type: { id: string; label: string; folders: { id: string; label: string; items?: { id: string; label: string; meta?: string }[] }[] }[]
props.description: The cabinet, top drawer first: each drawer's folders and each folder's sheets.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The chosen leaf's id (a sheet, or a folder that is a leaf), controlled or initial.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the press or key that chose a leaf, with its id and the labels from drawer to leaf.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires when a drawer comes out, with its id, or when every drawer is home, with null.

props.name: label
props.description: The menu's accessible name.

props.name: depth
props.description: How many levels the menu has: 2 (drawers, folders as leaves) or 3 (drawers, folders, sheets).

props.name: runners
props.description: The runners, 0 to 1: plain wooden slides that stop dead, up to ball-bearing slides that glide, bump the end-stop and rebound when shut hard. Also changes the runner hardware drawn.

props.name: finish
props.description: The cabinet's material: brushed steel with chrome pulls, oak with grain and brass pulls, or mint enamel.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a thock when a drawer the visitor moved meets its stop, and paper as folders open and a leaf is chosen.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The cabinet can be read but no drawer opens.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the cabinet's carcass.

usageNotes: A vertical role="menubar" of drawer fronts (roving tabindex), each owning a role="menu" of folders; folders with sheets own a nested menu and leaves are menuitemradio with aria-checked. Up and Down walk a level, Home and End jump, a letter jumps ahead, Right, Enter or Space open and step in, Left or Escape push the innermost open level home one per press (Escape calls preventDefault whenever it closes something); a press outside or tabbing away shuts the cabinet.

Under reduced motion nothing slides or bounces: a drawer's inside appears at full height with a short fade and a folder's sheets appear together; the chosen leaf is still marked and the drawer's label holder still names it.
The bar pull is the only touch-action none area, so the rest of the cabinet still scrolls a page; the choice is announced once, politely.

items.title: Cantilever Menu
items.tagline: Every tool, one lift away.
items.description: An actions menu drawn as a cantilever toolbox: opening lifts the trays up and outward on parallelogram arms, each tray staying level while it rides a true circular arc over the top and out into a staircase, and its tools stand up out of it as it clears the tray below. One spring per tray drives the arc, the arms and the tools; arms sets the linkage from one stiff unit to springy arms that stagger and bounce at their stops with a clack each, and closing folds the trays back from the bottom up until the latch clicks. Choosing a tool lifts it out on snap before the box shuts; arrow keys walk the tools and cross trays, Up and Down move between trays, and Escape hands focus back to the latch.

props.name: groups
props.type: { id: string; label: string; actions: { id: string; label: string; icon?: ReactNode; shortcut?: string; tone?: "default" | "danger" }[] }[]
props.description: One group per tray, top tray first, up to four actions each; groups beyond the trays share the box's own compartment.

props.name: label
props.description: The menu's name: the latch's accessible name, shown on its plate while shut.

props.name: onAction
props.description: A tool was chosen. Fires as it lifts out, before the box folds shut.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the box is open, controlled or initial.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires from the press, pull or key that opened or shut the box.

props.name: trays
props.description: How many tiers of trays the box has, 1 to 3. With fewer tiers than groups, the rest sit in the box.

props.name: arms
props.description: How springy the linked arms are, 0 to 1: 0 moves the trays as one stout, stiff unit; 1 has slender arms that let each tray lag the one above and bounce at its stop.

props.name: finish
props.description: The paint: red enamel, bare steel or green.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a clack as each tray the visitor opened reaches its stop and as a tool lifts out, and a click when the latch catches.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The box stays shut and the latch cannot be pressed.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is as tall as the box's tallest pose and scales down below 300 px wide.

usageNotes: The latch is a menu button (aria-haspopup, aria-expanded, aria-controls): Enter, Space or ArrowDown open it on the first tool and ArrowUp on the last. Inside the role="menu", ArrowLeft and ArrowRight walk the tools and cross trays, ArrowUp and ArrowDown move to the nearest tool in the tray above or below, Home and End jump, a letter jumps ahead, Enter or Space chooses, and Escape or Tab shut the box (with preventDefault) and return focus to the latch.

Under reduced motion there are no arcs, bounces or rising tools: the trays fade out of the stack and into the staircase and back, the tools already standing; the highlight, the latch plate and the sounds still answer.
The grip on top of the shut box pulls it open 1:1 (touch-action pan-x on the grip only) and a throw commits open or shut; while shut, the trays are inert and hidden from assistive technology.

items.title: Thumb Index
items.tagline: Jump straight to the letter.
items.description: Section navigation cut into a book's fore-edge: half-moon notches run down the page's edge, each with a printed tab, and a drawn thumb rests in the current one. Pressing a tab lifts the thumb on flick, carries it down the edge on glide and drops it into the new notch on snap, whose one overshoot is the press; the tab stays down and the pages riffle to the section, leaves hinged at the spine turning over one after another on a single staggered clock while the running heads of the sections passed flick by. Arrow keys move between tabs, Home and End jump, a letter moves to the tab that holds it, Enter or Space presses, and the thumb can be dragged down the edge to scrub.

props.name: sections
props.type: number | { id: string; label: string; title?: string; letters?: string; href?: string }[]
props.description: How many sections to split A–Z into (4 to 12, balanced by how much of a dictionary each letter fills), or the sections themselves. A section with an href makes its tab a link.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The current section's id. An id that is not found falls back to the section holding its first letter, so a letter id survives a change of section count.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the press, key or scrub that chose a section, with its id.

props.name: children
props.description: What the page shows for a section, under its running head. Rendered again on the leaf that carries the page during a riffle.

props.name: label
props.description: The navigation's accessible name.

props.name: tabs
props.description: Half-moon notches with round tabs, or square-cut notches with square tabs.

props.name: riffle
props.description: How many leaves turn on the way to a section, and how slowly, 0 to 1. A longer jump turns more leaves; 0 changes the page with a fade.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a thock when the thumb lands in a notch and a paper riffle for the turning leaves, only in answer to the visitor.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The page can be read but the tabs cannot be pressed or scrubbed.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which sets the page's size. Defaults to h-104 w-full; the notches spread down whatever height it is given.

usageNotes: A nav of links or buttons with aria-current="page" on the current section and a roving tabindex: ArrowUp and ArrowDown (or Left and Right) move between tabs, Home and End jump, a letter key moves focus to the tab whose section holds that letter, and Enter or Space presses it. The new section is said once in a polite live region.

Under reduced motion the thumb fades between notches instead of travelling and the page cross-fades instead of riffling; the pressed tab, the page and the announcement still change. Scrubbing still follows the finger.
alphabetSections(count) is exported for hosts that want the same balanced A–Z split to filter their own content by each section's letters.

items.title: Key Ring
items.tagline: Pick the key for the workspace.
items.description: A workspace switcher drawn as keys hanging from a split ring, each bow capped in the workspace's colour and printed with its initial, each blade cut with teeth seeded from its id.
