items.description: A mute toggle drawn as a speaker cone with up to four waves and a five-pill level meter: muting folds the waves back into the cone outermost first, a cascade apart on the exit ease, then a pen draws the slash; unmuting lifts the pen and releases the waves one by one on the snap spring, each overshooting its own radius, while the meter refills to the kept level on the glide spring. The volume is a second value: a long press arms a scrub, a vertical drag follows the finger 1:1 and rubber-bands past either end, the waves follow the level band by band, and reaching 0 mutes. It is a button with aria-pressed and a constant name; Space and Enter mute, the arrow keys, Page keys, Home and End set the volume, and the change is announced politely.

props.name: pressed / defaultPressed
props.description: Whether the sound is muted, controlled or initial.

props.name: onPressedChange
props.description: Fires from the press, drag or key that muted or unmuted.

props.name: level / defaultLevel
props.description: The volume, 0 to 100, controlled or initial. Muting keeps it; 0 is silence.

props.name: onLevelChange
props.description: Fires from the drag or key that changed the volume, as it changes.

props.name: waves
props.description: How many sound waves the cone can hold, 1 to 4; the level fills them in turn and the icon's width follows.

props.name: slash
props.description: The mark drawn once the waves have folded: a slash through the cone, a cross where the waves were, or none.

props.name: step
props.description: How far one arrow key moves the level.

props.name: label
props.description: The word while sound plays.

props.name: pressedLabel
props.description: The word while muted, in the muted colour.

props.name: name
props.description: The toggle's accessible name, the same in both states.

props.name: formatLevel
props.description: How the level is written while it is scrubbed, and spoken.

props.name: holdDelay
props.description: How long a press is held before it starts scrubbing the level, in ms.

props.name: scrubDistance
props.description: How far a vertical drag travels to cross the whole range, in px.

props.name: stagger
props.description: The beat between one wave and the next as they fold or release, in ms.

props.name: compact
props.description: Icon only: the cone over a row of five dots, the words in its accessible name.

props.name: size
props.description: 40, 48 or 56px tall.

props.name: accent
props.description: The waves and the meter, any CSS colour.

props.name: mutedColor
props.description: The muted mark and word.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play the fold and release, the slash, and the meter's detents; only ever for the visitor's own press, drag or key.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Not pressable or draggable, drawn at half strength.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the button.

usageNotes: Space and Enter mute and unmute; with focus on the button, Arrow Up/Right and Down/Left move the volume by step, Page Up/Down by 25, Home mutes and End plays at 100. A key change and the end of a drag are announced in a polite live region.
Under reduced motion the waves and the mark appear and disappear in place by opacity, the meter changes on a short tween and nothing stretches; the level and the muted state still show.
The visible level is level while playing and 0 while muted. Scrubbing to 0 reports level 0 and muted; unmuting a muted control whose level is 0 brings back the last audible level.
Keep both pairs controlled together (pressed with onPressedChange, level with onLevelChange); a host that refuses a drag gets its own value back when the finger lifts.
The button takes touch-action: pan-x, so a vertical drag on it scrubs instead of scrolling the page; a horizontal swipe still pans.

items.title: Pin Press
items.tagline: Pressed into the board, pulled back out.
items.description: A pin toggle drawn as a push-pin over a small cork patch at three-quarters: a press pushes the pin part of the way in on the flick spring, and letting go drives it home with the press's speed while the head shrinks away, its shadow tightens, the head takes the hit on the recoil spring and a dimple ring spreads across the cork, and a to-top tag slides out from under the label on snap. Unpinning pulls the pin up on a heavy spring while the needle wobbles about its tip on an underdamped one and the shadow grows back. It is a button with aria-pressed and a constant name; Space pushes on the way down and pins on the way up, Enter pins at once, and Escape or blur mid-press lets the pin back out without committing.

props.name: pressed / defaultPressed
props.description: Whether the item is pinned, controlled or initial.

props.name: onPressedChange
props.description: Fires from the press that pinned or unpinned; the pin lands only once the state actually changes.

props.name: label
props.description: The word before pinning.

props.name: pressedLabel
props.description: The word once pinned; the label column keeps the widest of the words and the tag.

props.name: tag
props.description: Show the small tag that slides out under the pinned word.

props.name: tagLabel
props.description: The tag's words: where a pinned item goes. Also read in the pinned description.

props.name: name
props.description: The toggle's accessible name, the same in both states.

props.name: depth
props.description: How deep the pin goes in, 0 to 1: the needle hides, the head shrinks away, the shadow tightens and the ring spreads wider.

props.name: wobble
props.description: How loose the needle is as it comes out, 0 to 1: straight out, or a floppy wobble about its tip.

props.name: anticipation
props.description: How far a press pushes the pin before it is let go, 0 to 1 of the way home.

props.name: ringDuration
props.description: How long the dimple ring takes to spread across the cork, in ms.

props.name: compact
props.description: Icon only: the pin and its cork in a round button, the words in its accessible name.

props.name: size
props.description: 36, 40 or 48px tall.

props.name: pinColor
props.description: The pin's head, any CSS colour; a fixed lightness reads the same in both themes.

props.name: corkColor
props.description: The cork.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a thock as the pin lands home and a pop as the needle leaves the cork; only ever for the visitor's own press.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Not pressable, drawn at half strength.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the button.

usageNotes: Space pushes the pin on the way down and commits on the way up, as a pointer press does; Enter commits at once; Escape (handled with preventDefault) or blur while Space is held lets the pin back out without committing.
Under reduced motion the pin swaps poses with no travel, squash or wobble, the dimple ring fades at full size and the words and tag cross-fade in place; the pinned state always shows.
Controlled: pass pressed and onPressedChange. The press reports first and the pin lands only when the host answers, so a refused pin never shows a landing.
The accessible name stays the same in both states (pass name, e.g. "Pin Q4 field schedule"); while pinned the button is described as "Pinned to top" from pressedLabel and tagLabel.
Colours are pigments at a fixed lightness, so the pin and cork read the same in light and dark themes; pass any CSS colour to recolour them.

items.title: Privacy Blinds
items.tagline: Public, or private — slat by slat.
items.description: A Public / Private toggle drawn as a window with venetian blinds. Going private, each slat tilts shut from the top down on springs.snap in a short cascade, the bands of daylight the window throws across the button thin out until a last sliver stripes the label, and the bottom rail folds into a padlock whose shackle rises on snap; going public, the lock lets go, the slats open from the bottom up and a soft beam sweeps the face on a tween. It is a toggle button with aria-pressed under one constant name: Space and Enter press it, and hovering peeks the slats a few degrees.

props.name: pressed / defaultPressed
props.description: Controlled and initial state; true is Private, the blinds shut.

props.name: onPressedChange
props.description: Fires from the press that changed it, with the new state.

props.name: publicLabel
props.description: The word shown while open.

props.name: privateLabel
props.description: The word shown while shut.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name, the same in both states; aria-pressed carries the state.

props.name: compact
props.description: Icon only; the accessible name stays.

props.name: slats
props.description: How many slats hang in the window, 3 to 8.

props.name: tilt
props.description: The open slats' angle in degrees: 0 is edge-on and all daylight, 45 is half shut.

props.name: peek
props.description: How far hovering tips the slats, in degrees: open a crack when private, toward shut when public.

props.name: beam
props.description: Strength of the light, 0 to 1: the daylight bands, the sweep when it opens, the last sliver as it shuts.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Milliseconds between one slat and the next, tightened by cascade() so the fall stays under 600ms.

props.name: lock
props.description: Form a padlock out of the bottom rail while private.

props.name: size
props.description: Pill height 32, 36 or 44px with a 20, 24 or 28px window.

props.name: light
props.description: Daylight colour, any CSS colour.

props.name: shade
props.description: Slat colour, any CSS colour.

props.name: accent
props.description: Padlock colour, any CSS colour.

props.name: sound
props.description: A swish as the slats move, a soft click as each one seats, a firmer click for the lock. Only after a press.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Greys the toggle out and ignores presses and hover.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the button.

usageNotes: It is a <button aria-pressed>: Space and Enter toggle it through the native click, and the accessible name stays `label` ("Private" by default) in both states, so screen readers hear "Private, pressed" or "not pressed" rather than a name that changes under them.

Controlled hosts get onPressedChange from the press and the blinds only move once `pressed` changes, so a refused change never shows a false shut; a change the host makes on its own animates silently.
Under reduced motion all slats turn together on a 150ms tween, the lock fades in at its final shape and the beam does not sweep; the window still shuts and the lock still appears.
Both words sit in one grid cell, so the pill keeps the width of the longer one and neighbours never shift; pass compact for an icon-only control in dense toolbars.
Colours are CSS colour strings defaulting to tokens, so the toggle reads in light and dark themes; the daylight is a pigment taken from --warn at a fixed lightness.

items.title: Renew Loop
items.tagline: The arrows close the circle, the date turns over.
items.description: An auto-renew switch whose icon is the renewal: switched on, two arc arrows chase round the ring on springs.glide until their heads catch the other's tails and lock into a closed ring on springs.snap, the heads folding to small chevrons as the ring takes the accent, while a split-flap readout beside the label turns over cell by cell to the renewal date. Switched off, the ring breaks at the top, the arrows coast apart under friction on an inertia decay and the readout flips back to the day access ends. Dates come only from props, read in UTC; Space and Enter toggle it, and a polite status speaks the new date.

props.name: pressed / defaultPressed
props.description: Controlled and initial state; true while the plan renews by itself.

props.name: onPressedChange
props.description: Fires from the press that changed it, with the new state.

props.name: renewsOn
props.description: The next renewal date, when your billing system already knows it.

props.name: renewedOn
props.description: The day the current term began: the last renewal, or the purchase.

props.name: period
props.description: The billing period: how far each renewal carries the plan.

props.name: label
props.description: What the switch controls; the button's accessible name.

props.name: renewsLabel
props.description: The word before the date while on.

props.name: endsLabel
props.description: The word before the date while off.

props.name: formatDate
props.description: How a date is written in the readout and the description.

props.name: chase
props.description: How far the arrows chase before their heads lock, in degrees.

props.name: flip
props.description: How long one flap takes to fall, in ms.

props.name: friction
props.description: How quickly the released arrows coast to a stop, 0 (they glide on) to 1 (they stop short).

props.name: compact
props.description: Ring only; the label becomes the accessible name and the date its description and title.

props.name: size
props.description: Pill height 32, 36 or 44px with the readout scaled to match.

props.name: accent
props.description: The closed ring's colour, any CSS colour.

props.name: sound
props.description: A ratchet tick per 30° of spin, a snap when the heads lock or the ring breaks, a faint tick per flap. Only after a press.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Greys the switch out and ignores presses and hover.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root, which wraps the button.

usageNotes: Pass the term start (renewedOn) and the period, or the renewal date your billing system already has (renewsOn); the readout shows the renewal date while on and the last day of access, the day before it, while off. Dates are read in UTC, so server and client agree; pass formatDate for another style.

It is a <button aria-pressed> named by its visible label: Space and Enter toggle it, the full sentence ("Renews 15 Nov, then every month.") is its description, and a polite status speaks the new sentence after each change.

Controlled hosts get onPressedChange from the press; the ring only chases once `pressed` changes, so a refused change never shows a false lock. A period or date change flips only the cells that changed, silently.
The readout keeps the width of the longer sentence in fixed cells, so the pill never changes width as it flips; the label truncates with a title before anything overflows.
Under reduced motion the ring swaps shape under a short fade and the readout changes in place; the colour, the date and the announcement still change.

items.title: Focus Moon
items.tagline: An eclipse for your notifications.
items.description: A do-not-disturb toggle that eclipses its own sun: pressed, a moon slides across it on springs.snap, whose one overshoot flashes the last bead of sun on the far limb before the corona comes up on snap, the face turns to night and stars twinkle in on snap in a cascade; while focusing and on screen the corona breathes from one phase value. Holding the button extends the end time in grid steps, a tick per step as the changed digits roll on snap, and letting go sets it; pressed off, the moon slides away on an exit tween and the sunlight blooms back, settling on springs.drift. Space and Enter toggle it, the Up and Down arrows move the end a step, and times come only from the now prop.

props.name: pressed / defaultPressed
props.description: Controlled and initial state; true while notifications are held.

props.name: onPressedChange
props.description: Fires from the tap, the hold or the key that changed it, with the new state.

props.name: until / defaultUntil
props.defaultValue: now plus minutes once it starts
props.description: Controlled and initial end of the focus.

props.name: onUntilChange
props.description: Fires when a tap, a released hold or an arrow key sets a new end time.

props.name: now
props.description: The current time. Pass it from your clock so server and client agree; without it a press reads the clock when it happens.

props.name: minutes
props.description: How long a tap focuses for, in minutes.

props.name: step
props.description: What one hold step or arrow key adds, in minutes; steps land on this grid (15:07 to 15:30).

props.name: maxMinutes
props.description: The furthest a hold can push the end, in minutes from now.

props.name: holdDelay
props.description: How long a press must be held before it starts extending, in ms.

props.name: holdInterval
props.description: Time between steps while held, in ms.

props.name: stars
props.description: How many stars come out around the eclipse, 0 to 8.

props.name: glow
props.description: Strength of the light, 0 to 1: the sun's bloom, the corona and its breathing.

props.name: label
props.description: The button's accessible name and its words while off.

props.name: focusLabel
props.description: The words before the end time while on.

props.name: format
props.description: How the end time is written.

props.name: timeZone
props.description: The IANA time zone the default format writes in.

props.name: compact
props.description: Icon only; the name stays and the end time moves to the description and title.

props.name: size
props.description: Pill height 32, 40 or 48px with a 24, 30 or 36px sky.

props.name: sun
props.description: The sun, the corona and the bloom, any CSS colour.

props.name: night
props.description: The night the face turns while focusing, any CSS colour.

props.name: sound
props.description: A chime at totality (lower when it ends) and a rising tick per hold step or arrow key. Only after the visitor acts.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Greys the toggle out and ignores presses, holds and keys.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root, which wraps the button.

usageNotes: Keyboard: Space and Enter toggle it (on at the default length); the Up and Right arrows add a step (turning it on when off) and Down and Left take one away, never before the next step after now. A held press does the same with the pointer: past holdDelay it adds a step every holdInterval and letting go sets the time.

Pass now from your own clock (a ticking state or a server timestamp) so the label renders the same on server and client. The toggle never turns itself off: when now passes until, set pressed to false from that clock.

Controlled hosts get onPressedChange and onUntilChange from the gesture; a hold shows its draft time while held and commits once, on release, so the host hears one change rather than every step. A refused change slides the moon back away.

A polite status speaks each committed change ("Focusing until 15:30", "Do not disturb off"); the end time and the hold hint are the button's description, and the name stays constant while aria-pressed carries the state.

The corona's breathing runs only while focusing, on screen and in a visible tab. Under reduced motion the moon fades in over the sun and nothing slides, breathes or rolls; the night face, the label and the time still change.

items.title: Repeat Coil
items.tagline: Off, all, then just this one.
items.description: A three-way repeat button whose glyph is two strands rebuilt every frame: off they hang as loose arrows, the first press bends them into one closed loop on the glide spring, and the second winds a third turn inside it on glide while a "1" pip pops out of the loop onto its corner on the recoil spring. The third press drops the pip back on an exit tween and lets the loop fall slack again. It reports aria-pressed false, true and mixed; Space and Enter cycle it, the arrow keys step either way, and Home and End jump to the ends.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The repeat mode, controlled or initial.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the press or key that changed the mode.

props.name: labels
props.defaultValue: Repeat off / Repeat all / Repeat one
props.description: Text for each mode; the button keeps the width of the longest.

props.name: allowOne
props.description: Offer repeat-one; off, the button cycles off and all only.

props.name: compact
props.description: Icon only, with the mode's label as the accessible name.

props.name: coil
props.description: How far and how deep the third turn winds in repeat-one, 0 to 1.

props.name: pip
props.description: Pop a "1" badge out of the loop in repeat-one.

props.name: slack
props.description: How much the loose arrows sag while repeat is off, 0 to 1.

props.name: pipDelay
props.description: Milliseconds from the coil starting to the pip popping out.

props.name: size
props.description: Button height 32, 40 or 48 px with the glyph scaled to match.

props.name: accent
props.description: The loop, the pip and the pressed tint; any CSS colour.

props.name: idleColor
props.description: The loose arrows' colour while repeat is off.

props.name: sound
props.description: A click on every press and a pop as the pip lands.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Ignores presses and keys and dims the button.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper.

usageNotes: Keyboard: Space and Enter cycle off, all, one; ArrowRight and ArrowUp step forward, ArrowLeft and ArrowDown step back (both wrap), Home goes to off and End to the last mode.
aria-pressed reads false for off, true for all and "mixed" for one, and a polite live region speaks the new label after a change the visitor made, once a controlled host has accepted it.
Controlled: pass value and onValueChange; the glyph animates when the host's value changes, so a refused change never shows a false state.
Reduced motion swaps the glyph to each state at once, cross-fades the colour and fades the pip in on its corner, with no bend, coil travel or bounce.
With allowOne off it is a two-state repeat toggle; a host value of "one" is then shown as all.

items.title: Latch Lock
items.tagline: The shackle drops home.
items.description: A lock toggle drawn as a padlock whose parts move on their own springs: unlocking lifts the shackle on the snap spring and swings it out about its long leg with one overshoot while the body drops a few pixels and a glint sweeps the keyhole; locking swings it back and drops it home on the flick spring against a hard stop, with a short shake through the whole lock. A disabled lock stays focusable, rattles in place and says why instead of toggling. Space and Enter toggle it through the native click, and aria-pressed reports locked.

props.name: pressed / defaultPressed
props.description: Locked state, controlled or initial; true is locked.

props.name: onPressedChange
props.description: Fires from the press that changed it.

props.name: lockedLabel
props.description: Text and accessible name while locked.

props.name: unlockedLabel
props.description: Text and accessible name while unlocked; the button keeps the wider label's width.

props.name: compact
props.description: Icon only, with the label as the accessible name.

props.name: weight
props.description: How heavy the lock is, 0 to 1: slower swing, deeper drop, lower thock.

props.name: rattle
props.description: How hard the lock shakes as the shackle seats and when a disabled lock is pressed.

props.name: glint
props.description: Strength of the keyhole glint on unlocking; 0 hides it.

props.name: swing
props.description: How far the open shackle swings out, in degrees.

props.name: size
props.description: Button height 32, 40 or 48 px with the padlock scaled to match.

props.name: lockedColor
props.description: The body's colour while locked and the pressed tint; any CSS colour.

props.name: unlockedColor
props.description: The body's colour while unlocked.

props.name: disabledNote
props.defaultValue: "This lock can't be changed right now"
props.description: Spoken in a polite live region when a disabled lock is pressed.

props.name: onRefused
props.description: A press on a disabled lock, after it rattled and stayed put.

props.name: sound
props.description: Clack as the shackle lets go, thock as it seats, muted clacks for a refusal.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Rattles instead of toggling; stays in the tab order via aria-disabled.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper.

usageNotes: Keyboard: Space and Enter toggle through the native click; aria-pressed is true while locked, and the visible label is the accessible name (aria-label in compact mode).
Disabled uses aria-disabled rather than the native attribute, so keyboard users can reach it and hear disabledNote when they press it; wire onRefused to explain the hold elsewhere too.
Controlled: pass pressed and onPressedChange; the padlock moves when the host's value changes, so a refused change never shows a false state.
Reduced motion jumps the shackle and body to each pose, cross-fades the colour, turns the glint into a short flash and the refusal rattle into a flash of the rim.
lockedColor and unlockedColor take any CSS colour, so a lock that guards something risky can use var(--warn) for its unlocked body.

items.title: Eye Lid
items.tagline: It watches until you close it.
items.description: A show/hide toggle drawn as an eye that watches: while open, the iris and pupil follow the pointer anywhere on the page, held inside the eye on a spring whose keenness you set. Pressing blinks the lid shut on the snap spring with its lashes swinging over; shut, the lid twitches when the pointer passes close, and opening wakes it with a couple of slow tweened blinks before the gaze finds the pointer again on the glide spring. Space and Enter toggle it through the native click, and aria-pressed reports hidden.

props.name: pressed / defaultPressed
props.description: Hidden state, controlled or initial; true is hidden, the eye shut.

props.name: onPressedChange
props.description: Fires from the press that changed it.

props.name: shownLabel
props.description: Text and accessible name while the eye is open.

props.name: hiddenLabel
props.description: Text and accessible name while the eye is shut; the button keeps the wider label's width.

props.name: compact
props.description: Icon only, with the label as the accessible name.

props.name: follow
props.description: How keenly the pupil chases the pointer, 0 to 1: spring stiffness and reach.

props.name: blink
props.description: How many slow blinks it takes to wake when opened, 0 to 3.

props.name: blinkDuration
props.description: How long one waking blink lasts, in ms.

props.name: lashes
props.description: Lashes on the upper lid, 0 to 8.

props.name: twitch
props.description: Let the shut lid twitch when the pointer passes close.

props.name: twitchRadius
props.description: How close the pointer must pass to make the shut lid twitch, in px.

props.name: irisColor
props.description: The iris colour; any CSS colour.

props.name: size
props.description: Button height 32, 40 or 48 px with the eye scaled to match.

props.name: sound
props.description: A tick each time the lids meet, after a press.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Ignores presses; the gaze rests centred.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper.

usageNotes: Keyboard: Space and Enter toggle through the native click; aria-pressed is true while hidden, and the visible label is the accessible name (aria-label in compact mode).
The watching is decoration: the eye listens to the pointer only while it is on screen and the page is visible, reads it once per frame, and never runs a loop while the pointer is still.
Use it beside a balance or a password field and mask the value from pressed; the component only reports, it never hides anything itself.
Reduced motion keeps the gaze centred and swaps the lid between open and shut at once, with no blinks or twitches; the label still changes.
A press during the waking blinks shuts it again at once; in controlled mode the lid only moves when the host's pressed value changes.

items.title: Wish Tag
items.tagline: A price tag swings onto your list.
items.description: A save-to-list toggle that hangs a paper price tag from the button's eyelet: saving swings it in from above the frame as a real pendulum on a recoil-family spring whose period and damping you set, with the tag hinged at its hole so it dangles a beat behind the string, while the counter rolls up on snap and bumps on recoil as the tag first comes taut. Removing snips the string, the stub curls back into the eyelet and the tag drops out of the frame on an ease-in fall. Space and Enter toggle it through the native click, aria-pressed reports saved, and a polite live region says what changed and the new count.

props.name: pressed / defaultPressed
props.description: Saved state, controlled or initial; true is on the list.

props.name: onPressedChange
props.description: Fires from the press that changed it.

props.name: price
props.description: The amount the tag prints; the tag widens to fit it.

props.name: format
props.description: How the price is printed.

props.name: count
props.description: Items on the list without this one; the counter shows one more while saved.

props.name: showCount
props.description: Show the list counter.

props.name: countLabel
props.description: The word after the counter's number.

props.name: saveLabel
props.description: Text and accessible name while not saved.

props.name: savedLabel
props.description: Text and accessible name while saved; the button keeps the wider label's width.

props.name: compact
props.description: Icon only, with the label as the accessible name and the counter beside it.

props.name: swing
props.description: How loosely the tag swings, 0 to 1; the middle is the house recoil.

props.name: stringLength
props.description: From the eyelet to the tag's hole, in px.

props.name: size
props.description: Button height 32, 40 or 48 px with the tag scaled to match.

props.name: tagColor
props.description: The tag's paper; any CSS colour.

props.name: accent
props.description: The saved tint and the tick; any CSS colour.

props.name: sound
props.description: Paper as the tag comes taut, pop with the counter bump, a short snip on removal.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Ignores presses and dims the button.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root.

usageNotes: Keyboard: Space and Enter toggle through the native click; aria-pressed is true while saved, and a polite live region says "Added to your list, 13 saved" or "Removed from your list, 12 saved" after the visitor's change.
The tag swings inside the component's own box, which includes a strip under and to the right of the button; the counter sits in that strip, so leave the component room rather than clipping it.
Controlled: pass pressed and onPressedChange; the tag hangs or falls when the host's value changes, so a refused save never shows a tag.
Reduced motion fades the tag in hanging still and fades it out, with the counter cross-fading and no swing, fall, nudge or bump.
Pass format for other currencies or decimals; the tag's width follows the printed string, so the same price always draws the same tag on the server and the client.

items.title: Launch Pad
items.tagline: Three, two, one — shipped.
items.description: A deploy button with a launch pad in its left cap: a press arms a countdown ring that drains one segment per second, linearly, while the label's digit rolls on springs.snap, and a second press or Escape aborts. At zero the rocket squats and climbs out through the roof on an accelerating exit ease with exhaust billowing along the floor, the label lifts off after it, and a progress line runs while the onLaunch promise is pending; a resolve drops a flag into the pad on springs.recoil and unfurls it on springs.snap, a reject brings the rocket back nose-down on springs.glide and shakes the button with the error and a retry. Enter and Space press it, Escape aborts the count, and every change is spoken once in a polite live region.

props.name: onLaunch
props.description: The deploy itself, called at zero. A returned promise keeps the rocket in flight until it settles: resolve lands the flag, reject shows the error.

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled state. Omit it and the countdown and the promise drive the pad.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Every change of state — a press, the count reaching zero, the promise settling, a hold running out — with the rejection on error. A controlled pad waits for the host to apply it.

props.name: onAbort
props.description: A press or Escape during the countdown called the launch off.

props.name: countdown
props.description: Seconds counted down before lift-off, 0 to 9; each is one segment of the ring. 0 launches on the press.

props.name: thrust
props.description: How hard it launches, 0 to 1: a quicker climb, a longer flame, more exhaust.

props.name: shake
props.description: How far a failure shakes the button, in px. 0 keeps it still.

props.name: progress
props.description: Known progress of the deploy, 0 to 1. Omit it for an estimate that approaches 92% and never claims the finish.

props.name: eta
props.description: How long a deploy usually takes, in ms; paces the estimated progress line.

props.name: label
props.description: The idle label.

props.name: abortLabel
props.description: Shown before the seconds while counting down, when a press aborts.

props.name: pendingLabel
props.description: The label while the deploy is in flight.

props.name: version
props.description: The version that goes live, read out in the success label.

props.name: successLabel
props.description: The label once live.

props.name: errorLabel
props.description: What failed, shown before the retry. A rejection's own message replaces it and truncates with a title.

props.name: retryLabel
props.description: The word after the error that says a press tries again.

props.name: successHold
props.description: How long Live holds before the pad resets, in ms; 0 keeps it. Counts only while the page is visible.

props.name: errorHold
props.description: How long a failure holds before the pad resets, in ms; 0 keeps it until retried.

props.name: size
props.description: 36, 44 or 52px tall; the rocket, flag and ring scale with it.

props.name: accent
props.description: The button's face while idle, counting and in flight.

props.name: flame
props.description: The exhaust flame's colour.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play the countdown ticks, the lift-off, the landing chime and the failure buzz — only for a launch the visitor started.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Takes the button out of use.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer wrapper.

usageNotes: Keyboard: Enter or Space presses through the native click; during the countdown a second press or Escape aborts (Escape is handled with preventDefault). In flight and while Live, the button stays focusable but is aria-disabled, and pending is aria-busy.

Reduced motion: nothing travels or bounces — the ring still drains because it is the time left, the digit swaps, the rocket fades out and back, the progress line still fills, the flag and the tilted rocket appear in place, and the button never shakes; colours still change.

Controlled use: pass state and apply what onStateChange reports. The pad calls onLaunch at zero and reports pending, then success or error when the promise settles; a host that refuses a change simply leaves the pad where it is.
The countdown is an abort window, so it pauses while the page is hidden instead of launching behind the visitor's back; the success and error holds pause too.
The button reserves the width of its longest built-in label, so neighbours never move between states; a longer rejection message truncates with a title.
Sound plays only for a sequence the visitor started with a press; a host driving state on its own is silent.

items.title: Settle Button
items.tagline: The amount runs down to paid.
items.description: A pay button laid out like a checkout bar, the amount on an odometer with one wheel per digit: a press sweeps a fill in the paid colour in behind the text, and as its front crosses each digit that wheel rolls down to zero, closing in on the last digit exponentially and holding there while the onPay promise is pending. Resolved, the characters fold away in a cascade on the exit ease, Pay rolls to Paid on springs.snap and a check is stamped where the last digit stood on springs.recoil, its stroke drawn on springs.flick; declined, the fill retreats on springs.glide, the wheels roll back up and the face tints to danger. Enter and Space press it through the native click, and each change is spoken once in a polite live region.

props.name: amount
props.description: What is owed, in major units — dollars, not cents.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO 4217 code: sets the sign, the separators and how many places roll.

props.name: locale
props.description: The formatting locale. USD en-US, EUR de-DE, GBP en-GB, JPY ja-JP, otherwise en-US — fixed, so the server and the browser format alike.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the amount for the label and the spoken text; every digit in its output becomes a wheel.

props.name: onPay
props.description: Takes the payment. A returned promise holds the meter short of zero until it settles.

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled state. Omit it and the press and the promise drive the button.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Every change of state — the press, the promise, a hold running out — with the rejection on error.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the amount runs down, 0.5 to 2 times.

props.name: stamp
props.description: How hard the check is stamped, 0 to 1: 0 only draws it, 1 slams it down with an ink ring.

props.name: label
props.description: The word before the amount.

props.name: pendingLabel
props.description: The word while the payment is in flight.

props.name: paidLabel
props.description: The word once paid.

props.name: retryLabel
props.description: The word after a failure, when a press tries again.

props.name: errorLabel
props.description: What failed, spoken and shown as the button's title. A rejection's own message replaces it.

props.name: successHold
props.description: How long Paid holds before the amount rolls back up, in ms; 0 keeps it paid. Counts only while the page is visible.

props.name: errorHold
props.description: How long the failure tint holds, in ms; 0 keeps it until the next press.

props.name: size
props.description: 36, 44 or 52px tall.

props.name: accent
props.description: The unpaid face.

props.name: fill
props.description: The paid colour that sweeps in behind the digits.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a tick as each digit reaches zero, the stamp's chime and the decline's buzz — only for a payment the visitor pressed.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Takes the button out of use.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer wrapper.

usageNotes: Keyboard: Enter or Space presses through the native click. In flight and once paid the button stays focusable but is aria-disabled, and in flight it is aria-busy; its name is one sentence, such as "Pay $1,284.50".

Reduced motion: the fill still sweeps because it is the progress, but each digit swaps to zero as the front passes it instead of rolling, the fold is a fade and the check appears without the stamp's bounce or ink ring; the danger tint still shows a decline.

Amounts go through Intl.NumberFormat in a fixed locale (or your format function), so the server and the browser render the same digits; the figures are mono and tabular, and leading digits dim to ghost zeros rather than collapsing, so nothing shifts.
Controlled use: pass state and apply what onStateChange reports. The button calls onPay on the press and reports pending, then success or error when the promise settles.
A new amount while idle rolls up from zeros, so a host can swap to the next invoice after successHold and the button shows it arriving.

items.title: Download Tray
items.tagline: The file drops in, the tray slides shut.
items.description: A download button with a tray hidden behind its bottom edge: a press dips the arrow and drops it under gravity through the label row and out of the button, while the tray slides out on the chosen spring (glide, snap or recoil) to catch it, the arrow landing with a squash on springs.recoil and the progress drawn along the tray's lip. At 100% the tray slides shut, the file size is stamped into the caption on springs.recoil, and the arrow rises back on springs.glide and flips into a check on springs.snap; pressing during the download cancels and pulls the arrow back up on springs.snap. Enter and Space press it, Escape cancels, the open tray is a progressbar, and each change is spoken once in a polite live region.

props.name: bytes
props.description: The file's size in bytes: the readout's total and the size stamped when the tray shuts.

props.name: fileName
props.description: The file's name, shown in the caption under the button at rest and spoken when the download starts.

props.name: kind
props.description: A short type tag before the size in the caption, such as "PDF".

props.name: formatBytes
props.description: Formats a byte count, as in "8.4 MB".

props.name: onDownload
props.description: Starts the download. A returned promise holds the tray open near the end until it settles; a rejection shows the error.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: A press or Escape during the download cancelled it.

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled state. Omit it and the press, the progress and the promise drive the tray.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Every change of state — the press, the finish, a cancel, the promise, a hold — with the rejection on error.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled progress from your own transfer, 0 to 1; reaching 1 finishes. Omit it to simulate from duration.

props.name: duration
props.description: How long the simulated download takes, in ms.

props.name: tray
props.description: The spring the tray slides out and shuts on: glide slides, snap clicks out with one overshoot, recoil bounces.

props.name: progress
props.description: How progress is drawn along the tray's lip: a line, a row of ticks, or a line with the bytes received.

props.name: size
props.description: Button 36, 40 or 48px tall over a 24, 28 or 32px well.

props.name: label
props.description: The idle label.

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: The label during the download, when a press cancels.

props.name: successLabel
props.description: The label once the file is in.

props.name: retryLabel
props.description: The label after a failure, when a press tries again.

props.name: savedLabel
props.description: The word stamped beside the size when the tray shuts.

props.name: errorLabel
props.description: What failed, shown under the button. A rejection's own message replaces it.

props.name: successHold
props.description: How long Downloaded holds before the button resets, in ms; 0 keeps it. Counts only while the page is visible.

props.name: errorHold
props.description: How long a failure holds before the button resets, in ms; 0 keeps it until retried.

props.name: accent
props.description: The arrow, the check and the progress on the lip.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play the arrow landing in the tray and the tray shutting — only for a download the visitor pressed.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Takes the button out of use.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer wrapper.

usageNotes: Keyboard: Enter or Space presses through the native click; during the download a second press or Escape cancels (Escape is handled with preventDefault). The caption is the button's description, and the open tray is a progressbar whose value moves in 5% steps.

Reduced motion: nothing falls, slides or flips — the arrow fades from its slot and appears in the tray, the tray fades in place over a caption that hides first, the lip still fills, and the check cross-fades in with the size.

Progress: pass value from your own transfer (0 to 1), or let it simulate over duration. If onDownload returns a promise, a simulated download waits near the end until the promise settles, so the tray never claims a finish the file has not reached.

The tray lives inside the component's own box — it slides out of a well under the button that holds the file's caption at rest — so it never overlaps the content around it and nothing shifts when it opens.
Pressing Downloaded downloads again; set successHold to have it return to Download on its own.

items.title: Bin Lid
items.tagline: Thrown away, with a window to fish it out.
items.description: A delete button whose bin lid lifts on its hinge on the snap spring when the pointer or keyboard focus arrives; pressing folds the label into a paper sheet that is lobbed into the bin on a true ballistic arc and tumbles out of sight behind its front wall, the lid falls shut on an accelerating tween, and the bin squashes and recovers on snap while dust puffs from both ends of the lid. The button's corners then glide into an undo pill and a ring round the bin drains linearly over the undo window; undo, by a press or Escape, flies the paper back out along the same arc and unfolds it into the label, and when the ring empties onDelete fires, with a spinning ring while its promise is pending and the paper thrown back out with a shake if it fails. It is a native button whose Enter and Space press through the native click, its width never changes, and a polite live region speaks each change once.

props.name: onDelete
props.description: Fires once the undo window runs out. Return a promise and the button shows the deletion pending until it settles, then Deleted or the error.

props.name: onUndo
props.description: The visitor fished it back out, with a press or Escape, before the window ran out.

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled state. Every move the button wants to make goes through onStateChange and waits for this; the choreography follows the shown state, so a host's change plays it too.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Each state the button moves to, from the press, the timer or the promise that caused it.

props.name: window
props.description: How long the undo window stays open, in ms: the time the ring takes to drain. It pauses while the page is hidden.

props.name: arc
props.description: How high the paper is lobbed into the bin and how much it tumbles, 0 to 1. The apex is kept inside the component's frame.

props.name: puff
props.description: How much dust the slammed lid pushes out of its ends, 0 to 1: count, reach and size. 0 slams clean.

props.name: label
props.description: The text at rest.

props.name: undoLabel
props.description: The text while the undo window is open.

props.name: pendingLabel
props.description: The text while onDelete is settling.

props.name: successLabel
props.description: The text once it is gone.

props.name: errorLabel
props.description: The text after onDelete failed; a press throws it away again.

props.name: itemName
props.description: What is being thrown away. Joins the accessible name ("Delete Q3 forecast draft") and the spoken sentences.

props.name: successHold
props.description: How long Deleted holds before the button is ready again, in ms.

props.name: errorHold
props.description: How long the error holds before the button rests again, in ms.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: The bin alone in a square button (a circle as the undo pill) that keeps its accessible name.

props.name: size
props.description: 32, 40 or 48 px tall; the bin, the paper and the dust scale with it.

props.name: accent
props.description: The destructive colour for the text, outline, bin and ring. Any CSS colour.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play the paper as it is thrown, the thud of the lid and the pop as it comes back out, only in answer to a press or key. No audio context exists unless this is on.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims and disables the button.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the root's classes (the button and the 12 px frame its lob and dust stay inside).

usageNotes: A native button named by its current label (with itemName at rest): Enter or Space presses it through the native click, a press during the undo window restores, Escape restores too (handled where focus is, with preventDefault), and presses are ignored while pending or after success. A polite live region speaks one sentence per change: moved to the bin with the window in seconds, restored, deleting, deleted, or not deleted.

Under reduced motion nothing flies, swings, squashes or puffs and the corners do not morph: the labels cross-fade, the ring still drains because the window is information, pending shows a still dashed ring, and an error changes the outline colour instead of shaking.

onDelete only runs when the window has run out, so an undo never needs a server round trip; return a promise to keep the button pending until the deletion is confirmed, and a rejection brings the item back with Retry.
Every label is stacked in one grid cell, so the button keeps the width of the longest through every state and nothing beside it moves.
The undo countdown and the success and error holds pause while the page is hidden, and nothing animates at rest.

items.title: Upload Orbit
items.tagline: The file circles until it lands.
items.description: An upload button over a real file input whose files orbit it while they go up: chosen or dropped files become dots that pop into a waiting line on the top edge on the snap spring, step out on the glide spring, and then sit round the button's perimeter at their progress, walked by arc length so one lap is the whole file, chasing each reported value on a critically damped spring while a softer spring drags a fading comet tail behind them. A finished dot completes its lap and hops into the count in the label, where the badge recoils on the recoil spring and the digit rolls on snap; a failed dot leaves along its tangent, falls and fades red while a red counter appears on the badge. Click, Enter or Space opens the system picker and files can be dropped anywhere on it; Escape cancels what is in flight, and after a batch with failures a press queues them again.

props.name: onUpload
props.type: (file: File, progress: (share: number) => void, signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<unknown>
props.description: Uploads one file: report progress from 0 to 1 as it goes and settle the promise when it is done or failed. Called for at most queue files at once; the signal aborts on Escape or unmount.

props.name: files
props.description: Controlled list of files ({ id, name, size?, progress, status: "queued" | "uploading" | "done" | "error", error? }). The button reports every list it wants through onFilesChange and draws this one.

props.name: onFilesChange
props.description: Every new list: files added, progress, completions, failures, retries.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: The files the visitor chose or dropped that passed accept and maxSize.

props.name: accept
props.description: What the picker offers and a drop accepts, as for a file input ("image/*,.pdf"). Refused files fall off at once and cannot be retried.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Take several files at a time; off, only the first of a drop is taken.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: The largest file accepted, in bytes. Larger ones fall off at once.

props.name: tail
props.description: How far each dot's comet tail trails it while it moves, 0 to 1, capped at 35% of the lap. 0 draws no tail.

props.name: speed
props.description: How quickly a dot runs to its reported progress, 0 to 1: a lazy glide that smooths a chunky connection, or a tight follow that dashes.

props.name: queue
props.description: How many files fly at once, 1 to 4; the rest wait in line as smaller dots.

props.name: label
props.description: The text at rest.

props.name: pendingLabel
props.description: The text while files are queued, in flight or landing.

props.name: successLabel
props.description: The text once a batch has landed.

props.name: errorLabel
props.description: The text after a batch with failures that can be retried; a press queues them again.

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled button state. Without it, the state follows the files: pending until the last finished dot has landed.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Each state the button moves to, from the change that caused it.

props.name: successHold
props.description: How long Uploaded holds before the button rests, in ms.

props.name: errorHold
props.description: How long Retry holds before the button rests, in ms.

props.name: size
props.description: 32, 40 or 48 px tall; the dots, their spacing and the orbit scale with it.

props.name: accent
props.description: The orbit's colour: dots, tails and the lit track. Any CSS colour.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a pop for the drop or pick and a rising plip as each dot takes its place, only in answer to the visitor. Landings and failures are silent.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the button and refuses picks and drops.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the root's classes (the button and the 12 px frame its orbit stays inside).

props.name: ref
props.description: An imperative handle: add(files) queues files as if dropped, open() opens the picker, cancel() stops everything in flight, retry() queues the failed files again.

usageNotes: The button is the keyboard path to the same end state as a drop: Enter or Space opens the native picker (the input itself is hidden and out of the tab order), Escape cancels everything queued or in flight while it is busy, and after a batch with failures a press retries them. The button is described by a sentence with the counts, aria-busy while pending.
A polite live region speaks per arrival, never per progress tick: files added, each file uploaded with its place in the batch, each failure with its reason, and cancellations.

Under reduced motion there is no glide, tail, hop or fall: queued dots sit at their slots, a flying dot jumps to each reported progress, a finished one fades into the badge (the count still moves) and a failed one turns red and fades in place.

Uncontrolled, onUpload runs the uploads with at most queue in flight and gets an AbortSignal for cancels and unmounts; controlled, pass files and onFilesChange and the button draws your list, starting any queued files you added on the next frame.
The count in the label moves only when a dot lands, and the button stays pending until the last finished dot has landed, so the words never run ahead of the picture.

items.title: Publish Press
items.tagline: A roller inks it live.
items.description: A publish button drawn as a sheet of paper, printed by a roller: a press sets an inked roller down at the start of the label, it bobs in place on a mirrored tween while the action is pending, and on success it rolls across the label on a symmetric move tween, inking the new word behind it through a clip that follows its track while the old label smears into a dragged, skewed band that dries away; the roller is a cylinder seen face on whose ribs turn at distance over radius, so a bigger drum turns slower. The ink is printed through a halftone screen whose dots grow with the ink load and starts wet and solid, drying back to its screen over the success hold; with a schedule set, a date stamp hovers while pending and slams down on the recoil spring instead, and pressing a published or scheduled button lifts the ink off in four strips on the exit ease in a cascade. It is a native button: Enter or Space presses it, Escape cancels while pending, and a failure leaves Retry.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The document's status, controlled or initial. A controlled press reports through onValueChange and prints once the host answers.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Each status the document moves to, once its action has succeeded.

props.name: onPublish
props.type: (at: Date | null, signal: AbortSignal) => void | Promise<unknown>
props.description: Publishes now (at is null) or schedules for at. Return a promise and the roller bobs until it settles; the signal aborts on Escape.

props.name: onUnpublish
props.description: Takes a published or scheduled document back to draft.

props.name: schedule
props.description: When set, a press schedules for this moment and stamps the date instead of rolling; the draft label becomes scheduleLabel.

props.name: formatDate
props.description: How the stamped date reads. The default prints "Oct 9 · 09:00" from UTC parts so server and browser agree; pass your own for the reader's zone.

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled action state. Every move goes through onStateChange and waits for this.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Each action state, from the press, the answer or the timer that caused it.

props.name: ink
props.description: How much ink the roller carries, 0 to 1: a pale, speckled halftone print or a dense, solid one.

props.name: roller
props.description: How big and heavy the roller is, 0 to 1: a quick small brayer or a slow wide drum whose ribs turn slower.

props.name: smudge
props.description: How much the old label smears as the roller drags over it, 0 to 1: the band's width, drag, skew and strength. 0 wipes clean.

props.name: label
props.description: The text on a draft.

props.name: scheduleLabel
props.description: The text on a draft when schedule is set.

props.name: pendingLabel
props.description: The text while publishing.

props.name: publishedLabel
props.description: The word the roller inks.

props.name: errorLabel
props.description: The text after an action failed; a press tries it again.

props.name: inkColor
props.description: The ink: the printed word, the stamp and the roller. Any CSS colour.

props.name: successHold
props.description: How long fresh ink stays wet before it dries and the button rests, in ms.

props.name: errorHold
props.description: How long the error holds before the button rests, in ms.

props.name: size
props.description: 32, 40 or 48 px tall; the roller and the strips scale with it.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play the thock of the roller setting down and the stamp landing, and the swish of the roll and the peel, only within the press's own beat. No audio context exists unless this is on.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims and disables the button.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the root's classes.

usageNotes: A native button named by what it shows (Publish, Publishing, Published, Scheduled for the date, Retry) and described by what a press will do: Enter or Space presses it, a press on a published or scheduled document unpublishes it, Escape cancels a pending action (handled where focus is, with preventDefault), and a polite live region speaks each change once.

Under reduced motion nothing rolls, bobs, drops, smears or peels: the roller stands still at the start of the label while pending, the ink and the stamp fade in dry, and they fade out as one when unpublished. Labels, value and timings are unchanged.

The label only changes once the action succeeds: pending keeps the old words with the roller waiting on them, and a refusal lifts the roller away and leaves Retry, so the button never claims something the server has not done.
Every face, the stamped date included, is stacked in one grid cell, so the button keeps one width through every state; everything it draws stays inside the button.
The bob runs only while pending and pauses on a hidden page, and the wet-ink and error holds pause there too; at rest nothing animates.

items.title: Refresh Wind
items.tagline: Wind it up, let it spin.
items.description: A refresh button you wind like a clock spring: drag around it, or press and hold, and the arrow turns back with the finger while its stroke coils into a tightening spiral and a ring of notches lights and ticks with the tension; let go and a per-frame integrator whips it forward from rest on the spring, then lets it coast on the stored energy against friction and air drag while the refresh runs, settling to a steady cruise if the work outlasts the energy and, once it has answered, decaying exactly onto the nearest upright. A plain press does one turn, and on success the Updated 2 min ago stamp rolls to just now on the snap spring while the notches flash and fade. It is a native button: Enter and Space refresh, Shift+Enter winds a full turn (again for another) and lets go, and Escape cancels a refresh in flight.

props.name: onRefresh
props.description: Runs the refresh. Return a promise and the arrow keeps turning until it settles; the signal aborts on Escape.

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled action state. Every move goes through onStateChange and waits for this.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Each action state, from the press, the answer or the timer that caused it.

props.name: updatedAt / defaultUpdatedAt
props.description: The time of the last successful refresh, controlled or initial. The stamp is written from it.

props.name: onUpdatedAtChange
props.description: The moment of each successful refresh: the now prop's value, or the clock when none is given.

props.name: now
props.description: The time the stamp is read against. Pass it for a relative stamp that renders on the server; without it the phrase arrives after mount and a shared 30-second clock keeps it current while the page is visible.

props.name: onWind
props.description: Fires when a wind is let go, with the turns of spring it stored.

props.name: friction
props.description: How quickly the released spin slows, 0 to 1: 0 coasts for seconds, 1 stops within a turn or two.

props.name: wind
props.description: Turns of spring the button holds: how far a full wind goes back, how tight the coil gets and how long the spin runs.

props.name: stamp
props.description: The stamp beside the button: Updated 2 min ago, Updated 09:40, or none (an icon-only button whose stamp is its accessible description).

props.name: formatStamp
props.description: Writes the stamp from the last refresh and the current time; pass one for the reader's own time zone or language.

props.name: label
props.description: The button's accessible name.

props.name: pendingLabel
props.description: The name and the stamp while refreshing.

props.name: errorLabel
props.description: The stamp after a failed refresh; a press retries.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: The stamp before the first refresh.

props.name: accent
props.description: The coil and the tension notches. Any CSS colour.

props.name: successHold
props.description: How long the success flash holds before the button rests, in ms.

props.name: errorHold
props.description: How long a failure holds before the button rests, in ms.

props.name: size
props.description: 32, 40 or 48 px across; the coil and the notch ring scale with it.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a tick for every notch the wind lights and the whir of the spin while it spends the spring's energy. No audio context exists unless this is on.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the button and lets go of any wind without firing it.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the root's classes.

usageNotes: A native button named by its label and described by the stamp and the gesture: Enter and Space refresh with one turn, Shift+Enter winds a full turn (press it again during the wind for another, up to wind) and lets go, and Escape cancels a refresh in flight (handled where focus is, with preventDefault). A polite live region speaks Refreshing, the new stamp, a failure or a cancel once each.

The wind is a real drag through the shared gesture kit: it follows the pointer's angle round the button 1:1, rubber-bands past empty and past full, and takes the pointer only after a few pixels, so a plain press is still a click. The button is touch-action none, since the wind is two-dimensional.

Under reduced motion nothing spins or whips: the coil and the notches still show the tension while winding, the arrow stays upright, a refresh in flight shows the notch ring steady at half strength, and the stamp swaps by cross-fade.

The spin is integrated per frame only while it moves and stops at rest; the whir only spends the energy the visitor wound in and fades as the spin falls to cruising speed. A host that sets state to pending on its own gets the cruise without a sound.

The stamp's width is the widest of its phrases stacked in one cell, so the row never shifts when it rolls to just now or to the error. Pass now for server rendering; the default clock is shared by every instance and pauses on a hidden page.

items.title: Gate Button
items.tagline: Locked until the form is ready.
items.description: A submit button that shows its own readiness: a padlock at its left wears a segmented arc, one segment per requirement, and each requirement the form meets is drawn along the arc on the flick spring. When the last is met the shackle pops open, lifting on the recoil spring and swinging about its long leg on snap, and the button warms as an accent bloom grows out of the padlock across the face on glide; pressed, the padlock gives way to three dots bouncing in a wave while the request runs, then the dots run together and a check draws on flick as the label rolls to Sent. Locked, it stays focusable: hover or keyboard focus lists what is missing, Enter or Space is refused with a rattle and the first missing item flagged, and Escape closes the list or cancels a send.

props.name: requirements
props.type: { id: string; label: string; met: boolean }[]
props.description: What the form needs before it can be sent; one arc segment each. With none, the button is ready.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Sends the form. Return a promise and the dots bounce until it settles; the signal aborts on Escape.

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled action state. Every move goes through onStateChange and waits for this.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Each action state, from the press, the answer or the timer that caused it.

props.name: onLockedPress
props.type: (missing: { id: string; label: string; met: boolean }[]) => void
props.description: A press while locked, with what is still missing: scroll to the first field, flag it.

props.name: segments
props.description: How the padlock wears the requirements: an arc open at the foot, a closed ring, or one pip each.

props.name: warm
props.description: How strongly the button warms once it is ready, 0 to 1: an accent outline at 0, a solid accent fill with light text at 1.

props.name: hint
props.description: What hovering or focusing the locked button shows: every requirement ticked or not, only the next one missing, or nothing (the description still names them).

props.name: hintTitle
props.description: The list's heading, also used in the spoken description.

props.name: hintSide
props.description: Which side of the button the hint opens on.

props.name: hintAlign
props.description: Which edge of the button the hint lines up with; end suits a form footer's right-hand button.

props.name: label
props.description: The button's text.

props.name: pendingLabel
props.description: The text while sending.

props.name: successLabel
props.description: The text once sent.

props.name: errorLabel
props.description: The text after a failed send; a press tries again.

props.name: accent
props.description: The met segments and the warm fill. Any CSS colour.

props.name: successHold
props.description: How long Sent holds before the button rests, in ms.

props.name: errorHold
props.description: How long the error holds before the button rests, in ms.

props.name: size
props.description: 32, 40 or 48 px tall; the padlock scales with it.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a click for each requirement the visitor meets, the shackle's snap, a dull click on a refused press and a chime when sent. Requirements met by the host alone are silent. No audio context exists unless this is on.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims and disables the button; no hint opens.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the root's classes.

usageNotes: Locked is aria-disabled, never disabled, so the button stays in the tab order, its hint opens on keyboard focus as well as hover, and its description says what is missing (Locked. Still needed: Team chosen, Data policy accepted.) whether or not the hint is shown.

A refused press rattles the padlock, keeps the hint open for a couple of seconds (for touch, which cannot hover), flags the first missing item and calls onLockedPress with the missing list, so the form can scroll to or highlight the field. A polite live region speaks progress, Ready to submit, Sending, Sent, a failure and a cancel once each.
Escape is handled where focus is, with preventDefault: it cancels a send in flight (the signal aborts) or closes an open hint.

Under reduced motion nothing lifts, swings, rattles or bounces: the shackle swaps open, the warm fill fades in, the segments fill quickly, the pending dots pulse in opacity and the check appears whole.

Every label is stacked in one cell, so the button keeps its width from Submit request to Sending, Sent and Retry; the bloom, dots and check are all drawn inside the button. The hint is an overlay anchored to the button by hintSide and hintAlign.

items.title: Rewind Undo
items.tagline: Spool back through what you did.
items.description: Undo and redo as a tape deck: the Undo button carries a reel holding the applied history, the Redo button a reel holding what has been rewound, and the tape between them reads out each step. A press rewinds one step as both reels turn the same way on a spring as heavy as the spool, each by the tape's length over its own radius so a nearly empty reel visibly spins faster, while the undone action's name is pulled out onto the tape on the snap spring and struck through on flick; holding scrubs back with steps that come faster and faster, the reels spinning up and the names flicking past, and Redo slides in on glide once there is something to redo. Both are native buttons in a named group: Enter or Space steps and, held, scrubs exactly as a held pointer does, Escape cancels a step the host is still applying, and optional shortcuts bind Cmd or Ctrl+Z and Shift+Cmd+Z or Ctrl+Y outside text fields.

props.name: history
props.description: Everything done so far, oldest first: the tape. Each label names its step on the tape and in the buttons' names.

props.name: index / defaultIndex
props.description: How many steps of history are applied, controlled or initial.

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Each new position, from the press, the hold or the shortcut that moved it.

props.name: onUndo
props.type: (step: { id: string; label: string }, signal: AbortSignal) => void | Promise<unknown>
props.description: Undoes one step. Return a promise and the step waits on it (the reels tug, the name is faint) and commits once it settles; the signal aborts on Escape.

props.name: onRedo
props.type: (step: { id: string; label: string }, signal: AbortSignal) => void | Promise<unknown>
props.description: Redoes one step, the same way.

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled action state. Every move goes through onStateChange and waits for this.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Each action state, from the press, the answer or the timer that caused it.

props.name: steps
props.description: Steps one turn of a half-full reel holds, 3 to 12; also the reel's spokes. Fewer means bigger turns per press.

props.name: spool
props.description: Reel weight, 0 to 1: a light reel snaps to each step, a heavy one carries past and settles back.

props.name: hold
props.description: How hard a held press speeds up the scrub, 0 to 1: 0 keeps a steady pace, 1 races to the end.

props.name: holdDelay
props.description: How long a press is held before it starts to scrub, in ms.

props.name: shortcuts
props.description: Bind Cmd or Ctrl+Z to undo and Shift+Cmd+Z or Ctrl+Y to redo, from anywhere on the page outside inputs, text areas and editable content.

props.name: undoLabel
props.description: The Undo button's word; its accessible name adds the step it would undo.

props.name: redoLabel
props.description: The Redo button's word; its accessible name adds the step it would redo.

props.name: readoutLabels
props.type: { undid?: string; redid?: string; last?: string; empty?: string; failed?: string }
props.defaultValue: { undid: "Undid", redid: "Redid", last: "Last", empty: "Nothing to undo", failed: "Failed" }
props.description: The words on the tape between the reels.

props.name: accent
props.description: The tape on the reels. Any CSS colour.

props.name: successHold
props.description: How long a step's name stays on the tape before it rests on the last step, in ms.

props.name: errorHold
props.description: How long a failure holds before it rests, in ms.

props.name: size
props.description: 32, 40 or 48 px tall; the reels scale with it.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a click per step pitched by its place in history, a dull click at either end, and the reels' whir while a hold scrubs. No audio context exists unless this is on.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims and disables both buttons and the shortcuts.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the group's classes.

usageNotes: A role=group named History holding two native buttons named Undo and Redo plus the step they would take (Undo Removed column). Enter or Space steps on key-down and, held, scrubs exactly as a held pointer does; a pointer steps on release, so a scroll that merely starts on the button never undoes. Undo at the start stays focusable as aria-disabled, and Redo, while there is nothing to redo, is inert and out of the tab order; if it leaves while focused, focus moves to Undo.

A polite live region speaks each committed step once (Undid Removed column.), a whole scrub once on release (Undid 5 steps. Last: Renamed sheet.), a step in progress, a failure and a cancel, never once per scrubbed step.
Under reduced motion the reels do not turn and Redo does not slide: the tape on each reel changes at once, names cross-fade, the strike appears whole, and a held press still scrubs at the same pace.

When the tape is too narrow for its longest line the buttons drop their words and keep their names, with hysteresis so the switch never flickers; the tape truncates a long name with a title. The deck keeps one width as Redo comes and goes, since its slot is part of the deck.

With shortcuts on, keystrokes in text fields are left alone so native text undo still works there; a host that keeps its own undo bindings should leave shortcuts off and drive index instead, and the reels and tape follow its changes the same way.

items.title: Plug In
items.tagline: Connected, with a spark.
items.description: A connect button with a plug on a cable: pressed, the plug lifts level and slides to the socket in the button's edge on the glide spring while its weighted cable first dips and then straightens, and while the connection is pending the plug works at the socket mouth in a seeded, uneven jiggle. When the integration answers, the plug seats on the snap spring with a clack, a seeded burst of sparks flies from the seam with a pop, the lamp lights and the label rolls to Connected; pressing again pulls the plug out on a tween and the cable recoils on the recoil spring's two bounces. The plug can be pushed in or pulled out by hand, following 1:1 and committing by where the throw would land, and the button is a native button in a group named for the integration: Enter and Space press it and Escape cancels a connection in flight.

props.name: connected / defaultConnected
props.description: Whether the integration is connected, controlled or initial. A controlled press reports through onConnectedChange and seats the plug once the host answers.

props.name: onConnectedChange
props.description: Each change, once its action has succeeded.

props.name: onConnect
props.description: Connects. Return a promise and the plug works at the socket until it settles; the signal aborts on Escape.

props.name: onDisconnect
props.description: Disconnects, the same way; the plug tugs at the socket while it waits.

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled action state. Every move goes through onStateChange and waits for this.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Each action state, from the press, the answer or the timer that caused it.

props.name: slack
props.description: Spare cable, 0 to 1: a nearly taut line, or a deep loop that dips and swings when the plug moves.

props.name: spark
props.description: The contact's burst, 0 to 1: how many sparks and how far they fly. 0 is a clean connection.

props.name: jiggle
props.description: How hard the plug works at the socket while it connects, 0 to 1.

props.name: name
props.description: What is being connected: the group's accessible name.

props.name: icon
props.description: The integration's mark on the tile the cable comes from, 16px.

props.name: label
props.description: The button's text while disconnected.

props.name: pendingLabel
props.description: The text while connecting.

props.name: connectedLabel
props.description: The text once connected.

props.name: disconnectLabel
props.description: What a connected button shows, in danger ink, on hover or keyboard focus: what a press will do.

props.name: errorLabel
props.description: The text after a failure; a press tries again.

props.name: accent
props.description: The live cable, the lamp and the connected face's tint. Any CSS colour.

props.name: successHold
props.description: How long the contact holds as success before the button rests, in ms.

props.name: errorHold
props.description: How long a failure holds before the button rests, in ms.

props.name: size
props.description: 32, 40 or 48 px tall; the tile, cable, plug and sparks scale with it.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play the clack of the plug seating and pulling out and the pop of the spark, only within a few seconds of the visitor's press or push. No audio context exists unless this is on.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims and disables the button and the plug handle.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the group's classes.

usageNotes: A role=group named by name holding a native button named by its visible label and, when connected, described as Press to disconnect. Enter and Space press it; Escape cancels a connect or disconnect in flight (handled where focus is, with preventDefault). A polite live region speaks Connecting, Connected, Disconnected, a failure and a cancel once each.

The plug handle is a decorative, aria-hidden drag through the shared gesture kit, touch-action pan-y so the page still scrolls: it follows the hand 1:1, rubber-bands at the rest and at the socket, and commits by projecting the release; a short or slow push springs back. The button reaches every state the hand can.

Under reduced motion nothing slides, jiggles or recoils: the plug swaps between its rest, socket-mouth and seated poses, the cable takes its sag at once, and the contact is a still flash that fades; the lamp, label and live region still carry the state.
