The label never claims Connected before the host has answered, and a pointer still resting on the button after it connects does not preview Disconnect until it leaves and comes back. Every label is stacked in one cell, so the control keeps one width; the cable, plug and sparks are drawn inside its own box.
The jiggle and the holds pause on a hidden page; at rest nothing animates.

items.title: Profile Lift
items.tagline: The portrait steps out of its frame.
items.description: A profile card whose portrait steps out of its frame: hovering it or moving keyboard focus into it lifts the portrait out of a recessed circular well on the snap spring, growing past the frame's edge while its shadow falls into the empty ring below and softens with the height, as the figures count up from zero and the follow pill docks on the frame's rim on snap; a mouse or pen tilts the card toward itself on glide, the lifted portrait shifting further than the card. Pressing the card grows it into a sheet with the bio, links and followers in common, one shared-layout surface on the glide spring with the portrait, name and figures travelling to their places, and Escape or the close button folds it back the same way. The card and the follow pill are real buttons that Enter and Space press, focus moves to the sheet's close button and back to the card, and under reduced motion nothing tilts or travels: the frame lights, the shadow and pill fade in place and the sheet cross-fades.

props.name: name
props.description: The person: the card's heading, the drawn portrait's seed and every accessible name.

props.name: handle
props.description: Shown in the open sheet above the bio.

props.name: role
props.description: The line under the name.

props.name: portrait
props.description: What fills the portrait disc, such as an img. Defaults to a head-and-shoulders portrait drawn from the name in the accent's hue.

props.name: bio
props.description: The open sheet's paragraph.

props.name: figures
props.description: The counted row ({ id, label, value }). The first figure is the followers count, which following adds one to.

props.name: links
props.description: The open sheet's links ({ id, label, detail?, href }).

props.name: mutuals
props.description: Followers in common: the named ones shown first, then the rest as a count.

props.name: following / defaultFollowing
props.description: Whether the viewer follows this person, controlled or initial.

props.name: onFollowingChange
props.description: Fires from the press that changed it, with the new state.

props.name: expanded / defaultExpanded
props.description: Whether the card is open as the full sheet, controlled or initial.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Fires from the press or the Escape that opened or closed the sheet.

props.name: followLabel
props.description: The follow button before following; also the start of its accessible name.

props.name: followingLabel
props.description: The follow button once following. The pill is always as wide as the longer label.

props.name: lift
props.description: How far the portrait steps out of its frame, 0 to 1: how high it rises, how much it grows and how deep its shadow falls.

props.name: tilt
props.description: How far the card turns toward the pointer, in degrees on each axis (up to 10); 0 holds it flat.

props.name: stats
props.description: What the figures do as the portrait lifts: count up from zero, stay still, or leave the card.

props.name: countDuration
props.description: How long the count-up runs, in ms.

props.name: formatFigure
props.description: How a figure is written. Defaults to compact en-US, "2.4K".

props.name: size
props.description: The portrait: 72, 88 or 104 px across, in a frame 20 to 28 px wider.

props.name: accent
props.description: The follow button's fill and the drawn portrait's hue, any CSS colour.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a swish as the visitor opens or closes the sheet and a pop as they follow or unfollow. Nothing sounds on hover.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Nothing lifts, tilts or opens, and the card is drawn at reduced strength.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card's outer box.

usageNotes: Keyboard: Tab reaches the card itself (Enter or Space opens the sheet) and then Follow; focus anywhere inside lifts the portrait exactly as a hover does. In the sheet focus starts on the close button, and Escape anywhere in the card closes it and returns focus to the card.

Reduced motion is a designed state: no tilt, rise or layout travel. The frame's ring lights, the shadow and the follow pill fade in place, the figures show their values without counting and the sheet cross-fades.
Pass figures without the viewer: the first figure is treated as the followers count and shows one more while following, rolling to it when the state changes.
The outer box carries 8 px of padding so the tilted card never draws outside it; the card itself is up to 320 px wide and the sheet grows to about 520 px tall at 316 wide.
Controlled `expanded` waits for the host: focus moves into the sheet only when it actually arrives, and back to the card only when the card does.

items.title: Pricing Plinth
items.tagline: The plan you pick rises to meet you.
items.description: A pricing table whose plans stand on plinths along a floor: choosing one lifts it on the glide spring while its plinth grows underneath, a spotlight pans across to it from above on the same spring and pools light on its head, the other plans step back, and the chosen plan's features check in one after another with each tick drawn on the flick spring. The Monthly/Yearly switch slides its thumb on snap and re-rolls every price on an odometer whose wheels each go round once more and settle on their new digits on glide, a beat apart, as a save tag swings in on its string on the recoil spring. Plans and billing are real radiogroups where the arrow keys move and choose and Home and End jump, a polite live region speaks the chosen plan and price once, and under reduced motion nothing rises, pans or spins while the light, ring and prices still change.

props.name: plans
props.description: The plans, left to right: { id, name, blurb?, monthly, yearly, features }, with monthly and yearly both as prices per month.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The chosen plan's id, controlled or initial; null chooses none and puts the light out.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the press or the key that chose a plan.

props.name: cycle / defaultCycle
props.description: The billing cycle, controlled or initial. Changing it re-rolls every price.

props.name: onCycleChange
props.description: Fires from the switch that changed it.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: The Continue button, with the chosen plan and cycle.

props.name: rise
props.description: How high the chosen plan rises on its plinth, in px (up to 28); a hovered plan rises 30% of it.

props.name: spotlight
props.description: How strong the light on the chosen plan is, 0 to 1: the cone, the pool on its head and the lit plinth. 0 puts the spotlight out.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay between the odometer's wheels as prices re-roll, in ms.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the plans' accessible name.

props.name: monthlyLabel
props.description: The switch's first option.

props.name: yearlyLabel
props.description: The switch's second option.

props.name: saveLabel
props.description: The tag that swings in for yearly billing, by default the best saving across the plans; an empty string hides it.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: The Continue button's text for a plan. The button is always as wide as the longest.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO 4217 code the prices are in.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale the prices are written in.

props.name: size
props.description: The prices' type scale.

props.name: accent
props.description: The light, the chosen ring, the tag and the ticks, any CSS colour.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a click on the switch, a chime as the saving swings in and a snap as a plan lands on its plinth.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Nothing can be chosen or switched, and the table is drawn at reduced strength.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the table's outer box.

usageNotes: Keyboard: Tab reaches the billing switch and then the chosen plan; in each group the arrow keys move and choose, Home and End jump, and Space or Enter chooses. Tab again reaches Continue.

Reduced motion keeps every piece of information and drops the travel: no rise, no step back, no pan and no spin. The light and the ring cross-fade to the chosen plan, the wheels land on their digits, the tag fades and the ticks appear by opacity.

Give yearly prices per month, as the page shows them; the yearly total is worked out for the note under the price and for the spoken sentence. The odometer handles digits being added or dropped (9 to 16) by growing or collapsing a wheel.

The layout follows the component's own width through a named container query: below 32rem the plans stand as three narrow columns and the chosen plan's features list under the floor; from 32rem each card carries its blurb and features.
The odometer is hidden from assistive technology; each plan's description carries its price and billing as a sentence, and a polite live region speaks the chosen plan and price once per change.

items.title: Place Card
items.tagline: The map finds the door as you look.
items.description: A venue card with a small drawn map: hovering the card or moving keyboard focus into it zooms the map toward the pin on the glide spring, closing in about a point by the door so the pin holds still while streets thin and blocks grow, then draws the walk from you to the door and sets its dashes marching while the pin hops once on the recoil spring; markers and the walk keep their size on screen at any zoom, and the march runs only while the card is looked at, on screen and visible. Under the map a clock dial around the closing time shows the opening hours, a dot at now and an arc to closing whose sweep glides when now moves, read from a now prop in the venue's time zone. Directions opens numbered steps on a measured height that glides open, focus moves to the first step, Up and Down choose a step and light its stretch of the walk with a marker that glides to its start, and Escape closes the list and returns focus to the button.

props.name: name
props.description: The venue: the card's heading and the map's accessible name.

props.name: kind
props.description: What kind of place it is, under the name.

props.name: address
props.description: Under the name, after the kind.

props.name: now
props.description: The moment the hours are read at. Without it the card keeps its own clock, read from the first frame after mount and paused while the page is hidden.

props.name: timeZone
props.description: The venue's IANA time zone, used to read now, so the server and the browser agree.

props.name: opensAt
props.description: Today's opening time, 24-hour HH:MM.

props.name: closesAt
props.description: Today's closing time, 24-hour HH:MM; earlier than opensAt means after midnight.

props.name: map
props.description: The neighbourhood: world size, streets, river, parks, blocks, the venue's building, and the walk's path from you (its first point) to the door (its last).

props.name: steps
props.description: The walk as numbered steps ({ id, text, meters, at }), each starting at a point of map.path.

props.name: expanded / defaultExpanded
props.description: Whether the directions are open, controlled or initial.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Fires from the press or the Escape that opened or closed the directions.

props.name: onStepSelect
props.description: A step was chosen from the list, by press or arrow key.

props.name: zoom
props.description: How far looking at the card zooms the map toward the pin, 1 to 3.

props.name: route
props.description: How the walk is drawn: dashes that march to the door, footstep dots that march, or a still line.

props.name: hours
props.description: The clock the hours are read on: the dial's 12 or 24 hours and every time on the card.

props.name: drawDuration
props.description: How long the walk takes to draw from you to the door, in ms.

props.name: walkSpeed
props.description: Walking pace that turns the steps' metres into minutes, in metres a minute.

props.name: directionsLabel
props.description: The directions button's text while closed.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: The same button's text while the steps are open; the button is always as wide as the longer label.

props.name: size
props.description: The map's height: 136, 168 or 200 px.

props.name: accent
props.description: The walk, the you marker and the hours arc, any CSS colour.

props.name: pinColor
props.description: The pin's pigment, any CSS colour; drawn at a fixed lightness so it reads the same in both themes.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a swish as the visitor opens or closes the directions and a plip, rising with the step number, as they choose a step.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Nothing zooms or opens, and the card is drawn at reduced strength.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card.

usageNotes: Keyboard: Tab reaches Directions, and focus there zooms the map and draws the walk just as a hover does. Enter or Space opens the steps with focus on the first; Up, Down, Home and End choose a step; Escape anywhere in the card closes them and returns focus to the button.

Reduced motion keeps the information and drops the travel: the map does not zoom, the walk fades in whole and never marches, the pin does not hop, the hours arc and the step marker land without sweeping, and the steps open without sliding.

Pass now with the venue's timeZone for server rendering: both are read through Intl, so the server and the browser draw the same dial. Without now the card renders its hours alone and starts its own minute clock after mount.
The march costs nothing when no one is looking: it runs only while the card is hovered, focused or open, on screen (IntersectionObserver) and while the page is visible.

Bring your own neighbourhood through map: draw it in any world size, and keep the walk within the middle of the world, since the frame crops the world to its own aspect and zooms about a point between the door and the middle of the walk.

items.title: Track Card
items.tagline: Hover to see the shape of it.
items.description: A music track card whose waveform is its bottom edge: a dotted baseline at rest that stands up bar by bar on hover, keyboard focus or play, rippling out from where the pointer came in with every bar on its own springs.snap step response, while moving along the card scrubs a ghost playhead that lights the bars up to the pointer and a press or drag on the lane seeks with the playhead gliding on springs.glide. Play slides the record half out of its sleeve on glide and spins it up like a turntable under a sheen that does not turn; Like and Queue throw a copy of the cover on a parabola into the Up next badge, which recoils on springs.recoil and rolls its count on snap when it lands and opens a real disclosure panel on snap. The lane is a slider (arrows five seconds, Page keys thirty, Home and End), Play, Like and Queue are buttons, and Escape closes the panel and hands focus back to the badge.

props.name: track
props.type: { id: string; title: string; artist: string; duration: number; release?: string }
props.description: The track; its title is the card's heading and duration (seconds) sets the lane's length.

props.name: art
props.description: Cover art drawn inside the sleeve, such as an . Defaults to procedural art seeded from the track.

props.name: upNext
props.type: { id: string; title: string; artist: string; duration: number }[]
props.description: The tracks already lined up after this one, listed in the Up next panel and counted on the badge.

props.name: playing / defaultPlaying
props.description: Playback. Playing slides the record out and spins it; uncontrolled, the playhead advances by itself.

props.name: onPlayingChange
props.description: Fires from the press that changed it, or when the track reaches its end.

props.name: position / defaultPosition
props.description: The playhead in seconds. Controlled, the playhead follows the host and glides on a real seek.

props.name: onPositionChange
props.description: Fires on every seek (press, drag, arrow keys), on pause and at the end.

props.name: liked / defaultLiked
props.description: The heart.

props.name: onLikedChange
props.description: Fires from the press that changed it.

props.name: queued / defaultQueued
props.description: This track is lined up in Up next.

props.name: onQueuedChange
props.description: Fires from Queue, from a like that lines the track up, or from Remove in the panel.

props.name: likeQueues
props.description: Liking a track that is not lined up yet also adds it to Up next, thrown into the badge.

props.name: bars
props.description: How many bars the waveform is drawn with: coarse blocks or a dense comb (under 4 px a bar, the gaps close).

props.name: spin
props.description: How fast the record turns while playing, in rpm; 0 holds it still.

props.name: peek
props.description: How far the record slides out of its sleeve while playing, as a share of the record (0.1 to 0.7).

props.name: reveal
props.description: When the waveform stands up: on hover, focus, play and scrub, or always.

props.name: size
props.description: Sleeve 64 / 72 / 80 px on a narrow card, 96 / 112 / 128 px on a wide one.

props.name: accent
props.description: Colour of the played bars, the playhead and the cover art, as any CSS colour.

props.name: sound
props.description: Ticks for presses and scrub detents, and a blup when a thrown track lands in the badge.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Nothing plays, seeks, reveals or queues.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card.

usageNotes: Keyboard: Tab reaches the Up next badge, Play, Like, Queue and the lane; the lane is a slider (ArrowRight or ArrowUp +5 s, ArrowLeft or ArrowDown -5 s, PageUp and PageDown 30 s, Home, End). Keyboard focus anywhere in the card raises the waveform and lets the record peek out, exactly as hover does.

The badge opens the Up next panel as a disclosure: focus moves into it when it arrives, Escape (caught wherever focus is in the card), the close button, the badge or a press outside close it, and focus returns to the badge.
Reduced motion: no ripple, slide, spin, throw or recoil. The full waveform cross-fades in over its stubs, the record swaps out in place, and the playhead, the lit bars and the count still change.

For real playback, control position from your audio element's timeupdate and playing from its play and pause events; the record and the lane follow. Uncontrolled, the card simulates playback, paused while it is off screen or the page is hidden.
The card lays itself out by its own width: a compact layout under 36rem with an icon-only Play, and a wide one with a 112 px sleeve from 36rem.
Sound plays only when sound is true and only answers a press, a drag or a key; playback itself is silent.

items.title: Role Card
items.tagline: The salary band draws itself.
items.description: A job listing card whose salary band draws itself against the market range on springs.glide when you hover or focus it, the end labels counting as they travel, while the location, remote and employment chips straighten from a loose scatter on springs.snap with a cascade and the company badge flips in real perspective to show the team's size. The top-right corner is paper: pressing it, or dragging it down and left 1:1 and letting go, folds it over along the diagonal in 3D on snap, cutting the card along the crease and showing its shaded back, and unfolding glides it open. Apply morphs into a two-field form inside the card through a shared layout on glide, and a sent application morphs back into Applied as a stamp lands beside it on springs.recoil; the form is a real disclosure that takes focus on arrival and gives it back on Cancel or Escape.

props.name: listing
props.description: The role: title, company, team, team size, location, remote, employment, salary band, market range, summary, posted and applicants.

props.name: saved / defaultSaved
props.description: The corner is folded down and the role saved.

props.name: onSavedChange
props.description: Fires from the press or the drag that folded or unfolded the corner.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: The application form is showing.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires from Apply, Cancel, Escape and a sent application.

props.name: applied / defaultApplied
props.description: An application has been sent and the card is stamped.

props.name: onAppliedChange
props.description: Fires when a submission succeeds.

props.name: onApply
props.type: (application: { email: string; link: string }) => void | Promise<unknown>
props.description: Sends the application. A returned promise shows Sending with the button's width held; a rejection keeps the form open with an error.

props.name: band
props.description: How the salary band draws: sweeping up from its low end, spreading from its midpoint, or closing in from the scale's edges.

props.name: crease
props.description: The folding corner's size in px: a small dog-ear or a big fold.

props.name: expand
props.description: Where the form opens: growing the card in place (its height glides), or as a sheet over its lower half.

props.name: reveal
props.description: When the band draws, the chips settle and the badge flips: on hover, keyboard focus or a tap, or always.

props.name: formatMoney
props.description: How an amount is written, in the labels, the band and its spoken sentence.

props.name: applyLabel
props.description: The Apply button's text.

props.name: appliedLabel
props.description: The text once applied, on the button and the stamp.

props.name: size
props.description: Badge (36 / 40 / 48 px) and title size; sm also tightens the padding.

props.name: accent
props.description: The offered band, the Apply fill and the warm chip icons, as any CSS colour.

props.name: sound
props.description: Paper for the fold and the form, a click for Send and for the stamp landing.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No reveal, no fold, no applying.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card.

usageNotes: Keyboard: Tab reaches Apply, then the corner; keyboard focus anywhere in the card draws the band, settles the chips and flips the badge. The corner is an aria-pressed button, so Space or Enter folds and unfolds it through the same path as a press.

Apply is a disclosure: the form takes focus on its email field when it arrives, Cancel and Escape (caught wherever focus is in the card) close it and return focus to Apply, and after a sent application focus lands on Applied.

Return a promise from onApply to show Sending; reject it to keep the form open with a 'Not sent' line, and the next Send tries again. An invalid email is flagged with aria-invalid and a message without calling onApply.
Reduced motion: nothing folds, flips, tilts, travels or bounces. The dog-ear swaps in, the badge faces cross-fade, the band fades in whole and the stamp fades in, so every state still shows.
On touch screens a tap on the card reveals the band, and the corner can be dragged down and left to fold it (touch-action is none on the corner only).

items.title: Lesson Card
items.tagline: Progress you can see filling.
items.description: A course card made as a small deck: the front card's ring fills to the share of the course done on springs.glide the first time it comes into view, its percentage counting with it, and the streak days dot along its bottom edge, while the next lesson's card sits behind as a sliver and rises out on glide on hover or keyboard focus. Continue flips through: the front card tips back about its bottom edge on an accelerating exit tween, the next comes forward on springs.snap, the one behind moves up a place on glide, and then the ring fills to its new share and today's dot pops in on springs.recoil. The peeking card's strip is a real disclosure button that pins it up, Escape lowers it, Continue's name says where it goes, and focus follows the new front card.

props.name: course
props.description: The course: the card's heading.

props.name: provider
props.description: Who runs it, shown beside Continue.

props.name: lessons
props.type: { id: string; title: string; minutes: number }[]
props.description: The course's lessons, in order.

props.name: lesson / defaultLesson
props.description: Index of the current lesson; lessons.length means the course is complete. The ring shows lesson / lessons.length.

props.name: onLessonChange
props.description: Fires from Continue (the next index) and Start again (0).

props.name: onContinue
props.type: (lesson: { id: string; title: string; minutes: number }) => void
props.description: Fires from Continue with the lesson just finished.

props.name: activity
props.description: Days of activity, oldest first; the last is today. Continue marks today done.

props.name: ring
props.description: The ring: one thin arc, one thick arc, or one segment per lesson filling in turn.

props.name: peek
props.description: How far the next lesson's card rises from behind on hover, 0 to 1.

props.name: streak
props.description: How many days dot along the bottom edge; 0 hides the streak.

props.name: continueLabel
props.description: The Continue button's text.

props.name: finishLabel
props.description: Continue's text on the last lesson.

props.name: restartLabel
props.description: The button on the complete card.

props.name: nextLabel
props.description: Words on the card that peeks from behind.

props.name: size
props.description: Ring 48 / 60 / 72 px.

props.name: accent
props.description: The ring, the active days and Continue, as any CSS colour.

props.name: sound
props.description: A swish for the flip-through and a plip, pitched by the share, when the ring lands.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Nothing continues or peeks.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card.

usageNotes: Keyboard: Tab reaches Continue, then the peeking card's strip; keyboard focus in the card raises the next card. Enter on the strip pins it up and Escape (caught wherever focus is in the card) lowers it. After Continue, focus moves to the new front card's button before the old card leaves.

Only the front card is in the tab and reading order: the cards behind, and the one flipping away, are inert and hidden from assistive technology. The ring is a progressbar whose value is lessons done, and a polite live region speaks one sentence per lesson.
Reduced motion: the deck re-stacks in place and the new card cross-fades in with no tip, rise or bounce; the ring still fills, on a short tween, and the percentage and streak still update.
The ring fills the first time the card enters the viewport, so a card further down a page fills when it is reached rather than off screen.
Control lesson to drive the card from your progress store; a host that moves it plays the same flip-through, and Start again calls onLessonChange(0).

items.title: Team Fan
items.tagline: Hover the stack, meet the team.
items.description: A team card whose overlapping faces fan into a readable row on hover or keyboard focus: each face springs to its slot on springs.snap a cascade beat after the last, its first name rolls up beneath it and its presence dot pops in on flick, the "+12" bubble flips about its axis to the full count and an invite button springs out to the end; leaving gathers them back in reverse on glide. Pressing a face lifts it on snap while the rest recede on glide, and opens a details disclosure whose measured height glides open with role, presence, local time and Message. The row is a toolbar with a roving tabindex: arrows move, Home and End jump, Enter focuses a person and moves focus into the details, Escape hands it back.

props.name: members
props.description: Everyone on the team (id, name, role, presence, utcOffset, image); the first max are the faces in the stack.

props.name: total
props.description: The team's size when members is only a page of it; the count bubble reads it.

props.name: max
props.description: Faces in the stack before the count bubble; four under 26rem of container width.

props.name: title
props.description: The card's heading, and the toolbar's name.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: The line under the heading.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The heading's level.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The focused member's id, controlled or initial; null when nobody is focused.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the press that focused a face or let it go.

props.name: onInvite
props.description: The invite button at the end of the fan.

props.name: onShowAll
props.description: The count bubble: show everyone.

props.name: onMessage
props.description: Message, in a focused person's details.

props.name: inviteLabel
props.description: The invite button's label, under it in the fan.

props.name: countLabel
props.description: The word under the flipped count.

props.name: spread
props.description: How much air the fan puts between faces, 0 to 1; always clamped to the card's width.

props.name: cascade
props.description: The beat between one face landing and the next, in ms.

props.name: focus
props.description: How far the rest of the team recedes behind a focused face, 0 to 1: opacity, scale and colour.

props.name: size
props.description: Faces 28, 36 or 44 px across.

props.name: now
props.description: The clock each person's local time is read from.

props.name: accent
props.description: The focused face's ring and the invite tint; any CSS colour.

props.name: sound
props.description: A swish as a key or a tap opens the fan (hover opens it silently), a pop as a face is focused.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Keeps the stack closed and its buttons inert.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the article.

usageNotes: Keyboard: Tab into the row opens the fan like hover; Left and Right move between faces, the count and Invite, Home and End jump, Enter or Space focuses a person and moves focus into the details, and Escape or Close returns it to their face.
On touch the first tap on the stack opens the fan and the next tap on a face focuses that person; a tap outside the card gathers it.
Which faces a width shows is decided by a container query, so the server's stack and the client's agree; the fan's slots are then measured from the row, so it never leaves the card.
Reduced motion: faces jump to their slots while the row cross-fades, the count bubble cross-fades instead of flipping, and the rest of the team recedes by opacity alone.
Pass now from your own clock so each person's local time stays current; the component never reads the time itself.

items.title: Swatch Card
items.tagline: Every colour re-dyes the product.
items.description: A product card whose drawn tote takes the colour you choose: a swatch floods the bag with the new dye from where that swatch sits, a liquid front whose edge sloshes mid-flood on a tween, while one ring slides to the swatch on springs.snap and the swatch dips and lands on recoil. The price rolls its digit columns on snap, sizes a colour does not come in shrink to struck chips as the rest glide wider, the drawing grows to the chosen size about its base on glide, and Add to bag morphs into a quantity stepper whose buttons slide in from the middle on snap. Colours and sizes are radio groups with a roving tabindex, and focus follows the morph to the stepper and back.

props.name: swatches
props.description: The colours on offer: id, label, CSS colour, price, and the size ids each comes in.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The chosen colour id, controlled or initial.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the swatch press or arrow key that chose a colour.

props.name: sizes
props.description: The sizes on offer, smallest first: id, label, note, the drawing's scale, and a price difference.

props.name: selectedSize / defaultSelectedSize
props.description: The chosen size id, controlled or initial.

props.name: onSelectedSizeChange
props.description: Fires from the size press, or from a colour press that does not come in the chosen size.

props.name: quantity / defaultQuantity
props.description: How many are in the bag; 0 shows Add to bag.

props.name: onQuantityChange
props.description: Fires from Add to bag, the stepper, or remove, with the new quantity.

props.name: maxQuantity
props.description: The most the stepper allows.

props.name: brand
props.description: The maker, above the name.

props.name: name
props.description: The product's name: the card's heading.

props.name: detail
props.description: A line under the name.

props.name: format
props.description: How a price is printed.

props.name: wipe
props.description: How liquid the dye front is, 0 to 1: a clean circle, or an edge that sloshes as it floods.

props.name: wipeDuration
props.description: How long the dye takes to flood the product, in ms.

props.name: shade
props.description: How much the drawing is modelled, 0 to 1: flat colour, or deep folds and highlights.

props.name: stepper
props.description: Adding morphs into a quantity stepper; off, it becomes an In bag toggle.

props.name: addLabel
props.description: The add button's text.

props.name: inBagLabel
props.description: After the quantity in the stepper, and the toggle's pressed text.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The heading's level.

props.name: sound
props.description: A plip for each colour pitched by its place in the row, a pop for each change to the bag.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Locks every choice and dims the card.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the article.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the colours and the sizes are radio groups; arrow keys move and choose, Home and End jump, and sizes a colour does not come in are skipped. Enter on Add to bag moves focus to the stepper's +, and removing the last one hands it back to Add to bag.
Pass each swatch's sizes to say what it comes in; a colour that drops the chosen size moves to the nearest one and reports it through onSelectedSizeChange from the same press.
Colours are any CSS colour; the defaults are pigments taken from the theme's tokens at a fixed lightness, so a product looks the same in light and dark.
Reduced motion: the new dye fades over the old instead of flooding, the price swaps in place, sizes and the drawing change size at once, and the stepper cross-fades without sliding.
A polite live region says the colour and its price after a colour change, and Added to bag, 2 in bag or Removed from bag after a change to the quantity.

items.title: Review Card
items.tagline: The stars fill as the words come in.
items.description: A product review that arrives as you read it: the first time it comes into view, the visible lines ink in one at a time under a soft left-to-right edge while the stars fill on the same linear clock, a liquid clipped by the star shapes whose front ripples as it travels and sloshes back on springs.recoil when it lands. A long review folds under a fade and Read more unrolls it to its measured height on the spring you choose (snap, glide or drift), ticking per line; Helpful tallies roll on snap and bump on recoil, and the photos fan out of their seeded deck on snap. Read more is a disclosure that moves focus into the text, Escape rolls it back up and returns focus, and votes are aria-pressed toggles.

props.name: rating
props.description: The reviewer's rating, 0 to 5; a fraction fills part of a star.

props.name: title
props.defaultValue: "Carries a whole day, rain and all"
props.description: The review's title: the card's heading.

props.name: body
props.description: The review; a blank line starts a new paragraph.

props.name: author
props.description: Who wrote it.

props.name: authorDetail
props.description: After the author.

props.name: date
props.description: When it was written.

props.name: timeZone
props.description: The zone dates print in, so the server and the browser print the same day.

props.name: formatDate
props.description: How the date is printed.

props.name: product
props.description: What was bought, above the vote.

props.name: photos
props.description: The reviewer's photos: id, alt, and a seed for the procedural scene or an image node.

props.name: onPhotoOpen
props.description: A thumbnail was pressed.

props.name: helpful
props.description: People who found it helpful, not counting this visitor.

props.name: unhelpful
props.description: People who did not, not counting this visitor.

props.name: vote / defaultVote
props.description: This visitor's vote, controlled or initial.

props.name: onVoteChange
props.description: Fires from the vote press, with the new vote or null when undone.

props.name: expanded / defaultExpanded
props.description: Whether the long review is unrolled, controlled or initial.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Fires from Read more, Show less or Escape.

props.name: lines
props.description: Lines shown while the review is folded.

props.name: pace
props.description: How long each line takes to ink in on view, in ms; the stars take the same time in all.

props.name: fill
props.description: How liquid the stars' fill is, 0 to 1: a straight sweep, or a front that ripples and sloshes.

props.name: unroll
props.description: The spring that unrolls and rolls up the fold.

props.name: fan
props.description: How far the photos fan out on hover, 0 to 1.

props.name: starColor
props.description: The stars' liquid; any CSS colour, with the outline mixed from it.

props.name: revealOnView
props.description: Ink the review in the first time it comes into view; off, it starts shown.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The heading's level.

props.name: sound
props.description: A tick per line as the visitor unrolls the review, a pop for a vote.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Locks the fold, the votes and the photos.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the article.

usageNotes: Keyboard: Read more is a button with aria-expanded; opening moves focus into the review text, and Escape there or on the button rolls it back up and returns focus to the button. Tabbing into the photos fans them; votes are toggle buttons.
The text is always in the DOM in full; the ink-in is a mask, so assistive technology reads the whole review from the start.
Lines are measured from the text itself and re-measured on resize, so the fold always shows exactly lines lines and the sweep never lands between them.
Reduced motion: the text and the stars fade in together on view, the fold opens to its height at once, vote counts swap without a bump, and the photos spread without turning.
Pass revealOnView={false} for lists where many reviews arrive at once, or remount with a new key to play the reveal again.

items.title: Meeting Card
items.tagline: Join when the room lights up.
items.description: An upcoming-meeting card that counts down from now: a ring around the start time drains over the last few minutes on a tween per tick, and at the start swells and settles on springs.recoil, sends one ring out and turns into the meeting's elapsed share in the live colour. Attendees light up as each one's join time passes, filling with colour and landing on recoil with a ring going out, and once live the Join button breathes a halo, only while the card is on screen. The agenda is a sheet tucked under the card: dragging its lip pulls it out 1:1 with rubber-banding and a release commits by projection on springs.snap, to open, closed or, row by row, to each detent. The lip is a disclosure button: Enter or Space toggles and moves focus into the agenda, arrow keys pull it out and push it back, Escape closes.

props.name: title
props.description: The meeting's name: the card's heading.

props.name: place
props.description: Where it happens, after the times.

props.name: start
props.description: When it starts.

props.name: end
props.description: When it ends.

props.name: now
props.description: The clock; update it (every second, say) for a live countdown. The card never reads the time itself.

props.name: timeZone
props.description: The zone times print in, so the server and the browser print the same.

props.name: attendees
props.description: Who is invited (id, name, joinedAt, image); each lights up once now passes their joinedAt.

props.name: agendaItems
props.description: The agenda under the card (id, title, minutes, owner); times count from the start.

props.name: joined / defaultJoined
props.description: Whether the viewer has joined, controlled or initial.

props.name: onJoinedChange
props.description: Fires from the Join press, with true for joined.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the agenda is pulled out, controlled or initial.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires from the drag, press or key that pulled the agenda out or pushed it back.

props.name: ring
props.description: The countdown window the ring spans before the start, in minutes.

props.name: glow
props.description: How strongly the Join button breathes once the meeting is live, 0 to 1.

props.name: agenda
props.description: How the agenda comes out: in one pull, or a row at a time with a detent at each.

props.name: agendaRows
props.description: Agenda rows shown before the sheet scrolls inside.

props.name: joinLabel
props.description: The Join button's text.

props.name: joinedLabel
props.description: Its text once joined; the button keeps the widest label's width.

props.name: endedLabel
props.description: Its text after the end, when it is disabled.

props.name: youLabel
props.description: The viewer's own face, waiting at the end of the row and lit when joined.

props.name: accent
props.description: The countdown ring and the Join halo; any CSS colour.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The heading's level.

props.name: sound
props.description: A chime as the viewer joins, a tick at each agenda detent the viewer pulls past. Nothing sounds on its own.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Locks Join and the agenda and dims the card.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the article.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the agenda lip is a button with aria-expanded; Enter or Space toggles it and moves focus into the agenda, ArrowDown and ArrowUp pull it out and push it back (a row at a time with agenda="rows"), Home and End close and open, and Escape closes from the lip or from inside the agenda.
Pass now from your own clock and update it; the ring eases to each new value, so ticking every second reads as a clock and ticking faster as a continuous drain.
Join breathes only while the meeting is live, the card is on screen and the page is visible, and stops once the viewer joins.
Reduced motion: the ring steps with no swell, faces light by colour alone, Join shows a steady halo, and the agenda goes straight to its detent; a drag still follows the finger.
A polite live region says when someone joins and when the meeting goes live, once per change, never per tick.

items.title: Pane Stack
items.tagline: Go deeper; the way back stays in view.
items.description: Nested navigation that keeps the way back in view: opening a row slides its pane in from the right on springs.glide, and the pane it covers is pushed and compresses into a narrow labelled tab along the left edge, its content clipped rather than squashed while the tab face takes over. One motion value is the stack's position, so every pane edge, the staircase of covered tabs and the fold of tabs that no longer fit (with a count) are functions of it; a tab, Escape or a 1:1 swipe of the open pane to the right goes back, the throw projected and carried on glide with its release velocity. Rows are a list with one tab stop (arrows move, Enter, Space or ArrowRight open, ArrowLeft goes back), the tabs are a nav with their own stop, and focus moves into each new pane and back onto the row you came from.

props.name: root
props.description: The tree to navigate: each node has an id, title, optional description, meta, icon, content and children. defaultPaneTree is a Fieldline workspace seven levels deep.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The open pane's id, controlled or initial.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the press, key or swipe that asked to open a pane, with its id and the ids from the root to it.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: A row with nothing inside it (no children, no content) was chosen.

props.name: label
props.description: The container's accessible name.

props.name: depth
props.description: How far covered panes recede, 0 to 1: tabs step in from top and bottom, shade toward the page and take the open pane's shadow. 0 is flat.

props.name: compress
props.description: Width of a covered pane's tab in px (28 to 64); from 36 up the tab shows its level's icon.

props.name: speed
props.description: Tempo of every slide, 0.5 to 1.5: the glide spring sped up or slowed down with its damping ratio kept.

props.name: minPaneWidth
props.description: The narrowest the open pane gets, in px; past it the oldest tabs fold under the first, which carries a count.

props.name: swipeBack
props.description: Drag the open pane to the right to go back a level.

props.name: backLabel
props.description: A tab's accessible name, from its pane's title.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: What a pane with no content and no children says.

props.name: height
props.description: The container's height, in px or any CSS length.

props.name: size
props.description: Row height 36, 44 or 52 px; small rows drop the description line.

props.name: accent
props.description: The trail back (the row you came from), the chosen row and the fold badge; any CSS colour.

props.name: sound
props.description: A swish for each push and pop, a click for a tab, a chosen row and the swipe's half-way detent.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Inert and dimmed: no presses, keys or swipes.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the container.

usageNotes: Keyboard: rows are one tab stop (Up, Down, Home, End move; Enter, Space or ArrowRight open; ArrowLeft or Backspace go back); the tabs are a nav with their own stop (arrows walk them, Enter goes back to that level, ArrowRight past the last returns to the pane). Escape goes back a level and is left alone at the root, so a dialog around the stack can still close on it.
Focus moves into each new pane as it arrives (its first row, else its heading) and back onto the row that led down when you return, but only when focus was already inside the stack.
Rows open when their node has children or content; a node with neither is a leaf, and choosing it fires onSelect and marks it with aria-current.
Controlled: pass value and onValueChange; a host that refuses the change keeps the stack where it is, and a host jump to a far branch slides in from the shared ancestor.
Reduced motion jumps the stack and fades the arriving pane in; the swipe still follows the finger and drops to its result.
Widths are CSS on the container's own width, so server markup is exact; the fold of extra tabs waits for the first measurement.

items.title: Float Panel
items.tagline: An inspector that docks where you leave it.
items.description: A floating inspector over a workspace: dragged by its title bar it follows 1:1, a magnet pulls it flush to an edge on springs.flick, pushed into a side it docks full height on springs.snap with the throw's velocity while the workspace glides aside, and carried into a corner it collapses into a pill that grows back into the panel when pressed. Its edges resize it 1:1 and a release springs to the nearest preset width on snap; with storageKey each key remembers its own place. The title bar is a button whose arrows nudge, Alt with an arrow docks, floats or collapses, Enter docks or floats and Escape collapses; the edge is a separator with arrow, Home and End keys.

props.name: title
props.description: The title bar's text, the pill's label and the panel's accessible name.

props.name: icon
props.description: 16px, drawn in currentColor, in the title bar and on the pill.

props.name: children
props.description: The inspector's body; it scrolls when it is taller than the room.

props.name: workspace
props.description: What the panel floats over; a docked panel takes room from it.

props.name: placement / defaultPlacement
props.description: Floating at shares of the free room ({ mode: "float", x, y, width }), docked to a side ({ mode: "dock", side, width }) or collapsed to a corner ({ mode: "pill", corner }); controlled or initial.

props.name: onPlacementChange
props.description: Fires from the drag, key or button that moved, docked, collapsed or resized it.

props.name: storageKey
props.description: Remember the placement under this key in local storage; each key keeps its own place, read the same way on the server and in the browser.

props.name: magnet
props.description: How close an edge has to come, in px, before the panel snaps flush to it; 0 turns the magnet off.

props.name: collapse
props.description: How close to a corner, in px, a drag has to come to collapse the panel into a pill there; 0 never collapses by drag.

props.name: widths
props.description: Preset widths a resize springs to: a count spread evenly between minWidth and maxWidth (0 resizes freely), or the widths in px.

props.name: minWidth
props.description: Narrowest the panel can be, in px.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Widest the panel can be, in px; the container caps it too.

props.name: nudge
props.description: How far one arrow key moves the panel, in px; Shift moves four times as far.

props.name: reserve
props.description: A docked panel takes its room from the workspace instead of covering it, while at least 240 px of workspace remain.

props.name: badge
props.description: Shown on the pill after the title: a count, a dot.

props.name: height
props.description: The container's height, in px or any CSS length.

props.name: label
props.description: The workspace region's accessible name.

props.name: accent
props.description: The dock and pill ghosts, the preset guides, the grip and the width readout; any CSS colour.

props.name: sound
props.description: A snap when the magnet catches and when a width lands on a preset, a thock when it docks, collapses, expands or a pill lands.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Inert and dimmed: no drags, keys or buttons.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the container.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the title bar is a button. Arrows nudge it with the same magnet (an arrow away from a dock lifts it off), Alt+Left and Alt+Right dock it, Alt+Up floats it, Alt+Down collapses it to the nearest bottom corner, and Enter or Space docks or floats it. Escape inside the panel collapses it and focus moves to the pill; Enter on the pill opens it and focus returns to the title bar; arrows move the pill between corners.
The resize edge is a role="separator" with aria-valuenow in px: Left and Right step between presets (16 px when free), Home and End go to the minimum and maximum.

Controlled: pass placement and onPlacementChange; the panel moves when the host's value changes and returns if the host refuses. Floating positions are shares of the room, so they survive the container being resized.
With storageKey the placement and the place a pill reopens to are kept per key; a key change glides the panel to that key's place.
Reduced motion jumps the panel to each place and cross-fades the pill and the body; drags still follow the finger and the magnet still catches.
Give the workspace content that reflows: a docked panel narrows it on glide when reserve is on.

items.title: Tab Strip
items.tagline: Open as many as you like.
items.description: A document tab strip whose tabs share one width that narrows as more open; the ones that no longer fit go into an overflow menu carrying their count, which rolls on springs.snap, and the active tab always stays in view. Every tab's slot and width are motion values on springs.glide, so a closing tab collapses while the rest are pulled left with no gap and a new tab grows out of the plus; a dragged tab lifts, leans into its speed and follows the finger 1:1 while its neighbours make room on the reorder spring. The panel cross-fades with a slide toward the side of the tab you moved to and its height glides to the new one; the tablist's arrows move and select, Shift with an arrow moves a tab, Delete closes one, and the overflow is a real menu button.

props.name: tabs / defaultTabs
props.description: The open tabs in order, controlled or initial: id, title, optional icon, content, dirty and pinned. defaultStripTabs is four Fernworks documents.

props.name: onTabsChange
props.description: Fires with the whole list after a close, a new tab or a reorder.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The active tab's id, controlled or initial.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the press, key or menu choice that made a tab active, and when closing the active tab hands over to its neighbour.

props.name: onCreate
props.description: Makes the tab the plus opens; return nothing to open none.

props.name: onClose
props.description: A tab was closed, by its button, Delete or the shortcut.

props.name: label
props.description: The tablist's accessible name.

props.name: width
props.description: How wide a tab is while there is room, in px; past that they all narrow together.

props.name: minWidth
props.description: Narrowest a tab gets before the ones that no longer fit go into the overflow menu, in px.

props.name: reorder
props.description: How the other tabs make room for a dragged one: smoothly, with one crisp overshoot, or not at all (dragging off).

props.name: slide
props.description: How far the panel slides as it changes, in px, toward the side of the tab you moved to; 0 cross-fades in place.

props.name: maxTabs
props.description: The plus is disabled at this many open tabs.

props.name: closable
props.description: Close buttons on tabs and Delete to close; pinned tabs never close.

props.name: shortcuts
props.description: Ctrl or Cmd with W closes the active tab and with T opens one, where the browser passes those keys on.

props.name: newLabel
props.description: The plus button's accessible name.

props.name: size
props.description: Strip height 32, 36 or 40 px.

props.name: accent
props.description: The active tab's rule and the unsaved dot; any CSS colour.

props.name: sound
props.description: A click for each tab chosen (pitched by its slot) and each slot a dragged tab takes, a pop as a new tab grows and a lower one as a tab closes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the tabs, the plus and the menu.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the strip and its panel.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the tablist is one tab stop; Left and Right move and select (wrapping among the tabs in view), Home and End jump, Shift with an arrow moves the focused tab a slot, Delete or Backspace closes it and focus lands on the tab that takes over. The plus and the overflow menu button follow in the tab order; the menu opens on ArrowDown, Enter or Space, moves with arrows, chooses with Enter and closes on Escape with focus back on its button.

Close buttons are siblings of their tab, never nested inside it, and are out of the tab order: Delete is the keyboard path. A tab with dirty shows a dot that turns into the close button on hover and is announced as unsaved.
Controlled: pass tabs with onTabsChange and value with onValueChange. Closing the active tab reports the neighbour that takes over in the same press.

The active tab is always in view: choosing a tab from the overflow menu brings it into the last slot and the tab it replaces collapses into the menu. While the menu is open the panel grows to hold it, so it never leaves the strip's box.
Reduced motion changes places and sizes at once and cross-fades panels on opacity alone; a drag still follows the finger and drops into place.
shortcuts only helps where the browser passes Ctrl or Cmd with W and T on (installed apps, embedded views); in an ordinary tab the browser keeps them.

items.title: Bridge Menu
items.tagline: The panel follows the pointer across.
items.description: A navigation bar with one mega-menu panel for every trigger: moving from one trigger to the next, the same panel slides across and resizes to the new content on springs.glide while that content crossfades in from the side the pointer came from, and a notch on the panel's edge and a pill behind the trigger move on springs.snap so they arrive first. A safe triangle from the last point on the open trigger to the panel's top edge (the bridge) holds the menu open while the pointer heads diagonally across other triggers, until it reaches the panel, leaves the triangle or rests, and bridge="show" draws it. The triggers are disclosure buttons in one tab stop: Left and Right move along the bar with the open panel following, Enter or Space opens, Down moves into the panel and Escape comes back to the trigger.

props.name: items
props.description: The bar's items in order. An item with sections (and an optional feature card) or custom content has a panel; an item with only an href is a plain link in the bar.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The open menu's id, or null when closed, controlled or initial.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the hover, press or key that opened, switched or closed a menu.

props.name: onSelect
props.type: (link: BridgeMenuLink, itemId: string, event: React.MouseEvent) => void
props.description: A link in a panel (or a plain link in the bar) was chosen; the menu closes after it. Call event.preventDefault() to stay on the page.

props.name: label
props.description: The navigation landmark's accessible name.

props.name: travel
props.description: How far the content slides in the direction of travel as it crossfades, in px. 0 is a plain crossfade.

props.name: bridge
props.description: The safe triangle that keeps a menu open while the pointer crosses other triggers on its way to the panel; show draws it as a translucent wedge.

props.name: delay
props.description: How long the pointer rests on a trigger before a closed menu opens, and inside the bridge before it gives way, in ms.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: How long a menu stays open after the pointer leaves the bar and the panel, in ms.

props.name: align
props.description: The panel centred under its trigger, or starting at it; either way it is held inside the bar.

props.name: offset
props.description: The gap between the bar and the panel, in px.

props.name: notch
props.description: Draw a notch on the panel's top edge pointing at the open trigger.

props.name: scrim
props.description: Dim the page under the bar while a menu is open.

props.name: size
props.description: Bar height 32, 40 or 48px, with trigger text to match.

props.name: accent
props.description: Any CSS colour for the open trigger's rule, the bridge and link icons on hover.

props.name: start
props.description: Content before the triggers, such as a brand mark.

props.name: end
props.description: Content at the bar's end, such as sign-in actions.

props.name: children
props.description: The page under the bar. With it, the panel floats over the page, its height is capped to the room there, and it never leaves the component's box.

props.name: sound
props.description: A swish when a press or a key opens or closes a menu, and a tick when a key moves the panel between triggers or within it. Hover-driven changes are silent, so a pointer passing over the bar never starts audio.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the bar closed and ignores hovers, presses and keys.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root element.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the bar is one tab stop (Left and Right move with wrapping, Home and End jump, and while a menu is open the panel follows the focused trigger); Enter or Space toggles a menu, Down or Up opens it and moves focus to its first or last link, and Escape closes it, keeping focus on the trigger. Inside a panel, Up and Down walk the links, Left and Right move to the nearest link in the column beside, and Escape returns to the trigger.

The panel follows its trigger in the document, so Tab from an open trigger walks straight into the panel; focus leaving the menu closes it, and focus inside a panel that is about to switch or close is moved to the trigger first so it is never dropped.

Pass the page under the bar as children: the panel floats over it, the page dims while a menu is open, and the panel's height is capped to the room above the page's bottom, with a fade at its foot while its content scrolls.
Under reduced motion the panel jumps to its trigger's place and size and content swaps by opacity alone; the bridge still holds, and bridge="show" still draws it.
Touch never hovers: taps toggle menus and a tap on the page closes them. A press within 400ms of a hover opening the menu keeps it open instead of closing it.

items.title: List Detail
items.tagline: The row becomes the page.
items.description: A master list whose chosen row becomes the page: the row's avatar, title, subtitle and meta are measured and fly to their places in the detail header, scaling from the row's size to the header's, while the body streams in below a block at a time on springs.glide. Stacked, the row's own surface grows from its rectangle to fill the box on glide as the list fades beneath it, and Back runs the morph in reverse until the parts land on their row; side by side, the parts fly across between the panes while the previous header flies home as a ghost and a selection rule slides down the list on springs.snap, and with morph="arc" each part's x runs on snap and its y on glide so it travels a curve. The list is a listbox with one tab stop (arrows and Home or End move, Enter or Space choose), and stacked, focus moves to the detail's heading and Escape or Back returns it to the row.

props.name: items
props.description: The list in order: id, title, subtitle, meta, avatar (initials, tint, icon), badge and the detail's blocks (text, fields, list, actions). defaultListDetailItems is the seven-person Fernworks team.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The chosen item's id, or null for none, controlled or initial.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the press, key or Back that changed the choice.

props.name: onAction
props.description: An action button in the detail was pressed.

props.name: onLayoutChange
props.description: Fires when the layout moves between stacked and side by side, whether a resize or the split prop moved it, and once when first measured.

props.name: label
props.description: The list's name: its heading, the listbox's accessible name and the Back button's text.

props.name: morph
props.description: How the row's parts travel to the header: straight on glide, on a curve (x on snap, y on glide, cascaded), or not at all (a fade).

props.name: stream
props.description: The wait between one body block arriving and the next, in ms; the total is held under 600ms, and 0 brings the body in at once.

props.name: split
props.description: How list and detail share the box: side by side from 36rem of container width and stacked below it, always stacked, or always side by side with the list as a narrow rail of avatars (each named and titled).

props.name: listWidth
props.description: The list's width side by side, in px (at least 200); a rail is always 72px.

props.name: height
props.description: The component's height, in px or any CSS length; the list and the detail scroll inside it.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: What the detail pane says side by side with nothing chosen.

props.name: renderDetail
props.description: Replaces the block body with your own detail; the header still morphs.

props.name: size
props.description: Row height 48, 56 or 64px.

props.name: accent
props.description: Any CSS colour for the selection rule and the chosen row's wash.

props.name: sound
props.description: A click when a row is chosen, pitched by its place in the list, and a swish as the page opens or goes back.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Ignores choices and dims the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root element.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the list is a listbox with one tab stop (Up, Down, Home and End move; Enter or Space choose). Stacked, choosing moves focus to the detail's heading and Back, Escape or Alt+ArrowLeft return focus to the row once the list is live again; side by side, focus stays on the row and Escape inside the detail goes back to the chosen row. Every Escape it handles calls preventDefault.

The static layout is container-query CSS (@container/list-detail), so the server render is already right at any width; a ResizeObserver tells the component which choreography to run and reports it through onLayoutChange. With split="rail" the list is a column of avatars at every width: the avatar flies to the header and the rest of the header fades in.

Boxes are measured from the offset chain rather than the screen, so an interrupted flight never skews where the next one lands; a part flying home hides its row's own copy until it lands, so nothing doubles.

Under reduced motion nothing flies or grows: the header and body fade in place in order, the list and detail cross-fade, and the selection rule jumps; the choice, focus moves and announcements are unchanged.
A polite status region speaks each change once, frozen from the new value as it happens: "Showing Ines Okafor, Design lead." or "Back to People."

items.title: Push Sheet
items.tagline: The page steps back to make room.
items.description: A bottom sheet that pushes its page back: as the sheet rises on springs.glide, the page behind scales down about its top centre, drops a few pixels, rounds its corners and dims like a card behind another in a stack, and a sheet opened from a sheet steps the one beneath it back the same way. Every layer's look is a function of how far the sheets above it have risen, so the grabber and title bar drag the top sheet 1:1 with everything behind following, rubber-banded past the top stop, and a release projects the throw to the nearest stop (half and full by default) carried on glide with its velocity, or sends the sheet away at its own speed. Each sheet is a modal dialog with focus moved in and trapped, Escape closes it and returns focus to its opener, and its grabber is a slider whose arrows move between stops.

props.name: sheets
props.description: Every sheet that can open: id, title, description, content (a node or a function of the stack's controls) and optional snaps of its own.

props.name: children
props.description: The page under the sheets. As a function it receives { open, close, snapTo, stack }.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The open sheets' ids, bottom first, controlled or initial (at most four).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the call, drag, key or button that opened or closed a sheet, with the new stack.

props.name: onSnapChange
props.description: A sheet came to rest on a stop after a drag, a key or snapTo, given as a share of its full height.

props.name: push
props.description: How far a covered layer steps back, 0 to 1: 0 only dims it; 1 shrinks it 6% per level, drops it 16px and rounds it fully.

props.name: snaps
props.description: Where a sheet stops: half and full height, full only, thirds, or your own shares of the full height.

props.name: dim
props.description: How dark a fully covered layer gets, 0 to 0.8; a second level darkens it by half again.

props.name: openAt
props.description: Where a new sheet comes to rest.

props.name: inset
props.description: The gap above a sheet at full height, in px, where the layer behind peeks out.

props.name: width
props.description: A sheet's widest, in px; it is centred when the box is wider.

props.name: radius
props.description: The sheets' top corners and the pushed page's corners, in px.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Whether a drag down, Escape, a press on the page behind and ArrowDown at the lowest stop close the top sheet.

props.name: height
props.description: The box's height, in px or any CSS length; everything stays inside it.

props.name: backdrop
props.description: Any CSS colour shown behind the pushed page.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: The close button's accessible name.

props.name: sound
props.description: A swish as a sheet opens or is sent away, and a thock when it lands on a stop, louder for a harder throw and lower for a higher stop.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Ignores opens, drags and keys and dims the box.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root element.

usageNotes: Keyboard: each sheet is a modal dialog. Focus moves to its first control when it arrives, Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside the top sheet, Escape closes it (calling preventDefault) and focus returns to whatever opened it. The grabber is a vertical slider: Up and Page Up go to the next stop, Down and Page Down to the one below (from the lowest it closes the sheet when dismissible), Home and End jump, and Enter or Space toggle between the lowest and highest stops.

Open and close sheets from inside the page or a sheet with the function form of children and content: (api) => <button onClick={() => api.open("send")} />. api.close(id) closes that sheet and everything above it.

Focus reaching a control below a sheet's fold raises the sheet to its top stop, so a focused control is always on screen; the body also keeps room under its end equal to what is below the box, so its last line can always be scrolled into view.

Under reduced motion sheets fade in at their stop and fade out, stops change on a short tween, and the page neither scales nor moves, but it still dims and rounds its corners, because what is covered is information.
Controlled: a drag that sends a sheet away springs it back to its stop while asking the host; if the host takes the close, the exit carries on from there, and if it refuses, the sheet simply stays.

items.title: Search Expand
items.tagline: The search makes its own room.
items.description: An app header whose search icon grows into a field on the glide spring while the bar gives way to it frame by frame: the nav items nearest the field squeeze to their icons, then tuck into a More button that grows in with the first and squeezes on flick and snap as each lands, and the brand name steps aside before the last item goes — one motion value drives it all, and both rest states are rounded to whole items. The results panel then grows down out of the field itself on glide, its shell easing from a pill to a card with the matches rising in a cascade and a highlight that moves on snap, and Escape, a choice or blur unwinds it in reverse: the panel retracts on the exit ease before the field narrows and the items come back. The field is a combobox that `/` opens from anywhere, arrows move through results and Enter chooses; More is a menu button whose menu holds whatever is tucked.

props.name: nav
props.description: The bar's navigation in order (id, label, icon). The items nearest the search give way first.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The current page. It carries the wash pill, which moves on snap; tucked, it hands over to a dot on More.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the press or the More menu choice that asked for a page.

props.name: index
props.description: What the search searches: id, title, group, meta, icon, keywords. Results are grouped in the order groups first appear here.

props.name: recent
props.description: Searches offered while the field is empty; choosing one fills the field.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: A result was chosen by a press or Enter. The search closes after it.

props.name: onQueryChange
props.description: Every edit of the field, with its text.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the search is open. Controlled, every request goes through onOpenChange and the bar follows the host.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires from the press, key or blur that asked to open or close it.

props.name: onTuckChange
props.description: The ids tucked into More once the bar settles, whenever that set changes.

props.name: width
props.description: How wide the open field grows, in px. A wider field squeezes and tucks more of the nav; it never takes more than the bar can spare.

props.name: results
props.description: How many results the panel lists at most.

props.name: tuck
props.description: How much of the nav squeezes to its icons before anything tucks into More, 0 to 1: 0 tucks items whole, 1 squeezes every one first.

props.name: brand
props.description: The brand mark, about 24px, always shown.

props.name: brandName
props.description: The product name beside the mark; it steps aside just before the last nav item tucks.

props.name: actions
props.description: The account slot at the bar's far end: an avatar, a button.

props.name: children
props.description: The page under the bar. The results panel and the More menu float over it and never reach past its bottom.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The field's placeholder, and the search button's accessible name.

props.name: label
props.description: The navigation's accessible name.

props.name: moreLabel
props.description: The More button's name; its accessible name adds the count and whether the current page is inside.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: The row shown when nothing matches.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: The key that opens the search from anywhere on the page that is not typing; null for none.

props.name: maxPanelHeight
props.description: The panel's tallest, in px, when nothing sits under the bar to bound it; past it the panel scrolls inside itself.

props.name: size
props.description: Bar height 40, 48 or 56 px; the field and the items scale with it.

props.name: accent
props.description: The current-page pill, the result highlight, the matched letters and More's dot. Any CSS colour.

props.name: sound
props.description: A swish as the visitor opens or closes the field, and clicks for choices, for each item landing in More and, softly, for arrow keys. Nothing plays unless the visitor did something.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the bar and disables the search, the nav and the shortcut.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the root (a container-query box holding the bar and the page).

usageNotes: Keyboard: `/` anywhere that is not typing opens the search with focus in the field; arrow keys move through the results (the input keeps focus, with aria-activedescendant), Enter chooses, and Escape closes with preventDefault and puts focus back on the search button. Tab leaving the field closes it too, except into More and its menu.

More is a menu button (ArrowDown, Enter or Space open it) whose menuitemradio rows move with arrows, Home and End; Escape and Tab close it with focus back on More. Tucked items are inert in the bar, so Tab never lands on something invisible.
Give the bar a page as children inside a box of fixed height: the panel and the menu are capped by the room under the bar and scroll inside themselves, so nothing draws past the component's box.
Under reduced motion the field and panel fade in at their final size and the bar jumps to its squeezed layout; the More count, the current-page dot, the highlight and every announcement still change.
The live region speaks the result count once typing settles (250 ms) and the choice made, never a sentence per keystroke.

items.title: Zoom Timeline
items.tagline: Years to minutes in one scroll.
items.description: A horizontal timeline with semantic zoom from years to minutes: Ctrl or Cmd with the wheel zooms about the pointer on the flick spring, a pinch zooms 1:1 about the fingers, and + and - step on glide, while each tick label fades in as the room around it grows (quarters before months, Mondays before days, every third hour before every hour) and the unit above becomes a row of context labels pinned to the left edge. Markers closer than the cluster radius merge into counted bubbles, and each member springs in and out on snap as you zoom, so a bubble visibly splits into its events; dragging pans 1:1 with rubber-banded ends, and a throw coasts on a critically damped spring whose time constant is the projection's, carrying the release velocity. Markers are one roving list: arrows step and pan to keep them in view, Enter selects an event or opens a bubble, Page Up and Page Down pan a screen.

props.name: events
props.description: The events to place: id, at (ms, an ISO string or a Date), title, detail and tone (default, success, warn or danger).

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The selected event. Its marker fills on flick and the readout row cross-fades to its title, time and detail.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the press or key that selected an event, or cleared it (Escape) with null.

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: The view once a gesture, step or coast settles: start and end in ms, the axis unit, and how many events and bubbles are in view.

props.name: defaultCenter
props.description: Where the view opens.

props.name: defaultUnit
props.description: The unit the view opens on.

props.name: levels
props.description: The zoom ladder: how far out and in the view can go. Changing it re-frames the view on its opening unit.

props.name: cluster
props.description: How close markers get, in px, before they merge into a counted bubble (with 10% hysteresis); 0 never merges.

props.name: momentum
props.description: How far a throw coasts, 0 to 1: 0 stops almost under the finger, 1 glides a long way.

props.name: now
props.description: Draws a now line there. Passed in, never read from the clock, so the server and the browser agree.

props.name: utcOffset
props.description: Minutes added to UTC for every label and readout, e.g. 60 for UTC+1.

props.name: label
props.description: The timeline's accessible name.

props.name: formatTime
props.description: The readout's and every accessible name's time; the default drops the time at midnight.

props.name: zoomControls
props.description: Show the zoom out, unit and zoom in controls in the readout row.

props.name: height
props.description: Total height in px: a 36px readout row, the marker lane and a 52px axis with its context row.

props.name: accent
props.description: Selection, bubbles and the now line. Any CSS colour.

props.name: sound
props.description: A tick each time the axis changes unit during a visitor's zoom and softly as arrow keys step, and a whoosh for a fast throw or a zoom step. Nothing plays on its own.
