items.description: A file manager you work with your hands: grid and list are the same items laid out twice, so the toggle morphs every tile into its row through motion's layout on the spring you choose, and folders slide in from the side you travel on that spring. Press empty space and drag to lasso (items join as the rectangle touches them, or only once inside); drag a selection and it lifts into a stack that follows the pointer, a folder's lid opens as the hover charges until it springs open with you still carrying, a drop on a folder shrinks the stack into it while it bumps on recoil, and a drop into the open folder lands the files on their measured places. Uploads run as rows whose progress glides and each turns into its tile when it resolves; the items are a multi-select listbox where arrows move, Shift extends, Enter opens, Backspace goes up, Ctrl or Cmd with X and V cut and paste, and Delete removes with Undo.

props.name: view / defaultView
props.description: The layout. Changing view morphs every item into the other layout; the toggle also switches it and reports through onViewChange.

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: Fires from the grid and list toggle with the new layout.

props.name: lasso
props.description: How the lasso picks: items it touches, only items wholly inside it, or no lasso (empty space just clears).

props.name: spring
props.description: The spring under the grid and list morph, the folder slide and every landing: crisp, settled or bouncy.

props.name: files / defaultFiles
props.description: Every item in every folder as one flat list linked by parentId. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onFilesChange
props.description: Fires from the drop, paste, move, upload or delete that changed the items, with all of them.

props.name: folder / defaultFolder
props.description: The open folder's id. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onFolderChange
props.description: Fires from a crumb, the tree, Enter, Backspace or a folder springing open under a drag.

props.name: selected / defaultSelected
props.description: Selected item ids. A selection brings in the selection bar with Move to and Delete.

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Fires from the press, lasso or key that changed the selection.

props.name: rootId
props.description: The id top-level items carry as parentId.

props.name: rootLabel
props.description: The top level's name in the breadcrumb and the tree.

props.name: openDelay
props.description: How long, in ms, a dragged stack hovers a folder (a tile, a crumb or a tree row) before it springs open.

props.name: upload
props.type: (file: File, progress: (fraction: number) => void, signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<Partial<FileItem> | void>
props.description: Stores an uploaded file, reporting progress and honouring the signal; resolves with anything the stored item should carry. Without it a seeded local simulation runs, for demos.

props.name: accept
props.description: File types uploads take, as an input's accept (".pdf,image/*"). Others are listed with the reason.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: The largest file an upload takes, in bytes (25 MB).

props.name: quota
props.description: Storage shown on the meter under the tree, in bytes (15 GB).

props.name: now
props.description: The moment modified dates are read against (Today, 09:12; 28 Sep). Never read from the clock during render.

props.name: zoneOffset
props.description: Minutes east of UTC that dates are shown in, so the server and the browser agree.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: A file was opened by double-click, Enter or Open in the details panel.

props.name: onMove
props.description: Items moved into a folder by drop, paste or Move to (and back, by Undo).

props.name: onDelete
props.description: Items were removed, with everything inside a removed folder.

props.name: onUploadComplete
props.description: An upload resolved and landed as an item.

props.name: label
props.description: The browser's accessible name.

props.name: status
props.description: Loading draws placeholder tiles; error offers Retry.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Retry was pressed on the error state.

props.name: ref
props.description: A handle whose upload(files) uploads into the open folder, as a drop or the picker would.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a pop when a press selects, items join a lasso or a drop lands, and a swish on the view toggle, navigation and a folder springing open. Off unless asked for.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Makes the whole browser inert.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root; it is 560px tall by default and lays out by its own width.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the items are one tab stop in a multi-select listbox. Arrows move (two-dimensional in the grid), Shift extends, Ctrl or Cmd with an arrow moves without selecting, Space toggles, Ctrl or Cmd with A selects all, Enter opens, Backspace or Alt with Up goes up, Ctrl or Cmd with X then V cuts and pastes into the open folder, Delete removes, Escape clears. The tree, the layout toggle and the Move to menu each have their own arrow keys.

Reduced motion: the layout swaps at once, folders cross-fade instead of sliding, and every flight (the stack home, into a folder, onto the grid) is a short fade; the lasso and the stack still follow the pointer and progress still fills.

Uploads: pass upload to store files; report progress from 0 to 1 and honour the AbortSignal (Cancel aborts it). Resolve with the stored item's fields; its row turns into its tile when it lands. accept and maxSize refuse files with a reason, and a rejected promise offers Retry.
Layout follows the browser's own width: one column with a Back button under 40rem, a folder tree with the storage meter and full breadcrumbs from 40rem, and a details panel from 68rem.
Touch: the items scroll with touch-pan-y; a finger rests 350ms before it lassoes or lifts files, so a swipe still scrolls.
Every move and delete leaves a toast with Undo; a folder can never be moved into itself or anything inside it.

items.title: Review Thread
items.tagline: Comments that know where they belong.
items.description: A draft under review with its discussions pinned in the margin at the height of the passages they are about: one layout pass places every card, the open one exactly on its passage, and when a card grows the cards beneath it glide out of its way. Hovering or focusing a passage or a card brightens the highlight and draws a leader along the passage's underline into the card, rebuilt each frame from the card's own position; replies land on snap, @-mentions complete from a list, and resolving folds the thread back into a one-line check with a dog-eared corner on glide while the check draws on flick. Up and Down walk the threads in reading order, Enter opens one, Escape closes the mention list and then the thread.

props.name: document
props.description: The draft under review: a title, a meta line and its heading and paragraph blocks.

props.name: threads / defaultThreads
props.description: The discussions, each anchored to a quote inside one block, with its comments and resolved state. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onThreadsChange
props.description: Fires from the reply or the resolve that changed the list, with the whole new list.

props.name: people
props.description: Everyone who can write here: comment authors and the @-mention list.

props.name: me
props.description: The id of the person replying and resolving.

props.name: now
props.description: The moment every comment is dated against; the component never reads the clock.

props.name: active / defaultActive
props.description: The open thread, or null. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: Fires when a press, a key or a resolve opens or closes a thread.

props.name: onReply
props.description: A reply was sent, with the comment as stored.

props.name: onResolve
props.description: A thread was resolved (true) or reopened (false).

props.name: onMention
props.description: A sent reply mentioned someone.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: The Retry button of the error state.

props.name: leaders
props.description: The line that joins a lit passage to its card: a curve, two rounded right angles, or none (the highlight still brightens).

props.name: resolve
props.description: What resolving does: fold the thread to a one-line check in place, fold it and tuck it out of the rail behind a Resolved toggle, or no resolving at all.

props.name: density
props.description: Type size, card padding, avatar size and how many lines of a closed thread show.

props.name: highlight
props.description: The passages' highlight and leader colour, any CSS colour.

props.name: status
props.description: Loading draws the surface's skeleton; error offers Retry.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The reply composer's placeholder.

props.name: label
props.description: The region's accessible name. Defaults to “Review of” and the title.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a tick on opening and moving between threads and a pop on replying and resolving. Off unless asked for.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Reads but does not reply, resolve or open.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. The root is h-[560px] by default; pass a height to change it.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the thread cards are one roving tab stop. Up and Down walk them in reading order, Home and End jump, Enter or Space opens one, Escape closes it; inside an open thread Tab reaches Resolve and the reply box, where Enter sends and Shift+Enter breaks a line. Typing @ opens the mention list: Up and Down move, Enter or Tab inserts, Escape closes it without closing the thread.

Reduced motion: cards jump to their places, the fold and the leader fade instead of moving or drawing, and scrolling to a passage is instant. Highlights, counts, the resolved check and the replies still appear.

Layout follows the component's own width: under 600px the threads sit under their paragraphs with a notch pointing at the passage; from 600px they move into a margin rail; from 1040px a thread index joins on the left and a press there glides the draft to the passage.

Anchors are quotes, not offsets: a thread points at the first occurrence of its quote inside its block, so an edit elsewhere in the draft never moves it. A quote that is no longer in the text keeps its thread, placed after the anchored ones.
Every time is relative to `now`. Pass the current time from your app (a minute tick is plenty) and the “4 min ago” labels move with it; nothing reads the clock in render, so server and client match.

items.title: Notice Center
items.tagline: Everything that happened, sorted out.
items.description: A notification center whose groups stack into a deck: pressing one deals it out, each hidden row starting where its layer was and gliding down to its place on glide in a cascade while the group's measured height glides open, and Show less gathers them back on the exit ease. A row or a whole stack follows a sideways swipe 1:1, is thrown off on the exit ease when its projected rest passes 40% of its width (or snaps back on snap with the release velocity), and the rows under it close the gap on glide. Mark all read sends a band down the list that clears each unread row as it passes — the dot shrinks on flick — the tab pill slides on snap and times roll as `now` moves; arrows walk the rows, Enter opens, Right deals and Left gathers a stack, Delete dismisses.

props.name: notices / defaultNotices
props.description: Every notice: its source, title, body, time, read state and whether it mentions you. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onNoticesChange
props.description: Fires from the dismiss, open or sweep that changed the list, with the whole new list.

props.name: sources
props.description: Where notices come from: a name, an icon and a colour for each.

props.name: now
props.description: The moment every notice is dated against. Move it and the times roll over; days are UTC days.

props.name: filter / defaultFilter
props.description: The selected tab. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onFilterChange
props.description: Fires when a tab is chosen by press or arrow key.

props.name: selected / defaultSelected
props.description: The open notice, shown in the detail pane from 600px wide. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Fires when opening or dismissing changes the open notice.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: A notice was opened by press or Enter. It is marked read first.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Notices were dismissed by swipe, key or button: one, or a whole collapsed group.

props.name: onMarkAllRead
props.description: Mark all read cleared these notices.

props.name: onReadChange
props.description: One notice was marked read or unread.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: The Retry button of the error state.

props.name: stack
props.description: How a collapsed group shows what is under its newest notice: layers peeking below, the same layers fanned, or a flat “+3”.

props.name: sweep
props.description: How long Mark all read's band takes to cross the list, in ms.

props.name: group
props.description: Group by source into collapsible stacks, by day under sticky Today, Yesterday and Earlier headings, or not at all.

props.name: title
props.description: The panel's heading and accessible name.

props.name: status
props.description: Loading draws placeholder rows; error offers Retry.

props.name: label
props.description: The region's accessible name, when it should differ from the title.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a swish on dismiss and Mark all read and a pop on dealing, gathering and read changes. Off unless asked for.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the notices but takes no presses, swipes or keys.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. The root is h-[560px] by default; pass a height to change it.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the rows are one roving tab stop. Up and Down move, Home and End jump, Enter or Space opens a notice (or deals a stack), Right deals a stack and Left gathers it, Delete or Backspace dismisses with focus moving to the next row, and U toggles read. The tabs are a tablist: Left and Right switch them.

Reduced motion: nothing travels. A stack's rows fade in place and its height changes at once, a dismissed row fades and its space closes, the band is skipped and every read state cross-fades together. Counts, dots and the read state still change.
Layout follows the component's own width: under 600px a single column; from 600px a detail pane opens beside the list; from 1040px a Sources rail joins on the left and narrows the list to one source.
Times are relative to `now` and days are UTC days, so server and client render the same labels. Advance `now` from your app (a minute tick is plenty) and the times roll over in place.

A swipe commits only past 40% of the row's width, measured on where the throw would come to rest, so a lazy drag snaps back and a quick flick goes. Dismissing a collapsed stack dismisses the whole group.

items.title: Block Editor
items.tagline: Write in blocks; move them freely.
items.description: A document of text, heading, to-do and quote blocks, each a plain auto-growing textarea underneath, whose inline marks are plain text that renders formatted while the block rests. A block's grip drags it 1:1 with a lift on flick and a rubber band past the ends while its neighbours glide out of its way, and on release every block FLIPs on glide from where it was drawn to where the new order puts it, the dropped one carrying its release velocity; Alt+Up and Alt+Down make the same move with focus and caret kept. `/` opens a block menu at the caret on snap, a selection raises a formatting bubble over itself on snap, and Enter splits, Backspace joins and Up and Down cross between blocks at their first and last lines.

props.name: blocks / defaultBlocks
props.description: The document: each block's id, type (paragraph, heading, subheading, todo, quote), text and, for a to-do, its tick. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onBlocksChange
props.description: Fires from the keystroke, drag, menu pick or tick that changed the document, with every block.

props.name: title
props.description: The document's name: the surface's heading and accessible name.

props.name: meta
props.description: One quiet line under the title.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: What an empty block says while you are in it.

props.name: handles
props.description: The gutter's grip and + button: on hover and focus (faintly always on a phone), always, or none. Alt+Up and Alt+Down move blocks either way.

props.name: slash
props.description: The block menu that `/` and + open: rows with hints, a grid of tiles, or none (`/` is just a character; the markdown openings # , ## , [] and > still work).

props.name: bubble
props.description: The toolbar over a selection: bold, italic, code, strike and link; the first three; or none (the shortcuts still work).

props.name: status
props.description: Loading draws placeholder lines; error offers Retry.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: The Retry button of the error state.

props.name: onFocusChange
props.description: Fires with the block being written in, or null when focus leaves the document.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Reads without writing, moving or ticking; the gutter is hidden.

props.name: label
props.description: The region's accessible name, when it should differ from the title.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a tick on menu moves, drag slot changes and Alt-moves, and a click on drops, picks, ticks and formats. Off unless asked for.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the document dimmed and takes no input.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. The root is h-[560px] by default; pass a height to change it.

usageNotes: Keyboard: Enter splits a block at the caret (an empty to-do turns back into text), Backspace at the start turns a styled block into text or joins it to the one above, Delete at the end joins the next, Up and Down at the first or last line move between blocks, Mod+Enter ticks a to-do, and Alt+Up or Alt+Down moves the block. Mod+B, I, E, K and Shift+X format a selection; Alt+F10 moves focus into the bubble, where Left and Right walk it and Escape returns to the text.

Reduced motion: no lift and no travel. A dropped or Alt-moved block swaps into place at once, menus and the bubble fade without rising, new blocks appear without fading and the tick appears without drawing. The order, the marks and the tick still change, and every move is announced.

Marks are stored as plain text (`**bold**`, `_italic_`, `` `code` ``, `~~strike~~`, `[text](url)`), so the blocks round-trip through any text field or database column; a block shows them raw while you write in it and formatted while it rests, and a click lands the caret on the character you pressed.

Layout follows the component's own width: under 600px the gutter holds only the grip and the slash grid has two columns; from 600px the + button joins it; from 1040px an Outline of the headings sits on the left and a press glides the page to one.

items.title: Member Roster
items.tagline: Who is here, and what they can do.
items.description: The people in a workspace and what each can do. A role changes only after a confirm unfolds under the row to its measured height on glide and is accepted — in menu mode a chip whose label then rolls to the new role on snap, in segmented mode a thumb that slides on snap and waits dashed until the confirm — and the last owner can never be demoted or removed. Invites are typed or pasted as email chips that land one after another from 0.6 scale on snap, pending invites resend behind a cooldown bar that drains linearly, and removing someone folds the row away, tipping back about its top edge while its height runs to zero and the rows below close the gap. Menus and radio groups take the arrow keys, confirms take focus when they arrive and give it back on Escape.

props.name: members / defaultMembers
props.description: Everyone in the workspace: name, email, role, last active and whether it is you. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onMembersChange
props.description: Fires from the confirm that changed a role or removed someone, with every member.

props.name: invites / defaultInvites
props.description: Invites still waiting: email, role and when they were sent. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onInvitesChange
props.description: Fires when invites are sent or revoked, with every pending invite.

props.name: roleSet
props.description: The roles a member can hold, most powerful first, each with a sentence of what it can do. A role with id "owner" is never left empty.

props.name: now
props.description: The moment “last active” and “sent” are dated against; the component never reads the clock in render.

props.name: seats
props.description: How many seats the plan has. Members and pending invites both take one; inviting past it is refused.

props.name: cooldown
props.description: Seconds before an invite can be sent again.

props.name: workspace
props.description: The workspace's name, for the heading and the confirms.

props.name: onRoleChange
props.type: (memberId: string, role: string, previous: string) => void
props.description: A role change was confirmed.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: A removal was confirmed.

props.name: onInvite
props.description: Invites were sent, all with one role.

props.name: onResend
props.description: An invite was sent again; its cooldown starts.

props.name: onRevoke
props.description: An invite was withdrawn.

props.name: density
props.description: Row height, avatar size and type size.

props.name: invite
props.description: The invite field: always shown, behind an Invite button that glides it open, or not offered.

props.name: roles
props.description: How a role is changed: a menu of roles with what each can do, or a segmented control in the row (a menu on a phone). Both confirm first.

props.name: status
props.description: Loading draws placeholder rows; error offers Retry.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: The Retry button of the error state.

props.name: label
props.description: The region's accessible name. Defaults to “Members of” and the workspace.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a click on chips, role menus, resends, revokes and removals and a pop on confirmed roles and sent invites. Off unless asked for.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the roster dimmed and changes nothing.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. The root is h-[560px] by default; pass a height to change it.

usageNotes: Keyboard: a role menu opens with Enter or Space and takes Up, Down, Home, End and Enter; the segmented control is a radio group the arrow keys walk. Choosing a different role unfolds a confirm whose button takes focus (arrow keys leave focus in the group while you choose); Escape cancels and returns focus to the role. In the invite field Enter, comma, semicolon or space turn text into chips, Left walks back through them, Backspace or Delete removes one, and Enter on an empty field sends.

Reduced motion: confirms, chips and rows appear and leave by fading, heights change at once and the thumb jumps. Roles, counts, chips and the cooldown still change, and the cooldown bar still drains because the time left is information.

Nothing changes on a single press: roles and removals wait for a confirm, and the last owner is locked with a title that says why. Fire your API call from onRoleChange or onRemove; in controlled mode, refusing the change simply leaves the row as it was.

Layout follows the component's own width: under 600px Members and Pending are tabs and each member is a two-line row; from 600px the members are a table with Pending under it; from 1040px the invite field and Pending move into a column on the right.

items.title: Data Grid
items.tagline: A table that keeps up with you.
items.description: A data grid that keeps pace with the hand: rows arrive after a skeleton in a cascade on glide (row by row, on a diagonal wave of cells, or in one fade) and replay from the side you paged toward, a heading press morphs its sort glyph between a double chevron and an arrow on snap while the rows on the page glide to their new seats, and columns resize from a grip that follows the finger 1:1, rubber-bands past its limits and springs back on snap with the release velocity. Shift-click selects a range drawn as one band that stretches from the anchor on snap, editable cells open an editor that lifts out of the cell and land their new value on flick, and the header and first columns stay pinned while the body scrolls. It is a real role="grid" with one roving cell: arrows move, Page keys turn the page, Space selects, Shift with an arrow extends the range, Enter sorts a heading or edits a cell, and Shift with Left or Right resizes a column.

props.name: density
props.description: Row height and type: 32, 40 or 48px rows. Heights glide when it changes.

props.name: cascade
props.description: How a page arrives after the skeleton or a page turn: rows rising in order, cells on a diagonal wave from the top-left, or one fade.

props.name: stripes
props.description: Paint alternate rows, so a wide row is easy to follow across. The pinned cells share the stripe.

props.name: columns
props.description: The columns in order: id, header, kind (text, number, money, date, status), width and its limits, align, sortable, editable, mono, relative dates, status options and tones, and format, validate and parse functions. The first is the row header and stays pinned.

props.name: rows / defaultRows
props.description: The records, each with an id and a field per column. Controlled or uncontrolled; the default is 42 seeded invoices.

props.name: onRowsChange
props.description: Fires with every row after an edit is committed, or reverted after a failed save.

props.name: onCellEdit
props.description: Fires when an edit is committed, with the row, column, new value and previous value. Return a promise to show the cell saving; a rejection puts the old value back.

props.name: sort / defaultSort
props.description: The sort, or null for the rows' own order. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onSortChange
props.description: Fires from the heading press or key that changed the sort: ascending, descending, then off.

props.name: selected / defaultSelected
props.description: The selected row ids. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Fires from the click, Shift-click or key that changed the selection.

props.name: page / defaultPage
props.description: The page shown, from 0. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Fires from the button or key that turned the page.

props.name: pageSize
props.description: Rows per page.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Tallest the body grows, in px, before it scrolls under its pinned header.

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons offered in the footer while rows are selected: id, label, an optional 14px icon and tone.

props.name: onAction
props.description: One of the actions was pressed, with the selected row ids.

props.name: onColumnResize
props.description: Fires when a column's width settles after a drag, a double-click fit or a key.

props.name: now
props.description: Today, for relative dates such as "in 3d" and "5d ago".

props.name: itemLabel
props.description: What one row is called in counts and announcements: "3 invoices selected".

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale for numbers and money.

props.name: currency
props.description: The currency for money columns.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the rows have arrived. Loading shows a skeleton of one page; going to ready plays the arrival.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after the rows failed to load.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: What an empty grid says.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading over the grid.

props.name: label
props.description: The grid's accessible name. Defaults to the title.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a click for sorts, toggles, page turns and saves, and a tick per row joining a range and per 16px of resize.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Keeps the grid readable and navigable but refuses sorting, selecting, editing, resizing and paging.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer panel.

usageNotes: Keyboard: one cell is the tab stop. Arrows move, Home and End reach the row's ends, Ctrl+Home and Ctrl+End the page's corners, Page Up and Page Down turn the page. On a heading Enter or Space sorts, Shift+Left or Shift+Right resizes by 16px and Shift+Enter fits the column to its contents (as a double-click on its grip does); in the body Space toggles the row, Shift+Up and Shift+Down extend the range from the anchor, Ctrl or Cmd+A selects the page, and Escape clears a selection.

Editing: Enter, F2, a double-click or a typed character opens the editor on an editable cell (typing replaces the value). Enter and Tab commit, Escape cancels and hands focus back to the cell. validate returns the message shown under the editor; return a promise from onCellEdit to show the cell saving, and reject it to put the old value back.
Sorting is an action, not a live view: the order is taken when a heading is pressed or rows come and go, so an edited row stays under the hand that edited it until the next sort.

Reduced motion: rows and cells fade in without travel, reorders, bands and the page pill settle at once, the sort glyph swaps on a short tween and the editor appears without lifting. Selection, order, widths and saved values still change.
On a narrow container the pinned column takes at most about half the width so the columns beside it can scroll; the footer turns its page numbers into a compact count.
Columns and rows are plain data: pass format for custom cells, and keep the default exports (defaultDataGridColumns, defaultDataGridRows) as a template for your own.

items.title: Pulse Dashboard
items.tagline: Change the range; watch it all reflow.
items.description: A KPI dashboard where everything reads one window of days, and a change of window moves it all in one beat: the four tiles' digits roll on snap, units first and the tiles in cascade, while the chart's window glides on glide, so a longer period is a real zoom out — the area is rebuilt every frame from the window, a day per point while they fit and the mean of each sample's share past that — and the y scale and the donut's slices glide with it. Dragging across the chart draws a brush that follows the finger 1:1 and rubber-bands past the ends, and letting go zooms into it as the brush opens out to the plot's edges; pointing at a donut slice pulls it out along its own middle on snap while the hub cross-fades to it. The period is a radio group, the tiles a tablist whose panel is the chart, and the chart a slider over its days: arrows step a day, Page keys a week, Shift with an arrow stretches a brush, Enter zooms to it and Escape lets go of the brush, then the zoom.

props.name: range / defaultRange
props.description: The period: the last 7, 30 or 90 days, or the last year, up to now. Changing it glides the chart's window, so it zooms out or in. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onRangeChange
props.description: Fires from the period switch with the new period.

props.name: smooth
props.description: How much the chart's line curves, 0 to 1: straight segments at 0, monotone curves at 1 that never overshoot a reading.

props.name: donut / defaultDonut
props.description: Which breakdown the donut splits revenue by (an id from breakdowns). A new breakdown sweeps its ring in clockwise. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onDonutChange
props.description: Fires from the breakdown switch with the new breakdown's id.

props.name: metric / defaultMetric
props.description: The tile the chart draws. A new metric grows out of the old one's shape. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onMetricChange
props.description: Fires from the tile press or arrow key that chose a metric.

props.name: onWindowChange
props.type: (window: { from: string; to: string; custom: boolean }) => void
props.description: Fires whenever the window changes — a period, a zoom or a reset — with both dates included, as YYYY-MM-DD.

props.name: metrics
props.description: The tiles in order (four fit a row): id, label, kind (money, count or percent as a fraction), aggregate (sum or mean), goodWhen (up or down) and one value per day, oldest first. The default is 730 seeded days of a small store.

props.name: breakdowns
props.description: The donut's splits of revenue: each an id, a label and segments with a daily series aligned with the metrics and an optional colour.

props.name: now
props.description: The date of the last value in every series. Dates are counted back from it.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale for numbers and money.

props.name: currency
props.description: The currency for money metrics.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats a value for the tiles, the chart's readout and the spoken sentences. Defaults to whole currency, grouped counts and percentages to two places.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the numbers have arrived: loading shows the dashboard's skeleton, error a retry.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after the numbers failed to load.

props.name: title
props.description: The dashboard's heading.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: A quieter line under the heading, before the window's dates.

props.name: label
props.description: The dashboard's accessible name. Defaults to the title.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a tick for a period, tile or slice chosen and each week the keyboard crosses, and a swish when a zoom lands or resets.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the numbers but refuses period, metric, breakdown and zoom changes.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer panel.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the period and the breakdown are radio groups and the tiles a tablist (arrows move and select, Home and End jump). The chart is a slider over its days: Left and Right step a day, Page Up and Page Down a week, Home and End the window's ends; Shift with an arrow stretches a brush from the cursor, Enter zooms to it, and Escape lets go of the brush first, then the zoom.
Pointer: drag across the chart to zoom into the days under the brush, tap or point to read a day, double-click to reset. The legend rows are toggle buttons that pin a slice.
A zoom is a custom window that the tiles and donut answer too; the period switch shows no selection until a period is chosen again, and onWindowChange reports it with custom set.

Reduced motion: nothing travels or rolls — the window, axis and slices change at once behind a short fade, the brush still draws, and slices are outlined instead of pulled out. Every number still updates.

Lays out by its own width: two tiles across with the donut beside its legend on a phone, four across with the chart and donut side by side from 640px, and a taller chart with the legend's amounts from about 1090px. At most 560px tall; it scrolls inside its own box below that.
Every series is one value per day ending at now, oldest first; percentages are fractions (0.031). Keep defaultPulseMetrics and defaultPulseBreakdowns as templates for your own data.

items.title: Funnel Flow
items.tagline: See where they slip away.
items.description: A conversion funnel drawn as a flow: stages are bars as long as the people who reached them, ribbons carry the ones who went on, and from each stage a drop-off branch peels away and fades. A seeded pool of particles runs it, and at each stage a particle goes on only if its lane falls inside the share that converted, so the dots split exactly as the people did; pointing at a stage freezes its particles where they are while the rest keep flowing and the details swap in on snap, and the segment switch re-weights every stage and branch on glide while particles already in flight follow their lanes onto the new shapes. The stages are a list of buttons named with full sentences: arrows move between them and freeze each, Enter pins, Escape unpins, and the segment is a radio group.

props.name: particles
props.description: How many particles run the funnel at once, 20 to 200. The pool is seeded and warmed up, so it is full from the first frame.

props.name: segment / defaultSegment
props.description: Which of segments the flow is weighted by. A change glides every stage and branch to its new size. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onSegmentChange
props.description: Fires from the segment switch with the new segment's id.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the particles run, as a multiple of 64px a second.

props.name: stages
props.description: The stages in order, each an id and a label.

props.name: segments
props.description: The segments: id, label, the people who reached each stage, and optionally the median hours from the stage before and the top reason people left at each stage.

props.name: stage / defaultStage
props.description: The pinned stage: frozen, with its details shown, until it is unpinned. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onStageChange
props.description: Fires from the press or key that pinned or unpinned a stage.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the particles' lanes and pace, so the same page always draws the same flow.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats a count of people. Defaults to grouped digits in locale.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale for counts.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the numbers have arrived: loading shows the funnel's skeleton, error a retry.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after the numbers failed to load.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: A quieter line under the heading, before the first stage's count.

props.name: label
props.description: The funnel's accessible name. Defaults to the title.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a swish when the segment changes and a plip when a stage is pinned or the keyboard moves to it, pitched by how many of its people the stage keeps. Particles never sound.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the flow but refuses segment changes and pins.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer panel.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the stages are one tab stop. Arrow keys move between them, Home and End jump, and the stage with focus freezes and shows its details; Enter or Space pins it, Escape unpins. The segment switch is a radio group whose arrows select.

The particles run only while the funnel is on screen and the page is visible; under reduced motion they never move, and each ribbon and branch holds a still, seeded scatter of dots in the same proportions while the numbers and the freeze still work.
Bars are drawn relative to the segment's own first stage, so switching segments compares conversion, not size; the counts on each stage say how many people that is.

Lays out by its own width: on a phone the funnel stands up, labels in a column on the left and losses peeling right; from 560px it lies on its side with the losses below; from about 1090px a table of stages sits beside it. At most 560px tall; it scrolls inside its own box below that.
Every stage, count, median and reason is data: keep defaultFunnelStages and defaultFunnelSegments as templates for your own.

items.title: Status Board
items.tagline: Ninety days, one glance.
items.description: A service status board built from records: each service's strip of days grows up out of the baseline in one wave on glide, sweeping across and down the board a cascade apart, every bar coloured by the worst incident that touched it. Point at a strip, scrub it, or step it with the arrow keys and a lens rides to the day on snap with a card of what happened; select an incident and every strip it touched stamps a ring over its days on snap while its updates open on glide. Beside it a seeded p95 latency line advances live from now, gliding left a step per sample and pausing while it is read, over a dot-matrix map whose troubled regions pulse only while the board is on screen.

props.name: days
props.description: Days of history each service shows, 7 to 90. Changing it regrows the strips and recomputes every uptime figure.

props.name: live
props.description: The latency sparkline takes a new seeded sample every interval while the board is on screen. Off: a snapshot at now.

props.name: regions
props.description: The regions panel: true for defaultStatusRegions, your own list, or false to leave it out.

props.name: services
props.description: One row each: id, name, current status, and minutes of downtime per day ending today.

props.name: incidents
props.description: What went wrong or was planned: title, impact (minor, major, maintenance), services, start, end (omit while open) and updates.

props.name: now
props.description: The board's moment: today's bar, the update time, open incidents and the latency feed all run from it.

props.name: latency
props.description: Your own p95 series, oldest first. Omit it for a seeded series that advances from now; pass it and you advance it.

props.name: latencyWindow
props.description: Samples across the sparkline.

props.name: latencyTarget
props.description: The p95 target in ms: a dashed line, and the reading turns warn above it.

props.name: interval
props.description: Milliseconds between seeded samples while live.

props.name: incident / defaultIncident
props.description: The selected incident: its days are ringed on every strip it touched and its updates are open. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onIncidentChange
props.description: Fires from the click, key or bar that selected or cleared an incident.

props.name: region / defaultRegion
props.description: The region whose latency the sparkline shows, or null for all regions. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onRegionChange
props.description: Fires from the chip, arrow key or map marker that chose a region.

props.name: onDaySelect
props.description: Enter on a day, or a click on its bar, with the service id and the day as YYYY-MM-DD.

props.name: incidentLimit
props.description: Incidents listed before Show more; a desktop-wide board, with the room, lists three more.

props.name: formatDate
props.description: Day labels. Defaults to "Sep 24" in UTC, so the server and the browser print the same.

props.name: formatTime
props.description: Clock labels. Defaults to "14:32" in UTC; latency samples add seconds.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the status has arrived: a skeleton while loading, a message with Try again on error.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed while status is "error".

props.name: title
props.description: The board's heading; also its accessible name unless label is given.

props.name: label
props.description: The board's accessible name. Defaults to the title.

props.name: sound
props.description: A tick for each day stepped by key or scrub and for a region choice, a low buzz when you select a major outage. The live feed is always silent.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Read only: days and samples still read out, nothing can be selected and the feed holds still.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It is at most 560px tall and scrolls inside itself; pass a max-height class to change that.

usageNotes: Keyboard: each strip is a slider over its days with one tab stop for the board — Left and Right step a day, Page keys a week, Home and End the oldest day and today, Up and Down the neighbouring service, Enter selects the day and its incident, Escape clears it. The sparkline is a slider over its samples, the regions a radio group.

The seeded latency feed only runs while the board is on screen, the page is visible and nobody is reading the line; it pauses ("Paused") while pointed at or focused. Pass latency to drive it yourself — a new last sample glides in the same way.
Bar colours come from incidents first (the worst impact that touched the service that day), then from downtime nobody filed. Every colour is pigment, the same in light and dark.
Under reduced motion the bars stand at full height, the lens, card and line step without travel, and troubled regions wear a still halo; uptime, latency and selection still change.
Lays out by its own width: stacked on a phone (scrolling inside its box), services with the timeline beside a latency and regions column from 40rem, and three columns from 68rem.

items.title: Filter Builder
items.tagline: Say exactly which rows you mean.
items.description: A query builder over typed rows: rules of field, condition and value in nested All / Any groups, each with a rail down its left edge. Switching a group slides its thumb on snap, re-colours the rail and rolls every and between its rows to or on snap a cascade apart, so the change runs down the group; rules arrive from zero height on glide and leave on the exit ease while the gap closes on glide. Every change re-runs the query and the count rolls to its new figure a digit at a time on snap, chips above summarise the query and lead back to their rows, and the controls are native selects and inputs in groups and radio groups.

props.name: nesting
props.description: How deep groups may nest, 0 to 3. At 0 the query is a flat list of rules with no Add group and no inner rails.

props.name: chips
props.description: A strip of chips above the builder summarising each top-level rule or group; a chip focuses its row and its × removes it.

props.name: count
props.description: The result readout: a rolling row count, the share with a meter that glides to it, or none.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The query: a root group of rules and nested groups. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the control that changed the query, with the whole new query.

props.name: fields
props.description: What can be filtered on: id, label, type (text, number, enum, date, boolean), enum options, number prefix and suffix.

props.name: rows
props.description: The records the count and preview are taken over. The default is 2,400 seeded transactions.

props.name: matches
props.description: A count from your server; overrides counting rows.

props.name: total
props.description: The total from your server. Defaults to rows.length.

props.name: now
props.description: Where "in the last N days" counts back from.

props.name: onApply
props.description: The footer's Show button, and Enter in a value. Without it there is no Show button.

props.name: applyLabel
props.description: The Show button's verb; the count follows it.

props.name: maxRules
props.description: Rules allowed in the whole query; the Add buttons disable at the limit.

props.name: noun
props.description: What a row is called in the count and its announcement.

props.name: formatCount
props.description: Counts as text. Defaults to grouped digits in en-US, so the server and the browser print the same.

props.name: renderRow
props.description: One row of the desktop preview. Defaults to the first text field, a few others as meta, and the first number on the right.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the count has arrived, for a server count: Counting… while loading, Count unavailable with Try again on error.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed while status is "error".

props.name: title
props.description: The builder's heading; also its accessible name unless label is given.

props.name: label
props.description: The builder's accessible name. Defaults to the title.

props.name: sound
props.description: A click for each field, condition or match change, a pop for each rule or group added and a lower one for each removed. Typing is silent.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Read only: the query shows and nothing changes.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It is at most 560px tall and its body scrolls between a fixed header and footer.

usageNotes: Keyboard: every rule is three native controls and a remove button in tab order; All / Any is a radio group on the arrow keys; Enter in a value applies. A new rule takes focus on its field the moment it arrives, and a removed one hands focus to its neighbour or to the group's Add button.

Rules without a usable value are drawn dashed and left out of the count (a bad number is marked invalid); a group with nothing left in it lets every row through. matchFilter(query, row, fields, now) is exported to run the same logic on your side.
The count is announced politely once typing settles (half a second); adding, removing and clearing are announced at once.
Under reduced motion rows and chips fade without travel, digits swap instead of rolling and joiners swap without the flip; the count, the meter and focus still move.
Lays out by its own width: rules on two lines on a phone, one line from 40rem, and a preview of the newest matching rows beside the builder from 68rem.

items.title: Cohort Grid
items.tagline: Who stayed, week by week.
items.description: A cohort retention triangle built from weekly cohorts: cells fill in on snap along the diagonals, the rows or the columns, the whole sweep inside 600ms, and a Users / Revenue switch slides its thumb on snap and recolours the grid in the same order. Pointing at a cell or stepping with the arrow keys lays a row band and a column band through it that ride between cells on snap, while the curve above, sharing the grid's week columns, morphs from the size-weighted average to that cohort on glide and carries on as a dashed projection past the weeks it has lived. It is a real grid with one tab stop: arrows walk the triangle, Home and End reach a row's ends, Enter pins a cohort and Escape lets it go.

props.name: cascade
props.description: The order the cells fill in and recolour in. Changing it replays the fill.

props.name: metric / defaultMetric
props.description: What the cells measure: users retained as a share of the cohort, or revenue as a share of week 0 (which can pass 100%). Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onMetricChange
props.description: Fires from the switch or arrow key that changed the metric.

props.name: curve
props.description: The summary curve over the grid: filled, a line, or none.

props.name: cohorts
props.description: One per week of sign-ups, oldest first: id, start (YYYY-MM-DD), size, and users and revenue per week since.

props.name: weeks
props.description: Week columns shown. Defaults to the longest cohort, at most 12.

props.name: now
props.description: Today: the week each cohort is living through is hatched in progress and left out of the averages.

props.name: selected / defaultSelected
props.description: The pinned cohort: the curve and the side panel hold it when the pointer leaves. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Fires from the click or key that pinned or unpinned a cohort.

props.name: onCellSelect
props.description: Enter on a cell, or a click on it.

props.name: onCrosshairChange
props.type: (cell: { cohortId: string; week: number } | null) => void
props.description: The crosshair moved to a cell by pointer or key, or left the grid. Use it to link other views.

props.name: format
props.description: A cell's value, a share (0.31 is 31%), as text. Defaults to a whole percent.

props.name: formatMoney
props.description: Money in the readouts and the side panel. Defaults to whole US dollars, en-US.

props.name: formatDate
props.description: Cohort labels. Defaults to "Aug 3", in UTC.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the cohorts have arrived: a skeleton triangle while loading, a message with Try again on error.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed while status is "error".

props.name: title
props.description: The grid's heading; also its accessible name unless label is given.

props.name: label
props.description: The grid's accessible name. Defaults to the title.

props.name: sound
props.description: A tick for each cell you step to or click, pitched by its value, and one for a metric switch.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Read only: cells still read out; nothing pins and the metric is fixed.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It is at most 560px tall and scrolls inside itself.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the heatmap is a grid with one tab stop. Arrows walk the triangle (Down into a younger cohort lands on its last week), Home and End reach a row's ends, Ctrl+Home and Ctrl+End the corners, Page Up and Page Down five cohorts, Enter or Space pins the cohort, Escape unpins it. Every cell is named in full: "Aug 3 cohort, week 4: 31%, 402 of 1,297 users".
The week a cohort is still living through (from now) is hatched and left out of the averages and the curve, which projects it along the average's shape instead.
Cells are pigment mixed into the card in oklab — cobalt for users, signal for revenue — so the ramp reads the same in light and dark; strong cells switch to light text.
Under reduced motion the cells appear together, the recolour is a short fade with no sweep, and the bands and the curve jump to their place; values, the crosshair and the pinned cohort still change.
Lays out by its own width: on a phone the grid scrolls sideways inside its box with the cohort column held, KPI tiles join from 40rem, and a side panel with the focused cohort and the key from 68rem.

items.title: Activity Stream
items.tagline: Everything that just happened.
items.description: A live activity feed where new events gather behind an "N new" pill instead of shoving the list under the reader: the faces behind them land on the pill on recoil and the count rolls on snap. Pressing it scrolls the feed to its top on glide and releases them in a cascade while everything below glides down, each revealed line keeping a wash that fades over two seconds; switching the grouping between person, type and none glides every line to its new seat, and relative times tick on a timer set for the next boundary any line will cross. The list is a role="feed" of articles with one roving tab stop — Up and Down move between lines, Page keys between articles, Home and End to the ends, Enter opens — and the kind chips are toggle buttons.

props.name: rate
props.description: How many events arrive per minute from incoming while live; 0 stops arrivals. Sets how fast the pill fills.

props.name: group
props.description: How the feed groups: consecutive events by one person, by one type, or one article per event. Changing it glides every line to its new seat.

props.name: pill
props.description: How new events wait: behind a pill of faces and a rolling count, behind a plain count, or not at all — they slide in at the top as they land.

props.name: events
props.description: The history, in any order: id, actor, kind, action, target, detail and at (Date or ms). Ids added after mount wait behind the pill like arrivals.

props.name: incoming
props.description: Events still to come (no time yet), released in order at rate and stamped with the stream's clock; the list loops with fresh ids.

props.name: actors
props.description: Who can act: id, name, an optional role shown in group headers and an optional tint (any CSS colour) for the avatar.

props.name: kinds
props.description: What can happen: id, label, plural and an optional 16px icon. Each kind present becomes a filter chip with its count.

props.name: now
props.description: The time the stream starts from. Relative times are measured from it, never from the wall clock during render.

props.name: live
props.description: The clock runs on from now in real time and incoming arrives. Off: the clock holds and nothing arrives.

props.name: filter / defaultFilter
props.description: The kind ids shown; empty shows everything. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onFilterChange
props.description: Fires from the chip that changed the filter, with the new kind ids.

props.name: onReveal
props.description: The pill was pressed: fires with the events it brought into the feed, newest first.

props.name: onArrive
props.description: An incoming event arrived, stamped with the stream's clock.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: A line was pressed or opened with Enter.

props.name: groupWindow
props.description: Consecutive events further apart than this many minutes start a new group.

props.name: collapseAfter
props.description: Lines a group shows before a Show N more disclosure, whose height glides open to what its lines measure.

props.name: height
props.description: The panel's height in px; the feed scrolls inside it.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the history has arrived: loading shows a skeleton and marks the feed busy, error a retry.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after the history failed to load.

props.name: title
props.description: The panel's heading.

props.name: label
props.description: The panel's accessible name. Defaults to the title.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: What an empty feed says.

props.name: formatTime
props.description: The absolute time in a line's title. Defaults to a fixed, locale-free "30 Sep, 14:05 UTC".

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a plip for filter chips and Show more, and a pop when the pill reveals. Arrivals and ticks are always silent.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the feed but refuses filters, reveals and opens; arrivals keep gathering.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer panel.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the feed has one tab stop. Up and Down move between lines and Show more buttons, Page Down and Page Up jump to the next or previous article, Home and End to the ends, Enter opens a line. The pill is a button named with its count; revealing from the keyboard moves focus to the newest revealed line.

Feed it either way: let the component release a scripted incoming list at rate (looped with fresh ids), or set live={false} and append to events yourself — new ids wait behind the pill exactly like arrivals.

Times come from now plus the stream's own running clock, so server and browser render the same markup; the clock pauses its updates while the page is hidden or the feed is off screen and catches up when it returns.
A polite status speaks once when updates start waiting, once per reveal and once per filter change — never per arrival or clock tick.

Reduced motion: the feed simply lists. Arrivals, reveals and regrouping swap in place, the count changes without rolling and the pill fades; the fresh wash still fades, because what is new is information.
Lays out by its own width: chips in a scrolling row on a phone, a sidebar of kind filters and people from 640px, and an hourly histogram with each line's detail inline from about 1090px.

items.title: Region Map
items.tagline: Pick a region; the map leans in.
items.description: A choropleth of invented regions with the numbers behind every colour. Picking a region leans the map toward it: the camera — centre and scale written into the SVG viewBox — glides on glide to frame it, the region lifts above its neighbours on snap with a flat shadow while the rest dim, and the side panel swaps the ranking for the region's numbers and trend, with Previous and Next travelling region to region by rank. The legend is a slider you scrub: a bracket follows the finger 1:1 and lights only the regions inside the band, then springs onto the class under it on snap with the throw's velocity. The map is a listbox where arrows move to the nearest region in that direction, Enter picks and Escape leans out; the legend takes arrows, Home, End and Escape.

props.name: zoom
props.description: How far the map leans in on a picked region, from 1 (it stays put and only highlights) to 4.

props.name: legend
props.description: Stepped classes or a continuous ramp — for the fills, the legend, and how a scrubbed band snaps (to a class, or wherever it is let go).

props.name: scheme
props.description: The colour scheme: one hue, a warm heat ramp, or a diverging pair around zero for changes. Fills are pigment mixed into the card colour, so both themes read.

props.name: regions
props.description: The regions as SVG paths in the map's viewBox: id, name, d, and an optional box ([x, y, width, height], measured from the path when omitted) and label point. The default is fourteen regions generated once from seeded points.

props.name: viewBox
props.description: The map's extent: what the camera shows when nothing is picked.

props.name: stats
props.description: What is measured: id, label, kind (count, money, percent as a fraction, or number), an optional unit word and signed for changes. Each becomes a metric option and a row in the details panel.

props.name: data
props.description: One datum per region: its values per stat id and optional trends (recent readings, oldest first) drawn in the details panel. Regions without a datum read as no data.

props.name: metric / defaultMetric
props.description: The stat id the map is coloured and ranked by. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onMetricChange
props.description: Fires from the metric switch with the new stat id. A band is cleared with it, since it was in the old metric's units.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The picked region the map leans toward, or null for the whole map. Controlled or uncontrolled; a host change moves the camera the same way a click does.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the click, key or button that picked a region, or with null when the map leans out.

props.name: band / defaultBand
props.description: The [low, high] values the legend highlights; regions outside it fade back. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onBandChange
props.description: Fires when a scrub settles, a tap or key moves the band, or it is cleared.

props.name: steps
props.description: Classes in the stepped legend, 3 to 7, laid on round numbers that hold every value.

props.name: format
props.description: How a value reads in the tooltip, the panel and the spoken text. Defaults to the stat's kind in locale.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale for numbers and money.

props.name: currency
props.description: The currency for money stats.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the numbers have arrived: loading shows a skeleton, error a retry over the map.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after the numbers failed to load.

props.name: title
props.description: The map's heading.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: A quieter line under the heading.

props.name: label
props.description: The map's accessible name. Defaults to the title.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: The tallest the surface grows, in px; it scrolls inside itself past that (the phone layout does).

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a swish whenever the camera moves, panned to the region, and a plip as a scrubbed band crosses into a new class.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the map and its numbers but refuses picks, bands and metric changes.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer panel.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the map is one tab stop (a listbox with an active region). Arrows move to the nearest region in that direction, Home and End to the first and last by rank, Enter or Space picks, Escape leans out — or, with nothing picked, clears the band. The legend is a slider: arrows move the band a class (or a tenth of a ramp), Page keys two, Home and End to the ends, Escape or Delete clears it. The ranking rows take Up, Down, Home and End.
Bring your own geography: pass regions as SVG paths in your viewBox. Give each a box when you can; without one it is measured from the rendered path once, after mount.
The default map is generated once from seeded points with arithmetic only — no trigonometry — so the server and every browser draw the same coast to the last digit.
A polite status speaks once per pick, band and metric change, never while a scrub is moving.

Reduced motion: the camera cuts instead of travelling, the picked region does not lift (its outline and the dimming still mark it), the panel swaps on opacity and the bracket jumps to its class. Colours, bands and numbers are unchanged.
Lays out by its own width: stacked with the top five regions on a phone, map and a 15rem panel side by side from 640px, and a wider map with summary figures over a 20rem panel from about 1090px.

items.title: Tree Map
items.tagline: Zoom into where it adds up.
items.description: A spending treemap you zoom into with a real relayout. Every node has a rectangle in every view — squarified fresh for the plot's shape inside the focus, and the root's layout seen through the camera outside it — so a zoom glides each tile on glide from where it was to where it goes: the chosen category opens out to fill the plot while its children re-squarify into the new shape, siblings fly off past the edges and fade on the exit ease, and grandchildren grow out of their parent's old box; breadcrumbs reverse it. Labels are decided from each tile's final size and fade as they come and go, and a readout names the tile under the pointer. The tiles are buttons with one roving tab stop: arrows move to the nearest tile in that direction, Enter zooms in or selects a leaf, Backspace and Escape zoom out, and focus lands on the tile you came out of.

props.name: depth
props.description: How many levels the view draws below the node in focus, 1 to 3: 1 is flat tiles, 2 and 3 frame each tile with a header and nest its children inside.

props.name: labels
props.description: Tile labels: name, amount and share where they fit (fewer lines where they do not, none on slivers); the name alone; or none.

props.name: palette
props.description: How tiles are coloured: a hue per top-level category shaded by rank, one hue by share of the focus, or warm for spend that grew and green for spend that shrank.

props.name: data
props.description: The tree: id, name, children, and on leaves a value and an optional previous value. A parent's amount is the sum of its children; color overrides the palette for a branch.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The id of the node the view is zoomed into. Controlled or uncontrolled; an id that is not a parent falls back to the root.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the tile, crumb or key that zoomed, with the new focus id.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: A leaf was pressed or chosen with Enter, with the path from the root down to it.

props.name: format
props.description: How an amount reads in tiles, the readout, the table and spoken names. Defaults to whole currency in locale.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale for amounts and shares.

props.name: currency
props.description: The currency for amounts.

props.name: period
props.description: The period the amounts cover, shown beside the total.

props.name: compareLabel
props.description: What the change is measured against, in the readout and spoken names.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the numbers have arrived: loading shows a skeleton of blocks, error a retry.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after the numbers failed to load.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name. Defaults to the title.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a swish on every zoom (higher in, lower out) and a click for a leaf, a crumb or a keyboard move.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the spend but refuses zooms and selections.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer panel.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the top-level tiles are one tab stop. Arrows move to the nearest tile in that direction, Home and End to the largest and smallest, Enter or Space zooms in (or selects a leaf), Backspace and Escape zoom out — Escape only when there is a level to leave. After a zoom, focus lands on the first tile, or on the tile you came out of.
A press anywhere inside a top-level tile — on a nested tile too — acts on that tile, so depth 2 and 3 are previews of what a zoom will show.
The layout is squarified with arithmetic only, from the plot's measured size: the server renders a 2:1 layout and the browser settles to its own shape at once, without animating.
A polite status speaks each zoom and selection once; the readout under the plot is visual, and every tile carries its full reading in its name.
Reduced motion: nothing travels — the new view cross-fades in over the old one, leaving tiles fading where they stood. Labels, colours and the readout are unchanged.
Lays out by its own width: a 4:5 plot with crumbs that scroll on a phone, a 2:1 plot with the palette key from 640px, and a ranked table of the focus's children beside it from about 1090px.

items.title: Chart Morph
items.tagline: One dataset, any shape.
items.description: A multi-series chart whose type is a shape the data takes, not a different drawing. Each series is one path rebuilt every frame from a few motion values — per point a flat top joined to the next by cubics that are either a notch to the floor or the curve between the points, plus a dot — so bars, line, area and dots are four settings of the same numbers, and a type change moves the points in a left-to-right sweep on glide: bars narrow and their notches rise into the curve, dots swell from the line or bars retract into them. The window, the y scale and each series' visibility glide too, gridlines riding the scale, and a cursor snaps to the nearest point on snap with a ring per series and a readout beside it. The type switch is a radio group, the legend toggle buttons, and the plot a slider: arrows step the cursor, Page keys three, Home and End to the ends, Escape clears it.

props.name: type / defaultType
props.description: The chart type. Changing it morphs the same points into the new shape in a left-to-right sweep. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onTypeChange
props.description: Fires from the type switch with the new type.

props.name: smooth
props.description: Curve tension for the line and the area, 0 (straight segments) to 1 (monotone curves that never overshoot a reading); bars round their corners by it.

props.name: points
props.description: How many of the latest readings are shown, from 2 to all of them. A change glides the window, so points slide in from the left or out past it.

props.name: series
props.description: The series: id, label, values (one per label, oldest first) and an optional colour (any CSS colour; defaults to the house pigments).

props.name: labels
props.description: One label per reading, oldest first, such as "Sep 2026". The axis shows the first word; the readout and spoken text the whole label.

props.name: hidden / defaultHidden
props.description: Series ids toggled off in the legend. A hidden series flattens to the floor and fades while the others re-dodge. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onHiddenChange
props.description: Fires from the legend with the new hidden ids. The last visible series refuses to hide.

props.name: onCursorChange
props.description: The point under the cursor changed (an index into labels), or the cursor left.

props.name: wave
props.description: How far a type change sweeps across the points, 0 (all at once) to 1 (a full left-to-right wave).

props.name: format
props.description: How a reading prints on the axis, the legend, the readout and in spoken text. Defaults to compact currency in locale.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale for readings.

props.name: currency
props.description: The currency for readings.

props.name: title
props.description: The chart's heading.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: A quieter line under the heading, before the latest total.

props.name: label
props.description: The chart's accessible name. Defaults to the title.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the readings have arrived: loading shows a skeleton of bars, error a retry.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after the readings failed to load.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a swish on a type change, pitched by type, and a tick when the cursor reaches a new point or a series is toggled.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the chart but refuses type, series and cursor changes.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer panel.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the type switch is a radio group (arrows move and select). The legend's series are toggle buttons. The plot is a slider over the visible points: Left and Right step the cursor (the first press lands on the latest point), Page Up and Page Down move three, Home and End jump to the ends, and Escape clears the cursor — only when there is one.
Every type is the same geometry with different numbers, so a change in the middle of another carries on from the shapes on screen rather than restarting.
The y scale rounds up to three to five even steps over the visible series in the window; hiding a series or changing points glides it, and each gridline keeps its value as it moves.
The plot's aria-valuetext reads the cursor's label and every visible series' value; a polite status speaks type and series changes once.
Reduced motion: types, windows, scales and series change at once behind a 150ms fade of the marks; the cursor and its readout jump. Every value still updates.

Lays out by its own width: an icon-only type switch and a 200px plot on a phone, a labelled switch and a 300px plot from 640px, and a summary table of each series' total, average and change beside the plot from about 1090px.

items.title: Setup Checklist
items.tagline: Getting started, one step at a time.
items.description: An onboarding checklist whose steps open into their own inline action — a field, a choice or one button — on glide to a measured height, while the open step is lifted out as a raised card that travels between rows on glide, placed from the rows' own motion values so it tracks them exactly as they open and close. Finishing a step fills its disc on snap, draws its check on flick and fills the progress ring's share on glide; a beat later the next unfinished step slides into focus, and the last one lands the all-set state with seeded sparks and a check stamped on recoil before Dismiss folds the list into one line. The headers are an accordion: Up and Down move, Enter and Space open, Escape closes a step and returns focus to its header.

props.name: steps
props.description: The steps in order: title, description, minutes, optional flag and the inline action (button, field or choice) each opens into.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Which steps are done or skipped, by id. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the action, Skip or key that finished a step, with the whole new progress.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: The open step, or null for none. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires when a header press, a key or the advance after a finished step opens another.

props.name: dismissed / defaultDismissed
props.description: Folds the checklist away into a one-line bar with a Show button. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onDismissedChange
props.description: Fires from Dismiss, Skip setup for now, and the bar's Show.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Runs a step's action with the field's text or the chosen option's id. A returned promise holds the button pending; a rejection's message is shown on the step. Without it, actions finish at once.

props.name: onSkip
props.description: An optional step was skipped. A skipped step counts as finished and can still be done later.

props.name: ring
props.description: How progress is drawn: one round stroke, one arc per step, or a dial of forty ticks.

props.name: expand
props.description: The open step as a raised card that travels between steps, or flush in the list with an accent bar that travels.

props.name: celebrate
props.description: The all-set moment: seeded sparks with a stamped check, the whole ring landing on recoil, or colour alone.

props.name: advance
props.description: Finishing a step opens the next unfinished one and moves keyboard focus to it.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading and the region's accessible name.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: The line under the heading.

props.name: doneTitle
props.description: The heading once every step is finished.

props.name: doneBody
props.description: The line under it.

props.name: status
props.description: Loading draws placeholder rows; error offers Retry.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: The Retry button of the error state.

props.name: label
props.description: The region's accessible name, when it should differ from the title.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a plip as a step you finished checks off, rising with progress, and a chime when your action finishes the list. Off unless asked for.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the checklist but takes no presses or keys.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It is content-sized; give it a height and it scrolls inside, bringing each newly opened step into view.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the step headers are an accordion. Up and Down move between them, Home and End jump, Enter or Space opens and closes, Escape inside an open step closes it and returns focus to its header. Choice actions are a radiogroup: arrows select. After a step finishes, focus follows the advance to the next step's header, or to Dismiss when the list is done.

Reduced motion: nothing glides or bounces. Bodies open at once, the lift moves at once, no sparks and no stamp, and the check appears whole — but the ring still takes its new share on a short tween and the count still changes, because progress is the information.

Actions are yours: return a promise from onAction and the step's button holds a pending label at its own width until it settles; reject with an Error and its message is shown on the step as an alert. Email fields are checked before onAction is called.

Layout follows the component's own width: under 640px the ring sits beside the title above the list; from 640px a summary column holds a large ring and Skip setup for now; from 960px an open step lays its description and its action side by side.

Progress is controlled through value / onValueChange as a map of step id to "done" or "skipped", so it persists however your app stores onboarding state. Announcements are made from the value the host renders, so a host that refuses a change is never announced.

items.title: Sign In
items.tagline: In, by whichever way you like.
