items.description: An authentication card: email first under generic single sign-on buttons, then a choice of method, a code or a password slides in from 16px on glide while the card's height glides to the new step and the step pips widen on snap. The code is one real input drawn as cells — a ring slides on snap to the cell the next digit lands in, digits land on snap, a paste fills them all, and a full code verifies itself under a travelling wave — while a refused field shakes on a symmetric tween, never a spring, and an accepted sign-in flies the button that finished it into the welcome's avatar on glide. Every step is a real form: Enter submits, Escape goes back a step, and focus moves to each step's first field as it arrives.

props.name: steps
props.description: What follows the email: a choice of method, straight to an emailed code, or straight to a password.

props.name: shake
props.description: How far a refused field shakes, in px; 0 for no shake.

props.name: cells
props.description: How many digits the sign-in code has, 4 to 8.

props.name: brand
props.description: The product's name, in the heading and the accessible name.

props.name: mark
props.description: The product's mark, 32px. Defaults to the brand's initial on a tile.

props.name: providers
props.description: Single sign-on buttons above the email field, each with a label and an icon; an empty list hides them.

props.name: aside
props.description: The brand panel beside the form from 640px wide: heading, line, points, and a quote from 960px. Null for none.

props.name: email / defaultEmail
props.description: The email address. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onEmailChange
props.description: Fires as the email is typed.

props.name: step / defaultStep
props.description: The step on show. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onStepChange
props.description: Fires from the press or key that moved the flow, before the new step shows.

props.name: onEmailSubmit
props.description: Checks the email before the next step; reject with an Error to refuse it with your message.

props.name: onSendCode
props.description: Sends the code and its link; called again by Resend.

props.name: onVerifyCode
props.type: (email: string, code: string) => void | Promise<SignInAccount | void>
props.description: Checks a complete code. Reject to refuse it; resolve with the account to welcome it by name.

props.name: onVerifyPassword
props.type: (email: string, password: string) => void | Promise<SignInAccount | void>
props.description: Checks a password, the same way.

props.name: onProvider
props.description: Runs a single sign-on button, the same way.

props.name: onSuccess
props.description: Fires the moment a sign-in is accepted, with the account.

props.name: onForgotPassword
props.description: The Forgot password link on the password step.

props.name: onCreateAccount
props.description: The Create an account link under the email step.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a click on presses, a buzz on a refusal and a chime as the welcome lands. Off unless asked for.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the card but takes no input.

props.name: label
props.description: The group's accessible name. Defaults to "Sign in to" and the brand.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. The card is content-sized and lays itself out by its own width.

usageNotes: Keyboard: every step is a real form, so Tab moves through it and Enter submits. Escape goes back a step. Focus moves to each step's first control as it arrives — the email field, the first method, the code input, the password — and to the welcome heading at the end.

The code is a single input with autocomplete="one-time-code" drawn as cells, so a paste (even "123-456"), an SMS autofill and Backspace all behave natively; a press on a filled cell selects that digit so the next one replaces it. A full code verifies itself.

Reduced motion: panels cross-fade in place and the height changes at once, nothing shakes and nothing flies — the danger border and the message still say what was refused, and the welcome fades in with its avatar already in place.

Every network step is your callback. Reject with an Error and its message is shown under the field as an alert; resolve a verifying callback with { name, email } and the welcome greets them by first name. The card never invents an account.
Layout follows the component's own width: under 640px the card stands alone; from 640px a brand panel sits beside it; from 960px the panel widens and shows its quote.

items.title: Upgrade Wall
items.tagline: What you get, and when you pay.
items.description: A paywall whose comparison shows what the chosen plan unlocks: those rows light in a cascade and their locks lift open on snap, and a plan change re-lights only the rows that changed while the chosen column's cells roll and, in the all-plans view, a band slides across to the new column on snap. Plan and billing are radiogroups with pills that slide on snap, every price rolls digit by digit, and the trial is drawn as a track from today to the first charge whose span sweeps in on glide, ticking off each day, with the reminder above it. The purchase button holds its width through pending, success and error — success stamps its check on recoil and turns the track and the unlocked rows green — and the plan and billing groups take arrow keys while the comparison is a real table.

props.name: timeline
props.description: The trial drawn as a track from today to the first charge, as a vertical list of the same three moments, or no trial at all (billed today).

props.name: compare
props.description: The current plan against the chosen one, only what the chosen plan unlocks, or every plan side by side with a band behind the chosen column.

props.name: cycle
props.description: The billing cycles offered: both behind a switch with the yearly saving, or only one.

props.name: plans
props.description: The plans, the current one included: name, tagline, monthly and yearly per-seat price, current flag and badge.

props.name: features
props.description: The comparison rows, each with a value per plan: included, not included, or a short amount.

props.name: current
props.description: The id of the plan the account is on now.

props.name: plan / defaultPlan
props.defaultValue: the first plan with a badge
props.description: The chosen plan. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onPlanChange
props.description: Fires from the press or arrow key that chose a plan.

props.name: billing / defaultBilling
props.description: The billing cycle when both are offered. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onBillingChange
props.description: Fires from the press or arrow key that switched billing.

props.name: seats
props.description: Seats the per-seat price is multiplied by.

props.name: trialDays
props.description: Length of the free trial, in days; the track has a tick for each.

props.name: reminderDays
props.description: How many days before the first charge the reminder goes out.

props.name: now
props.description: Today, for the dates on the timeline. Days are UTC days, so server and client print the same dates.

props.name: format
props.description: Prints every amount: prices, totals and the first charge.

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled purchase state. Without it the wall follows the promise onPurchase returns.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Fires from the press that started a purchase, and again when it settles.

props.name: onPurchase
props.description: Starts the purchase with the plan, billing, seats, trial, amount and first-charge date. Return a promise to hold the button pending; reject with an Error to show its message.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: The Not now button in the corner. Hidden without it.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading and the region's accessible name.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: The line under it: why the wall is here.

props.name: status
props.description: Loading draws placeholders; error offers Retry.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: The Retry button of the error state.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a click on plan and billing changes and a chime when your purchase lands. Off unless asked for.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the wall but takes no input.

props.name: label
props.description: The region's accessible name, when it should differ from the title.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It is h-[560px] by default; pass a height to change it — the columns scroll inside.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the plan and the billing cycle are radiogroups with one tab stop each — arrows move and choose, Home and End jump. The comparison is a real table with row and column headers that say Included and Not included in words; the timeline is read as three sentences.

Reduced motion: nothing rolls, slides, sweeps or stamps. Prices and cells swap in place, the pills and the column band move at once, the trial track appears drawn and success is a colour change with the check whole — every price, date and state still changes.

The purchase is yours: onPurchase receives the plan, billing, seats, whether a trial comes first, the amount and the first-charge date. Return a promise and the button holds Starting trial… at its own width, announced politely; reject with an Error and its message appears under the button, and a plan or billing change clears it. Or drive the button yourself through state and onStateChange.

Layout follows the component's own width: under 640px one scrolling column with the price and the button in a footer; from 640px the summary (price, timeline, button) gets its own column; from 960px the plan switch becomes plan cards with prices.
Dates on the timeline come from now, trialDays and reminderDays, printed as UTC days. Amounts go through format, so a different currency or locale is one function.

items.title: Billing Panel
items.tagline: Cards, invoices and the next bill.
items.description: A billing settings panel built from data: the cards on file are a deck that sits in a pile and fans out like a hand, unfolds into wallet strips, or lies flat, every pose a glide from one function of the deck's measured width; Make default lifts the chosen card, slides it to the front on glide and the Default tag slides across to it on snap. The next bill rolls digit by digit on snap as you drag the projected-usage slider 1:1 — it rubber-bands against what has already been used and lands on its step with the throw's velocity — and invoices download through a promise with a turning ring and a check drawn on flick. The deck is a tablist (arrows open the pile and move, Escape folds it), the projection a slider (arrows, Page keys, Home and End).

props.name: methods
props.description: The cards on file: id, issuer, kind, last four, expiry, holder, an invented network mark and a tint (any CSS colour, kept at a fixed lightness).

props.name: primaryMethod / defaultPrimaryMethod
props.description: The id of the default card — the one charged. Controlled or uncontrolled; defaults to the first method.

props.name: onPrimaryMethodChange
props.description: Fires from Make default with the new default's id. A controlled host that refuses it leaves the deck as it was.

props.name: expanded / defaultExpanded
props.description: Whether the deck is fanned open. Controlled or uncontrolled; ignored when stack is "none".

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Fires from the press, arrow key or Escape that opened or folded the deck.

props.name: onAddMethod
props.description: Add was pressed. Without it there is no Add button.

props.name: onRemoveMethod
props.description: Remove was pressed on a card that is not the default. Without it there is no Remove button; remove the card from methods to see it leave.

props.name: plan
props.description: The plan: name, price per cycle, the next bill's date (YYYY-MM-DD) and the cycle's length in days.

props.name: meter
props.description: The metered part of the bill: name and unit, used so far, included, the slider's max and step, and tier prices per 1,000 units above the allowance.

props.name: taxRate
props.description: Tax on plan and usage, 0 to 1.

props.name: usage / defaultUsage
props.description: The projected usage for this cycle: the slider's value. Controlled or uncontrolled; defaults to the pace so far carried to the cycle's end.

props.name: onUsageChange
props.description: Fires from the drag or key that moved the projection, once per step it lands on.

props.name: invoices
props.description: Past invoices, newest first: number, date, amount, status (paid, open, failed, refunded) and an optional description line.

props.name: onDownload
props.description: Download was pressed. Return a promise and the row waits with a turning ring, then shows a check (or the error, and retries on the next press).

props.name: onChangePlan
props.description: Change plan was pressed. Without it there is no button.

props.name: now
props.description: Today: how far into the cycle the bill is, which sets the pace and the days left.

props.name: format
props.description: Money everywhere in the panel. Defaults to currency in locale.

props.name: formatUsage
props.description: Usage counts. Defaults to compact: 182k, 1.2M.

props.name: formatDate
props.description: Invoice dates from YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to "Sep 1, 2026".

props.name: locale
props.description: The default money format's locale. Fixed, so the server and the browser print the same.

props.name: currency
props.description: The default money format's currency.

props.name: stack
props.description: How the cards sit: a pile that fans out like a hand, a pile that unfolds into strips, or a flat grid.

props.name: estimate
props.description: How the next bill reads: one rolling total with a caption, or the total plus plan, usage and tax lines (each rolling) over a bar that re-proportions on glide.

props.name: density
props.description: Padding, invoice row height and how much each row says: one line, two, or two plus its description.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the billing data has arrived: a skeleton while loading, a message with Try again on error.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed while status is "error".

props.name: title
props.description: The panel's heading; also its accessible name unless label is given.

props.name: label
props.description: The panel's accessible name. Defaults to the title.

props.name: sound
props.description: A click for each press (deck, card, Make default, Remove, Add, Download, Back to pace) and a tick, pitched by usage, for each step the projection crosses.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Read only: nothing opens, moves or downloads.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It is 560px tall and scrolls inside itself; pass a height class to change it.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the deck is a tablist — Arrow keys open a closed pile and move through the cards (Left and Right in the fan and grid, Up and Down in the wallet), Home and End jump, Escape folds it back and returns focus to the front card. Make default and Remove act on the selected card. The projection is a slider: arrows one step, Page keys ten, Home to what is already used, End to the max.
The deck's poses come from its measured width, so the same component fans across a phone column or a desktop sidebar; every card and the Default tag stay inside the deck's own box.

Every amount goes through format and rolls digit by digit; the widest amount the meter can produce is reserved, so a new digit never shifts the layout. estimateBill(plan, meter, taxRate, usage) is exported to print the same total elsewhere.

Under reduced motion cards change pose without travel or a lift, digits change without rolling and the thumb follows without springs or rubber-band; the totals, the Default tag and the download states still change, because they are the information.
Lays out by its own width: one column on a phone (scrolling inside its box), cards and the next bill side by side from 40rem with invoices below, and three columns from 68rem.

items.title: Settings Form
items.tagline: Change what you want; keep what you did.
items.description: A settings form built from typed sections that knows what you changed: a changed field grows an edge bar on snap with a bloom of accent washing into its row, and a save bar slides up on snap counting the changes, its digit rolling as fields change and come back. Discard plays every change backwards — text un-types and re-types, a switch's knob slides home, a choice's indicator slides back, a select's label rolls back down, a range's thumb glides home — newest edit first; Save waits on a promise, then confirms field by field with a check drawn on flick while the count rolls down, and fields the save refuses shake and keep their message. Enter and Ctrl/⌘+S save, Escape takes a changed text field back, every field has its Revert, and each control is native or a real widget.

props.name: sections
props.description: The form: sections with a title, a line of help and fields — text (with prefix and validate), textarea, switch, choice, select or range — each with its own defaultValue.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The saved values, by field id: what the draft is compared against. Controlled or uncontrolled; fields left out use their own defaultValue (settingsValuesOf builds the full set).

props.name: defaultDraft
props.description: Edits to start from over the saved values — a draft restored from an earlier visit. They count as changes: the fields glow and the bar is up from the first render.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires when a save lands, with every saved value. Fields the save refused keep their old value.

props.name: onDraftChange
props.description: Fires on every change to the draft — edits, reverts and each field a rewind brings back — with the ids that differ from what is saved.

props.name: onSave
props.type: (changes: SettingsChange[], draft: SettingsValues) => void | { errors?: Record<string, string> } | Promise<…>
props.description: Save was pressed (or Ctrl/⌘+S, or Enter in a text field). A promise holds the bar in Saving; resolve with { errors } to refuse some fields with a message, reject to keep everything changed.

props.name: onDiscard
props.description: Discard was pressed, with the changes being undone, in the order they will rewind.

props.name: glow
props.description: How far and how bright a changed field's edge glows into its row, 0 to 1. 0 keeps only the edge bar.

props.name: bar
props.description: Where the save bar lives: docked to the panel's bottom edge, a floating pill above it, or in the flow at the form's end.

props.name: rewind
props.description: How Discard undoes: each field plays its change backwards newest edit first, all fields at once, or every value swaps back at once with only the glow fading.

props.name: rewindDuration
props.description: The longest one field's rewind may take, in ms. Short text rewinds faster.

props.name: confirmStagger
props.description: Time between fields confirming after a save, in ms.

props.name: savedHold
props.description: How long "All changes saved" stays before the bar leaves, in ms.

props.name: title
props.description: The panel's heading; also its accessible name unless label is given. Focus lands here when the bar leaves with focus inside it.

props.name: description
props.description: A line under the heading.

props.name: label
props.description: The panel's accessible name. Defaults to the title.

props.name: saveLabel
props.description: The Save button's text.

props.name: discardLabel
props.description: The Discard button's text.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the saved values have arrived: a skeleton while loading, a message with Try again on error.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed while status is "error".

props.name: sound
props.description: Clicks for Save, Discard and Revert, a softer falling click as each rewound field lands, and a pop for each field a save you started confirms.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Read only: every control is disabled and no bar appears.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It is 560px tall and scrolls inside itself, the dock and float bars sticky to its bottom; pass a height class to change it.

usageNotes: Keyboard: every control is native or a real widget — inputs, textarea, select, role="switch" buttons, a radiogroup with roving radios, a role="slider" with arrows, Page keys, Home and End. Enter in a text field and Ctrl/⌘+S save; Escape in a changed text field rewinds that field; each changed field has a Revert button named for it.

The draft lives in the form; the saved values can be yours (value + onValueChange). onSave receives the changes and the whole draft; resolve with { errors: { slug: "That address is taken." } } and those fields shake, show the message and stay changed while the rest confirm.
Validation runs per text field through validate(value); a field with a message cannot be saved — Save shakes it and moves focus there.

Under reduced motion nothing travels: values swap back at once, the glow fades in and out, the bar fades in place, and fields still confirm one by one with a static check, because what was saved is the information.

Lays out by its own width: label above control on a phone; label and help beside the control from 40rem; from 68rem a section nav with a changed count per section and a Changes panel listing each change with its own Revert.

items.title: Integration Hub
items.tagline: Connect the tools you already use.
items.description: A directory of integrations built from data, each with a seeded glyph and a connect switch that does not flip at once: its knob waits halfway on snap while the permissions step slides in as a sheet — from the side or the bottom on glide, or a dialog rising in the centre on snap — listing required scopes locked and the rest as checkboxes, and completes its travel when onConnect's promise lands. Connected cards read their sync (synced, syncing, paused, needing attention) with the time since the last one, and the search filters as you type: cards that stay glide to their new cells, cards that go fade and shrink on the exit ease, and returning ones rise on snap. The sheet is a modal dialog with a focus trap, Escape and focus returned to its opener; categories are a radiogroup, "/" jumps to the search and Escape clears it.

props.name: integrations
props.description: The directory: id, name, category, a line of description, the maker, the scopes it asks for (required or optional), a glyph tint and mark, and its sync while connected.

props.name: connected / defaultConnected
props.description: The ids that are connected. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onConnectedChange
props.description: Fires when a connect or disconnect lands, with every connected id.

props.name: onConnect
props.description: Allow and connect was pressed, with the scopes granted (required plus the optional ones left ticked). A promise holds the sheet in Connecting…; a rejection shows the error in the sheet.

props.name: onDisconnect
props.description: Disconnect was confirmed. A promise holds the sheet until it lands.

props.name: onSync
props.description: Sync now was pressed on a connected card. A promise keeps it syncing until it lands, then it reads synced just now.

props.name: query / defaultQuery
props.description: The search text. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onQueryChange
props.description: Fires on every keystroke in the search, on Clear and on Escape.

props.name: category / defaultCategory
props.description: The category filter: "all", "connected", or a category's name in lower-case with dashes. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onCategoryChange
props.description: Fires when a category is chosen by click or arrow key.

props.name: grid
props.description: The directory's layout: cards with a description and a sync footer, compact tiles, or a list of rows.

props.name: sheet
props.description: Where the permissions step comes from: a side sheet or a bottom sheet sliding in on glide, or a dialog rising in the centre on snap.

props.name: status
props.description: How a connected card reads its sync: a coloured dot with words, a tinted pill with the last sync time, or a stripe down the card's edge that pulses while it syncs.

props.name: now
props.description: Now, for "Last sync 4 min ago". Pass a ticking value to keep the times fresh.

props.name: formatAgo
props.description: How long ago, from a span in ms. Defaults to just now, 4 min ago, 2 h ago, yesterday.

props.name: account
props.description: The account the permissions step says it signs in as.

props.name: appName
props.description: Your product's name in the permissions step: "Fieldline will be able to".

props.name: loading
props.description: The directory has not arrived: a skeleton of cards.

props.name: error
props.description: The directory failed to load: this message, with Try again when onRetry is given.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after an error.

props.name: title
props.description: The panel's heading; also its accessible name unless label is given.

props.name: description
props.description: A line under the heading.

props.name: label
props.description: The panel's accessible name. Defaults to the title.

props.name: sound
props.description: A clack for each switch press and category choice, a pop for Allow and connect, Disconnect and Sync now.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Read only: nothing connects, syncs or filters.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It is 560px tall with the directory scrolling inside and the sheet laid over it; pass a height class to change it.

usageNotes: Keyboard: each switch is a real role="switch" named "Connect Basinworks Drive" — Space or Enter opens the step to confirm; the sheet is a modal dialog with focus on arrival, Tab kept inside, Escape and the backdrop cancelling, and focus returned to whatever opened it. Categories are a radiogroup on the arrow keys; "/" jumps to the search and Escape clears it.

Nothing flips until the host agrees: the knob waits halfway while the sheet is open and only completes when onConnect (or onDisconnect) lands. A connected card in error offers Reconnect, which reopens the permissions step.
Glyphs are procedural (a seeded mark on a pigment tile from the integration's tint), so the directory renders the same on the server and in the browser; never pass a real brand's logo.

Under reduced motion cards swap to their new cells and fade, the sheet fades in place, the knob moves without a spring and the sync icon does not turn; the connected state, the times and the counts still change.
Lays out by its own width: a scrolling row of category chips over one column on a phone, two columns of cards from 34rem of directory, and a category sidebar beside three columns from 68rem.

items.title: Setup Wizard
items.tagline: Four steps, never lost.
items.description: A multi-step setup flow whose rail is also its record: the fill follows the step on glide, and a valid Next lifts the step's answer off the panel and flies it to that step's place on the rail, x on glide and y on snap so the path bows, where it stays. A Next the step cannot take leans the rail toward the next node on flick and pulls it back on snap while each field says why; panels swap by direction by 16px on snap inside a box that glides to the measured height, and the review lists every answer with an Edit link that returns straight to it. The rail is a list of buttons, the panel a real form where Enter is Next, choices are native radio groups moved with the arrow keys, and the new panel's heading takes focus as it arrives.

props.name: steps
props.description: The steps before the review: id, title, description, fields (text, email, url, choice, segmented or toggle with their rules) and an optional summary for the rail.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Every answer, by field id.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the keystroke, pick or switch that changed an answer, with every answer.

props.name: step / defaultStep
props.description: The step on screen; steps.length is the review. Controlled, the wizard asks through onStepChange and waits.

props.name: onStepChange
props.description: Fires from Next, Back, Edit or a rail node with the step asked for.

props.name: onInvalid
props.description: A Next or a rail jump was held, with the fields that need attention.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Runs from the review's button. A promise holds it pending; a rejection's message is shown in an alert.

props.name: onRestart
props.description: Start over was pressed on the finished state.

props.name: rail
props.description: Beside the panel with each answer kept under its step, across the top with answers under the labels, or a slim segmented bar.

props.name: validate
props.description: When a field's message shows: after a held Next, when the field is left, or as you type (with a tick on valid fields).

props.name: direction
props.description: The axis panels travel on between steps.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading and accessible name.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: A line under the heading.

props.name: reviewTitle
props.description: The review step's heading and rail label.

props.name: submitLabel
props.description: The review's button.

props.name: pendingLabel
props.description: The button while onSubmit is pending; the button keeps its width.

props.name: doneTitle
props.description: The finished state's heading.

props.name: doneBody
props.description: The finished state's line.

props.name: status
props.description: Loading draws placeholder rows; error offers Retry.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: The Retry button of the error state.

props.name: label
props.description: The region's accessible name when it should differ from the title.

props.name: sound
props.description: A swish on each step change and clicks on choices, Edit and a held Next.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the wizard but takes no input.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the region; give it a max height and it scrolls inside itself.

usageNotes: Keyboard: Enter in any text field is Next; choices and segments are native radio groups (arrows move and select); rail nodes are buttons that jump to any step already reached, validating the way forward first.
A held Next leans the rail, shows every field's message and moves focus to the first one; a polite status names the fields. Step changes are announced and the new panel's heading takes focus.
Fields validate from data: required, minLength, pattern, a validate(value, values) function, and the email and url shapes. The validate prop only decides when messages show.
Edit on the review jumps back to that step; its button becomes Back to review and returns straight there once the step stands.
Reduced motion: panels cross-fade in place, answers appear on the rail without flying, a held Next flashes the next node instead of leaning, and progress and messages still show.
The region lays out by its own width: a side rail from 40rem, paired half fields once the panel is 36rem wide, and a compact top rail on phones.

items.title: Feedback Widget
items.tagline: Tell us, in ten seconds.
items.description: A feedback widget docked to the edge of a page: its tab opens a panel on glide with a row of drawn faces that wake as the pointer or focus reaches them, the mouth curving into its mood on snap and the pigment rising from grey, the chosen one landing on recoil; a press slid along the row scrubs through them. A choice glides open a text box whose question answers the mood and an optional screenshot that flashes the page and flies its frame into the panel on glide; Send folds the note in half about its crease on glide, tucks it into the tab on the exit ease, and the tab lands on recoil to say thanks. The faces are a radio group (arrows move and choose), Tab stays inside the panel, and Escape closes it and returns focus to the tab.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: The panel is open.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires from the tab, the close button, Escape or a finished send.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The draft: rating (1 to the number of faces, or null), message and screenshot.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the face, keystroke or attachment that changed the draft, and with an empty draft after a send.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Sends the feedback. A promise holds Send pending; a rejection's message is shown and Send retries.

props.name: onCapture
props.description: Takes the screenshot (name and an image src). Without it a drawn sketch of the page is attached.

props.name: faces
props.description: How many faces the rating offers.

props.name: dock
props.description: The edge the tab sits on; the panel opens beside it (above it for bottom).

props.name: steps
props.description: Faces first and the rest after a choice, everything at once, or faces only where a choice sends.

props.name: title
props.description: The panel's question and accessible name.

props.name: prompts
props.description: What the text box asks after a low, middling or high rating.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The text box's hint.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: The longest message; the counter turns warn in the last 10%.

props.name: screenshot
props.description: Offer to attach a screenshot.

props.name: tabLabel
props.description: The tab's word.

props.name: sentLabel
props.description: What the tab and the folded note say once it is sent.

props.name: thanksHold
props.description: How long the tab says thanks, in ms; it waits while the page is hidden.

props.name: fixed
props.description: Dock to the viewport instead of the page passed as children.

props.name: children
props.description: The page the widget docks to.

props.name: label
props.description: The panel's accessible name when it should differ from the title.

props.name: sound
props.description: A pop for each face chosen (pitched by rating) and for the note landing in the tab; a swish as the panel opens, closes and folds.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the tab but takes no input.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which wraps the page.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the tab is a button; the panel takes focus on the first (or chosen) face, keeps Tab inside, and Escape closes it and returns focus to the tab. Faces are a radio group: arrows move and choose, Home and End jump; Ctrl or Cmd with Enter sends from the text box.
In the quick layout a choice sends, so arrows only move between faces there and Space or Enter chooses.
Pass onCapture to attach a real screenshot ({ name, src }); without it a drawn sketch of the page stands in, so the flow can be shown anywhere.

Reduced motion: the panel fades where it sits, faces wake by colour without a spring, the capture fades in, and sending shows a short Sent line before the panel fades, while the tab still says thanks.
The root wraps its children and clips to them; pass fixed to dock to the viewport. feedbackScales names each rating for a host's own status or analytics.

items.title: Help Panel
items.tagline: Answers before you ask.
items.description: A support panel that grows out of a corner launcher: one surface carried from the launcher's circle to the panel's box on glide, shrinking back into it on the exit ease, while the launcher's mark turns into a cross on snap. Inside, views move by direction (a push arrives from 16px right on snap, Back reverses): search with articles suggested for the page before you type and live results with the matched words marked, an article with a helpful vote, a contact form, and a handoff to a live chat where the agent joins, a typing indicator waves and replies arrive on snap, or to a ticket. The search is a combobox over a listbox (Down and Up move, Enter opens), the dialog keeps Tab inside, and Escape steps back a view, clears the search, then closes and returns focus to the launcher.

props.name: articles
props.description: The help centre: id, title, summary, body paragraphs, tags, reading time, views and when it changed.

props.name: context
props.description: The page the visitor is on, matched against articles' tags for suggestions.

props.name: contextLabel
props.description: How that page is named in "Suggested for …".

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: The panel is open.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires from the launcher, the close button or Escape.

props.name: corner
props.description: The corner the launcher sits in; the panel grows out of it.

props.name: suggest
props.description: What waits under the search before anything is typed: articles for this page, the most read, or nothing.

props.name: handoff
props.description: Where contacting support leads: a live chat after the form, a ticket after the form, or straight to the chat.

props.name: greeting
props.description: The line under the visitor's name on the home view.

props.name: user

props.name: agent

props.name: replies

props.name: messages
props.description: Controlled chat: the conversation. When given, the panel shows it and scripts nothing.

props.name: agentTyping
props.description: Controlled chat: the agent is typing.

props.name: onSend
props.description: You sent a chat message.

props.name: onArticleOpen
props.description: An article was opened from a list.

props.name: onHelpful
props.description: Yes or No on "Was this helpful?".

props.name: onContactSubmit
props.description: Sends the contact form (topic, message, email). A promise holds Send pending; a rejection's message is shown.

props.name: onHandoff
props.description: Support took over: a chat started or a ticket was opened.

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: The view on screen changed: home, article, contact, chat or ticket.

props.name: topics
props.description: The contact form's topic chips.

props.name: now
props.description: The clock chat messages are stamped with; without it, the time each one arrives.

props.name: status
props.description: Loading draws placeholder articles; error offers Retry.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: The Retry button of the error state.

props.name: fixed
props.description: Sit in a corner of the viewport instead of the page passed as children.

props.name: children
props.description: The page the launcher sits on.

props.name: label
props.description: The panel's accessible name and kicker.

props.name: sound
props.description: A swish as you open, close and move between views; a pop when you send, vote or send the form. The agent makes no sound.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the launcher but takes no input.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which wraps the page.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the launcher is a button for the dialog; opening focuses the search. Down and Up walk the suggestions or results, Enter opens one, Escape steps back a view, then clears the search, then closes and returns focus to the launcher. Tab stays inside the panel.

The chat is a list whose new agent messages are announced politely, once each; the composer is a real textarea (Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks the line) and your last message says whether it was read.
Uncontrolled, the agent is scripted by replies, with timed steps that wait while the page is hidden; pass messages and agentTyping to drive a real conversation, and onSend to receive yours.
Reduced motion: the panel fades where it sits instead of growing from the launcher, views cross-fade, and the typing dots dim in turn instead of bouncing.
The panel lays out by the page's width (up to 22.5rem, 23.75rem from 64rem) and never leaves the root, which clips to its children; pass fixed to sit in the viewport's corner.

items.title: Invite Flow
items.tagline: Bring the team in.
items.description: An invite form whose addresses become chips as you type a separator, or several at once from a pasted list: each pops in on snap a cascade step after the last, and one that is not an address, is already a member or is past the seats left shakes on a five-key tween once it lands and stays tinted with the reason in its name. Every invitee gets a role (in its chip, in a list with a segmented control sliding on snap, or once for everyone) and the note is optional; Send folds each chip into an envelope where it sits on flick, closes the flap and flies it out across the right edge, x on the exit ease and y on the enter ease so the path rises first, then the count rolls up on snap in a summary of who was invited as what. The chips are a list with roving focus (arrows move, Delete removes, Enter fixes or opens a role listbox) and Ctrl or Cmd with Enter sends from anywhere.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Every address entered, valid or not, with its role.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the keystroke, paste, role pick or removal that changed the list, and with [] after a send.

props.name: message / defaultMessage
props.description: The note sent with the invites.

props.name: onMessageChange
props.description: Fires as the note is typed.

props.name: roleOptions
props.description: The roles an invitee can have: id, label and a one-line description.

props.name: defaultRole
props.description: The role a new address starts with.

props.name: members

props.name: seats
props.description: Seats left; addresses past it are flagged. Omit for no limit.

props.name: onSend
props.description: Sends the invites. A promise holds Send pending; a rejection's message is shown and nothing leaves.

props.name: onDone
props.description: Invite more was pressed on the summary.

props.name: inviteLink
props.description: The shareable join link offered on the summary.

props.name: onCopyLink
props.description: The link was copied.

props.name: chips
props.description: How a chip shows its person: a tinted initial and the address, the address alone, or a name read from it.

props.name: roles
props.description: Where roles are picked: in each chip, in a list under the field, or once for everyone.

props.name: send
props.description: How Send looks: chips fold into envelopes and fly out, gather on Send into one envelope, or tick and fade.

props.name: workspace
props.description: The workspace's name, in the heading and the messages.

props.name: sender
props.description: Who the note is from, shown under it.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The empty field's hint.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: The longest note, in characters.

props.name: status
props.description: Loading draws placeholder chips; error offers Retry.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: The Retry button of the error state.

props.name: label
props.description: The region's accessible name when it should differ from the heading.

props.name: sound
props.description: A pop for each chip you add (rising a semitone each) and each role change; a swish for each envelope leaving.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the form but takes no input.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the region; give it a max height and it scrolls inside itself.

usageNotes: Keyboard: Enter, Tab, comma or semicolon turns the text into a chip; Backspace in an empty box, or Left at its start, moves into the chips. There, Left and Right move, Home and End jump, Delete removes, Enter fixes an invalid chip or opens its role listbox (Alt+Down too), and Right past the last returns to the box. Ctrl or Cmd with Enter sends from anywhere.
Paste a whole list: commas, semicolons and line breaks separate, spaces separate addresses, and "Name <address>" keeps the address. A duplicate is not added; the chip already there pulses.
Send is refused while any chip needs fixing: the invalid chips shake again, the reason is announced and focus goes to the first of them.
Reduced motion: chips appear without popping, problems show by tint and words without shaking, and Send cross-fades to the summary with each chip checked; the count still lands on the number sent.
The region lays out by its own width: two columns from 40rem (about 200px tall, so it fits a 232px card) and one column on phones, where it scrolls inside a capped height.

items.title: Product Detail
items.tagline: Look closer, then make it yours.
items.description: The buying half of a product page, where every choice shows on the piece: the pictures sit in a strip that follows the finger 1:1, rubber-bands at the ends and commits by projection on glide, and a loupe follows the pointer 1:1 to show the glaze at lens power. Choosing a colour floods the new glaze across the picture from the edge nearest the picker on drift, a size grows or settles the piece from its foot on glide, the price rolls its digits on snap, and Add to bag becomes the stepper in the same box as the fill contracts onto the count on glide while − and + scale in on snap. Colours and sizes are radio groups moved with the arrow keys, the pictures a tablist whose panel takes Enter to open the loupe and arrows to move it, and a buy bar docks at the bottom of the scroll box whenever the buy row is out of it.

props.name: product
props.description: The product: brand, name, price, rating, colours, sizes, pictures (render functions of a colour and size), unavailable combinations and detail sections.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.defaultValue: — / the first colour with the featured size
props.description: Controlled or initial colour and size, as { colour, size } ids.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the swatch, tile or size the visitor chose, with the new selection.

props.name: quantity / defaultQuantity
props.description: The count in the bag for the selected variant; 0 shows Add to bag.

props.name: onQuantityChange
props.description: Fires from Add to bag and the stepper with the new count and the variant it is for.

props.name: onAdd
props.description: Add to bag was pressed. A promise holds the button pending; a rejection's message is shown under it.

props.name: onNotify
props.description: Notify me was pressed on a sold-out variant.

props.name: view / defaultView
props.description: Controlled or initial picture index.

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: Fires from the drag, thumbnail or key that changed the picture.

props.name: estimate
props.type: (postcode: string, now: number) => DeliveryEstimate | null | Promise<DeliveryEstimate | null>
props.description: Answers a postcode with a delivery estimate; null means no delivery there.

props.name: defaultPostcode
props.description: A postcode already known; its estimate shows from the start.

props.name: onEstimate
props.description: Fires with each checked postcode and its answer.

props.name: now
props.description: The moment estimates count from; never read from the clock during render.

props.name: maxQuantity
props.description: The most one variant can have in the bag; never more than its stock.

props.name: lens
props.description: The loupe's power, 1.5 to 4.

props.name: variants
props.description: How colours are offered: glaze dots, little pictures of the piece in each colour, or named pills (sizes become pills too).

props.name: sticky
props.description: Dock a buy bar at the bottom of the scroll box while the buy row is out of it, and pin the pictures beside the details.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats an amount for display.

props.name: addLabel
props.description: The buy button's words.

props.name: status
props.description: Loading draws placeholders; error offers Retry.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: The Retry button of the error state.

props.name: label
props.description: The region's accessible name when it should differ from the product's name.

props.name: sound
props.description: A plip on each pick and when the loupe opens, a pop on Add to bag and the stepper.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the product but takes no input.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the region; give it a max height and it scrolls inside itself, which is what the docked bar answers to.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the thumbnails are a tablist (arrows, Home, End); the picture panel takes Left and Right to change picture, Enter to open the loupe, arrows (Shift for further) to move it and Escape to put it away. Colours and sizes are radio groups whose arrow keys move and choose.
Pictures are render functions of { colour, size }, drawn again inside the loupe at its power, so vector art stays sharp; give a size a scale and the piece grows from its foot when it is chosen.
Add to bag morphs into the stepper in the same box and focus moves to + as it arrives; − at one runs the morph backwards and returns focus to Add to bag.
The docked bar watches the buy row against the component's own scroll box: cap the region's height (max-h) so it scrolls, or the bar never needs to show.
Reduced motion: the glaze and the pictures cross-fade, sizes swap without growing, the loupe fades (it still follows the pointer), the price swaps digits; every choice is still shown and announced.
Delivery dates come from estimate(postcode, now), counted from the now prop, so server and browser render the same words.

items.title: Cart Drawer
items.tagline: Everything in the bag, in one pull.
items.description: A bag that slides over the page it belongs to: the panel arrives from the right edge on glide over a fading scrim and can be pulled shut by its header, 1:1 with a rubber-banded overpull and a release or flick that closes on glide with the throw's velocity. Each line's face slides over a tray of actions — Save and Remove, or in full mode a pull right through that removes it — a removed line leaves on the exit ease while its height closes on glide and Undo keeps it for six seconds, steppers roll their counts on snap, and the totals roll, count or cross-fade as anything changes. A bar fills toward free delivery on glide with a van on its leading edge, and when the visitor carries the subtotal over the threshold the bar turns success, flecks spray from its end and the news lands on recoil; Escape closes a tray then the drawer, and every swipe has a button that does the same thing.

props.name: items / defaultItems
props.description: Controlled or initial lines: name, variant, unit price, compare-at price, quantity, max, and a thumbnail or drawn art.

props.name: onItemsChange
props.description: Fires from the stepper, swipe, button, Undo or upsell that changed the bag, with every line.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: Controlled or initial: the drawer is open.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires from the close button, Escape, the scrim or the pull that closed it.

props.name: upsells
props.description: Things that pair with the bag, offered in a sideways row; ones already in the bag are left out.

props.name: onUpsellAdd
props.description: An upsell was added; it is already at the top of the lines.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: A line left the bag: swiped, removed, or stepped below one.

props.name: onUndo
props.description: Undo put a removed line back where it was.

props.name: onSaveForLater
props.description: Save for later was chosen from a line's tray; it has left the bag.

props.name: onCheckout
props.description: Checkout was pressed. A promise holds the button pending; a rejection's message is shown.

props.name: threshold
props.description: The subtotal that earns free delivery, in the currency's major unit.

props.name: shipping
props.description: Delivery under the threshold.

props.name: swipe
props.description: How a line is pulled away: open a tray of actions, pull right through to remove, or not at all.

props.name: totals
props.description: How changing figures move: digits that roll, figures that count through the cents, or a cross-fade.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats an amount for display.

props.name: title
props.description: The drawer's heading and accessible name.

props.name: checkoutLabel
props.description: The checkout button's words.

props.name: emptyTitle
props.description: The empty bag's heading.

props.name: emptyBody
props.description: The empty bag's line.

props.name: onContinue
props.description: Continue shopping was pressed on the empty bag (it also closes the drawer).

props.name: status
props.description: Loading draws placeholder lines; error offers Retry.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: The Retry button of the error state.

props.name: children
props.description: The page the drawer opens over; it is inert while the drawer is open.

props.name: label
props.description: The dialog's accessible name when it should differ from the title.

props.name: sound
props.description: Pops on the steppers and upsells, a brighter one when free delivery unlocks and a low one as a full swipe arms; swishes as the drawer and lines come and go.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the bag but takes no input.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the box the drawer lives in; give it a height.

usageNotes: The drawer lives inside its own box over the children you pass, so it can sit in a page section or fill the viewport (give the box h-dvh and fixed positioning).

Keyboard: opening from your trigger moves focus to the close button and closing returns it; Escape closes an open tray first, then the drawer. Every swipe has a button: each line has Remove and a stepper, and − at one takes the line out.
Focus on a removed line moves to Undo, and Undo hands it back to the restored line. The Undo clock pauses while the page is hidden.
Free delivery only celebrates a change the visitor made — a bag loaded over the threshold, or a host update, unlocks quietly.

Reduced motion: the panel fades in place, lines appear and leave on opacity, swipes still follow the finger but release without a spring, and no flecks fly; the bar still fills and every change is announced.
Money is in the currency's major unit (9.5 is €9.50) and rounded to cents at every sum; pass format for another currency.

items.title: Checkout Flow
items.tagline: Four steps to yours.
items.description: A four-step checkout beside a sticky order summary: a step bar whose pill slides to the current stop on snap, with reached stops drawing a check on flick, and steps that either swap by direction 16px on snap inside a box that glides to each panel's measured height, or stand as sections that fold to a summary line as you finish them. A Continue the step cannot take shakes its head on a short tween, never a spring; delivery choices move the selection on snap and roll the summary's figures, and the payment step draws a generic card where every typed digit drops into its slot on flick and an outline travels on snap to the part the focused field writes. Place order holds pending while the order is placed, then the button itself becomes the confirmation as a shared layout carries its box out on glide, a check draws and the order number lands on recoil; every step is a real form where Enter continues, delivery is a native radio group, and each new step's heading takes focus as it arrives.

props.name: items
props.description: What is being bought: name, variant, unit price, quantity, and a thumbnail or drawn art.

props.name: deliveryOptions
props.description: How it can get there: label, working days from now, price, an optional note and verb.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Every answer: the address, the delivery id, the card (digits only) and whether billing matches delivery.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the keystroke or choice that changed an answer, with every answer.

props.name: step / defaultStep
props.description: Controlled or initial step: 0 address, 1 delivery, 2 payment, 3 review.

props.name: onStepChange
props.description: Fires from Continue, Back, Edit or the step bar with the step asked for.

props.name: onInvalid
props.description: A Continue (or Place order) was held, with the step and the fields that need attention.

props.name: onPlaceOrder
props.type: (values: CheckoutValues, total: number) => void | Promise<{ orderId?: string } | void>
props.description: Place order was pressed. A promise holds it pending; resolve with an order id to show it, reject to show why.

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled place-order state.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Fires as the order goes pending, confirmed or refused.

props.name: onContinueShopping
props.description: Continue shopping was pressed on the confirmation.

props.name: now
props.description: The moment delivery dates and card expiry count from; never read from the clock during render.

props.name: steps
props.description: One step at a time sliding by direction, or every step stacked as sections that fold.

props.name: summary
props.description: The order summary as a sticky column beside the form (a bar on phones), a collapsible bar at every width, or only on the review.

props.name: format
props.description: How the card number formats as it is typed: spaced groups with the caret kept, a guide whose bullets fill in place, or plain digits.

props.name: formatPrice
props.description: Formats an amount for display.

props.name: testCard
props.description: A test card the payment step offers to fill in one press, for sandbox checkouts.

props.name: countries
props.description: The countries offered for delivery.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading and accessible name.

props.name: placeLabel
props.description: The final button's words; the total follows them.

props.name: pendingLabel
props.description: The final button while the order is placed; the button keeps its width.

props.name: status
props.description: Loading draws placeholders; error offers Retry.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: The Retry button of the error state.

props.name: label
props.description: The region's accessible name when it should differ from the title.

props.name: sound
props.description: Clicks on step changes, choices and Edit, a low click on a refused Continue, a chime when the order is confirmed.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the checkout but takes no input.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the region; give it a max height and it scrolls inside itself with the summary pinned.

usageNotes: Keyboard: Enter in any field continues; delivery is a native radio group; the step bar's reached stops are buttons; Edit on the review returns to that step and its button becomes Back to review.

A held Continue shakes the panel on a tween, shows every field's message and moves focus to the first one; a polite status names the fields. Each new step's heading, and the confirmation's, takes focus as it arrives when focus was already inside.

The card number keeps the caret on the same digit as you edit in the middle, and Backspace over a group's space takes the digit before it; the number must pass the checksum and the expiry must be after now.
The card face is decoration (aria-hidden): the fields are the truth, with cc-number, cc-name, cc-exp and cc-csc autocomplete tokens, and shipping tokens on the address.
Reduced motion: panels cross-fade in place, the refusal does not shake (messages and danger borders still show), digits appear without dropping, and the Place order morph becomes a cross-fade.
Control the order with state and onStateChange when the payment answer arrives somewhere else (a webhook, a redirect).

items.title: Order Tracker
items.tagline: Where it is, right now.
items.description: An order tracking surface where one progress value drives everything: the live dot rides the shipment's path between stages on glide as `now` advances, the path fills behind it through a sweeping clip, and on the map strip the van rides its route while the strip pans to keep it centred; reaching the door lands a check on recoil. Grab the dot and it scrubs the history 1:1 — fill, van and a time chip rewinding with it, ticking at every scan — then settles on the nearest scan with the release velocity, while the delivery window rolls digit by digit on snap and Change opens a measured disclosure on glide. The path is a slider: arrow keys step through the scans, Home goes to the first, End and Escape come back to now.

props.name: path
props.description: The progress track's shape: a straight rail, a winding road whose bends the stages ride, or one long arc.

props.name: eta
props.description: How the arrival reads: the delivery window, a countdown to it that rolls as `now` advances, or the weekday.

props.name: map
props.description: The map strip: seeded streets, blocks, a river and parks; a dot grid with the route only; or no strip.

props.name: order
props.description: The order's number, store, carrier and tracking number, the map's origin, waypoint and destination labels, and the full address.

props.name: stages
props.description: The shipment's stages in order: label, when it was reached (or is expected), whether it has been reached, where, and where along the map's route it happens.

props.name: scans
props.description: Every carrier scan: time, text, the stage it belongs to, place, and a warn tone for hold-ups. Past scans are the marks the dot can stop on.

props.name: items
props.description: What is in the parcel: name, variant, quantity, unit price, a pigment and a thumbnail kind.

props.name: shipping
props.description: Shipping charged; 0 reads Free.

props.name: tax
props.description: Tax charged. Defaults to 8% of the items.

props.name: now
props.description: The tracker's moment: where the dot sits between stages and what the countdown reads. Never read from the clock during render.

props.name: delivery / defaultDelivery
props.description: The delivery window (start and end, ms). Controlled or uncontrolled; defaults to the first of windows.

props.name: onDeliveryChange
props.description: Fires from the choice in Change with the new window. A controlled host that refuses it keeps the readout where it was.

props.name: windows
props.description: Windows the visitor may move delivery to. Empty hides Change.

props.name: onHelp
props.description: Get help was pressed. Without it there is no Get help button.

props.name: onScanSelect
props.description: A scan was previewed by drag, key or list (its id), or the preview went back to now (null).

props.name: format
props.description: Money. Defaults to Intl currency formatting in locale and currency.

props.name: formatTime
props.description: Times. Defaults to a 12-hour UTC clock, "2:40 PM", so server and browser agree.

props.name: formatDate
props.description: Dates. Defaults to "Thu, Oct 1" in UTC.

props.name: formatDay
props.description: The weekday the day view shows large. Defaults to "Thursday" in UTC.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for the default money format.

props.name: currency
props.description: Currency for the default money format.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether tracking has arrived: a skeleton while loading, a message and Try again on error.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after tracking failed to load.

props.name: title
props.description: The surface's heading.

props.name: label
props.description: The region's accessible name. Defaults to the title.

props.name: sound
props.description: Ticks for each scan crossed while scrubbing or stepped with a key, a plip as the dot lands back at now, as a window is chosen and as the tracking number is copied. Nothing sounds on its own.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Read only: the history cannot be scrubbed, the map not panned, the window not changed.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is at most 560px tall and scrolls inside itself.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the path is a slider — Left and Right step through past scans, Page keys move three, Home goes to the first, End and Escape return to now. The map strip pans with Left, Right, Home and End, and R recentres it. Change opens on click or Down; arrows move between windows and Enter chooses.

Pass `now` and advance it yourself (a timer, a socket): the dot glides forward on its own spring. A stage counts as reached when `reached` is true or, if omitted, when its time has passed — set `reached: false` on the last stage until the carrier confirms delivery.

Reduced motion: the dot, the van and the pan move without travel, the halo holds still, digits swap and the disclosure opens at once; the fill, the readout and the ETA still change because they are the information.
Layout follows the container: one column at phone width (it scrolls inside its 560px box), map and scans beside the items from 40rem, three columns from 60rem.
All times are formatted in UTC by default so the server render matches the browser's; pass formatTime, formatDate and formatDay for a local clock.

items.title: Product Grid
items.tagline: Filter, and the shelf rearranges.
items.description: A filterable product grid whose shelf moves instead of snapping: when a facet chip or the sort changes, cards that stay travel to their new cells on glide, leaving cards shrink and fade on the exit ease and arriving ones scale in — together, as a wave timed by each card's new position, or as a cross-fade — while every chip's count and the result total roll on snap. A card's quick view grows out of the card itself: the dialog's rounded clip opens from the card's box while the product art flies to its place on the same glide progress, or it rises as a sheet or slides in from the side. Facets are roving-focus toggle groups, sort is a listbox, and the quick view is a modal dialog that traps focus, closes on Escape and gives focus back to its card.

props.name: reflow
props.description: How the shelf rearranges: every card glides together, a wave delayed by each card's new position (kept under 600ms), or a cross-fade with no travel.

props.name: quickview
props.description: How the quick view arrives: grown out of the card, risen as a bottom sheet, or slid in as a side panel (a sheet below 40rem).

props.name: density
props.description: Columns and how much each card says: compact drops the rating for more columns, roomy adds the description and lays phone cards out sideways.

props.name: products
props.description: The shelf: id, name, category, price, compareAt, colour ids, rating, reviews, badge, stock, when it arrived, description and the drawn shape that stands in for its photograph.

props.name: colors
props.description: The glazes products come in: id, name and a pigment tint (any CSS colour, ideally at a fixed lightness).

props.name: priceBands
props.description: The price chips: id, label, inclusive min and exclusive max (omit it for no ceiling).

props.name: filters / defaultFilters
props.description: Categories, colour ids, a price band id and in-stock-only. Controlled or uncontrolled; defaults to nothing set.

props.name: onFiltersChange
props.description: Fires from the chip, or Clear filters, that changed the filters, with the whole new set.

props.name: sort / defaultSort
props.description: The order of the shelf. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onSortChange
props.description: Fires from the sort menu's choice.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: The product whose quick view is open. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires as a quick view is opened from a card (its id) or closed by Escape, Close or the scrim (null).

props.name: onAddToCart
props.type: (id: string, options: { color: string; qty: number }) => void
props.description: Quick add on a card (the default colour, one) or Add to bag in the quick view (the chosen colour and quantity).

props.name: onOpen
props.description: View details in the quick view. Without it there is no link.

props.name: pageSize
props.description: Cards shown before Show more. A new filter or sort starts from the first page.

props.name: format
props.description: Money. Defaults to Intl currency formatting in locale and currency.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for the default money format.

props.name: currency
props.description: Currency for the default money format.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the shelf has arrived: skeleton cards while loading, a message and Try again on error.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after the shelf failed to load.

props.name: title
props.description: The shelf's heading.

props.name: label
props.description: The region's accessible name. Defaults to the title.

props.name: sound
props.description: A click for every chip, sort choice, glaze, stepper and add; a swish as a quick view opens (higher) and closes (lower).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Browse only: nothing can be filtered, sorted, opened or added.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root; its scroller is at most 560px tall and the quick view covers the root's visible box.

usageNotes: Keyboard: each facet is one tab stop — arrows move between its chips, Space or Enter toggles. Sort opens with Enter, Space or an arrow; arrows move, Enter chooses and Escape closes, back on the button. In a quick view Tab cycles inside it, arrows choose a glaze and Escape closes it, returning focus to the card.
Reduced motion: the shelf rearranges on opacity alone, every quick view fades in place, checks appear without drawing and digits swap; counts and order still change.

Counts on chips are what that chip would leave given the other facets, so a reader can see a dead end before pressing it. `matchProducts(products, filters, priceBands)` runs the same test on your side.
Only cards new to the shelf play an entrance; a card that merely moves never does, so sorting a page of fifty reads as one movement.
Layout follows the container: chips in one scrolling row and two columns on a phone, a facet sidebar from 40rem, wider grids from 60rem.

items.title: Bundle Builder
items.tagline: Pick three, save more.
items.description: A bundle builder where picking a product sends its bag flying into the next empty compartment — a thrown arc, a straight glide or a lift and a drop — and the landing is the event: the bag squashes and recovers on recoil, the box dips and the lid hops, and only then do the lid's savings and the totals roll on snap. Bags can also be dragged 1:1 and thrown at the box, gliding in with the release velocity; taking one out flies it home to its shelf while the bags beside it slide over on glide, and the lid, hinged in perspective, closes in on snap as the box fills. Every product has a real toggle and every filled compartment a real remove button, so the keyboard reaches each end state, and landings are announced with the new total.

props.name: slots
props.description: Compartments in the box, 2 to 5. A box that shrinks lets go of the bags that no longer fit.

props.name: fly
props.description: How a picked bag travels: a thrown arc that turns with its direction, a straight glide, or a lift over the compartment and a fall into it with a bigger squash.

props.name: savings
props.description: The deal the lid shows: percent off a full box, a discount that climbs with every bag to percent, or the cheapest bag free once the box is full.

props.name: products
props.description: The shelf: id, name, tasting notes, price, a label tint, roast 1 to 5, and stock (0 is sold out).

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The picked ids in compartment order. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the press, tap, drop or remove that changed the box. A controlled host that refuses a pick sees the bag fly home instead of landing.

props.name: percent
props.description: The full box's discount for flat, and the top of the ladder for tiered, in percent.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: The full box was added to the cart. A returned promise shows a pending ring, then Added with a check on flick, or Try again if it rejects.

props.name: submitLabel
props.description: The submit button's words; the total follows them.

props.name: format
props.description: Money. Defaults to Intl currency formatting in locale and currency.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for the default money format.

props.name: currency
props.description: Currency for the default money format.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the shelf has arrived: a skeleton while loading, a message and Try again on error.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after the shelf failed to load.

props.name: title
props.description: The builder's heading.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: The line under the heading. Defaults to the offer in words, from slots, savings and percent.

props.name: label
props.description: The region's accessible name. Defaults to the title.

props.name: sound
props.description: A pop as a bag leaves the shelf or the box, a thock timed to its landing (higher as the box fills), softer and lower when it lands home or a full box refuses it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Look only: nothing can be picked, dragged, removed or added to the cart.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root; its scroller is at most 560px tall and flights are clipped to the root.

usageNotes: Keyboard: each product's round toggle adds it (Space or Enter) and shows pressed while it is in the box; each filled compartment has a Remove button, and removing moves focus to the bag that slides into its place, or back to the product when the box is empty. Add box to cart stays focusable through pending and success.
Drag works on touch too: the bag art is touch-pan-y, so a vertical swipe still scrolls the shelf and a sideways start picks the bag up. A throw counts if its projected landing is on the box.

Reduced motion: nothing flies, squashes, tilts or shakes — bags appear in and leave their compartments in place, a refused drop flashes the box's outline — while totals, the lid's message and the announcements change exactly as before.
Totals and the lid change when a bag lands, not when it is pressed, so the money never runs ahead of the box; `bundleTotals(products, ids, { slots, savings, percent })` gives you the same sums.
Layout follows the container: on a phone the box rides sticky above a two-column shelf; from 40rem the box is a sticky column beside the shelf.

items.title: Return Flow
items.tagline: Send it back, easily.
items.description: A returns flow built from data that ends as paper in your hand: pick the items (each tick draws on flick), give each a reason as chips, rows or tiles, choose where the refund goes while its digits roll on snap, and the label feeds out of a printer slot in 3px steps like a stepper motor. Pull it down and a rip runs along the perforation from the left while the label pivots about its unripped corner; past the line it comes free and lands on recoil, and released early it swings back on snap with the throw's velocity. Paged, the steps move by direction inside a box that glides to each panel's measured height under a rail whose pill slides on snap; every pick, reason and card is a real checkbox or radiogroup, and Tear off does by key what the pull does by hand.

props.name: print
props.description: What comes out of the slot: a shipping label with carrier band, addresses and a seeded barcode, or a printer-free slip with a large QR and a short counter code.

props.name: steps
props.description: Four pages (Items, Reason, Refund, Label) under a step rail with Back and Continue, or one page where reasons unfold under each picked item and the printer arrives at the end.

props.name: reasons
props.description: How a reason is picked: wrapping pills whose check slides in, rows with a detail line and a growing dot, or two- and three-up icon tiles. Each is a radiogroup.

props.name: order
props.description: The order: id, merchant, delivered date (ms), return window in days, the payment a refund goes back to, both addresses and the items (name, variant, price, quantity, kind, tint, returnable).

props.name: reasonOptions
props.description: The reasons on offer. A reason with note opens a Tell us more field; one with waivesFee (a fault) drops the return fee.

props.name: methods
props.description: Where the money goes. bonus adds credit as a share of the items; fee: false waives the return fee.

props.name: dropoffs
props.description: How the parcel leaves; a fee is taken off the refund.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.defaultValue: nothing picked, the first method and drop-off
props.description: The selection: one line per picked item (quantity, reason, note) plus the refund method and drop-off. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the pick, stepper, reason, note or card that changed the selection.

props.name: step / defaultStep
props.description: The page, 0 to 2 while editing; the label page (3) shows whenever the label state is ready.

props.name: onStepChange
props.description: Fires from Continue, Back or a rail stop, and with 3 when the label is made.

props.name: onCreateLabel
props.type: (selection: ReturnSelection, refund: ReturnRefund) => void | Promise<ReturnShippingLabel | void>
props.description: Make the label. A promise holds the button pending with its width kept; resolve with your label to print it, reject to show the error.

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled label state. Ready prints the label; only a print the visitor started makes sound.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Fires as the label is requested, made or refused.

props.name: shippingLabel
props.defaultValue: one made from the order, seeded
props.description: The label to print: carrier, tracking, RMA, counter code and drop-by date (ms).

props.name: onTear
props.description: The label was torn off, by a pull or by Tear off.

props.name: onDownload
props.description: Download on a torn label. Without it there is no Download button.

props.name: onEmail
props.description: Email it on a torn label. Without it there is no Email button.

props.name: onStartOver
props.description: Start over was pressed: the selection and the label are cleared and the flow returns to its first page.

props.name: returnFee
props.description: The return fee, taken off the refund unless the method or a fault reason waives it.

props.name: now
props.description: The flow's moment: the days-left pill and the default drop-by date count from it, never the wall clock.

props.name: formatPrice
props.description: Turns amounts into text everywhere they appear.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the region's name unless label is given.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the order has arrived: loading shows skeleton rows, error a message with Try again.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after the order failed to load.

props.name: label
props.description: The region's accessible name, when the visible title is not enough.

props.name: sound
