props.description: Clicks for picks, reasons and steps, soft paper bursts as a visitor-started label feeds and a louder paper when it tears.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Read only: everything shows, nothing can be changed.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It is at most 560px tall and scrolls inside itself.

usageNotes: Keyboard: items are checkboxes (Space toggles), reasons, methods and drop-offs are radiogroups (arrows move and choose, Home and End jump), Continue and Back move pages and focus lands on each new page's heading. Tear off reaches the torn label without a pull, and focus moves to its heading.
Reduced motion: panels cross-fade in place, figures swap and ticks appear whole; the label fades in already printed and a press on it or on Tear off swaps to the torn state with its teeth showing.
A Continue the page cannot take shakes once (a refusal never bounces), says why under the footer and focuses the first item or reason that needs attention.

Pass onCreateLabel a promise to hold the button pending; resolve with your carrier's ReturnShippingLabel to print it. Without a label the component seeds one from the order id, so server and client print the same barcode.
refundFor(order, selection, reasons, methods, dropoffs, fee) is exported, so a host can show the same refund the component does.
The root is capped at 560px and scrolls inside itself; at 40rem it adds a Your return summary column, and at 68rem the step rail moves to a vertical list with a live line under each stop.

items.title: Subscription Manager
items.tagline: Skip, swap, or pause.
items.description: A subscription whose schedule is a row of dots you can push around: every upcoming delivery is a dot keyed by its place in the schedule, so skipping hollows it and slides the Next flag to the box that will ship on snap, a new cadence keeps the next box where it is and sends every later dot to its new day on glide, and a pause draws a hatched band across the days it covers. The strip of days drags 1:1, rubber-bands and coasts on glide with the throw's velocity (or turns month pages by direction), the cadence is chips or a detent slider that reshapes the dots live, and the next box swaps by dragging a coffee off the shelf onto a slot, both products flying from where they were on glide. Dots are toggle buttons with roving arrows, the cadence a radiogroup or slider, and a held product is placed with the arrows and Enter.

props.name: calendar
props.description: How the schedule is drawn: a strip of days that drags, coasts and rubber-bands, or month pages (two side by side from 40rem) whose dots hop between days on a cadence change.

props.name: frequency
props.description: How the cadence is chosen: a radiogroup of the common cadences with a sliding pill, or a detent slider from 1 to maxCadence weeks that reshapes the dots live as the thumb crosses each detent.

props.name: swap
props.description: How the next box is changed: drag (or pick up and place) a product from a shelf of alternatives onto a slot, or a Swap button on each slot that opens a listbox with the price difference.

props.name: plan
props.description: The merchant, plan name, the anchor delivery date (ms), per-box shipping, the payment it is charged to and how many days before a delivery it is charged.

props.name: products
props.description: Everything that can go in a box: name, detail, price, a packaging drawing (beans, tin, tea) and a tint.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The cadence in weeks, the skipped dates (YYYY-MM-DD), the resume date of a pause or null, and the product ids in the next box. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the press, drag or key that changed the plan. A cadence change also drops skips that fall off the new schedule.

props.name: onSkip
props.description: A delivery was skipped or brought back.

props.name: onSwap
props.type: (slot: number, fromId: string, toId: string) => void
props.description: A slot's product was swapped.

props.name: onPause
props.description: Paused until a date, or resumed with null.

props.name: onCadenceChange
props.description: The cadence changed: once per chip, once per detent the slider crosses.

props.name: cadences
props.description: The chips' cadences, in weeks.

props.name: maxCadence
props.description: The slider's longest cadence, in weeks.

props.name: horizon
props.description: Weeks of schedule shown on the strip and across the month pages.

props.name: freeShippingOver
props.description: Boxes at or over this amount ship free; the total rolls as a swap crosses it.

props.name: now
props.description: Today on the calendar and the base for the pause choices, never the wall clock.

props.name: formatPrice
props.description: Turns amounts into text.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the region's name unless label is given.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the plan has arrived: loading shows skeleton panels, error a message with Try again.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after the plan failed to load.

props.name: label
props.description: The region's accessible name, when the visible title is not enough.

props.name: sound
props.description: Clicks for skips, detents, pick-ups and pauses; a swish when a swap lands or a cadence chip sends the dots travelling.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Read only: the schedule and box still show, nothing changes.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It is at most 560px tall and scrolls inside itself.

usageNotes: Keyboard: Tab reaches the next delivery's dot, Left and Right walk deliveries, Home and End jump, Space or Enter skips or brings one back. On the shelf, Space or Enter picks a product up, the arrows choose a slot, Enter puts it there and Escape puts it back; in menu mode ArrowDown opens the list and Escape returns focus to Swap.
Pick a date turns the calendar's days into a radiogroup (Left and Right a day, Up and Down a week); the hatched band previews the pause as you move and Enter picks the resume day.
A cadence change keeps the next box on its day and moves the rest; skips that no longer fall on the schedule are dropped from the value it reports.
Reduced motion: dots jump to their days, the strip stops without coasting, the band appears whole and swaps happen in place, while every skip, pause and total still shows.
scheduleOf(plan, value, now, horizon) is exported so a host can show the same next box the component does.
The root is capped at 560px and scrolls inside itself; at 40rem the schedule spans the top, and at 68rem the layout becomes three columns with the calendar in the middle.

items.title: Ratings Summary
items.tagline: What everyone thought, at a glance.
items.description: A product's ratings where the distribution is the filter: the average rolls up on snap, the stars fill from the left on glide and the five bars grow on a cascade, and pressing a bar filters the reviews below, which reflow rather than reload — leavers fade on the exit ease, the rest travel to their new places on glide and newcomers arrive from 8px inside a height that glides with them. One star at a time slides a wash between bars on snap, several toggle with checks; helpful votes roll their count and pop the thumb, and photos from reviews open in a viewer over the component's own frame, growing out of their thumbnail on glide and swiped 1:1 with a projected release. Bars are toggle buttons with roving arrows, the viewer a dialog that keeps Tab inside and gives focus back to its thumbnail.

props.name: bars
props.description: How the distribution is drawn: horizontal bars with star and count, or a five-column histogram rising from a baseline.

props.name: filter
props.description: One star at a time, with a cobalt wash that slides between bars (pressing the chosen bar again clears it), or several stars toggled together, each with a check.

props.name: photos
props.description: Photos from reviews as one scrolling strip of thumbnails, a mosaic with a +N tile (its own column from 68rem), or left out along with the thumbnails on each review.

props.name: reviews
props.description: The page of reviews: author, rating, title, body, date (ms), verified, helpful count, variant and photos (alt, tint, scene).

props.name: distribution
props.description: Ratings per star for the whole product, 1★ first. Counted from reviews when you pass your own reviews without it.

props.name: productName
props.description: The product, shown under the heading.

props.name: stars / defaultStars
props.description: The star filter: the ratings shown, empty for all. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onStarsChange
props.description: Fires from the bar, key or Clear that changed the filter.

props.name: sort / defaultSort
props.description: The list's order. Controlled or uncontrolled; a change reorders the list with a layout glide.

props.name: onSortChange
props.description: Fires when the visitor picks an order.

props.name: voted / defaultVoted
props.description: The reviews this visitor marked helpful. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onVotedChange
props.description: Fires with every helpful mark after a vote.

props.name: onVote
props.description: A review was marked helpful or unmarked.

props.name: pageSize
props.description: Reviews shown before Show more; each press adds this many, cascading in.

props.name: onPhotoOpen
props.description: A photo was opened in the viewer.

props.name: now
props.description: The moment relative dates count from, never the wall clock.

props.name: formatDate
props.description: Review dates to text.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the region's name unless label is given.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the reviews have arrived: loading shows skeletons, error a message with Try again.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after the reviews failed to load.

props.name: label
props.description: The region's accessible name, when the visible title is not enough.

props.name: sound
props.description: Ticks pitched by star for bars, and for photos in the viewer; a pop for a helpful vote.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Read only: the reviews still read, nothing can be filtered, voted or opened.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It is at most 560px tall and scrolls inside itself.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the bars are one Tab stop — Up and Down (Left and Right for columns) move, Home and End jump, Space or Enter toggles. The photo strip roves with Left and Right. The viewer moves with Left and Right, keeps Tab inside, closes on Escape and gives focus back to the thumbnail; See review closes it and focuses that review, clearing a filter that hid it.

Pass distribution for the whole product and reviews for one page of them: the bars and the average describe every rating, the list only the written ones, and a filter that matches none of this page says how many people rated without writing.
Reduced motion: the bars, stars and average appear whole, the filter wash jumps, the list swaps without travel and the viewer opens on a fade.

Photos are procedural and seeded by id (sky, ground, the product in its tint at fixed lightness), so server and client draw the same picture in both themes; replace PhotoArt with real images if you have them.

The root is capped at 560px with a header and its own scroll area; the viewer covers that frame, not the page. From 40rem the summary is a sticky left column, and from 68rem the photo grid gets its own column.

items.title: Gift Builder
items.tagline: Choose, write, wrap.
items.description: A gift card you build by looking at it: the amount rolls onto the card's face digit by digit on snap, a design wipes across it as a circle growing on glide from the side its swatch sits on (or slides in 1:1 under your thumb when you swipe the card itself, committing by projection), and writing the message turns the card over on glide — side to side, or top over bottom — while each new run of characters inks onto the back and the type shrinks on glide to fit. Add to bag runs your promise and, when it lands, a paper band wraps across the card on glide and the seal lands on recoil. Amount, design, send day and the card's face are radiogroups, a slider and a toggle with full keyboard paths, and the card turns to follow the fields focus is in.

props.name: flip
props.description: How the card shows its back: turned side to side about the vertical axis, tumbled top over bottom, or laid beside the front with no turning, both faces updating live.

props.name: designs
props.description: How a design is picked: round swatches or miniature cards (the new design wipes across from the picker's side), or by swiping the card itself with dots as the radiogroup.

props.name: amount
props.description: How the amount is set: preset chips with a sliding pill and a Custom field, or a logarithmic detent slider that is drawn to the presets and settles on its step with the release velocity.

props.name: designOptions
props.description: The designs on offer: id, name, art (meadow, confetti, linen, night, bloom, tide) and a tint drawn at fixed lightness.

props.name: amounts
props.description: The preset amounts: chips, or the slider's labelled detents.

props.name: min
props.description: The smallest amount, for the slider and the custom field.

props.name: max
props.description: The largest amount.

props.name: step
props.description: The slider's step; arrows move one, Page keys five.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The gift: amount, design id, to, from, message, recipient email and the send day (YYYY-MM-DD, or null to send now). Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the chip, key, drag, swipe or field that changed the gift.

props.name: side / defaultSide
props.description: The face the card shows. Controlled or uncontrolled; ignored when flip is none.

props.name: onSideChange
props.description: Fires when the visitor moves to the message (back), the amount or design (front), or turns the card with Show back.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Buy it. A promise holds Add to bag pending with its width kept; reject with an Error to show its message in an alert.

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled purchase state; done wraps the card and shows the confirmation.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Fires as the purchase is asked for, done or refused.

props.name: onReset
props.description: Make another was pressed after a purchase.

props.name: brand
props.description: The shop on the card's face, back and seal.

props.name: maxMessage
props.description: The message's limit; the counter turns warn in the last twenty characters.

props.name: scheduleDays
props.description: Days ahead a send can be scheduled.

props.name: now
props.description: The builder's moment: send days count from it, never the wall clock.

props.name: formatPrice
props.description: Amounts to text, on the card, the chips, the slider and the button.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the region's name unless label is given.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the designs have arrived: loading shows skeletons, error a message with Try again.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after loading failed.

props.name: label
props.description: The region's accessible name, when the visible title is not enough.

props.name: sound
props.description: Paper when the visitor turns the card and as the band wraps; a swish when a design arrives or the amount moves.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Read only: the card and the answers show, nothing changes.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It is at most 560px tall and scrolls inside itself.

usageNotes: Keyboard: amount chips, designs, Send now or Schedule and the send days are radiogroups (arrows choose, Home and End jump); the slider takes arrows, Page keys, Home and End; Show back turns the card by hand. Tabbing into To, From, Message or the email turns the card to its back, and into the amount or design to its front.

Add to bag validates first: a missing name or a bad email shakes the form once (a refusal never bounces), shows each message under its field and focuses the first one. On success focus moves to the Added to bag heading.

Reduced motion: the card never tilts or turns — its faces cross-fade — designs cross-fade instead of wiping or sliding, digits swap, characters appear without inking and the band and seal appear in place.
Designs are procedural SVG in token pigments at fixed lightness, so a card looks the same in both themes; pass your own designOptions with any of the six arts and a tint token.
The root is capped at 560px and scrolls inside itself; from 40rem the card is a sticky column beside the form, and from 68rem the form splits into amount and delivery beside the message.

items.title: AI Workspace
items.tagline: A whole assistant, in one screen.
items.description: A whole assistant screen built from thread-view, prompt-dock and pin-press: a dated, searchable conversation sidebar, a thread whose replies stream in word by word while Send folds into Stop, and an artifact the reply writes line by line in a pane that slides in beside the thread on glide, its column and the thread's edge one motion value, each new line rising 4px on glide; split, overlay and canvas set how the pane arrives, a split divider follows the pointer 1:1 and settles on glide, and pinned conversations glide to the top. Below 640px it becomes a stack of conversations, thread and artifact pushed on glide with the screen beneath shifting and dimming. The sidebar is a roving list (arrows, Home, End), the divider a separator the arrow keys move, Preview and Source a tablist, and Escape closes the pane or goes back.

props.name: density
props.description: How tightly the thread and the sidebar are set: passed to the thread, and the sidebar's rows follow.

props.name: pane
props.description: How the artifact arrives: a column sharing the stage with the thread (with a draggable divider, the sidebar folding when the three cannot fit), a sheet sliding over the thread's edge, or a canvas that gives the artifact the stage.

props.name: theme
props.description: Wear the page's theme, or force light or dark inside the workspace.

props.name: conversations / defaultConversations
props.description: Every conversation: a title, its thread-view messages, whether it is pinned, and the latest artifact it produced. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onConversationsChange
props.description: Fires from the send, stream, pin, edit or reaction that changed them, with all of them. A streamed reply is reported whole when it starts and again when it finishes.

props.name: conversation / defaultConversation
props.description: The open conversation's id. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onConversationChange
props.description: Fires from the row, New chat or key that opened another conversation.

props.name: artifactOpen / defaultArtifactOpen
props.description: Whether the artifact pane is open. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onArtifactOpenChange
props.description: Fires from the strip, the Artifact button, Close, Escape, or a reply that started writing an artifact.

props.name: respond
props.description: Answers a prompt with text and, optionally, an artifact. A promise shows the reply thinking until it settles; a rejection shows it failed, with Retry.

props.name: onSend
props.description: A prompt was sent, from the dock or by editing a sent turn.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Stop, or Escape in the dock, cut a reply short where it stood.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: The artifact was copied.

props.name: models
props.description: The models the dock's pill switches between.

props.name: model
props.description: The selected model's id; its name signs replies and heads the thread.

props.name: onModelChange
props.description: The visitor switched models in the dock.

props.name: user
props.description: Who is signed in, at the foot of the sidebar; prompts are sent under this name.

props.name: workspace
props.description: The workspace's name, at the head of the sidebar.

props.name: now
props.description: The moment the sidebar's groups (Today, Yesterday, Previous 7 days) and times count from, so server and browser agree.

props.name: stream
props.description: How fast a reply streams in, in characters a second.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the conversations have arrived: loading draws placeholders, error offers Try again.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after the conversations failed to load.

props.name: label
props.description: The screen's accessible name.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play the ticks and the pane's swish, only for the visitor's own actions. The composed pieces play theirs too.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Read only: nothing can be sent, pinned or opened.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It is 560px tall by default; pass a height class to change it.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the sidebar is one tab stop whose arrows, Home and End move between conversations and Enter opens one; the divider is a separator that ← and → move 32px and Home and End send to its limits; Preview and Source are a tablist; Escape closes the artifact pane, or on a phone goes back a screen.

Streams are driven by `respond`, never by the clock during render: the reply is reported whole when it starts and again when it settles, and the timer that reveals it pauses while the page is hidden. Pass your own `respond` (sync or a promise) to answer from a real backend, or drive `conversations` yourself and mark a message `status: "streaming"`.
Layout follows the component's own width, not the viewport: a stack below 640px, a sidebar and thread with the pane per `pane` from 640px, and all three side by side from 1040px when they fit.

Under reduced motion nothing slides: columns, the overlay and phone screens swap with a short cross-fade and artifact lines fade in place, while the stream, the writing bar, counts and checks still show.

Composes thread-view (with its composer off), prompt-dock and pin-press; install them with it. The artifact is the latest one a conversation produced; keep a history in your own data if you need versions.

items.title: Mail Client
items.tagline: Three panes, zero clutter.
items.description: A complete three-pane mail screen built around mail-inbox and bin-lid: mailboxes whose current-folder pill travels on snap, the inbox list with its swipe triage, and a reading pane where a thread arrives from 4px on glide, earlier messages open on a measured glide, a quick reply grows on glide and lands on snap, Archive and Snooze leave an Undo toast that lands on recoil, and Delete drops the thread in the bin until its undo ring drains. `folders` keeps the mailboxes as a pane, an icon rail or a drawer that slides over the list on glide; below 640px the panes become a stack whose pushes slide in on glide over a dimming, shifting screen, and a swipe from a pushed screen's left edge follows the finger 1:1 and goes back when the projected throw passes halfway. Back, Alt+← and Escape go back, / searches, c composes, and the list keeps its own j, k, x, e, b, s, u and z.

props.name: density
props.description: Row height and type size in the list, and the reading pane's type.

props.name: preview
props.description: Lines of message preview under each subject in the list, 0 to 2.

props.name: folders
props.description: How the mailboxes live beside the list on wide screens: a labelled pane, a 60px icon rail with badges, or a drawer behind the menu button. A phone always stacks them.

props.name: threads / defaultThreads
props.description: Every thread in every folder (mail-inbox's type). Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onThreadsChange
props.description: Fires from the swipe, key, button, reply or delete that changed the threads, with all of them.

props.name: folder / defaultFolder
props.description: The folder on screen. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onFolderChange
props.description: A mailbox was chosen.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: The thread in the reading pane. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires from the row, the arrows, the back swipe or the action that opened or closed a thread.

props.name: account
props.description: Whose mail it is: shown at the head of the mailboxes, and the sender of replies.

props.name: storage
props.description: The mailbox's storage in bytes, for the meter under the mailboxes.

props.name: now
props.description: The moment times are read against, so server and browser agree.

props.name: zoneOffset
props.description: Minutes east of UTC that times are shown in.

props.name: onSend
props.description: A reply (with its threadId) or a new message from Compose was sent.

props.name: onArchive
props.description: Threads sent to the archive, from the list or the reading pane.

props.name: onSnooze
props.description: Threads snoozed, and until when (epoch ms).

props.name: onDelete
props.description: Threads deleted, once the bin's undo window ran out.

props.name: onStarChange
props.description: A thread was starred or unstarred.

props.name: onReadChange
props.description: Threads marked read by opening them, or unread from the list or the pane.

props.name: status
props.description: Loading draws placeholder rows; error offers Retry.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Retry was pressed after the mail failed to load.

props.name: label
props.description: The screen's accessible name.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play the slides, stars and sends, only for the visitor's own actions; the list and the bin play theirs too.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Read only: nothing can be moved, sent or deleted.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It is 560px tall by default; pass a height class to change it.

usageNotes: Keyboard: / goes to search and c to Compose from anywhere outside a field; the list keeps mail-inbox's keys (j k move, Enter opens, x selects, e archives, b snoozes, s stars, u unread, z undo); Escape closes the reading pane on a wide screen and goes back a screen on a phone, as does Alt+←. Compose and the drawer trap focus and give it back when they close.

Layout follows the component's own width: a stack of Mailboxes, Inbox and Message below 640px, three panes from 640px, a wider list from 1040px. `folders` only changes the wide layouts; a phone always stacks.

The list is mail-inbox held to its list: the screen hands it the filtered threads (search and label), merges its changes back by id, and keeps `open` itself so an opened row goes to the reading pane. Install mail-inbox and bin-lid with it.

Archiving, snoozing or deleting from the reading pane opens the next thread on a wide screen and returns to the list on a phone. Delete is bin-lid: `onDelete` only fires once its undo ring has drained.

Under reduced motion screens, the drawer and compose cross-fade, the edge swipe is off (Back, Alt+← and Escape remain), and messages fade in place, while counts, stars, read state and toasts still change.

items.title: Music App
items.tagline: Library, now playing, queue.
items.description: A complete music screen built with repeat-coil, mute-cone and follow-knot: a library of procedural covers and album pages that push in on glide, and a mini player (a bar, a pill or a corner card) that is one shared surface with the full player, growing from its box to the whole screen while the cover becomes the disc's label and the title and Play travel, all on glide; a downward drag on the grab bar follows 1:1 and, projected past a third of the height, folds it back. The disc (a record, a silver disc, or a sleeve the record slides half out of on glide) spins up like a motor on Play and coasts down under friction on Pause, its angle and the playing position integrated by one frame loop that runs only while something moves and the screen is visible; Up next follows a dragged row 1:1 while the others glide out of its way and settle it with its release velocity. The scrubber is a slider (arrows 5 s, Page keys 30 s, Home and End), the queue is one tab stop (arrows move, Alt+arrows reorder, Enter plays, Delete removes), and Escape closes the queue sheet, then the player.

props.name: disc
props.description: The turning artwork in the player: a record under a fixed sheen with the cover as its label, a silver disc printed with the cover, or the square sleeve with the record sliding half out of it while it plays.

props.name: queue
props.description: Where Up next lives: a panel beside the library on desktop and beside the player on tablet, or a sheet behind a button. A phone always uses the sheet.

props.name: mini
props.description: The mini player's shape, and the shape the full player grows from: a bar along the bottom with a progress line, a floating pill with a progress ring, or a card in the corner.

props.name: albums
props.description: The library: albums with an artist, a year, procedural cover art and their tracks.

props.name: track / defaultTrack
props.description: The current track's id. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onTrackChange
props.description: Fires from the press, the queue or the end of a track that moved to another.

props.name: playing / defaultPlaying
props.description: Whether it is playing. Nothing plays until asked. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onPlayingChange
props.description: Play or Pause was pressed, or the queue ran out.

props.name: upNext / defaultUpNext
props.description: The queue after the current track, as track ids. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onUpNextChange
props.description: Fires from the drag, key, remove, clear, shuffle or track change that changed the queue.

props.name: expanded / defaultExpanded
props.description: Whether the full player is open. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: The mini player was pressed, or the player was closed by its button, a downward drag or Escape.

props.name: repeat / defaultRepeat
props.description: Repeat mode, shown by repeat-coil. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onRepeatChange
props.description: The repeat button changed mode.

props.name: volume / defaultVolume
props.description: Volume 0 to 100, shown and set by mute-cone. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onVolumeChange
props.description: The volume was dragged or keyed.

props.name: muted / defaultMuted
props.description: Whether it is muted. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onMutedChange
props.description: Mute was toggled.

props.name: following / defaultFollowing
props.description: The artists the listener follows, by name, toggled with follow-knot on album pages. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onFollowingChange
props.description: An artist was followed or unfollowed.

props.name: defaultPosition
props.description: Where the first track starts, in seconds.

props.name: onSeek
props.description: The visitor moved the playhead: a scrub, a press on the track, a key, or Previous.

props.name: status
props.description: Loading draws placeholder covers; error offers Try again.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after the library failed to load.

props.name: label
props.description: The screen's accessible name.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play the presses, the ticks of a scrub and the queue, only for the visitor's own actions; the composed pieces play theirs too.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Nothing plays, moves or opens.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It is 560px tall by default; pass a height class to change it.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the full player is a dialog within the screen (focus moves in, Tab cycles, Escape closes the queue sheet and then the player, focus returns to the mini player); the scrubber is a slider (arrows 5 s, Page Up and Page Down 30 s, Home and End); Up next is one tab stop whose arrows move, Alt+arrows reorder, Enter plays and Delete removes, each move announced.

Playback is simulated, with no audio: the position advances from one frame loop that also turns the disc, and it runs only while playing (or while the disc coasts down), while the screen is on screen and the page is visible. The position is reported only when the visitor moves it (`onSeek`); a track that ends moves on through the queue, honouring repeat.

Layout follows the component's own width: two-column covers and a stacked player below 640px; from 640px the player lays its disc beside the controls when it has 560px, and with `queue="panel"` Up next sits beside the player, and from 1040px beside the library too.

Under reduced motion the player cross-fades in and out instead of growing, the disc stands still, the sleeve's record is simply out, and queue rows swap at once; the time, the progress, the bars and every count still move.
Composes repeat-coil, mute-cone and follow-knot; install them with it. Covers are procedural pigments turned from the accent's hue, so they read in both themes without image files.

items.title: Bank App
items.tagline: Money, made calm.
items.description: A complete mobile banking home framed as a phone: a balance card whose digits are wheels that roll down into dots on snap (or frost over, or are wiped out by a bar on glide) when the composed eye shuts, quick actions, a day-grouped activity list that filters with rows closing up on glide, a detail screen pushed on glide and dragged back 1:1 with a projected release, and a send sheet with an amount pad whose characters rise in on snap, with the composed settle button as Send. Wide, the phone unfolds into two panes. Rows rove with the arrow keys, Escape steps back, the sheet is a trapped dialog that digits type into from anywhere.

props.name: account
props.description: The account on the card: name, last four digits, opening balance and currency. The balance shown is the opening figure plus every transaction in the list.

props.name: transactions / defaultTransactions
props.description: The account's activity, any order; shown newest first, grouped by day.

props.name: onTransactionsChange
props.description: Fires with every transaction once a payment made in the sheet has landed.

props.name: contacts
props.description: Who money can be sent to or asked from.

props.name: owner
props.description: The first name in the greeting.

props.name: bank
props.description: The bank's name, over the greeting and in the accessible name.

props.name: now
props.description: The current moment: the status bar's clock, Today and Yesterday.

props.name: zoneOffset
props.description: Minutes east of UTC that times are shown in, so server and browser agree.

props.name: hidden / defaultHidden
props.description: Privacy: true hides the balance.

props.name: onHiddenChange
props.description: Fires from the eye that hid or showed the balance.

props.name: balance
props.description: How the balance hides: its digits roll down into dots, frost over, or a bar wipes across them.

props.name: sheet
props.description: How the send sheet presents: rising while home recedes behind it, covering the screen, or as a floating card.

props.name: density
props.description: Row height 48, 56 or 64px, with avatars, paddings and the balance to match.

props.name: onSend
props.description: Sends, requests or adds the money. A returned promise holds the button until it settles; a rejection leaves the sheet open on Retry.

props.name: onTransactionOpen
props.description: A transaction's detail opened (its id) or closed (null).

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale for amounts.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats an amount (always positive) for the card, the rows and the sheet.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the activity has arrived: skeleton rows, or a message with Try again.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after the activity failed to load.

props.name: label
props.description: The screen's accessible name.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play the pad's ticks and the navigation; the composed eye and Send button play their own.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Greys the screen out and makes it inert.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer wrapper.

usageNotes: Keyboard: Tab reaches the eye, the three actions, the filter (arrows choose) and the activity, whose rows rove with Up, Down, Home and End; Enter opens a row and its heading takes focus. Escape or Back returns focus to the row.

The send sheet is a modal dialog with a trapped Tab: digits, the decimal point and Backspace type into the amount from anywhere in it, the pad is one tab stop that arrows move through, and Escape closes it and hands focus back to the button that opened it.
The balance is account.opening plus the list (pending credits excluded), so a host that controls transactions only has to append the new one in onTransactionsChange for the balance to roll.

Reduced motion: the wheels swap, frost and redact appear by opacity, the detail and the sheet cross-fade in place, and a refused key flashes the figure in danger instead of shaking; every amount still changes and is announced.
It lays out by its own width: a 360px phone below 640px, and above it the phone unfolds into two panes, home and the month's summary or the chosen transaction.

items.title: Project Tracker
items.tagline: Plan it, board it, ship it.
items.description: A complete project screen: a projects sidebar with the composed pin, a view switch whose thumb slides on snap, and the tasks as a list, a board or a timeline — switching is one morph, each task's plate gliding from row to card to date bar on glide while its title glides without stretching. Board cards are carried 1:1 to another column and fly into their slot; timeline bars slide along their row and land on the projected day on snap with the release velocity. A task opens in a drawer (over, pushing or rising) with every field editable and the composed watch and delete buttons; arrows rove the tasks, Shift with Left or Right moves a card a column or a bar's due date, Space ticks, Escape closes.

props.name: projects
props.description: The projects in the sidebar: id, name and the three-letter key that prefixes task numbers.

props.name: people
props.description: Everyone a task can be assigned to.

props.name: tasks / defaultTasks
props.description: Every project's tasks: status, priority, assignee, start and due dates, tag, description, subtasks and watchers.

props.name: onTasksChange
props.description: Fires with every task after any change: a status, a drop, a date, an edit, a new task or a deletion.

props.name: project / defaultProject
props.description: The project on screen.

props.name: onProjectChange
props.description: Fires from the sidebar row or key that chose a project.

props.name: view / defaultView
props.description: The tasks as a list grouped by status, a board of status columns, or bars on a timeline.

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: Fires from the view switch with the new view.

props.name: task / defaultTask
props.description: The task open in the drawer; null closes it.

props.name: onTaskChange
props.description: Fires from the row, card, bar or key that opened a task, and with null when the drawer closes.

props.name: pinned / defaultPinned
props.description: Pinned project ids, shown first in the sidebar.

props.name: onPinnedChange
props.description: Fires from the pin with every pinned id.

props.name: onTaskCreate
props.description: A task was made with New task.

props.name: onTaskUpdate
props.description: A task changed, with what it was before.

props.name: onTaskDelete
props.description: A task was deleted, after its undo window.

props.name: now
props.description: Today: the timeline's line, and what is due or late.

props.name: drawer
props.description: How the task drawer presents: over the work from the right, pushing the work aside, or rising from the bottom.

props.name: density
props.description: Row height 32, 40 or 48px, with card padding and the timeline's rows and days to match.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the tasks have arrived: skeleton rows, or a message with Try again.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after the tasks failed to load.

props.name: label
props.description: The screen's accessible name.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play the swishes and clicks; the composed pin, watch and delete buttons play their own.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Greys the screen out and makes it inert.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the screen's frame.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the sidebar rows rove with Up and Down; the view switch is a radiogroup. In every view one task is the tab stop: arrows move between tasks (Left and Right cross board columns), Enter opens the drawer and its title field takes focus.

Every pointer move has a key: Space ticks a list task, Shift with Left or Right moves a board card a column, Left and Right move a timeline bar a day and Shift with them changes its due date. Each change is announced once.

The drawer is a modal dialog with a trapped Tab for overlay and sheet, and a non-modal region for push (which acts as overlay below 640px). Escape closes it and focus goes back to the task, or to the first task left after a delete.
Reduced motion: no plate travels — each view fades in with every task in place, drags still follow the pointer but land at once, and the drawer and the phone screens cross-fade.
Deleting runs through the composed delete button's undo window; closing the drawer during the window deletes at once, since the undo is no longer on screen.

items.title: Analytics Console
items.tagline: The numbers, arranged.
items.description: A complete store analytics screen where every panel reads one query — store, window and filters. Change the period on the composed KPI panel, or brush its chart, and the console moves in one beat: source bars glide to new lengths in cascade on glide while their figures count, the device split re-divides, countries re-rank by gliding to new rows, the hours heatmap re-tints on a diagonal wave, and the composed pages table refetches into its own cascade. The four charts re-arrange per grid and width on glide; filter chips open real menus (arrows, Enter, Escape back to the chip) and below 900px the stores fold into a draggable drawer.

props.name: sites
props.description: The stores in the sidebar: id, name and host.

props.name: site / defaultSite
props.description: The store on screen.

props.name: onSiteChange
props.description: Fires from the sidebar row or key that chose a store.

props.name: views
props.description: Saved sets of filters in the sidebar; a press applies one at once.

props.name: dimensions
props.description: What the filters bar can split by: device, channel and country, each with its options and shares.

props.name: filters / defaultFilters
props.description: A dimension's id to the option chosen for it; absent means all.

props.name: onFiltersChange
props.description: Fires from the chip, view or Clear that changed the filters.

props.name: range / defaultRange
props.description: The period: the last 7, 30 or 90 days, or the last year.

props.name: onRangeChange
props.description: Fires from the KPI panel's period switch with the new period.

props.name: onWindowChange
props.description: Fires whenever the window changes: a period, a brush zoom on the chart or its reset.

props.name: data
props.description: Answers a store, a window of days and filters with the KPI series, the breakdowns, the window's bars and hours, and its top pages.

props.name: now
props.description: The last day of data.

props.name: grid
props.description: How the four charts are arranged: one doubled up, evenly, or one under another.

props.name: density
props.description: The table's rows (32, 40 or 48px), the panels' padding, the bars and the gaps.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale for numbers and money.

props.name: currency
props.description: The currency for money.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the numbers have arrived: skeletons everywhere, or a message with Try again.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after the numbers failed to load.

props.name: label
props.description: The console's accessible name.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play the ticks and swishes; the composed KPI panel and table play their own.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Greys the console out and makes it inert.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the console's frame.

usageNotes: Everything reads one query, so a host only answers data(query): metrics and breakdowns are whole daily series (the KPI panel windows them), everything else is for the window it is asked about. Memoise it if it is expensive; it is called again when the store, window or filters change.

Keyboard: filter chips open a menu with Enter or Down; arrows, Home and End move, Enter chooses, Escape closes and returns focus to the chip. Stores and saved views rove with Up and Down. The KPI panel's period switch and chart keys (arrows, Shift to brush, Enter to zoom) drive the whole console.
Below 900px the stores fold into a modal drawer that can be dragged back out; Escape or Close returns focus to the menu button.

Reduced motion: bars, splits and tints take their new values at once behind a short fade, figures swap without counting, panels reflow in place, and the drawer and menus fade; every number still changes and each new query is announced once.

items.title: Team Chat
items.tagline: Channels, threads, people.
items.description: A complete team chat screen built around three Studio toggles: channels whose current pill travels on snap, a message stream whose action bar rises 4px on snap with pin-press in it, drawn reactions that hop and land on recoil while a ring flares and the count rolls, and a thread panel that arrives on glide — docked, over the stream or pushed — with its replies cascading in and follow-knot in its header, while mute-cone mutes the channel. Below 640px the panes become a stack whose pushes slide on glide and whose left edge takes a 1:1 back-swipe that commits by projection. Up and Down walk the messages, Enter opens a thread, Alt+Up and Alt+Down switch channel, and Escape closes the thread or goes back.

props.name: thread
props.description: How the thread panel arrives on wide screens: docked beside the stream (which narrows, and on a tablet the channel list folds to a rail), over it above a scrim as a modal dialog, or pushed like a phone screen. A phone always pushes.

props.name: presence
props.description: How presence is drawn on avatars: a corner dot, a ring, or not drawn. It is always spoken, and the header still counts who is active.

props.name: density
props.description: Avatar size, type and spacing in the stream; compact sets each run's name inline with its first line.

props.name: people
props.description: Everyone in the workspace, with their presence and an optional status line.

props.name: me
props.description: The viewer's person id: the author of what they send and whose reactions show as theirs.

props.name: channels / defaultChannels
props.description: Channels and direct messages in sidebar order, with unread and mention counts and muted state; controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onChannelsChange
props.description: Fires from the visit, mute or read that changed a channel, with all of them.

props.name: messages / defaultMessages
props.description: Every channel's messages and thread replies as one flat list; a reply carries its parent's id.

props.name: onMessagesChange
props.description: Fires from the send, reaction or pin that changed the list, with all of it.

props.name: channel / defaultChannel
props.description: The open channel's id.

props.name: onChannelChange
props.description: Fires from the row, Alt+arrow or phone push that opened a channel.

props.name: openThread / defaultOpenThread
props.description: The open thread: its first message's id, or null.

props.name: onOpenThreadChange
props.description: Fires from Reply in thread, a thread summary, Enter on a message, Close, Back, Escape or the back-swipe.

props.name: following / defaultFollowing
props.description: The threads the viewer follows, by their first messages' ids.

props.name: onFollowingChange
props.description: Fires from the thread's Follow button, or from a reply that followed the thread.

props.name: typing
props.description: Person ids writing in the open channel right now; shown over the composer with three dots that rest while the page is hidden.

props.name: now
props.description: The moment day dividers are read against, and what a sent message is stamped with. Never read from the clock during render.

props.name: zoneOffset
props.description: Minutes east of UTC that times are shown in, so server and browser agree.

props.name: workspace
props.description: The workspace's name over the channel list.

props.name: onSend
props.description: A message or thread reply was sent; it is already in the list.

props.name: onReact
props.type: (messageId: string, kind: ChatReactionKind, added: boolean) => void
props.description: The viewer added or took back a reaction.

props.name: onPinChange
props.description: A message was pinned or unpinned from its action bar.

props.name: onMuteChange
props.description: The channel header's mute toggle changed.

props.name: status
props.description: Loading draws placeholder rows; error offers Try again.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed in the error state.

props.name: label
props.description: The screen's accessible name.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a pop for reactions, sends and channel picks and a swish for threads and stack moves; the composed toggles play their own. Off unless asked for.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Read only: nothing can be sent, reacted to, pinned or muted.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It is 560px tall by default; pass a height class to change it.

usageNotes: Messages are a list of articles with one tab stop: Up and Down walk them, Home and End jump, Enter opens the message's thread, and Tab reaches its action bar (React, Reply in thread, Pin). The reaction picker is a menu: arrows move, Enter chooses, Escape returns focus to React.
Alt+Up and Alt+Down switch channel from anywhere; Escape closes the thread (in dock mode only when focus is inside it), and on a phone goes back a screen, as do Back and Alt+Left.

Under reduced motion nothing travels or hops: the thread panel and stack screens cross-fade, the channel pill jumps and the edge swipe is off, while counts, pins, mutes, unread state and the typing line all still change.

Data is flat and typed: pass people, channels and messages (replies carry `parent`) controlled or uncontrolled, and stream incoming messages by appending to `messages`; `typing` drives the typing line.

The screen measures its own width: below 640px it is a Channels → Channel → Thread stack, from 640px the channel list sits beside the stream, and from 1040px it widens to 232px with a 340px docked thread.

items.title: Notes App
items.tagline: Write it down, find it later.
items.description: A complete notes screen built around block-editor, pin-press and bin-lid: tags whose current pill travels on snap, a list whose pinned note lifts on snap and glides to the top — under a Pinned heading or floated over the rest — while the rows between close the gap on glide, search that washes the words it found and grows from its magnifier on snap, and an editor that cross-fades in from 4px on glide with the note's own title and tags over the blocks. Deleting drops the note in the bin until its undo ring drains. Below 640px the list and the note become a stack whose pushes slide on glide and whose left edge takes a 1:1 back-swipe that commits by projection; the list is one tab stop with Up, Down, Home and End, slash searches, and Escape clears the search or goes back.

props.name: pin
props.description: Where pinned notes go: under a Pinned heading, floated to the top of one list with a pin glyph, or pinning is off (no pin button, plain recency order).

props.name: search
props.description: How search lives over the list: an open field, a magnifier that grows into the field and folds back when emptied and left, or no search.

props.name: density
props.description: Row height and how much each row says: title and date, one snippet line, or two lines and the tags.

props.name: notes / defaultNotes
props.description: Every note: title, block-editor blocks, tags, pinned and when it was last edited.

props.name: onNotesChange
props.description: Fires from the edit, pin, tag, creation or deletion that changed the notes, with all of them.

props.name: note / defaultNote
props.description: The open note's id.

props.name: onNoteChange
props.description: Fires from the row, the new note or the deletion that changed the open note.

props.name: tag / defaultTag
props.description: The tag the list is filtered to, or null for every note.

props.name: onTagChange
props.description: Fires from the sidebar row or chip that changed the filter.

props.name: query / defaultQuery
props.description: The search text; it matches titles, every block and tags.

props.name: onQueryChange
props.description: Fires with every edit of the search field, Clear and Escape.

props.name: now
props.description: The moment dates are read against, and what an edit is stamped with. Never read from the clock during render.

props.name: zoneOffset
props.description: Minutes east of UTC that times are shown in, so server and browser agree.

props.name: onCreate
props.description: A new note was made; it is already in the list and open with its title focused.

props.name: onDelete
props.description: A note was thrown away, once its undo window ran out.

props.name: onPinChange
props.description: The editor's pin was pressed.

props.name: status
props.description: Loading draws placeholder rows and lines; error offers Try again.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed in the error state.

props.name: label
props.description: The screen's accessible name.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a tick for list steps and tag picks and a click for new notes, tags and screen moves; the composed pieces play their own. Off unless asked for.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Read only: nothing can be written, pinned, tagged or deleted.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It is 560px tall by default; pass a height class to change it.

usageNotes: The list is one tab stop: Up and Down move between notes, Home and End jump, Enter opens one; ArrowDown from the search field lands on the first result, and slash focuses search from anywhere that is not a field.

Escape clears the search, then folds an expanding search back to its magnifier; on a phone it goes back to the list, as do Back, Alt+Left and the edge swipe. The bin's own Escape undoes a deletion while its ring drains.
In the note, Enter in the title jumps into the body; the tag field takes Enter or a comma to add (words are lower-cased and joined with hyphens) and Backspace when empty to remove the last tag.
Under reduced motion rows swap places at once, the search field appears at its width, the editor and stack screens cross-fade, and every pin, tag, count and highlight still changes.
Notes are plain data: pass `notes` controlled and persist from `onNotesChange`; every edit stamps `updated` with `now`, which also orders the list, so a host that ticks `now` keeps edits honest.

items.title: Calendar App
items.tagline: Month, week, and the day ahead.
items.description: A complete calendar screen built around week-planner and meeting-card: a month grid and the week that morph into each other — the week you are in is a row of the month, so Week grows that row to fill the grid on glide while the other weeks fold away, then the planner cross-fades in over it, and Month runs it back — with a view switch whose pill travels on snap, months that slide in from 16px, a sidebar of mini month, calendars and the day ahead, and an event drawer that docks on glide, slides over or rises as a sheet you can pull down 1:1. Everything is read against `now`. The month is a real grid: arrows, Home, End and Page keys move the day, Enter steps into its events and Escape steps back out.

props.name: view / defaultView
props.description: The month, or the focused day's week; changing it runs the morph.

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: Fires from the switch, a day's number or Show in week.

props.name: drawer
props.description: How the event drawer arrives: docked at the right (the calendar narrows), over the calendar above a scrim, or as a sheet from the bottom that pulls down. A phone always uses the sheet.

props.name: density
props.description: Month chips (two plain, three with times on wide grids, or three filled) and week-planner's hour height.

props.name: events / defaultEvents
props.description: Week-planner events with optional attendees, agenda and notes; an event with attendees opens as a meeting card.

props.name: onEventsChange
props.description: Fires from the drag, edit, creation or deletion that changed the events, with all of them.

props.name: calendars
props.description: The calendars events belong to, with their tints (CSS colours, never hex).

props.name: hidden / defaultHidden
props.description: Calendar ids whose events are hidden everywhere.

props.name: onHiddenChange
props.description: Fires from the calendar checkboxes.

props.name: day / defaultDay
props.description: The focused day: the month and the week shown, and the day the agenda reads.

props.name: onDayChange
props.description: Fires with the new day's midnight from the grid, the mini month, the arrows, Today or the planner.

props.name: selected / defaultSelected
props.description: The event in the drawer, or null for a closed drawer.

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Fires from a chip, an agenda row, a planner event, Close, Escape, the scrim or the pull.

props.name: now
props.description: The current moment: today, the now line, the agenda's Now and countdowns, and the meeting card's ring. Never read from the clock during render.

props.name: zoneOffset
props.description: Minutes east of UTC that dates and times are drawn in, so server and browser agree.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: 1 starts weeks on Monday, 0 on Sunday.

props.name: onCreate
props.description: An event was drawn or added in the week.

props.name: onDelete
props.description: An event was deleted from the drawer or the week.

props.name: onJoinedChange
props.description: The viewer joined or left a meeting from its card.

props.name: status
props.description: Loading draws placeholder chips; error offers Try again.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed in the error state.

props.name: label
props.description: The screen's accessible name.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a swish for the morph, the drawer and the sidebar and a tick for each step of the day cursor; the composed pieces play their own. Off unless asked for.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Read only: nothing can be moved, made or deleted.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It is 560px tall by default; pass a height class to change it.

usageNotes: The month is one tab stop: arrows move a day or a week, Home and End go to the week's ends, Page Up and Page Down change month, Enter steps into the day's events (Up and Down walk them, Enter opens one) and Escape steps back to the day. The view switch is a radio group; arrows flip it.

The drawer is a dialog in over and sheet modes, trapping focus; focus moves to its heading and back to the chip, row or planner event that opened it, and Escape, Close and the scrim shut it. The sheet's handle pulls it down 1:1 and a release past 40% or a flick closes it.

Under reduced motion the morph is a cross-fade with no rows growing, the drawers and sidebar fade in place and the sheet does not follow a drag, while every date, chip, count and countdown still changes.

Hiding a calendar filters it from the month, the week, the mini month's dots and the agenda; week-planner's changes are merged back by id so the hidden events and any attendees or notes survive an edit.
Below 640px the sidebar becomes a drawer, the month shows dots with the focused day's agenda under it, and the week is week-planner's one-day mode; from 1040px the sidebar is docked.

items.title: Storefront
items.tagline: A shop that wants to be browsed.
items.description: A complete store home built around cart-drawer, product-grid and product-detail: the whole store is the bag's page, so the bag slides over it on glide and pulls shut; a hero, a category rail and product rails that scroll-snap and glide a page at a time; a category, a card or See all pushes product-grid's shelf in from the right on glide, and the hero pushes product-detail's page. Quick add throws a dot in the product's glaze to the bag on a true arc — x steady, y thrown up and falling — and when it lands the badge bumps on recoil, its count rolls and the button draws a check on flick. Rails take Left, Right, Home and End, pushed screens go back with Back, Alt+Left, Escape or a 1:1 swipe from their left edge that commits by projection.

props.name: rails
props.description: How many collections show as rails on the home, 1 to 3.

props.name: hero
props.description: The hero: a banner with the copy over the still life, a split with the copy beside it (a banner on a phone), or none, so the category rail leads.

props.name: density
props.description: Rail card widths (132, 160 or 196px; narrower on a phone) and how much each says — price only, a rating, or the rating and its glazes; also the shelf's density.

props.name: products
props.description: The catalogue, in product-grid's shape: categories come from it and every rail, tile and shelf reads it.

props.name: colors
props.description: The glazes products come in, as pigments that read in both themes.

props.name: collections
props.description: The rails in order: a title, a line, product ids, and how See all sorts and filters the shelf.

props.name: featured
props.description: The product the hero opens as a full product page; its glazes paint the hero's still life.

props.name: heroCopy
props.description: The hero's eyebrow, title, line and button words.

props.name: items / defaultItems
props.description: The lines in the bag, in cart-drawer's shape.

props.name: onItemsChange
props.description: Fires from the quick add, shelf, product page or bag that changed the lines, with all of them.

props.name: cartOpen / defaultCartOpen
props.description: Whether the bag is open over the store.

props.name: onCartOpenChange
props.description: Fires from the Bag button and from the bag's close, Escape, scrim or pull.

props.name: screen / defaultScreen
props.description: The screen on show: home, the featured product, or the shelf for a category or a collection.

props.name: onScreenChange
props.description: Fires from a tile, a card, See all, the hero, Back, Alt+Left, Escape or the back-swipe.

props.name: onAdd
props.description: Something went in the bag from the store, with the line as it now stands.

props.name: onCheckout
props.description: Checkout was pressed in the bag; a promise holds its button pending.

props.name: now
props.description: The moment the product page's delivery estimate counts from. Never read from the clock during render.

props.name: format
props.description: Money everywhere: rails, shelf, product page and bag.

props.name: storeName
props.description: The store's name in the top bar.

props.name: status
props.description: Loading draws placeholder cards; error offers Try again. Passed on to the shelf.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed in the error state.

props.name: label
props.description: The screen's accessible name.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a pop as a quick add lands and a category opens, and a swish for pushes, pops and the bag; the composed pieces play their own. Off unless asked for.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Browse only: nothing can be added or bought.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It is 560px tall by default; pass a height class to change it.

usageNotes: Each rail is one tab stop: Left and Right move between cards, Home and End jump, Enter opens the card's shelf with its quick view open, and Tab reaches the card's quick add. The rail's arrow buttons glide it a page at a time.

Pushed screens (a category, a collection, the featured product) go back with Back, Alt+Left, Escape when nothing inside used it, or a 1:1 swipe from their left edge; focus moves to the arriving screen's heading and back to what pushed it.
The badge counts what has landed: a quick add's count joins it when its dot reaches the bag, so the number and the bump arrive together. Adds from the shelf and the product page bump it at once.
Under reduced motion nothing flies or slides: screens cross-fade, rails jump-scroll, the badge's count changes in place and the quick add's check appears.
The catalogue is product-grid's: pass `products`, `colors` and `collections`, and the bag's lines (cart-drawer's `CartLine`) controlled through `items` to persist them.

items.title: Tune In
items.tagline: A headline that finds its frequency.
items.description: A headline that comes in like a station on an analogue dial: every letter starts as faint seeded static jittering over a broken scanline, a thin carrier line sweeps across on a tween, letters ahead of it calm and flicker toward their real shape, and each one it passes locks onto its true glyph with a small vertical settle on springs.snap and a flash of signal colour that cools, while a mono readout riding the carrier rolls to the station's frequency. A mouse over the tuned headline detunes the letters under it for a moment and they relock on the same spring; with trigger="hover" the headline is focusable and keyboard focus tunes it in.

props.name: text
props.description: The headline.

props.name: as
props.description: The element rendered.

props.name: frequency
props.description: Where the readout lands when the headline locks.

props.name: from
props.description: Where the readout starts as the carrier sets off.

props.name: unit
props.description: Printed after the readout.

props.name: sweep
props.description: How long the carrier takes to cross the headline, ms.

props.name: noise
props.description: Static strength, 0 to 1: opacity, jitter, churn and scanline roughness; 0 is a still, faint ghost alphabet.

props.name: readout
props.description: Show the small frequency readout riding the carrier, in a strip reserved above the text.

props.name: color
props.description: The carrier, the readout and each letter's brief lock flash.

props.name: staticColor
props.description: The static glyphs and the scanline under them.

props.name: glyphs
props.description: The alphabet the static is drawn from.

props.name: interactive
props.description: A mouse or pen over a tuned headline detunes the letters under it for a moment.

props.name: trigger
props.description: When it tunes in: on mount, when scrolled into view, on hover or keyboard focus, or when active turns true.

props.name: once
props.description: Tune in only the first time it is seen or hovered; false re-tunes each time.

props.name: delay
props.description: Wait before the carrier sets off, ms.

props.name: active
props.description: For trigger="manual": true tunes in, false drops back to static.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the static so the server and browser draw the same; derived from text by default.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Fires when the last letter locks.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root element; set the type size and colour here.

usageNotes: The text is read once from an sr-only copy and the animated layer is aria-hidden; the true glyphs are real text, so selecting and copying the headline gives the real words.
Each letter's final box is reserved from the first frame (the true glyph is there, transparent), so the line never reflows while it tunes in; the readout strip only exists when readout is on.
One rAF loop drives the static and runs only while some letter is static, the headline is on screen and the page is visible; noise={0} needs no frames until the carrier arrives.
Under reduced motion the static holds still and the letters crossfade in reading order, with the readout already at its frequency; hover detuning is off.
With trigger="hover" the headline becomes focusable and keyboard focus tunes it in; use trigger="manual" with active to tie it to your own state.
Font size and colour inherit, and every offset is in em, so it works from a caption to a hero in either theme.

items.title: Drum Words
items.tagline: Words turn on a ratcheted drum.
items.description: One word of a sentence on a ratcheted drum: the slot is a window onto a cylinder of faces placed with real 3D transforms about an axis behind the line, so the outgoing word tips away over the top while the next comes up from below foreshortened and shaded. Each change is one detent — a hair backwards on springs.flick as the pawl lifts, then forward on springs.snap, whose single overshoot is the detent catching — and the slot's width follows the word on springs.glide so the sentence glides instead of jumping. The word is a spinbutton: Up/Right, Enter and Space turn it forward, Down/Left back, Home/End to the ends, and a vertical drag turns the drum 1:1 with a throw committing to the detent it was heading for.

props.name: words
props.description: The words on the drum's faces, in turning order.

props.name: before
props.description: The sentence before the slot; end it with "\n" to set the word on its own line so a longer word never re-wraps the sentence.

props.name: after
props.description: The sentence after the slot, including any leading space it needs.

props.name: as
props.description: The element rendered.

props.name: index / defaultIndex
props.description: The word showing, controlled or initial.

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Fires from the turn that changed it — the timer, a key, a tap or a throw — with the new index.

props.name: interval
props.description: How long each word rests before the drum turns, ms; 0 turns only by hand.

props.name: depth
props.description: Drum curvature, 0 to 1: 0 is a nearly flat roll, 1 a tight drum with deep foreshortening.

props.name: width
props.description: "fit" springs the slot to each word so the sentence glides; "widest" holds the widest word so it never moves.

props.name: align
props.description: Where a word sits in a slot wider than it.

props.name: color
props.description: The words' colour.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Hold the drum while the pointer rests on the word.

props.name: paused
props.description: Stop turning on the timer; keys, taps and throws still turn it.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The word is a control: drag or throw it vertically, tap it, or use the arrow keys.

props.name: trigger
props.description: When the timer runs: from mount, once seen, only while the sentence is hovered or focused, or never (turn by index).

props.name: once
props.description: Turn through the words a single time and rest on the last.

props.name: delay
props.description: Extra wait before the first turn, ms.

props.name: sound
props.description: Tick on every detent the visitor turns; the timer's turns are silent.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Fires when a once cycle comes to rest on the last word.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the sentence; set the type size and colour here.

usageNotes: The sentence is real text and the word is a spinbutton whose value text is the current word; automatic turns are not announced, and the word is read on focus and on each key step.
The timer pauses while the pointer rests on the word, while it has focus, while it is dragged, off screen and in a hidden page, which also meets the need to pause moving content.
Geometry is in lh units, so the drum keeps its shape from a caption to a hero and renders identically on the server; only word widths are measured.
End before with a newline to put the word on its own line: with width="fit" a word longer than the space left on the line would otherwise re-wrap the sentence.
Under reduced motion the words crossfade and the slot width changes at once; a vertical drag still steps one word.
Sound is off by default and only ever answers the visitor: taps, keys and throws tick per detent, timer turns stay silent.

items.title: Tide Mask
items.tagline: A heading rises out of the waterline.
items.description: A multi-line heading revealed by a travelling liquid edge: each line sits behind its own clip path whose top edge is a wave (a swell and a counter-running chop), and the water level rises past each line on a tween, lines a stagger apart, while the letters float up a step onto their line on springs.glide and the glyphs just under the waterline stay wet and tinted until it moves on. The final line's last ripple is left behind as a fine underline that calms on springs.drift, ripples for a while and stirs again when the heading is hovered or focused; with trigger="hover" the heading is focusable and keyboard focus raises it.

props.name: text
props.description: The heading's lines: an array, or a string split on "\n"; a line too long for its box wraps and rises as one block.

props.name: as
props.description: The element rendered.

props.name: amplitude
props.description: Wave height, 0 to 1; 0 is a straight rising edge and 1 about a fifth of a line.

props.name: frequency
props.description: Wave crests across every 10em of line.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the water rises and the waves travel, 0.5 to 2.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay between one line's rise and the next, ms.

props.name: color
props.description: The waterline, the wet glyphs just under it and the underline.

props.name: wet
props.description: How strongly the glyphs just under the waterline are tinted while wet, 0 to 1.

props.name: underline
props.description: The final line's last ripple settles into a fine underline.

props.name: rippleFor
props.description: How long the underline keeps rippling once it settles, and again after each hover, ms; 0 is still and Infinity ripples while on screen.

props.name: align
props.description: Line alignment.

props.name: trigger
props.description: When the water rises: on mount, when scrolled into view, on hover or keyboard focus, or when active turns true.

props.name: once
props.description: Rise only the first time it is seen or hovered; false lowers the water when it leaves view and raises it again.

props.name: delay
props.description: Wait before the first line starts to rise, ms.

props.name: active
props.description: For trigger="manual": true raises the heading, false lowers the water back over it.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Fires when the last line has risen.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the heading; set the type size and colour here.

usageNotes: The lines are real text, read in order and selectable; the wet copy, the waterline and the underline are aria-hidden and unselectable.
One rAF loop drives every edge while anything moves and stops when the heading settles, off screen or in a hidden page; risen lines drop their clip path altogether.
Under reduced motion the lines crossfade in with a straight edge, staggered, and the underline fades in flat and never ripples.
The heading reserves a little padding above and below (0.12em, 0.2em with the underline) so the wave's crests and the underline stay inside its own box.
Pass rippleFor={0} for a still underline, or Infinity for one that keeps moving while it is on screen; hovering always stirs it.

items.title: Grain Gather
items.tagline: Text assembled from drifting grains.
items.description: Particle text poured from sand: the words are laid out for real in the DOM, drawn from their own glyphs into an offscreen mask and sampled into a few thousand grains on a canvas, which start scattered in a slow drift and gather into the letters in a left-to-right sweep on per-grain springs from the springs.drift calibration, a touch under-damped so the words sharpen out of a haze. A pointer moving through the words parts the grains like a hand through sand and they flow back behind it; a press throws them outward and they regather, and Enter or Space on the focused text does the same from its centre.

props.name: text
props.description: The words the grains gather into.

props.name: as
props.description: The text element rendered.

props.name: density
props.description: How many grains, 0 to 1: about 1,200 to 4,800, spread over the letters' ink.

props.name: radius
props.description: How far the hand reaches, px.

props.name: strength
props.description: How hard the hand pushes the grains aside, 0 to 1.

props.name: scatter
props.description: How hard a press throws the grains, 0 to 1.

props.name: drift
props.description: How much the scattered grains wander before they gather, 0 to 1.

props.name: color
props.description: The grains' colour; by default the text colour you set.

props.name: grain
props.description: A grain's size, px; large type scales it up so the sand stays dense.

props.name: dpr
props.description: The highest device pixel ratio the canvas draws at (never above 2).

props.name: interactive
props.description: A pointer parts the grains, a press scatters them, and Enter or Space scatters them from the keyboard.

props.name: trigger
props.description: When they gather: on mount, when scrolled into view, on hover or keyboard focus, or when active turns true.

props.name: once
props.description: Gather only the first time; false lets them drift apart when the text leaves view and gather again.

props.name: delay
props.description: Wait before the grains start to gather, ms.

props.name: active
props.description: For trigger="manual": true gathers the grains, false lets them drift apart.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Fires the first time the grains settle into the words.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper; set the type size, weight and colour here.

usageNotes: The real words stay in the DOM in your font — transparent, read once and selectable — and the canvas is aria-hidden; the grains are sampled from that exact layout, so wrapping and fonts always match.

The simulation is typed arrays with nothing allocated per frame; it runs only on screen in a visible page and stops the moment every grain is home, and a resize re-samples with the grains flowing to their new homes.
