props.description: The glow breathing under the outline, 0 to 1.

props.name: color
props.description: The current's colour; its hot core is mixed toward the foreground, so it is white-hot on dark and ink on light.

props.name: hoverBoost
props.description: How much hover or keyboard focus raises the voltage, as a share of what is left to full.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the arcs crawl, as a multiple of the house pace (0.25 to 3).

props.name: forks
props.description: How often an arc throws a fork off its side, 0 to 1.

props.name: sparks
props.description: Corners crackle with sparks once the voltage passes 0.6, and burst on a discharge.

props.name: conductor
props.description: Draw the outline itself as a faint wire.

props.name: thickness
props.description: The wire's stroke width, in CSS pixels.

props.name: label
props.description: The mark's accessible name.

props.name: interactive
props.description: A press discharges the mark and hover and focus charge it; off, it is an image.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the current still.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for where the arcs start and how they kink.

props.name: dpr
props.description: The highest device pixel ratio the canvas draws at (never above 2).

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a buzz when the visitor discharges the mark.

props.name: onDischarge
props.description: Fires when the visitor discharges the mark.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the box; size it here (default size-40).

usageNotes: Interactive, the mark is a button named by label: hover and keyboard focus charge it, and a click, Enter or Space discharges it. With interactive off it is role="img" with the same label.
The path is drawn inset by 14% of the box so arcs, forks and sparks always stay inside the canvas; size the box with className and the mark scales with it.

Canvas 2D with fixed pools of arcs, forks and sparks, so nothing is allocated per frame. The loop runs only on screen in a visible tab and stops while paused; the wire is resampled only when the size or path changes, and the canvas caps its pixel ratio at 2.
Colours resolve on the element and re-resolve when the theme changes; a light core adds light on dark pages and a dark core is drawn over light ones, so it reads in both themes.
Under reduced motion it is a still frame of the lit wire with frozen arcs; hover brightens it and a press darkens it for a beat, with no flicker or travel.

items.title: Dither Curtain
items.tagline: A veil of ordered dots draws back.
items.description: A veil of ordered dots over any content: where it is partly drawn back, cells switch on and off by a Bayer threshold, and the dots coarsen through nested grids toward the middle of the dissolving edge, so the content appears through a regular screen rather than a blur. The reveal is a tween across a ragged front (a dissolve is a clip, never a spring) and covering again is a shorter exit tween; while veiled, a mouse or pen pushes a dithered hole through it that trails the pointer and opens on springs.glide. With the hover trigger the reveal grows from the pointer, and keyboard focus anywhere inside lifts it the same way.

props.name: children
props.description: The content behind the veil; it stays fully interactive and in the accessibility tree throughout.

props.name: matrix
props.description: The ordered-dither matrix: 2×2 is a coarse check, 8×8 a fine, even screen.

props.name: scale
props.description: The finest dot, in CSS pixels.

props.name: coarsen
props.description: How much the dots coarsen toward the middle of the dissolving edge, from one size at 0 to up to 8× scale at 1.

props.name: shape
props.description: Square cells, or round dots that grow until a full veil is solid.

props.name: color
props.description: The veil's colour, resolved on the element so it follows the theme.

props.name: trigger
props.description: When the veil draws back: on mount, when scrolled into view, on hover or keyboard focus, or when revealed turns true.

props.name: revealed
props.description: For trigger="manual": true draws the veil back, false brings it over again.

props.name: once
props.description: Reveal only once; false lets the veil come back when the piece leaves the view (inView) or the pointer and focus leave (hover).

props.name: origin
props.description: Where the dissolve starts.

props.name: duration
props.description: How long the reveal takes, ms; covering again takes 0.6× as long.

props.name: delay
props.description: Wait before a mount or in-view reveal, ms.

props.name: softness
props.description: How wide the dithered band at the edge is, 0 to 1.

props.name: ragged
props.description: How ragged the edge is, from a straight line at 0 to 1.

props.name: holeRadius
props.description: The radius of the hole a mouse or pen pushes through the veil, px; 0 turns it off.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer pushes a hole through the veil (mouse and pen only), and with the hover trigger the wrapper takes keyboard focus.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for the edge's raggedness.

props.name: dpr
props.description: The highest device pixel ratio the canvas draws at (never above 2).

props.name: onRevealChange
props.description: Fires when a reveal or a re-cover completes, with whether the content is now revealed.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper; give it the content's radius so the veil follows it.

usageNotes: The veil is decoration: its canvas is aria-hidden and takes no pointer events, so the children stay fully interactive and are read normally even while veiled. Use onRevealChange if a host wants to announce the state.
With trigger="hover" the wrapper becomes a tab stop and keyboard focus anywhere inside lifts the veil from the focused element; a tap lifts it for touch-only visitors.

Canvas 2D, one filled path per frame: solid and clear blocks are drawn or skipped whole and only the dissolving band is subdivided. Frames are drawn only while the progress, the hole or the size changes, never off screen, and nothing runs once it has settled.
The server renders a solid veil in the same colour so the content never flashes before the canvas covers it; the colour re-resolves when the theme changes.
Under reduced motion there is no travelling front and no hole: the solid veil cross-fades away, and back.

items.title: Lantern Cursor
items.tagline: A warm pool of light follows you.
items.description: A dim room lit by a lantern the visitor carries: a canvas of night over any children with a feathered pool cut out of it and a faint warm spill past its edge, plus a disc of lamplight blended over what it lights. The lantern follows the pointer on a damped spring that slides from springs.flick through springs.glide to springs.drift by lag, leaning ahead along its travel and stretching with speed, while seeded noise makes the flame breathe; leaving sets it down at rest on springs.drift. Keyboard focus inside carries the light to the focused element and opens it to cover it.

props.name: children
props.description: The scene the lantern lights; it stays fully interactive.

props.name: radius
props.description: The pool of light's radius, in CSS pixels.

props.name: warmth
props.description: The light's colour temperature, from a neutral white at 0 to candle amber at 1.

props.name: dim
props.description: How dark the room is outside the light, 0 to 1.

props.name: feather
props.description: How soft the pool's edge is, as a share of its radius.

props.name: lag
props.description: How far the lantern lags the hand: the flick spring at 0, glide at 0.5, drift at 1.

props.name: lean
props.description: How far the light swings ahead along its travel and stretches with speed, 0 to 1.

props.name: flicker
props.description: The flame's faint flicker in size and warmth; 0 holds it steady and lets the loop stop.

props.name: glow
props.description: The warmth the lamplight lays over what it lights, 0 to 1.

props.name: rest
props.description: Where the lantern is set down when the pointer leaves, as fractions of the box.

props.name: darkness
props.description: The night's colour; fixed art by default, because night is night in either theme.

props.name: followFocus
props.description: Keyboard focus inside carries the lantern to the focused element.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer carries the lantern (mouse and pen; touch gets the resting light).

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the flicker.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for the flicker.

props.name: dpr
props.description: The highest device pixel ratio the canvas draws at (never above 2).

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the box.

usageNotes: The night and the lamplight are aria-hidden and never take pointer events, so every control in the children still clicks, focuses and reads as usual, and the system cursor is left alone.

Keyboard visitors see what they are on: focus inside carries the light to the focused element and opens it to cover it, and it stays there when the pointer leaves. Touch-only visitors get the resting light.

One canvas fill and one gradient cut per frame, with the lamplight moved by a composited transform. The loop runs while the lantern travels; the flicker keeps a half-rate loop only while on screen and visible, and flicker 0 or paused lets it stop. DPR is capped at 2.

The lamplight screens over dark pages and multiplies over light ones, so it reads as added light in dark and as a warm tint on paper in light; the server renders the resting room in CSS so there is no flash.
Under reduced motion there is no lag, lean or flicker: the pool sits exactly under the pointer and jumps to focus and back to rest.

items.title: Scroll Unfold
items.tagline: Media that grows to fill the frame as you scroll.
items.description: A scroll-linked media card that grows to fill the frame: the section pins a stage in its nearest scroll container, and the distance scrolled, 1:1 and eased once by the house's symmetric move, opens the card's clip from its inset to full bleed while its corners flatten and the picture zooms out to meet it. The headline is split around the card and each half is pushed by the card's own edge, keeping a fixed gap as the words part and slide off the stage, while the caption rides the frame's bottom edge away and an overlay title rises over the last quarter; scrolling back folds it. Keyboard scrolling of the container (arrows, Page keys, Space) drives it exactly as the wheel does.

props.name: children
props.description: The media the card frames (an image, a video, an SVG); it fills the frame, so give it size-full object-cover.

props.name: headline
props.description: The headline that splits around the card.

props.name: splitAt
props.description: How many words go before the card.

props.name: as
props.description: The headline's element.

props.name: caption
props.description: A line under the card that slides away as it grows.

props.name: overlay
props.description: A title laid over the full-bleed frame, rising in over the last quarter.

props.name: range
props.description: How far the reader scrolls to unfold it, px.

props.name: inset
props.description: The card's starting inset as a share of the stage width (0.05 to 0.45).

props.name: radius
props.description: The card's starting corner radius, px; it flattens to 0 at full bleed.

props.name: zoom
props.description: How much the media zooms out as the frame opens, 0 to 0.4.

props.name: pin
props.description: Hold the stage in place (sticky) while it unfolds.

props.name: height
props.description: The stage's height, px.

props.name: start
props.description: Scroll distance before the unfold begins, px.

props.name: smooth
props.description: Eases the scroll-linked progress on a spring, from 1:1 with the scroll at 0 to heavy at 1.

props.name: gap
props.description: The space between the headline and the card, px.

props.name: onStageChange
props.description: Fires when the piece passes between folded, unfolding and unfolded.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the section.

usageNotes: It finds the nearest scrolling ancestor (or the window) and listens to its scroll passively, only while the section is within 200px of view; every visual is a clip-path, transform or opacity, and nothing loops.

The headline is one real heading with both halves inside it, read once and in order; nothing takes focus, so keyboard scrolling of the container drives it exactly as a wheel does. Make a custom scroll container focusable so keyboard visitors can scroll it.
On a wide stage the words sit either side of the card; when the side columns would be under 120px they stack above and below it, so it reads at 258px.
Under reduced motion it is a still: the folded composition, unpinned, with no scroll linking.
Pass height when the stage should not take the scroll container's full height, or when it renders before the container is measured.

items.title: Drop Ripple
items.tagline: Touch an image and it ripples like water.
items.description: Water over an image or generated pool tiles, simulated on the GPU: a height field on a ping-pong pair of framebuffers (half-float where possible, byte-encoded where not) takes the neighbours' average less the previous height each fixed step and damps it, and its reads clamp at the edges, so a ring meets the sides and comes back crossed with its own reflection before it smooths to glass. A press drops a cosine dimple, a drag leaves a wake, a passing mouse a faint trail and seeded rain can fall; the picture is refracted through the surface normals with a soft highlight on the crests. The surface is a button: Enter or Space drops at a marker the arrow keys move, which glides there on springs.snap.

props.name: src
props.description: An image to put under the water; without one, the water lies over generated pool tiles.

props.name: alt
props.description: What the picture under the water shows, for assistive technology.

props.name: children
props.description: Content laid over the water, such as a headline; it takes no pointer events, so drops land through it (give a control pointer-events-auto).

props.name: damping
props.description: How quickly the rings die away, from long-lived with many reflections at 0 to a quick settle at 1.

props.name: size
props.description: A drop's radius, in CSS pixels.

props.name: rain
props.description: Seeded rain on the surface, from none at 0 to about eight drops a second on a wide card at 1.

props.name: strength
props.description: How deep a drop dents the surface, 0 to 1.

props.name: refraction
props.description: How far the water bends the picture under it, 0 to 1.

props.name: specular
props.description: The soft highlight on the crests, 0 to 1.

props.name: wake
props.description: The faint wake a mouse leaves as it moves over the water, 0 to 1.

props.name: colors
props.defaultValue: pigments mixed from --accent and --signal with the background
props.description: The generated tiles' deep water, shallow water and grout-and-lane colours, resolved on the element.

props.name: tile
props.description: The generated tiles' size, in CSS pixels.

props.name: resolution
props.description: The simulation's resolution as a share of the box, 0.25 to 1.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Presses, drags, the mouse and the keyboard disturb the water; off, it is an image.

props.name: label
props.description: The surface's accessible name.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for the tiles' tones and the rain.

props.name: dpr
props.description: The highest device pixel ratio the canvas draws at (never above 2).

props.name: paused
props.description: Freeze the water where it is.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a plip for each drop the visitor makes (never for rain).

props.name: onDrop
props.description: Fires when the visitor drops into the water, with the point as fractions of the box.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the box; set its height here (default h-56).

usageNotes: The surface is a focusable button described by alt: Enter or Space drops at a marker shown only on keyboard focus, and the arrow keys move it (Shift for bigger steps). The overlay sits outside the button, so a headline stays readable as text.

One WebGL2 context: a half-resolution simulation (two fixed steps a frame) and one render pass. The loop runs only while there is energy in the water or rain on it, never off screen or in a hidden tab, and it stops on a clean flat frame. DPR is capped at 2.
Without float render targets the field is byte-encoded and still reflects and settles; without WebGL2, or after a lost context, the still picture stands in and each drop draws a CSS ring.
The tile colours are pigments resolved from tokens on the element and re-resolved when the theme changes, so the pool reads in light and dark; pass src for a photograph instead.
Under reduced motion there is no simulation or rain: a drop shows one still set of rings at that point that fades in place.

items.title: Cloth Grid
items.tagline: A mesh you can pull like fabric.
items.description: A rectangle of printed fabric that is a real Verlet cloth: pressed and pulled, the fabric under the fingers follows 1:1 and rises toward you with the snap spring's one overshoot, tenting up with radial folds and bunching ahead of the pull, lit from its own normals with a soft cast shadow. Let go and the release velocity carries on while every particle springs back to rest on a spring whose damping runs from the drift spring's ζ 1 down by ripple, so the cloth lies flat again through a few soft ripples; hung from a rod it sways from a passing pointer, pinned at two corners it falls into a drape. Focus shows a handle that moves on the glide spring: Arrow keys take hold and pull it, Enter or Space lets go (or plucks the cloth), Escape lets go.

props.name: src
props.description: An image the cloth carries; it must be readable across origins (CORS). The woven print is used without it or when it fails to load.

props.name: pattern
props.description: The woven print drawn when there is no image.

props.name: colors
props.description: The print's ground, thread and accent colours, as CSS colours; the defaults are pigments that read the same in both themes.

props.name: caption
props.description: Words woven into the print; they are part of the accessible name too.

props.name: label
props.description: The cloth's accessible name.

props.name: stiffness
props.description: Silk (0) to canvas (1): how many folds form, how far the weave stretches and how firmly it returns.

props.name: resolution
props.description: Cells across the cloth's long side, 8 to 48: coarse cloth folds in facets, fine cloth in curves.

props.name: pin
props.description: How the cloth is held: lying flat, hanging from a rod, or pinned at its two top corners.

props.name: lift
props.description: How far a pinch raises the fabric toward you, 0 to 1.

props.name: grip
props.description: How much fabric a pinch takes, 0 (a single point) to 1 (a handful).

props.name: ripple
props.description: How many soft ripples the cloth leaves as it returns, 0 to 1.

props.name: gravity
props.description: The cloth's weight when it hangs (banner and corners), 0 to 1.

props.name: wind
props.description: How much a passing pointer pushes the cloth, 0 to 1.

props.name: sheen
props.description: The highlight along ridges, 0 (cotton) to 1 (silk).

props.name: shadow
props.description: Lifted cloth casts a soft shadow.

props.name: dpr
props.description: The highest device pixel ratio drawn, capped at 2.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freeze the cloth where it is.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer and the keyboard move the cloth; false leaves it still and out of the tab order.

props.name: onGrabChange
props.description: Fires when the cloth is taken hold of (true) and let go (false), by pointer or keys.

props.name: className
props.description: Size the box here.

usageNotes: The surface is a role="application" named by label (and caption): focus shows a handle, Arrow keys take hold and pull it (Shift for longer pulls), Enter or Space lets go or plucks the cloth, and Escape lets go; a drag uses touch-action: none.
One requestAnimationFrame loop runs only while the cloth moves or is held; it sleeps once every particle is still, never runs off screen or in a hidden tab, and caps the device pixel ratio at 2.
WebGL2 draws the mesh (positions go up as a float texture each frame); with no WebGL2, or after a lost context, the flat print is shown as the still frame, and a restored context rebuilds itself.
Under reduced motion a pull still poses the cloth under the hand, but nothing ripples or swings and a release lays it flat at once; banner and corners show their settled pose.

Size it with className (it fills the box with a 14px margin so a pulled edge and the shadow have room); the default colours are fixed-lightness pigments, so the linen reads the same on light and dark pages.

items.title: Murmuration
items.tagline: A flock that wheels around your cursor.
items.description: A starling murmuration at dusk: a 3D boids flock seen in perspective, so the cloud folds over itself as it turns, with each bird darkening as it banks so waves of darkness roll through it. The pointer is a lure the flock wheels round, the lure trailing the hand on the drift spring's constants, and a click sends a hawk through whose fright passes bird to bird with a reaction delay, opening a hole that folds shut again. Focus shows the lure: Arrow keys move it, Enter or Space sends a hawk, Escape lets the flock drift.

props.name: count
props.description: How many birds, 50 to 2,400.

props.name: attraction
props.description: How strongly the pointer draws the flock and wheels it round, 0 to 1.

props.name: speed
props.description: Flight speed, as a multiple of the natural pace (0.25 to 3).

props.name: cohesion
props.description: How tightly the birds keep together, 0 to 1.

props.name: alignment
props.description: How closely each bird matches its neighbours' heading, 0 to 1.

props.name: separation
props.description: How much room each bird keeps, 0 to 1.

props.name: orbit
props.description: The radius the flock wheels at around the pointer, px (held within the box's short side).

props.name: bird
props.description: A bird's size at middle depth, px.

props.name: scatter
props.description: How hard a passing hawk scatters the flock, 0 to 1.

props.name: color
props.description: The birds' ink.

props.name: sky
props.description: Paint a dusk sky behind the flock.

props.name: horizon
props.description: Paint a reed bed along the bottom.

props.name: seed
props.description: The flock's starting formation and the reeds.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the flock still.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer and the keyboard lead the flock and send hawks; false leaves it to itself.

props.name: dpr
props.description: The highest device pixel ratio drawn, capped at 2.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the keyboard surface.

props.name: onHawk
props.description: Fires when a hawk is sent: a click, a tap, Enter or Space.

props.name: onLeadChange
props.description: Fires when the pointer or the keys start (true) or stop (false) leading the flock.

props.name: children
props.description: Content over the sky, in its own layer: a headline, a caption.

props.name: className
props.description: Size the box here.

usageNotes: The canvases are aria-hidden; a role="application" surface carries label: focus shows the lure, Arrow keys move it (Shift for larger steps), Enter or Space sends a hawk, Escape lets the flock drift. The system cursor is never hidden, and presses on controls inside children stay theirs.

The flock is ambient: one loop runs while it is on screen in a visible tab and not paused, and stops off screen. Positions live in typed arrays allocated once for 2,400 birds, neighbours come from a spatial hash, and birds draw as six batched strokes.
The sky is a separate static canvas drawn only on resize or theme change; its colours resolve from tokens on the element, so the dusk follows the page between light and dark.
Under reduced motion the flock is one still frame flown from its seed; a hawk re-poses it with the hole it tore, and no loop runs.
Touch: a tap sends a hawk and a sideways drag leads the lure (touch-action: pan-y keeps the page scrolling).

items.title: Halftone Wake
items.tagline: An image surfaces through printed dots.
items.description: A single-ink halftone plate whose image surfaces in the pointer's wake: every dot rests at a faint fraction of its size, and the dots the hand passes grow on their own springs with the snap constants, popping just past full size before they settle, then recede from the trail's oldest end over linger seconds. Scrolling sweeps a band of ink down across the plate, and the first time it is mostly in view one press runs across it. The plate is a focusable image: focus and Enter or Space run the press across the whole of it.

props.name: src
props.description: The image to print; it must be readable across origins (CORS). The generated art is used without it or when it fails.

props.name: art
props.description: The generated artwork printed when there is no image.

props.name: alt
props.description: What the image shows: the plate's accessible name.

props.name: cell
props.description: The screen's cell size, px (4 to 32).

props.name: angle
props.description: The screen's angle, degrees; 45 is the classic black screen.

props.name: linger
props.description: How long the wake takes to recede, s.

props.name: shape
props.description: The dot: round, square, or a line screen whose thickness follows the tone.

props.name: ink
props.description: The ink.

props.name: paper
props.description: Paper behind the dots; the page shows through when unset. Dark ink on light paper prints shadows, light ink on dark paper prints highlights.

props.name: rest
props.description: The dot size where nothing has passed, 0 to 1; 0 hides the image until it is printed.

props.name: brush
props.description: The width of the pointer's wake, px.

props.name: contrast
props.description: The plate's tone curve, 0 (flat) to 1 (punchy).

props.name: scroll
props.description: Scrolling the page sweeps a band of ink down across the plate.

props.name: intro
props.description: One sweep across the plate the first time it is mostly in view.

props.name: seed
props.description: The generated art's variation.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer, the scroll and the keys print; false leaves the plate at rest and out of the tab order.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freeze the plate as it is.

props.name: dpr
props.description: The highest device pixel ratio drawn, capped at 2.

props.name: onCoverageChange
props.description: Fires with the share of the plate printed, 0 to 1, whenever it moves by a whole percent.

props.name: className
props.description: Size the plate here.

usageNotes: The plate is role="img" named by alt and focusable when interactive: focus and Enter or Space run the press across the whole image, so the keyboard reaches the same printed state the pointer does. touch-action: pan-y keeps vertical scrolling (which prints through the scroll band).

One loop runs only while a wake recedes, a dot spring moves or a sweep runs; it sleeps when every dot is settled and never runs off screen or in a hidden tab. Dot sizes are computed on the CPU per cell and drawn by a WebGL2 shader, with a Canvas 2D fallback that draws the same plate after a lost context or without WebGL2.

The ink resolves from its CSS colour on the element and the paper from the page's background, so the plate prints shadows on light pages and highlights on dark ones and re-reads itself when the theme changes.
Under reduced motion the plate prints fully and holds: every dot at its size, no wake, no springs, no sweep.
An image src needs CORS headers to be sampled; without them the generated art is printed instead.

items.title: Mosaic Flip
items.tagline: Images change hands tile by tile.
items.description: An image carousel whose change is a wave of turning tiles: each tile waits for the wave from the pointer, a corner, an edge or the centre, then turns 180° about the axis perpendicular to the wave's travel, so the tiles fall away from the origin like dominoes, on the snap spring with a slight lift and shadow mid-turn and each face darkening as it turns from the light. Arrows, dots, a click, a swipe and the keyboard all change it, the active dot glides on the glide spring, and with sound each landing tile ticks. The frame is a labelled slide: Left and Right turn to the previous and next image, Home and End to the ends.

props.name: images
props.description: The images, in order: any URL a CSS background can load, and what each shows.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The index shown (controlled), or shown first when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the press, key, swipe or autoplay tick that changed the image, with the new index.

props.name: grid
props.description: Columns of tiles, 2 to 20.

props.name: rows
props.description: Rows of tiles; by default they follow the frame's aspect so tiles stay square.

props.name: origin
props.description: Where each wave starts: the pointer (or the control pressed), the leading corner, the leading edge, or the centre.

props.name: speed
props.description: Pace of the wave and of each turn, as a multiple (0.25 to 3).

props.name: lift
props.description: How far a tile rises toward you mid-turn, 0 to 1.

props.name: jitter
props.description: How irregular the wave front is, 0 (mechanical) to 1 (hand-turned).

props.name: axis
props.description: Tiles turn away from the wave, or all about one axis.

props.name: gap
props.description: Grout between tiles, px.

props.name: radius
props.description: Tile corner radius, px.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Advance by itself every so many ms while visible, unhovered and unfocused; 0 is off.

props.name: loop
props.description: Wrap past the first and last image.

props.name: controls
props.description: Show the arrows and dots.

props.name: sound
props.description: A soft tick as each tile lands, for changes the visitor makes.

props.name: label
props.description: The carousel's accessible name.

props.name: onSettle
props.description: Fires when a wave has landed, with the index now shown.

props.name: className
props.description: Size the frame here.

usageNotes: It is a carousel section with a focusable slide named "2 of 4: alt": Left and Right turn to the previous and next image, Home and End to the ends, the arrows and dots are real buttons (dots carry aria-current), and the change is announced politely — silenced while autoplay runs.
Autoplay pauses on hover, on focus inside, off screen and in a hidden tab, and a Pause button appears with the dots; sound only ever answers the visitor, never an autoplay tick.

One requestAnimationFrame loop turns the whole wave and nothing runs at rest; each tile is a single flat layer promoted only while it turns, and the server renders the image whole until the frame is measured.
Images are cover-fitted to the whole frame (each tile shows its slice), passed once as CSS custom properties; the next and previous images are preloaded.
Under reduced motion the new image crossfades over the whole frame instead of turning, and the dot indicator moves without gliding.

items.title: Dot Lens
items.tagline: A dot grid that swells into a lens.
items.description: A quiet field of fine dots that swells into a fisheye lens: within it each dot is carried along its radius by the map g(u) = (m+1)u/(mu+1), so dots near the centre swell and spread while the rim packs into a fine ring of compressed grain. The lens trails the pointer on a spring set by lag (the flick, glide or drift constants) and swells in on the snap spring; a click sends a ring out through the grid and the lens throbs on the recoil spring. Focus brings the lens in: Arrow keys move it, Home re-centres it, Enter or Space sends a ring, Escape lets it rest.

props.name: radius
props.description: The lens radius, px; never more than 0.6 of the box's short side.

props.name: power
props.description: Magnification, 0 to 1.

props.name: dot
props.description: A resting dot's diameter, px.

props.name: gap
props.description: Spacing between dots, px.

props.name: lattice
props.description: How the dots are laid: a square grid or a hexagonal one.

props.name: color
props.description: The dots' colour.

props.name: accent
props.description: The colour at the lens centre and on a pulse.

props.name: glow
props.description: How far dots under the lens lean toward accent, 0 to 1.

props.name: lag
props.description: How far the lens trails the pointer, 0 (the flick spring) to 1 (the drift spring).

props.name: pulse
props.description: Strength of the ring a click sends through the grid, 0 to 1.

props.name: rest
props.description: Where the lens goes when nobody leads it: parked in the middle, deflated away, or wandering.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer and the keyboard lead the lens and send rings; false leaves it at rest.

props.name: dpr
props.description: The highest device pixel ratio drawn, capped at 2.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the keyboard surface.

props.name: onPulse
props.description: Fires when a ring is sent: a click, a tap, Enter or Space.

props.name: onLeadChange
props.description: Fires when the pointer or the keys start (true) or stop (false) leading the lens.

props.name: children
props.description: Content over the field, in its own layer.

props.name: className
props.description: Size the box here.

usageNotes: The canvas is aria-hidden; a role="application" surface carries label: focus brings the lens in, Arrow keys move it (Shift for larger steps), Home re-centres it, Enter or Space sends a ring, Escape lets it go back to rest. Presses on controls inside children stay theirs.
The loop runs only while the lens, its power or a ring is moving (or rest="drift"), only on screen in a visible tab, and sleeps when settled; dots draw as five batched colour paths.
Colours resolve from CSS on the canvas and re-read on a theme change, so the field follows light and dark; the default ink-3 dots stay quiet behind content.
Under reduced motion the lens is wherever the pointer or keys put it, at once — no trailing, swell or throb — and a pulse tints a ring of dots for a moment instead of moving them.
Touch: a touch places the lens, a sideways drag leads it and a tap sends a ring (touch-action: pan-y).

items.title: Enter Stage
items.tagline: Content that takes its place with poise.
items.description: A wrapper that brings its direct children on stage in a cascade ranked by where they actually sit, so a grid arrives as one diagonal wave whose gaps open as it lands, all inside the 600 ms budget. Each preset carries its own spring: rise glides up, settle is set down on springs.snap with one overshoot, unfold swings down on a top hinge on springs.glide, and iris opens a clip while the piece drifts up to size; exits run in reverse on the exit ease and never spring. It adds no wrappers and no tab stops of its own — the children stay interactive in their own tab order, and tabbing into waiting content brings it on at once.

props.name: children
props.description: What comes on stage. With scope "children" each direct child moves on its own.

props.name: as
props.description: The element the stage renders — the only node it adds, so a list stays a list.

props.name: preset
props.description: How each piece arrives: rises, is set down, swings down on a top hinge, or opens through an iris.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Gap between neighbouring pieces, ms; the whole cascade is held to the 600 ms budget.

props.name: distance
props.description: How far the pieces travel, px — also the hinge angle of unfold and the zoom of iris.

props.name: scope
props.description: Move each direct child, or the stage as one piece.

props.name: curve
props.description: How the delays are spaced through the order: gaps that open as it lands, close up, or stay even.

props.name: origin
props.description: Where the wave starts; pieces are ranked by where they actually sit, so a grid enters as a diagonal.

props.name: trigger
props.description: What starts the entrance.

props.name: show
props.description: False sends the pieces off with the exit choreography; with trigger "manual", true brings them on.

props.name: once
props.description: True: the entrance plays once. False: leaving view plays the exit and coming back plays it again.

props.name: amount
props.description: Share of the stage that must be visible before an inView entrance starts, 0 to 1.

props.name: delay
props.description: Wait before the first piece moves, ms.

props.name: spring
props.description: Override the preset's spring from the calibration set (rise and unfold glide, settle snaps, iris drifts).

props.name: duration
props.description: Length of the tweened parts (opacity, the iris clip), ms.

props.name: exitOrder
props.description: Order of the exit: last in leaves first, or the entrance order again.

props.name: replayKey
props.description: Change it to play the entrance again from the start.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: The entrance has landed, or the exit has finished.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the stage element; lay out the grid or list here. Other HTML attributes (aria-label, id, style) pass through.

usageNotes: Keyboard and assistive tech: the stage adds no role and no tab stop, so the children keep theirs. Waiting content stays in the accessibility tree, and focus moving into it brings it on stage at once; an exited stage is inert.
Reduced motion: no travel, scale, hinge or clip — each piece fades in on a cascade compressed to a quarter, and exits fade out on the exit ease. The content still arrives.
Motion is written onto the direct children with inline styles and cleared when the entrance lands; a child that sets its own inline transform will have it replaced while it moves.
Children added after the entrance (a list that grows) come on by themselves; keyed reorders are left alone.
No loops: one IntersectionObserver until the entrance has run (kept only with once off), one MutationObserver for late arrivals, every animation stopped on unmount.

items.title: Haze Fade
items.tagline: Content that clears like morning haze.
items.description: A fade-in wrapper whose content clears like haze lifting: three stacked backdrop-blur sheets, each masked a little ahead of the last, make a soft blur ramp that travels across on the move ease, while the content's own mask carries the fade and a brightness lift with it, so a headline sharpens letter by letter from one side to the other. As the front sets off the content rises a few pixels into place on springs.drift, and once clear the sheets and the mask are gone. The content is rendered once and stays selectable and interactive throughout; keyboard focus moving into hazed content clears it at once.

props.name: children
props.description: The content that clears. Rendered once, live and interactive throughout.

props.name: as
props.description: The element that wraps the content.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way the clearing front travels.

props.name: haze
props.description: How thick the haze is, 0 to 1: blur, brightness lift and fade all scale with it.

props.name: duration
props.description: How long the front takes to cross, ms.

props.name: softness
props.description: Width of the soft front as a share of the travel, 0 to 1.

props.name: blur
props.description: Blur at full haze, px.

props.name: brightness
props.description: Brightness at full haze: hazed ink glows a little, the way mist holds light.

props.name: fade
props.description: How far the hazed content fades toward the page at full haze, 0 to 1.

props.name: drift
props.description: How far the content rises into place as it clears, px; 0 keeps it still.

props.name: trigger
props.description: What starts the clearing.

props.name: play
props.description: With trigger "manual": true clears, false lets the haze roll back in.

props.name: once
props.description: True: clears once. False: leaving view brings the haze back for the next visit.

props.name: amount
props.description: Share of the content visible before an inView clearing starts, 0 to 1.

props.name: delay
props.description: Wait before the front sets off, ms.

props.name: replayKey
props.description: Change it to haze the content and clear it again.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: The content is clear.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper; lay out the content here. Other HTML attributes (aria-*, id, handlers) pass through.

usageNotes: Accessibility: the content is never duplicated or hidden from assistive tech, the haze sheets are aria-hidden and pointer-events none, and keyboard focus moving into hazed content clears it immediately.
Reduced motion: no travelling front and no lift — the whole haze cross-fades away over 0.7 s, and the content still arrives.

Theming: the fade is a mask on the content, not a tint, so hazed content fades toward whatever surface is really behind it, in either theme; the brightness lift is what makes it read as luminous mist.

Performance: the backdrop filters exist only while hazed or clearing (about duration ms); once clear they are switched off and the mask removed. One IntersectionObserver until the trigger (kept only with once off).
The heavier sheets thin out within their blur radius of the wrapper's edges so halos are never sliced off; content flush against an edge clears from a lighter blur.

items.title: Arc Border
items.tagline: A frame with lightning in its edge.
items.description: An electric frame around any children: a canvas draws a jagged current that hugs the content's rounded rectangle and re-strikes into a new shape several times a second, each strike a faint ghost strand, a glow pass, the coloured arc with a shadow halo and a hot core, while on a seeded schedule a bright bolt jumps across a corner and dies in 180 ms. Hover or focus inside charges it on springs.snap — the jag deepens, the glow swells, it strikes faster and jumps more — and the charge lets go on springs.drift so the hum lingers. The children stay fully interactive in their own tab order; the canvas never takes a pointer.

props.name: children
props.description: What the frame goes around. Fully interactive; the current never takes a click.

props.name: color
props.description: The current's colour: a preset, or any CSS colour (tokens resolve on the element, so they follow the theme).

props.name: coreColor
props.description: The hot core down the middle of the arc. Defaults to the colour mixed toward white.

props.name: jitter
props.description: How far the edge jags, 0 (a nearly smooth live wire) to 1 (a ragged storm).

props.name: thickness
props.description: Width of the arc, px; the core is 40% of it.

props.name: glow
props.description: How far the soft glow spreads, 0 to 1.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the frame and the content box, px.

props.name: rate
props.description: How many times a second the arc re-strikes into a new shape at rest.

props.name: jumps
props.description: How often a bright jump leaps across a corner, 0 (never) to 1 (often).

props.name: surge
props.description: How far hover and focus inside lift the current, 0 to 1.

props.name: charged
props.description: Hold the frame charged, as if hovered.

props.name: live
props.description: "always" crackles whenever it is on screen; "hover" rests as one still strike until a visitor arrives.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the current still.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for the arc's shapes, so two frames on a page differ.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Highest device pixel ratio the canvas renders at (capped at 2).

props.name: onChargeChange
props.description: The frame charged or settled, from the hover or focus that caused it.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer box (the frame's gutter is its padding).

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Classes for the content box inside the frame — its surface and padding.

usageNotes: Accessibility: the canvas, rail and probes are aria-hidden and pointer-events none; the children keep their own roles and tab order, and keyboard focus inside charges the frame exactly as hover does.
Reduced motion: one still strike that never re-forms and no corner jumps; hover and focus still brighten it, because charge is state.

Performance: the loop runs only on screen, in a visible tab, unpaused and (with live="hover") while charged; between strikes a frame draws nothing. Buffers are typed arrays sized on resize, the backing store is capped at dpr (max 2), and everything is disposed on unmount.
Fit: the gutter that holds the jag and its glow is the outer box's padding, computed from jitter, thickness, glow and surge, so the current never draws outside the component.
Theming: the colour resolves on the component's own element and re-resolves when the theme changes; presets map to the accent, signal, warn and danger tokens.

items.title: Moon Ring
items.tagline: Images circling like moons in orbit.
items.description: Images or generated tiles on a tipped elliptical orbit around a centre object: one phase value drives every moon's position, depth scale, far-side softening and z-order, so moons pass behind the planet and back in front of it, while the ring revolves on its own until a visitor touches it. A drag spins it 1:1 and a release projects the throw, snaps to the nearest moon and lands on springs.drift with the release velocity, so a flick coasts several moons round; a click brings a moon round the shortest way on springs.glide, with an optional whoosh. It is a radio group: the front moon is checked and holds the tab stop, arrow keys bring the neighbours round, and Home and End the first and last.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; label: string; src?: string; alt?: string }[]
props.description: The moons. Short of count, generated tiles fill the ring.

props.name: count
props.description: How many moons circle, 3 to 12.

props.name: tilt
props.description: How far the orbit tips toward you, degrees: 0 is edge-on, 70 nearly overhead.

props.name: speed
props.description: Idle revolution, degrees per second; negative turns the other way, 0 holds still.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The moon at the front. Controlled rings do not drift.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: A new moon reached the front, with what brought it there.

props.name: lean
props.description: The orbit's lean in the picture, degrees.

props.name: depth
props.description: How much smaller the far side is, 0 to 0.8.

props.name: soften
props.description: Blur at the far side of the orbit, px.

props.name: shape
props.description: Moon shape.

props.name: moonSize
props.description: Moon size, px. Fits the stage when left out.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the stage.

props.name: center
props.description: What the moons circle. A lit planet when left out.

props.name: caption
props.description: Name the front moon under the ring.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the ring.

props.name: sound
props.description: A whoosh when a throw or a long trip brings a moon round.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the idle revolution.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No drag, no presses; the moons leave the tab order.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root (a size container for the stage).

usageNotes: Keyboard: one tab stop on the front moon (a radio group); Left/Up and Right/Down bring the neighbouring moon round and move focus with it, Home and End jump to the first and last, Space and Enter bring a focused moon round. Keyboard focus inside holds the revolution still.

Reduced motion: no revolution and no travel — a press, key or release puts the chosen moon at the front at once; dragging still follows the finger, and depth, scale and softening stay as a still picture.
Touch: the stage uses touch-pan-y, so a horizontal drag spins the ring and a vertical one scrolls the page; a tap on a moon brings it round.

Performance: every pose is a useTransform of one phase value — no React state per frame. The revolution runs only uncontrolled, on screen, in a visible tab, unpaused and untouched, and eases back in a moment after the visitor leaves.
Sound is off unless sound is set, and only ever answers a drag, press or key — never the idle revolution.

items.title: Block Dissolve
items.tagline: Swap images through a cascade of pixels.
items.description: A two-state transition for any two children: the first dissolves into the second block by block, each clipped by a path rebuilt every frame so even transparent content never shows through. The blocks come from a seeded quadtree and flip in a random, diagonal or pointer-led order with coarse blocks first and finer halves and quarters filling the holes, so the block size eases from coarse to fine as the dissolve finishes, and a faint glint rides the blocks that have just flipped; progress is one tween on the move ease and turns back over the same blocks if the pointer leaves early. With hover or press it is a single toggle button: Enter and Space swap it, touch taps swap it, and only the state on show is exposed to assistive technology.

props.name: children
props.description: Exactly two children: the first state, then the second. Any content — images, cards, charts.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Which state shows.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: The state changed, from the hover, press or key that changed it.

props.name: trigger
props.description: What swaps the states: hovering (keys and taps toggle), pressing, or only value.

props.name: block
props.description: Coarse block size, px; the run refines to halves and quarters of it.

props.name: order
props.description: The order the blocks flip in: seeded scatter, a diagonal sweep, or outward from the pointer.

props.name: duration
props.description: How long the whole dissolve takes, ms.

props.name: levels
props.description: How many sizes the blocks refine through.

props.name: glint
props.description: Brightness of the glint on freshly flipped blocks, 0 to 1.

props.name: glintColor
props.description: Colour of the glint.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for the block order and the coarse-to-fine split.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the toggle, e.g. "Show the night view".

props.name: disabled
props.description: No swapping; the toggle says it is unavailable.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: A dissolve finished on this state.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the box — give it a size or an aspect ratio and a radius.

usageNotes: Keyboard: with hover or press the box is one tab stop, a toggle button with aria-pressed; Enter and Space swap the states (from the centre). Touch has no hover, so a tap swaps a hover dissolve.
Reduced motion: no blocks — the two states cross-fade over 0.4 s, and the swap still happens.
Accessibility: the state not on show is aria-hidden and inert, so screen readers and Tab only meet what is visible. Keep interactive controls out of the children when the box itself is the toggle.
Performance: nothing runs at rest and neither child is clipped. During a dissolve one tween drives the clip paths; the blocks are built once per run into typed arrays.
Fit: the box sizes to the larger child (both share one grid cell); give it an aspect ratio so the two states line up.

items.title: Sheen Glass
items.tagline: A glint that follows your hand across glass.
items.description: A glass glare over any card: a soft streak of light with a brighter core and a faint ghost reflection rides with the hand on a spring between flick and drift, turns toward perpendicular to the way the hand is travelling on springs.glide, and flares with pointer speed on springs.flick before sinking back on springs.drift. On leave it keeps going the way the hand went and slides off the edge while it fades on the exit ease, and a 1 px inner rim catches the light nearest the streak. Keyboard focus inside the card brings the light to the focused control; the card's children are untouched and fully interactive.

props.name: children
props.description: The card under the glass. Untouched and fully interactive.

props.name: angle
props.description: The streak's resting lean off vertical, degrees.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the soft streak, px; the bright core is a fifth of it.

props.name: strength
props.description: Peak brightness of the glint, 0 to 1.

props.name: speedBoost
props.description: How much a fast hand brightens it, 0 to 1.

props.name: steer
props.description: How far the direction of travel turns the streak, 0 (never) to 1 (fully perpendicular).

props.name: lag
props.description: How loosely the glint trails the hand, 0 (tight) to 1 (lazy).

props.name: color
props.description: The light's colour.

props.name: core
props.description: Brightness of the core against the soft streak, 0 to 1.

props.name: ghost
props.description: The faint second reflection beside the streak, 0 to 1.

props.name: edge
props.description: How much the inner border catches the light, 0 to 1.

props.name: blend
props.description: How the light mixes with the card.

props.name: intro
props.description: One sweep across the first time the card comes into view.

props.name: interval
props.description: A sweep every so many ms while on screen; 0 never.

props.name: sweepKey
props.description: Change it to send a sweep across now.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No glint at all.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card box; its radius is the glass's. Other HTML attributes and handlers pass through.

usageNotes: Accessibility: the glare and rim are aria-hidden and pointer-events none; the children keep their roles and tab order, and keyboard focus inside the card brings the light to the focused control (the same end state the pointer reaches).
Reduced motion: no following, steering, sliding or sweeps — the light rests a third of the way across at the resting angle, and hover and focus brighten it in place with a cross-fade.
Theming: light only brightens, so the glint shows on mid and dark surfaces and fades into near-white ones; use blend="overlay" for a glossier look on mid-tones.
Performance: no loop of its own — motion values and springs run only while settling. The intro observer disconnects after its sweep, and interval sweeps run only on screen in a visible tab.
Touch: the glint follows a finger until the page starts scrolling, then slides off.

items.title: Float Field
items.tagline: Particles that drift away from your touch.
items.description: A few hundred soft motes rise through the box behind your content on a gentle seeded sway, in three depths from small far points to large out-of-focus discs. The pointer carries a bubble of clear air whose centre trails it on springs.glide's constants and whose radius opens on springs.glide and closes on springs.drift, so motes crowd along its rim and drift back in behind it; a press releases a burst that throws nearby motes upward and sends a fountain of sparks after them. Keyboard focus on a control inside opens the bubble around it, and Enter or Space on it bursts from its centre.

props.name: count
props.description: How many motes fill a 760×232 box; a box of another size gets proportionally more or fewer.

props.name: rise
props.description: How fast the motes rise, in px per second; near motes rise faster than far ones.

props.name: repel
props.description: How hard the pointer's bubble pushes motes away, 0 to 1; 0 is no bubble.

props.name: radius
props.description: The bubble's radius in px, never more than 40% of the box's shorter side.

props.name: turbulence
props.description: How much the motes sway sideways as they rise, 0 to 1.

props.name: size
props.description: The base radius of a mote in px; depth scales it from about half to twice that.

props.name: glow
props.description: How soft a halo each mote carries, from a crisp dot at 0 to a wide glow at 1.

props.name: burst
props.description: How strong a press's burst is, 0 to 1; 0 turns bursts off.

props.name: colors
props.description: Mote colours, any CSS colours, resolved on the element so they follow the theme; the first is the most common.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Respond to the pointer, presses and keyboard focus.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freeze the field where it is.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for the motes' arrangement and sway.

props.name: dpr
props.description: The highest device pixel ratio the canvas draws at (never above 2).

props.name: onBurst
props.description: Fires when a press or a keyboard activation releases a burst, with its point in the box.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the box; size it here.

props.name: children
props.description: Content laid over the field; it keeps every click, focus and key.

usageNotes: The field is aria-hidden decoration under your content: the canvas never takes a click, and the wrapper only listens, so every button and link inside works as it would without it.
Keyboard visitors get the same bubble: focusing a control inside opens clear air around it, and Enter or Space on it releases the burst from its centre.

One 2D canvas with pre-drawn sprites and no allocation per frame. The loop runs only on screen with the tab visible and not paused, and rations itself to about 30 fps while nobody touches it; the backing store caps its device pixel ratio at 2.
Colours resolve from tokens on the component's own element and redraw when the theme changes, so the motes read on light and dark surfaces alike; give the box its background with className.
Under reduced motion the field is one still scatter, denser low than high, and the pointer and presses leave it alone.

items.title: Logo Parade
items.tagline: A conveyor of marks that slows to look.
items.description: An endless conveyor of marks with edge fades, built in the DOM so every mark stays crisp and real. A row's speed is a spring on springs.drift's constants, so under the pointer it brakes smoothly to a stop and picks back up when the pointer leaves, while the mark under the pointer lifts on springs.snap and takes its colour as the rest stay muted; rows drag 1:1 and a flick hands its velocity to the same spring, so the conveyor spins away, leans into the throw and glides back to cruising speed, with further rows running the other way. Linked or selectable marks sit on a roving tabindex where Left and Right move between them and the row glides on springs.glide to centre the focused one; plain marks make the row the focus stop and the arrows step it.

props.name: items
props.description: The marks, each `{ id, name, mark, color?, href? }`; the mark paints with currentColor and may use var(--mark-color) for an accent that turns to `color` when looked at.

props.name: speed
props.description: Cruising speed in px per second.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between marks in px.

props.name: rows
props.description: How many rows, 1 to 3; each further row runs the other way, half a set along.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way the first row travels.

props.name: hoverSpeed
props.description: The share of the cruising speed a row keeps under the pointer, 0 to 1; 0 brakes it to a stop.

props.name: lift
props.description: How far the looked-at mark lifts, in px.

props.name: muted
props.description: How grey and faint the marks at rest are, 0 to 1.

props.name: fade
props.description: Width of the edge fades in px, never more than a fifth of the row.

props.name: skew
props.description: How far a fast row leans into its travel, 0 to 1.

props.name: size
props.description: Row height and mark size.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Let rows be dragged and flicked.

props.name: paused
props.description: Stop the conveyor; marks still answer the pointer and keys.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the list of marks.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called when a mark without an href is pressed or activated with Enter.

props.name: onLook
props.description: Called when the mark being looked at (hovered or focused) changes, with null when none is.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wall.

usageNotes: Moving content needs a way to stop it: pass `paused` from a Pause control of your own, as the demo does. Hovering or focusing a row also stops it, and reduced motion keeps every row still.

The first row is a real list that holds each mark once by its `name`; echo copies and further rows are hidden from assistive technology and out of the tab order, so a wall of six marks is six list items and one Tab stop.

Give marks an `href` or pass `onSelect` to make them links or buttons on a roving tabindex: Left and Right move between them, Home and End jump, Enter activates, and the row glides to centre the focused mark. A release at the end of a drag never activates the mark under it.
Marks inherit colour: draw them with currentColor for the wordmark and var(--mark-color) for an accent, and give each item a `color` (a token or any CSS colour) for the look it takes when hovered.
Each row runs its own animation frame only while it moves on screen; a row braked to a stop under the pointer costs nothing until the pointer leaves.

items.title: Lock On
items.tagline: A reticle that locks onto what you point at.
items.description: A target cursor bounded to the container it wraps: a hotspot dot sits exactly under the pointer while a reticle of four corner brackets trails it on a house spring and turns slowly, a little faster as it travels. When the pointer reaches an interactive child the brackets snap outward to frame it on springs.snap while the rotation unwinds to square, with a lock flash and an optional tick, and leaving releases them back to the pointer on springs.glide. Keyboard focus locks onto the focused control the same way and gives the system cursor back.

props.name: corner
props.description: Length of each bracket's arms, in px.

props.name: spin
props.description: How fast the idle reticle turns, in degrees per second; travel adds a little more.

props.name: color
props.description: The reticle's colour: a named tone or any CSS colour.

props.name: size
props.description: The idle reticle's size, in px.

props.name: padding
props.description: Space between a locked target and its frame, in px.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Bracket stroke width, in px.

props.name: follow
props.description: The house spring the idle reticle trails the pointer on.

props.name: targets
props.description: What the reticle locks onto, as a CSS selector; disabled controls never lock.

props.name: hideCursor
props.description: Hide the system cursor inside the container while a mouse is there; text fields keep theirs.

props.name: flash
props.description: Flash the frame when it locks.

props.name: dot
props.description: Show a hotspot dot exactly under the pointer.

props.name: rest
props.description: With nobody pointing, rest the frame dimly on the first target, or on one marked data-lock-home.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a tick when the reticle locks, pitched by the target's width; never before the page has had a click, tap or key.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turn the reticle off and give the cursor back.

props.name: onLock
props.description: Called with the element the reticle locks onto, and with null when it lets go.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the container.

props.name: children
props.description: The content the reticle roams over; it keeps every click, focus and key.

usageNotes: The reticle is an aria-hidden layer with pointer-events none: buttons, links and fields inside keep their own clicks, focus and keys. The system cursor is hidden only inside the container and only for a mouse, comes back on leave and as soon as a key is pressed, and text fields keep their I-beam.
Keyboard focus locks the frame onto the focused control (it pairs well with your own focus ring), so Tab walks the reticle through the content exactly as the pointer does.
Mark a control with data-lock-target to make anything lockable, data-lock-home to choose where the frame rests, or pass `targets` to narrow the selector.
Under reduced motion nothing spins or springs: the reticle follows the dot exactly and a lock jumps onto its target with a short fade.

DOM only: four brackets, a flash and a dot positioned from motion values. An animation frame runs only to turn the idle reticle while a mouse is inside and on screen; a locked or resting reticle costs nothing.

items.title: Halo Rings
items.tagline: Rings that ripple out from your cursor.
items.description: Rings of light ripple out from a source that trails the pointer, drawn in one WebGL2 pass under your content: each ring spreads, thins and fades, and because every ring is a short wave packet summed as a wave, offset rings that cross add and cancel into a fine lattice. The source follows the pointer on a damped spring blended between springs.glide and springs.drift by `lag`, so a sweep leaves a wake of crossing rings, and a press sends a bright ring that cuts through the rest. Keyboard focus moves the source to the focused control and Enter or Space on it sends the bright ring.

props.name: pulse
props.description: Rings sent per second while the pointer is in; three quarters of that at rest.

props.name: width
props.description: A new ring's width in px; it thins as it spreads.

props.name: colors
props.description: A named palette, or two CSS colours a ring travels between as it ages; resolved on the element so they follow the theme.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast a ring spreads, in px per second.

props.name: reach
props.description: How far a ring travels before it has faded out, in px, never past the box's diagonal.

props.name: lag
props.description: How far the source trails the pointer, from springs.glide at 0 to springs.drift at 1.

props.name: interference
props.description: From plain glowing rings at 0 to wave packets whose crests add and cancel where they cross at 1.

props.name: intensity
props.description: How bright the rings are, 0 to 1.

props.name: origin
props.description: Where the source rests with nobody pointing, as x and y fractions of the box.

props.name: ambient
props.description: Keep pulsing from origin while nobody points; off, the rings die away and the loop stops.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Follow the pointer and keyboard focus; a press sends a bright ring.

props.name: layer
props.description: Draw the rings under the content or over it.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freeze the rings where they are.

props.name: dpr
props.description: The highest device pixel ratio the canvas draws at (never above 2).

props.name: onRing
props.description: Fires when a press or a keyboard activation sends a bright ring, with its point in the box.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the box; size it here.

props.name: children
props.description: Content over (or under) the rings; it keeps every click, focus and key.

usageNotes: The rings are an aria-hidden canvas with pointer-events none; the wrapper only listens, so every control inside keeps its clicks, focus and keys. Keyboard visitors move the source by focusing a control and send the bright ring with Enter or Space.

One WebGL2 context and one draw per frame, with up to 24 rings in a uniform array. The loop runs only while a ring is alive or the source is pulsing, on screen with the tab visible; resting, it draws every other frame, and with ambient off it stops once the last ring fades. The backing store caps its device pixel ratio at 2.
Without WebGL2, or after a lost context, the same rings are stroked on a 2D canvas (without the interference); before the first frame a CSS still of soft rings stands in.
Palettes resolve from tokens on the component's own element and re-resolve on a theme change; on a dark page the brightest crossings burn toward white, on a light one they stay pigment.
Under reduced motion the rings are one still ripple around origin, and a press re-centres it instantly.

items.title: Laser Sheet
items.tagline: A beam that sweeps and scatters off the page.
items.description: A volumetric laser sheet in a hazy room, drawn per pixel in one WebGL2 pass behind your content: an emitter near the top fans a thin sheet of light down through drifting haze, the haze glows in proportion to the path each view ray travels inside the sheet (faint and textured while it faces you, a bright blade as it turns edge-on), dust glints only as it crosses the plane, and the sheet meets the floor in a crisp bright line with a spill of light around it. It sweeps back and forth on its own; the pointer steers it instead, the angle trailing on a damped spring blended between springs.glide and springs.drift by `lag`, and a press fires a pulse down the sheet that flares the line where it lands. Keyboard focus aims the sheet at the focused control and Enter or Space on it fires.

props.name: haze
props.description: How thick the air is, 0 to 1: from clear air where only the floor line shows to a dense, glowing fan.

props.name: sweep
props.description: How fast the sheet sweeps on its own, from holding still at 0 to a pass every couple of seconds at 1.

props.name: color
props.description: The beam's colour: a named tone or any CSS colour, resolved on the element so it follows the theme.

props.name: spread
props.description: Half the fan's opening, in degrees.

props.name: range
props.description: How far the sheet swings either way, in degrees.

props.name: lag
props.description: How far the beam trails the pointer, from springs.glide at 0 to springs.drift at 1.

props.name: dust
props.description: How much dust glints in the sheet, 0 to 1.

props.name: glow
props.description: How bright the floor line and its spill are, 0 to 1.

props.name: grid
props.description: Draw a faint perspective grid on the floor.

props.name: source
props.description: Where the emitter hangs, as x and y fractions of the box (y up to 0.5).

props.name: interactive
props.description: Steer with the pointer and keyboard focus; a press fires a pulse down the sheet.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freeze the beam where it is.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for the haze and the dust.

props.name: dpr
props.description: The highest device pixel ratio the canvas draws at (never above 2).

props.name: onFire
props.description: Fires when a press or a keyboard activation fires a pulse.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the box; size it and give it its background here.

props.name: children
props.description: Content laid over the scene; it keeps every click, focus and key.

usageNotes: The scene is an aria-hidden canvas with pointer-events none behind your content; the wrapper only listens, so every control inside keeps its clicks, focus and keys. Keyboard visitors aim the sheet by focusing a control and fire it with Enter or Space.

The room is the box's own background: give it one with className (a surface token) and the floor, grid and beam are worked out from it. On a dark room the light adds and burns toward white; on a pale one the beam is laid down as pigment, so both themes read.

One WebGL2 context and one draw per frame. The loop runs only on screen with the tab visible and not paused; sweeping on its own it draws about 30 frames a second, every frame while steered or firing. The backing store caps its device pixel ratio at 2.
Without WebGL2, or after a lost context, a CSS still of the fan, its floor line and the emitter stands in; the same still shows before the first frame.
Under reduced motion the scene is one still frame with the sheet at a fixed angle; presses and focus re-aim it instantly and never fire.

items.title: Compass Field
items.tagline: A field of needles turns to find you.
items.description: A staggered grid of compass needles on one canvas, each a damped rotational spring that turns to point at the pointer with a wobble set by its damping ratio, stiffening, lengthening and brightening as the pointer comes near. Every needle reads the pointer where it was distance / wave seconds ago, so a turn spreads outward from the hand like a ripple and the field swings home to north as a wave from wherever the pointer left; a seeded gust swings through it the first time it comes into view. Keyboard focus inside turns the needles toward the focused element, and a tap turns them for a moment.

props.name: children
props.description: Content laid over the field, such as a headline; it stays fully interactive.

props.name: density
props.description: How many needles stand in every 100 px, along each axis.

props.name: length
props.description: A needle's resting length, as a share of the space between needles.

props.name: damping
props.description: Each needle's damping ratio: low values ring and wobble, 1 settles dead-beat.

props.name: grow
props.description: How much longer needles grow as the pointer comes near, as a share of their length.

props.name: reach
props.description: The distance, in px, within which needles answer faster, lengthen and brighten.

props.name: speed
props.description: How quickly the needles answer overall, as a multiple of the house stiffness.

props.name: wave
props.description: How fast a turn spreads outward from the pointer, in px per second; 0 turns every needle at once.

props.name: north
props.description: The bearing every needle rests at when the pointer is away, in degrees clockwise from up.

props.name: scatter
props.description: The seeded deviation from that bearing at rest, in degrees.

props.name: polarity
props.description: Whether the north ends turn toward the pointer or away from it.

props.name: northColor
props.description: The north half of every needle, any CSS colour, resolved on the element.

props.name: southColor
props.description: The south half and the pivot, any CSS colour, resolved on the element.

props.name: intro
props.description: One gust through the field the first time it comes into view.

props.name: followFocus
props.description: Keyboard focus inside turns the needles toward the focused element.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer (mouse and pen) turns the needles, and a tap turns them for a moment.

props.name: paused
props.description: Holds every needle where it is and stops the loop.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for the resting scatter, each needle's own frequency and the gust.

props.name: dpr
props.description: The highest device pixel ratio the canvas draws at (never above 2).

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the box; give it a height.

props.name: ref
props.description: Exposes swing(), which sends a silent, seeded gust through the field.

usageNotes: The canvas sits under the children, is aria-hidden and never takes a click, so everything laid over the field reads, focuses and clicks as usual; the system cursor is left alone.
Keyboard visitors see the field answer them: focus inside turns every needle toward the focused element until focus leaves. A tap turns the field toward it for 1.2 s without touching scroll.

Needles live in typed arrays and are drawn in six fills a frame. The loop runs only while a needle is still swinging or the pointer is moving, on screen and with the tab visible; a settled field costs nothing. DPR is capped at 2.

Colours resolve on the element and re-resolve when the theme changes, so tokens work in light and dark; the server renders a faint dot grid of the pivots that hands over to the canvas on its first frame.
Under reduced motion there is no spring, wobble, wave or gust: needles point straight at the pointer, still lengthen and brighten near it, and jump home on leave.

items.title: Phantom Cursor
items.tagline: A shadow self that lags behind you.
items.description: A shadow self that follows the pointer inside its box: a soft form of rising smoke shaped like the pointer's own arrow (or a round wisp), drawn by one WebGL2 shader scissored to its own bounds. It trails on a 2D spring that slides from springs.glide to one softer than springs.drift, smearing along its travel, then stiffens up to five times and hurries in to condense under the cursor once the hand rests, and dissolves after an idle moment. Keyboard focus inside sends it to rest on the focused element's corner.

props.name: children
props.description: The surface the phantom haunts; it stays fully interactive.

props.name: lag
props.description: How far it lags the hand: 0 keeps close on the glide spring, 1 trails on a spring softer than drift.

props.name: size
props.description: The phantom's height, in CSS pixels.

props.name: smoke
props.description: How much of it is smoke: 0 is a soft silhouette, 1 a loose, drifting wisp.

props.name: shape
props.description: A shadow of the pointer's own arrow, or a round wisp.

props.name: stretch
props.description: How far it smears behind itself along its travel, 0 to 1.

props.name: catchUp
props.description: How much faster it closes in once the hand rests, 0 (never hurries) to 1 (five times stiffer).

props.name: idle
props.description: How long it lingers once caught up and still, in ms, before it dissolves; 0 never dissolves while the pointer is inside.

props.name: offset
props.description: Where it rests relative to the pointer, in CSS pixels; a shadow falls below and to the right.

props.name: color
props.description: Its colour, any CSS colour, resolved on the element.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Its peak opacity, 0 to 1.

props.name: followFocus
props.description: Keyboard focus inside sends the phantom to the focused element.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer (mouse and pen) summons it; touch gets the resting state.

props.name: paused
props.description: Holds the smoke's drift; the phantom still follows.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for the smoke.

props.name: dpr
props.description: The highest device pixel ratio the canvas draws at (never above 2).

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the box.

props.name: ref
props.description: Exposes appear(x?, y?), which shows the phantom resting at a point in the box (its centre when omitted) until it dissolves; ignored while the visitor's pointer is inside.

usageNotes: The canvas is aria-hidden and never takes a click, and the system cursor is never hidden, so the phantom is a companion rather than a replacement: the children read, focus and click as usual.
Keyboard focus inside sends the phantom to the focused element's corner, where it dissolves after the idle time like it does for the pointer. Touch-only visitors get the resting state: no phantom.
