The shader runs only inside a scissor rect around the phantom and its smear, and the loop stops once it has dissolved, is off screen or the tab is hidden. DPR is capped at 2; program and buffers are disposed on unmount.
Without WebGL2, or after a lost context, a blurred DOM copy of the same shape takes over on the same physics, smearing along its travel with a composited transform.
Under reduced motion there is no lag, smear or drift: a still, soft shadow sits exactly at the pointer and fades in and out.

items.title: Edge Haze
items.tagline: Content that blurs softly into the edges.
items.description: A scroll area whose edges dissolve instead of cutting off: stacks of backdrop blurs, each twice the last and masked to begin a step further toward the edge, ramp the content smoothly from sharp to the full blur while a wash of the surface's own colour deepens toward the edge. Each edge's haze measures what it hides — the distance hidden beyond it over reach, followed on springs.glide — so the bottom haze recedes as the end comes near and lifts away on arrival while the top one gathers, and with nothing to scroll nothing is drawn. The viewport is a focusable region while it overflows, so arrow keys, Page Up and Down, Home and End scroll it natively.

props.name: children
props.description: The scrolling content.

props.name: strength
props.description: The blur at the very edge, in CSS pixels; it halves at each step inward.

props.name: height
props.description: How deep the haze reaches into the area at its fullest, in CSS pixels.

props.name: edges
props.description: Which edges haze over when content is hidden beyond them.

props.name: steps
props.description: How many blur layers build the ramp, 3 to 8.

props.name: fade
props.description: How far the content fades into the surface at the very edge as well as blurring, 0 (not at all) to 1 (gone at the edge).

props.name: reach
props.description: How many pixels of hidden content give the full haze.

props.name: tint
props.defaultValue: the first solid background behind the area
props.description: The colour the content fades into at the edge, any CSS colour; read on the element and again when the theme changes.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: The scroll area's maximum height (a number is CSS pixels); or size the box with className.

props.name: label
props.description: The scroll area's accessible name.

props.name: scrollPadding
props.description: Keep keyboard-focused content and page steps clear of the haze.

props.name: onEdgesChange
props.description: Fires when content starts or stops being hidden beyond either edge, and once on the first measure.

props.name: viewportRef
props.description: A ref to the scrolling element, for hosts that scroll it themselves.

props.name: viewportClassName
props.description: Classes for the scrolling element.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the box.

usageNotes: The viewport is a role="region" with an accessible name and becomes a tab stop only while it overflows, so keyboard visitors scroll it with arrow keys, Page Up and Down, Space, Home and End; scroll padding equal to the haze keeps a focused item clear of the blur.

No overflow, no cost: when the content fits, the blur layers are not rendered and the content carries no mask. There is no animation loop; a passive scroll listener writes two values and the springs run only while they settle.

The fade is a wash of the surface's own colour that stands still over the edge while the content scrolls under it, so it can never lag a fast scroll; it reads the first solid background behind the area (or tint) and re-reads it when the theme changes. The scrollbar and the focus ring stay crisp, and the blur stops short of the scrollbar.
Size the box with className (a height, or a grid row of minmax(0, 1fr)) or pass maxHeight; the haze stacks inherit the box's corner radius.
Under reduced motion each edge's haze follows the scroll directly with no spring; it still shows, because it tells the reader there is more.

items.title: Click Bloom
items.tagline: Every click blooms into petals.
items.description: A wrapper whose every click opens a small flower on one canvas: the petals unfold out of the press point on springs.snap's response with the pollen popping on springs.recoil's, then each lets go in its own moment, thrown outward by spread to fall under gravity through air that slows it, tumbling in 3D on two axes so it thins to an edge, shows its darker back and slips sideways as it turns, while a few heavier seeds burst out ahead. Rapid clicks layer blooms; keyboard clicks — Enter or Space on anything inside — bloom from the centre of what was activated.

props.name: children
props.description: What blooms when clicked; it stays fully interactive.

props.name: petals
props.description: Petals in each bloom, 3 to 12.

props.name: spread
props.description: How far the petals are thrown when they let go, as a multiple of the house throw.

props.name: gravity
props.description: How hard petals and seeds fall, in px/s².

props.name: seeds
props.description: Seeds thrown with each bloom, 0 to 12; heavier and quicker than the petals.

props.name: size
props.description: A petal's length, in CSS pixels.

props.name: drag
props.description: Air resistance, 0 (petals drop like stones) to 1 (they float and drift).

props.name: tumble
props.description: How hard petals turn over as they fall, 0 to 1.

props.name: duration
props.description: How long a bloom lives, in ms, before its last petal has faded.

props.name: colors
props.description: The blooms' colours, any CSS colours resolved on the element; each bloom takes the next.

props.name: max
props.description: The most blooms in the air at once; the oldest retires early to make room.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Bloom on the press itself, or on the completed click; keyboard clicks bloom either way.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No blooms.

props.name: onBloom
props.description: Fires with each bloom the visitor opens, at its point in the box's own pixels.

props.name: sound
props.description: A soft pop with each bloom the visitor opens.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for every petal's throw, spin and lifetime.

props.name: dpr
props.description: The highest device pixel ratio the canvas draws at (never above 2).

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the box.

props.name: ref
props.description: Exposes bloom(x?, y?), which opens a silent bloom at a point in the box (its centre when omitted).

usageNotes: The canvas is aria-hidden and never takes a click; every control inside keeps its own role and handlers, and the bloom is decoration on top of them.

Keyboard visitors get the same bloom: a click with no pointer behind it (Enter or Space) opens from the centre of the activated element. Touch blooms on the tap, so a scroll that starts on the box never blooms.

Particles live in a preallocated pool of typed arrays; nothing allocates per frame. The loop runs only while a petal is alive, on screen and with the tab visible, and stops with the last one. DPR is capped at 2.
Colours default to pigments at fixed lightness, so a bloom reads the same in light and dark; blush and back tones are mixed in oklab and re-resolved when the theme changes.
Sound is off unless asked for and only ever answers the visitor's press or key; bloom() from the ref is always silent.
Under reduced motion a soft ring in the bloom's colour appears at the point and fades, with no petals and no travel.

items.title: Lodestone
items.tagline: Elements that lean toward your cursor.
items.description: A magnetic wrapper whose still outer box measures the pointer while an inner layer leans toward it once it comes within radius of the child's own edges: it follows strength of the pointer's offset — most when close — eased into a limit, and tilts in perspective so the nearest side rises toward it, on a follow spring between springs.glide and springs.snap integrated per frame. Past the field's edge the bond breaks and it snaps home on springs.recoil with the velocity it had; a press seats it on springs.flick, and keyboard focus holds it steady with a small lift on springs.snap while a drop shadow falls away from the pull.

props.name: children
props.description: What the lodestone pulls: a button, an icon, a card; it keeps its own role, focus and clicks.

props.name: radius
props.description: How far the pull reaches beyond the child's own edges, in CSS pixels.

props.name: strength
props.description: How much of the pointer's offset from the child's centre it follows, 0 to 1.

props.name: tilt
props.description: How far it tilts toward the pointer at most, in degrees.

props.name: limit
props.description: The most it travels, in CSS pixels; the pull eases into this cap.

props.name: lift
props.description: How far keyboard focus lifts it, in CSS pixels, while holding it steady.

props.name: shadow
props.description: The shadow that falls away from the pull and deepens with the lift, 0 to 1.

props.name: release
props.description: The spring it snaps home on when the pointer leaves the field.

props.name: axis
props.description: Which way it may travel.

props.name: pressable
props.description: A press seats it: back toward the centre and down a little, until release.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer pulls it (mouse and pen; touch gets the resting state).

props.name: disabled
props.description: No pull, no tilt, no press; it rests.

props.name: onPullChange
props.description: Fires when the pointer enters or leaves the field, with whether it is now pulled.

props.name: as
props.description: The wrapper's element: a div, or a span for inline use.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the still outer box (its layout never moves).

props.name: innerClassName
props.description: Classes for the moving inner layer.

usageNotes: The wrapper adds no role and no tab stop: the child keeps its semantics, focus and clicks, and because the moving layer is the child's own box, hit testing follows what the eye sees.
Keyboard focus inside holds the child steady and lifts it slightly, so a focused control never drifts away from its focus ring; touch-only visitors get the resting state.
One passive pointermove listener on the document is attached only while the wrapper is on screen and interactive; the spring loop runs only while the child is moving and stops when it settles.
Give neighbouring lodestones room for limit on each side (20 px apart at the defaults) so two leaning toward the same pointer never touch.
Under reduced motion nothing travels or tilts; keyboard focus shows as a shadow alone.

items.title: Kelp Strands
items.tagline: Strands that sway as you pass through.
items.description: A bed of kelp anchored along the bottom of its box, every strand a Verlet chain with a fixed root, buoyant toward the tip, held upright by a bending constraint set by stiffness and dragged toward the velocity of the water around it, so it sways as a slow swell rolls across the bed. The pointer pushes the water: strands part around the hand, the eddies it leaves keep curling them for a moment, and they spring back; up to three depth rows (further back is shorter, fainter and slower) are drawn as tapered blades shaded from base to tip with a float at each end. Keyboard focus inside parts the strands around the focused element.

props.name: children
props.description: Content laid over the bed, such as a headline; it stays fully interactive.

props.name: count
props.description: How many strands grow across the box.

props.name: current
props.description: The strength of the slow current that sways the bed, 0 (still water) to 1 (a strong swell).

props.name: stiffness
props.description: How upright and springy the strands are, 0 (limp, trailing long behind a wake) to 1 (stalks that snap back).

props.name: rows
props.description: Depth rows, 1 to 3: rows further back are shorter, fainter and slower.

props.name: height
props.description: How far up the box the tallest strands reach, 0 to 1.

props.name: width
props.description: The root width of a front-row strand, in CSS pixels.

props.name: wake
props.description: How hard the pointer pushes the water, 0 to 1.

props.name: radius
props.description: How far the pointer's push reaches, in CSS pixels.

props.name: colors
props.description: The base and tip colours, any CSS colours resolved on the element.

props.name: floats
props.description: A small gas float at the tip of each strand.

props.name: motes
props.description: Faint specks drifting with the current.

props.name: followFocus
props.description: Keyboard focus inside parts the strands around the focused element.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer (and a sideways swipe) pushes through the strands.

props.name: paused
props.description: Holds the bed still and stops the loop.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for where every strand grows, how tall it is and how it sways.

props.name: dpr
props.description: The highest device pixel ratio the canvas draws at (never above 2).

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the box; give it a height.

usageNotes: The canvas sits under the children, is aria-hidden and never takes a click; keyboard focus inside parts the strands around the focused element so keyboard visitors see the bed answer them.
The box is touch-pan-y: a sideways swipe pushes through the strands while vertical swipes still scroll the page.

About 300 points of physics and one gradient per strand built on resize or theme change, never per frame. The loop runs on screen, visible and unpaused; with current 0 it stops once the water is still and restarts on a wake. DPR is capped at 2.

Colours default to pigments at fixed lightness from --success and --signal, re-resolved when the theme changes, so the bed reads in light and dark; back rows fade by opacity, so they work over any surface.
Under reduced motion the bed is a still frame leaning gently with the mean current; focus still parts it, as an instant change.

items.title: Peel Label
items.tagline: A label you can lift by its corner.
items.description: A paper label over any content whose fold is real geometry: the fold line is the perpendicular bisector of the corner and the tip under your finger, the face is clipped beyond it, and the corner's half is reflected across it — curled, liner-pale, shaded at the crease and casting a shadow that deepens as it lifts. Released short of halfway it falls back on a spring between springs.snap and springs.recoil that takes the throw, slapping flat and popping back to its dog-ear; past halfway the fold runs across the label on springs.glide and the sheet leaves, and putting it back rolls it on and lands it on springs.recoil. The corner is a slider: arrows peel a step at a time, End or Enter lifts it off, Home or Escape lays it back, and Enter on a bared label puts it back.

props.name: children
props.description: What the label covers, revealed when it comes off. It also sizes the label.

props.name: label
props.description: The label's printed face. Presentational: the back shows it mirrored.

props.name: corner
props.description: The corner that stands up and is lifted.

props.name: curl
props.description: How much the lifted paper rolls rather than folding flat, 0 to 1: a broader, brighter crease and more sheet off the surface.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Depth of the shadow under the lifted paper, 0 to 1.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Share of the corner-to-corner pull past which a release (with the throw projected) lifts the label off.

props.name: dogEar
props.description: How far the corner stands up at rest, in px; 0 lays it flat.

props.name: bounce
props.description: How lively the fall back is: 0 settles on the snap spring, 1 bounces on the recoil spring.

props.name: step
props.description: How far one arrow key peels, as a share of the pull.

props.name: color
props.description: The face's paper, any CSS colour; a pigment so it reads the same in both themes.

props.name: backColor
props.description: The back of the label, its liner side.

props.name: ink
props.description: Ink for the printed face and its perforated rule.

props.name: showThrough
props.description: How much of the print shows through the back, mirrored, 0 to 1.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the label, px.

props.name: intro
props.description: Lift the corner once, as an invitation, the first time it comes into view.

props.name: peeled / defaultPeeled
props.description: Whether the label is off, controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onPeeledChange
props.description: Fires from the release, key or press that took the label off or put it back.

props.name: onProgressChange
props.description: Fires as the visitor peels, with how far, 0 to 1 (two decimals).

props.name: handleLabel
props.description: The corner handle's accessible name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Holds the label down: no drag, no keys.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play the paper's sounds: a crinkle when the corner is taken and as the adhesive lets go, a brighter one when it comes off, a soft one when it lands back.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the box; the children size it.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the corner is a role="slider" (0–100, with a spoken value). Right and Up peel a step and the label holds there; a step past the threshold lifts it off. Left and Down step back, Home or Escape lays it back (Escape is only taken when there is a peel to undo), End or Enter lifts it off, and Enter on a bared label puts it back. Moving focus away lets a held peel fall.

While the label is on, the covered children are inert — they cannot be seen, so they cannot be focused; once it is off they are fully interactive. The face and the flap are aria-hidden presentation, so keep `label` free of controls and ids.

Reduced motion: the drag still follows the hand, but nothing springs — a release puts the corner straight back, lifting off fades the label away, putting it back fades it in, and keyboard steps jump. The fold shading and the spoken progress still show.

Performance: DOM and CSS only. The fold is four layers whose clip-path, transform and filter are written from one change handler on the tip's motion values — no loop, no canvas, no React render per frame, and nothing runs at rest.

Colours are CSS strings applied directly, so they follow a theme switch with no work; the defaults are pigments of the accent at fixed lightness, so the label looks like the same physical sticker on a light or a dark page.

items.title: Mosaic Trail
items.tagline: Your path in fading pixels.
items.description: A pointer trail laid in pixels: the box is a mosaic of square cells, and every cell along the pointer's path lights under a soft brush, holds for a beat, then fades while its colour walks from the head of the palette to the tail with its age, so a stroke is a comet that cools behind you. Brightness steps down through an ordered dither, so the tail dissolves pixel by pixel in a checker-and-cross pattern, and each tile that lights from dark pops in on its own spring with the springs.snap constants. A click sends an eight-ray pixel burst; keyboard focus inside runs a comet to the focused control on springs.glide and traces a pixel frame round it.

props.name: children
props.description: Content laid over the mosaic. It stays fully interactive; the tiles never take a click.

props.name: cell
props.description: The side of one square cell, in px.

props.name: gap
props.description: The grout between lit tiles, in px.

props.name: fade
props.description: How long a tile takes to fade out once its hold is over, in ms.

props.name: hold
props.description: How long a tile stays at full brightness before it starts to fade, in ms.

props.name: colors
props.description: The trail's colours from head to tail: a preset, or any CSS colours resolved on the element and mixed in oklab.

props.name: levels
props.description: How many brightness steps a tile fades through, 2 to 8.

props.name: dither
props.description: Fade through an ordered dither, so tiles drop out in a pixel pattern rather than all together.

props.name: brush
props.description: The brush's radius in cells; a fast stroke paints a little wider.

props.name: round
props.description: How rounded each tile is, as a share of its side (0 to 0.5).

props.name: grid
props.description: How visible the resting grout grid is, 0 to 1.

props.name: intensity
props.description: The brightest a tile gets, 0 to 1.

props.name: burst
props.description: A click sends a pixel burst with rays this many cells long; 0 turns it off.

props.name: intro
props.description: One comet across the mosaic the first time it comes into view.

props.name: followFocus
props.description: Keyboard focus inside draws a comet to the focused control and frames it in pixels.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer paints (mouse and pen); a tap sends a burst.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freezes the trail where it is.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for the dither offsets, the intro's path and the reduced-motion still.

props.name: dpr
props.description: The highest device pixel ratio the canvas draws at (never above 2).

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: Fires when the first tile lights and when the last one has faded.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the box. Give it a height; children are laid out inside it.

usageNotes: The canvas and the grout grid sit under the children, aria-hidden and without pointer events, so every child stays clickable and focusable; give the box a height and lay the content out inside it.

Keyboard: focus moving onto a child (focus-visible) runs a comet from the last focused control to the new one and traces a pixel frame round it, so tabbing through a hero reads in the same pixels a mouse paints. Touch: a tap sends a burst and scrolling is untouched.

Reduced motion: no moving trail, no pop and no burst. A still, seeded comet is laid across the mosaic with its dithered tail, the tile under the mouse lights in place, and a focused control gets a still pixel frame.

Performance: lit tiles live in an active list of typed arrays, and the loop runs only while one is lit or popping, only on screen and in a visible tab, stopping itself when the last tile goes dark. The canvas caps DPR at min(dpr, 2) and resizes with a ResizeObserver.

Colours resolve on the element (so a themed subtree's tokens are the ones read) and re-resolve on a theme change; a custom `colors` array can be any CSS colours, mixed evenly in oklab from head to tail.

items.title: Cube Field
items.tagline: A floor of cubes that rises to meet you.
items.description: A floor of cubes in true isometric fills the box behind its children, each cube shaded per face from tokens so it reads lit from the upper left in either theme. Every cube is a spring with the springs.snap, springs.glide or springs.drift constants toward a height that peaks under the pointer and falls away over a raised-cosine bell on the floor plane, so a hill follows the hand and settles back when it leaves; a click knocks the floor and a real lattice wave — each cube coupled to its four neighbours, short wavelengths damped — carries a glowing ring outward until a sponge at the edges drinks it. Rendered as CSS 3D cubes, or as canvas polygons past 260 cubes; keyboard focus inside raises the floor under the focused control.

props.name: children
props.description: Content laid over the floor. It stays fully interactive; the cubes never take a click.

props.name: grid
props.description: A cube's edge on the floor, in px — the grid's pitch.

props.name: rise
props.description: How high the cubes under the pointer climb, in px.

props.name: falloff
props.description: How far the rise reaches, in cubes, fading to nothing along a raised-cosine bell.

props.name: base
props.description: Every cube's resting height, in px.

props.name: spring
props.description: The calibrated spring the cubes rise and settle on.

props.name: wave
props.description: Strength of the wave a click sends through the floor, 0 to 2; 0 turns it off.

props.name: waveSpeed
props.description: How fast the wave travels, as a multiple of 14 cubes a second (0.5 to 2).

props.name: topColor
props.description: The cubes' tops, any CSS colour.

props.name: sideColor
props.description: The colour the sides are shaded from, toward black in oklab.

props.name: glowColor
props.description: The colour a risen top glows toward.

props.name: glow
props.description: How strongly a fully risen top glows, 0 to 1.

props.name: shade
props.description: How dark the sides are, 0 to 1: the left face takes half of it, the right face all of it.

props.name: renderer
props.description: CSS 3D cubes, canvas polygons, or CSS until the floor needs more than 260 cubes.

props.name: intro
props.description: One gentle wave from the centre the first time it comes into view.

props.name: followFocus
props.description: Keyboard focus inside raises the floor under the focused control.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer raises the floor (mouse and pen); a click or a tap sends a wave.

props.name: paused
props.description: Holds every cube where it is.

props.name: dpr
props.description: The highest device pixel ratio the canvas renderer draws at (never above 2).

props.name: onWave
props.description: Fires when a visitor sends a wave with a click or a tap.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the box. Give it a height; children are laid out inside it.

usageNotes: The floor is aria-hidden and takes no pointer events — the pointer is read from the box — so the children stay fully interactive. Keyboard focus moving onto a child (focus-visible) raises the floor under it and sends a small wave; touch taps send a wave and scrolling is untouched.

Reduced motion: the floor stays flat — no rise, no wave, no intro — and the tops under the pointer or the focused control brighten toward the glow colour instead, as an instant colour change with the same falloff.

Performance: one simulation loop that runs only while some cube is moving, on screen and in a visible tab, and stops itself when the floor has settled. In CSS mode a frame writes only transforms and an opacity to the cubes that moved (compositor work, no layout); past 260 cubes, or with renderer="canvas", the same floor is drawn as polygons with DPR capped at min(dpr, 2).

Colours: the CSS cubes read their tokens live, so a theme switch needs no work; the canvas resolves them on the element and re-resolves on a theme change, mixing the sides toward black in oklab exactly as the CSS does.
Give the box a height (a hero band of 200–400 px reads best); `grid` sets the cube size, so larger boxes or smaller cubes move to the canvas renderer automatically.

items.title: Molten Mark
items.tagline: Your logo poured in liquid metal.
items.description: An SVG mark or a word filled with liquid metal in one WebGL2 pass inside the shape's own mask: an exact distance transform rolls the edge like a meniscus, a slow churn of warped noise moves across the surface, and every pixel reflects a procedural studio tinted chrome, gold, copper or the accent, with a key light that follows the pointer on springs.glide and drifts home on springs.drift. The first time it is in view the metal pours into the empty mould from its foot, white-hot at the front and cooling to metal, and a click drops a ring ripple into the surface. It is an image to assistive technology, has nothing to focus, and shows a still metallic gradient without WebGL2.

props.name: path
props.defaultValue: a ring with a droplet in it
props.description: The mark as SVG path data in viewBox units, filled with the nonzero rule.

props.name: viewBox
props.description: The viewBox the path is drawn in.

props.name: text
props.description: A word to pour instead of the path, set in the inherited font at heavy weight.

props.name: label
props.description: The mark's accessible name.

props.name: tint

props.name: flow
props.description: How fast the surface churns, as a multiple of the house pace (0 to 3); 0 holds it still and stops the loop.

props.name: shine
props.description: Polish, 0 to 1: satin with soft broad highlights to a mirror with small hard ones.

props.name: bevel
props.description: How rounded the metal stands at its edges, 0.1 to 1: a flat pour with a rolled rim to a full pillow.

props.name: ripple
props.description: How deep the churning ripples run, 0 to 1.

props.name: heat
props.description: How hot the pour runs, 0 to 1: white-hot at the front and cooling through ember; 0 pours cold.

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the mark, as a share of the box on each side (0 to 0.3).

props.name: intro
props.description: Pour the metal in the first time the mark comes into view; off, it is cast already.

props.name: pourKey
props.description: Change it to pour again.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The key light follows the pointer, and a click drops a ripple into the metal.

props.name: paused
props.description: Holds the surface still and stops the loop.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for the flow's pattern.

props.name: dpr
props.description: The highest device pixel ratio the canvas draws at (never above 2).

props.name: onPour
props.description: Fires when a pour begins: on first view, or when pourKey changes.

props.name: onPoured
props.description: Fires when the mark is cast: a pour has filled it and cooled, or, with no pour to run, the first time it is in view.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the box; give it a size.

usageNotes: The box is role="img" named by `label` (or the word); the canvas, mould and still are aria-hidden and nothing is focusable — the light and the ripple are decoration, so keyboard and touch visitors get the finished cast (a tap drops a ripple and moves the light there).

Give the box a size: it uses size containment so a `text` word can be fitted with container units, and the GL mask is rasterised from the word's own computed font and position so the metal lands on the same pixels.
Reduced motion: no pour, no churn, no ripple and no springs — one still frame of the finished metal, the light moving without easing, drawn on demand. Nothing loops.

Performance: one fullscreen pass. The loop runs only while the flow is on and the mark is on screen in a visible tab, or while a pour, a ripple or the light is moving; flow={0} or paused stops it. DPR is capped at min(dpr, 2), and the mask and surface field are rebuilt once per resize, the field fitted to the mark's own box and stored as half-float so reflections run smooth.

Without WebGL2, or after a lost context, the mark shows a still metallic gradient in its tint; a restored context rebuilds everything, and every GL object is disposed on unmount. The studio takes its brightness from the page background, so chrome reads silver on a light page and smoky on a dark one.

items.title: Film Grain
items.tagline: Analog grain that makes pixels feel printed.
items.description: Film grain over any section, built for cost: two seamless grain tiles per seed — fine noise plus clumped octaves blurred on the torus — are made once and shared, and each projected frame at the chosen frame rate only swaps which tile shows and jumps it to a seeded offset, so the compositor does the work and no WebGL context is used. Dark specks multiply and light specks screen, so the grain reads on light and dark pages alike, with optional gate weave, faint scratches, a vignette and a wavering lamp; the projector spins up from 4 fps the first time it is in view. Under the mouse, and around a control with keyboard focus, the grain clears in a soft patch that follows on springs.glide and fades in and out on tweens.

props.name: children

props.name: intensity
props.description: How strong the grain is, 0 to 1.

props.name: size

props.name: fps
props.description: The projector's frame rate: how many times a second the grain changes (1 to 30).

props.name: blend

props.name: weave
props.description: Gate weave: how far the section drifts in the gate from frame to frame, in px (0 to 2).

props.name: scratches
props.description: How often faint scratches run down the frame, 0 to 1.

props.name: vignette
props.description: The darkening toward the corners, 0 to 1.

props.name: flicker
props.description: How much the lamp's brightness wavers from frame to frame, 0 to 1.

props.name: calm
props.description: How much the grain clears around the mouse and around a focused control, 0 to 1.

props.name: calmRadius
props.description: The radius of that clear patch, in px.

props.name: intro
props.description: Spin the projector up the first time the section comes into view.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The mouse and keyboard focus clear the grain around them.

props.name: paused
props.description: Holds one frame of grain and stops the projector.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for the grain tiles and every flaw. Sections with the same seed share their tiles.

props.name: dpr
props.description: The highest device pixel ratio the grain is drawn for: one grain pixel per device pixel up to this (never above 2).

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the section box.

usageNotes: Every grain layer is aria-hidden with pointer-events none, so the section underneath stays selectable and interactive; the component isolates its own stacking context, so the blend modes only touch what is inside it. Give the box a border radius and the grain follows it.
Keyboard: focus moving onto a control inside (focus-visible) clears the grain around it, so what is being pressed reads clean. Touch visitors get the grain at rest.
Reduced motion: one still frame of grain and the vignette — no stepping, flicker, scratches, weave or start-up — and the clear patch moves without easing.

Performance: zero cost off screen or in a hidden tab. While projecting, a frame is about ten opacity and transform writes on a timer at `fps` — no canvas, no WebGL, nothing painted per frame — and the tiles (about 5 ms to make) are cached per seed and shared by every section, so a page can carry many grained sections.
`weave` moves the section itself by a fraction of a pixel, which softens text slightly between frames; keep it for imagery and posters, and leave it at 0 over body copy.

items.title: Soft Shape
items.tagline: Shapes that blur into each other near you.
items.description: Flat pigment circles, rounded squares and rounded triangles drawn as signed-distance fields in one WebGL2 pass, joined by a smooth minimum whose reach grows near the pointer: as the pointer draws two shapes together (each leans in on springs.glide and drifts home on springs.drift) they flow into one mass through a neck and their colours blend across it, while their edges soften into a grained gradient near the pointer and stay crisp away from it. Pressing gathers the whole composition into one soft mass and releasing scatters it home on springs.recoil. Keyboard focus on a control inside draws the shapes to it, and Enter or Space on it pulses a gather.

props.name: melt

props.name: radius

props.description: Fires when a press (or Enter/Space on a control inside) gathers the shapes, and again when they scatter.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the box. Give it a height; children are laid out inside it.

usageNotes: The canvas and its still are aria-hidden with pointer-events none, so buttons and links inside keep their own clicks, focus and keys. Focus on a control draws the shapes to it, and Enter or Space on it pulses a gather, so the keyboard reaches the same states as the pointer.

Give the box a height (h-52, h-64, or a hero's own size). The composition is one zigzag row at 560 px and wider and two staggered rows below; the server renders the same shapes as an SVG still, which the canvas replaces on its first frame.

Colours default to pigments built from the theme tokens at a fixed lightness, so the shapes read the same in light and dark; pass your own CSS colours to color, and they are re-read when the theme changes.
Under reduced motion it is one still frame with a soft neck between the two closest shapes; the soft spot jumps to the pointer or the focused control and nothing travels or bounces.

One fragment pass with at most eight shapes. The loop stops off screen, on a hidden tab, when paused and, with ambient off, once the springs settle; ambient-only frames run at 30 fps. Without WebGL2, or after a lost context, the SVG still stays.

items.title: Sight Lines
items.tagline: Hairlines that measure where you point.
items.description: A precision measuring overlay bounded to the container it wraps: four hairlines run in from the edges to the pointer, each with its length in a mono pill, over tick rulers that mark the pointer's coordinate, and the lines ease after the pointer on springs.glide while the crosshair cursor stays exactly under the hand. Reaching a child opens the meeting point into the child's box on springs.snap — the lines retract to its edges and measure its margins, a hairline box outlines it, the readout becomes its width × height and the ruler markers widen into its span — and leaving releases the lines back to the pointer on springs.glide. Keyboard focus on a child snaps the lines to it exactly as hover does.

props.name: children
props.description: The content being measured; it keeps every click, focus and key.

props.name: labels
props.description: The unit of the distance labels and the readout, or "none" to hide the labels.

props.name: snap
props.description: Hovering (or focusing) a child snaps the lines to its edges and shows its size.

props.name: color
props.description: The hairline tone: a named tone from the theme or any CSS colour.

props.name: targets
props.description: What the lines snap to, as a CSS selector; disabled controls never snap.

props.name: follow
props.description: The house spring the lines ease after the pointer on.

props.name: ticks
props.description: Tick rulers along the four edges, with a marker at the pointer's coordinate that widens into a snapped child's span.

props.name: tickStep
props.description: Distance between minor ticks, in px; every fifth is a major tick.

props.name: dashed
props.description: Dashed hairlines instead of solid ones.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Hairline thickness, in px.

props.name: readout
props.description: A small tag with the pointer's coordinates, or a snapped child's width × height.

props.name: rest
props.description: Where the lines rest with nobody pointing: dimly on the [data-measure-home] child (or the first target), at the centre, or hidden.

props.name: crosshair
props.description: A crosshair cursor inside the container; text fields keep the I-beam.

props.name: precision
props.description: Decimals in pixel labels.

props.name: rootSize
props.description: Pixels per rem, for rem labels.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turn the overlay off.

props.name: onMeasure
props.description: Fires when the lines snap onto a child — with its label, size and distance from each edge in px — and with null when they let go.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the container.

usageNotes: The overlay is aria-hidden with pointer-events none, so every child keeps its clicks, focus and keys. Focus on a child snaps the lines to it exactly as hover does, so Tab walks the measurement through the content.
Mark anything with data-measure="Name" to make it measurable and to name it in onMeasure, mark one data-measure-home to choose where the lines rest, or pass targets to narrow the selector.
Under reduced motion nothing springs: the lines sit exactly at the pointer and jump to a child's box, and only the box, the labels and the readout fade.
DOM and one SVG positioned from motion values, with no frame loop: a spring runs only after input and stops when it settles. A resize, a scroll or a child changing size keeps a snapped box aligned.
The hairlines take the tone as currentColor, and the pills are opaque bg-background so the line breaks around each number in both themes; on touch, a tap measures where it lands.

items.title: Photo Scatter
items.tagline: Pictures drop where your cursor travels.
items.description: An image trail of real-looking prints: as the pointer travels, the distance it covers is measured along its path and every few dozen px a print drops at that exact point, born lifted and landing with its scale on springs.recoil, its seeded tilt on springs.snap and its shadow drawing in tight on springs.glide. After its life each print fades and shrinks away on the exit ease, oldest first, and a press pins one to the table with a strip of tape until the next press. Keyboard focus travels too, dropping prints along the way to a focused control and landing them beside it, and Enter or Space pins one there.

props.name: children
props.description: Content on the table, such as a headline; it keeps every click, focus and key.

props.name: images
props.description: The pictures, used in turn: a string is an image URL (rendered with empty alt), anything else is rendered as the picture.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Distance the pointer travels between prints, in px.

props.name: life
props.description: How long a print rests before it fades, in ms.

props.name: tilt
props.description: The most a print turns off square, in degrees; each one is seeded within ±tilt.

props.name: size
props.description: A print's width in px, capped so it never stands taller than 62% of the box or wider than 36% of it.

props.name: aspect
props.description: The picture's width / height.

props.name: frame
props.description: The paper round the picture: an instant print's deep bottom margin, an even border, or none.

props.name: paper
props.description: The paper's colour, any CSS colour.

props.name: fade
props.description: How long a print takes to fade and shrink away, in ms.

props.name: drop
props.description: How far a print falls before it lands, 0 (placed) to 1 (tossed from high).

props.name: max
props.description: The most prints on the table at once; past it the oldest is hurried out.

props.name: order
props.description: Use the images in order, or in a seeded shuffle that never repeats the last one.

props.name: rest
props.description: Prints already lying on the table before anyone points; they leave in order after the first touch.

props.name: origin
props.description: Where the resting prints lie, as [x, y] fractions of the box.

props.name: pinOnPress
props.description: A press on the open table pins a print where it lands, taped down until the next press; presses on controls are left to the controls.

props.name: followFocus
props.description: Keyboard focus travels too: prints drop along the way to a focused control and land beside it.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Drop prints as the pointer travels.

props.name: layer
props.description: Draw the prints under the content, like a table, or over it.

props.name: paused
props.description: Stop dropping; prints already down finish their lives.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for the tilts, the scatter and the shuffle.

props.name: onDrop
props.type: (info: { total: number; image: number; pinned: boolean }) => void
props.description: Fires on every print dropped, with the running total, which image it shows, and whether it was pinned.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the table. Give it a height.

usageNotes: The prints are an aria-hidden layer with pointer-events none, under the content by default, so links and buttons stay readable and clickable; a press on a control is left to the control and never pins.
Tab moves the trail too: prints drop along the way to the focused control and land beside its group rather than on it, and Enter or Space pins one there, so keyboard visitors reach every state.

Pass images as URLs or as your own nodes (an , a gradient, an illustration); with none, it uses quiet plates tinted from the theme. Sizes cap through container units, so the server and the browser render the same resting stack.
Under reduced motion a print appears in place with a short fade and leaves the same way; the trail, the pin and the order of leaving all still work.

DOM only, transform and opacity on the compositor, at most max prints plus the pin; there is no frame loop, and each print's springs stop once it lands. On touch a sideways drag lays a trail (vertical scrolling is untouched) and a tap pins.

items.title: Silk Ribbons
items.tagline: Ribbons that flow from your cursor.
items.description: Silk ribbons stream from the pointer on one Canvas 2D layer: each is a chain of 32 links whose head rides the pointer on a spring blended between springs.drift and springs.snap, with every link following the one ahead at its length and held smooth by a bending spring, and the ribbons differ in length, stiffness and drag so a sweep fans them out. When a link catches up its overtaking motion turns sideways, so as the pointer stops the ribbons overshoot, wind into loops and unwind, and a press whips an S-wave down each chain; each ribbon tapers and twists, darkening edge-on and shifting colour between its two faces like iridescent silk. With nobody pointing they fly a slow figure-eight, keyboard focus sends them to circle the focused control, and Enter or Space on it whips them there.

props.name: children
props.description: Content laid over the ribbons, such as a headline. It keeps every click, focus and key.

props.name: count
props.description: How many ribbons stream from the pointer, 1 to 8.

props.name: length
props.description: A ribbon's length in px; each varies around it by variance, and none outgrows 1.6× the box's shorter side.

props.name: colors
props.description: The silk: a named palette from the theme tokens, or your own CSS colours the ribbons shift through along their length.

props.name: width
props.description: A ribbon's widest, just below the head, in px.

props.name: taper
props.description: How much a ribbon thins toward its tail, 0 (even) to 1 (a fine point).

props.name: stiffness
props.description: How tightly the heads follow and the silk holds its line, 0 (springs.drift, loose) to 1 (springs.snap, taut).

props.name: variance
props.description: How different the ribbons are from each other in length, stiffness and drag, 0 to 1.

props.name: curl
props.description: How much the ribbons wind into loops as they catch up, 0 to 1.

props.name: twist
props.description: Twists along each ribbon; where it turns edge-on it narrows and darkens.

props.name: sheen
props.description: A soft specular streak down faces turned to the light, 0 to 1.

props.name: spread
props.description: How wide the fan of heads is either side of the pointer, across its direction of travel, in px.

props.name: whip
props.description: A press whips the ribbons, throwing a loop down each one.

props.name: ambient
props.description: With nobody pointing, the ribbons fly a slow figure-eight through the box.

props.name: followFocus
props.description: Keyboard focus on a control inside sends the ribbons to circle it.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Follow the pointer.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the ribbons still and stop the frame loop.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for every ribbon's length, spring, twist and colour.

props.name: dpr
props.description: The highest device pixel ratio the canvas draws at (never above 2).

props.name: onWhip
props.description: Fires when a press (or Enter/Space on a control inside) whips the ribbons, with the point in the box.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the box. Give it a height; children are laid out inside it.

usageNotes: The canvas is aria-hidden with pointer-events none and sits under the children, so a headline stays readable and every button and link keeps its own clicks, focus and keys.

Keyboard focus on a control sends the ribbons to circle it and Enter or Space on it whips them, so the keyboard reaches the same states as the pointer; on touch, a tap swoops them to the tap and a sideways drag leads them, while vertical scrolling is untouched.

Colours default to pigments built from the theme tokens at a fixed lightness (mono follows the foreground), blended in OKLab into a lookup made once per palette, and they are re-read when the theme changes.
Under reduced motion the ribbons are one still sweep, simulated from the seed and drawn once; nothing follows the pointer and no loop runs.

Canvas 2D with typed arrays made once, so a frame allocates nothing. The loop stops off screen, on a hidden tab and when paused; ambient-only frames draw at 30 fps, and with ambient off it stops once the silk settles. DPR is capped at 2.

items.title: Ink Splash
items.tagline: Your cursor stirs a pool of ink.
items.description: A pool of water under your content, simulated on the GPU as a real incompressible fluid (advection, vorticity confinement and a warm-started pressure solve every frame): the pointer drags a brush through it that pushes the water and lays pigment, so ink is shoved ahead, peels into curls, diffuses and fades. A click drops a splash — a zero-mean volume source pushes a ring of water out from the drop, its ink blooms with a pooled rim, satellite droplets patter down on a cascade stagger and a surface ripple runs out bending the ink — all inside 600 ms. Keyboard focus moving between controls inside draws a stroke of ink to the new one, and Enter or Space on a control drops a splash there.

props.name: children
props.description: Content floated on the pool, such as a headline. It keeps every click, focus and key.

props.name: viscosity
props.description: How thick the water is, 0 to 1: thin water coasts and curls, thick ink stops short and smooths.

props.name: fade
props.description: How long ink lingers before the water clears, in seconds (1 to 20).

props.name: colors
props.description: The pigments: a named set from the theme tokens, or your own CSS colours. The brush walks through them, one per stroke and per splash.

props.name: curl
props.description: How strongly eddies are kept and sharpened, 0 to 1 (thick water damps them further).

props.name: radius
props.description: The brush's width, in px.

props.name: force
props.description: How hard the brush pushes the water, 0 to 1.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Coverage of the densest ink, 0 to 1.

props.name: splash
props.description: A click (or Enter/Space on a control inside) drops a splash.

props.name: splashSize
props.description: The splash drop's radius, in px.

props.name: droplets
props.description: Satellite droplets that patter down around each splash, 0 to 12.

props.name: ambient
props.description: With nobody stirring, a slow drip lands every few seconds so the pool stays alive.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer stirs the pool (mouse and pen; a tap drops a splash).

props.name: followFocus
props.description: Keyboard focus moving between controls inside draws a stroke of ink to the new one.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the water still and stop the frame loop.

props.name: resolution
props.description: The simulation grid's long side, 48 to 192 cells. Lower is cheaper and softer.

props.name: dpr
props.description: The highest device pixel ratio the canvas draws at (never above 2).

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for the opening drop, the drips, the droplets, the grain and the still.

props.name: onSplash
props.type: (splash: { x: number; y: number; source: "pointer" | "keyboard" | "ambient" }) => void
props.description: Fires when a drop lands, with where (px from the box's top-left) and why.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the box. Give it a height; children are laid out inside it.

usageNotes: The canvas and its still are aria-hidden and never take the pointer, so buttons and links inside keep their own clicks, focus and keys. Focus moving between controls draws ink to the new one and Enter or Space on a control drops a splash, so the keyboard reaches the same states as the pointer.
Give the box a height (h-52, h-60, or a hero's own size). Touch scrolls the page as usual — a tap drops a splash, a drag never stirs — so the pool is safe in a scrolling layout.

Pigments default to the theme tokens at their own lightness and are re-read when the theme changes: deep ink with a darker pooled rim on a light page, a step brighter on a dark one. Pass your own CSS colours to colors.
Under reduced motion there is no simulation: the server-rendered still swirl stays, and a click or Enter/Space crossfades a soft blot in at the point and lets it fade over the fade time.

Needs WebGL2 with renderable half-float buffers; without them, or after a lost context, the still stays. The grid is capped at 192 cells and the dye at 512 texels; the loop stops off screen, on a hidden tab and when paused, drops to 30 fps when only the drip moves the water, and with ambient off stops once the water has settled and the ink has faded.

items.title: Lava Blobs
items.tagline: Blobs that merge and part like wax.
items.description: A tall column of warm liquid where wax rises and falls: each blob carries a temperature that the coil raises on the floor and the cap lowers at the top, buoyancy follows it, and touching blobs pull together, share heat and travel as one mass until their heat parts them. The wax is a metaball field drawn in one WebGL2 pass with soft light — wrap diffuse, a glossy specular, a rim and an inner glow that follows temperature — so blobs merge with smooth necks and pinch apart. The pointer adds its own blob that follows on springs.glide and swells in on springs.snap, drawing wax along; pressing grips nearby wax into one mass and releasing throws it with the pointer's velocity. Keyboard focus sends the hand to the focused control and Enter or Space grips there.

props.name: children
props.description: Content laid over the lamp, such as a headline. It keeps every click, focus and key.

props.name: count
props.description: How many blobs of wax, 3 to 10.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the wax lives: 0.25 is a slow evening, 2 a lamp left on all day.

props.name: colors
props.description: The wax: a named set from the theme tokens, or your own [cool wax, hot wax, liquid tint] CSS colours.

props.name: size
props.description: Blob size relative to the column, 0.6 to 1.4.

props.name: heat
props.description: How hard the base heats the wax, 0 to 1: more heat keeps more of it aloft.

props.name: gloss
props.description: The glossy specular and rim light on the wax, 0 to 1.

props.name: glow
props.description: The wax's inner glow and the coil's light in the liquid, 0 to 1.

props.name: pull
props.description: How strongly the pointer's own blob draws wax toward it, 0 to 1.

props.name: handSize
props.description: The pointer blob's radius, in px.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer adds its blob; a press grips nearby wax and a release throws it.

props.name: followFocus
props.description: Keyboard focus on a control inside sends the pointer blob there; Enter or Space grips.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the wax still and stop the frame loop.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for the sizes, the starting composition and the wander.

props.name: dpr
props.description: The highest device pixel ratio the canvas draws at (never above 2).

props.name: onGripChange
props.description: Fires when a press (or Enter/Space on a control inside) grips wax, and again when it lets go.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the box. Give it a height; children are laid out inside it.

usageNotes: The canvas and its still are aria-hidden and never take the pointer, so buttons and links inside keep their own clicks, focus and keys. Focus on a control sends the hand there and Enter or Space on it grips, so the keyboard reaches the same states as the pointer. On touch a press grips under the finger; a drag still scrolls the page.

Made for a tall box (h-[420px] to a full-height hero). Blob size follows the column's width, clamped, so narrow and wide columns hold the same composition; the server renders that composition as lit discs, which the canvas replaces on its first frame.

Wax is pigment — token hues at a fixed lightness — so it reads the same on light and dark pages; the liquid is the card colour washed with the palette's tint and is re-read when the theme changes. Pass your own [cool, hot, liquid] CSS colours to colors.

Under reduced motion it is one lit still frame with two blobs mid-merge and one leaving the pool; the hand appears at the pointer or the focused control instantly and a grip shows the gathered frame, with no travel.

One fragment pass with at most eleven kernels. The loop runs at 30 fps while the wax only drifts and every frame while the hand is in play, and stops off screen, on a hidden tab and when paused. Without WebGL2 a Canvas 2D renderer draws the same field at a third of the resolution; a lost context brings the still back.

items.title: Jelly Cursor
items.tagline: A cursor with a wobble of its own.
items.description: Inside its box the pointer becomes a ball of jelly: a soft-body ring of 40 points on damped springs, carried rigidly with the pointer so the cursor stays exact, drawn out into an area-keeping ellipse behind a fast move and set wobbling by a stop, with a damping ratio that `wobble` maps across springs.flick, springs.recoil and looser. Over a button or link it reaches for it side-first and wraps the child's own rounded box as a tint; leaving, the far side clings while the near side follows, until it lets go and snaps back into a ball. Keyboard focus on a child gets the same wrap and Enter or Space squashes it; any key returns the system cursor.

props.name: children
props.description: The area the jelly lives in. Its buttons and links keep every click, focus and key.

props.name: size
props.description: The jelly ball's diameter, in px.

props.name: wobble
props.description: How long it jiggles once it stops: 0 settles at once (flick), 0.5 bounces twice (recoil), 1 keeps on jiggling.

props.name: color
props.description: Its colour: a named pigment from the theme tokens, or any CSS colour.

props.name: stretch
props.description: How far it draws out behind a fast pointer, 0 to 1.

props.name: squash
props.description: How deep a press squashes it, 0 to 1.

props.name: targets
props.description: Which children it wraps itself round, as a CSS selector.

props.name: padding
props.description: Room it leaves round a wrapped child, in px; a bigger jelly is puffier (6 at the default size).

props.name: stickiness
props.description: How far it clings to a child you leave before it lets go, 0 to 1.

props.name: tint
props.description: Its body's opacity while wrapped round a child, so the label reads through, 0 to 1.

props.name: restOn
props.description: The child it rests on with no pointer inside, as a CSS selector; with none it hides.

props.name: hideCursor
props.description: Hide the system cursor while the jelly leads (never over text fields, never after a key press).

props.name: followFocus
props.description: Keyboard focus on a child wraps the jelly round it; Enter or Space squashes it.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer leads the jelly (mouse and pen; a tap moves it to the tapped child).

props.name: onTargetChange
props.description: Fires when the child it is wrapped round changes, with that child or null.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the box.

usageNotes: The jelly is an aria-hidden SVG with pointer-events none, so every child keeps its own clicks, focus, keys and focus ring. The system cursor is hidden only inside the box, only for mouse and pen, never over inputs, textareas, selects or contenteditable, and it comes back on any key press and when the pointer leaves.
Mark the child it should sit on at rest with data-jelly-rest (or pass restOn), so the box shows a designed first frame before anyone points. Add data-jelly to any extra element it should wrap.

Keyboard focus on a child wraps the jelly round it as a second focus cue beside the ring, and Enter or Space squashes it the way a press does. On touch there is no follower: a tap moves the jelly to the tapped child.
Under reduced motion it follows 1:1 as a plain disc with no stretch, wobble or squash, and wrapping changes its outline at once with the tint crossfading.

Pure SVG, no canvas: one path of 40 points written straight to the DOM each frame, numbers rounded to 0.1 px. The loop runs only while the jelly moves or settles, and stops off screen and on a hidden tab.

items.title: Comet Border
items.tagline: A comet circles the frame.
items.description: A frame for any children with a comet travelling its border: a bright head and a tail that tapers in width and light, drawn on a Canvas 2D layer along the border's own centreline — read from the computed border width and all four corner radii and sampled by arc length, so the pace stays even through the corners. The border brightens just ahead of the head and keeps a fading afterglow behind it. Hovering, or keyboard focus inside, speeds the comet up on the springs.glide constants and lets it coast back on springs.drift, and lights a twin that ignites opposite and runs the other way; where the two heads cross the border flares. The children keep their own focus order, clicks and rings.

props.name: children
props.description: What the frame holds. It keeps every click, focus and key.

props.name: speed
props.description: The comet's pace along the border, in px per second.

props.name: tail
props.description: The tail's length, in px (never more than 45% of the frame).

props.name: color
props.description: Its colour: a named token, or any CSS colour.

props.name: width
props.description: The head's thickness, in px.

props.name: glow
props.description: How far its halo spreads and how bright, 0 to 1.

props.name: afterglow
props.description: How long the border stays lit after the comet passes, in ms; 0 leaves no trace.

props.name: hoverSpeed
props.description: How much faster it runs while the frame is hovered or holds keyboard focus, 1 to 5.

props.name: twin
props.description: A second comet running the other way: always, never, or lit by hover and focus.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way round the frame it travels.

props.name: start
props.description: Where it sets off (and rests under reduced motion), 0 to 1 round the frame from the top-left corner.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the comet where it is and stop the frame loop.

props.name: dpr
props.description: The highest device pixel ratio the canvas draws at (never above 2).

props.name: onLap
props.description: Fires each time the comet completes a lap, with the count so far.

props.name: onCross
props.description: Fires when the twin and the comet cross and the border flares.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the frame. It draws its own rounded hairline; any rounded-* and border-* class sets the path.

usageNotes: The component is the bordered box itself: give it the card's background, radius and padding through className (rounded-4 bg-card p-4…). The comet follows whatever border width and corner radii the box computes to, and re-reads them on resize.

The canvas is aria-hidden and never takes the pointer; the children keep their semantics, focus order and focus rings. Keyboard focus inside counts as hover — the twin lights and the pace lifts — while a mouse click that focuses a button does not.

Colours resolve on the component and are re-read when the theme changes: at night the head runs a hot white core with a soft halo, on paper the colour itself leads and the halo is quieter, so it never smudges a light card.

Under reduced motion there is no travel: the comet rests at start with its tail and a soft afterglow laid behind, and hover or focus brightens the frame with a 150 ms tween (and shows the twin opposite).
Canvas 2D, a few dozen quads per comet and a handful of batched strokes for the afterglow each frame, with nothing allocated per frame. The loop stops off screen, on a hidden tab and when paused.

items.title: Chevron Tide
items.tagline: A woven pattern that rolls like the sea.
items.description: A herringbone cloth as a background, drawn crisply in one WebGL2 pass with the content on top: two long swells of different length and heading pass through the weave, every row of chevrons rises and falls with them, and each stripe is a rounded rib that runs light to shade across its width, more so at the crest, where a soft sheen rolls with the swell while the troughs settle into shade. The pointer lifts a mound of cloth that trails it on springs.glide and rises on springs.drift, and a press on the cloth sends a ring swell out across the weave. It is decoration and never takes focus; keyboard focus landing on a control inside moves the mound there and sends a softer ring.

props.name: children
props.description: The content on top of the cloth: a hero line, a heading, a call to action.

props.name: scale
props.description: Width of one chevron column in px; the whole weave grows or tightens with it.

props.name: swell
props.description: Height of the swell, 0 (a flat, still cloth) to 1 (a heavy sea).

props.name: colors
props.description: A named palette, or your own CSS colours in order: stripe, alternate stripe, light, shade.

props.name: pattern
props.description: Herringbone breaks the twill at every column; chevron runs one unbroken zigzag.

props.name: stripes
props.description: Stripes across each column, 2 to 8.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the sea moves, 0 (held) to 3.

props.name: wavelength
props.description: Distance between crests of the main swell, in px.

props.name: angle
props.description: Heading of the main swell in degrees: 0 rolls left to right, 90 rolls down toward you.

props.name: sheen
props.description: How brightly the crests catch the light, 0 to 1.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer and keyboard focus nudge the swell.

props.name: pointerStrength
props.description: How high the pointer lifts the cloth, 0 to 1.

props.name: pulse
props.description: A press on the cloth (not on a control) sends a ring swell out from it.

props.name: intro
props.description: The swell rises out of a flat cloth the first time it comes into view.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the sea still; the pointer can still nudge it.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the swells' phases and headings, so two cloths never roll in step.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: Fires when the pointer or keyboard focus starts (true) or stops (false) nudging the swell.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes and shapes the box; it fills its parent by default (h-full w-full).

usageNotes: Give the box a size (a height class, or a parent that has one); children render above the cloth in their own layer and keep every click, focus and text selection. The cloth itself is aria-hidden and has no focus stop.

Keyboard: when a control inside gains keyboard focus the swell gathers under it and a soft ring rolls out from it; blur lets it go. Touch lifts the cloth where a finger lands without blocking page scrolling.
Reduced motion: a still cloth frozen mid-swell with its crests lit, no intro and no rings; the pointer's mound is drawn straight under the pointer with no easing.

Cost: one fullscreen WebGL2 draw per frame, only while on screen, in a visible tab and while something moves; swell 0, paused or reduced motion stops the loop once settled. DPR is capped at dpr. Without WebGL2, or after a lost context, a CSS chevron still frame stands in.
Theming: colours resolve on the component's own element, so a light or dark wrapper is honoured and a theme switch repaints at once. Pass four CSS colours to colors to dye the cloth your own way.

items.title: Louver Light
items.tagline: Light caught on a thousand turning slats.
items.description: An architectural louvre wall as a background, drawn in one WebGL2 pass with the content in front: rows of fine slats, cut into blades by thin mullions, each turning rigidly on its long axis as a rolling wave crosses the wall, so a blade's face brightens and glints as it turns toward a soft light above and bands of light travel across, while blades turned edge-on open onto a shadowed recess. The pointer bends the wave around itself, its place on springs.glide and its pull on springs.drift, and a press flips the slats over in a ring that runs out from it, each blade landing its half turn on the recoil spring. It never takes focus; keyboard focus on a control inside bends the wave there and flips a small ring from it.

props.name: slats

props.name: tilt

props.name: light

props.name: speed

props.name: angle

props.name: segment

props.name: finish

props.name: glint

props.name: interactive

props.name: pointerStrength

props.name: pulse

props.name: paused

props.name: seed

props.name: dpr

props.name: onActiveChange

props.name: className

usageNotes: slats counts rows over the box's height, so the pitch scales with the box: about 5 px on a 200 px card, about 15 px on a 600 px hero. segment sets each blade's length in pitches.

Keyboard: a control inside that gains keyboard focus bends the bands of light around itself and flips a small ring of slats; blur releases it. The wall itself is aria-hidden and never a focus stop or a click target.
Reduced motion: a still wall at a seeded phase with its bands of light, no intro and no flips; the pointer bends the still bands directly as it moves.

Cost: one fullscreen WebGL2 draw per frame, only on screen, in a visible tab and while the wave, a spring or a flip is moving; swing 0 or paused stops it once settled. DPR capped at dpr; context loss and missing WebGL2 fall back to a CSS still of striped blades with a band of light.
Theming: the slats' paint defaults to a tint of the page, so the wall is pale on a light page and dark on a dark one; the named lights are fixed pigments that read the same in both.

items.title: Shape Swell
items.tagline: Rows of shapes rising on a slow swell.
items.description: A grid of small circles, rounded squares, plus signs and triangles as a background, each a signed distance field in one WebGL2 pass so every edge stays crisp, with the content on top: a diagonal swell rolls through, and a shape rising toward the crest grows, turns and fills with colour while one sinking into the trough shrinks, turns home and fades to a fine outline. The pointer raises a crest of its own, placed on springs.glide and lifted on springs.drift, and a press sends a ring crest across the grid that pops every shape it passes. It never takes focus; keyboard focus on a control inside raises the crest there and sends a softer ring.

props.name: children

props.name: spacing

props.name: speed

props.name: size

props.name: colors
props.description: Crest fill colours, laid across the field along the swell, as CSS colours (1 to 3).

props.name: outline

props.name: stroke

props.name: turn

props.name: wavelength

props.name: angle

props.name: interactive

props.name: pointerStrength

props.name: intro

props.name: paused

props.name: seed

props.name: dpr

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: Fires when the pointer or keyboard focus starts (true) or stops (false) raising its crest.

props.name: className

usageNotes: The canvas is transparent, so the field sits on whatever surface you give the box (bg-card, bg-background, an image). Only whole cells are drawn, centred, so the margins match on every side at any width.
Keyboard: a control inside that gains keyboard focus raises the crest under it and sends a soft ring; blur lets it sink. The field is aria-hidden and never a focus stop or a click target.
Reduced motion: a still field frozen mid-swell, a diagonal band of filled shapes across the outlines, with no intro and no rings; the pointer's crest is drawn directly under it.

Cost: one fullscreen WebGL2 draw per frame (four distance-field taps a pixel), only on screen, in a visible tab and while something moves; paused or reduced motion stops once settled. DPR capped at dpr; context loss and missing WebGL2 fall back to a CSS grid of rings.
Theming: fills and outlines are CSS colours resolved on the element, so tokens follow the theme and a theme switch repaints at once.

items.title: Glass Drift
items.tagline: Shards of glass drift through soft colour.
items.description: Seeded glass shards floating in shallow 3D over a soft colour field, as a background with the content on top: each shard wanders, tilts and turns on its own and refracts the field behind it in WebGL2, magnified, shifted by its tilt and bent hard across a bevelled rim where the colours part a little, tinted toward glass, brighter as it turns edge-on, with a crisp rim lit on the side toward the light and a soft shadow beneath. The pointer parts the shards, each moving aside on springs.glide and drifting home on springs.drift, and a press puffs them outward with a little spin before the drift spring brings them back. It never takes focus; keyboard focus on a control inside parts the glass around it and puffs gently.

props.name: count

props.name: refraction

props.name: palette

props.name: depth

props.name: speed

props.name: tint

props.name: edge

props.name: interactive

props.name: pointerStrength

props.name: pulse

props.name: paused

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the cut of every shard and where it floats.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: Fires when the pointer or keyboard focus starts (true) or stops (false) parting the shards.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes and shapes the box; it fills its parent by default (h-full w-full).

usageNotes: Shards are sized from the box's shorter side and placed as fractions of it, so a card and a full hero hold the same composition. Change seed for a different cut and arrangement.

Keyboard: a control inside that gains keyboard focus parts the glass around itself and sends a gentle puff; blur lets the shards drift home. The glass is aria-hidden and never a focus stop or a click target.
Reduced motion: a still composition with every shard at its resting place and angle, no drift, intro or puff; the pointer parts the shards directly as it moves.

Cost: the field renders at half resolution, then one blit and two small draws per shard (shadow and glass) from one preallocated vertex buffer; nothing runs off screen, in a hidden tab or when held and settled. DPR capped at dpr. Without WebGL2, or after a lost context, a server-rendered CSS composition of the same blooms and frosted shards stands in.
Theming: palette colours are pigments mixed into the page's background, so the field is pastel on a light page and deep on a dark one; a theme switch repaints at once.

items.title: Fiber Mist
items.tagline: Soft fibres of light drifting in haze.
items.description: Hundreds of fine fibres drifting through haze as a background, with the content on top: each fibre is a streamline of a slowly turning curl-noise flow, traced from an anchor the flow itself carries, so they curve together and never knot, drawn in Canvas 2D as a fine core inside a faint halo that adds light where fibres cross in a dark haze and deepens like ink silk in a pale one. The pointer combs them, its path laid into the flow so nearby fibres align to it and relax back within about a second and a half, its place on springs.glide and its presence on springs.drift, and a press stirs them aside in a spiral. It never takes focus; keyboard focus on a control inside draws the fibres into a level stream through it.

props.description: The content on top of the haze: a hero line, a heading, a call to action.

props.name: count
props.description: How many fibres drift through the haze, 40 to 800.

props.name: glow

props.name: drift

props.name: colors

props.name: haze

props.name: length
props.description: A fibre's length, in px.

props.name: curl
props.description: How tightly the flow curls, 0 (long lazy sweeps) to 1 (tight eddies).

props.name: width
props.description: A fibre's core width, in px.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer combs the fibres, and keyboard focus draws them into a stream.

props.name: pointerStrength
props.description: How firmly the pointer combs, 0 to 1.

props.name: pulse
props.description: A press on the haze (not on a control) stirs the fibres aside in a spiral from it.

props.name: intro

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the flow still; the pointer can still comb it.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds where every fibre starts, its colour and the flow.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: Fires when the pointer or keyboard focus starts (true) or stops (false) combing.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes and shapes the box; it fills its parent by default (h-full w-full).

usageNotes: The haze follows the page: on a dark background the fibres add light and glow brighter where they cross; on a light one they multiply and deepen there. Pass haze to set it explicitly.

Keyboard: a control inside that gains keyboard focus draws the fibres into a level stream through it while it holds focus; blur lets them relax. The haze is aria-hidden and never a focus stop or a click target.
Reduced motion: a still mist at a seeded moment, fibres at full length, no intro, drift or stirring; the pointer still combs the fibres directly as it moves, and leaving clears the comb.

Cost: the flow is one noise sample per 22 px grid node per frame, fibres are traced through it with bilinear lookups and drawn in a few dozen batched strokes; every array is preallocated per size and count. Nothing runs off screen, in a hidden tab, or when held with the comb relaxed. DPR capped at dpr.
Density is absolute: count stays the same as the box grows, so a phone card is denser and a wide hero airier; scale count with your box if you want the same look everywhere.

items.title: Tube Glow
items.tagline: A colour field seen through an old tube.
items.description: A slowly shifting colour field seen through a curved picture tube, as a background with the content in front and perfectly crisp: domain-warped noise through a four-stop ramp, bowed by barrel distortion into a rounded picture that falls into a dark phosphor rim, laid with fine scanlines that close where the light is bright, an aperture grille, a slowly breathing bloom, a rolling sync bar and a soft reflection on the glass, all in two WebGL2 passes. The curve leans toward the pointer, placed on springs.glide and eased in on springs.drift, while the reflection slides the other way, and a press degausses the tube: the colour swirls round the press and the guns part, ringing down on the recoil spring. It never takes focus; keyboard focus on a control inside leans the curve toward it and degausses softly.

props.name: pitch

props.name: glare

props.name: seed

props.name: dpr

props.name: onActiveChange

props.name: className
