items.description: A thin seam of light along the bottom of the frame throws its light up through slow haze, and the headline standing in front of it casts long shadow shafts up into the beam: every pixel gathers light from points along the seam and marches toward each through a mask of the words, drawn from the DOM's own word boxes and font, so a slit throws crisp shadows fanned wide and a broad glow soft, stretched ones. The first time it is seen the seam cracks open from a slit to its aperture on springs.drift, or its opening follows the scroll container, and the pointer or keyboard focus on a control inside slides the light along the floor on the drift constants so every shadow swings. The headline is real, selectable text drawn as a backlit silhouette with a warm rim; there is no tab stop of its own.

props.name: headline
props.description: The words standing in the light; each letter casts its own shaft.

props.name: as
props.description: The headline's element.

props.name: children
props.description: Content at the top of the frame — an eyebrow, a nav; it casts no shadow.

props.name: aperture
props.description: How far the seam is open, 0 (a slit: crisp shadows fanned wide) to 1 (a broad glow: soft, stretched ones).

props.name: haze
props.description: How thick the air is, 0 (clear: only the shafts) to 1 (smoky, the beam everywhere).

props.name: warmth
props.description: The light's colour, 0 (cool white) to 1 (warm amber).

props.name: trigger
props.description: What opens the seam: coming into view, mounting, scrolling it up its scroll container, or aperture alone.

props.name: once
props.description: Open once (true) or each time it comes back into view (false).

props.name: intensity
props.description: How bright the light burns, 0 to 1.5.

props.name: reach
props.description: How far up the frame the light and the shadows reach, 0 to 1.

props.name: drift
props.description: How fast the haze drifts up through the beam, 0 (still) to 1.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer, and keyboard focus inside, slide the seam's light along the floor.

props.name: pointerStrength
props.description: How far the light follows the hand, 0 to 1.

props.name: coolColor
props.description: The light's cool end; taken at a fixed lightness.

props.name: warmColor
props.description: The light's warm end; taken at a fixed lightness.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the haze still; the seam still opens and follows the hand.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the haze.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Fires when the seam has finished opening.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the box.

usageNotes: The scene is decoration (canvas, CSS stand-in and colour carriers are aria-hidden); the headline is a real heading — pick its level with as — read once and selectable, and children keep their focus and clicks. Keyboard focus on a control inside slides the light to it, so keyboard visitors see the shadows swing too.

The shadows come from the rendered words: the mask is redrawn from the DOM's word boxes and computed font on resize, a headline change and when web fonts finish loading, so any font and any wrap casts the right shadow. Keep the headline to a line or two; it sits a sixth of the height above the floor and sizes itself by container width.

On a dark page the light adds to a deep room and the words are a near-black silhouette; on a light page the light paints cream shafts on the paper and the words are ink. The rim and halo round the letters are the light's own colour.
Under reduced motion the seam rests at its aperture, still: no opening, no haze drift, no slide — the light jumps to the hand. trigger="scroll" still sets the opening as still frames.

One fullscreen WebGL2 pass at half the capped pixel ratio — six seam points × fourteen mask samples, only where a ray crosses the words — at 30 fps while the haze drifts and every frame while the seam opens or slides; nothing off screen, hidden, or settled with drift={0}. Without WebGL2, or after a lost context, a CSS still of the seam and its glow stands in.

items.title: Facet Laser
items.tagline: A cut crystal that splits one beam into many.
items.description: A single laser enters a cut crystal in a smoky room and leaves as a crown of hairline beams, each a seeded direction traced to the wall it strikes in a room seen in one-point perspective with the frame as its front opening. Turning the crystal sweeps every beam at once and each hit point engraves a line on the walls that cools from white-hot through the laser's colour to ember and fades, so a turn leaves a drawing behind; a sideways drag turns it 1:1, a throw coasts on its velocity and settles on the nearest facet on springs.snap, and untouched it drifts round slowly. It is a slider: arrow keys turn it one facet at a time on the snap spring, Page Up and Page Down three facets, Home brings it back.

props.name: beamCount
props.description: How many hairline beams leave the crystal, 3 to 24.

props.name: haze
props.description: How smoky the room is, 0 (clear: only the hits show) to 1 (the beams hang in the air).

props.name: cooling
props.description: How fast an engraving cools from white through the laser's colour to ember and fades, 0 (slow) to 1 (fast).

props.name: color
props.description: The laser's colour, any CSS colour; taken at a fixed lightness per theme.

props.name: facets
props.description: The crystal's facets: how many detents a turn has, 5 to 12.

props.name: angle / defaultAngle
props.description: The crystal's angle in degrees: controlled, or where it starts when uncontrolled.

props.name: onAngleChange
props.description: Fires with the facet angle (0–359) a key, a drag or a throw settles on.

props.name: onTurningChange
props.description: Fires when a hand or a key starts turning the crystal (true) and when it has settled on a facet (false).

props.name: drift
props.description: How fast the crystal turns by itself while untouched, degrees a second, 0 to 30.

props.name: momentum
props.description: How long a thrown turn coasts before it settles on a facet, 0 to 1.

props.name: spread
props.description: How wide the crown of beams opens toward the walls, 0 (a tight cone) to 1 (wide).

props.name: interactive
props.description: Dragging and the keys turn the crystal.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the drift and the smoke still; the hand still turns it.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the beams' directions, so two crystals cut differently.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: label
props.description: The crystal's accessible name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The room is drawn and holds still; drag and keys are ignored.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the box.

props.name: children
props.description: Content over the room, bottom left: a caption, a label.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the room is one role="slider" tab stop whose value is the settled angle and whose value text names the facet ("Facet 3 of 8, 90 degrees"). Arrow Right/Up turn a facet clockwise, Left/Down back, Page Up/Down three facets, Home returns to zero — the same detents a drag or a throw settles on.

The drag is sideways with touch-action: pan-y, so a vertical swipe still scrolls on touch. Give it a box with a height; the room's depth and the crystal's size follow the box, and a resize clears the old engravings.

On a dark page the engravings add light — white-hot, then the laser's colour, then ember; on a light page they are ink, deep where fresh and paling as they cool. Pass any CSS colour as color; it is taken at a fixed lightness per theme.
Under reduced motion there is no drift, smoke or coasting: a key or a release jumps to the facet and the whole engraving for that turn is drawn at once, then fades in still steps.

Canvas 2D: up to 24 beams and 360 trail samples each in preallocated typed arrays, the whole drawing in ten batched strokes, the room and smoke pre-rendered per size and theme. Every frame while turning, 30 fps while drifting or cooling, nothing off screen, in a hidden page, or when still with cold walls.

items.title: Hex Coffers
items.tagline: A hexagonal ceiling lit by a lamp you carry.
items.description: A vault of recessed hexagonal coffers seen from below in true perspective — each a convex well of ridge, six bevelled walls and a floor with a small boss, every pixel's view ray intersected with its well exactly — lit by a lamp you carry, with a soft inverse square and exact shadows: a point is lit only if its ray to the lamp leaves the well through its opening, so every lit wall and every shadow swings together as the lamp moves, like the sun crossing a dome. The lamp follows the pointer on the glide constants and drifts on a slow figure of eight when no one carries it; a press lowers it into the vault on springs.glide so the nearest cells flare and the far ones fall dark. The keyboard's way in is a transparent button behind your content: arrow keys carry the lamp and Space or Enter held lowers it.

props.name: children
props.description: The content under the vault: a hero line, a heading, a call to action.

props.name: cellSize
props.description: The width of one coffer, px, 24 to 96.

props.name: depth
props.description: How deep the coffers are recessed, 0 (shallow) to 1 (deep wells).

props.name: lampWarmth
props.description: The lamp's light, 0 (cool white) to 1 (warm amber).

props.name: lampHeight
props.description: How far the lamp hangs below the vault at rest, 0 (close) to 1 (far).

props.name: press
props.description: How far a press lowers the lamp into the vault, 0 (not at all) to 1 (almost touching).

props.name: bevel
props.description: The width of each coffer's sloped inner walls, 0 (steep) to 1 (wide bevels).

props.name: rim
props.description: The width of the flat ridge between coffers, 0 to 1.

props.name: boss
props.description: A small round boss at the centre of each coffer.

props.name: intensity
props.description: How bright the lamp burns, 0 to 1.5.

props.name: drift
props.description: How fast the lamp drifts on its figure of eight when no one carries it, 0 (still) to 1.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer carries the lamp and a press lowers it; the keys do the same.

props.name: pointerStrength
props.description: How closely the lamp follows the hand, 0 (it stays on its drift) to 1 (under the pointer).

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the figure of eight still; the hand still carries the lamp.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: label
props.description: The vault's accessible name, for the keyboard's way in.

props.name: onPressChange
props.description: The lamp was lowered (true) or lifted (false), by the pointer or the keys that did it.

props.name: onCarryChange
props.description: A hand took the lamp (true: the pointer over the vault, or the keys) or gave it back to its drift (false).

props.name: disabled
props.description: The vault is lit and still; the hand is ignored.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the box.

usageNotes: Keyboard: one tab stop — a transparent button behind your content, named by label. Arrow keys carry the lamp (Shift for longer steps), Space or Enter held lowers it into the vault and letting go lifts it, the same end states as the pointer; blur hands the lamp back to its drift. A polite status says "Lamp lowered."

The scene fills its parent and your children sit above in their own layer with focus, clicks and selection intact; presses on your own controls never lower the lamp. Busy ceilings want a scrim behind text: a gradient from bg-background at the bottom keeps a headline readable in both themes.
Plaster and lamp come from tokens: a dusky plaster lit warm on a dark page, pale plaster with cool shade on a light one. Cells keep their pixel size, so a wider box shows more of the vault.
Under reduced motion the lamp stands at the vault's upper middle with no figure of eight; the pointer and keys move it straight to the hand and a press lowers it at once.

One fullscreen WebGL2 pass (three quarters of the capped pixel ratio on dense screens, full on plain ones): every frame while the lamp is carried or lowered, 30 fps while it only drifts, nothing off screen, in a hidden page, or with drift={0} and no hand. Without WebGL2, or after a lost context, an SVG pattern of lit coffers stands in.

items.title: Fluted Tumbler
items.tagline: Layered colour stirred behind fluted glass.
items.description: A heavy fluted tumbler of two to four coloured layers, drawn per pixel in one WebGL2 pass: every flute is a small lens that resamples the liquid about its own centre, so the layers' boundaries break into repeating slivers with a faint colour fringe at the ribs. Drag in circles and the hand's angular velocity spins the liquid; overturning currents fold the layers into streaks and buoyancy separates them again by weight, while a sideways move tips the glass on springs.glide (heavy, no bounce) and sets the surface sloshing on a pendulum damped by the viscosity. The glass is a button: Left and Right stir, Shift with them tips it, Enter or Space gives a brisk stir.

props.name: layers
props.description: How many layers of liquid are stacked, 2 to 4; they take the first colours of `colors`.

props.name: colors
props.description: The layers' colours, bottom to top, as CSS colours; pigment, so they read the same in either theme.

props.name: amounts
props.description: Each layer's share of the liquid, bottom to top; only the ratios matter.

props.name: fill
props.description: How full the glass is, 0.3 to 0.95 of the space above its heavy base.

props.name: fluteCount
props.description: Flutes round the whole glass, 8 to 40; about half face you.

props.name: fluteDepth
props.description: How hard each flute bends what is behind it, 0 (flat glass) to 1 (each flute shows a small inverted sliver).

props.name: fringe
props.description: The colour fringe where the image jumps at a rib, 0 to 1.

props.name: viscosity
props.description: How thick the liquid is, 0 to 1: runny liquid swirls long and sloshes, syrup turns slowly and comes to rest quickly.

props.name: settle
props.description: Roughly how long the layers take to separate again by weight, in seconds.

props.name: tilt
props.description: The furthest a sideways move tips the glass, in degrees.

props.name: glassColor
props.description: The glass's own tint, any CSS colour, resolved on the element so it follows the theme.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Drag, tap and keys stir the glass.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the liquid exactly where it is.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the glass for assistive technology.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a pour while the liquid spins. Off unless asked for.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds where the overturning currents run, so two glasses never stir alike.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: onStir
props.description: Fires when the visitor starts stirring a settled glass: a drag, a tap or a key.

props.name: onSettle
props.description: Fires once the stirred layers have separated again and the glass is still.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the glass but takes no stirring.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the box; give it a height.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the glass is one button. Left and Right stir anticlockwise and clockwise (held keys keep stirring), Shift+Left/Right tips the glass, Enter or Space gives a brisk stir; a status line says when it is stirred and when it has settled.
Reduced motion: the glass rests still. A stir swaps at once to a still of the stirred liquid, and the layers separate again in three still steps over `settle` seconds.

Performance: one fragment pass and a 64 by 40 field texture updated only while the liquid moves; the frame loop stops once the glass is settled, off screen or in a hidden tab. DPR is capped at `dpr`; a lost context or a browser without WebGL2 shows the designed CSS still.
The canvas is transparent: the glass, its shadow and the coloured light it throws sit on whatever surface holds it, in either theme. Give the box a height; the glass is sized from it.
Sound is off by default; with `sound` the pour loop follows the spin and stops as the liquid slows, on release, when hidden and on unmount.

items.title: Fibre Lamp
items.tagline: A bundle of glowing strands that sways and shifts hue.
items.description: A fibre-optic lamp on one Canvas 2D layer: a fan of fibres rises from a weighted base, each dark along its length and bright only at its tip, and a colour wheel turning in the base shows through a lens window while each new colour climbs the fibres with a delay set by their length, blooming at the tips one after another. The pointer is a breeze the bundle leans away from; every fibre's lean is its own oscillator with springs.recoil's damping ratio and a length-set frequency, so the dome ripples back out of a gust, and a press or Enter advances the wheel one colour on springs.snap. The lamp is a button: Space or Enter advances the colour, Left and Right send a gust from either side.

props.name: strandCount
props.description: How many fibres rise from the base, 24 to 200.

props.name: sway
props.description: How much the bundle breathes on its own and how far a breeze bends it, 0 to 1.

props.name: hueSpeed
props.description: How fast the colour wheel turns by itself, in colours a second; 0 holds a colour.

props.name: colors
props.defaultValue: rose, amber, lime, teal, cobalt, violet
props.description: The colour wheel, as CSS colours in order round it; pigment, so they read the same in either theme.

props.name: names
props.description: A name for each colour of the wheel, for the lamp's accessible name and announcements.

props.name: travel
props.description: How long a new colour takes to climb to the longest tips, in ms.

props.name: spread
props.description: The fan's angle, in degrees.

props.name: reach
props.description: The fibres' length, 0.4 to 1 of the room above the base.

props.name: glow
props.description: How bright the tips are and how far their halo spreads, 0 to 1.

props.name: breeze
props.description: How hard the pointer's breeze pushes the bundle, 0 to 1.

props.name: defaultIndex
props.description: The wheel's colour when the lamp first lights, as an index into `colors`.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer, keys and presses reach the lamp.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the bundle and the wheel still.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the lamp for assistive technology; the colour is added to it.

props.name: sound
props.description: Hum while a new colour climbs the fibres. Off unless asked for.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds how the fibres fan and sway, so two lamps never match.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: onAdvance
props.description: Fires when a press or a key advances the wheel, with the colour's index.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the lamp but takes no input.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the box; give it a height.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the lamp is one button named with its current colour. Space or Enter advances the wheel and announces the new colour; Left and Right send a gust from either side, the keyboard's breeze.
Reduced motion: the fibres are still and the wheel holds its colour; an advance crossfades the whole bundle to the new colour over 240 ms instead of climbing.

Performance: colours are precomputed into a lookup and cached gradient sprites, so a frame allocates nothing; the loop runs only while visible and while something moves, and stops when paused and settled. DPR is capped at `dpr`.
Theming: on a dark page the tips add light; on a light page they are deepened so they still read as coloured beads. The unlit fibres take the page's ink.
Sound is off by default; with `sound` each advance hums on a pentatonic step while the colour climbs, and the hum always stops after it reaches the tips.

items.title: Moire Band
items.tagline: Two ribbons of wire that shimmer where they cross.
items.description: Two ribbons of fine parallel wires drift and turn over across the box, drawn per pixel in one WebGL2 pass with optional content above, and wherever they overlap broad interference fringes bloom and slide far faster than the wires move. The fringes are computed, not aliased: each grating is a short Fourier series of its wire and their product is expanded into sum and difference terms, each filtered by its own frequency, so the moire survives at any scale. The pointer sets the twist on a curve that is fine near the middle (calm wide bands) and coarse at the ends (racing fringes), followed on springs.glide; the first sighting brings the twist in from wider on springs.drift. It is a slider: arrows, Page Up and Down, Home and End.

props.name: children
props.description: The content above the ribbons: a hero line, a heading, a call to action.

props.name: wireCount
props.description: Wires in each ribbon, 8 to 120.

props.name: spacing

props.name: twist
props.description: The twist between the two ribbons, in degrees, where the band starts; changing it moves the band there.

props.name: value
props.description: The twist when you control it, in degrees; pair with `onValueChange`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the pointer or the keys that turned the twist, with the new twist in degrees.

props.name: maxTwist
props.description: The furthest the pointer or keys can turn the twist either way, in degrees.

props.name: drift
props.description: How restless the ribbons are, 0 (still) to 1.

props.name: roll
props.description: How far each ribbon turns over as it runs, 0 (flat) to 1 (edge-on at its narrowest).

props.name: wireWidth
props.description: A wire's width as a share of the spacing, 0.15 to 0.7.

props.name: tint
props.description: The wires' colour, or one colour for each ribbon, as CSS colours.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer and keys turn the twist.

props.name: intro
props.description: The first time the band comes into view, the twist arrives from wider so the fringes spread into calm bands.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the ribbons still; the twist still turns.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the twist control for assistive technology.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the ribbons' curves and turns, so two bands never match.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the band but takes no input.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes and shapes the box.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the band is a slider behind the content. ArrowRight/Up and ArrowLeft/Down turn the twist half a degree, Page Up and Page Down four, Home and End go to the limits; the reading says the twist and how the fringes look.
Reduced motion: one crossing is frozen — no drift, no intro. Mouse hover does nothing; a drag and the keys still set the twist, drawn at once.

Performance: one fragment pass of about ten cosines a pixel; the loop runs while the ribbons drift or the twist eases, only on screen and in a visible tab. DPR is capped at `dpr`; a lost context or no WebGL2 shows striped CSS bands.

The canvas is transparent and the wires take `tint` (the page's ink and accent by default), so the band sits on any surface in either theme. Content above stays fully interactive; a press on it never moves the twist.

items.title: Block Horizon
items.tagline: A curved sea of blocks under a low sun.
items.description: A horizon of square columns curving away over the rim of a small world, drawn with WebGL2 as instanced boxes: two long swells and a light chop heave the rows, the tops catch a low sun with a path of glints toward it, the troughs sit in shade and distance fades into haze. Pass a series and the nearest rows calm into a bar chart that still breathes while the far sea rolls on; on first sight each bar rises out of the swell on springs.drift, staggered by the house cascade, and a new series glides each bar on springs.glide. Drag sideways to turn the swell's heading 1:1 — a throw is projected and the heading glides there with the release velocity — or use the slider's keys: Left and Right 15°, Page Up and Down 45°, Home to 0°.

props.name: children
props.description: The content above the sea: a kicker, a figure, a call to action.

props.name: series

props.name: seriesLabel
props.description: What the series is, for assistive technology.

props.name: blockSize

props.name: swell

props.name: sunAngle

props.name: sunAzimuth

props.name: colors
props.description: A named palette, or CSS colours in order: block, sunlit top, sky, horizon haze, chart, sun.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the sea moves, 0 (held) to 2.

props.name: curvature
props.description: How small the world is, 0 (nearly flat) to 1 (a tight curve at the rim).

props.name: chartRows
props.description: How many of the nearest rows stand up as the chart, 0 to 4.

props.name: chartHeight
props.description: The tallest value's height, in blocks.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The swell's heading in degrees, controlled or to start from: 0 rolls toward you from the horizon.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the drag or the key that turned the swell, with the new heading in whole degrees, 0 to 359.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Dragging and keys turn the swell.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the sea still; the swell can still be turned.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the heading control for assistive technology.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the swells' phases and the second swell's crossing angle.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the sea but takes no input.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes and shapes the box.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the scene is a heading slider behind the content, described by a sentence of the series (its values, lowest and highest). Left/Right and Up/Down turn the swell 15°, Page Up and Down 45°, Home brings it back to 0°.
Reduced motion: the sea is still at its composed moment and the chart stands at its values; a drag or key turns the heading and redraws at once, without momentum.

Performance: one instanced draw of a few thousand columns plus a sky pass; rows are clipped to the view and to the world's horizon, and far rows stand in twos and fours. The loop runs only on screen, in a visible tab, while the sea moves or a spring settles. DPR is capped at `dpr`.

Theming: the palettes mix tokens with the page, so the sky and the sea follow light and dark; pass `colors` to match a brand. Without WebGL2 a CSS still shows the sky, the horizon and the series as bars.

items.title: Trace Current
items.tagline: Light routed across a board of dots.
items.description: A grid of dim dots wired like a circuit board on one Canvas 2D layer, with content above: seeded walkers lay right-angled traces, and currents of light run along them dot to dot, lighting each dot and trace as they pass. Bring the pointer in and a walk along the traces makes every connected dot downhill toward it, so the currents reroute the way water finds the quickest way down and gather at the hand, falling back to their circuits when it leaves; a click sends one pulse out along every trace at once, the front walking each trace from its nearest point to the click. Nothing springs here — currents run at a steady rate and light fades exponentially — and the keyboard has a probe: arrows move it dot to dot, Enter or Space pulses from it, Escape lifts it.

props.name: children
props.description: The content above the board: a hero line, a heading, a call to action.

props.name: density
props.description: How fine the board is, 0 (a sparse board of long traces) to 1 (dense and fine).

props.name: flowRate
props.description: How fast the currents run, in dots a second.

props.name: hue
props.description: The light's hue, in degrees, at the theme's accent lightness.

props.name: currents
props.description: How many currents run at once, 4 to 80.

props.name: trail
props.description: How long a lit dot and trace keep glowing after a current passes, 0 to 1.

props.name: pull
props.description: How many of the currents answer the pointer, 0 (none) to 1 (all).

props.name: pulseSpeed
props.description: How fast a pulse's front runs along the traces, in px a second.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer reroutes the currents and a click sends a pulse.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the currents where they are.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the board for assistive technology.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the traces' layout, so two boards never match.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: onPulse
props.description: Fires when a click or a key sends a pulse, with its origin in px from the board's top-left.

props.name: onRerouteChange
props.description: Fires when the currents start (true) or stop (false) rerouting toward the pointer or the probe.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the board but takes no input.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes and shapes the box.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the board's surface behind the content is one focus stop. Focusing it puts a probe at the centre; arrows move it dot to dot and the currents reroute to it, Enter or Space sends a pulse from it, Escape lifts it (and is handled, so it never closes a surrounding dialog).
Reduced motion: a still board with a handful of currents caught mid-flight; the pointer or probe lights the routes that lead to it, and a pulse lights every trace at once and fades in still steps.

Performance: the dim board is one cached image; lit traces and dots are grouped into eight brightness levels and stroked as one path each, from preallocated arrays. The loop stops off screen, in a hidden tab and when paused.
Theming: traces and dots take the page's ink; the light is the theme's accent lightness at `hue`, added on dark pages and laid on light ones. Content above stays fully interactive.

items.title: Pocket Sky
items.tagline: A small sky whose clouds drift where you push.
items.description: A small sky drawn in two WebGL2 passes with content above it: a few soft cumulus — clusters of puffs eroded by noise that travels with them — hang in a blue sky with the sun behind them, their bellies grey and their thin edges silver, and light shafts are walked toward the sun through every gap. Drag through it and your hand becomes wind: puffs near its path are dragged toward its velocity, those either side curl opposite ways, each stretches and thins with its speed and the clouds part so rays break through; then every puff gathers back into its cloud with springs.drift's damping ratio at the slower period `gather` sets. Arrow keys send a gust from each side, the same wind a drag makes.

props.description: The content above the sky: a hero line, a heading, a call to action.

props.name: sunHeight

props.name: windDrag

props.name: timeOfDay

props.name: sunX

props.name: rays

props.name: drift

props.name: gather
props.description: About how long torn clouds take to gather themselves again, in seconds.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Dragging, taps and keys make wind.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the sky still; the hand's wind still moves it.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the sky for assistive technology.

props.name: seed

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: onWindChange
