props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the sky but takes no input.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes and shapes the box.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the sky's surface behind the content is one focus stop; each arrow key sends a gust from the opposite side sweeping across the middle of the sky, announced, and the status says when the clouds have gathered again.
Reduced motion: a still sky with no drift or boil; wind moves the clouds in one still step and they gather back in three still steps over `gather` seconds.

Performance: the density pass runs at half the CSS resolution with at most 64 puffs, the lighting pass at DPR capped by `dpr`; the loop stops off screen, in a hidden tab, and when paused with the clouds gathered. A lost context or no WebGL2 shows a CSS still of the same sky.
The sky is fixed art — a sky is blue in either theme — so put a translucent panel behind any text on it, as the demo does. Content above stays fully interactive; a press on it never makes wind.

items.title: Satin Rake
items.tagline: Satin folds under a lamp you steer.
items.description: A length of satin lying in soft folds, shaded per pixel in one WebGL2 pass: meandering folds crisp in the crease and rounded on the ridge, a wrapped diffuse that keeps the dye rich in the troughs, and an anisotropic sheen whose lobe runs long along each fold, so the highlights streak down the ridges. The light is a lamp a little above the cloth that sweeps slowly back and forth on its own; the pointer takes it (where on springs.glide, how much on springs.drift) and raking it over a trough turns the trough's walls to the light, while a click sends one slow wave rolling out through the cloth, lifting and kinking every fold it crosses. One slider under the content steers the lamp from the keyboard and Enter sends a wave.

props.name: children
props.description: The content on top of the satin: a headline, a product plate, a call to action.

props.name: foldCount
props.description: How many long folds lie across the cloth, 3 to 14.

props.name: sheen
props.description: How strongly the ridges streak with sheen, 0 (matte silk) to 1 (liquid satin).

props.name: tint
props.description: The dye: a named satin or any CSS colour. Named dyes hold their lightness, so the cloth is the same on a light and a dark page.

props.name: angle
props.description: The direction the folds run, in degrees from horizontal (negative rises to the right).

props.name: softness
props.description: The folds' profile, 0 (pressed creases) to 1 (soft rolls).

props.name: depth
props.description: How deep the folds are, 0 (nearly flat) to 1 (deep drape).

props.name: lampHeight
props.description: How high the lamp hangs over the cloth, 0 (raking, deep shadows) to 1 (overhead, even light).

props.name: reach
props.description: The size of the lamp's pool of light, as a share of the box's diagonal, 0.2 to 1.

props.name: sweep
props.description: One slow return trip of the unattended lamp, in ms.

props.name: waveStrength
props.description: How high a click's wave lifts the cloth, 0 (no waves) to 1.

props.name: waveSpeed
props.description: How fast a wave rolls out through the cloth, px per second.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer and keys steer the lamp, and a click sends a wave.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the unattended lamp still; the hand and waves still move.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the drape, so two lengths of satin never fold alike.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the lamp control.

props.name: onWave
props.description: Fires when a click or Enter sends a wave, with its origin as shares of the box (0 to 1).

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: Fires when the pointer or the keyboard takes the lamp (true) or hands it back to its sweep (false).

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes and shapes the box; it fills its parent by default (h-full w-full).

usageNotes: Give the box a height (a class, or a parent that has one). Children render above the cloth in their own layer and keep every click, focus and text selection; a press on a control never sends a wave.

Keyboard: one focus stop, a slider under the content, steers the lamp — arrows move it 5% across, PageUp/PageDown 20%, Home/End to the edges — and Enter or Space sends a wave from under it. Focus takes the lamp; blur hands it back to the sweep.

Reduced motion: a still satin with no sweep; the lamp goes straight to where the pointer or keys put it, and a click lifts a still swell at the press that fades over 0.7 s instead of a travelling wave.

Cost: one fullscreen WebGL2 draw per frame, at 30 fps while only the sweep moves, and none off screen, in a hidden tab, or when paused or reduced and settled. DPR is capped at dpr. Without WebGL2, or after a lost context, a CSS still frame of the folds stands in.

Theming: the named dyes are pigments with a fixed lightness, so the cloth looks the same in either theme; pass any CSS colour to tint to dye it your own way, and its shadow and sheen are mixed from it.

items.title: Thread Hourglass
items.tagline: Straight threads that twist into a waist of light.
items.description: A string sculpture in Canvas 2D: two glowing hoops, one above the other, strung with straight threads and seen from a little above with real perspective. Twist the top hoop and every thread leans the same way, so together they draw a hyperboloid — a curve made of nothing but straight lines — whose waist narrows into a band of light where the threads gather. A sideways drag twists it 1:1 with the hoop's front bead under the finger and rubber-bands past the limit; release and it unwinds on springs.snap from the release's speed, overshooting straight once. It is a slider: arrow keys twist it a step at a time on the same spring and Escape, Enter or Space let go.

props.name: threadCount
props.description: How many threads string the two hoops, 8 to 120.

props.name: twist
props.description: How far the top hoop can be twisted either way, in degrees, 30 to 178; near 180 the waist closes to a point.

props.name: glow
props.description: The threads' bloom and the light at the waist, 0 (fine lines only) to 1.

props.name: color
props.description: The threads' colour.

props.name: hoopColor
props.description: The hoops' colour; by default the thread colour mixed toward the foreground.

props.name: tilt
props.description: How far we look down on the hoops, in degrees, 0 (side on) to 40.

props.name: spin
props.description: The sculpture's slow turn about its axis, degrees per second, 0 to 40.

props.name: step
props.description: Degrees per arrow key.

props.name: bounce
props.description: How far the hoop overshoots straight as it unwinds, 0 (none) to 1; the default is the house snap spring.

props.name: springBack
props.description: Let go and the hoop unwinds to straight; off, it stays where it is left.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the slow turn; twisting still works.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No twisting by hand or key.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the twist control.

props.name: onTwistChange
props.description: Fires as a hand or key sets the twist, in whole degrees (positive to the right), and with the resting twist on release.

props.name: onHoldChange
props.description: Fires when a drag or the keyboard takes hold of the top hoop (true) and lets go (false).

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the box; it fills its parent by default (h-full w-full).

usageNotes: Give the parent a height; the sculpture sizes itself to the box (hoop radius up to 36% of the width or 26% of the height), so it suits a tall card or a square panel.

Keyboard: it is a slider whose value is the twist in degrees. Arrows twist a step (step), PageUp/PageDown three steps, Home unwinds and End winds to the limit; Escape, Enter or Space let go, and so does moving focus away.
Reduced motion: no slow turn and no spring — the twist goes straight to where the hand or key puts it and straight back on release, so the waist still shows.

Cost: Canvas 2D with every thread cut into depth bands and batched, about a dozen strokes a frame whatever the count; frames run only while on screen, in a visible tab and while it turns or springs. spin 0 or paused stops the loop once still.

Theming: on a dark page the threads are drawn additively so the waist glows; on a light page they are inked with soft alpha so it reads as a dense woven band. Colours resolve on the component's own element and repaint on a theme switch.

items.title: Sea Level
items.tagline: A sea of points seen from the waterline.
items.description: An ocean drawn in points and seen from a camera floating just above the surface, with a content plate riding the near water. Three seeded swells with peaked crests and two trains of chop move a world grid of points; the points are drawn near to far against a silhouette buffer, so a passing swell rises past the horizon and hides the water behind it, while the camera floats over the water ahead and rolls and pitches with it, so the whole view rocks. The pointer is the wind: its side turns the wind's direction on springs.drift and builds chop from that side on springs.drift, and the plate keeps riding the same swell. One slider under the plate turns the wind from the keyboard.

props.name: children
props.description: The content plate that floats on the near water and rides the swell: a headline, a card.

props.name: waveHeight
props.description: How high the swell runs, 0 (glass) to 1 (a heavy sea that hides the horizon).

props.name: pointSize
props.description: The size of a near point, px; far points are finer. 0.6 to 3.

props.name: wind
props.description: The standing breeze, 0 (still air) to 1: how much chop rides the swell and how briskly it all moves.

props.name: color
props.description: The water's points.

props.name: foamColor
props.description: The crests' points, where the swell breaks into foam; by default the foreground mixed with a little of color.

props.name: horizon
props.description: Where the horizon sits, as a share of the height from the top, 0.15 to 0.6.

props.name: density
props.description: How closely the points are set, 0.5 (open) to 1.5 (dense).

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the sea moves, 0 (held) to 2.

props.name: rock
props.description: How much the camera rolls and pitches with the water, 0 (level) to 1; it always floats at the surface.

props.name: floatAt
props.description: Where the plate floats, as shares of the box: the point on the water under the plate's bottom edge.

props.name: heading / defaultHeading
props.description: The wind's direction in degrees, -80 (from the left) to 80 (from the right); 0 blows straight in. Controlled or initial.

props.name: onHeadingChange
props.description: Fires when the pointer (on leaving) or the keys set a new wind direction, in whole degrees.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer and keys turn the wind and build chop.

props.name: pointerStrength
props.description: How much chop the hand builds from its side, 0 to 1.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the sea still; the wind can still build chop.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the swell, so two seas never match.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the wind control.

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: Fires when the pointer or the keyboard starts (true) or stops (false) building chop.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes and shapes the box; it fills its parent by default (h-full w-full).

usageNotes: Give the box a height. Children are the floating plate: they are placed with their bottom edge on the water at floatAt and keep their own clicks and focus while they ride the swell (the transform is written straight to the layer each frame, never through React state).

Keyboard: one focus stop under the plate is a slider for the wind's direction — arrows turn it 10°, PageUp/PageDown 30°, Home/End to either side — and while it has focus the chop builds as it does under the hand.
Reduced motion: the sea settles to glass — still points in perfect perspective with a faint frozen ripple, no rocking, the plate level — and the wind still answers with a still ruffle on its side.

Cost: about 2,500–3,500 points at density 1, computed into preallocated arrays and drawn in eight batched fills; frames run only while on screen and in a visible tab, and stop when paused or reduced and settled. DPR is capped at dpr.
Theming: colours resolve on the component's own element and repaint on a theme switch; a light page gets fuller, darker points and a fainter horizon haze so the sea reads in both themes.

items.title: Dust Devil
items.tagline: A whirlwind of light that leans after your hand.
items.description: A tall funnel of fine light threads spiralling up from a floor in Canvas 2D, tight at the foot and loose at the crown, with dust circling its skirt: each thread winds round a spine of twenty nodes, spinning faster low down, drawn dim behind and bright in front, dense at the skirt and wispy at the crown. The foot walks after the pointer on springs.glide while every node above chases the one below on its own underdamped spring, softer toward the top, so the column bends as it walks and the crown whips past and settles when it stops; a click flings a spray of dust off the skirt along the spin. It is a slider for where it stands: arrow keys walk the foot and Enter flings dust.

props.name: turns
props.description: How many times each thread winds round the column from foot to crown, 1 to 8.

props.name: lean
props.description: How far the crown trails the foot and whips past when it stops, 0 (a stiff column) to 1 (a whippy one).

props.name: threadCount
props.description: How many threads of light make the funnel, 6 to 64.

props.name: color
props.description: The light's colour: sand from the warn token's hue. Drawn additively on a dark page and as ink on a light one.

props.name: flare
props.description: The crown's width, as a share of the box's width, 0.2 to 0.9.

props.name: height
props.description: The funnel's height, as a share of the box's height, 0.4 to 0.95.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast it spins, 0 (held) to 2.

props.name: dust
props.description: How much dust circles the skirt and how big a spray a click flings, 0 to 1.

props.name: wander
props.description: How far the foot wanders round its spot when no hand leads it, 0 to 1.

props.name: step
props.description: Percent of the width per arrow key.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Where it stands, 0 (left) to 100 (right), across the room the crown allows. Controlled or initial.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires when the pointer (on leaving) or the keys set a new place, in whole percent.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer and keys walk it, and a click flings dust.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No walking or flinging by hand or key.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the spin and the wander; the walk and a fling still move.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the threads and the dust, so two whirlwinds never match.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the whirlwind's control.

props.name: onFling
props.description: Fires when a click or Enter flings dust off the skirt.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the box; it fills its parent by default (h-full w-full).

usageNotes: Give the parent a height; a tall box suits it best. The foot's travel is kept inside the room the crown allows, so the whole funnel stays in the box at every value.

Keyboard: it is a slider for where it stands — arrows walk it by step, PageUp/PageDown by 25, Home/End to either side — and Enter or Space flings dust. The pointer leads the foot while it hovers and commits the new place when it leaves; a tap flings, a drag only walks.
Reduced motion: no spin and no lag — the column stands straight above the foot and goes straight to where it is put — and a fling shows as a still ring of dust round the skirt that fades over 0.7 s.

Cost: Canvas 2D with every thread sampled into one preallocated buffer and drawn in six batched strokes; frames run only while on screen and in a visible tab, and stop when paused or reduced and settled. DPR is capped at dpr.

Theming: on a dark page the threads are drawn additively so the skirt glows; on a light page they are inked in a darkened mix of color. Colours resolve on the component's own element and repaint on a theme switch.

items.title: Star Geode
items.tagline: A shell of stars that opens like a geode.
items.description: A shell of stars on a slowly turning sphere, drawn in Canvas 2D with real 3D: an icosahedron cut into 20 to 320 facets and pushed onto the sphere, a star at every vertex and fainter ones scattered across the faces, all linked by fine seams; the outer faces are nearly clear and the inner ones are crystal. Opened by a press, a key or the page scrolling past, it breaks along its seams: each triangle drifts outward with its stars attached, starting from a seeded crack, and turns about its own axis so its inner face catches the light — opening on springs.drift and closing on springs.snap, so the pieces click back into one sphere with a single crisp overshoot. A drag spins it 1:1 and a flick coasts back to the slow turn; it is a switch, so Space or Enter toggles it, Right/Up open, Left/Down close and Shift+arrows turn it.

props.name: detail
props.description: How finely the shell is cut: 1 (20 facets) to 4 (320).

props.name: explode
props.description: How far the pieces drift apart when it opens, 0 to 1. The sphere sizes itself so the open pieces stay in the box.

props.name: twinkle
props.description: How much the stars twinkle, 0 (steady) to 1.

props.name: starCount
props.description: How many faint stars are scattered across the facets, 0 to 600, besides the one at every vertex.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the geode is held open. Controlled or initial.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires from the press, key or timer that opened or closed it, with the new state.

props.name: autoClose
props.description: Close by itself this long after opening, ms; 0 keeps it open until pressed again.

props.name: trigger
props.description: What cracks it open: a press, the page scrolling past it, or both. The keys always work.

props.name: spin
props.description: The shell's slow turn, degrees per second, 0 to 60.

props.name: color
props.description: The stars and the seams.

props.name: crystal
props.description: The crystal on the inner faces.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the turn and the twinkle; opening, closing and dragging still move.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the scattered stars and how the pieces part, so two geodes never break alike.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No opening or turning by hand or key.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the geode's switch.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the box; it fills its parent by default (h-full w-full).

usageNotes: Give the parent a size; the sphere takes the shorter side and shrinks as explode grows, so the open pieces stay inside the box at any width.

Keyboard: it is a switch — Space or Enter toggles it, Right/Up open, Left/Down close, and Shift with the arrows turns the shell 20° (the drag's keyboard path). A pointer drag spins it 1:1 and a tap toggles it.
Reduced motion: no turn, no twinkle and no springs — open and closed are instant swaps between two still frames, scrolling never opens it, and it turns only under the hand, with no coast.

Cost: at detail 4, 320 facets sorted per frame in a preallocated index and drawn with one fill and one stroke each; frames run only while on screen, in a visible tab and while it turns, twinkles, coasts or springs. The scroll listener is passive and reads only the box's position.
autoClose closes it from its own timer and reports through onOpenChange, so a controlled host stays the source of truth; set it to 0 for a plain toggle.

items.title: Tidal Pair
items.tagline: Two galaxies on a close pass, scrubbed by hand.
items.description: Two small spiral galaxies on a slow, close pass, drawn in Canvas 2D points: a restricted three-body encounter in which two cores swing past each other on a bound orbit and every star of their prograde, tilted disks feels both, integrated with a fixed-step kick-drift-kick leapfrog, so the near sides are drawn into a bridge of stars and the far sides fling out into tidal tails that wrap and unwind. Checkpoints filled in the background make every moment exact, so a scrub shows the same sky every time, and the frame follows the pair as they part. It plays on its own at an unhurried pace and loops with a fade; drag sideways to scrub through time 1:1, and let go — a flick carries on and its pace eases back to playback. It is a slider through time: arrows step it, Space plays and pauses, Home and End jump.

props.name: massRatio
props.description: The companion's mass against the primary's, 0.1 (a small satellite) to 1 (an equal pair).

props.name: inclination
props.description: How far the disks tilt from the plane of their orbit, in degrees, 0 (flat, long tails) to 90.

props.name: starCount
props.description: How many stars the two disks hold between them, 200 to 3000.

props.name: colors
props.description: The primary's and the companion's stars.

props.name: duration
props.description: How long the whole encounter takes to play, ms.

props.name: view
props.description: How far the orbit's plane is tilted from face-on, in degrees, 0 to 80.

props.name: closeness
props.description: How close they pass, as the closest distance over a disk's size, 0.6 (grazing) to 1.6 (wide).

props.name: playing / defaultPlaying
props.description: Whether the encounter plays on by itself. Controlled or initial.

props.name: onPlayingChange
props.description: Fires when Space or Enter starts or stops the playback, and when the arrow keys pause it to step.

props.name: defaultTime
props.description: Where in the encounter it starts, 0 (far apart) to 1 (tails unwound).

props.name: loop
props.description: At the end, hold a moment, fade, and play again.

props.name: step
props.description: How far an arrow key steps through the encounter, as a share of it.

props.name: onScrub
props.description: Fires as the hand or the keys move through time, with the time from 0 to 1.

props.name: onPhaseChange
props.description: Fires when the encounter passes into a new phase: approach, closest approach, the bridge forming, the tails unwinding.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the stars, so two encounters never match.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No scrubbing by hand or key.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the timeline control.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the box; it fills its parent by default (h-full w-full).

usageNotes: Give the box a size; a wide one suits the pass best. A hairline timeline along the bottom shows where you are, with closest approach marked.

Keyboard: it is a slider through time whose reading is spoken as millions of years either side of closest approach — arrows step it (and pause playback so the step holds), PageUp/PageDown four steps, Home/End jump, Space or Enter plays and pauses.
Reduced motion: no autoplay and no coast — it opens on a still frame of the tails and moves only when stepped or scrubbed, with frames swapped instantly; the loop's fade is skipped.

Cost: about 1,600 stars feel two cores per step; checkpoints (positions and velocities every 50 steps) are filled a few milliseconds a frame while it is on screen, and any moment is at most 50 steps from one. Points are drawn in six batched fills; frames run only while on screen, in a visible tab and while playing, coasting or computing.
Theming: the two colours resolve on the component's own element and repaint on a theme switch; on a dark page the stars and cores are drawn additively, on a light page as ink.

items.title: Beach Scrawl
items.tagline: Write in the sand and let the tide take it.
items.description: A shoreline seen from above and drawn in characters — swell glyphs for the sea, sparse dots for dry sand, denser marks for wet — where an unseen hand writes a message in single-stroke capitals, hopping pen-up between strokes on the springs.flick constants, and waves run up on a decelerating ballistic curve to a reach that varies along the shore, spread a foam lace at the top of their run and drain away. Every water front that crosses a groove scours it and spreads it into its neighbours, so each wave leaves the writing softer until the tide has taken it and the hand writes again. Drag to press your own grooves into the sand; focus the beach and type, and the hand writes your letters at a caret (Backspace rakes the last one smooth, Enter smooths the line).

props.name: message
props.description: What the unseen hand writes, in single-stroke capitals (A–Z, 0–9, . - ' & +). Empty for none.

props.name: loop
props.description: Write the message again once the tide has taken it.

props.name: waveRate
props.description: How often the tide comes, in waves a minute (1 to 30).

props.name: charSet
props.description: The glyph vocabulary for sand, water and foam.

props.name: wetness
props.description: How far the swash runs up the beach and how long the sand stays dark, 0 to 1.

props.name: erosion
props.description: How much each wave takes from the writing, 0 (nothing) to 1 (about two waves).

props.name: writeSpeed
props.description: How fast the hand writes, in letters a second.

props.name: cell
props.description: Glyph size in px (6 to 18), or "auto": 10 on a wide beach down to 7 on a phone, so a long word still has enough cells to read.

props.name: brush
props.description: Width of a pressed stroke in px; the hand's stick narrows for small letters.

props.name: sandColor
props.description: Sand ink, any CSS colour. Wet sand mixes it toward the sea; grooves toward the foreground.

props.name: seaColor
props.description: Sea ink, any CSS colour.

props.name: foamColor
props.description: Foam ink, any CSS colour.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Let the visitor write: drag to draw, type to write.

props.name: trigger
props.description: When the hand starts writing: at mount, or the first time the beach is on screen.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the tide and the hand where they are.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the sand, the waves and their reach.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: onWritten
props.description: Fires when the hand finishes writing the message, with the text it wrote.

props.name: onWashed
props.description: Fires when the tide has taken every mark from the sand.

props.name: onWave
props.description: Fires as each wave starts up the beach, with the count so far.

props.name: label
props.description: The beach's accessible name; what the sand reads is added to it.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes and shapes the box.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the beach is one tab stop. Letters, digits and . - ' & + are written into the sand by the hand at a caret (shown while focused); Space advances, Backspace rakes the last letter smooth, Enter smooths the line. Escape is left to the page.

Pointer and touch: a drag presses a groove 1:1 under the finger (segments between events are stamped, so fast strokes never dot) and a tap pokes a hole; the box is touch-action: none while interactive, so set interactive={false} where the page must scroll through it.
The accessible name says what the sand reads ("Beach. The sand reads LOW TIDE."), and a polite live region announces "Written" and "Washed away" only — never per stroke or per wave.
Under reduced motion the water is still, a single lace sits at the shore, writing appears at once, and the tide takes it one step per wave period by a short crossfade; nothing runs between steps.

Canvas 2D from a glyph atlas with the device pixel ratio capped at 2; the loop runs only on screen in a visible page and stops when paused. Colours are text tokens resolved on the element and re-read when the theme changes.
The tide waits for the hand to finish the message before the next wave, so the story is always written before it is taken; marks the waves cannot reach dry out and blow smooth after six waves.

items.title: Log Rain
items.tagline: Falling code that stops to be read.
items.description: Columns of log-shaped glyphs rain at up to three depths, the far ones small, dim and slow, and any near column stops to be read: hover it, tap it or reach it with the arrow keys and its fall halts, then the stick of glyphs swings flat about the glyph under the pointer — every glyph upright on its arc, re-rolling centre-out into the real characters of a line from your logs — on one progress value driven by springs.snap, so the line lands with one crisp overshoot over a plate that keeps it readable. Leave it and, after the dwell, it tips back up on springs.glide and the column falls again from rest. Left and Right (or Up and Down) move between raining columns, Home and End jump, and Escape tips the line back.

props.name: lines
props.description: The log lines the columns become when they stop: { time?, source, text, level? } or plain strings shown as they are. Columns take lines in turn.

props.name: layers
props.description: How many depths rain, nearest first: 1 to 3.

props.name: fallSpeed
props.description: How fast the rain falls, 0 (held) to 3.

props.name: hue
props.description: The rain's hue in degrees, at the accent token's own lightness and chroma, so it suits both themes.

props.name: glyphs
props.description: The characters the rain is made of.

props.name: density
props.description: The share of columns that rain, 0 to 1.

props.name: size
props.description: Glyph size of the nearest depth in px (9 to 22); the others scale from it.

props.name: trail
props.description: How long the trails run, 0 to 1.

props.name: dwell
props.description: How long a line stays readable after the pointer leaves, in ms.

props.name: levelColors
props.description: Colour a line's source by its level: warn and error in their tokens.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Hover, tap and arrow keys stop a column to read it.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the rain where it is; lines can still be read.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the columns, their speeds and lengths.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: onLineChange
props.description: Fires with the index of the line that tipped in, and with null when it tips back.

props.name: label
props.description: The field's accessible name.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes and shapes the box.

usageNotes: It is a listbox with one tab stop: the lines are its options (rendered for assistive technology), aria-activedescendant follows the line that is up, so a screen reader reads the line when it arrives. Left/Right or Up/Down move between raining columns, Home/End jump, Escape (only while a line is up) tips it back, and blur releases it.
Touch: a tap stops a column and a second tap (or a tap on empty rain) lets it go; the box keeps touch-action: pan-y so the page still scrolls through it.
Under reduced motion the rain is a still frame and a line crossfades in place over 150 ms; nothing falls, swings or re-rolls, and no loop runs between crossfades.

Canvas 2D from one glyph atlas per depth (rain ink and head ink); lines are drawn at the glyph's own advance over a plate in the card colour. The loop runs only on screen in a visible page; the device pixel ratio is capped at 2.
The hue keeps the accent token's lightness and chroma (oklch relative colour), so any hue stays legible in light and dark; colours re-read when the theme changes.
Export defaultLogRainLines shows the line shape; keep lines short (a phone panel wraps them to at most three rows and ellipsises the rest).

items.title: ASCII Hearth
items.tagline: A fire drawn in characters, fanned by your cursor.
items.description: A small hearth drawn in characters — a brick surround in a running bond, a lintel and a hearthstone around a dark firebox — holding a fire whose every cell picks its glyph from a ramp by its heat and its ink from a ramp of ember red to white-hot, stepped at a fixed 30 Hz with rising noise carving the heat into licking tongues. The pointer's speed works the bellows: the air is a springs.recoil spring, so a fast pass makes the flames leap twice and settle while they lean away from the pointer on the springs.drift constants and throw sparks; left alone for bankAfter, the fire banks down to a bed of glowing embers. It is a real button: Space, Enter or a click gives one full puff.

props.name: heat
props.description: How tall the fire burns while it is tended, 0 (embers) to 1.

props.name: charRamp
props.description: The glyph ramp the fire is drawn in, coolest to hottest.

props.name: draught
props.description: How strongly the pointer's speed fans the fire and leans the flames, 0 to 1.

props.name: bankAfter
props.description: How long the fire burns untended before it banks down to embers, ms.

props.name: sparks
props.description: Sparks fly from the bed while the fire is fanned.

props.name: bricks
props.description: Draw the brick surround and hearthstone; off, the fire burns in a plain dark box.

props.name: size
props.description: Glyph size in px (7 to 16).

props.name: colors
props.description: Five CSS colours from ember to white-hot, mixed in oklab into twelve inks. Pigments at fixed lightness by default, so the fire reads the same in both themes.

props.name: brickColor
props.description: Brick ink, any CSS colour.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer and the keyboard work the bellows.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the flames where they are.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the logs, the tongues and the sparks.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: onLevelChange
props.description: Fires with the fire's level from the start and whenever it changes: banked to embers, low, steady or roaring.

props.name: label
props.description: The fire's name; the button reads "<label>: work the bellows".

props.name: disabled
props.description: No bellows: the fire keeps burning and banks as usual, and the button is aria-disabled.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes and shapes the box.

usageNotes: The hearth is a native button labelled "<label>: work the bellows": Space, Enter and clicks each give one puff, the pointer's speed over it fans the fire, and a polite live region announces level changes (banked, low, steady, roaring) only — never per frame.
Touch keeps touch-action: pan-y: a sideways swipe fans the fire, a vertical one scrolls the page, a tap puffs.

Under reduced motion the fire is a still frame (the field stepped to rest); a puff or a fast pass crossfades to a roaring still for 1.6 s and back, and banking crossfades to an ember still. Nothing flickers and no loop runs between crossfades.

The heat field steps at 30 Hz (12 Hz once banked) over typed arrays; the bricks are drawn once into a cached layer, the fire from a glyph atlas of the ramp in twelve heat inks. Nothing runs off screen, in a hidden page or when paused; the device pixel ratio is capped at 2.
The fire's inks are pigments at fixed lightness and the firebox is soot in both themes, so a white-hot bed still glows on a light page; the bricks use a text token mix and re-read on theme change.

items.title: Banded Giant
items.tagline: A gas giant in type, its bands running at their own pace.
items.description: A ringed gas giant rendered per glyph cell on Canvas 2D: each cell is cast onto the sphere and the ring plane, its glyph picked by the light it receives and its ink by what it hit — pale zone, darker belt, the storm, the ring — while every latitude flows at its own speed and the turbulence is sampled in each latitude's advected longitude, so the bands shear past one another, a storm turns in the south, the ring's shadow falls across the disc and the planet's across the ring, and now and then a moon crosses in front as one bright character with its shadow beside it. Drag sideways to spin it 1:1 (a throw coasts with friction) and up or down to tip it, rubber-banded past ±30° and returned to ringTilt on springs.drift with the release velocity. Left and Right give a spin that coasts, Up and Down tip it and let it swing back, Home stops the spin.

props.name: bandSpeed
props.description: How fast the bands shear past one another, 0 (still) to 3.

props.name: ringTilt
props.description: How far the ring opens toward you, in degrees (−40 to 60); 0 is edge-on.

props.name: charSet
props.description: The glyph ramp the light is drawn in.

props.name: spin
props.description: How fast the planet turns as a whole, 0 to 3.

props.name: bands
props.description: How many bands cross the disc, 4 to 20.

props.name: storm
props.description: A slow storm turning in the south, riding its band.

props.name: ring
props.description: The ring, its division and its shadow on the disc.

props.name: moon
props.description: A moon that now and then crosses in front, with its shadow.

props.name: moonPeriod
props.description: Seconds for the moon to go once round.

props.name: resolution
props.description: Rows of glyphs across the disc, 14 to 60.

props.name: colors
props.type: { zone?: string; belt?: string; storm?: string; ring?: string }
props.description: The planet's inks, any CSS colours. Pigments at fixed lightness by default, made for a night-sky backdrop in either theme.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Drag and the arrow keys spin and tip it.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the bands, the storm and the moon where they are.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the bands, their jets and the turbulence.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: onTransit
props.description: Fires as the moon starts across the disc.

props.name: label
props.description: The planet's accessible name; the ring's opening is added to it.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes and shapes the box; the planet and its ring always fit inside it.

usageNotes: It is one tab stop (role group, roledescription planet) named with the ring's opening; Left/Right spin it, Up/Down tip it, Home stops the spin, and Escape is left to the page. A polite live region announces transits only.
Drag is two-dimensional, so the box is touch-action: none while interactive; set interactive={false} where a phone must scroll through it.
The default inks are pigments at fixed lightness, drawn for a night sky: put it on a dark backdrop in both themes (as the demo does), or pass colors with darker inks for a light surface.

Under reduced motion the bands, storm and moon are still (the moon parked on the disc with its shadow); a drag turns and tips it 1:1 and leaves it there, keys turn 15° and tip 6° per press, and no loop runs unless you are dragging.

Sphere and ring maths per cell with value noise, glyphs from one atlas, the device pixel ratio capped at 2; the loop runs only on screen in a visible page and stops when nothing flows (bandSpeed 0, spin 0, no moon, nothing coasting) or when paused.

items.title: Echo Sounder
items.tagline: A depth sounder drawing the seabed in glyphs.
items.description: A survey launch over a chart-recorder echogram drawn in glyph density: the launch rides the top edge after the pointer on springs.glide, pitching with its speed and bobbing on the swell, while the seabed scrolls beneath it, so the record painted under the keel is carried away behind it. At the ping rate a pulse arc descends and writes each depth's return into the column under the beam as it passes — surface clutter, water speckle, shoals as clouds of bright marks, the bed a bold band with a sub-bottom tail and a faint second echo — then the return climbs back. A click, Space or Enter pings at once with a brighter pulse and a highlighted column; it is a slider, so Left and Right steer the launch 2% a press, Page keys 10%, Home and End to the ends.

props.name: depths
props.description: Depths along the transect in metres; the line loops. The default is the Coldbrook basin: a shelf, a slope, a ridge, the deep floor and a channel.

props.name: shoals
props.type: readonly { at: number; depth: number; size?: number; density?: number }[]
props.description: Shoals along the transect: where (0 to 1), how deep (m), how tall (m, about four times as long) and how thick.

props.name: pingRate
props.description: Pings a second, 0.25 to 6.

props.name: gain
props.description: Return strength, 0 to 1: bolder bands, a longer sub-bottom tail, more clutter.

props.name: depthScale
props.description: Metres from the surface to the bottom edge, 10 to 400.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the launch is under way, px a second; 0 holds it over one spot.

props.name: units
props.description: Units for the readout and the scale (depths are given in metres).

props.name: scale
props.description: Show the depth scale on the right edge.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The launch's place across the box, 0 to 1, controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires as the pointer or the keys steer the launch, with its new place.

props.name: colors
props.type: { water?: string; bed?: string; shoal?: string; boat?: string }
props.description: The inks; text tokens by default (accent, foreground, signal, foreground), so both themes keep contrast.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer steers, a click pings, the keys steer and ping.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the launch and the record where they are.

props.name: sound
props.description: A blup at each ping you ask for, pitched by depth, and a quieter one when its echo returns.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the clutter, the speckle and the fish.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: onPing
props.description: Fires with the depth under the keel (metres) as each ping's echo comes back, and whether the visitor asked for it.

props.name: label
props.description: The sounder's accessible name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No steering and no pings from the visitor; the survey runs on.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes and shapes the box.

usageNotes: It is a slider (one tab stop) for the launch's place: Left/Right 2%, Page Up/Down 10%, Home/End to the ends, Space or Enter pings. aria-valuetext carries the depth under the keel, and a polite live region announces the depth after the visitor's own pings only.
Sound answers the visitor only: automatic pings are silent; a ping you ask for plays a blup pitched by depth and a quieter one when the echo returns. Nothing plays unless sound is on.
Touch keeps touch-action: pan-y: a sideways drag steers, a vertical one scrolls the page, a tap pings.

Under reduced motion the record is a finished still survey across the width, the launch moves straight to where it is steered, and a ping glows the column under it while the readout updates; no loop runs between pings.

The record is a ring buffer of typed-array columns drawn from a glyph atlas; steering writes the slider's value straight to the node, not through React state. The loop runs only on screen in a visible page and stops when paused; the device pixel ratio is capped at 2.

items.title: Taffy Pull
items.tagline: Pull a letter like taffy and let it snap home.
items.description: A display headline whose every letter can be grabbed and pulled like taffy: the part you hold follows the finger 1:1 while the letter's far side stays in its slot, so it stretches along the pull and thins into a neck (redrawn as a textured canvas mesh), rubber-banding past its reach while its neighbours are dragged a little after it on springs.snap. Let go and it snaps home on a spring of the given stiffness that takes the release velocity, while a wobble runs down the word letter by letter on the cascade; fling it hard, or pull far past the reach, and it tears free, arcs out under gravity, and is reeled back into its slot on springs.glide, landing with a recoil. Keyboard: Left and Right choose a letter, Up and Down tug it (Shift with Left or Right tugs sideways), holding the key pulls further and letting go lets it snap.

props.name: text
props.description: The headline. Every letter (grapheme) can be pulled; words never break mid-word.

props.name: as
props.description: The element the headline renders as.

props.name: stretch
props.description: How far a letter reaches before it resists (and, at 1.6× that, tears): 0 is 0.4 of a letter's height, 1 is 1.6.

props.name: stiffness
props.description: How hard a letter snaps home, as a spring stiffness (120 to 900).

props.name: thinning
props.description: How thin the neck gets as it stretches, 0 to 1.

props.name: wobble
props.description: How long a letter rings after the snap, 0 (dead) to 1 (ringing): the snap spring's damping ratio runs 0.9 to 0.18.

props.name: cling
props.description: How much the neighbours are dragged after a pulled letter, and how far the wobble carries down the word, 0 to 1.

props.name: tear
props.description: A hard fling, or a pull far past the reach, tears the letter free; it arcs out and is reeled back.

props.name: tearSpeed
props.description: Release speed that tears a letter free, px a second (with at least 40% of the reach pulled).

props.name: color
props.description: Ink for the letters; inherits the text colour unless set.

props.name: onPull
props.description: Fires while a letter is pulled, with its index and how far toward the reach it is, 0 to 1 in steps of 0.01.

props.name: onSnap
props.description: Fires when a pulled letter is let go and snaps home, or lands after a tear.

props.name: onTear
props.description: Fires when a letter tears free.

props.name: sound
props.description: A twang at the snap pitched by the stretch, a higher one at a tear, a low one at the landing.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Letters cannot be pulled; the headline is plain text.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the type (set the font size here, the letters inherit it) and places the headline; the box keeps 0.75em above and below for pulls.

usageNotes: The headline element carries the text once for assistive technology; the letter spans are aria-hidden. The pullable part is one tab stop (a group named by the headline, with a hint): Left/Right choose a letter (Home/End jump), Up/Down tug it, Shift with Left/Right tugs sideways, holding the key pulls further (past the limit it tears), releasing it lets go, and Escape lets go of a held letter. A polite live region names the chosen letter and announces tears.
Letters are touch-action: none (a drag on a letter pulls it) while the rest of the box scrolls normally; a drag captures the pointer only after 3 px, so taps and text selection elsewhere behave.

Idle cost is zero: no loop runs unless a letter is moving, and it stops once every spring is at rest. Rest letters are plain text with no transform; only a stretched letter is redrawn, as a 10×12 textured mesh rastered once per font and colour at the device ratio (capped at 2).

Under reduced motion a pull still stretches under the finger (it is the visitor's own movement), but there is no wobble, neighbour drag or flight: a release or a tear crossfades the letter home over 150 ms.
Pulls and flights stay inside the component's box; give it the room you want for them through its font size, since the padding is in em.

items.title: Bulb Marquee
items.tagline: A headline spelled in theatre bulbs.
items.description: A headline spelled in an alphabet of theatre bulbs: every glyph is a set of centre-line strokes with bulbs dropped along them at an even pitch, each in a dark socket on a deep enamel face, with a frame of bulbs round the edge. On reveal a comet chases one lap of the frame, then the letters fill bulb by bulb in pen order, each filament following the step response of springs.recoil — a cold filament's inrush flashes past its rest brightness and settles — while its colour climbs from dull red through orange to the warm white set by warmth; at rest a slow chase keeps the frame alive. Hover sparkles the letter under the pointer, a press throws the switch and relights the sign, and a transparent button gives the keyboard Enter to relight and Left and Right to sparkle letter by letter.

props.name: children / text
props.description: The headline, as children or a prop; set in capitals.

props.name: as
props.description: The element that carries the headline.

props.name: bulbSize
props.description: Bulb diameter, 0.6 to 1.4 times the house bulb; the spacing follows, so small bulbs make fine letters and big ones chunky letters.

props.name: chase
props.description: The resting frame's chase, steps per second, 0 to 10; 0 holds the frame steady.

props.name: warmth
props.description: Filament colour temperature, 0 (clear white) to 1 (deep amber).

props.name: glow
props.description: How far each bulb's halo spills, 0 to 1.

props.name: pattern
props.description: The frame at rest: a three-step chase, or odd and even bulbs taking turns.

props.name: frame
props.description: Draw the border of bulbs round the sign face.

props.name: face
props.description: The sign face, any CSS colour; a fixed enamel pigment by default so the sign reads the same in both themes.

props.name: trigger
props.description: What lights the sign.

props.name: once
props.description: Light once, or go dark again when it leaves view or the hover ends.

props.name: play
props.description: With trigger "manual": true lights the sign, false switches it off.

props.name: delay
props.description: Wait before the frame's first lap, ms.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Gap between letters starting to fill, ms.

props.name: duration
props.description: How long one letter takes to fill bulb by bulb, ms.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Hover sparkles a letter, a press relights the sign, and the keys do both.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: The sign went dark, began warming up, or finished lighting.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: The reveal has finished: every bulb is lit and settled.

props.name: className
props.description: Size (the bulb grid is in em) and layout.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the sign carries a transparent button — Enter or Space relights it (the same end state as a press), Left, Right, Home and End run a sparkle through one letter at a time; the focus ring is drawn round the sign.
Reduced motion: no lap, chase, sparkle or overshoot — every bulb fades up together on a short tween and the frame stays lit steady with every third bulb a little brighter.

Performance: bulbs are deterministic SVG (the server renders the unlit sign); one loop writes pre-built palette strings only while a reveal, relight or sparkle runs, the resting chase is a timer plus CSS fades, and everything stops off screen and in hidden tabs.
The alphabet covers A–Z, 0–9 and common punctuation; other characters fall back to a question mark. The text is read once from an sr-only copy and the bulbs are aria-hidden.
Size it with font-size: the cap height is 0.78em and words wrap between themselves; the face and bulbs are fixed pigments, so it reads the same on light and dark pages.

items.title: Reed Type
items.tagline: Letters on stalks that sway as you pass.
items.description: Each letter stands on a slim stalk rising out of a waterline, the stalk drawn as one smooth arc and the letter riding its tip, turned about its own foot. Every reed is a damped angular oscillator joined to its neighbours by a coupling spring, with stiffness set between springs.drift and springs.snap, so a reed the pointer brushes bends away, whips back on a damped sway and pulls the next one a beat later; a fast drag released across the line sends a gust down all of it, and reeds that sank on a leave grow back up on springs.glide. A transparent button takes focus: keyboard focus sends a gentle ripple across, Enter or Space a strong one, and Left and Right a gust from either end.

props.name: children / text
props.description: The line, as children or a prop.

props.name: as
props.description: The element that carries the line.

props.name: stalk
props.description: Stalk length, em: tall reeds sway wider and slower.

props.name: stiffness

props.name: damping

props.name: coupling

props.name: radius

props.name: strength

props.name: maxBend

props.name: stalkColor
props.description: The stalks' colour, any CSS colour; sage ink by default.

props.name: water
props.description: Draw the waterline, the stalks' reflections and the ripples.

props.name: trigger
props.description: What sends the arrival gust (and raises reeds that sank).

props.name: once
props.description: Arrive once, or sink and rise again each time the line re-enters view or is hovered.

props.name: play
props.description: With trigger "manual": true brings the reeds in, false sinks them.

props.name: delay
props.description: Wait before the arrival, ms.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Gap between reeds rising, ms.

props.name: duration

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer, touch and the keys sway the reeds.

props.name: onSwayChange
props.description: The reeds started swaying (true), or every reed has come to rest (false).

props.name: onComplete
props.description: The arrival has settled.

props.name: className
props.description: Size and type; stalks and bends are in em.

usageNotes: Keyboard: focusing the line by keyboard sends a gentle ripple across; Enter or Space sends a strong one, and Left and Right a gust from either end — the same travelling push a fast drag leaves behind.
Touch: press and drag across the line to brush the reeds (touch-action: pan-y keeps vertical scrolling); a fast release sends a gust.
Reduced motion: nothing sways or rises — the reeds stand straight and a colour wave along the stalks answers the pointer and the keys.

Performance: one loop integrates every reed at fixed 1/240 s substeps and stops when they are all still (no idle cost); it halts off screen and in hidden tabs. Rest positions are measured on resize and font load.
The line reads once from an sr-only copy; the reeds are aria-hidden. The root keeps 0.6em of sway room each side and clips to itself, so bends never spill out.

items.title: Incense Script
items.tagline: A thread of smoke that curls into your words.
items.description: A stick of incense stands at the left edge and one thread of smoke leaves its ember, rises and drifts right, its curls catching on the letters one by one so each forms out of the smoke the thread leaves there; written, the phrase lingers, then diffuses upward into haze and the next one begins. Canvas 2D draws the thread along a seeded spline with turbulence, its ageing trail, the ember's plume and every smoke particle sampled from the real glyphs, each pulled into place by a spring at springs.glide's damping ratio while a decaying swirl curls it in. A hand through the smoke pushes it aside and it drifts back, and a transparent button gives the keyboard Enter to waft a breath across the words.

props.name: phrases
props.description: The phrases, written in smoke one after another.

props.name: as
props.description: The element that carries the phrases.

props.name: drift

props.name: curl
props.description: Turbulence, 0 (a laminar thread) to 1 (curling, swirling smoke).

props.name: linger
props.description: How long a written phrase stays before it clears to haze, ms.

props.name: color
props.description: The smoke, any CSS colour; resolved on the element, so it follows the theme.

props.name: ember

props.name: density
props.description: How much smoke makes each letter, 0 (wisps) to 1 (dense).

props.name: stick
props.description: Draw the stick of incense and its dish at the left edge.

props.name: loop
props.description: Cycle the phrases; false stops on the last one, written.

props.name: trigger
props.description: What lights the stick.

props.name: play
props.description: With trigger "manual": true lights the stick, false lets it rest.

props.name: delay
props.description: Wait before the first thread leaves the ember, ms.

props.name: interactive
props.description: A hand through the smoke pushes it aside; Enter wafts a breath across.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's pixel ratio (never above 2).

props.name: onPhraseChange
props.description: A phrase began: its index in phrases.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: A phrase finished writing: its index in phrases.

props.name: className
props.description: Size and type; the stick and gutter are in em.

usageNotes: Keyboard: a transparent, pointer-transparent button over the words takes focus — Enter or Space wafts a breath along the line, the same push a hand through the smoke gives.

Reduced motion: no canvas runs — each phrase stands finished as still smoke (the real text in the smoke colour with a soft glow) beside a still plume, and phrases cross-fade after linger. That is also the server-rendered first frame.

Performance: one Canvas 2D loop at a pixel ratio capped at 2 (dpr lowers it) runs while the stick burns and pauses off screen and in hidden tabs; particles live in typed arrays and the mask, body and sprite canvases are built per phrase or per colour, never per frame. With loop off it stops once the last phrase settles.
Accessibility: every phrase is read once from an sr-only sentence list; the laid-out copy is aria-hidden but stays selectable, so copying produces the real words.
The box reserves the largest phrase, so the height never changes between phrases; the smoke colour is re-read from the element when the theme changes.

items.title: Cutout Letters
items.tagline: Letters that fold up off the page near you.
items.description: A headline die-cut into heavy card: each letter is a tab hinged along its baseline, read by its cut line until the pointer comes near and the tabs fold up out of their holes toward you in real CSS 3D — faces darkening as they turn from the top light, soft shadows falling on the card, and past ninety degrees the tabs tip over to show the blank reverse while the holes show the darker stock below. Each tab's angle is a spring that rises on springs.snap and lies back on a spring between snap and drift, slapping flat with one small bounce, and on its trigger or keyboard focus a wave lifts the whole word letter by letter. A transparent slider gives the keyboard Left and Right to lift letters one at a time, Home and End to jump, Escape to lay them flat and Enter or Space to run the wave.

props.name: children / text
props.description: The headline, as children or a prop.

props.name: as
props.description: The element that carries the headline.

props.name: radius
props.description: How far the pointer's reach extends, em.

props.name: foldAngle
props.description: How far a tab folds up, degrees: under 90 they stand toward you, over 90 they tip over and show their backs.

props.name: paperTone
props.description: The card stock.

props.name: shadow
props.description: How dark the raised tabs' shadows fall, 0 to 1.

props.name: relax
props.description: How slowly tabs lie back down, 0 (the snap spring) to 1 (the drift spring).

props.name: depth
props.description: Perspective distance, em: smaller is a stronger 3D.

props.name: trigger
props.description: When the wave of folding tabs runs across the headline.

props.name: once
props.description: Run the wave once, or each time the headline re-enters view or is hovered.

props.name: play
props.description: With trigger "manual": true runs the wave.

props.name: delay
props.description: Wait before the wave, ms.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Time the wave takes from one letter to the next, ms.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer, a touch drag and the keys lift the letters.

props.name: sound
props.description: Paper sounds for the folds the visitor makes.

props.name: onFold

usageNotes: Keyboard: a slider over the card — Left and Right lift the letters one at a time, Home and End jump, Escape lays them flat and Enter or Space runs the wave; focusing it by keyboard runs the wave too.
Reduced motion: no tab moves — letters near the pointer or the keys show their dark holes instead (an opacity change), and the wave becomes a wave of holes.
Sound: with sound on, a paper crinkle answers a tab the visitor raises past half its fold and a lighter one a tab that slaps down; it stays silent until the page has had a click, tap or key press.
Performance: one loop springs every tab and stops when they all lie flat; it halts off screen and in hidden tabs. Shadows are static blurs moved only by transforms.
The card stocks are fixed pigments and read the same in both themes; the headline is read once from an sr-only copy and the tabs are aria-hidden.

items.title: Bookend Type
items.tagline: Letters slump like books, then stand straight again.
items.description: Capitals stand on a shelf between two bookends like books. A round: the near bookend nudges the first letter and the lean runs down the line under a gravity ease, each book pushing the next and coming to rest slanted against it with a small recoil on springs.recoil's ratio, the last resting its top on the far bookend, which stands exactly where the solved parallel slump puts it; then the near bookend slides in and pushes them upright one after another, each landing with a soft knock, and the next word takes the shelf with the bookends gliding to it on springs.glide and the next round leaning the other way. The shelf is a button: a press, Enter or Space starts a round now, tidies a slumped shelf at once, or puts up the next word.

props.name: as

props.name: leanAngle

props.name: pace

props.name: shelf

props.name: caps

props.name: color

props.name: bookendColor

props.name: autoplay

props.name: interval

props.name: alternate
props.description: Each round leans the other way, the bookends trading roles.

props.name: trigger

props.name: play

props.name: delay
props.description: Wait before the first round, ms.

props.name: interactive

props.name: sound
props.description: Knocks for the rounds the visitor starts.

props.name: onWordChange

usageNotes: Keyboard: the shelf is a native button — Enter or Space nudges the books over, tidies a slumped shelf, or puts up the next word, the same as a press.
Reduced motion: the shelf stays upright — no tipping and no sliding bookends; each round cross-fades to the next word.

Geometry is solved from the measured letter widths and cap height: slumped books stack parallel, so the far bookend's gap is W(1/cos θ − 1) + H·sin θ. A hidden copy of every word fits the type to the longest slump, so the size never changes between words.
Performance: one loop runs only while books move; between rounds a single timer waits, and nothing runs off screen or in hidden tabs. Sounds answer only rounds the visitor started.
The current word is the heading's text (one word, read on demand); the books are aria-hidden. Wood and steel shelves are fixed pigments; letters and bookends take tokens.

items.title: Letter Dice
items.tagline: Letters rolled like dice that land on your words.
items.description: Each letter is an ivory cube with a glyph on every face, sitting in an engraved slot on a felt strip. On its trigger the set is thrown in over the left rail and tumbles in real 3D — rolled a quarter turn per side length travelled, hopping on bounces that die away, spun about the vertical — along seeded paths defined backwards from the rest pose, so every die lands square in its slot with the right letter up, faces shaded from their real normals and a contact shadow tightening as it comes down; the last one rocks on an edge on the springs.recoil ratio before it lies still. The felt is a button: a press throws, a flick throws as hard as it was flicked, and Enter or Space throws again onto the next word.

props.name: inkColor

props.name: interactive

usageNotes: Keyboard: the felt is a native button — Enter or Space throws again onto the next word, the same as a press or a flick.
Touch: a horizontal flick across the felt throws as hard as it was flicked (touch-action: pan-y keeps vertical scrolling); a tap throws at the tumble strength.
Reduced motion: no tumbling — the dice fade into their slots face up, one after another, and the last one does not rock.
Performance: one loop runs only during a throw, evaluating each die's analytic path and face shading, and stops when the last die is still; nothing runs at rest, off screen or in hidden tabs.
The dice rest in their slots on the first frame (and on the server), so the word reads before the throw; the current word is the heading's text and the cubes are aria-hidden.

items.title: Anagram Sort
items.tagline: A jumble that sorts itself into your headline.
items.description: The headline arrives as a seeded anagram of itself — each word's letters jumbled, stray ones in a softer ink — and sorts itself back in beats: a letter hops over its neighbour on an arc whose height rides its horizontal springs.snap progress, so the spring's one overshoot lands it a hair past its slot and back, while the letter it crosses dips under and the letters between glide aside on springs.glide; each landing squashes on the baseline and a letter that reaches home develops to full ink. The method sets the rhythm — every out-of-order pair at once, one letter at a time leaping into place, or one sweep along the line — and a press, Enter or Space tosses the letters into a new jumble and sorts them again.

props.name: text
props.description: The headline. Letters only ever travel inside their own word.

props.name: as
props.description: The element rendered.

props.name: method

props.name: swapSpeed

props.name: arcHeight

props.name: duration
props.description: Time scale of a hop's spring, ms; its damping ratio is kept.

props.name: stagger

props.name: delay

props.name: settle

props.name: seed

props.name: color

props.name: strayColor

props.name: trigger

props.name: onProgress

props.name: onComplete

props.name: className

usageNotes: Keyboard: interactive headlines are in the tab order; Enter or Space tosses the letters into a new jumble and sorts them again. Screen readers get the headline once, from a hidden copy, and the real words sit under the letters for selection and copy.
Reduced motion: nothing travels. A sort jumps every letter home and develops the ink from stray to settled on a tween; a press shows the new jumble, then the same crossfade.
The server renders the jumble, so the first paint is a legible anagram; the sort starts when the trigger fires and pauses off screen or in a hidden tab.

Letters and digits move, punctuation stays put, and letters never leave their word, so line breaks never change while it sorts. Keep `arcHeight` in mind: the same room is reserved above the first line.
Sound plays only for a sort the visitor started, one tick per landing, and only when `sound` is true.

items.title: Caustic Type
items.tagline: Words on the floor of a pool, lit by moving water.
items.description: A paragraph laid in the floor of a clear pool: the words stay real DOM text while a WebGL2 canvas draws them as dark tiles in a pale plaster floor seen through moving water, and the light is computed, not painted — the floor's brightness is how hard refraction through a surface of nine seeded waves squeezes the light together, so it gathers into bright, wavering nets that slide across the words with a thin rainbow at their edges. Moving the pointer sends rings across the surface that sweep new nets over the paragraph and a press drops a pebble; resting lets the rings fade back to a slow shimmer. The pool is a focusable group: the arrow keys move a fingertip that stirs the water and Enter or Space drops a pebble.

props.name: as

props.name: tint
props.description: The water: its colour, the floor, the letter tiles and the light.

props.name: waterColor

props.name: lightColor

props.name: inkColor

props.name: dispersion

props.name: speed

props.name: interactive

usageNotes: Keyboard: the pool is a focusable group with a hint; the arrow keys move a fingertip (a faint ring on the surface) that stirs the water, Enter or Space drops a pebble. The paragraph itself is real text for screen readers, selection and copy.
Reduced motion: a still pool — one frame of light nets at a fixed moment, no loop and no ripples.

Performance: one requestAnimationFrame loop, only on screen in a visible tab and not paused, drawing every other frame while the water is calm; the device pixel ratio is capped at `dpr` and the backing store follows a ResizeObserver.

Robust: a lost WebGL context shows the designed CSS pool until it is restored, and without WebGL2 that pool — the floor through the water with soft pools of light — is what shows. It is also the server's first frame.

The water is pigment, not theme: it reads the same on light and dark pages. Pass `waterColor`, `lightColor` or `inkColor` (any CSS colour, tokens included) to make it yours; they are re-read when the theme changes.

items.title: Armillary Words
items.tagline: Lines of text engraved on turning brass rings.
items.description: An armillary sphere of thin metal bands drawn on a canvas with its own perspective, each band engraved round its outer face with one line and graduated in degrees on the rest, every segment of every band depth-sorted with the globe and polar rod so the rings cross properly. A drag spins the sphere 1:1 and a throw coasts down by its friction to a slow idle turn; tapping a ring, or picking or tabbing to its plate, swings it to face you — its orientation slerps on the springs.snap constants with one crisp overshoot to level, line centred toward you, a little forward — while the other rings slow on the springs.drift constants and dim. The sphere is a slider that Left and Right throw, and the plates are a toolbar of toggle buttons named by their lines; Escape lets the ring go.

props.name: tilt

props.name: spin

props.name: friction

props.name: view

props.name: caps
props.description: Engrave the lines in capitals.

props.name: graduations

props.name: label

props.name: className

usageNotes: Keyboard: the sphere is a slider in the tab order — Left and Right throw it a step, Page Up and Page Down a quarter turn, Home back to the start. The ring plates beneath are a toolbar (one tab stop, arrows move): tabbing to a plate turns its ring to face you, Enter or Space toggles it, Escape lets it go. Each plate is named by its full line, so screen readers hear every line.
Reduced motion: no idle turn, no coasting and no swing. A drag still turns the sphere 1:1 under the hand and stops on release; a chosen ring faces you at once and the others dim.

Performance: the canvas loop runs only on screen in a visible tab and only while something moves — the idle turn, a throw, a swing; with `spin={0}` or `paused` it draws once and stops. Every buffer is allocated once; the device pixel ratio is capped at `dpr`.

The metals are pigments, so the sphere reads the same on light and dark pages. Keep lines to about thirty characters: each is fitted to the front 150° of its band, and a longer line is engraved smaller.
The server renders the ring outlines as a still, replaced by the canvas once it has drawn its first frame.

items.title: Blade Type
items.tagline: Slice the headline and watch it mend.
items.description: A headline cut from stiff card that a drag cuts like a blade: a bright streak follows the pointer and every letter it passes through splits exactly along the line where the blade entered and left it, the upper piece sliding down the cut on springs.glide with the blade's speed, then dropping and tipping a little on springs.recoil while the staying piece flinches on springs.flick. After the heal delay the pieces draw back together on springs.snap, one crisp overshoot as they meet, and the seam flashes and cools to a faint mark that fades away. Enter or Space makes one diagonal cut across the whole headline, a tap nicks the letter under it, and a silent diagonal cut on arrival shows what it does.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the headline is in the tab order with a hint; Enter or Space makes one diagonal cut across it. Screen readers get the headline once, from a hidden copy.

Touch: horizontal slashes cut and vertical swipes scroll the page (touch-action: pan-y); a tap nicks the letter under it. While interactive the headline is not selectable, because a drag is the blade.
Reduced motion: nothing comes apart or moves. A cut draws its seam across the letters it crosses, which cools to the faint mark after the heal delay and fades away.
No loop: every piece is a finite spring or tween on its own motion values, with clip polygons set once per cut; letter boxes are measured once per stroke.
The card edge is a stacked text shadow in `edgeColor`; the default mixes the ink toward the page, so the edge reads on light and dark themes. The seam's gold is a pigment taken from the warn token.

items.title: Crest Reader
items.tagline: A sea of lines, the one on the crest in focus.
items.description: A list read off the sea: the rows lie on a gently rolling surface in perspective, the current line riding the crest of a swell — lifted, standing up to face you, full size and sharp — while the lines to come lie ahead on the water, smaller, lying back and softer toward a hazy horizon, and the line just read sinks into the trough below, with a slow swell always passing through. The crest is one continuous value that the wheel and a drag move 1:1; a release projects the throw and settles on a line on springs.glide with its velocity, a tap carries a row to the crest and the arrow keys glide from line to line. It is a listbox whose active option is the crest line, and the wheel hands the scroll back to the page at either end.

props.name: crestAt

props.name: speed

props.name: height
props.description: The stage's height, px.

usageNotes: Keyboard: a listbox in the tab order whose active option is the crest line — Up and Down (or Left and Right) move a line, Page Up and Page Down three, Home and End to the ends. Every row is a real option, so screen readers can read the whole list.

Pointer: the wheel and a vertical drag move the crest 1:1 and a throw settles on the line it was heading for; a tap carries that row to the crest. At the first and last line the wheel scrolls the page again. Touch uses touch-action: pan-x, so a vertical drag moves the sea.
Reduced motion: no swell and no glide. The crest jumps to the new line and the rows' ink, blur and fade cross-fade into place.

Performance: one requestAnimationFrame loop runs while the swell is on screen in a visible tab or the crest is moving; with `paused` or `speed={0}` it stops when the crest settles. Row heights are measured, so wrapped lines take their room; blur is quantised to quarter pixels.
The server draws only the crest line; once the rows are measured the rest of the sea rises in around it. Colours are the foreground and ink tokens, so both themes read.

items.title: Bunting Line
items.tagline: Your headline strung across as bunting.
items.description: A headline strung across the frame as bunting: each letter printed on a cloth flag sewn along a string that sags between two pegs, the string a real one — forty-eight nodes under the damped wave equation, fixed at the pegs — and every flag riding its slope on its own pair of damped oscillators for sway and swing, driven by the string's jolts and a breeze whose gusts run along the line so the flags flutter in turn. Pressing near the string and pulling bends it 1:1 under the pointer; letting go splits the kink into two waves that run out to both pegs and back. A tap plucks it with a flick, the mouse brushing across strums it, and Space or Enter plucks at a marker that Left and Right move from flag to flag.

props.name: stringColor

props.name: ring

usageNotes: Keyboard: the headline is in the tab order with a hint; Space or Enter plucks the string at a small marker that shows while focused, and Left, Right, Home and End move it from flag to flag. Screen readers get the headline once, from a hidden copy.

Pointer: press near the string (or a flag) and pull to bend it, release to pluck; a tap flicks it and the mouse brushing across strums it. Touch keeps vertical page scrolling (touch-action: pan-y), so a tap is its pluck.
Reduced motion: no breeze and no waves — the flags hang still with a slight lean, and a pluck runs a wave of light along the flags instead of motion.

Performance: one requestAnimationFrame loop while the breeze blows on screen in a visible tab, or while the string and flags still move; with `wind={0}` or `paused` it stops as soon as everything is at rest. Nodes live in typed arrays and attributes are written straight to the SVG.

The drawing is a fixed 1000-unit design space scaled to the element's width, so the server's frame is exact at any size; flags shrink as letters are added, so keep a single string to about a dozen letters, or break it with \n.

items.title: Optical Mix
items.tagline: Letters painted in dots that blend at a distance.

Hovering opens a soft lens whose fisheye pushes the dabs apart and swells them, each pigment opening on the glide spring 45 ms after the last like light through a prism and closing on the slower drift spring, while idle dabs breathe and the line is painted on left to right on the snap spring. Keyboard focus sweeps the lens along the line; Left and Right move it word to word, Home and End jump, Enter sweeps again and Escape closes it.

props.name: spread

props.name: twinkle
