At most eight DOM tags moved by transform alone, written once a frame while anything still moves; the loop stops when the string settles, off screen and on a hidden tab.

items.title: Board Tiles
items.tagline: Letter tiles laid down behind your cursor.
items.description: A board where the cursor's path spells a sentence in wooden letter tiles: as it travels, a tile drops into each grid cell it leaves (or, with grid off, one tile-pitch along the path itself, turned a little with it), falling from just above at a larger scale while its shadow tightens, and landing on a spring whose damping comes from bounce, from a dead set-down through the recoil spring's two bounces, with a wooden clack. Spaces leave gaps and the sentence repeats; after its life each tile flips face down on springs.snap and fades. A resting word holds the board until the first tile flips it away, and it drops back in on a cascade once your tiles are gone; the keyboard walks a caret across the cells laying a tile in each one it leaves, and Delete clears the board.

props.name: sentence
props.description: The sentence the path spells, letter by letter; a space leaves an empty cell.

props.name: tileSize
props.description: Each tile's side, px.

props.name: bounce
props.description: How much a tile bounces as it lands, 0 (sets down dead) to 1 (lively).

props.name: grid
props.description: Snap tiles to a grid of cells; off, they are laid along the path itself, turned with it.

props.name: gap
props.description: The space between cells, px.

props.name: life
props.description: How long a tile shows its letter before it flips face down, ms.

props.name: maxTiles
props.description: The most tiles on the board; past it the oldest flips early.

props.name: tone
props.description: The wood.

props.name: uppercase
props.description: Show the letters in capitals.

props.name: restText
props.description: The word laid out at rest, before anyone moves; an empty string leaves the board empty.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer and touch lay tiles.

props.name: clearKey
props.description: Any change flips every tile on the board face down and clears it.

props.name: label
props.description: The board's accessible name.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a wooden clack as each tile lands. Off unless asked for.

props.name: onTile
props.description: A tile was laid, with its letter and how many so far.

props.name: onSentence
props.description: The whole sentence was spelled, with how many times so far.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Nothing is laid and the keyboard's way in is off.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the board.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the board is one tab stop with a dashed caret cell. Arrow keys walk the caret and lay the next tile in the cell it leaves, Enter or Space lays one where it stands and steps right, Delete or Backspace clears the board; each completed sentence is announced once, never each tile.
The tiles are aria-hidden; the sentence itself is in the board once as screen-reader text. Letters are split by grapheme, so accented letters and symbols stay whole on one tile.
Touch: drag across the board to lay tiles; the board is touch-action none so the drag lays tiles rather than scrolling.
The clack plays only with sound on and only after the page has had a press or a key; moving a mouse over the board alone never starts audio.
Under reduced motion tiles appear in place with a short fade and leave by fading, with no fall, bounce or flip; the resting word stays still.

Tiles are DOM elements animated by transform and opacity alone, at most maxTiles at once; nothing runs at rest. Wood tones are fixed lightnesses of the theme's hues so the set looks the same on light and dark boards.

items.title: Serpentine Pop
items.tagline: Paper streamers that uncurl from your cursor.
items.description: Paper streamers for any box: a moving pointer throws tight coils of coloured paper off the cursor, each popping out on the springs.recoil constants and flying on its throw while the strip pays out behind it, so the roll visibly unwinds in the air before the free paper flutters down, springing into ringlets from its curl memory and turning over to show its paler back. A click or tap fires a popper — a ring flashes, a dozen coils leave in an upward cone with a puff of tumbling flecks — and everything settles along the bottom edge in fixed 120 Hz Verlet physics. The box is one tab stop: Enter or Space fires a popper from an aim point on the bottom edge, and Left and Right move the aim.

props.name: children
props.description: The content the paper falls over (or behind, with layer="back"). It stays fully interactive.

props.name: palette
props.description: The paper's colours: pigments at a fixed lightness, so a streamer looks the same on any page; mono follows the ink tokens.

props.name: colors
props.description: Your own paper colours, any CSS colours (tokens included); replaces palette.

props.name: rate
props.description: How many streamers a moving pointer throws, at most, per second (1 to 12).

props.name: curl
props.description: How tightly the paper remembers its roll, 0 (straight ribbons) to 1 (tight ringlets).

props.name: stripWidth
props.description: Width of the paper strip, px.

props.name: streamerLength
props.description: Length of one streamer unrolled, px.

props.name: burst
props.description: Streamers a popper fires.

props.name: flecks
props.description: Paper flecks a popper puffs out with them.

props.name: gravity
props.description: How fast paper falls, 0.5 (floating) to 2 (heavy).

props.name: linger
props.description: Seconds settled paper lies on the floor before it fades; 0 keeps it until maxPaper is reached. The resting garland never lingers out.

props.name: maxPaper
props.description: Most streamers lying on the floor at once; past it the oldest fade.

props.name: scatter
props.description: Curled streamers already lying along the bottom edge at rest (fewer on a narrow box).

props.name: layer
props.description: Draw the paper in front of the content or behind it.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the paper where it is and stop throwing.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the colours, curls and launch of every streamer.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: label
props.description: The popper's accessible name.

props.name: onPop
props.description: Fires on every popper, with how many have been fired so far.

props.name: sound
props.description: A pop and a paper crinkle when a popper fires (never on hover).

props.name: disabled
props.description: No streamers, no poppers; the box is plain content and leaves the tab order.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes and shapes the box; it clips the paper (rounded corners included).

usageNotes: The box is one tab stop (a group with an aim hint): Enter or Space fires a popper from the aim point on the bottom edge, Left and Right move the aim by a tenth of the width (Shift a quarter), Home and End jump to the edges. Keys pressed on a child are left to the child. A polite live region says each popper once.

The paper is a canvas with pointer-events: none, so buttons and links inside keep their clicks; a tap or click anywhere inside fires a popper except on form fields. Touch only taps (touch-action: manipulation), so the page still scrolls through the box.

Idle cost is zero: the loop runs only while paper is in the air, flashing or fading, on screen and with the tab visible; settled paper is painted once into a floor layer. Physics steps at a fixed 120 Hz with no per-frame allocation, live streamers are capped at 70, and the canvas caps its pixel ratio at 2.
Under reduced motion nothing flies: the resting garland lies along the floor, and a popper sets its streamers and flecks down in place with a 200 ms fade, so the press still answers.

Colours are read from a carrier on the component's own element and re-read when the theme changes; the default palettes are pigments at a fixed lightness, so they look the same on a light or a dark page.

items.title: Flipbook Path
items.tagline: Leave frames behind, then sweep back to play them.
items.description: A surface that turns the pointer's path into a flipbook: moving over open space lays the next page of a drawn sequence every few pixels — a paper card with a binding edge and its frame number — set down on springs.snap and leaning into the direction it was laid in, so the path becomes a fanned deck. Sweep back over the trail and the page under the pointer lifts on springs.flick with its neighbours rising a little, so the drawing plays in order under the pointer at the speed of the sweep, forward or backward; left alone, the trail clears from its oldest page. The surface is one tab stop: the arrow keys move a pen that lays and plays exactly as the pointer does, and Backspace clears the trail.

props.name: frames
props.description: Pages in one cycle of the drawing (4 to 24); laid pages loop through it.

props.name: sequence
props.description: The built-in drawing: a ball with squash and stretch, a gull's wingbeat, a flower opening and closing, a moon passing in front of and behind its planet.

props.name: renderFrame
props.type: (ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, progress: number, size: number) => void
props.description: Your own drawing for each page, into a square `size` CSS px wide at the origin; progress runs 0 to 1 across the cycle. Replaces sequence; pages are redrawn when the function's identity changes.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Travel between two laid pages, px (12 to 96).

props.name: frameSize
props.description: Width of a page, px (24 to 96); pages are 4:5 landscape.

props.name: fade
props.description: Seconds a trail left alone takes to clear, oldest page first.

props.name: hold
props.description: Milliseconds a trail waits, left alone, before it starts to clear.

props.name: lift
props.description: How far the page under the pointer rises, as a scale (1 to 2).

props.name: tilt
props.description: How far pages lean into the direction they were laid in, 0 to 1.

props.name: maxFrames
props.description: Most pages on the surface; past it the oldest fades.

props.name: resting
props.description: Lay an S-curve of pages at rest (played once by an unseen hand on first view), and lay it again whenever the trail has cleared and the pointer has left.

props.name: paper
props.description: Page colour, any CSS colour.

props.name: ink
props.description: Drawing colour.

props.name: accent
props.description: The drawings' one fill colour, and the lifted page's edge.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freeze the pages where they are; nothing lays, lifts or fades.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the pages' hand-laid jitter and the resting curve.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The surface ignores the pointer and the keys, leaves the tab order and lets touch scroll.

props.name: label
props.description: The surface's accessible name.

props.name: onFrame
props.description: Fires when the page under the pointer (or the keyboard's pen) changes, with its frame (1-based) and the cycle length.

props.name: onTrail
props.description: Fires when the number of pages on the surface changes; resting is true when the component laid them itself.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes and shapes the surface; pages stay inside it.

usageNotes: One tab stop (a group with a hint): the arrow keys move a pen by the spacing (Shift for three), which lays pages over open space and plays them over the trail, as the pointer does; Backspace or Delete clears the trail. A polite live region reads the frame under the keyboard's pen.
Touch: drag to lay and to play. The surface is touch-action: none while enabled (it is a drawing surface), so give it a fixed height in a scrolling page; disabled gives scrolling back.

Pages are rendered once into sprites per size, pixel ratio, colours and drawing; each page then costs two drawImage calls. The loop runs only while a page lands, lifts or fades, and stops on its own; off screen or in a hidden tab nothing runs.

Under reduced motion pages appear with a 120 ms fade instead of a landing spring, the page under the pointer is raised at once without neighbours, and the resting trail is simply there — no unseen hand.
Colours resolve from the component's own element (paper, ink and accent default to tokens) and re-read when the theme changes; pass renderFrame to draw your own sequence.

items.title: Gel Cling
items.tagline: A jelly window cling that stretches as it lifts.
items.description: A thick gel window cling on any surface, drawn as a 72-node soft body: press it and it squishes away from the finger and rings back; grab it and peel, and the part in your fingers comes away 1:1 while the rest clings, the peel front running across it as the pull grows and strings of tack stretching between the glass and the lifted gel until each snaps into a bead. Pull far enough and it lets go — the last strings snap in a run — and hangs from your finger, its far side catching up on its springs; let go and it falls on springs.snap, spreads as it meets the surface and pulls back with two small bounces, and clings. The decal is a real button: Enter peels it from the edge with the most room, the arrow keys carry it on springs.snap, Enter or Space sticks it down and Escape puts it back.

props.name: children
props.description: The surface the decal clings to (a window, a card, a photo), drawn under the gel.

props.name: shape
props.description: The decal's outline.

props.name: size
props.description: The decal's width, px; held to 60% of the box's smaller side.

props.name: thickness
props.description: How thick the gel is, 0 to 1: a deeper rim and side wall, a longer shadow, a softer, slower wobble.

props.name: tack
props.description: How hard it clings, 0 to 1: how far you pull before it lets go, and how many strings of tack hold on and how long they stretch.

props.name: tint
props.description: The gel's colour: a named pigment (the same in both themes) or any CSS colour.

props.name: gloss
props.description: Strength of the glossy highlight, 0 to 1.

props.name: wobble
props.description: How long the gel jiggles after a press or a landing, 0 (dead) to 1 (ringing).

props.name: position / defaultPosition
props.description: Where the decal's centre sits, as [x, y] fractions of the box. A controlled change lifts it, glides it there and lays it down; a refused move glides it back.

props.name: onPositionChange
props.description: Fires when the decal is stuck down somewhere new, with its centre as fractions (3 dp).

props.name: onPeel
props.description: Fires while a corner is peeled, with how far it is toward letting go, 0 to 1 in steps of 0.05.

props.name: onLift
props.description: Fires when the decal lets go of the surface.

props.name: onStick
props.description: Fires when it lands and clings again, with where.

props.name: label
props.description: The decal's accessible name.

props.name: sound
props.description: A gloop when it lets go and when it lands, a plip as each string of tack snaps, a blup when squished.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The decal stays stuck: no press, peel or keys.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes and shapes the surface; the decal never leaves it.

usageNotes: The decal is a real button (aria-roledescription "gel decal", aria-pressed while lifted): Enter peels it, the arrow keys move it 8 px (Shift 32 px), Enter or Space sticks it down, Escape puts it back where it was (and prevents the stage's own Escape), Space on a stuck decal squishes it. A polite live region says when it is lifted and where it sticks.
Only the decal is touch-action: none; the rest of the surface scrolls normally. The drag captures the pointer after 3 px, so a press is a squish and a drag is a peel.

Idle cost is zero: a stuck decal is one still frame. The loop (fixed 120 Hz node springs, no per-frame allocation) runs only while a node, the lift, a string or a bead is moving, on screen and with the tab visible.

Under reduced motion the gel moves without ringing: a press shows the squash and returns, a peel still follows the finger, strings fade instead of whipping back, and lift and landing are short fades with no splat.
The tint resolves on the component's own element and re-reads on theme change; named tints are pigments at a fixed lightness, so a cherry star is the same red on a light or a dark page.

items.title: Mica Drift
items.tagline: Flakes that flash as they catch the light.
items.description: Fine mica flakes suspended in a dark liquid, as a background with your content above: each flake is a thin plate that sinks slowly, drifts on a seeded current and rocks as it falls, lined up with the liquid's flow so neighbours face nearly the same way, and every frame its normal is checked against the half vector between the light and the eye — a broad sheen brightens a whole band of flakes and a tight lobe makes single faces flash with a four-point flare. The light rests far off at lightAngle; bring the pointer in and it comes close on the springs.drift constants, so the angle each flake needs changes across the field and a wave of glints follows the hand, and a click stirs a swirl that the liquid's viscosity takes back. The keyboard handle turns the light with the arrow keys and stirs with Enter or Space.

props.name: children
props.description: Content above the liquid, in a readable layer; it keeps its own focus and clicks.

props.name: flakeCount
props.description: Flakes in a 760 × 232 box; scaled by the box's area and held between 120 and 2400.

props.name: lightAngle
props.description: Where the light comes from when the pointer is away, degrees: 0 from the right, 90 from above. The keyboard turns it from here.

props.name: viscosity
props.description: How thick the liquid is, 0 to 1: thin and lively to slow, heavy settling; it also sets how fast a stir dies and how quickly flakes line up again.

props.name: flakeSize
props.description: Flake size, 0.5 to 2.

props.name: shimmer
props.description: How bright a flake flashes, 0 to 1.

props.name: glintColor
props.description: The flash's colour, any CSS colour.

props.name: flakeColor
props.description: The flakes' own dim colour (a pigment, the same in both themes).

props.name: liquid
props.description: The liquid: fixed art, dark in both themes. Also the box's CSS background, so the server-rendered frame is already the liquid.

props.name: depth
props.description: How much depth the field has, 0 (flat) to 1: far flakes smaller, fainter and slower.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer carries the light, a click stirs, and the keyboard handle is present.

props.name: stir
props.description: Strength of a click's swirl, 0 to 2.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold every flake where it is; the loop stops.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds every flake.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: label
props.description: Name of the keyboard handle that turns the light.

props.name: onLightAngleChange
props.description: Fires when the keyboard turns the light, with its new angle in degrees.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes and shapes the box; the liquid fills it edge to edge.

usageNotes: The painted layer is aria-hidden. A full-size button sits beneath the content as the keyboard's handle: Left/Up and Right/Down turn the light by 15° (Shift 45°), Enter or Space stirs at the centre, and a polite live region says the new angle. Clicks on links and buttons in the content never stir.

The loop runs only while the box is on screen and the tab is visible (or not at all when paused): flakes live in typed arrays, bodies are filled in five brightness batches, and only flakes with a visible flash get a pre-drawn sprite. Nothing is allocated per frame; the canvas caps its pixel ratio at 2.
Under reduced motion the flakes hold still and nothing swirls; the light still follows the pointer and the arrow keys, and each move relights the still field once.

The liquid is dark in both themes by design, so put light text on it (text-primary-foreground reads in both); flake and flash colours resolve on the component's own element and re-read on theme change.

items.title: Bow Ribbon
items.tagline: A message on a ribbon that ties itself in a bow.
items.description: A message printed on a satin ribbon that comes in from the left edge and ties itself into a bow: the ribbon slides along its own path like a strip pulled off a spool, twisting as it comes — its width is w·cos θ, the plain back shows where it turns over, and a sheen band runs along the satin as the turn meets the light — while a soft wave rolls along it and dies away. When the message has passed, the head of the ribbon runs on round the bow's track at the knot, so the end loops up into a right loop, a left loop and a tail; the knot wraps on with springs.flick, a second tail drops in, and the bow lands with a small bounce on springs.recoil. Everything is SVG in em units, so it sizes with the type and the server renders the tied still frame.

props.name: text
props.description: The message printed on the ribbon; graphemes are kept whole.

props.name: as
props.description: The element the message renders as.

props.name: ribbonWidth
props.description: The ribbon's width, in em of the type: 1.2 is snug, 2.4 generous.

props.name: sheen
props.description: How strongly the satin catches the light as it turns, 0 (matte) to 1.

props.name: bowSize
props.description: The bow's size relative to the ribbon, 0.6 to 1.6; the box grows to hold it.

props.name: color
props.description: The satin's colour, any CSS colour; the default is a pigment that looks the same in both themes.

props.name: textColor
props.description: The printed message's colour.

props.name: twists
props.description: Full turns the ribbon makes as it comes in, 0 to 3.

props.name: trigger
props.description: When the ribbon runs: on mount, when first on screen, on hover or keyboard focus, or only when replayKey changes.

props.name: once
props.description: Run once, or again each time it returns to view (inView) or is hovered.

props.name: delay
props.description: Wait before it starts, ms.

props.name: duration
props.description: How long the ribbon takes to come in and tie, ms (900 to 6000); the bow's landing adds about half a second.

props.name: replayKey
props.description: Change it to run the ribbon again.

props.name: onStart
props.description: Fires when a run begins.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Fires when the bow has settled (at once under reduced motion).

props.name: className
props.description: Sets the type size (the ribbon, bow and box are sized in em) and places it.

usageNotes: The message is read once, from an sr-only copy inside the heading; the drawn ribbon is aria-hidden. With trigger="hover" the heading is focusable and a keyboard focus replays it too; otherwise there is nothing to operate.
The box reserves its final height in em from the first render, so nothing below moves while it plays; size the type so the band holds the message (the demo uses a container-relative clamp).

One requestAnimationFrame loop runs only during a run (about the duration plus half a second); it pauses off screen or in a hidden tab and resumes where it stopped. At rest nothing runs: the still frame is plain HTML and SVG.
Under reduced motion the tied ribbon is shown still — no slide, no twist, no bounce — and onComplete fires at once.
Colours are CSS strings applied as styles, so tokens and the theme work directly; the defaults are pigments at a fixed lightness.

items.title: Branch Draft
items.tagline: A headline weighing its next words out loud.
items.description: A headline that writes itself out loud: at each pause the candidate continuations fan down from the caret like cards hinged there, each opening on springs.snap a cascade apart, faint, with a small weight beside it. The weights flicker while it thinks, then converge — the strongest gains real typographic weight and full ink on springs.glide while the others thin, fade and drop away — and the chosen words swing up into the line and set in solid ink at their real place in the flow, so they wrap like text, before the caret moves on. With interactive, the arrow keys or the pointer pick a ghost, which gains the weight, and Tab, Enter or a click accepts it.

props.name: steps
props.type: { text: string; alternates?: string[]; weights?: number[] }[]
props.description: The headline: an opening, then each pause's chosen words and the alternates it weighs (weights seeded when left out, with text the strongest).

props.name: as
props.description: The element the headline renders as.

props.name: candidates
props.description: How many continuations fan out at each pause, the chosen one included (2 to 5).

props.name: pace
props.description: Speed of the whole draft, 0.5 (deliberate) to 2 (brisk).

props.name: ghostOpacity
props.description: How faint a ghost continuation is before it is chosen, 0 to 1.

props.name: ghostColor
props.description: The ghosts' colour, any CSS colour.

props.name: showWeights
props.description: Show each ghost's weight beside it, flickering while it weighs.

props.name: fan
props.description: Degrees each ghost turns more than the one above it.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Let the visitor choose: arrows or the pointer pick, Tab, Enter or a click accepts; a pick left alone is taken after a moment.

props.name: loop
props.description: Write the headline again after hold; only while it is on screen.

props.name: hold
props.description: How long the finished headline holds before it is written again, ms.

props.name: trigger
props.description: When writing starts: on mount, when first on screen, or only when replayKey changes.

props.name: delay
props.description: Wait before writing starts, ms.

props.name: replayKey
props.description: Change it to write the headline again from the start.

props.name: onStep
props.description: Fires as each pause settles, with the step's index and the words chosen.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Fires when the headline is written, with its full text.

props.name: className
props.description: Sets the type (size, weight) and places the headline; the ghosts and the committed words inherit it.

usageNotes: The headline is read once, from an sr-only copy of the finished words; the animated words, the ghosts and the caret are aria-hidden. With interactive, the box is one tab stop (a group with a hint): Up/Down or Left/Right choose the next words, Tab or Enter accepts them (Tab is taken only while words are on offer), and a polite live region reads the options when the fan opens and each choice.
The final box is reserved from the first render by an invisible copy of the longest possible headline, plus room below the last line for the fan, so nothing below it moves while it writes.
Ghost weight is real typographic weight: with a variable font (the default sans is one) it grows smoothly; with static weights it steps.
Only timers and short motion tweens and springs run while it writes; a finished headline that does not loop is idle, and a looping one waits off screen or in a hidden tab before it writes again.
Under reduced motion the ghosts appear stacked under the caret with a fade and do not swing; the weighing, the choice and the words still show, by opacity and weight.

items.title: Melt Swap
items.tagline: One word melts and pours into the next.
items.description: A rotating word that swaps by melting: letters the next word does not share sag to the baseline and soften into glossy beads, the beads slide along the baseline and pool where the new letters stand, and the new letters rise out of the pools and firm up with a slight wobble, while letters the two words share keep their substance and glide across on the glide spring. The liquid is one SVG goo filter lit by `gloss`, its springs drawn from glide and recoil and thickened by `viscosity`, in a box reserved to the widest word so the line never shifts. It swaps on a timer, on hover or focus, or when a host sets `value`.

props.name: words
props.description: The words it swaps between, in order.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The index of the word shown; a new value pours into that word.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires as a swap begins — from the timer, a hover or a host — with the new index.

props.name: interval
props.description: Rest between automatic swaps in ms, before pace; 0 swaps only on hover or a new value.

props.name: viscosity
props.description: How thick the liquid is, 0 to 1: runny beads race and wobble, thick ones crawl and firm up composed.

props.name: gloss
props.description: How wet the molten letters look: matte to a bright highlight with shaded edges.

props.name: pace
props.description: Speed of the whole pour, 0.25 to 2; the rest between swaps scales with it.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay between letters starting to soften, in ms, from the middle of the change outward.

props.name: delay
props.description: Wait before the first swap once triggered, in ms.

props.name: trigger
props.description: What starts the swaps: on mount, in view, one per hover or focus, or only a new value.

props.name: once
props.description: Stop at the last word instead of wrapping round.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the current word; a swap under way finishes.

props.name: align
props.description: Where each word sits in the box reserved for the widest.

props.name: liquidColor
props.description: The molten letters' colour; they cool to the text colour as they firm.

props.name: announce
props.description: Announce each settled word politely to screen readers.

props.name: as
props.description: The element to render.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Fires when a swap has settled, with the index now shown.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the word's box; font size and colour inherit.

usageNotes: The word is real text at rest and its sr-only copy is the only one assistive tech reads; every animated letter is aria-hidden. Set `announce` when the swaps carry meaning a listener should hear.
Size and colour inherit (blur, beads and lean are in em), so the same component works from a caption to a hero; the box is reserved to the widest word, so the surrounding line never moves.

Nothing runs between swaps: the goo filter is applied only while a swap pours, the timer waits while the word is off screen or the page hidden, and one rAF loop runs per swap and stops when every letter rests.
Under reduced motion the words cross-fade in place; the timer, `onValueChange` and `onComplete` still run.
Letters two words share are matched in order first, so pairs like melted → tempered keep most of their letters and only the difference melts.

items.title: Avatar Jar
items.tagline: Faces poured into a jar you can tilt.
items.description: A glass jar of avatar pebbles that are real rigid discs: they pour in through the neck one by one, tumble, roll on each other and settle under gravity with a rattle. Drag the jar sideways and it turns 1:1 under the finger, rubber-banded past `tilt`, the turning frame sloshing the heap against the low side; on release the throw is projected and the jar glides to rest with the release velocity. Clicking a pebble lifts it out on the snap spring, upright and enlarged with its name card settling beside it on flick, and the heap closes the gap; clicking again drops it back through the mouth on glide to find a gap. Up and Down move between pebbles, Left and Right tilt, Enter lifts or drops, Escape drops.

props.name: items
props.description: What is in the jar: { id, name, role?, src?, color? }. More than fit are counted on the lid.

props.name: angle / defaultAngle
props.description: The jar's tilt in degrees; negative leans left.

props.name: onAngleChange
props.description: Fires when a drag or a key leaves the jar at a new tilt, with the angle it will rest at.

props.name: lifted / defaultLifted
props.description: The id of the pebble lifted out of the jar.

props.name: onLiftedChange
props.description: Fires when a pebble is lifted out (its id) or dropped back (null).

props.name: tilt
props.description: How far the jar can tip either way, in degrees.

props.name: pebbleSize
props.description: A pebble's diameter in jar units (the jar is 200 wide inside).

props.name: glass
props.description: The glass's tint.

props.name: gravity
props.description: Gravity as a multiple of the house's.

props.name: bounce
props.description: How much a pebble bounces off glass and other pebbles, 0 to 0.8.

props.name: pour
props.description: When the pebbles pour in; with none they start in a heap.

props.name: repourKey
props.description: Change it to pour every pebble in again from the top.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the jar for assistive technology.

props.name: sound
props.description: Clack when pebbles the visitor moved hit the glass and each other.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds where pebbles start and how each portrait is drawn.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freeze the pebbles where they are.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the jar but takes no input.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the jar's box; give it a height.

usageNotes: The pebbles are one roving tab stop: Up and Down move between them, Home and End jump, Left and Right tilt the jar 5° (Shift 15°), 0 rights it, Enter or Space lifts or drops the focused pebble, and Escape drops a lifted one. Lifts, drops and tilts are announced.

The simulation runs only while something moves: it sleeps once the heap has been still for 0.4 s, wakes on input, and never runs off screen or in a hidden tab. Positions are written straight to transforms, never through React state.
Under reduced motion nothing tumbles or pours: a tilt, a lift or a drop re-solves the heap at once and the result is shown still.
Sound answers only the visitor's own commotion — impacts within 1.5 s of their drag, key, lift or drop — and only after the page has had a click or key press.
Items without `src` get a drawn portrait seeded from their id; pass `src` for photos. The jar scales to fit its box, leaving room above the mouth for a lifted pebble and its card.

items.title: Field Loupe
items.tagline: Magnify a photo and find its notes.
items.description: A photo inspected with a jeweller's loupe: a circle of it magnified `power` times inside a hairline brass rim follows the pointer on the flick spring, and annotated points are magnetic — come close and the loupe settles onto the note on the glide spring and holds until you pull clearly away, while a leader line draws out from the rim and a note card rises in beside it on flick. The wheel or a trackpad pinch (two fingers on the lens on touch) changes the magnification and hands the scroll back to the page at either end. Every note is a button, so Tab walks the loupe from note to note, + and - change the power and Escape closes the card.

props.name: notes
props.description: The annotated points: { id, x, y (fractions of the photo), title, body, tag? }.

props.name: src
props.description: An image to inspect instead of the drawn workbench.

props.name: alt
props.description: What the photo shows, for assistive technology.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: The photo's width divided by its height.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The id of the open note.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires when a note opens or closes.

props.name: power
props.description: Magnification at rest; the wheel, a pinch or + and - change it from there.

props.name: minPower
props.description: The least the wheel or a pinch can magnify.

props.name: maxPower
props.description: The most the wheel or a pinch can magnify.

props.name: onPowerChange
props.description: Fires when the wheel, a pinch or a key changes the magnification.

props.name: lensSize
props.description: The lens diameter in px, capped to fit small photos.

props.name: snap
props.description: How strongly notes pull the loupe, 0 (free) to 1 (a firm magnetic detent).

props.name: wheelZoom
props.description: Let the wheel and a trackpad pinch change magnification over the photo.

props.name: markers
props.description: Draw the hairline rings that mark each note.

props.name: rimColor
props.description: The rim and leader line, any CSS colour.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the photo with its notes for assistive technology.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the photo without the loupe's input.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the component; the photo keeps its aspect ratio at this width.

usageNotes: Notes are real buttons in tab order, named "Note 2 of 5: …" and described by their card; focusing one moves the loupe there. + and - change the power, Escape closes the open card, and each change is announced politely.
The drawn workbench is vector art, so magnifying it finds real detail; with `src` a raster shows its own pixels, so give it resolution to spare.

No loop runs at rest: the lens position and power are motion values and the magnified copy is a transform derived from them. The lens is its own compositing layer, so moving it never repaints the photo underneath.
The wheel only zooms between the limits and returns the scroll to the page at either end; on touch, a tap places the loupe and dragging the lens moves it while the photo still scrolls the page.

On photos under 440 px wide the card sits under the photo, with the leader line dropping to its edge, and its height glides between notes. Under reduced motion the loupe jumps and the line and card appear without drawing or rising.

items.title: Burning Glass
items.tagline: Focus the sun and burn through to the next image.
items.description: A frame of images you burn through with a magnifying glass: inside the frame the cursor is the glass, the picture under the lens a little darker and its light gathered into one bright point. Hold still and the spot browns, smokes and catches, then a hole spreads outward on its own along a ragged, glowing ember edge with a ring of char ahead of it until the next image is on top; move away early and only a scorch is left, fading slowly. Heat lives in a small WebGL2 field the CPU mirrors, so nothing is read back; the frame is a button, arrows move the glass and Enter burns from where it is.

props.name: images
props.description: The images, { src, alt }, in the order they burn through; for WebGL they must be same-origin or CORS.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The index of the image on top.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires when a burn has gone all the way through, with the index now on top.

props.name: focus
props.description: How tightly the glass focuses the sun: a broad warm glow (0) to a hard pin-point that bites fast (1).

props.name: burnRate
props.description: How quickly a held spot catches and how fast the hole spreads, 0.25 to 2.

props.name: scorch
props.description: How dark the browning goes and how long a scorch lingers once you move away.

props.name: lensSize
props.description: The glass's diameter in px; it shrinks to fit short frames.

props.name: smoke
props.description: How much smoke rises from hot spots and burning edges.

props.name: emberColor
props.description: The glow along the burning edge, any CSS colour.

props.name: smokeColor
props.description: The smoke, any CSS colour.

props.name: label
props.description: The frame's accessible name.

props.name: onStageChange
props.description: Fires as the held spot warms, browns, smokes and catches, and when it settles again.

props.name: sound
props.description: Sizzle while the spot heats and burns, with a flare when it catches.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold everything where it is.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the image but takes no input.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the frame; give it a height.

usageNotes: The frame is a real button described by the current image's alt: Enter or Space burns from where the glass is (the centre by default), arrow keys move the glass (Shift for larger steps), and each burn-through announces the new image. The system cursor is hidden only inside the frame while a pointer is there.

One WebGL2 context: the heat field runs at no more than 256 px wide (half-float when available) on a fixed 60 Hz step, and the loop runs only while the glass is over the frame, a hole is burning or a scorch is fading; it stops off screen and in hidden tabs. DPR is capped at 2 and context loss is handled.

Without WebGL2 (or with a cross-origin image that cannot become a texture) the image is shown as a still and Enter cross-fades to the next. Under reduced motion there is no smoke or spreading flame: the spot still browns, and on catching the next image cross-fades in.

Sound answers only the visitor and never starts before the page has had a click or key press: hovering alone stays silent, and the sizzle loop always stops when the glass leaves, the burn ends or the tab hides.
The default scenes are drawn in code as SVG, so nothing is fetched; pass your own `images` with alts that describe them.

items.title: Liquify Print
items.tagline: Push the picture around like wet paint.
items.description: A print you push around like wet paint: a drag smears the picture along the stroke through a WebGL2 displacement field, circling winds the paint into a small vortex, and fresh smears shine wet where the paint was worked. When the hand stops, the print relaxes back to itself on a critically damped ease over `relax` ms, as if the paint remembered its shape; smears made with Shift held are pinned in a second field and stay, and double click or Escape restores everything on the snap spring. The print is focusable: arrow keys smear from a brush at its centre, Shift pins, the bracket keys twist, P pins every smear and Escape restores.

props.name: src
props.description: An image to smear instead of the drawn print; for WebGL it must be same-origin or CORS.

props.name: alt
props.description: What the print shows, for assistive technology.

props.name: brush
props.description: The brush's radius in px.

props.name: relax
props.description: How long the paint takes to remember its shape once you stop, in ms.

props.name: gloss
props.description: How wet a fresh smear looks: dry and matte (0) to a sheen that dries as it relaxes (1).

props.name: strength
props.description: How much paint a stroke carries, 0 to 1.5.

props.name: swirl
props.description: How much a circling stroke winds the paint into a vortex, 0 to 1.

props.name: pinned / defaultPinned
props.description: Pin every smear so none relax.

props.name: onPinnedChange
props.description: Fires when the pin is switched (the P key), with the new state.

props.name: onSmear
props.description: Fires as a stroke starts, with whether it is pinned.

props.name: onRestore
props.description: Fires when the print is restored by a double click, Escape or restoreKey.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Fires as the print goes between rest, smearing, relaxing and holding.

props.name: restoreKey
props.description: Change it to restore the print from outside.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the print for assistive technology.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the print but takes no input.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the print; give it a height.

usageNotes: The print is one focusable group described by its keys: arrows smear 24 px from a brush ring at the centre (Shift pins the smear), [ and ] twist the paint, P toggles pinning everything, and Escape restores — claimed (and prevented) only when something is smeared, so otherwise it still reaches a surrounding dialog. Restores and pin changes are announced.

Two displacement fields — live over pinned — run at a quarter of the canvas, half-float when available; strokes are queued in a fixed buffer and applied once per frame. The loop runs only while smearing, relaxing or restoring and stops once the live field has settled; a pinned smear costs nothing.
The surface takes `touch-action: none`, so a finger smears instead of scrolling; give it a modest height on phones. Holding Shift anywhere while it is mounted pauses relaxation.

Under reduced motion smears still follow the hand, but nothing moves on its own: after `relax` the print cross-fades back, and restore is a cross-fade. Without WebGL2 (or with a cross-origin image) the print is shown as a still.
The default poster is drawn in code as SVG, so nothing is fetched; fine lines and type make the smear easiest to read.

items.title: Lantern Rise
items.tagline: Paper lanterns drifting up into the night.
items.description: A night sky with paper lanterns rising through it and your content above: each is lit from inside, a warm glow through its paper and a halo added to the sky, and climbs from below the frame swaying on its own breeze and leaning into the sway, receding as it rises until it is a pinpoint of light. A click on the sky releases one from that spot — the flame catches, the paper fills out on the snap spring, and it dips and lifts off — and wishes, when given, are written on the paper, legible while a lantern is near. The sky is focusable and Enter releases a lantern; clicks on your own links and buttons never do.

props.name: children
props.description: Content above the sky; it stays fully interactive.

props.name: wishes
props.description: Short wishes written on the paper, readable while a lantern is near; released lanterns carry the next in turn.

props.name: count
props.description: How many lanterns are aloft at once, 0 to 60.

props.name: drift
props.description: The breeze: still air (they rise straight) to a breezy sky (they lean, sail and sway wide).

props.name: warmth
props.description: The colour of the light, pale gold (0) to deep amber (1).

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast they climb, 0.25 to 2.

props.name: size
props.description: A near lantern's height in px, scaled down on small skies.

props.name: stars
props.description: How many stars, 0 to 1.

props.name: skyColor
props.description: The sky, any CSS colour; the top is deepened and the horizon warmed from it.

props.name: interactive
props.description: A click on the sky or Enter releases a lantern.

props.name: onRelease
props.description: Fires when a lantern is released, with the wish it carries.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold every lantern where it is.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds where the lanterns rise and how each one sways.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the sky for assistive technology.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the sky; give it a height.

usageNotes: The canvas is decoration and hidden from assistive tech; the sky itself is one focusable group whose description says Enter releases a lantern, and each release (with its wish) is announced politely. Clicks on links, buttons and other controls in `children` keep their own behaviour.

One Canvas 2D layer: each lantern's paper and wish is drawn once to a sprite and the halo is one shared sprite added with `lighter`, so a frame is a few dozen image draws. Nothing runs off screen or in a hidden tab, and the backing store is capped at the `dpr` you pass.
Lanterns recede at a rate set by the sky's height, so they reach a pinpoint before the top whether the box is a 200 px banner or a full hero.
Under reduced motion the lanterns hang still at seeded heights with a steady glow; a release adds a lantern where you clicked, fading in, and it hangs still too.
The night is drawn from `skyColor` in both themes, so keep content above it light; the server renders a still of the same sky so the first paint is finished.

items.title: Ring Shepherd
items.tagline: Ring dust parted by a moon you steer.
items.description: A close look down onto a planetary ring system in Canvas 2D: bands of fine dust bowed round a planet below the frame, dark gaps and thin ringlets between them, shearing past slowly as rings do seen from a moon's orbit. The pointer is a small moon on springs.snap that pushes every point of dust it passes out of a lane, and because each point then rings about its new orbit at the epicyclic frequency while the shear carries it along, both edges of the lane raise scalloped waves and bright crests that trail opposite ways and smooth out behind it as the lane closes. It is a slider for where the moon is: arrow keys steer it, Escape gives it back its own orbit, and with no pointer it circles the field on its own.

props.name: ringDensity
props.description: How thickly the dust lies in the bands, 0.1 (a sparse scatter) to 1 (dense, opaque rings).

props.name: gapWidth
props.description: Width of the dark gaps between the bands, 0 (bands touching) to 1 (wide divisions).

props.name: wake
props.description: How hard the moon pushes and how long its wake rings, 0 (a light touch that heals at once) to 1 (a wide lane with long scallops).

props.name: bands
props.description: How many bands of dust cross the frame, 3 to 9.

props.name: color
props.description: The dust's colour: pale ice from the warn token's hue. Drawn as light on a dark page and as a darkened ink on a light one.

props.name: moonColor
props.description: The moon's colour, a pigment that reads on both themes; it is lit from the upper left.

props.name: moonSize
props.description: The moon's radius, px, 3 to 14. The lane it clears scales with it.

props.name: shear
props.description: How fast the rings shear past, 0 (held) to 2. The middle of the frame rides with the moon; dust inside and outside it drifts opposite ways.

props.name: curvature
props.description: How far the bands bow, as if the planet sat below the frame, 0 (straight) to 1.

props.name: autopilot
props.description: With no pointer and no keys, the moon circles the field on its own.

props.name: step
props.description: Pixels per arrow key; Shift moves three times as far.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer and keys steer the moon.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No steering by pointer or key; the control leaves the tab order.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the shear and the moon's own orbit; steering still parts the dust.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the band layout and the dust's grain, so two ring systems never match.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the moon's control.

props.name: onBandChange
props.description: The band under the moon (0 is the outermost), or null while it crosses a gap. Fires on change, and once when it first reads.

props.name: onSteerChange
props.description: The visitor took the moon (true) or gave it back to its own orbit (false).

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the box; it fills its parent by default (h-full w-full).

usageNotes: Give the parent a height; a wide, shallow box suits it best. Band layout is in fractions of the height, so every band shows at any size.

Keyboard: it is one vertical slider for where the moon is. Up and Down move it across the bands, Left and Right along the track (Shift for three times the step), PageUp and PageDown by four steps, Home and End to the outer and inner edge; Escape, or leaving the control, gives the moon back its own orbit. The value text names the band or gap it is in.

Pointer: the moon follows a mouse while it is over the field and goes back to its orbit when it leaves. On touch a tap places the moon and a sideways drag steers it; an upright swipe still scrolls the page, and the moon returns to its orbit 1.4 s after the finger lifts.

Reduced motion: the dust lies still and the moon parks in a gap; it goes straight to where the pointer or keys put it and the dust round it is parted at once into a clean clearing, with no travelling lane and no scallops.

Cost: the dust is a lattice of up to 62,400 material points, one per texel of a small tone buffer, plus up to 2,200 glints, all in preallocated typed arrays and drawn with one putImageData and one batched path. Frames run only while on screen and in a visible tab; with paused or reduced motion the loop stops once everything settles. DPR is capped at dpr.

Theming: on a dark page the dust is light and the wake's crests glow; on a light page it is inked in a darkened mix of color, like an engraving. Colours resolve on the component's own element and repaint on a theme switch.

items.title: Rubber Belt
items.tagline: A strip of pictures that stretches with your speed.
items.description: An endless strip of pictures riding a rubber belt: a ring of masses joined by damped springs, one picture driven and the rest following through the rubber, so the strip stretches behind and bunches ahead when it speeds up, and the trailing pictures catch up and bunch when it brakes. Each picture is drawn on its own stretch of belt, its width from the spacing either side and its height answering the other way, so it squashes and stretches with the belt's acceleration and relaxes back to true; a click pulls a picture to the centre on springs.snap with one elastic overshoot the rubber carries down the strip. It is a carousel: arrow keys pull the next picture in, Home and End the first and last, Enter picks the centred one, and a drag, a throw or the wheel drives the belt too.

props.name: items
props.type: { src?: string; alt: string; caption?: string }[]
props.description: The pictures on the belt. Without a src the belt draws a landscape of its own; defaultBeltItems holds eight.

props.name: elasticity
props.description: How soft the rubber is, 0 (a stiff belt, almost rigid) to 1 (a soft one that stretches far and wobbles).

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between pictures at rest, px. The gaps stretch and bunch with the belt.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way the belt drifts on its own; "still" holds it.

props.name: speed
props.description: The idle drift's speed, px/s.

props.name: squash
props.description: How much a picture's height answers its stretch, 0 (width only) to 1 (it keeps its area).

props.name: itemWidth
props.description: Picture width, px. By default 30% of the belt's width, between 104 and 176.

props.name: aspect
props.description: Picture height as a share of its width.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Index of the picture pulled to the centre. Controlled or initial.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the click, key, drag or wheel that pulls a new picture to the centre.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Fires when the centred picture is clicked or Enter is pressed on it.

props.name: onMotionChange
props.description: What the belt is doing: drifting on its own, held by a hand or the wheel, pulling a picture in, or at rest.

props.name: resumeAfter
props.description: Quiet time after a hand or key before the drift resumes, ms.

props.name: wheel
props.description: The mouse wheel and trackpad drive the belt (either axis).

props.name: captions
props.description: Show each picture's caption under it, unstretched.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the idle drift; hands and keys still move the belt.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No input at all, and no drift.

props.name: label
props.description: The carousel's accessible name.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes on the outer box, which is a size container for the default picture width.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the centred picture is the one tab stop. Left and Right (or Up and Down) pull the previous or next picture to the centre and move focus with it, wrapping round the ring; Home and End go to the first and last; Enter or Space on the centred picture fires onSelect. Arriving by keyboard pulls your picture in wherever the drift had carried it.

It is a real carousel: a region with aria-roledescription carousel, each picture a labelled slide ("3 of 8: Salt flats"), and a polite live region that names the picture a gesture brought in. The idle drift pauses while the belt is hovered or holds focus, and stays paused for resumeAfter after any input.

Hand feel: a drag holds the grabbed picture 1:1 under the finger while the rest stretch and bunch behind it; a throw is projected and the picture nearest its landing is pulled in on springs.snap with the release speed. The wheel drives the belt while it spins and lands the nearest picture when it stops. A sideways finger drives it; an upright swipe still scrolls the page.
Reduced motion: the belt is rigid and does not drift; pictures stay true, and a pull is a 240 ms tween with no overshoot.

Cost: at most six copies of the items are simulated (copies are added only when the items cannot fill the ring, aria-hidden and inert) at 240 Hz in plain typed arrays; each frame writes only two transforms per picture, and the loop stops once the belt settles with no drift, off screen or in a hidden tab.
Pictures without a src are drawn in code as small landscapes; pass src for real images (they are laid object-cover and never dragged as files).

items.title: Hand Set
items.tagline: Words set by hand, the spacing breathing as they land.
items.description: A paragraph composed word by word as if set by hand in a compositor's stick: the browser lays it out once at its final measure, so the box never shifts, and the copy waits as a faint proof while each word slides in at the end of the line on springs.snap. As a word lands the whole line re-spreads on the same spring — a justified line spreads what it has across the measure, so the gaps tighten with every word and open a little again when the line takes its true justification — and when the line is full it locks with a faint rule drawn in beneath it, its ink deepens, and the next begins. It has no keyboard stop of its own: the words are real, selectable text and the paragraph is read once from an unseen copy.

props.name: children
props.description: The paragraph, as a string. Wins over text.

props.name: text
props.description: The paragraph, when it is not given as children. A short editor's note by default.

props.name: as
props.description: The element that carries the paragraph.

props.name: measure
props.description: Line length, in ch; never wider than the box.

props.name: pace
props.description: Time between words, ms; a comma or a full stop holds the stick a little longer.

props.name: justify
props.description: How the lines are set: justified to the measure (the gaps breathe), ragged right (words simply land), or centred (the line re-centres on each word).

props.name: maxSpread
props.description: The widest a gap may open while a justified line is still short, em, so two words never sit at opposite ends.

props.name: jitter
props.description: How uneven the hand is, 0 (a metronome) to 1. Seeded from the text, so the same paragraph is always set by the same hand.

props.name: linePause
props.description: The pause after a line locks before the next begins, ms.

props.name: rules
props.description: Draw a faint rule under each line as it locks.

props.name: ruleColor
props.description: The rules' colour.

props.name: setColor
props.description: The colour of words still in the stick; a locked line takes the paragraph's own colour.

props.name: proof
props.description: Opacity of the copy still waiting to be set, 0 (hidden) to 0.5. It is the designed first frame before the setting starts.

props.name: trigger
props.description: What starts the setting.

props.name: once
props.description: Set once, or start again each time the paragraph re-enters view or is hovered.

props.name: play
props.description: With trigger "manual": true sets the paragraph, false clears it back to the proof.

props.name: delay
props.description: Wait before the first word, ms.

props.name: onLineSet
props.description: A line has locked: its index and how many lines there are.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: The whole paragraph is set. Fires once per setting, and at once under reduced motion.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes on the paragraph element; type size and colour inherit from here.

usageNotes: The paragraph is laid out by the browser at its final measure and alignment from the first paint, and the words move by transforms only, so it reserves its box and never shifts the page. Line breaks are the browser's, so words never break mid-word and the font, size and hyphenation settings you give it are honoured.

Accessibility: the paragraph is read once from an sr-only copy and the visual words are aria-hidden; they are still real text, so selection and copy give the words. There is no focus stop. Use onLineSet if a host wants to narrate progress.
Reduced motion: the set paragraph — every word in place, every rule drawn, final ink — and onComplete fires at once.

Cost: no animation frame loop; each landing starts one snap spring per word in the current line, a timer schedules the next word, and everything stops while the tab is hidden and on unmount. ResizeObserver and font loading re-measure and re-pose what is already set.
Set it in left-to-right scripts; the breathing is computed from the line's left edge.

items.title: Off Register
items.tagline: Ink plates slip out of register where you point.
items.description: A headline printed on a sheet in up to four inks, each plate a real copy of the line stacked in register and blended like ink on paper, so it reads as one rich black until the pointer comes near; then every letter of every plate slips along that plate's own direction, leaving coloured edges and dark overprints where the plates cross, and register marks in the margins slip with them. Each letter of each plate is a mass on a spring: going out it rides springs.recoil, and the pointer's speed raises both the reach and a judder in the targets so a fast pass shakes the plates harder; coming home it rides a critically damped spring and eases back into register without a bounce. Keyboard focus slips the whole line once, left to right in a cascade, and Enter slips it again.

props.name: children
props.description: The headline, as a string. Wins over text.

props.name: text
props.description: The headline, when it is not given as children.

props.name: as
props.description: The element that carries the headline.

props.name: plates
props.description: How many inks print the line, 2 to 4: key and magenta, then cyan, then yellow.

props.name: slip
props.description: How far the plates slip apart near the pointer, 0 (they hold) to 1.

props.name: paperTone
props.description: The stock it is printed on, with its own inks; slate is a dark sheet printed in light inks blended as light.

props.name: inks
props.description: The inks, key first, as CSS colours; overrides the paper's own set.

props.name: radius
props.description: How far from the pointer the plates feel it, em.

props.name: shake
props.description: How much the pointer's speed shakes the plates, 0 (speed adds nothing) to 1.

props.name: settle
props.description: How long the plates take to ease back into register, ms.

props.name: marks
props.description: Draw register marks in the sheet's margins; they slip with the letters nearest them.

props.name: grain
props.description: Give the paper a fine tooth.

props.name: focusSlip
props.description: Keyboard focus slips the whole line once; Enter slips it again.

props.name: caption
props.description: A small imprint line printed under the headline, in the key ink.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer and keys move the plates.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No slipping by pointer or key, and no focus stop.

props.name: onRegisterChange
props.description: The plates left register (false) or came back into it (true), with the largest slip of that excursion, px.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes on the sheet; set the headline's size, weight and alignment here.

usageNotes: The headline is the as element with an sr-only copy of the text; the plates are aria-hidden, and only the key plate takes the pointer and selection, so copying gives the words once. Letters are split by grapheme and words never break mid-word.

Keyboard: one focus stop, an overlay button named "Slip the plates" that never takes the pointer. Arriving by keyboard slips the line once, left to right; Enter or Space slips it again. The focus ring is drawn inside the sheet.

Reduced motion: no travel and no shake — while the sheet is pointed at or focused the plates step a hairline off register at once, and step back when the pointer leaves or focus moves on. onRegisterChange still reports.

Cost: up to four plates of letters, each letter a spring in x, y and turn integrated at 120 Hz in one animation frame loop that runs only while something is out of register or the pointer is moving, and only while on screen in a visible tab. Transforms are written straight to the letter spans.

The paper and inks are fixed pigments, so the sheet reads like a printed proof on either theme; pass inks to print in your own colours. Size the type from the sheet's className (an em-based radius and slip scale with it).

items.title: Plumb Cursor
items.tagline: A weight that swings beneath your cursor.
items.description: A cursor effect bounded to its own box: a small brass plumb bob hangs from the pointer on a fine thread, a point mass under gravity on a thread that only pulls when taut, integrated at 240 Hz, so every movement swings it and it settles slowly to dead vertical — when a hairline drops from its tip to the floor — while fast circles pump it into an orbit round the pointer. A click pays out the reel and the bob falls freely to the end of its thread and bounces on the stretch before it is reeled back up on springs.glide; with no pointer it hangs from a nail, and the thread is handed to the pointer on springs.glide and carried back on springs.drift. Keyboard focus inside carries the thread over the focused control on springs.drift, and Enter drops it as a click does.

props.name: length
props.description: Thread length, px; kept to 70% of the box's height.

props.name: damping
props.description: How quickly a swing dies, 0 (it swings for ages) to 1 (it settles in one swing).

props.name: weight
props.description: The bob's weight, 0.5 to 2: a heavy bob is bigger, coasts longer against the air and stretches the thread further when it drops.

props.name: drop
props.description: How much thread a click pays out, as a share of the length, 0 to 1.5.

props.name: hold
props.description: How long the bob hangs at the end of its thread before it is reeled back, ms.

props.name: gravity
props.description: Gravity, as a multiple of the house value, 0.5 to 2: a slower or quicker swing.

props.name: color
props.description: The thread's colour.

props.name: bobColor
props.description: The bob's metal, a pigment that reads on both themes: brass from the warn token's hue, shaded into a turned body.

props.name: restAt
props.description: Where the nail sits that the bob hangs from with no pointer, as fractions of the box.

props.name: plumbLine
props.description: Drop a hairline to the floor when the bob hangs dead vertical.

props.name: followFocus
props.description: Keyboard focus inside moves the thread over the focused control, and Enter or Space drops the bob.

props.name: touch
props.description: On touch, the bob hangs from the finger while it is down and a quick tap drops it. Sets touch-action: none on the box.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The bob stays on its nail.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: What the bob is doing: on its nail, hanging true, swinging, orbiting the pointer, or dropped to the end of its thread.

props.name: children
props.description: The content the bob hangs over; it stays fully interactive.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes on the box the bob lives in; give it a size and, usually, overflow-clip and a radius.

usageNotes: It wraps content: the painted layer is an aria-hidden SVG with pointer-events none above the children, clipped to the box, so every control underneath keeps its own semantics, focus and clicks. The system cursor is never hidden.

Keyboard: there is no extra focus stop. When a control inside takes keyboard focus the thread is carried over it and the bob swings across to hang above it, tip pointing at it; Enter or Space on it drops the bob as a click would; leaving the box returns the bob to its nail.

Touch: the bob hangs from the finger while it is down and goes back to its nail when it lifts; a quick tap drops it. The box takes touch-action none for that; pass touch={false} where the page must scroll through it.

Reduced motion: no swing and no bounce — the bob hangs dead vertical straight under the pointer, the nail or the focused control, and a click shows the thread at full length at once and back after hold.

Cost: one SVG path and one group are rewritten per frame (rounded to hundredths), from a 240 Hz loop that runs only while the bob or the pivot moves, on screen, in a visible tab; it stops when the bob hangs true.

items.title: River Script
items.tagline: Text that flows downstream, quick through the narrows.
items.description: A sentence floats down a winding river on a pale map, letter by letter along the centreline and turned to its heading, as an accordion: the spacing opens in the wide pools, where the letters drift across the stream on a slow eddy, and closes up tight in the narrows, while the sentence's speed follows continuity — slow through the pools, quick through the narrows — so one sentence breathes as it travels and loops from the mouth back to the source. Hovering the text eases the current to a stop on springs.drift and the line lies straight to be read; grabbing the river by a bank drags the nearest bend 1:1, re-splining the course live with the letters flowing along it, and a released bend settles on springs.snap with the release speed. Space holds and frees the current, and each bend is a vertical slider for the keyboard.

props.name: children
props.description: The sentence, as a string. Wins over text.

props.name: text
props.description: The sentence, when it is not given as children. A line about the river by default.

props.name: meander
props.description: How far the river winds, 0 (a straight canal) to 1 (deep bends).

props.name: flowSpeed
props.description: The current's speed through an average reach, px/s; quicker in the narrows, slower in the pools.

props.name: width
props.description: The river's width at an average reach, px.

props.name: narrows
props.description: How much the width swings between pools and narrows, 0 (even) to 1.

props.name: bends
props.description: How many bends the course passes through, 3 to 7; a narrow map draws fewer (about one per 130 px) so the text never kinks.

props.name: course / defaultCourse
props.description: Offsets the visitor (or host) has added to each bend, -1 to 1 of the half height, negative north. Controlled or initial.

props.name: onCourseChange
props.description: Fires from the drag or key that re-routed the river, with every bend's offset.

props.name: paused / defaultPaused
props.description: Whether the current is held. Controlled or initial.

props.name: onPausedChange
props.description: Fires when Space holds or frees the current.

props.name: hoverToRead
props.description: Hovering the text slows the current to a stop so it can be read.

props.name: waterColor
props.description: The water's colour.

props.name: bankColor
props.description: The banks' and contour hints' ink.

props.name: places
props.description: Names for the widest pool and the tightest narrows, set beside the river where there is room (and left out where there is none).

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the course and its pools, so two rivers never match.

props.name: height
props.description: The map's height, px. It fills its parent's width.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No dragging and no bend keys; the current still runs.

props.name: label
props.description: The map's accessible name.

props.name: onFlowChange
props.description: The current's state: flowing, held by a hand over the text, or paused.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes on the map; the text's size and colour inherit from here.

usageNotes: The sentence is read once from an sr-only copy; the map and its letters are aria-hidden. Letters are split by grapheme and laid in reading order, the last letter leading downstream.

Keyboard: the map is one focus stop where Space holds and frees the current (announced politely). Each bend that fits the width is a vertical slider after it: Up and Down move it north and south (Shift for bigger steps), PageUp and PageDown by a quarter, Home and End to the south and north edges; the value text names the bend and how far it swings.

Pointer: hovering the text eases the current to a stop and lets it go when you move off; a vertical drag anywhere on the map takes the nearest bend 1:1, rubber-banding past the edges and settling on springs.snap when released. On touch a vertical drag re-routes the river and a sideways swipe scrolls.
Reduced motion: no current and no eddies — the sentence lies still across the widest pool with the same pool-and-narrows spacing, and a re-routed river carries it to its new course at once.

Cost: the course, banks and arclength table are rebuilt only when the shape or size changes (or while a released bend settles); each frame writes one transform per letter. The loop runs only while flowing, on screen and in a visible tab, and stops when held or paused once the current has eased to rest.

items.title: Notepad Flip
items.tagline: Lines that flip over the spiral as you scroll.
items.description: A top-bound reporter's pad seen at an angle in real CSS 3D, one line of text per sheet: scroll over it and the top sheet peels up, turns over the binding with its lower half lagging on the air so the paper curls, throws a shadow down the next line and comes to rest on the turned pile above the spiral, its writing showing through from behind. Each sheet's angle is a spring toward the scroll — rising on springs.snap with one flap at the top of its arc, falling back on springs.glide with a soft landing — and a jump in the scroll is followed one sheet after another, so sheets go over and come back down in order. The pad is a native scroller and a vertical slider: Down and Up turn one sheet at a time, Page Down and Page Up two, Home and End jump, and Enter or Space turns the next.

props.name: lines
props.description: One line per sheet, the top sheet first.

props.name: label
props.description: The pad's accessible name.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The index of the sheet showing, which is how many are turned.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the scroll, drag, tap or key that turned to a new sheet.

props.name: binding
props.description: How the sheets are bound along the top.

props.name: flipAngle
props.description: Where a turned sheet rests over the binding, degrees: under 180 the pile stands up, over 180 it leans away behind the pad.

props.name: paperTone
props.description: The paper stock, with its ruling.

props.name: tilt
props.description: How far the pad lies back on the desk, degrees.

props.name: curl
props.description: How far a turning sheet's free half bends behind it, 0 to 1.

props.name: shadow
props.description: How dark a lifted sheet's shadow falls on the next line, 0 to 1.

props.name: step
props.description: Scroll distance that turns one sheet, px.

props.name: ruled
props.description: Draw the blue rule under the words and the red margin line.

props.name: ink
props.description: The colour of the writing, any CSS colour.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Scrolling, dragging, tapping and the keys turn the sheets.

props.name: sound
props.description: Paper sounds for the turns the visitor makes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the pad as it is; nothing turns it.

props.name: className
props.description: Size the pad with font-size: it is drawn in em.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the pad is a vertical slider — Down and Up turn one sheet, Page Down and Page Up two, Home and End jump, Enter or Space turns the next and from the last sheet starts again; the value reads “Sheet 2 of 5”.

Scrolling: the pad is a real scroll region (step px per sheet, snapping to whole sheets), so wheel, trackpad and touch turn it and the page takes the scroll back at either end; a mouse drag scrubs 1:1 and a tap turns the next sheet.
Reduced motion: no sheet travels or curls — the top sheet cross-fades away to the line beneath and the turned pile appears with a fade; the value and its announcements are unchanged.
Performance: one loop springs every sheet and stops when they rest; it halts off screen and in hidden tabs. A line too long for its sheet is scaled to fit rather than wrapped.
Theming: the paper, ruling and binding are fixed pigments that read the same in both themes; the lines are read once from an sr-only list and every painted sheet is aria-hidden.
Sound: with sound on, a paper crinkle answers each sheet the visitor turns over the top; it stays silent until the page has had a click, tap or key press.

items.title: Firefly Letters
items.tagline: A headline of fireflies that scatter as you near.
items.description: A headline drawn by a few hundred fireflies on a dusk panel: the words are laid out for real, sampled into home spots, and a firefly hovers at each, glowing and flashing on its own rhythm — coupled oscillators, so a settled word slowly falls into step and its flashes ripple across it together. Bring the pointer near and the ones within reach flash once and burst away from it, blinking out as they coast into the dark; after a pause they come back one by one, nearest first, weaving in on a steering force that arrives softly, and each relights its spot with a swell timed like springs.drift until the word is whole. Keyboard focus startles the whole line in a wave from the left, and Enter or Space startles it again.

props.name: children / text
props.description: The headline, as children or a prop.

props.name: as
props.description: The element that carries the headline.

props.name: count
props.description: How many fireflies draw the words.

props.name: blink

props.name: shyness
