props.description: Names the board for assistive technology.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: The close button's name in a card brought close.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The heading level of a card's title when it is brought close.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the board but takes no input.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the board.

usageNotes: Every card is a button with aria-haspopup=dialog and aria-expanded. Enter or a click brings it close as a non-modal dialog labelled by its title; focus moves to its close button when it arrives, Escape is handled there (and on the board), and focus returns to the card. Arrow keys anywhere on the board tilt the view; Home or 0 levels it.
Under reduced motion the view never follows the pointer; arrow keys set a new still view at once, and a card brought close cross-fades in the middle instead of lifting and flying.
Nothing runs at rest: the view is two motion values on springs and every card, shadow, shaft and pin head derives from them, so a pointer move costs a few transforms.
Papers and pins are pigments, the same on light and dark pages; the cards' text is scoped to the light theme because it sits on paper.
The layout is measured: two columns under 520px, three above, cards scaled to their cells, and long titles truncate with their full text kept as a title and as the button's name.

items.title: Graph Horizon
items.tagline: Graph paper rolling to the horizon, plotted as it comes.
items.description: A strip of graph paper running to a horizon in perspective, its minor and major lines rolling toward you, plotted as it comes: a pen per series rides a rail halfway out and swings to each value as the paper passes, so every series is drawn in its own lane as a curve on the paper. As each sample reaches the reading line near the bottom, the curve there lifts off the paper toward you on the settle of springs.snap, a quick rise, a held peak and the faintest dip, with its shadow left on the paper and its values printed beside it, then lays back down. Drag the paper and the grabbed point stays under the pointer; a flick coasts and the roll picks up again. Arrow keys roll one sample at a time on the springs.glide constants and read it out, Space starts and stops the roll, Home and End go to the ends.

props.name: series
props.description: The series, each plotted in its own lane: { label, values, color?, unit? }. Up to six.

props.name: labels
props.description: A label per sample, printed at the strip's margin and read out.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the paper rolls toward you, in samples a second.

props.name: tilt
props.description: How far the camera looks down at the paper, in degrees: low is a grazing view with a high horizon.

props.name: inkColor
props.description: The grid's ink: a named ink or any CSS colour.

props.name: paper
props.description: The paper, any CSS colour; by default the card colour tinted toward the ink, white paper on a light page and blueprint on a dark one.

props.name: lift
props.description: How far a reading lifts off the paper as it passes, in px.

props.name: readAt
props.description: Where the reading line sits, as a share of the height from the top, 0.55 to 0.95.

props.name: majorEvery
props.description: Minor cells per major cell, and per sample row.

props.name: format
props.description: How a reading is printed; by default one decimal and the series' unit.

props.name: playing / defaultPlaying
props.description: Whether the paper is rolling, controlled or initial.

props.name: onPlayingChange
props.description: Fires from the key or the step that started or stopped the roll.

props.name: onSampleChange
props.description: Fires when a new sample reaches the reading line, with its index.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Drag and keys move the paper.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the chart for assistive technology.

props.name: children
props.description: Content above the horizon: a heading, a figure.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the paper still and takes no input.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the box.

usageNotes: The chart is a focusable group with aria-roledescription="strip chart" and an sr-only table of every series by sample. Arrow keys roll a sample at a time and announce its reading, Space starts and stops the roll, Home and End go to the first and last sample; the roll itself never announces.
Under reduced motion the sheet stands still with one reading lifted at the line; keys step at once and a drag moves the paper with no coast.

Canvas 2D at a device pixel ratio capped at dpr, resized by a ResizeObserver. The loop runs only while the paper rolls, coasts, steps or is dragged, and only on screen with the page visible; paused, it draws once and stops. Points live in fixed typed arrays, so nothing is allocated per frame.
Colours are resolved from tokens on the component's own element and re-read when the theme changes under it, so the paper is white with blue ink on a light page and blueprint on a dark one.
Each series gets its own lane scaled to its own range, so series in different units read side by side.

items.title: Snow Drive
items.tagline: Headlights into falling snow, the oldest warp.
items.description: Driving at night into falling snow, in Canvas 2D: every flake is a point in 3D falling at its own rate, swaying on its own phase, pushed by the wind and coming at you at the car's speed, and it is lit only by the headlights, so flakes appear out of the dark as they enter the beams and vanish at their edges, far ones points, near ones soft discs, each streaking from where it was one exposure ago. Reflector posts flash past on a snow-covered road, the beams glow in the snowy air, and a few flakes land on the windscreen and melt. Holding a press or Space eases the speed up on the springs.glide constants until the flakes stretch into long streaks, and letting go eases back to the cruise on the springs.drift constants; the pointer slides the vanishing point after it and bends the road, arrow keys steer and Home straightens.

props.name: snowfall
props.description: How hard it snows, 0 (a few flakes) to 1 (a blizzard).

props.name: speed
props.description: The cruising speed, in km/h.

props.name: beam
props.description: The headlights: a named lamp or any CSS colour.

props.name: boost
props.description: How much faster the car goes while held, 1 to 4 times the cruise.

props.name: wind
props.description: The crosswind, -1 (from the right) to 1 (from the left).

props.name: steer
props.description: How far the pointer steers the view, 0 (not at all) to 1.

props.name: road
props.description: Draw the road, its banks and the reflector posts.

props.name: glass
props.description: Let a few flakes land on the windscreen and melt.

props.name: speedometer
props.description: Show the speed in the corner.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the scene still on one frame.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Pointer and keys drive.

props.name: onBoostChange
props.description: Fires from the press or key that starts or ends a burst of speed.

props.name: children
props.description: Content over the scene, in a layer of its own whose tokens are the dark theme's.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the scene for assistive technology.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the snow.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the scene still and takes no input.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the scene.

usageNotes: The scene is a focusable group with aria-roledescription="driving scene": holding Space speeds up and releasing eases back, Arrow Left and Right steer, Home straightens, and the change of speed is announced politely. Presses on links and buttons in the children never speed it up.

Under reduced motion the scene is a still frame with the snow suspended in the beams; holding Space or a press shows a still frame at speed, streaks and all, and letting go returns the cruise. The pointer does not steer; the arrow keys do, at once.

Canvas 2D at a device pixel ratio capped at dpr, resized by a ResizeObserver; the beams and the flake sprite are drawn once per size and lamp. Up to 1,400 flakes live in fixed typed arrays and are drawn in a handful of batched paths by brightness and width, so nothing is allocated per frame. The loop stops off screen, in a hidden tab and when paused.
Night is night: the scene is the same dark pigments on light and dark pages, and its children are scoped to the dark theme's tokens so ordinary token classes read on it.
The speedometer is written straight to its text node when the whole number changes, never through React state per frame.

items.title: Harmonic Bands
items.tagline: Waves of colour you tune like a chord.
items.description: Layered strata of colour whose top edges are one travelling wave, the sum of a few harmonics of a fundamental, each tuned by a small vertical fader beneath; every band trails the one above by a phase lag, and dispersion decides whether the shape travels rigidly or keeps re-forming as each harmonic runs at its own speed. A change morphs the shape band by band on the glide spring, each lower band taking the new target a cascade step after the one above, while the palette slides with the spectrum from pale for a pure fundamental to deep when the upper harmonics lead. The faders follow a drag 1:1, rubber-band past either end and settle on snap with the release velocity, press on flick, and take the arrow, Page, Home and End keys.

props.name: harmonics
props.description: How many harmonics shape the wave, and so how many faders sit beneath it, 2 to 6.

props.name: palette
props.description: The colours the bands are drawn from, pale to deep: a preset, or two to eight CSS colours of your own.

props.name: flow
props.description: How fast the waves travel across the frame, 0 (held still) to 2.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Each harmonic's level, 0 to 1, fundamental first; controlled or initial.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the fader or key that changed a level, with every level.

props.name: bands
props.description: How many strata of colour are stacked, 3 to 8.

props.name: amplitude
props.description: How tall the crests stand, 0 (flat strata) to 1 (crests reaching the band above).

props.name: cycles
props.description: How many waves of the fundamental span the frame, 0.5 to 3.

props.name: dispersion
props.description: 0 moves the whole shape rigidly; 1 lets every harmonic run at its own deep-water speed, so the shape keeps re-forming.

props.name: lag
props.description: How far each lower band trails the one above, in phase and in the morph's cascade, 0 to 1.

props.name: sheen
props.description: The sheen on each crest and the shading toward each band's foot, 0 (flat pigment) to 1.

props.name: controls
props.description: Show the row of faders beneath the bands. Off, it is a display driven by value.

props.name: label
props.description: The fader row's accessible name.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the waves still.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds each harmonic's starting phase.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The faders stop answering; they stay focusable and say so.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the panel.

usageNotes: Each fader is a vertical role="slider" with a spoken value ("Third harmonic, 20%"): Up or Right raises it 5 points, Down or Left lowers it, Shift moves 20, Page Up and Page Down 25, Home and End go to 0 and 100. The row is a group named by label.

A drag follows the finger 1:1 over the fader's height, rubber-bands past either end and settles on the snap spring; the faders are touch-action pan-x, so a vertical drag never scrolls the page. A tap jumps to the tapped level.

Canvas 2D: the loop runs only while the waves flow or a spring is still settling, only on screen and with the tab visible; with flow at 0 or paused a settled panel is one frame. Gradients are rebuilt only when the colours change, and the device pixel ratio is capped at 2.
Under reduced motion the flow stops at its first frame and a new chord is drawn at once, colour and all; the fader fills move on a short tween.
Palettes are pigment: each stop takes a token's hue at a fixed lightness, so the strata look the same on light and dark pages and follow your accent. Pass any CSS colours as palette to use your own.

items.title: Tally Facets
items.tagline: Pick a value; every other count answers.
items.description: A faceted sidebar beside a results list where every value carries a live count and a slim count bar, counted disjunctively so a facet's own picks never zero its siblings. Picking a value flicks its check in on springs.flick and, in the same frame, every other facet's bars glide to their new lengths on springs.glide while their counts roll; values that would now return nothing dim and sink to the foot of their group on glide, and results leave on the exit ease while the rest close up and returning rows rise in a cascade. Arrow keys walk every value in the order you see it, Space toggles, and below a 560px container the facets fold into a modal sheet whose buttons carry the live result count.

props.name: facets
props.description: The facets in order: { id, label, values?, badge? }. Values omitted are read from the rows, largest first; a badge facet shows as a pill on each result.

props.name: rows
props.description: The records counted and listed: { id, title, code, amount, at, facets } where facets maps facet id to value id.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Picked value ids by facet id, controlled or initial.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the whole selection after every pick, clear or chip removal.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires once per decision with the value that changed and whether it is now picked.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Fires when Clear empties the selection.

props.name: onSaveView
props.description: Fires from Save view with the current selection; the button only shows when this is passed.

props.name: status
props.description: Loading stripes every bar and skeletons the results; error keeps the last counts, hatched, under a Retry banner.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Retry was pressed after a failed refresh.

props.name: density
props.description: Facet row height (26, 30 or 36px) and type size.

props.name: barStyle
props.description: How a count is drawn: a slim bar under the label, a hairline rule, or a wash behind the whole row.

props.name: accent
props.description: Checks, bars, chips and the live count, any CSS colour.

props.name: sinkEmpty
props.description: Values that would return nothing sink to the foot of their group.

props.name: now
props.description: Today in ms, for the "3d ago" on each result; never read from the clock during render.

props.name: formatAmount
props.description: Formats each result's amount.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading over the results and the surface's accessible name.

props.name: itemLabel
props.description: What one result is called, in counts and announcements.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the surface in px; the facets and the results scroll inside it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Nothing can be picked, cleared or saved; the surface dims.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer surface.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the facet list is one tab stop (roving tabindex). Up and Down walk every value in the order it is drawn, sunk values included, across groups; Home and End jump; Space or Enter toggles. Each value is a role="checkbox" named with its count ("North, 19 orders"), and empty values add "no matches" and aria-disabled. The result count is announced politely from the pick that changed it.

Below a 560px container the sidebar folds into a sheet behind a Filters button that shows how many values are picked. The sheet is a modal dialog: focus moves in and is trapped, Escape closes it and returns focus to the button, and its footer button reads the live result count.

Reduced motion: no glide, sink or rise — bars and counts jump to their new values, empty values dim and move instantly, the sheet fades in place and the loading stripes hold still. Counts and the result total still change, because they are the information.

Performance: nothing runs at rest. Bars are scaleX transforms and counts are motion values rendered as text, so a pick costs one React render and no per-frame renders. Sinking uses CSS order, so DOM order and keyboard focus never move under the visitor. The loading stripes run only while loading and on screen.

Counting is disjunctive: values in one facet are OR'd, facets are AND'd, and a facet's counts ignore its own picks. Bars measure against each facet's unfiltered maximum, so they only shrink as filters narrow, with a hairline tick at the unfiltered length.

items.title: Sieve Stack
items.tagline: See exactly which filter is costing you rows.
items.description: Active filters stacked as layers above a work-order table, each applied to what survived the layers above it, so every bar shows exactly what its filter costs: the rows it lets through as a solid fill, the rows it removes as a shaded band, bare track for what earlier layers took. Switching a layer off collapses its band and the returning rows pour back down the stack, every layer beneath widening on springs.glide a stagger after the one above while the table admits them in a cascade; the switch thumb snaps on springs.snap. A grip drags a layer 1:1 with its neighbours sliding aside on glide and the release settling with the throw's velocity, and Alt+Arrow moves a layer from any of its controls while Delete removes it.

props.name: filters / defaultFilters
props.description: The filters in the order they are applied, controlled or initial: { id, label, field, op, value, active? } with op is, not, in, gte, lte or within (days from now).

props.name: onFiltersChange
props.description: Fires with every filter after a switch, reorder or removal.

props.name: rows
props.description: The records the stack sieves: { id, ...fields }.

props.name: columns
props.description: The table's columns: { id, header, kind?: code | text | tag | due, hideBelow?: none | sm | md | lg, sub? }.

props.name: onToggle
props.description: Fires from the switch or key that turned a layer on or off.

props.name: onReorder
props.description: Fires from the drop or Alt+Arrow that moved a layer, with the new order.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Fires from the button or Delete key that removed a layer.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the rows have arrived; the stack keeps its shape in every state.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after the rows failed to load.

props.name: bandStyle
props.description: How the rows a layer removes are drawn: diagonal hatching, a flat wash, or a dashed outline.

props.name: density
props.description: Layer height (36, 44 or 52px; shorter on phones) and table row padding.

props.name: palette
props.description: The hue of the surviving fill and the removed band; ember and moss are fixed-lightness pigments so they read the same in both themes.

props.name: pourStagger
props.description: Delay per layer, ms, as returning rows pour down the stack.

props.name: now
props.description: Today in ms, for due dates and the within operator.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading over the stack and the surface's accessible name.

props.name: itemLabel
props.description: What one row is called, in counts and announcements.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the surface in px; the table scrolls inside it under a sticky header.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No switching, moving or removing; the surface dims.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer surface.

usageNotes: Keyboard: every layer has a grip button, a role="switch" named with what it removes ("Priority high or urgent, removes 13, 10 work orders remain") and a remove button. Alt+ArrowUp/Down on any of them moves the layer and keeps focus on that control; ArrowUp/Down on the grip also move it; ArrowUp/Down on a switch walk to the neighbouring switch; Delete or Backspace removes the layer and focus lands on a neighbour. Every change is announced politely.

Reduced motion: no pour cascade, no glide and no row rise — bands and fills reach their new widths in one short tween, rows appear in place, and a dragged layer still follows the finger but lands without a spring. The counts still change.

Performance: nothing runs at rest. Reorders are FLIPs on per-layer motion values (DOM order follows the visual order, focus is restored after the move), counts are motion values rendered as text, and a drag captures the pointer only after 4px so a tap on the grip is still a tap.

Each layer is applied to what survived the layers above it, so its cost depends on its place: moving a layer re-divides every band. When nothing gets through, the table names the layer whose removal would admit the most rows and offers to switch it off.

Below a 480px container every layer collapses to one line (grip, switch, label, surviving count) and its bar becomes the row's underlay; the table drops columns by each column's hideBelow and shows a column's sub field instead.

items.title: Prose Filter
items.tagline: Type what you want; the sentence becomes filters.
items.description: One search line that reads a sentence against a typed schema and turns it into field, operator and value chips docked above a results table. A phrase docks when you type the space after it: a ghost of its words rises a step and fades where they stood while the chip starts over them, scaled to their width, and flies to its slot on springs.snap with one crisp overshoot; results close up on springs.glide and arrive in a cascade. Words with more than one reading keep a dotted, dashed or wavy underline, Tab walks them and opens a listbox of meanings under the word, Enter docks the chosen one, and Backspace at the start of the line pulls the last chip back into editable text.

props.name: schema
props.description: What the line can read: { noun: { one, other, words }, fields } with enum (options with words, optional lead words), money, date (lead words, primary) and code fields.

props.name: rows
props.description: The records the chips filter: { id, ...fields }.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: A sentence read on first render; its finished phrases dock straight away and doubtful words stay in the line.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The empty line's hint.

props.name: onQueryChange
props.description: Fires with { noun, clauses, text, unsure } on first render and whenever a chip docks, leaves, is pulled back or the line changes.

props.name: onApply
props.description: Fires from Enter or the apply button, after finished phrases have docked.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the results have arrived: loading shows skeleton rows, error a Try again.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after the results failed to load.

props.name: chipStyle
props.description: Chip look: field, operator and value in three tinted segments, one soft wash pill, or a hairline outline.

props.name: underlineStyle
props.description: The underline under words with more than one reading.

props.name: accent
props.description: Chips, underlines, read-phrase washes and the live count, any CSS colour.

props.name: now
props.description: Today in ms, for last month, this week, the last N days and month names (always the most recent one).

props.name: formatAmount
props.description: Formats amounts in chips and rows.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: The most rows the table lists; it scrolls inside its box.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading before the sentence names its noun; it takes the noun's name once it docks.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the surface in px.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The line and the chips are inert; the surface dims.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer surface.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the line is a real input with role="combobox". A phrase docks on the space after it, Enter docks what is finished and applies, Tab walks the doubtful words once each (opening a listbox of meanings, driven by aria-activedescendant) and then lets focus move on, ArrowUp/Down choose, Enter docks the meaning, Escape closes the list. Backspace at the start of the line pulls the last chip back to edit. Each chip is a button named "Remove Amount over $500"; dock and pull-back are announced politely.

Reduced motion: no flight and no rising ghost — the chip fades in at its slot while the words leave the line, the meanings list fades without rising, rows appear in place. Underlines, chips and counts all still show.

Typing, selection, IME, paste and undo stay native: the underlines and washes are painted on a mirror behind a transparent-background input, kept aligned with its scroll by a motion value. Nothing runs at rest; a dock is three short springs on one chip.

Reading is deterministic and local: the schema's words, comparators (over, under, at least, between N and M), dates against now (UTC) and #numbers. Bare numbers, month names with two date fields, recent, big and large are doubtful and wait for a choice. A newer clause on the same field replaces the older one. readProse and proseMatches are exported for hosts that run the query themselves.
When nothing matches, the table names the chip whose removal would admit the most rows and offers to remove it.

items.title: Saved Lenses
items.tagline: Switch views; only the filters that differ move.
items.description: A row of saved views over a chip bar and a results list where switching views is a shared-element move: chips the two views have in common are the same elements and keep their slots, arriving chips take the slots departing ones leave, the differing ones slide out on the exit ease and in on springs.snap a cascade apart, and later chips glide on springs.glide only when a replaced chip is a different width. The tab mark slides on snap. Removing a chip or adding one from Filter makes a draft whose tab earns a modified dot on snap while Save, Save as new and Revert slide in on glide; views are a tablist with arrows, Home and End, and digits 1 to 9 pick a view from anywhere in the surface.

props.name: views
props.description: Seeds the saved views ({ id, name, filters: { field, value }[] }); the surface owns saves after that and reports them.

props.name: rows
props.description: The records each view filters: { id, code, title, due, ...fields }.

props.name: fields
props.description: The filterable fields and their values offered by Filter; a field of kind "due" reads due dates against now (overdue, today, this week).

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The active view id, controlled or initial.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the new view id from the tab, arrow or digit that chose it.

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: Fires with the view switched to (including unsaved edits) and the one left.

props.name: onSaveView
props.description: Fires from Save (asNew false) or Save as new (asNew true) with the saved view.

props.name: onRevert
props.description: Fires from Revert with the view whose edits were dropped.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the active view's results have arrived; loading, empty and failed views each get a quiet panel.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed on a failed view.

props.name: tabStyle
props.description: How the active tab is marked: an underline, a tinted pill, or a raised box; the mark slides between tabs.

props.name: chipStyle
props.description: Chip look: a soft wash, a hairline outline, or a solid fill.

props.name: cornerRadius
props.description: Corner radius of chips, tabs, the menu and buttons, px (0 to 16).

props.name: accent
props.description: The tab mark, chips and Save, any CSS colour.

props.name: now
props.description: Today in ms, for due dates.

props.name: me
props.description: Whose queue this is: an assignee chip with this value reads "Me".

props.name: title
props.description: The heading over the views and the surface's accessible name.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the surface in px; the results scroll inside it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Views, chips and actions are inert; the surface dims.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer surface.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the views are a role="tablist" with one tab stop; Left and Right move and select, Home and End jump, and digits 1 to 9 select view n from anywhere in the surface except a text field. Each tab says when it is edited. Chips are buttons named "Remove Account is Fernworks" (Delete or Backspace also remove), Filter is a menu button whose role="menu" takes focus, walks with the arrows and closes on Escape back to the button. Switches, edits and saves are announced politely.
Reduced motion: chips cross-fade in place (shared chips never move anyway), the tab mark and the modified dot appear without travel, rows fade in. Counts and contents still change.

Performance: no loop. A switch is one layout pass: shared chips keep their keys, so they are the same DOM nodes and do not animate at all; the strip's fade edges are CSS variables driven by motion values from scroll, never React state per frame.

Edits are drafts per view: switching away keeps a draft and its tab's dot, Save writes it back, Save as new names a copy (inline field, Enter saves, Escape cancels) and selects it, Revert drops it. A new value for a field replaces that field's chip in its slot.
Narrow surfaces turn the tabs into a horizontally scrolling strip with a fade on whichever edge has more, and keep the chosen tab in view without scrolling the page.

items.title: Brushed Windows
items.tagline: Cut several time windows out of one busy month.
items.description: A density ribbon of a month of events above an event list, where dragging across the ribbon cuts a frosted window that follows the pointer 1:1 and you may cut as many as you need, overlapping cuts joining. On release the window's edges settle onto bin boundaries on springs.snap with the drag's velocity, its soft handles swell in on snap, a chip for it pops into the row below, and the list regroups on springs.glide with one heading per window while rows outside every window fold away. Handles resize and the body moves a window 1:1; touch starts a cut with a long press; the ribbon is a slider cursor whose Enter cuts a day, and a focused window moves with the arrows, resizes with Shift and goes with Delete.

props.name: events
props.description: The events the ribbon counts and the list shows: { id, at, title, source, level: info | warn | alert }.

props.name: windows / defaultWindows
props.description: The cut windows in ms, controlled or initial; ids are assigned when missing.

props.name: onWindowsChange
props.description: Fires with every window, in time order and with ids, after a cut, move, resize, merge or removal.

props.name: now
props.description: The end of the period in ms; the ribbon shows the days before it. Never read from the clock during render.

props.name: days
props.description: How many days the ribbon spans.

props.name: binSize
props.description: Hours per bin, 1 to 24: the ribbon's grain and the step windows snap to and keys move by.

props.name: frostLevel
props.description: How frosted a window's glass is, 0 (clear, tinted) to 1 (deep frost).

props.name: accent
props.description: Windows, the density inside them, chips and the live count, any CSS colour.

props.name: maxWindows
props.description: Most windows at once; a cut past it replaces the oldest.

props.name: rowsPerWindow
props.description: Rows shown under each window's heading before Show all.

props.name: longPressMs
props.description: How long a touch must hold before it starts a window, so a swipe still scrolls.

props.name: status
props.description: Loading draws a skeleton ribbon and rows; error keeps the ribbon's shape with a Try again.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after the events failed to load.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading over the ribbon and the surface's accessible name.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the surface in px; the list scrolls inside it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No cutting, moving or removing; the surface dims.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer surface.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the ribbon is a role="slider" cursor over the period ("Sep 28, 06:00, 7 events"): Left and Right move a bin, Page Up and Page Down a day, Home and End jump, Enter or Space cuts a one-day window there and moves focus into it. A window is a focusable group: the arrows move it a bin, Shift with an arrow resizes its end, Alt and Shift its start, Delete or Backspace removes it and returns focus to the ribbon, Escape returns to the ribbon. Chips focus their window; their x removes it. Every change is announced politely.

Touch: the ribbon uses touch-action pan-y, and a cut starts only after a long press (longPressMs), so a vertical swipe scrolls the page and a quick horizontal swipe does nothing; after the hold a seed window appears under the finger and the drag draws it out.

Reduced motion: edges land on their bins without overshoot, handles appear, chips fade in and the list regroups without gliding. A window still follows the pointer during a cut: that is direct manipulation, not decoration.

Performance: nothing runs at rest. The ribbon's two paths are rebuilt only when the events, period or bin size change; window edges are motion values written 1:1 during a drag, so a drag causes no React render per frame; backdrop blur is limited to the window panes. The ribbon keeps its full width down to 316px, its labels thinning to one a week.
A stretch of a day and a half with no events is drawn as a flat dashed calm line labelled quiet, rather than a gap, so a refit or an outage reads as information.

items.title: Hover Forecast
items.tagline: Preview what a filter removes before you commit.
items.description: A trip board whose filter menus show what an option would remove before you choose it: resting on an option turns the cards it would drop into dashed ghosts that fade and lean aside about their foot, row by row down the grid on springs.snap, while the forecast count rolls on snap and the share meter glides on springs.glide; leaving the option springs them back, and committing exits the ghosts on the exit ease while the survivors glide into place. Arrow keys move through each menu previewing as they go, Enter or Space commits, Escape abandons, and the trip cards are one roving tab stop moved by arrows across the measured columns.

props.name: ghostOpacity
props.description: How faint a card the previewed option would remove becomes, 0–1.

props.name: layout
props.description: Full trip cards with a route line, two-line compact cards, or one-line rows.

props.name: motionScale
props.description: Scales the ghosts' lean, their step aside and the stagger, 0–2; 0 keeps the fade only.

props.name: records
props.description: The trips on the board.

props.name: filters
props.description: The filter menus in bar order; each option carries a match(trip) predicate.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The applied selection: filter id to option id, or null for any. Controlled or initial.

props.name: onApply
props.description: Fires when an option is committed or the filters are reset, with the whole new selection.

props.name: onPreview
props.description: Fires when a preview starts, moves or ends, so results can be fetched ahead of the commit.

props.name: forecast
props.description: The would-be total for a previewed selection; pending, zero and failed answers are each worded plainly.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: A trip card was opened (click or Enter).

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the trips have arrived: skeleton cards while loading, a retry when they failed.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after the trips failed to load.

props.name: title
props.description: The board's heading.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: The line under the heading.

props.name: noun
props.description: What one record is called in counts and sentences.

props.name: formatFare
props.description: Prints a fare.

props.name: label
props.description: The board's accessible name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Read only: menus do not open and cards do not open.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the surface; give it a height and the grid scrolls inside it.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the bar is a toolbar (Left/Right, Home/End); ArrowDown or Enter opens a menu on the applied option, Up/Down preview as they move, Enter or Space commits, Escape or Tab abandons and returns focus to the trigger. Trip cards are one tab stop moved by arrows.
Reduced motion: ghosts only cross-fade to ghostOpacity with their dashed outline; nothing leans, steps or staggers, digits swap and the meter jumps. The forecast itself still shows.
Ghosting is local to each option's match, so it is instant even when forecast returns a promise; the count and wording wait for the host's answer, and stale answers are dropped when forecast changes.
onPreview and onApply fire separately: start a fetch on preview and reuse it on apply. A keyboard preview is announced once through a polite live region after it settles.

Columns come from the container width (4 → 1) through container queries; give the surface a height and the grid scrolls inside it under the fixed bar. Idle cost is zero: every motion is a settled spring.

items.title: Paint Matrix
items.tagline: Paint the site and status pairs you care about.
items.description: A two-facet filter you paint: sites down the side, statuses across the top, and each cell's job count tinted by heat. Dragging across cells paints them in or out (the first cell decides), each cell blooming with a soft wash out of the exact point the pointer entered on a slow enter tween while its count pops on springs.snap, and the jobs list beside it changes once the stroke ends, rows rising a cascade apart on springs.glide as the count rolls. It is a real grid with one roving cursor over cells and headings: arrows move, Space or Enter paints, Shift+Arrow paints as it travels, and a heading paints its whole line.

props.name: cellShape
props.description: How a cell draws its count: a tinted tile, a disc sized by the count, or a bar along its foot.

props.name: heatScale
props.description: How strongly counts tint their cells, 0–1: 0 is flat, 1 a full heat ramp.

props.name: accent
props.description: The paint and heat colour: a named token, or any CSS colour.

props.name: rows
props.description: Sites, down the side; each may carry a short label for narrow containers.

props.name: columns
props.description: Statuses, across the top.

props.name: counts
props.description: Jobs per pair, rows × columns.

props.name: jobs
props.description: The jobs the list shows, each tied to a row and a column.

props.name: selection / defaultSelection
props.description: The painted pairs. Controlled or initial.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Fires once per stroke, key or heading press, from the gesture that made the change.

props.name: onOpenJob
props.description: A job row was opened.

props.name: now
props.description: Today, for due labels; never read from the clock.

props.name: listLimit
props.description: Most rows the list shows before "and N more".

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the counts have arrived: cells shimmer on a diagonal while loading; a retry when they failed.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after the counts failed to load.

props.name: title
props.description: The surface's heading.

props.name: label
props.description: The grid's accessible name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Read only: nothing can be painted or opened.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the surface; give it a height and the panes scroll inside it.

usageNotes: Keyboard: one tab stop; arrows move a cursor that also covers the headings, Space or Enter paints or clears, Shift+Arrow paints as it moves, Home/End go to the row's ends and Ctrl+Home/End to the corners. A heading or the corner paints its whole line or every pair.
Reduced motion: washes cross-fade in and out instead of blooming, counts do not pop and list rows do not rise; the paint, the counts and the list still change.

A stroke touches React state only when it enters a new cell and is sampled along its path, so fast strokes skip nothing; the list and onSelectionChange update once per stroke. The paint surface is touch-action: none.

Empty pairs are hatched, aria-disabled and cannot be painted. Colours resolve from tokens through CSS variables, with heat fills at a fixed lightness so amber or graphite read the same in light and dark.
Side by side from a 44rem container, stacked below it with a sticky status heading; headings switch to their short labels when the matrix pane is narrow.

items.title: Veto Chips
items.tagline: Keep some values, rule others out, in one row.
items.description: A filter row where every value can be ignored, kept or ruled out: the first press keeps a chip as a check draws in on springs.flick, the second turns it over on a quick springs.snap flip to its muted, struck-through vetoed face and slides it into a separate Excluding row on springs.glide while the gap closes and the result count rolls, and a third flips it back and glides it home. Rows measure their chips once and gather what does not fit into a +N popover. The chips are one toolbar: arrows move, Space or Enter cycles, Shift+Space vetoes, Delete clears, and focus follows a chip to the row it lands in.

props.name: chipStyle
props.description: Chip finish: tinted fills, hairline outlines, or solid kept chips.

props.name: flipAxis
props.description: How a chip turns over to its vetoed face: tumbling about its horizontal axis, turning about its vertical one, or a cross-fade.

props.name: tone
props.description: The vetoed face's colour, muted: red, amber or ink.

props.name: groups
props.description: The groups of values (crews, materials, priorities) in bar order.

props.name: records
props.description: The records filtered, counted and listed; fields map a group id to a value id.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The include and exclude sets of group:value keys. Controlled or initial.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires from the press or key that changed a chip, with both sets and the change.

props.name: onOpenRecord
props.description: A record row was opened.

props.name: showCounts
props.description: Show each value's number of records in its chip.

props.name: listLimit
props.description: Most rows the list shows before "and N more".

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the filters and records have arrived: skeleton chips while loading, a retry when they failed.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after a failed load.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading.

props.name: noun
props.description: What one record is called in counts and announcements.

props.name: excludeLabel
props.description: The second row's label.

props.name: excludeShortLabel
props.description: Its short form, used when the rows stack.

props.name: label
props.description: The surface's accessible name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Read only: chips cannot change.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the surface; give it a height and the list scrolls inside it.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the chips and both +N buttons are one toolbar (Left/Right, Home/End). Space or Enter cycles ignore → keep → exclude, Shift+Space excludes directly (or restores an excluded value), Delete or Backspace clears, and focus follows the chip into the row it lands in. Escape closes a +N popover and returns focus to it.
Reduced motion: no flip and no travel; the face changes in place and the chip appears in its new row at once. The strike, the count and the list still update.

Every face of a chip has the same width, so each row measures once (one ResizeObserver) and never re-measures on a press. The Excluding row keeps its newest vetoes in view and folds older ones into +N.
Each change is announced once, after it lands, with the new count. A second press during a flip lands the first immediately rather than queueing.
From a 40rem container the chips and the Excluding row share one line; below it they stack and the label shortens. Veto colours are muted from the status tokens so they read in light and dark.

items.title: Nested Ticks
items.tagline: Pick a whole crew, or just two of its people.
items.description: A filter tree of regions, crews and people with tri-state ticks and a summary that says the choice in words ("All of Coldbrook crew, 2 of Basinworks crew"). Ticking a parent sends a ripple down its open branch: each child whose tick changes lands on springs.snap a cascade step after the one above, its check drawing on springs.flick under a passing wash, while partial parents fill their tick halfway like a level; branches open on springs.glide and lazy ones load with a spinner row or offer Retry. It is an APG tree with one roving tab stop: arrows move, open and close, Space ticks, asterisk opens every sibling, and typed letters jump to a match while dimming the rest.

props.name: indent
props.description: Pixels of indent per level; narrow containers indent at 60%.

props.name: tickStyle
props.description: A square with a drawn check, a ring with a dot, or a slim gauge that fills; partial parents fill halfway in each.

props.name: accent
props.description: Tick and ripple colour: a named token, or any CSS colour.

props.name: nodes
props.description: The tree; a node may be lazy, with a count of the leaves it holds before it loads.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The ticked leaves (an unloaded lazy branch counts as a leaf). Controlled or initial.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires from the press or key that changed the ticks, with the leaf set in tree order.

props.name: expanded / defaultExpanded
props.description: The open branches. Controlled or initial.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Fires when a branch opens or closes, with every open branch.

props.name: onLoadChildren
props.description: Loads a lazy branch's children on first open; a rejection offers a Retry row.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Milliseconds between ticks in a ripple, capped so a ripple stays under 600 ms.

props.name: typeaheadMs
props.description: How long typed letters keep finding and dimming.

props.name: noun
props.description: What one leaf is called in counts and the summary.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the tree has arrived: skeleton rows while loading, a retry when it failed.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after the tree failed to load.

props.name: label
props.description: The tree's accessible name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Read only: nothing can be ticked.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the surface; give it a height and the tree scrolls inside it.

usageNotes: Keyboard (APG tree): Up/Down move, Right opens a branch or steps into it, Left closes it or steps out, Home/End jump, Space ticks (with the ripple), Enter ticks a person or opens a branch, * opens every sibling, letters type ahead (word starts first) and Escape clears an active type-ahead only.
Reduced motion: no ripple travel or rising rows; ticks change together with a short fade, branches open without travel, and the summary swaps. Ticks, counts and words still change.
Treeitems carry aria-checked true, false or mixed with aria-level, aria-setsize and aria-posinset; the summary is visible text and each change is announced once through a polite live region.
A lazy branch ticked before it loads is reported as its own id; when its children arrive they inherit the tick and onChange reports them instead.
No loops: ripple delays are computed once per press and the type-ahead uses one timer. The indent shrinks to 60% below a 19rem container.

items.title: Drill Columns
items.tagline: Walk deep folders without losing the path.
items.description: A column browser for deep folders: each opened folder adds a column and the last previews the selected file with drawn art. Opening a folder slides the track left on springs.glide while the selected row's highlight stretches to its column's edge and a thin connector draws along the divider into the new column's heading on glide; stepping back retracts it on the exit ease, and the selection glides between rows on springs.snap. One roving tab stop runs through every column: arrows travel within and across columns, Enter opens, Space previews, F2 renames and M picks an item up to move, while rows can also be dragged 1:1 onto a folder that bumps on springs.recoil as it takes the drop.

props.name: columnWidth
props.description: Width of each column in px; sets how far the track slides and how much of the path stays in view.

props.name: iconStyle
props.description: Type icons in tinted tiles, plain line icons, or mono type labels.

props.name: accent
props.description: Highlight, connector and folder tint: a named token, or any CSS colour.

props.name: folders
props.description: The root's contents; a folder may be lazy and load through loadFolder.

props.name: rootLabel
props.description: The root column's heading and first crumb.

props.name: path / defaultPath
props.description: Ids from the root; a file at the end is previewed. Controlled or initial.

props.name: onPathChange
props.description: Fires from the press or key that moved along the path.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: A file was opened: Enter, Open, or a double-click.

props.name: onMove
props.description: An item was dropped on a folder (null is the root), by drag or with M then Enter.

props.name: onRename
props.description: An item was renamed with F2 or Rename.

props.name: loadFolder
props.description: Loads a lazy folder's contents on first open: skeleton rows meanwhile, Retry in place on failure.

props.name: now
props.description: Now, for modified labels; never read from the clock.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the tree has arrived: skeleton columns while loading, a retry when it failed.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after the tree failed to load.

props.name: label
props.description: The browser's accessible name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Read only: nothing opens, moves or renames.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the surface; give it a height and the columns scroll inside it.

usageNotes: Keyboard: one tab stop across every column. Up/Down and Home/End move, Right steps into a folder (opening it), Left steps back and closes the column it left, Enter opens (a folder: step in; a file: onOpen), Space previews, F2 renames (Enter saves, Escape cancels), M picks an item up and Enter on a folder drops it; Escape cancels only an active move or rename.

Reduced motion: nothing slides or draws — the track jumps, columns and the connector appear in place, the drag chip still follows 1:1 but leaves without a spring. Path, preview, moves and renames all still work.
The connector path is rebuilt only on scroll, resize and selection change (a motion value, no React render) and pins to the column's edge, faded, when its row scrolls out of view. Idle cost is zero.
The browser keeps its own working copy of folders: moves, renames and loaded lazy folders land there and are reported through the callbacks; a new folders prop starts it over.

Below a 30rem container only the current column (or the preview) shows, full width, under a back crumb; deeper levels slide in from the right and back from the left. Preview art is drawn in SVG from tokens, never fetched.

items.title: Space Reclaim
items.tagline: Find what fills the drive and clear it calmly.
items.description: A storage clean-up surface: a quota bar drawn per file type in one hue sits over the scan's biggest files, ranked by size with proportional bars, types and last-opened ages. Choosing a file lifts its chip out of the row and flies it into the To remove tray on springs.glide while a striped reclaimable part grows inside that type's segment of the quota bar; Remove drains each segment by exactly its stripe on glide as the used figure rolls down and the removed rows fold away — calm, never bouncy, because it is a deletion. The list is a multi-select listbox: arrows move, Space chooses, Shift extends a range, Enter opens, K keeps a file out of the suggestions, Delete goes to Remove and Escape clears.

props.name: files
props.description: The scan's candidates: { id, name, folder, type, size, lastOpened } with sizes in bytes and lastOpened in ms or null.

props.name: quota
props.description: The drive's size and everything in use, in bytes.

props.name: selected / defaultSelected
props.description: File ids chosen for removal, controlled or initial.

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Fires from the click or key that changed the selection.

props.name: onReclaim
props.description: Remove was confirmed. Return a promise to show the removal; a rejection keeps the selection and says nothing was removed.

props.name: onSkip
props.description: A file was kept out of the suggestions (Keep, or K); it folds out of the list and nothing is deleted.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: A file was opened (Open, or Enter).

props.name: onRescan
props.description: Rescan or Retry was pressed.

props.name: status
props.description: Scanning shows progress and skeleton rows; error keeps the last results under a banner with Retry.

props.name: scanProgress
props.description: How far a running scan has got, 0 to 1.

props.name: scanPath
props.description: The folder a running scan is reading, or where a failed one stopped.

props.name: scannedAt
props.description: When the last scan finished, in ms.

props.name: now
props.description: The moment ages count from, in ms; never read from the clock during render.

props.name: barStyle
props.description: How the quota and size bars are drawn: rounded bars, thin rules, or bars cut into cells.

props.name: density
props.description: Row height: one line, a meta line, or a meta line with the folder.

props.name: tone
props.description: The hue the quota family, the stripes, the checks and the size bars are drawn in.

props.name: title
props.description: The workspace's name and the surface's accessible name.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the surface in px; the list scrolls inside it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Nothing can be chosen, kept, opened or removed; the surface dims.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer surface.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the ranked list is one tab stop (a multi-select listbox with roving focus). Up and Down move, Home and End jump, Space chooses, Shift with Space or an arrow chooses a range from the anchor, Ctrl or Cmd with A chooses every file, Enter opens, K keeps a file out of the suggestions, Delete moves focus to Remove and Escape clears the selection. The hover Open and Keep buttons are pointer twins of Enter and K.

The quota bar is a role="meter" whose value text names what is chosen; choices, removals, failures and scan progress (in quarters) are announced politely. Remove stays focusable while it works, marked aria-busy.

Removal is optimistic: after onReclaim resolves the surface subtracts the removed files and folds their rows away; when the host passes new files or a new quota it trusts those instead. A rejected promise keeps the selection and says nothing was removed.

Reduced motion: chips appear in the tray without flying, rows fade out instead of folding, and the stripes, the drain and the used figure change at once. Scan progress still fills and every number still changes.

Performance: nothing runs at rest. The used figure and tray totals are motion values rendered as text, so a roll costs no React renders; the only loop is the Removing… rule while a removal is in flight. Below a 40rem container the tray docks at the foot with a Review disclosure.

items.title: Revision Reel
items.tagline: Scrub through every saved version of a file.
items.description: A version history you scrub like footage: dragging the reel's playhead follows the finger 1:1 and dissolves the file's preview from one save into the next by its fractional position, while the deck of version cards above fans open around it — a closed-form bell of extra room, a tilt away from the playhead and a lift for the card at it, all read from one motion value. Released, the playhead is thrown by projection and settles on the nearest version on springs.snap with the release velocity; Restore lifts the chosen card on snap while the host saves, then a new newest version is born where it was, carried to the top of the stack on springs.glide and set down on snap. The reel is a slider — Left and Right step, Page keys jump, Home and End, Enter restores, C marks two versions to compare side by side, D downloads, Escape closes the comparison — and becomes a listbox of versions at phone widths.

props.name: versions / defaultVersions
props.description: Every save: { id, author, at, size, note, preview? }, shown oldest to newest by time. A missing preview gets a placeholder card.

props.name: onVersionsChange
props.description: Fires with the whole list when a restore adds a version.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The version at the playhead, by id, controlled or initial.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the drag, tap or key that moved the playhead to a new version.

props.name: onRestore
props.description: Restore (or Enter). Return a promise to hold the card up while it saves; a rejection shows a failed card with Try again.

props.name: onCompare
props.description: Two versions were marked and opened side by side, older first.

props.name: onDownload
props.description: Download (or D) for the version at the playhead.

props.name: status
props.description: Loading shows placeholder cards and a skeleton reel; error shows Try again.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after the history failed to load.

props.name: now
props.description: The moment ages count from, in ms; never read from the clock during render.

props.name: author
props.description: The name a restore is saved under.

props.name: fileName
props.description: The file's name, shown in the header and naming the surface.

props.name: reelStyle
props.description: How the reel is drawn: film frames with sprocket holes, ticks placed by time with day labels, or beads on a thread.

props.name: previewFit
props.description: How the preview sits in its pane: whole and letterboxed, cropped to fill, or fit to width and scrolled.

props.name: accent
props.description: Playhead, marks, the current card and Restore, any CSS colour.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the surface in px.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Nothing can be scrubbed, marked, restored or downloaded.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer surface.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the reel is a role="slider" whose value text reads the version, its author, age and note. Left and Right step, Page Up and Page Down jump five, Home and End reach the first and latest, Enter restores, C marks a version (a second mark opens the comparison), D downloads and Escape closes the comparison or clears the marks. Below a 34rem container the reel becomes a listbox of versions, newest first, with the same keys.
Previews are any React node — an , a canvas, an SVG. Images take object-fit from previewFit; a version with no preview gets a designed placeholder card instead of an empty pane.

Restoring is controlled-friendly: the component builds the new version ("Restored from v4") and reports the whole list through onVersionsChange; while it saves, Restore stays focusable and marked aria-busy, and a rejected promise shows a failed card with Try again and Dismiss.

Reduced motion: the deck holds still, evenly stacked, and the playhead moves at once; the preview still dissolves between versions while you drag, because the preview is the information. Restores appear in place.

Performance: one motion value drives the dissolve, the deck and the playhead through transforms, so scrubbing costs no React renders except when the playhead crosses a whole version. Nothing animates at rest; the deck's width comes from one ResizeObserver.

items.title: Name Clash
items.tagline: Two files, one name; decide in a glance.
items.description: An upload conflict resolver that decides one clash at a time: the file in the folder and the one being uploaded arrive side by side, sliding together until they touch on springs.glide, and picking an action previews it on the cards themselves — Replace slides the old card under the new one on glide, Keep both parts them on springs.snap while the upload's name grows its " (2)", Skip sets the upload aside. Apply sinks the pair on the exit ease and deals the next, Apply to all settles the rest in a cascade while the counter rolls down on snap, and an empty queue closes the panel to a one-line receipt. The actions are a radiogroup — arrows pick and the cards answer — Enter applies from anywhere in the panel and A applies to every remaining conflict.

props.name: conflicts

props.name: action / defaultAction
props.description: The action for the current conflict, controlled or initial.

props.name: onActionChange
props.description: Fires from the click or arrow key that picked an action.

props.name: onResolve
props.description: Fires once per file as it is settled, with the name the upload ends up with (empty when skipped).

props.name: onDone
props.description: Fires when the queue empties, with every decision in order.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: The close button was pressed; these conflicts are left unsettled.

props.name: status
props.description: Loading blanks the thumbnails and reads Comparing files; error explains the folder's file couldn't be read and makes Replace unavailable.

props.name: now
props.description: The moment ages count from, in ms; never read from the clock during render.

props.name: folder
props.description: The destination folder, shown under the title.

props.name: nextName
props.description: The name Keep both gives the upload; the part it adds grows in on the card.

props.name: cardLayout
props.description: How the two cards meet: side by side, one above the other, or turned toward each other and overlapping the seam.

props.name: thumbSize
props.description: Thumbnail edge in px, capped at 48 below a 32rem container.

props.name: accent
props.description: The chosen action, the upload's edge, the queue's current chip and Apply, any CSS colour.

props.name: title
props.description: The panel's heading and accessible name.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the open panel in px; it glides down to a 64px receipt when the queue empties.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Nothing can be picked or applied.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the panel.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the actions are a role="radiogroup" with one tab stop; all four arrows pick, Home and End jump, and the cards preview the choice. Enter applies from anywhere in the panel (a focused button keeps its own Enter), A applies the current action to every remaining conflict, and neither is taken while typing in a field. Escape is left to the host.

Every decision is announced politely ("Kept both: menu-board (2).png. 5 left."); the two cards are labelled figures whose names carry size, age and author, and when the queue empties focus moves to the receipt.

Thumbnails are drawn in code from each file's kind and seed (image, document, sheet, slides, audio), so the component needs no image files; pass different seeds to make two versions of a file look different.

Reduced motion: nothing slides — the pair appears in place, Replace dims the old card and badges it Will be replaced, Keep both shows the new name at once, and the close is a cross-fade. Every label, badge and count still changes.
Below a 32rem container the cards stack and meet vertically, the action icons drop and the thumbnails cap at 48px. Nothing runs at rest; one ResizeObserver reads the panel's width.

items.title: Incident Bridge
items.tagline: One room for the incident, from page to postmortem.
items.description: A live incident workspace: a severity band over a toolbar, a timeline with a slim time axis and a pin per update, and the roles, affected Gaugeworks services and response checklist beside it. Changing severity floods the band with the new colour outward from the segment that was pressed — a circle clip on an enter tween, quicker to escalate than to calm — while the segment pill moves on springs.snap; every update drops in with its pin landing on the axis on springs.recoil and its entry sliding in on springs.glide as the rest glide down. U posts an update, R hands out a role from a menu, S goes to severity where arrows change it, Resolve sweeps the band quiet and lights the postmortem, stale data is flagged with its age and a null incident reads all clear.

props.name: incident / defaultIncident
props.description: The incident: { id, title, severity, state, openedAt, updatedAt, roles, services, updates, checklist }; null reads all clear.

props.name: onIncidentChange
props.description: Fires with the whole incident after every change made on the bridge.

props.name: onSeverityChange
props.description: Severity was raised or lowered, from a press or an arrow key.

props.name: onPostUpdate
props.description: An update was posted from the composer; it is already on the timeline.

props.name: onResolve
props.description: Resolve was pressed, with the resolved incident.

props.name: onAssignRole
props.description: A role (commander, scribe, comms) was handed to a person.

props.name: onRefresh
props.description: Refresh (stale data) or Retry (error) was pressed.

props.name: people
props.description: Everyone who can hold a role or post: { id, name }.

props.name: lastIncident
props.description: Shown in the all-clear state.

props.name: status
props.description: Loading shows a skeleton band and timeline; error keeps the last state under a banner with its age and Retry.

props.name: now
props.description: The moment ages and the axis count from, in ms; never read from the clock during render.

props.name: staleAfter
props.description: How old updatedAt may get, in ms, before the data is flagged stale with its age.

props.name: author
props.description: The person posting from this bridge, by id.

props.name: severityPalette
props.description: Severity colours: red to blue, violet to teal, or one ink whose weight carries severity.

props.name: density
props.description: Entry padding, type size and row heights.

props.name: timelineSide
props.description: Which column the timeline takes at tablet width, and which side of the entries its rail runs on.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the bridge in px; its columns scroll inside it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Read only: nothing can be posted, assigned or changed.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer surface.

usageNotes: Keyboard: U opens the composer (Enter posts, Shift+Enter adds a line, Escape cancels), R opens the role menu for the first empty role (arrows, Home, End, Enter, Escape returns focus to its button), S focuses the severity radiogroup where arrows change it. The shortcuts never fire while typing in a field or inside a menu.

The timeline is a role="log" list, newest first, with every entry's time in the text; the axis above it is decorative. Severity, posts, roles, resolution and stale data are each announced once, politely.
Severity colours are pigments taken at a fixed lightness from the status tokens, so the band reads the same in both themes; text and small marks keep the plain tokens.
Reduced motion: the band cross-fades instead of sweeping, pins and entries fade in place, menus and the composer fade; every colour, count and entry still changes.

Below a 44rem container the timeline moves under the band and the roles, services and checklist follow it in one scrolling column. Nothing runs at rest: the sweep is one clip-path tween on one layer that is removed when it lands.

items.title: Blast Radius
items.tagline: See who feels it when one service falls over.
items.description: A service dependency map that answers who feels it when one service falls over: services sit in tidy layers computed from their calls (longest-path layering with barycentre sweeps), and every call is a curve whose weight is its traffic. Selecting a service runs the blast backwards up the calls one hop every ringSpeed ms — a pulse travels each edge, and as it lands the caller takes the impact tint and throws one ring that widens on springs.drift and fades, the impacted count rolls on springs.snap and the hop's rows rise into the list on springs.glide — while everything it never reaches dims; then it all settles. Every service is a button in the tab order where arrows move along the layout, Enter or Space selects and Escape clears, and below a 30rem container the map becomes an indented tree of hops.

props.name: services
props.description: The services on the map: { id, name, team, health, rps }.

props.name: edges
props.description: Who calls whom: { from, to, traffic }. If `to` falls over, `from` feels it; traffic is drawn as line weight.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The selected service, controlled or initial. An initial selection plays its blast once the map is in view.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the click or key that changed the selection.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Fires with the selected service and every service its fall would reach.

props.name: onAcknowledge
props.description: Acknowledge was pressed for the selected service.

props.name: onOpenRunbook
props.description: Runbook was pressed for the selected service.

props.name: status
props.description: Loading draws faint dashed outlines where the services sit; error keeps the last map, desaturated, under a banner with its age and Retry.

props.name: updatedAt
props.description: When the map's data was fetched, in ms; an error shows its age.

props.name: now
props.description: The moment ages count from, in ms; never read from the clock during render.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Retry was pressed after a failed refresh.

props.name: layoutDirection
props.description: Layers run left to right, or top to bottom; the arrow keys follow.

props.name: ringSpeed
props.description: How long the blast takes to cross one hop, in ms.

props.name: nodeShape
props.description: How a service is drawn: a named pill, a health dot with its name, or a small card with team and traffic.

props.description: The heading and the map's accessible name.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the surface in px.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Nothing can be selected or acknowledged.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer surface.

usageNotes: Keyboard: every service is a button in the tab order, layer by layer, named with its health, traffic and number of callers and marked aria-pressed when selected. Arrow keys move along the layout (between layers) and across it (within a layer), Home and End reach the first and last service, Enter or Space selects and Escape clears. Below a 30rem container the map becomes a role="tree" of hops with one tab stop, Up, Down, Home, End and Enter.

The blast is announced once, when it has landed ("Basinworks queue selected. 5 services impacted across 3 hops."), never per hop. A service that is down blasts in the danger tone; a healthy one plays a what-if in the accent.

Layout is deterministic — longest-path layers and barycentre ordering computed from the props — so the server and the browser draw the same map; it is recomputed only when services, edges, direction or the measured size change.
Reduced motion: no pulses and no rings; the hops still light in order at ringSpeed, with fades, because the order is information, and the count updates per hop without rolling.

Performance: the blast is a finite choreography — a few tweens per hop, all stopped on reselect or unmount — and an initial selection waits until the map is in view. Nothing runs at rest. Under a 56rem container the hop list sits under the map in columns; wider, it is a side list.

items.title: Tripwire Tuner
items.tagline: Set a threshold and see how often it would have fired.
items.description: An alert rule editor that replays itself over the past week: a threshold line follows the finger 1:1 across seven days of a sensor feed, the part of the series past it recolours in the same frame, and each step it crosses re-runs the rule, so alerts it would now have sent drop onto the timeline on springs.recoil in time order while alerts it no longer sends lift away on the exit ease and survivors slide to their new time on springs.glide. The would-have-alerted count rolls beside a Quiet, Steady or Noisy verdict, and on release the line lands on its step on springs.snap with the throw's velocity. The handle is a slider: arrows nudge a step, Shift or the Page keys ten, Home and End the axis ends, and markers are walked with the arrows and opened with Enter.

props.name: chartStyle
props.description: How the series is drawn: a line over a soft fill, the line alone, or one bar per two hours showing their peak.

props.name: markerShape
props.description: The shape of each would-have-fired marker on the timeline.

props.name: accent
props.description: The threshold line, the breach colour, the markers and Save, any CSS colour.

props.name: series
props.description: Readings oldest first, evenly spaced: { t, v } with v null where the feed has no data (drawn hatched).

props.name: now
props.description: The newest moment the chart covers, in ms; never read from the clock.

props.name: rule / defaultRule
props.description: The rule, controlled or initial: { threshold, comparison: "above" | "below", duration (minutes), channel }.

props.name: onRuleChange
props.description: Fires from the drag, key, click or field that changed the rule, with the whole rule.

props.name: onSave
props.description: Save was pressed. Return a promise to show saving; a rejection keeps the draft and says so.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the series has arrived. Loading keeps the axes; error keeps the draft under a Retry banner.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Retry was pressed after the series failed to load.

props.name: unit
props.description: The metric's unit, printed after every value.

props.name: domain
props.description: The y axis, low to high; the threshold stays inside it and rubber-bands past it.

props.name: step
props.description: The threshold's step: one arrow press and what a drag lands on; Shift moves ten.

props.name: durations

props.name: channels

props.name: title
props.description: The rule's name in the header and the editor's accessible name.

props.name: source
