props.description: The panel's height in px; the form and the list scroll inside it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Nothing can be edited or applied.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the panel.

usageNotes: Keyboard: Tab moves through the fields; Enter commits a field (the ripple runs) and moves to the next, then to Apply; Escape on a changed field keeps each original again (consumed). Choices are native selects with Keep each first; the records list is a real list of labelled checkboxes with a tristate select-all.

Only changed fields reach onChange, onApply and onCancel, and onApply receives only the selected records a change actually touches; records that already hold a value are left out of the count and the call.
Each field's variants are described to assistive technology ("Mixed: Active on 9, Draft on 4, Paused on 1"); results are announced once ("12 updated, 1 failed").
Reduced motion: chips swap without travel and the ripple lights every touched record at once; progress, ticks and counts still show.
Below a 40rem container the records list folds under the form behind a disclosure; values applied successfully are kept over the records you passed until you pass new ones.

items.title: Parcel Spec
items.tagline: Type the dimensions and see the box take shape.
items.description: A shipping form beside an isometric box drawn to scale on a floor of squares: length, width and height are springs, so typing a dimension stretches that edge on springs.snap with one crisp overshoot, switching parcels glides the box to the other parcel's shape on springs.glide, and a box that would outgrow the stage zooms the drawing out on glide while the floor's squares grow to say so. The dial's needle swings to the weight on snap against the chosen service's limit, and each service's balance tips on springs.recoil when a parcel is too heavy for it, greying the service with its reason; quotes from onQuote shimmer while they load and roll in on snap. Fields take any unit ("12 in", "1'6\"", "500 g") and settle into the shown one, Up and Down nudge by one (Shift ten, Alt a tenth), parcels are a tablist where Delete removes one, and services are a radiogroup whose arrows skip the ones that can't go.

props.name: packages / defaultPackages
props.description: Parcels in cm and kg: { id, contents?, length, width, height, weight }, controlled or initial.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires from the keystroke, nudge or button that changed a parcel.

props.name: onActivePackageChange
props.description: The parcel being drawn changed (a tab, a new parcel, a removal).

props.name: services

props.name: service / defaultService
props.description: The chosen service, controlled or initial.

props.name: onServiceChange
props.description: Fires from the click or arrow key that picked a service.

props.name: onQuote

props.name: unitSystem
props.description: The units fields, callouts, limits and floor squares are shown in; typed units always convert.

props.name: boxStyle

props.name: accent

props.name: maxPackages

props.name: heading

props.name: currency

props.name: locale
props.description: The quotes' locale.

props.name: status
props.description: Loading shows a skeleton stage and fields; error shows Try again.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after the shipment failed to load.

props.name: height
props.description: The panel's height in px.

props.name: disabled

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the panel.

usageNotes: Keyboard: each dimension is a text field with role="spinbutton" and aria-valuenow/min/max/valuetext; Up and Down nudge by 1 (Shift 10, Alt 0.1), Page Up and Page Down by 10, Enter settles the typed text into the shown unit. Parcels are a tablist (arrows, Home, End; Delete removes the selected parcel) and services a radiogroup whose arrows skip services that can't take the shipment.

Typed units convert: "12 in", "30cm", "1.2 m", "1'6\"", "500 g", "2 lb 4 oz"; while you type in another unit the field shows the conversion, and errors name their field ("Width: enter a size like 30 cm").
Quotes are requested once typing pauses and a stale answer is dropped; the shimmer only runs while the form is on screen, and the box's springs only run after a change.
Reduced motion: the box redraws at its new size at once, balances show tipped or level without travel, the needle jumps and the shimmer is a still bar.
The drawing is one SVG scaled to its stage, every coordinate rounded, so the server's frame and the browser's agree; below a 40rem container the box shrinks above the fields with the dial beside it.

items.title: Site Assessment
items.tagline: Answer each check and watch the risk score settle.
items.description: A scored site questionnaire beside the column that keeps its score: every answer drops a chip sized by its weighted points onto the stack from a step above, landing on springs.recoil and pressing the stack down by its weight before it springs back, while a clear answer lands as a flat seam so the stack stays exact. The stack wears the risk band its top reaches, so crossing a threshold is a soft colour change, the score's digits roll on springs.snap, and changing an answer pulls its chip out sideways on the exit ease while the chips above glide down on springs.glide. Each question is a radio group moved with the arrow keys, notes open to their measured height on glide, Submit takes focus to the first unanswered check and queues while offline.

props.name: questions
props.description: The checks: { id, section?, prompt, short?, help?, weight, options: { value, label, points }[] }. Points are multiplied by the weight.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Answers by question id, controlled or initial.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the press or arrow key that changed an answer, with every answer.

props.name: onAnswer
props.description: Fires once per answer given.

props.name: defaultNotes

props.name: onNotesChange

props.name: onQueue

props.name: onDraftChange
props.description: Fires after every answer or note, for a host that keeps drafts itself.

props.name: draftKey

props.name: online

props.name: bandCount

props.name: bandLabels

props.name: chipStyle
props.description: Chips as solid pigment blocks, a translucent wash with an edge, or inset pebbles.

props.name: palette
props.description: The band colours, lowest first: a named ramp of token pigments or any CSS colours.

props.name: status
props.description: Loading shows placeholder checks; error explains and offers Try again.

props.name: onRetry

props.name: title

props.name: now

props.name: disabled

props.name: className

usageNotes: Keyboard: each question is a role="radiogroup" with one tab stop — arrows move and select, Home and End jump. Note buttons carry aria-expanded and open into their field; Escape closes the note and returns focus. Submit with unanswered checks moves focus to the first one and flags the rest.
The column is a role="meter" (0–100, valuetext like "41, Elevated"); every answer is announced politely as one sentence with the new score and band.

Offline (the online prop, or the browser's own state when it is omitted) shows a strip and turns Submit into a queue; onQueue fires, and onSubmit follows the moment the connection returns. With draftKey the draft is written to localStorage after every change and restored after mount, so server and client render the same markup.
Reduced motion: chips appear and leave by fading with no fall, squash or slide, the stack re-tints at once and the digits swap; the fill, the score and the band still change.

Palettes are pigments at fixed lightness built from the status and accent tokens, so the column reads the same in light and dark. Below a 34rem container the column becomes a bar across the top. Nothing animates at rest.

items.title: Share Perimeter
items.tagline: See exactly who can open it.
items.description: A share dialog that draws who can open the document: the people with access stand together in a field and a perimeter ring runs around them, its reach set by link access. Widening access springs the ring outward on springs.snap while the old perimeter fades as a ghost on the exit ease, and every colleague dot lights the moment the ring passes it; narrowing pulls it back on the same spring, and new invitees join the cluster on snap as it re-packs on glide. It is a modal dialog with a focus trap: Escape closes, the add field is a combobox over the directory, roles are menus moved with the arrow keys and link access is a radio group.

props.name: people / defaultPeople
props.description: Everyone with access: { id, name, email, role, status?: "active" | "pending", invitedAt? }, controlled or initial.

props.name: onPeopleChange
props.description: Fires from the invite, role change or removal that changed the list.

props.name: directory
props.description: Colleagues the add field suggests as you type: { id, name, email }.

props.name: link / defaultLink

props.name: onLinkChange

props.name: onRoleChange

props.name: onResend

props.name: onRemove

props.name: onOpenChange

props.name: documentTitle
props.description: The document being shared.

props.name: org

props.name: me

props.name: now
props.description: The moment invite ages count from, in ms; never read from the clock.

props.name: status

props.name: onRetry

props.name: ringStyle
props.description: The perimeter as a crisp line, a dashed fence that opens up as access widens, or a soft halo.

props.name: density
props.description: Row heights, avatar size, the field's height and padding.

props.name: accent
props.description: The perimeter, lit colleagues, the chosen level and Done; text on it flips light or dark with its lightness.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the frame in px; the people list scrolls inside the dialog.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Nothing can be changed; the dialog still opens and closes.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the frame.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the dialog is role="dialog" aria-modal with the document behind made inert; Tab and Shift+Tab wrap, Escape closes, and focus starts in the add field and returns to Share. An open role menu or suggestion list takes the first Escape itself.

The add field is a combobox (Down and Up move, Enter adds) that also takes an email address; role buttons open a role="menu" of menuitemradios with arrows, Home, End and type-ahead; link access is a radio group whose arrows widen and narrow the ring.

The ring's radii are two motion values and each dot's light is derived from them per frame, so widening costs no React renders; nothing runs while the dialog is closed or settled. Menus render on the dialog's own layer, so the scrolling list never clips them.
Reduced motion: the ring and the dots jump to their level while the old ring cross-fades out, avatars and menus appear in place; counts, labels and lit dots still change.
Below a 30rem container the dialog becomes a sheet that fills the frame's width; below 24rem the level icons and the Invite label give way to the words that matter.

items.title: Destination Picker
items.tagline: Choose where it goes, and watch it hop there.
items.description: A move dialog whose file rides along: the item sits as a chip in the header and hops on a short arc to each destination you hover or arrow onto — one progress spring on springs.snap carries it in a line plus a parabola of arcHeight, landing with a small settle in the row's end slot. Hops interrupted by the next key leave from wherever the chip is, refused folders grey the chip and open their reason on glide, and moving dives the chip into the folder's glyph on glide before the dialog leaves on the exit ease. The tree is a real treeview with type-ahead and lazy branches behind a spinner row, search turns it into a listbox, and Enter moves.

props.name: item
props.description: The file being moved; kind (pdf, image, sheet, doc) picks the chip's glyph.

props.name: folders
props.description: The project tree: { id, name, count?, project?, children?, hasChildren?, forbidden? }.

props.name: recent
props.description: Folder ids offered as one-press destinations above the tree.

props.name: value / defaultValue

props.name: onValueChange

props.name: onMove

props.name: onCreateFolder
props.description: A new folder was named in the inline row; the returned folder joins the tree and is chosen.

props.name: onLoadChildren
props.description: Loads a folder that has hasChildren and no children; a spinner row stands in until it answers, a failure offers Retry.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the dialog is open over the listing, controlled or initial.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Move…, the close button, the scrim, Escape or a finished move opened or closed it.

props.name: currentFolder

props.name: status

props.name: onRetry

props.name: chipStyle
props.description: The riding file as a pill with its name, a folded tag with its extension, or just its glyph in a disc.

props.name: arcHeight
props.description: The apex of the hop in px, scaled down for short hops; 0 slides straight.

props.name: accent
props.description: The chip, the chosen row and Move; text on it flips light or dark with its lightness.

props.name: title
props.description: The dialog's heading.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the frame in px; the tree scrolls inside the dialog.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Nothing can be moved or created.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the frame.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the tree is an APG treeview with one tab stop — Up and Down move, Right opens or enters, Left closes or climbs, Home and End jump, letters typed together jump by prefix, Enter moves. Search is a combobox over a listbox of matching folders; Escape clears the search first, then closes the dialog.

It is a modal dialog: the listing behind is inert, Tab wraps, focus starts on the tree and returns to Move… on close. Refused folders stay reachable with aria-disabled and their reason in aria-describedby; every target change is announced once.

The chip is one absolutely placed shape driven by two motion values; a hop is a single animate() and the scroll and resize handlers only re-place it, so nothing runs while the dialog is closed or settled.
Reduced motion: the chip fades out of one slot and into the next without travelling, the dive is a fade and branches open in place; reasons, labels and the loading row still show.
Below a 30rem container the dialog becomes a full sheet, the recent destinations scroll sideways behind an edge fade and the pill chip caps at 7.5rem.

items.title: Leave Guard
items.tagline: You changed four things; keep them or let go.
items.description: An unsaved-changes guard that shows exactly what would be lost: it wraps the page and lists every edited field as a compact diff, old value struck and new value in the tone. Discard plays the edits backwards one row at a time inside the 600ms budget — each new value slides back onto the old one by its measured offset on springs.glide while the strike retracts on glide — before the dialog leaves on the exit ease; Save fills as fields report in and draws a check per row on springs.flick, and a failure stays inside the dialog. It is an alertdialog with a focus trap: focus starts on Keep editing, Escape keeps editing and focus goes back to the field that was being edited.

props.name: changes

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the guard stands over the page, controlled or initial.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires when the guard closes after a save, a discard or Keep editing.

props.name: onSave
props.description: Save was pressed. Call report(id) as each field lands to fill the progress; a promise holds the dialog, and a rejection (with optional fields messages) keeps it open with the reason inside.

props.name: onDiscard
props.description: The unwind finished: every change was let go.

props.name: onRevert
props.description: One row let go during the unwind, so the page behind can revert in step.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Keep editing or Escape: the guard closed and focus went back to the page.

props.name: children
props.description: The guarded page; it goes inert behind the scrim while the guard is open.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading; the default spells the count in words.

props.name: description
props.description: The line under the heading.

props.name: labels
props.description: The three actions' words.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: How a value is written in the diff.

props.name: diffStyle

props.name: density
props.description: Row padding and type size.

props.name: tone

props.name: disabled

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the guard is role="alertdialog" aria-modal with the page behind inert; focus starts on Keep editing, Tab and Shift+Tab wrap, Escape keeps editing. Keep editing returns focus to the field last edited in the page (checked with isConnected), a save or a discard to whatever opened the guard.

Each row's accessible text is one sentence ("Alarm threshold: 4.2 bar, was 3.8 bar."); Save stays focusable while it runs (aria-busy) and a role="progressbar" under the list tracks the reported fields. Every phase is announced once.
While a save or a discard runs the dialog keeps the list it started with, so a page that reverts on onRevert or refreshes on save never pulls rows out from under the animation.
Reduced motion: nothing slides — each row cross-fades to its old value in turn, so the unwind still reads one row at a time — and the progress fill and the drawn ticks still show.
Long lists scroll inside the dialog with edge fades that appear only while more waits past an edge; below a 24rem container the split diff stacks and Save takes the full width.

items.title: Quick Capture
items.tagline: Make a task from anywhere, then make another.
items.description: A keyboard-first create-task dialog: type a title, and @, #, + and ^ open the assignee, project, label and due-date lists where you type, turning picks into tokens that each reopen as their own combobox. Creating lifts the filled form into a toast that shrinks to a pill on springs.glide while it travels to its sidebar count — x on glide and y on springs.snap, so the path bows — and sinks in as the count bumps on springs.recoil and its digits roll on snap; a failed create rolls the count back and flies the draft home intact. Cmd or Ctrl+Enter creates and keeps the dialog open for the next one, and Escape asks before letting typed text go.

props.name: projects

props.name: people
props.description: People a task can be assigned to: { id, name, handle }.

props.name: labels
props.description: Labels a task can carry: { id, name }.

props.name: me

props.name: inboxCount
props.description: Tasks waiting in the Inbox.

props.name: mineCount
props.description: Tasks in My tasks.

props.name: defaultDraft
props.description: What the form holds when it first opens: { title, notes, assignee, project, due, labels }.

props.name: onCreate

props.name: onCreateAnother
props.description: A task was created and the dialog stayed open for the next one.

props.name: onDiscard
props.description: The draft was let go after Escape's question.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the dialog is open over the app, controlled or initial.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: New task, a create, Discard, the close button or Escape opened or closed it.

props.name: createAnother / defaultCreateAnother
props.description: When on, Enter behaves like Cmd/Ctrl+Enter and keeps the dialog open.

props.name: onCreateAnotherChange
props.description: Fires from the press that flipped the Create another switch.

props.name: now
props.description: The moment the due-date choices count from, in ms; never read from the clock.

props.name: placeholder

props.name: tokenStyle
props.description: Tokens as rounded pills, square tags with an accent edge, or plain words with a dotted underline.

props.name: density
props.description: Padding, gaps and the title's size.

props.name: accent
props.description: The caret, filled tokens, Create, the toast and the count's tint; text on it flips light or dark with its lightness.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the frame in px.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Nothing can be created.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the frame.

usageNotes: Keyboard: focus starts in the title. @ # + ^ open their list inline (Down and Up move, Enter or Tab picks, Escape dismisses); each token is a button that opens a filter combobox (Enter picks, Escape or Tab closes and returns to the token), and Backspace on a filled token clears it. Enter creates, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter creates and stays.

It is a modal dialog with the app behind inert: Tab wraps, Escape closes an open list first, then asks "Discard this task?" when text was typed (Escape again keeps writing). Focus returns to New task on close.

The create is optimistic: the count rises at once and the toast flies; if onCreate rejects, the count rolls back and the draft returns with every field intact and the reason inline. Counts are labelled ("Riverside upgrade, 13 tasks") and every create, failure and discard is announced once.
Reduced motion: nothing flies — the count updates with a tint, the form cross-fades to its reset state, and a failure fades the draft back.

Below a 36rem container the sidebar folds into a strip of count chips along the top (the toast flies to those), the dialog fills the width and the tokens wrap to a second line. Nothing runs while the dialog is idle.

items.title: Batch Runner
items.tagline: Run it on all 248, and see each one land.
items.description: A bulk-action dialog that confirms its scope as one small cell per item, then runs inside itself: a soft band glides down the grid a row at a time on springs.glide while each cell under it is stamped done on springs.flick, so every row reads as a ripple, and failures fill red with their reason and never bounce. Escape pauses after the item in flight, Stop leaves the rest untouched, and finishing folds the live counts into one plain sentence with the failures grouped by reason; Retry failed reruns only the red cells. The action is a roving radiogroup and the cells a role="grid" with one tab stop, arrows, Home/End and Page keys.

props.name: actions
props.description: The actions in the picker: { id, label, past, progressive, description, icon?, targetLabel?, targets? }.

props.name: action / defaultAction
props.description: The chosen action, controlled or initial.

props.name: onActionChange
props.description: Fires from the press or key that picked another action.

props.name: run
props.description: The work for one item, called one at a time in reading order; a throw or rejection fails it with the error's message as its reason.

props.name: pace
props.description: Milliseconds per item for the built-in simulation; a retry takes at least 280ms per item so each can be seen.

props.name: autoStart
props.description: Start the run by itself the first time the dialog scrolls into view.

props.name: itemLabel

props.name: source
props.description: Where the selection came from, under the title.

props.name: onRun

props.name: onRetry

props.name: onCancel

props.name: onPauseChange
props.description: The run paused (Escape or Pause) or resumed.

props.name: onProgress
props.description: Fires as each item lands, with counts across the whole selection.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: A pass finished or stopped: totals, failures grouped by reason, and whether it was cancelled.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Done was pressed, or Escape on the summary.

props.name: cellShape
props.description: Rounded squares, dots, or tall tally bars that fold the selection into fewer, taller rows.

props.name: cellSize
props.description: The largest cell edge in px; cells shrink below it to keep the grid under maxGridHeight.

props.name: palette
props.description: The done pigment, the row band and the progress line; failures stay red in every palette.

props.name: maxGridHeight
props.description: Tallest the grid may grow, px, before its cells shrink to fit.

props.name: status
props.description: Loading shows breathing placeholder cells and holds the primary; error offers Try again.

props.name: onReload
props.description: Try again was pressed after the selection failed to load.

props.name: modal
props.description: Trap Tab inside the dialog and set aria-modal; pass it when you render it in an overlay.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Nothing can be started, paused or retried.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the dialog panel.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the action picker is a radiogroup (arrows move and select); the grid holds one tab stop — arrows move between cells, Home/End to a row's ends, Ctrl+Home/End to the first and last, Page Up/Down by five rows — and each cell's name reads the item and its state. Escape cancels on the confirm step, pauses a run and closes the summary, always with preventDefault.

The footer's two buttons keep their identity through every phase (Cancel/Archive → Stop/Pause → Stop here/Resume → Retry failed/Done), so focus never drops; nothing focused is ever disabled. Start, each quarter, pause, resume and the final sentence are announced politely — never per item.
Reduced motion: cells change colour on a short tween with no stamp growth, the row band steps instead of gliding and the summary cross-fades; counts, the progress line and the sentence still update.

Hand it your real work through run(item, context): items are processed one at a time in reading order, started from the press itself — never from an effect — and pause, stop and unmount halt the queue. The run is not tied to visibility; only autoStart waits for the dialog to be in view.

Cells carry their look through data attributes styled once on the grid, so hundreds of items stay light in the markup and a tick re-renders one cell. One ResizeObserver fits the cell size to the width; render it inside your own overlay and pass modal to trap Tab.

items.title: Plate Picker
items.tagline: Choose several images in the order you want.
items.description: An asset picker dialog for choosing several images in order: picking a plate lands a numbered badge on it on springs.recoil while a copy of the picture flies from the tile into its slot in the tray on springs.glide, and dropping one makes every later badge roll its digit down on springs.snap while the tray closes the gap on glide. The tray reorders by drag — the thumb follows the finger 1:1, neighbours glide aside, the drop snaps home with the release velocity — or by Shift with an arrow, and tabs switch between the library (folders over plates drawn in code), uploads whose veil lifts with their progress, and links. The grid is a multiselectable role="grid" with one roving cell; Space or Enter picks.

props.name: assets
props.description: Every plate: { id, name, folder, width?, height?, src?, art?, status?, progress?, error? }; without src a plate is drawn in code from art (or its id).

props.name: folders
props.description: The folders, in order: { id, name }; "All" is added in front.

props.name: folder / defaultFolder
props.description: The folder shown, controlled or initial ("all" for every folder).

props.name: onFolderChange
props.description: Fires from the chip or key that changed the folder.

props.name: selected / defaultSelected
props.description: The chosen plate ids in insert order, controlled or initial.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Fires from every pick, removal and reorder with the ids in order.

props.name: max
props.description: How many plates may be chosen; past it the unpicked plates dim and say why.

props.name: onUpload
props.description: Uploads one file; call report(0–1) as it goes; resolve (optionally with fields to merge) or reject with the reason the tile shows.

props.name: onLink
props.description: An https address was added from the Link tab; reject to refuse it with a reason. Nothing is fetched.

props.name: onInsert
props.description: Insert was pressed, with the chosen plates in order.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Cancel, the close button or Escape.

props.name: tab / defaultTab
props.description: The tab shown, controlled or initial.

props.name: onTabChange
props.description: Fires from the tab press or key that changed the tab.

props.name: columns
props.description: Grid columns at full width; containers under 30rem always use two.

props.name: badgeStyle
props.description: The pick number as a disc on the corner, a folded corner tab, or a thick frame with the number in its corner.

props.name: accent
props.description: Badges, the selection ring, the tray's numbers and the tab indicator; filled badges take its hue at a fixed lightness.

props.name: title
props.description: The dialog's heading and accessible name.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: A quiet line under the heading.

props.name: itemLabel
props.description: What one asset is called, in counts and on the Insert button.

props.name: height
props.description: Dialog height in px; the grid scrolls inside it.

props.name: status
props.description: Loading shows breathing placeholder tiles; error offers Try again.

props.name: onReload
props.description: Try again was pressed after the library failed to load.

props.name: modal
props.description: Trap Tab inside the dialog and set aria-modal; pass it when you render it in an overlay.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Nothing can be picked, uploaded or inserted.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the dialog panel.

usageNotes: Keyboard: tabs are a tablist and folders a radiogroup (arrows, Home/End); the grid holds one tab stop — arrows move, Home/End reach a row's ends, Ctrl+Home/End the first and last, Space or Enter picks or puts back. In the tray, Left/Right move between thumbs, Shift with Left/Right (or Home/End) moves the plate and keeps focus on it, Delete removes it. Escape cancels with preventDefault.

Every pick, removal, reorder, upload start, finish and refusal, link and insert is announced politely; tile names carry the pick order ("chosen 2nd"), the upload percent or the failure reason, and the tray's thumbs say their place ("3rd of 4").
Reduced motion: no flight and no recoil — badges and thumbs cross-fade, digits swap, reorders settle at once (the drag itself still follows the finger) and the upload veil moves on a short tween.

Uploads are real: dropped or chosen image files preview through object URLs (revoked on removal and unmount) and run through onUpload, whose rejection marks the tile with Retry and Remove. Linked plates never load the address; art is drawn from its hash.
No loops run at rest; one ResizeObserver reads the dialog width (two columns under 30rem), and every plate's art is seeded SVG in pigment colours, identical on the server and in both themes.

items.title: Export Recipe
items.tagline: Pick the format and know the file size first.
items.description: An export dialog that shows the file before it exists: beside the recipe of format cards, range chips and column checkboxes sits a document glyph whose twelve marks morph from one format's layout to the next on springs.glide (comma rows, a grid, indented keys, column stripes) while its tab rolls the extension letter by letter and the size estimate and row count roll their digits on springs.snap. Large estimates glide open delivery by email; exporting folds the recipe away as the glyph fills with the host's progress and three stages tick on springs.flick, a ready file lands a check on recoil with Download, and a failure keeps every choice. Format, range and delivery are native radio groups, and the column checkboxes follow the arrow keys too.

props.name: formats
props.description: The formats offered: { id, label, ext, note, layout, factor, keyed?, gzipFactor?, header?, maxRows? }; the defaults are CSV, Spreadsheet (xlsx), JSON and a packed Columnar format.

props.name: columns
props.description: The table's columns: { id, label, bytes, required? }; required ones stay checked.

props.name: ranges
props.description: The ranges offered, each with its row count: { id, label, rows }.

props.name: format / defaultFormat
props.description: The format id, controlled or initial.

props.name: onFormatChange
props.description: Fires from the radio that changed the format.

props.name: selectedColumns / defaultColumns
props.description: The column ids, controlled or initial.

props.name: onColumnsChange
props.description: Fires from the checkbox that changed the columns.

props.name: range / defaultRange
props.description: The range id, controlled or initial.

props.name: onRangeChange
props.description: Fires from the radio that changed the range.

props.name: emailThreshold
props.description: Estimates over this many bytes offer delivery by email and choose it.

props.name: email
props.description: Where an emailed export goes.

props.name: onExport
props.description: Runs the export: report(0–1, stage?) as it goes; resolve with { name, bytes, url? } or reject with the reason; the AbortSignal fires on Cancel.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Cancel on the recipe (close the dialog) or during an export (it stops and the recipe comes back intact).

props.name: onDownload
props.description: Download was pressed on the ready file.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Done was pressed after an emailed export.

props.name: glyphStyle
props.description: The file glyph as a paper sheet with ink marks, a line drawing, or a solid block with the marks knocked out.

props.name: density
props.description: Option heights, card padding and the spacing between sections.

props.name: accent
props.description: Chosen cards and chips, the glyph's header marks and the progress fill; filled parts take its hue at a fixed lightness.

props.name: title
props.description: The dialog's heading and accessible name.

props.name: tableName
props.description: The table being exported, under the heading; the part before a "·" also names the file (gaugeworks-readings-7d.csv).

props.name: status
props.description: Loading shows placeholder rows; error offers Try again.

props.name: onReload
props.description: Try again was pressed after the table failed to load.

props.name: modal
props.description: Trap Tab inside the dialog and set aria-modal.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Every option and button is held.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the dialog panel; it caps at max-h-[35rem] (its body scrolls and the file panel stays pinned), so pass another max-h-* to change that.

usageNotes: Keyboard: format, range and delivery are native radio groups (arrows move and select) with the ring on their cards; column and option checkboxes also move with the arrows, Home and End, and Space toggles. Escape cancels the recipe or a running export, and returns from the result to the recipe, always with preventDefault.

The estimate is announced once it settles ("CSV, 604,800 rows, about 50.2 MB"), never per rolling digit; the run is a progressbar with a text value, and each stage, the ready file and a failure are announced. Focus stays on the primary button as it turns from Export into progress and then Download.
Reduced motion: the marks jump to the new layout, digits swap, the fill rises on a short tween and the ready badge appears without bounce; every value and stage still changes.
estimateExport(format, columns, rows, gzip) is exported so a server can quote the same number; counts and sizes are formatted by hand so the server and the browser print the same text.
No loops: each mark is a spring started by a change, the run is driven by your onExport (abortable through its signal) or a short simulation that stops on cancel and unmount.

items.title: Sender Stacks
items.tagline: Notifications gathered by who sent them.
items.description: A notification panel that gathers notifications by who sent them, each source a neat pile of cards — the newest on top, the next few peeking below, the unread count pinned on top. Opening a pile fans its cards down into a list on springs.glide, top card first, while the pile's height glides with them, and closing gathers them back in reverse; dismissing a source sweeps the whole pile aside together, the header leading and each card trailing a beat behind, then the gap closes and Undo is offered. Up and Down walk the stacks and an open stack's cards, Enter opens, Escape closes, Delete dismisses.

props.name: items
props.description: The notifications, grouped by source: { id, source, title, body?, at, read? }.

props.name: sources
props.description: The senders: { id, name, icon? } with icon one of deploy, review, billing, mention, alert, calendar.

props.name: now
props.description: The moment relative times count from, ms; never read from the clock during render.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: The open stacks' source ids, controlled or initial.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires from the press or key that opened or closed a stack.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Let several stacks stay open at once.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: A stack was opened.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: A stack was dismissed, with the ids it held.

props.name: onRestore
props.description: Undo brought a dismissed stack back.

props.name: onMarkRead
props.description: A stack was marked read, with the ids that were unread.

props.name: onMarkAllRead
props.description: Mark all read was pressed, with every unread id.

props.name: onItemOpen
props.description: A notification in an open stack was pressed; it is marked read.

props.name: stackDepth
props.description: How many cards peek under each stack's top card, 0 to 4.

props.name: cardStyle
props.description: Shadowed paper cards, filled flat cards, or hairline outline cards; lower layers take a shade darker.

props.name: accent
props.description: Count pills, unread dots and an open stack's rail; filled pills take its hue at a fixed lightness.

props.name: undoMs
props.description: How long Undo is offered after a dismissal, ms.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Tallest the panel grows before its stacks scroll, px.

props.name: title
props.description: The panel's heading and accessible name.

props.name: status
props.description: Loading draws breathing skeleton piles; error offers Try again; no items draws the caught-up state.

props.name: onReload
props.description: Try again was pressed after the notifications failed to load.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Nothing can be opened, read or dismissed.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the panel.

usageNotes: Keyboard: one tab stop walks the panel — Up and Down move between stacks and, inside an open stack, through its cards; Home and End jump; Enter or Space opens; Right and Left open and close; Escape closes the stack you are in and returns focus to its header (with preventDefault); Delete or Backspace dismisses it and focus moves to the stack that takes its place, or to Undo. The focused stack's Mark read and Dismiss buttons follow on Tab.

Each stack header is a button with aria-expanded whose name carries the source, the unread count and the newest title; an open pile is a labelled list of buttons, a closed one is hidden from assistive technology. Opening, closing, marking read, dismissal and undo are announced politely.

Reduced motion: piles open and close in place with a short cross-fade, the sweep becomes a fade, counts swap without rolling and hover does not spread the layers; every count, dot and state still changes.

Cards have one fixed height, so both the pile and the list are arithmetic — nothing is measured per frame and nothing runs at rest; the sweep and the undo timer are cleared on undo and unmount, and an undo caught mid-sweep brings the pile straight back.
The panel is w-full with a 25rem cap: full width on a phone, a popover anywhere wider. Times come from the now prop, so the server and the browser print the same text.

items.title: Errand Toasts
items.tagline: Long tasks that report back when they're done.
items.description: Toasts for long-running work whose border is the progress bar: a line traced round each toast's rounded outline, measured in pixels, chases every report on springs.glide, or laps it as a segment while the job cannot measure itself. Finishing closes the lap and seals it — the outline swells once and fades — while the glyph turns to a check on springs.flick, the text cross-fades into the result with its action and the toast lands on springs.recoil; a failure stops the line and turns the outline a muted red with Retry. Toasts stack newest on top, fold into a count past max, live in a labelled region with one polite status, and F6 reaches them from anywhere.

props.name: tasks
props.description: The errands in the order they started (the newest is drawn on top): { id, kind, title, detail?, progress?, state, result?, error? }; progress null means unknown.

props.name: max
props.description: Toasts shown before older ones fold into a "+N more" count that unfolds them.

props.name: corner
props.description: Where the stack sits in its container and the side toasts enter from.

props.name: borderStyle
props.description: How progress runs round the border: a fine line, a 3.5px band, or a trail of round dots.

props.name: accent
props.description: The progress line, its seal and the percentage; any CSS colour.

props.name: layout
props.description: Overlay pins the stack to a corner of the nearest positioned ancestor (never position: fixed); inline keeps it in flow.

props.name: width
props.description: Toast width in px; under 30rem of container the toasts span it.

props.name: doneTimeout
props.description: Finished toasts dismiss themselves after this long, paused while hovered or focused; 0 keeps them.

props.name: dismissed / defaultDismissed
props.description: Dismissed task ids, controlled or initial.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: A toast was dismissed by its ×, Escape, Delete or its own timeout.

props.name: onAction
props.description: A finished toast's action (Open, View) was pressed.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Retry was pressed on a failed toast.

props.name: onExpandChange
props.description: The folded count was opened or closed.

props.name: hotkey
props.description: The key that moves focus to the newest toast and, pressed again (or with Shift), back to where it was.

props.name: label
props.description: The region's name; the hotkey is appended to it.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the overlay layer (or the inline wrapper).

usageNotes: Keyboard: F6 moves focus to the newest toast from anywhere and F6 or Shift+F6 returns it to the element it came from (only if that node is still connected); several instances defer to the first that handles the key. Up and Down move between toasts; Escape or Delete dismisses the focused one with preventDefault and focus moves to its neighbour.

The stack is a labelled region holding an ordered list; one polite status speaks each change once ("Readings exported. Open.", "Uploading site photos failed: …") and never per percent. Each toast is an article whose name carries its state and percentage.

Reduced motion: no travel and no loop — the line steps to each reported length, unknown progress is a still segment, the result cross-fades, the seal is a fade and toasts fade in and out; every state still changes.

The border is an SVG sized in pixels by a ResizeObserver per toast and drawn with an explicit dash array from the outline's own length — no viewBox stretching, no non-scaling strokes. The unknown-progress lap runs only while the stack is in view and the page is visible.

Overlay mode positions inside the nearest positioned ancestor, so give the app frame position: relative; finished toasts clear themselves after doneTimeout unless someone is hovering or focused on them.

items.title: Wayfinding Dots
items.tagline: Gentle marks on the features you haven't found.
items.description: Non-blocking hint dots that sit on the corners of the features nobody has opened yet, each breathing slowly from one shared clock with its own phase. Pressing a dot flicks it up on springs.flick, frames the feature on springs.snap and unfolds the tip out of the dot as a clip circle growing from its centre; closing folds it back and the dot flies on springs.glide along an arc into the corner counter, whose digit rolls on springs.snap and pill lands on springs.recoil. Dots are buttons in reading order: Enter opens, Escape closes and moves focus to the next dot, H shows or hides them all, and under 420px the tip is a bottom sheet you can swipe away.

props.name: children
props.description: The interface the hints sit on. Mark each feature with data-wayfinding="<target>".

props.name: hints
props.description: The hints, { id, target, title, body, placement?, keys? }, in the order they are numbered.

props.name: found / defaultFound
props.description: Ids of the hints already found, controlled or initial.

props.name: onFoundChange
props.description: Fires from the close, the use or the Dismiss all that found a hint, with every found id.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: A dot was opened.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: A hint was closed and counted as found: via its button, Escape, a press outside, a swipe of the sheet or using the feature.

props.name: onDismissAll
props.description: Dismiss all was pressed, with the ids it found.

props.name: shown / defaultShown
props.description: Whether the dots are showing, controlled or initial.

props.name: onShownChange
props.description: Fires from the hotkey or the eye button that showed or hid the dots.

props.name: hotkey
props.description: The key that shows and hides every dot while focus is inside the component and not in a text field; null turns it off.

props.name: dotStyle
props.description: The mark: a ring that leaves the dot, a swelling glow, a breathing hollow ring, or a numbered badge.

props.name: breathSpeed
props.description: How fast the dots breathe, 0.25 to 2; 1 is one breath every 3.2 s.

props.name: accent
props.description: The dots, the highlight frame and the counter ring. Any CSS colour; dots take its hue at a fixed lightness so they read in both themes.

props.name: discoverOnUse
props.description: Using a feature yourself counts as finding it: its dot leaves for the counter without a tip.

props.name: counter
props.description: The corner the discovered counter sits in.

props.name: sheetBelow
props.description: Below this container width, in px, tips dock as a bottom sheet.

props.name: label
props.description: The hint layer's accessible name; the found count is added to it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The dots stay but cannot be opened, the hotkey is off and the counter's buttons are inert.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper around the interface.

usageNotes: Wrap the real interface and put data-wayfinding="<target>" on each feature; the layer measures targets from layout (ResizeObserver on the root and every target), so transforms above it never skew the dots. The wrapper clips, and tips are clamped inside it.

Keyboard: dots are buttons after the interface in reading order. Enter opens a tip and focuses Got it; Escape (handled with preventDefault) or Got it closes it and focus moves on to the next dot; Next hint opens the next. H toggles every dot unless focus is in a text field. The counter's eye and × buttons are the pointer twins of H and Dismiss all.
Each found hint is announced once, politely ("Saved views found. 2 of 5."), and the layer's name carries the count.
Reduced motion: nothing breathes or travels — each style rests at its fullest, tips and the sheet cross-fade in place, a found dot fades where it is and the count updates at once.

Performance: one linear clock animation drives every breath, and only while the component is on screen, the tab is visible, hints are shown and at least one remains; per-frame values are motion values, never React renders.
The pigment is the accent's hue at a fixed lightness (oklch from), so a token accent reads the same in light and dark themes; pass any CSS colour.

items.title: Moving Day
items.tagline: Bring everything over from your old tool.
items.description: The import step of moving into a new workspace: each category the old tool holds is a box with its count, and Start opens them in turn — the lid swings open on springs.snap, the count rolls up in tabular digits straight from a motion value, and the box's things leave it one by one, travelling into the new workspace's preview on springs.glide and landing on springs.recoil, before the box shuts with a tick drawn on springs.flick. A category too big to wait for keeps counting in the background behind a thin bar with a toast, and whatever could not move is listed with its reason for Retry. Start, Pause, Resume, Retry and Open are real buttons (the primary keeps focus as its label changes) and the source is a radiogroup the arrow keys move through.

props.name: sources
props.description: The old tools to import from, { id, name, detail?, counts, blocked? }, each with a count per category and the items that cannot move.

props.name: categories
props.description: What moves, { id, label, unit, icon?, samples }, one box each in the order they open.

props.name: source / defaultSource
props.description: The chosen source's id, controlled or initial.

props.name: onSourceChange
props.description: Fires from the radio or arrow key that changed the source; only before the import starts.

props.name: workspace
props.description: The new workspace's name, in the preview, the copy and the open button.

props.name: onStart
props.description: Start was pressed.

props.name: onPause
props.description: Pause was pressed; the open box's count holds where it is.

props.name: onResume
props.description: Resume was pressed; the count continues from the same number.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Retry was pressed, with the ids of the items it tries again. Retryable ones move; the rest keep their reasons.

props.name: onDone
props.description: Every box has finished, background ones included.

props.name: onOpenWorkspace
props.description: The open-workspace button was pressed (offered as soon as the visible pass is done).

props.name: pace
props.description: Items per second the simulated import moves; each box takes between 0.9 and 2.4 s.

props.name: backgroundAbove
props.description: A category with more items than this moves in the background after its first share, with a toast.

props.name: boxStyle
props.description: A carton whose flaps swing open, a slatted crate whose lid lifts and tilts, or a tote whose lid slides back.

props.name: density
props.description: Box size, row heights and spacing.

props.name: tone
props.description: The boxes' pigment, a hue at a fixed lightness shaded toward black in oklab, so it reads in both themes.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the old tool's counts have arrived: loading draws skeleton boxes, error a message with Try again.

props.name: onReload
props.description: Try again was pressed after the counts failed to load.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: The tallest the step grows before its body scrolls, px.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Nothing can be started or chosen; the step dims.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer section.

usageNotes: The host owns the real transfer: wire onStart, onPause, onResume and onRetry to it. The component is the visible step and simulates progress at pace, so the counts and arrivals always tell a coherent story.

Keyboard: the source is a radiogroup (arrows, Home, End) while nothing has started; Start, Pause, Resume and Open share one primary button that keeps focus as its label changes and is never disabled while focused (aria-disabled instead).

Each box is a list item named by a sentence ("Files, 1,285 of 1,286 moved, 1 stayed behind"); the rolling digits are hidden from assistive technology and box starts, finishes, pauses and the background toast are announced once each.
Reduced motion: lids cross-fade instead of swinging, things fade into their slots instead of travelling, the tick appears without its draw — the counts still count.

Performance: nothing runs at rest. During an import there is one linear count tween for the open box (and one per background box); it stops while the step is off screen or the tab is hidden and resumes from the same number. Arrival offsets are measured once per row, before paint.

items.title: Practice Run
items.tagline: Learn by doing the real thing, once.
items.description: A hands-on tutorial where each lesson is one small real task in a sandboxed copy of the interface: a working board whose cards drag 1:1 and glide into their lane on springs.glide, a comment box whose @ opens a real combobox of teammates, a job whose Labels menu opens on springs.snap. A coach line answers what the visitor actually does, one sentence at a time rising into place on springs.snap, and a finished task presses a quiet check stamp onto the sandbox on springs.recoil before the next lesson slides in on springs.glide. Every lesson has a keyboard path (Space picks a card up and the arrows carry it; arrows and Enter pick a person; arrows walk the menu) and a Skip, and progress is a value so a run resumes where it stopped.

props.name: lessons
props.description: The lessons in order, each a move (board), mention (combobox) or label (menu) task with its own data and optional coach lines.

props.name: progress / defaultProgress
props.description: Each lesson's state, controlled or initial. The run opens on the first lesson that is neither done nor skipped.

props.name: onProgressChange
props.description: Fires from the finish, skip or restart that changed it, with the whole progress.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: A lesson's task was done for real.

props.name: onSkip
props.description: A lesson was skipped.

props.name: onFinish
props.description: Start working was pressed after the last lesson.

props.name: onRestart
props.description: Practice again was pressed; progress is cleared.

props.name: coach
props.description: The coach's name, on its avatar, in the ticker and the caption.

props.name: coachStyle
props.description: An avatar and a speech bubble, a single mono line over a progress hairline, or a note in the left margin pointing at the sandbox. Under 30rem it is always a caption docked at the foot of the sandbox.

props.name: stampStyle
props.description: The stamp a finished task gets: a round seal with its rim lettered, a tick drawn on flick in a rounded square, or a rubber-stamped DONE.

props.name: accent
props.description: The stamp's ink, the lit lane, the step rail and the mention token. Any CSS colour, taken at a fixed lightness.

props.name: stampHold
props.description: How long the stamp rests before the next lesson slides in, ms.

props.name: workspace
props.description: The product being practised, in the copy.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the lessons are ready; loading draws a still sandbox and the rail is inert.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: The tallest the run grows before its body scrolls, px.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Nothing can be done or skipped; the run dims.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer section.

usageNotes: Keyboard: on the board, Space or Enter picks a card up, the arrow keys carry it lane to lane (focus follows it), Space puts it down and Escape puts it back. In the mention lesson @ opens a combobox (aria-activedescendant) that the arrows and Enter drive; in the label lesson the arrows open and walk a menu of checkbox items and Escape closes it. Skip and the step rail are buttons.

The coach line is the one polite live region: each reaction is a single sentence frozen when it happens, and the stamp is announced as "Done: <lesson>". Focus moves into each new lesson's first control once it has arrived, when it was inside the run before.

Pointer: cards follow the finger 1:1 after 4px of travel (touch-action none on the card only), settle into their new lane from where they were seen with the release velocity, and any card can be moved — the sandbox is real, and the coach says so.
Reduced motion: cards change lanes in place, the stamp fades in at rest, lessons and coach lines cross-fade. Every state still shows.
Nothing runs at rest; the only timer is the stamp's hold, cleared on unmount. Override any coach line per lesson with lesson.coach[event].

items.title: Name Plate
items.tagline: Name the workspace and hang its sign.
items.description: The workspace-creation step: as a name is typed its letters are set onto a plate that swings into the preview sidebar on a pendulum spring — slid along the rail on springs.glide, tilted, and falling through a few decaying swings to hang from its nail — while the address forms beneath the name with each new letter dropping in on springs.flick. Every keystroke is a small impulse to the same pendulum, a new colour re-tints the plate with a bigger push, the address is checked live with a status icon that morphs on springs.snap, and a taken address offers alternatives. Icons and colours are radiogroups the arrow keys move through, Create may return a promise, and a failed create keeps every field.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The name, address, icon and colour, controlled or initial.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires from the field, chip or radio that changed it, with the whole value.

props.name: onCreate
props.description: Create was pressed with a valid, available address. Return a promise to show it working; a rejection keeps every field and shows its message.

props.name: icons
props.description: The icons on offer, { id, label, icon }; eight Lucide glyphs by default.

props.name: colors

props.name: plateStyle

props.name: accent

usageNotes: The address follows the name until the visitor edits it (the pencil turns it into a field); Match name, or Escape in the field, hands it back. Format is checked at once; availability after a 250 ms pause, through checkAddress or takenAddresses, and the message is announced only once the check has answered.

Keyboard: the icon and colour pickers are radiogroups with roving focus (arrows, Home, End select as they move). Alternatives are buttons named "Use harbour-ops-team". Create is never disabled while focused — it stays focusable with aria-disabled and aria-busy while a promise is pending.
The preview is decoration (aria-hidden) with a visually hidden sentence that says what it shows; the plate swings only on its own spring, so nothing runs once it hangs still.
Reduced motion: the plate fades in and hangs still, letters appear without dropping, the status icon cross-fades. The checks, alternatives and create states are unchanged.
Under 40rem the plate hangs in a band above the fields instead of in the sidebar; long names step their type down and wrap by whole words so the plate never spills.

items.title: Goal Weave
items.tagline: Pick your goals; a plan assembles itself.
items.description: A goal-selection step whose plan assembles itself: choosing a goal draws a thread out of its card to each of its tasks — the curve split at a growing t on an enter tween, every point rounded — while the tasks arrive from 8px left on springs.glide in a cascade(), and removing a goal retracts its threads and pulls out only the tasks no other goal holds while shared ones stay. The goal cards are checkboxes that lift on springs.snap and follow the arrow keys; plan rows rove with Up and Down, Alt with Up or Down (or a drag of the grip, 1:1 with the release velocity handed to springs.glide) reorders them, and the threads follow every glide from a geometry loop that runs only while something moves.

props.name: goals
props.description: The goals to choose from, { id, title, detail?, icon?, tint? }.

props.name: tasks
props.description: Every task a goal can bring, { id, title, minutes?, goals, starter? }; a task in several goals is shared, and starter tasks form the plan while nothing is chosen.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The chosen goal ids, controlled or initial. A host change weaves like a press.

props.name: onGoalsChange
props.description: Fires from the card, key or click that changed the goals.

props.name: onPlanChange
props.description: Fires with the plan in order whenever goals or a reorder change it.

props.name: onAccept
props.description: Use this plan was pressed.

props.name: cardStyle
props.description: Two-column tiles with icon, title and detail; compact wrapping chips; or a list of rows with task counts.

props.name: threadStyle
props.description: A fine 1.5px curve, a dashed stitch, or a soft 6px ribbon.

props.name: accent
props.description: The first goal's tint (later goals turn its hue 48° each), the chosen cards and the primary button. Any CSS colour.

props.name: question
props.description: The question over the goal cards; it also names the checkbox group.

props.name: planTitle
props.description: The plan's heading (and the drawer's label on narrow widths).

props.name: acceptLabel
props.description: The primary button's label.

props.name: maxGoals
props.description: The most goals that can be chosen at once; the rest turn aria-disabled with the reason.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the goals have arrived: loading draws skeleton cards, error a message with Try again.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after the goals failed to load.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: The tallest the step grows before its body scrolls, px.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Nothing can be chosen, moved or accepted; the step dims.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer section.

usageNotes: Keyboard: goal cards are role=checkbox in one roving group — arrows move (Up and Down by a row of tiles), Home and End jump, Space or Enter toggles. Plan rows rove with Up, Down, Home and End on their grips; Alt with Up or Down moves the focused task and announces its new place.

Every change is announced once as a sentence ("Track inventory removed. 2 tasks left the plan, 1 stayed, shared."); rows carry aria-posinset and aria-setsize, since their DOM order is held steady while a drag is under way.

Performance: threads are SVG paths written straight to the DOM from a requestAnimationFrame loop that runs only while a weave, a reorder, a drag or a resize is in flight, and only while the step is on screen and the tab is visible.
Reduced motion: threads fade instead of drawing, tasks fade into their slots, reorders and the drawer jump. The plan, counts and announcements are unchanged.
Under 40rem the plan moves into a drawer under the goals; the threads give way to goal-coloured dots on each task, and a change made while it is closed rolls the count and shows a +n badge.

items.title: Shortcut Drills
items.tagline: Learn the keys by pressing them.
items.description: A keyboard practice built from a list of actions and their keys: the screen names an action, you press its shortcut, and every key you press is mirrored on a small keyboard whose caps go down on springs.flick and come back on springs.snap. A correct chord bottoms out together and lights, the caps rise key first and modifiers after, and a bead lifts off the key and flies on an arc into the streak rail on springs.glide, landing on springs.recoil; a wrong one shakes nothing and gently shows the right chord with a breathing ring and a caption. The prompt is a focusable practice pad that takes real chords (Tab and Escape still leave), the board is a roving group of buttons where modifiers latch and a key commits, and the set ends on a summary where any drill can be repeated.

props.name: drills
props.description: The shortcuts in order: { id, action, detail?, keys } where keys are Mod, Shift, Alt, Control, Meta plus one KeyboardEvent.code (Mod accepts ⌘ or Ctrl).

props.name: results / defaultResults
props.description: Each drill's result by id, controlled or initial; a returning visitor's beads.

props.name: onResultsChange
props.description: Fires from the press, tap or skip that changed a result, with every result.

props.name: onComplete
props.type: (summary: { total, clean, hinted, skipped, results }) => void
props.description: A run reached the summary: the whole set, or a repeat of part of it.

props.name: onSkip
props.description: Skip was pressed on a drill.

props.name: onAttempt
props.description: Every chord pressed or tapped while a drill was asked, right or wrong.

props.name: keyboardLayout
props.description: ⌘ ⌥ ⌃ legends, Ctrl and Alt legends, or the ⌘ board split in two halves.

props.name: keycapStyle
props.description: Tall caps with a skirt and real travel, low chiclets with a shadow, or line drawings that scale instead of travelling.

props.name: accent
props.description: Lit caps, beads, the hint ring and the streak: a named accent or any CSS colour.

props.name: reveal
props.description: Show the chord after a wrong press, or from the start as a learn mode.

props.name: advanceDelay
props.description: Milliseconds between a correct press and the next drill.

props.name: tapThrough
props.description: The caps answer taps: modifiers latch, a key commits the chord.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the drills have arrived: a skeleton while loading, a retry on error.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after the drills failed to load.

props.name: sound
props.description: A tick on every press, a brighter one when the bead lands.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Holds the pad, the board and the buttons.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the surface; give it a height to fix its frame.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the prompt is a role="application" pad, so screen readers pass keys through; every key but Tab and Escape is an attempt and is prevented while it has focus. Keep drills off chords the browser reserves (closing or opening tabs and windows). The board is one tab stop: arrows walk the caps, Enter or Space taps one.
Reduced motion: caps change colour instead of travelling, the bead fades into its slot instead of flying, prompts cross-fade; every result, count and caption still updates at once.

The board is drawn in key units and positioned in percentages with container-query legends, so it scales to any width (about 16px caps at a 316px card) and renders the same on the server. On a phone its caps grow taller.
Letters match by what they type as well as where they sit, so a visitor on another letter layout answers by the legend; Mod accepts either ⌘ or Ctrl whatever the board shows.
Nothing loops: the listening dot breathes only while the pad has focus, and timers and the bead flight are cleared on unmount.
Theming: everything is drawn from tokens; accent sets --sd-accent and a fixed-lightness pigment for filled caps and beads, so both themes read.

items.title: Last Slot
items.tagline: Five of five used; the sixth shows what it costs.
items.description: A project grid at its plan's limit: the used projects, then one ghost slot carrying a lock. Hovering or focusing the ghost unlatches the lock on springs.snap (a shackle swings, a bolt slides out of its keeper, or a dial spins and pops) and a beat later the card turns over on springs.glide, about Y in the grid and about X when it is a wide row, to show the plan that holds more projects and its price while the header's meter glides to the new limit. Every project stays a working button with arrow-key travel by the measured columns; the ghost is one labelled button that upgrades (admins) or asks an admin (members), with Compare plans and Not now beside it.

props.name: projects
props.description: The projects in the grid: { id, name, owner, updatedAt, tasks?, done?, next?, members?, tint? }.

props.name: usage
props.description: How many projects are used and allowed; at the limit the next cell carries the lock.

props.name: plan
props.description: The workspace's plan: { id, name, limit, price?, unit?, period?, perks? }.

props.name: offer

props.name: viewerRole

props.name: adminName

props.name: onUpgrade

props.name: onAskAdmin
props.description: The slot was pressed by a member at the limit.

props.name: onCompare
props.description: Compare plans was pressed.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Not now was pressed: the slot steps aside and a limit chip appears in the header.

props.name: dismissed / defaultDismissed
props.description: Whether the slot has been set aside, controlled or initial.

props.name: onDismissedChange
props.description: Fires from Not now (true) or the header's chip (false).

props.name: onOpenProject

props.name: onCreate
props.description: The slot was pressed while there is still room under the limit (it shows a plus, not a lock).

props.name: now
props.description: The moment edit times count from, in ms; never the wall clock.

props.name: formatPrice
props.description: Formats the offer's price; cents only when there are some.

props.name: slotStyle
props.description: The empty slot: a dashed outline, frosted glass over a faint card, or blueprint grid paper.

props.name: lockStyle
props.description: A padlock whose shackle lifts and swings, a door bolt that slides out of its keeper, or a combination dial that spins and pops.

props.name: accent
props.description: The open lock, the offer's eyebrow and checks, the grid paper and the meter's offer run.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the projects have arrived: placeholder cards while loading, a retry on error.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after the projects failed to load.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading.

props.name: disabled

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the surface; give it a height and the grid scrolls inside it.

usageNotes: Keyboard: projects and the slot are one roving set; arrows move by the measured columns, Home and End jump. Focusing the slot turns it over; Enter upgrades or asks; Tab reaches Compare plans and Not now, and focus anywhere in the slot keeps it turned.
Touch has no hover: the first tap turns the slot over to read it, the second presses it.
Reduced motion: no rotation and no lock travel; the faces cross-fade, the lock is drawn open and the meter re-reads at once. The offer still shows on hover and focus.
Not now moves focus to the header's limit chip, and the chip brings the slot back with focus on it; both are announced politely.
Narrow containers drop to one column of compact rows with the slot kept last, turning about X like a flap.
Times come from the now prop and prices from formatPrice, so the server and the browser render the same markup.

items.title: Teaser Lens
items.tagline: Look through the lens at what the upgrade shows.
items.description: A premium report drawn from the account's own numbers and softly blurred, with a glass lens that reads one region clearly, a little enlarged. The lens follows the finger 1:1 and has weight: it lifts on springs.flick, its rim tilts toward its travel and its highlight slides the other way, and when let go it coasts by projection, settles on springs.glide with the release velocity and sets down on springs.recoil, while an upgrade card trails beside it on a glide spring naming what that region would tell you. The lens is a button: arrows move it, Page keys and Home/End jump between regions, Enter upgrades and Escape puts it away; with no data the report draws a labelled sample, and in a narrow container the lens becomes a full-width band.

props.name: summary
props.description: The account's numbers: { workspace, period, members, activeMembers, tasksDone, cycleDays, onTime, weekly, cohorts, stages }; null draws defaultTeaserSample, labelled as a sample.

props.name: regions

props.name: value / defaultValue

props.name: onValueChange

props.name: onRegionChange

props.name: onUpgrade
props.description: Enter on the lens, or the card's call to action, with the region under the lens.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: The card's close button, or Escape on the lens.

props.name: dismissed / defaultDismissed
props.description: Whether the lens and its card are put away, controlled or initial.

props.name: onDismissedChange

props.name: lensSize
props.description: The disc's diameter in px; the band's height (up to 200) in a narrow container.

props.name: blurAmount
props.description: How soft the rest of the report is, in px of blur.

props.name: accent
props.description: The rim, the plan chip, the report's lead series and heatmap: a named accent or any CSS colour.

props.name: magnify
props.description: How much the glass enlarges what is under it (1 to 1.4); the band never enlarges.

props.name: weight
props.description: How heavy the glass is, 0 to 1: a heavy lens coasts less after a throw and tilts more while dragged.

props.name: planName
props.description: The plan the report belongs to, in the chips and the call to action.

props.name: title
props.description: The report's heading.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the numbers have arrived: a blurred skeleton while loading, a retry on error.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after the report failed to load.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Holds the lens and every action.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the surface; give it a height and the report scrolls inside it.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the lens is a button — arrows move it 5% (Shift 15%), Page Up/Down and Home/End jump between region centres, Enter calls onUpgrade with the region under it, Escape puts it away (handled, so the page behind does not close too).

Accessibility: both painted copies of the report are aria-hidden; readers get the lens's name, the card's teaser as its description, and one polite announcement each time the lens settles on a new region.
Reduced motion: the lens follows and stops where it is let go, with no coast, tilt, lift or bounce; the card moves with it and its text cross-fades.
Performance: nothing loops — motion values run only while dragging or settling; region rectangles and sizes come from a ResizeObserver, and the blur is a static filter on a static layer.
The report is painted twice (blurred, and sharp inside the lens's clip), so keep custom summaries to the shape of TeaserSummary; with no data pass summary={null} for a clearly labelled sample.
Narrow containers (under 480px) swap the disc for a full-width band that moves on y with touch-action pan-x, and dock the card under or over it.

items.title: Trial Recap
items.tagline: Seven days left, and what you did with them.
items.description: The screen a workspace sees as its trial runs out: what the team did with it beside the plans. The first time it is seen, the days-left ring sweeps to its share on springs.drift while the day count rolls up, the recap's counts roll up on odometer wheels in cascade on springs.glide (each wheel turns only as the one below it rolls over), and the plan that fits the workspace's actual usage rises on glide as its reason chip stamps in on springs.recoil. The plans are a radiogroup with arrow keys and roving focus; the call to action rolls its monthly total on springs.snap, and an expired trial changes the copy and empties the ring.

props.name: usage
props.description: What the workspace did: { projects, invited, seats, hoursSaved, teams? }.

props.name: plans

props.name: now
props.description: The moment days are counted from, in ms; never the wall clock.

props.name: onValueChange

props.name: onChoosePlan

props.name: onExtend

props.description: Talk to us was pressed.

props.name: extendDays

props.name: workspace

props.name: density

props.name: tone

props.name: formatPrice
props.description: Formats prices and the monthly total; cents only when there are some.

props.name: status

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was pressed after the recap failed to load.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Holds the plans and every action.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the surface; give it a height and it scrolls inside itself.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the plans are a role="radiogroup" with one tab stop on the chosen plan; arrows move the choice, Home and End jump, Space or Enter select. The fitting plan's reason is part of its description.
Arrival runs once, when an IntersectionObserver first sees the screen; the server and a no-JavaScript render show the finished numbers, and rolling digits sit behind a plain sr-only number.
Reduced motion: the ring, the day count and the recap counts show their values at once; the fitting plan is raised without travel and the call to action's total swaps.
Days come from now and endsAt, never the wall clock, so the server and the browser agree; pass a formatPrice for other currencies.
Containers under 40rem stack the recap above the plans with a smaller ring beside its caption.

items.title: Add-on Tray
items.tagline: Add only the extras you need, and see the total.
items.description: An add-on picker: toggle cards above, beside or under a running total tray. Turning a card on drops its chip into the tray on a small arc — one progress value on springs.glide carries it from the card's price to its place, x straight and y lifted — and it lands with two small bounces on springs.recoil as the monthly total rolls to its new value on odometer wheels on springs.snap; turning it off lifts the chip back out toward its card while the tray closes up on glide. Cards are role="checkbox" buttons with two-dimensional arrow-key travel; incompatible add-ons stay focusable, say why in place of their description and bring the reason forward when pressed, prices shimmer while they load, and narrow containers dock the tray at the bottom.

props.name: trayPosition

props.name: accent

props.name: checkoutLabel

props.name: onRetry

props.name: disabled
