Themes: the flat profile mixes the page's ink tokens, so it inverts with the theme; cove and gilt are fixed pigments that read on both. Pass color to match a brand.

items.title: Swatch Ladder
items.tagline: Colour strips in a slow wave; lift one to read.
items.description: A row of paint-chip strips, each a ladder of chips computed in OKLCH from the palest tint at the top to a shade as deep as you set at the foot, rising and falling in a slow wave that travels across the row. Pointing at a strip, or arrowing to it, lifts it clear on springs.snap with one crisp overshoot while its neighbours part on springs.glide, and the readout gives its name, code and the chip under the pointer in OKLCH with its light reflectance value; a click copies that chip as oklch() and a check pops onto it on springs.flick. It is a horizontal listbox: Left and Right move between paints, Up and Down step lighter and darker, Enter copies, Escape lowers the strip.

props.name: swatches
props.description: The paints, one strip each; chips are computed in OKLCH from hue and chroma.

props.name: strips
props.description: How many strips stand in the row, 3 to 12 (never more than swatches).

props.name: steps
props.description: Chips on each strip, palest to deepest, 4 to 9.

props.name: wave
props.description: How far the strips rise and fall in the travelling wave, 0 (still) to 1.

props.name: period
props.description: Seconds for one swell to pass, 2 to 14.

props.name: shade
props.description: How deep the darkest chip goes: 0 keeps to pale tints, 1 runs almost to black.

props.name: lift
props.description: How far a strip lifts clear when it is read, px, 6 to 28.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of a strip, px.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The strip being read, controlled or initial.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the hover, touch or key that lifted or lowered a strip.

props.name: onCopy
props.type: (color: string, info: { name, code?, step }) => void
props.description: Fires when a chip is copied, with its colour as oklch(L C H).

props.name: paper
props.description: The strips' card stock.

props.name: showReadout
props.description: Show the line under the row that reads the lifted strip.

props.name: label
props.description: The row's accessible name, also shown in the readout at rest.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the wave still.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No lifting or copying.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root.

usageNotes: Keyboard: one tab stop, a horizontal listbox with aria-activedescendant. Left and Right move between paints, Home and End jump, Up and Down step lighter and darker within the strip, Enter or Space copies the chip, Escape lowers the strip. Each option is labelled with its name, code, tint, oklch() value and LRV, and copies are announced politely.
Copy uses the Clipboard API; where it is unavailable the readout and the announcement say so and show the value instead. onCopy fires either way with the colour string.
Reduced motion: no travelling wave (the row holds a still, staggered arc) and the lift is an instant change; the ring, the readout and the copy check still answer.

Performance: DOM only. One requestAnimationFrame loop writes a transform per strip; it runs only on screen, in a visible tab, and while the wave is live or a spring is moving. wave={0} or paused lets it stop once settled.
The strips are physical card stock in a fixed paper pigment and the chips are absolute OKLCH colours, so the card reads the same on light and dark pages; the readout uses the page's ink tokens.

items.title: Spiral Engraving
items.tagline: A picture cut as one spiral line that turns inward.
items.description: A round plate engraved with one continuous spiral line whose width swells where the picture is dark and thins to an unbroken hairline where it is light, drawn per pixel in one WebGL2 pass that samples the picture at each pixel's own position. As the plate turns the line flows inward like a vortex while the picture holds still within it; a drag round the plate turns it 1:1 and a release keeps the throw's spin, easing back to the resting turn over a time set by friction. The first time it is seen the line swells from a hairline into the picture as a front runs out from the spindle. Arrow keys flick it either way, Enter flings it and Home brakes it.

props.name: pitch
props.description: Distance between neighbouring turns of the line, CSS px, 3 to 10.

props.name: contrast
props.description: How hard the picture's tones are pushed apart, 0.5 to 2.

props.name: spin
props.description: The resting spin in turns per minute, 0 to 60; the line flows by one pitch per turn.

props.name: subject
props.description: The picture drawn in code when there is no src.

props.name: src
props.description: An image URL to engrave (CORS-enabled); the subject stands in while it loads or if it cannot be read.

props.name: alt
props.description: What the picture shows, for assistive technology.

props.name: ink
props.description: The line's colour. A light ink on dark paper prints a white-line engraving (the line swells in light tones).

props.name: paper
props.description: The plate's colour.

props.name: thin
props.description: The line's width in the lightest tones as a share of the pitch, 0 to 0.4; it never breaks.

props.name: bold
props.description: The line's width in the darkest tones as a share of the pitch, 0.5 to 1.

props.name: friction
props.description: How quickly a fling slows back to the resting spin: 0 coasts long, 1 stops short.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way the line flows as the plate turns.

props.name: reveal
props.description: When the line swells from a hairline into the picture.

props.name: onSpinChange
props.description: Fires when the plate comes to rest, settles into its resting spin, or is flung faster.

props.name: label
props.description: The plate's accessible name.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the plate still; a drag still turns it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No dragging or keys.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root; it is square, so give it a width.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the plate is a role=button described by the picture's alt and a hint. Right and Up flick it with the spin, Left and Down against it, Enter or Space fling it, Home brakes it to its resting turn: the same end states as a drag. A polite live region says Flung, Turning or Still.
Touch: the drag turns the plate round its centre in two dimensions, so the plate sets touch-action: none; a tap gives it a small flick.
Reduced motion: no resting spin, no coasting and no cut animation; the picture is engraved at once and a drag (or a key, by a fixed step) still turns it, stopping where it is released.

Performance: one WebGL2 pass at a capped pixel ratio; the tone map is drawn once per subject or image. The loop runs only on screen, in a visible tab and while the plate turns; spin 0 and settled draws nothing. Context loss stops the loop and rebuilds on restore; without WebGL2 the same line is drawn as a ribbon on a 2D canvas, redrawn only while dragged.

Themes: ink and paper default to the page's foreground and card tokens, read from the component's own node and re-read when the theme changes; on a dark page the line becomes a white-line engraving rather than a negative.
The server draws an even hairline spiral (the uncut plate), so the first paint is designed before WebGL starts.

items.title: Pinscreen Swell
items.tagline: A pin toy that takes the shape of passing waves.
items.description: A pin-art toy seen face-on: a dense grid of steel pin heads in a dark plate, each drawn as a lit dome tilted by its neighbours' heights, so soft swells rolling underneath read as a rippling relief, with pins pushed back sinking into shadow and raised ones throwing short shadows. Pressing with the pointer leaves an impression of the path that relaxes and softens over a few seconds, and a click pushes in a deep round dent on springs.recoil, the pins bouncing back twice with a faint ring risen round it. Arrow keys move a press cursor, Shift with an arrow drags an impression, and Enter or Space pushes a dent.

props.name: pitch
props.description: Distance between pins, CSS px, 5 to 16.

props.name: depth
props.description: How far the pins travel: the strength of the relief, 0 to 1.

props.name: light
props.description: Where the light comes from, degrees clockwise from the top (315 is the upper left).

props.name: waves
props.description: How high the swell rolling underneath lifts the pins, 0 (flat) to 1.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the swell rolls, 0 to 1.

props.name: scale
props.description: The size of the swell's waves, 0.5 (choppy) to 2 (long).

props.name: brush
props.description: The radius of a pressed pointer's impression, in pins, 1 to 6.

props.name: dent
props.description: The radius of the dent a click pushes in, in pins, 2 to 12.

props.name: relax
props.description: Seconds for an impression to relax back, 0.5 to 10.

props.name: pinColor
props.description: The pins' metal; any CSS colour.

props.name: plateColor
props.description: The face plate; any CSS colour.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Pressing, clicking and keys leave impressions (and the surface takes focus).

props.name: onDent
props.description: Fires when a click or key pushes in a dent, with its pin column and row (from 1).

props.name: label
props.description: The pin screen's accessible name.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the swell still; impressions still relax.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the swell.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root; give it a height.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the surface is a focusable group (roledescription pin screen) described by a hint. Arrow keys move a press cursor two pins at a time, Shift with an arrow drags an impression along the way, Enter or Space pushes a dent at the cursor; each dent is announced with its column and row.
Touch: pressing is two-dimensional, so the surface sets touch-action: none; a tap pushes a dent and a press-drag leaves a trail.
Reduced motion: the swell holds still at a designed moment (the relief still reads) and dents go in without the recoil bounce; impressions still relax as a gentle fade of the relief.

Performance: two WebGL2 passes, one texel per pin for the heights and five texel fetches per pixel; the impression map is a small float grid allocated only on resize. The loop runs only on screen in a visible tab, at thirty frames a second while only the swell rolls, and stops when the swell is off (waves 0 or paused) and every impression has relaxed. Context loss is handled; without WebGL2 a CSS pin grid stands in, the same as the server's first paint.
The pins and plate are fixed metal pigments that read on light and dark pages; pass pinColor and plateColor for brass on walnut or chrome on white.

items.title: Ice Floes
items.tagline: Pictures on drifting floes across a dark sea.
items.description: An endless field of ice floes drifting on dark water, seen in CSS 3D from above at an angle, each a seeded irregular slab with a cyan body under the water, a visible thickness and a picture laid on its snow. Dragging glides over the water with the point under the finger held 1:1 and a throw that glides out; the floes have inertia, so they lag, bump as circles and turn with the slip of each bump. The first time it is seen the floes surface, near ones first; a click or Enter lifts a floe out of the water on springs.glide, turning it to face you with its caption and leaving a ring on the water, and lowering lands it back on springs.recoil with two bobs. Arrow keys move between floes on screen, the field gliding on springs.drift to keep the focused one in view; Home and End go to the first and last pictures and Escape lowers.

props.name: items
props.description: The pictures, one per floe, repeating across the field.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The item whose floe is lifted out of the water, controlled or initial.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the click or key that lifted or lowered a floe.

props.name: density
props.description: How crowded the water is, 0.2 (scattered) to 1 (packed).

props.name: drift
props.description: How fast the current carries the field, 0 (still water) to 1.

props.name: tint
props.description: The water's hue in degrees, at a fixed dark lightness.

props.name: heading
props.description: The way the floes travel on screen, degrees clockwise from up (180 comes straight toward you).

props.name: tilt
props.description: How steeply you look down at the water, degrees from straight down, 35 to 62.

props.name: size
props.description: Floe size, 0.7 to 1.4.

props.name: jostle
props.description: How much the floes lag, bump and turn when the water is moved, 0 to 1.

props.name: friction
props.description: How quickly a fling glides to a stop: 0 glides long, 1 stops short.

props.name: label
props.description: The field's accessible name.

props.name: paused
props.description: Still water: no current and no bobbing; a drag still moves the field.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No dragging, lifting or keys.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the floes' shapes and places.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root; give it a height.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the field is one tab stop, a listbox (roledescription ice field) whose options are the items, rendered on the server; the 3D floes are aria-hidden copies. Arrow keys move a focus ring to the nearest floe in that direction on screen and aria-activedescendant follows its item; Home and End go to the first and last pictures; Enter or Space lifts or lowers; Escape lowers. Lifts are announced with caption and note.
Touch: the drag is two-dimensional, so the field sets touch-action: none; a tap on a floe lifts it and a tap on the water lowers it.

Reduced motion: no current, bobbing, jostle or surfacing; a drag still moves the field 1:1 and stops on release, and a lifted floe is shown raised and facing you at once with its neighbours dimmed and the caption faded in.

Performance: CSS 3D on the compositor with no canvas; at most 48 floes, one transform and opacity write per floe per frame, floes off screen set to visibility hidden. The loop runs only on screen, in a visible tab, and while the current flows or something still moves; drift 0 and settled draws nothing.
The sea, ice and postcards are fixed pigments (the water's hue is tint), so the field reads the same on light and dark pages; pass items with src for your own pictures.

items.title: Text Bottle
items.tagline: A bottle of typed water you can tip.
items.description: A bottle typed on a fixed grid of monospace cells: its glass is one ring of edge glyphs that re-letters itself as it turns, and its water is a density ramp over a shallow-water simulation that conserves volume, so tipping it makes the water lag, run up the glass and slosh back. Dragging turns it 1:1 and a release projects the throw and lands on springs.glide with the release velocity; arrow keys tip it on springs.snap, whose one overshoot slops the water. Past the lip the water pours out of the neck in gulps as a ballistic stream of glyphs into a puddle, and stood upright it refills from a dripping tap.

props.name: tilt / defaultTilt
props.description: The bottle's angle in degrees, negative left and positive right; controlled or the uncontrolled start.

props.name: onTiltChange
props.description: Fires from the drag release or the key that tipped it, with the new angle in whole degrees.

props.name: viscosity
props.description: How thick the liquid is, 0 (water: quick waves, a fast glug) to 1 (syrup: slow, damped, a slow pour).

props.name: charset
props.description: The glyphs the water is typed in, light to heavy.

props.name: ramp
props.description: A custom density ramp, light to heavy, starting with a space; overrides charset.

props.name: fill
props.description: How full the bottle starts and refills to, 0 to 1.

props.name: maxTilt
props.description: The furthest it tips either way, 30 to 170 degrees.

props.name: refill
props.description: How long an upright bottle takes to refill from empty, ms; 0 never refills.

props.name: cellSize
props.description: The grid's font size in px; smaller is a finer, denser bottle.

props.name: waterColor
props.description: The water, any CSS colour, drawn at fixed lightness so it reads on both themes.

props.name: glassColor
props.description: The glass outline, any CSS colour; defaults to the ink at two thirds.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Fires when it starts or stops pouring, sloshing or refilling, or runs empty, with the level 0 to 1.

props.name: onLevelChange
props.description: Fires as the level passes each 5% step while it pours or refills.

props.name: sound
props.description: A glug loop while it pours, only after a tip by hand or key.

props.name: label
props.description: The slider's accessible name.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freezes the water: no waves, pouring or refilling; the bottle still turns.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No tipping by hand or key.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the piece; it fills a 448px-tall box by default.

usageNotes: It is a role="slider" for the angle: arrow keys tip it 10° (Shift 30°), PageUp/PageDown 45°, Home/End all the way, Enter or Space stand it upright. Its valuetext says the angle, the level and whether it is pouring or refilling, and a polite status says "Pouring.", "Empty." and "Full again." once each.

Under reduced motion the bottle turns at once and the water stays dead level; a pour still drains the level, drawn as a still column of glyphs, and a refill still raises it — the level is information, the slosh is not.

One Canvas 2D: per frame a few thousand signed-distance tests, a 60-column wave step at 240 Hz and glyphs drawn grouped by colour, with every buffer preallocated. The loop runs only while the bottle is on screen, the tab is visible and something moves, and stops once the water settles.
The glug is a loop that starts only after a visitor's drag or key tips the bottle past its lip, follows the flow and the level, and stops when the pour ends, on unmount or when sound is turned off.

Give it a tall box (360×560 or so): the bottle is sized so it still fits when tipped all the way, and the stream falls into the space below it. The server renders the upright bottle as SVG text; the canvas fades in over it.

items.title: Folded Steel
items.tagline: Twist the billet and the pattern comes up.
items.description: A polished bar of pattern-welded steel drawn per pixel in WebGL2: every pixel works out which layer of the twisted, pressed billet it was ground from, so twisting brings up chevrons and roses and folding presses waves into ladder rungs, etched dark with a crystalline grain and lit by a brushed sheen that follows the pointer on springs.glide. Dragging twists and folds it 1:1 and a release projects the throw and glides there; arrow keys step on springs.snap. A double click or Enter quenches it: a cool temper flash runs out from the strike and the layers relax straight on springs.drift, and the first time it is seen the etch comes up along it.

props.name: twist / defaultTwist
props.description: How far the billet is twisted, in turns along the bar, −3 to 3; controlled or the uncontrolled start.

props.name: onTwistChange
props.description: Fires from the drag release, key or quench that changed the twist, rounded to 0.05 turn.

props.name: fold / defaultFold
props.description: How deeply the layers are pressed into waves and ladder rungs, 0 to 1; controlled or the uncontrolled start.

props.name: onFoldChange
props.description: Fires from the drag release, key or quench that changed the fold, rounded to 0.05.

props.name: layers
props.description: How many layers were welded into the billet, 8 to 64.

props.name: etch
props.description: How deep the acid bit: 0 a polished blank, 1 dark sunk layers with a crystalline grain.

props.name: rungs
props.description: How many ladder rungs a full fold presses along the bar, 3 to 14.

props.name: sheen
props.description: The brushed sheen under the light, 0 to 1.

props.name: brightColor
props.description: The nickel-bright layers, any CSS colour; defaults to a cool steel from the tokens.

props.name: darkColor
props.description: The etched carbon layers, any CSS colour; defaults to a deep blued grey.

props.name: sheenColor
props.description: The light's colour on the brushed surface; defaults to a cool white.

props.name: reveal
props.description: When the etch first comes up: the first time it is seen, at mount, or already etched.

props.name: onQuench
props.description: Fires when a double click or Enter quenches the bar to straight layers.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The light follows the pointer and drags twist and fold.

props.name: label
props.description: The slider's accessible name.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the hand-forged wobble in the layers.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No twisting, folding or quenching.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the piece; the bar fills it less a small margin. 144px tall by default.

usageNotes: It is a role="slider" for the twist (−3 to 3 turns): ←/→ twist a quarter turn (Shift a whole one), PageUp/PageDown one turn, Home/End the limits, ↑/↓ fold by 10%, Enter quenches. The valuetext names the twist, the fold and the pattern they make; a quench is announced.
Under reduced motion the etch is there at once, twist and fold changes land without a spring, the sheen jumps to the pointer and the quench has no flash — every state still shows.

One WebGL2 fragment pass, drawn only when something changes (a spring, the light, the reveal or the quench) — there is no idle loop — and only while on screen with the tab visible. A lost context falls back to the CSS still and is rebuilt on restore; without WebGL2 the still bar (straight layers and a sheen) stays.
foldedSteelPattern(twist, fold) is exported for a status line: it names the pattern a smith would see — straight, waves, ladder, twist or rose.
Colours are resolved from the props on the component's own element and re-read when the theme changes; the metal keeps its own lightness so it reads on either page.

items.title: Tilled Horizon
items.tagline: Wavy furrows running to a low, striped sun.
items.description: A two-tone print of a ploughed field at dusk: furrows run away from you as fine wavy ribbons over rolling hills toward a low sun striped by haze, each drawn near to far so a crest hides the furrow behind it, heavy where the slope turns from the sun and hairline where it faces it, with the furrows in line with the sun taking its ink. The field glides slowly toward you. The pointer, or keyboard focus moving onto a control laid over it, slides the sun along the horizon on the springs.drift constants and the light rolls across every hill with it.

props.name: children
props.description: Content laid over the field in its own layer; it keeps every click and focus.

props.name: spacing
props.description: The furrows' spacing at the near edge, px: small is a fine engraving, large a few broad ribbons.

props.name: roll
props.description: How much the land rolls, 0 a flat field to 1 steep hills that hide the furrows behind them.

props.name: palette
props.description: The two inks the print is pulled in; the paper follows the page.

props.name: inkColor
props.description: Overrides the land's ink, any CSS colour.

props.name: sunColor
props.description: Overrides the sun's ink, any CSS colour.

props.name: paperColor
props.description: Overrides the paper; defaults to the page's background, warmed.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the field glides toward you, 0 (still) to 3.

props.name: horizon
props.description: Where the horizon sits, as a share of the height from the top, 0.2 to 0.7.

props.name: sunSize
props.description: The sun's diameter as a share of the height, 0.08 to 0.5.

props.name: haze
props.description: How strongly the haze stripes the sun and the sky, 0 to 1.

props.name: sun / defaultSun
props.description: Where the sun sits along the horizon, 0 left to 1 right; controlled or the uncontrolled start.

props.name: onSunChange
props.description: Fires when the pointer, a key or focus moves the sun, rounded to 0.01.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer over the scene, and focus moving between its children, steer the sun.

props.name: focusable
props.description: Makes the scene a slider tab stop that steers the sun with the arrow keys, for a field with no controls on it.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the sun slider when focusable.

props.name: paused
props.description: Holds the field still; the sun still moves.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the hills and the ridge.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the scene; 256px tall by default.

usageNotes: The painted scene is decoration (aria-hidden); children render above it and keep their clicks and focus. Keyboard focus landing on a child (focus-visible) moves the sun under it; with focusable the scene itself becomes a role="slider" (←/→ step 5%, Shift 20%, Home/End the ends).
Under reduced motion the field is a still print and the sun moves to the pointer at once, without drifting.

Canvas 2D: the furrows are batched into a few strokes by weight and fade, on an ink layer allocated only on resize, with the sun's glow laid source-atop. The loop runs only while on screen, the tab is visible and it is gliding or the sun is moving.

The paper mixes from the page background and the inks are mixed toward the foreground, so the print reads on both themes; colours are re-read when the theme changes. The server renders a CSS still of the sun and a fan of furrows.

items.title: Pulled Sugar
items.tagline: Glossy candy pulled and folded in slow loops.
items.description: A candy-pulling machine whose two arm pins orbit opposite ways round a fixed middle pin, with a rope of striped sugar looped over all three: a soft body of particles under gravity, carried by the pins' grip, that stretches plastically and necks thin where it is pulled and slowly gathers back. Every pass folds it over the middle pin, the stripes doubling along the rope from the fold until they read as satin, while a gloss highlight runs along the side of each span that faces a swaying light. Dragging an arm turns it 1:1 and the release sets the motor's speed, forwards or reversed, the flywheel easing to it on the springs.drift constants; arrow keys step the speed.

props.name: speed / defaultSpeed
props.description: The motor's speed in turns a minute, negative runs it backwards; controlled or the uncontrolled start.

props.name: onSpeedChange
props.description: Fires from the throw, key or stop that changed the motor's speed, in whole turns a minute.

props.name: stretch
props.description: How readily the sugar stretches, 0 stiff to 1 soft with long sags and thin necks.

props.name: gloss
props.description: How glassy the candy is, 0 matte to 1 a sharp, bright highlight.

props.name: palette
props.description: The candy's three colours.

props.name: colors
props.description: Three CSS colours for the stripes, overriding palette.

props.name: batch
props.description: Folds before a fresh batch drops on; 0 keeps pulling the same one.

props.name: maxSpeed
props.description: The fastest the motor turns either way, 10 to 90 turns a minute.

props.name: ropeWidth
props.description: The rope's thickness before it is pulled, in the machine's own units (it is drawn 280 wide).

props.name: onFold
props.description: Fires on every fold, and with 0 when a fresh batch starts, with the folds so far in this batch and the stripes across the rope.

props.name: label
props.description: The slider's accessible name.

props.name: paused
props.description: Stops the machine and the candy where they are.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No dragging or keys.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the stripes' order.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the piece; the machine scales to fit and centres. 224px tall by default.

usageNotes: It is a role="slider" for the motor speed: ←/→ (↓/↑) step 6 turns a minute (Shift 18), Home/End run it flat out backwards or forwards, Space stops and restarts it, Enter drops a fresh batch. The valuetext gives the direction, the speed and the stripes.
Under reduced motion the arms do not turn and the candy hangs still on the pins; speed changes are still reported, and a fresh batch swaps in place.

Canvas 2D with every buffer preallocated: a 120-particle rope at 120 Hz with ten constraint passes, drawn in fifteen chunks of stripe polygons. The loop runs only while on screen, the tab is visible and the motor turns or the rope is still moving; at rest it stops.

Letting go of a still arm leaves the motor at its speed; a throw sets a new one, which is how a drag reverses it. Candy colours are pigments at fixed lightness from the tokens, so they read the same on both themes.

items.title: Spin Art
items.tagline: Spin the disc; paint throws itself into spirals.
items.description: A spin-art turntable: drag round the card and it turns 1:1, then coasts from the release velocity on bearing friction and air drag; tap to drip. A drip lands as a blot with a little splash and breaks into threads that run outward under the spin's centrifugal pull while, in the card's own frame, the Coriolis effect bends them back against it — loose petals at a slow spin, long tight spirals at a fast one — with a gloss on the wet paint that fades as it dries matte. Arrow keys spin it up, Enter drips, Space brakes and Escape clears.

props.name: friction
props.description: How quickly the disc coasts down, 0 spinning on for many seconds to 1 stopping almost at once.

props.name: drips
props.description: The size of each drip, px of blot: small drips throw fine threads, big ones heavy ribbons.

props.name: palette
props.description: The paints, used in turn.

props.name: colors
props.description: CSS colours to drip in turn, overriding palette.

props.name: defaultSpin
props.description: The speed the disc starts at, turns a minute; negative is anticlockwise.

props.name: onSpinChange
props.description: Fires as the spin passes each 10 turns a minute and when it stops, from the hand, key or friction that changed it.

props.name: maxSpin
props.description: The fastest a throw or a key can spin it, 60 to 600 turns a minute.

props.name: runniness
props.description: How runny the paint is, 0 thick with short throws to 1 thin with long threads.

props.name: dryTime
props.description: How long paint stays wet and glossy, and can still be flung, ms.

props.name: intro
props.description: The first time it is seen the disc spins up and three drips land.

props.name: onDrip
props.description: Fires after each drip lands, with the drips on the card.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Fires when the card is cleared.

props.name: sound
props.description: A whir while the disc turns, after you spin it.

props.name: label
props.description: The slider's accessible name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No spinning, dripping or clearing.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds where keyboard drips land and how each one breaks up.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the piece; the disc fits inside and centres. 224px tall by default.

usageNotes: It is a role="slider" for the spin in turns a minute: ←/→ (↓/↑) add 30 either way (Shift 90), Home/End spin it flat out, Space brakes, Enter drips, Escape clears (it calls preventDefault so a surrounding dialog stays open). Drips and clears are announced.

Under reduced motion the card does not visibly turn: each drip resolves straight to its finished spiral using the spin at that moment, and a clear is instant; the spin value still changes and is announced.

Canvas 2D with one paint layer the size of the card, kept across resizes; rivulets come from a preallocated pool. The loop runs only while on screen and something moves — the spin, wet paint, a splash or a clear — and stops when the card is still and dry.
The whir is a loop that answers only the visitor's own spin (a drag or a key), follows the speed, and stops when the disc stops, on unmount or when sound is turned off; the intro is silent.

items.title: Lanyard Badge
items.tagline: A tiny LED badge you cycle through its patterns.
items.description: A small LED badge hanging on a printed lanyard: behind a smoked lens a crisp grid of square LEDs runs rippling waves in four PWM steps, the messages scrolling in a 5×7 pixel face, or simple pictures wiped in column by column, and two buttons on its edge cycle the mode and the brightness, each press travelling in on springs.flick with a click. Dragging the badge swings it on its lanyard as a pendulum held to its strap; on release a damped pendulum takes the throw while the badge rocks on its clip, a lighter hinge that lags and overshoots before both settle. The face is a button: Enter or Space push it, the arrow keys push it either way.

props.name: mode / defaultMode
props.description: What the screen runs: rippling waves, the messages scrolling, pictures, or all three in turn; controlled or the uncontrolled start.

props.name: onModeChange
props.description: Fires from the mode button with the new mode.

props.name: brightness / defaultBrightness
props.description: How bright the LEDs are: 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 or 1; controlled or the uncontrolled start.

props.name: onBrightnessChange
props.description: Fires from the brightness button with the new level.

props.name: messages
props.description: The messages the name mode scrolls in turn; letters, digits and simple punctuation.

props.name: pitch
props.description: LED pitch in px, 4 to 8: a finer pitch fits more, smaller LEDs.

props.name: color
props.description: The LEDs' colour: a preset or any CSS colour.

props.name: strapColor
props.description: The lanyard's colour; defaults to a deep navy from the tokens.

props.name: strapText
props.description: The word printed along the lanyard.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the screen runs — scrolling, ripples and pictures — 0.25 to 3.

props.name: swing
props.description: How freely the badge swings, 0 settling at once to 1 swinging on and on.

props.name: sound
props.description: A click from the side buttons.

props.name: label
props.description: The badge's accessible name.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freezes the screen.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No buttons, swinging or keys.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the piece; the badge scales to its width. 224px tall by default.

usageNotes: The side buttons are real buttons named for what they do ("Mode: Waves. Next: Name", "Brightness 3 of 4"); a polite status announces each change once. The face is a role="button" ("Swing the badge") whose description says what the screen shows: Enter or Space push it, ←/→ push it either way.

Under reduced motion the badge hangs still (a drag does nothing, a push is acknowledged in the status) and the screen shows still pages that turn every 2.4 s on a timer instead of a loop; the buttons still change the screen.

The LEDs are one Canvas 2D redrawn at thirty frames a second only while the badge is on screen, the tab is visible and the screen is not paused; the swing is motion values set from a fixed-step pendulum in the same loop, capped so the badge never swings out of its box.

The badge's width follows its container (164–228px) and a narrow box shows fewer LEDs rather than smaller ones. The housing and the LEDs keep their own colours on both themes; the engraved marks beside the buttons use the ink token.

items.title: Streak Pager
items.tagline: Swipe between slides and the stars streak sideways.
items.description: A slide pager over a quiet starfield: drag, swipe or press the arrows and the stars are thrown into sideways streaks that sweep into a warp point on the edge the slides travel toward, then shrink back to points as the new slide lands on springs.glide with the throw's velocity. A fast flick stretches the streaks further and tints them, a long jump warps hardest, and a landed slide's kicker rule draws in on springs.flick while the dots stretch on springs.snap. It is a carousel with one tab stop on the slides (arrow keys, Home and End), a dot tablist with roving focus and previous and next buttons.

props.name: items
props.description: The slides: title, alt, and optional kicker, body, caption and image src; pictures are drawn in code when src is absent.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The slide on screen, by index (controlled / initial).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the drag, key, button or dot that chose a new slide.

props.name: streak
props.description: How far the stars stretch into streaks at full speed, 0 to 1.

props.name: density
props.description: How many stars fill the sky, 0 to 1.

props.name: tint
props.description: The colour a fast swipe tints the streaks, any CSS colour.

props.name: parallax
props.description: How far the stars drift with the slides, 0 (fixed sky) to 1.

props.name: horizon
props.description: Height of the warp point on the edge, 0 (top) to 1 (bottom).

props.name: loop
props.description: Carry on from the last slide to the first.

props.name: interval
props.description: Autoplay every this many ms while nobody is using the pager; 0 never.

props.name: controls
props.description: Show the dots and the previous and next buttons.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the starfield.

props.name: onLand
props.description: Fires when a new slide has come to rest.

props.name: label
props.description: The carousel's accessible name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No dragging, keys or buttons.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the starfield's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the pager; give it a height. Defaults to h-56 w-full.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the slide area is one tab stop — Left and Right move a slide, Home and End jump; the dots are a tablist with roving focus; Previous and Next report aria-disabled at the ends instead of losing focus. Each landed slide is announced once, politely.
Reduced motion: slides cross-fade instead of travelling, the sky stays still and autoplay is off; a swipe past 40px still turns the page and the dots and count still update.

Performance: the stars are one Canvas 2D layer drawn in three strokes per frame, only while the pager moves or the streaks are relaxing, only on screen and while the tab is visible; at rest it is a still frame. DPR is capped at `dpr`.
Theming: the sky is the card surface and the stars are the foreground colour, so it reads as a night sky in dark mode and a star chart in light mode; colours re-resolve when the theme changes.
Autoplay (`interval`) pauses on hover, focus, drag, off screen and under reduced motion; at the last slide it comes back round to the first.

items.title: Acrylic Pour
items.tagline: Tilt the canvas; poured colours drift into cells.
items.description: A small canvas of poured acrylic: dragging tips it in 3D 1:1 under the hand and the paint runs downhill in WebGL2, each colour at its own pace so the rings shear and stretch, while lacy cells of a lighter layer open where the film thins. Released, the canvas settles level on springs.drift with the throw's velocity and the paint stays where it ran; a tap pours a new seeded composition that floods out cup by cup over the old one. The canvas is focusable: the arrow keys tilt it gently while held and Enter or Space pours anew.

props.name: seed / defaultSeed
props.description: The composition (controlled / initial); a new seed pours a new one over the old.

props.name: onSeedChange
props.description: Fires from the tap or key that asked for a new pour.

props.name: cells
props.description: How much the lighter layer breaks through as lacy cells, 0 to 1.

props.name: tilt
props.description: How far a drag tips the canvas and how freely the paint runs, 0 to 1.

props.name: palette
props.description: The paints: a named set, or up to five CSS colours.

props.name: pours
props.description: How many cups were poured, 2 to 7.

props.name: viscosity
props.description: How thick the paint is: runny and far-flowing (0) to heavy and creeping (1).

props.name: gloss
props.description: How glossy the wet paint looks, 0 to 1.

props.name: base
props.description: The lighter layer that shows through the cells, any CSS colour.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a pour while the paint runs.

props.name: onFlowChange
props.description: Fires when the paint starts and stops flowing.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the canvas for assistive technology.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the pour but takes no input.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the component (default h-52 w-full); the canvas is the largest square inside.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the canvas is one tab stop; hold an arrow key to tilt it that way (two keys tilt diagonally), let go to level it, and press Enter or Space for a new composition, which is announced.
Reduced motion: the canvas no longer tips in 3D and a new pour cross-fades instead of flooding; the paint still follows a drag, because that is direct manipulation.

Performance: the flow is a 128×128 half-float map advected only while the canvas is tilted or a pour floods in, on screen and while the tab is visible; at rest the canvas is a single still frame. DPR is capped at `dpr`, context loss rebuilds it, and without WebGL2 a still pour is drawn in CSS from the same seed.
Sound (`sound`): a pour loop follows the flow — louder and higher the steeper the tilt — and always stops when the paint settles; it never starts before the visitor has interacted with the page.
Palettes are pigments taken from the theme tokens at fixed lightness, so a pour looks the same in light and dark themes; pass `palette` as five CSS colours for your own.

items.title: Vantage Cube
items.tagline: A cube of loose letters that reads from one angle.
items.description: A wireframe cube of loose letters floating at different depths that turns to follow the pointer on a spring set by `lag`: from most angles it is a scatter, but at each word's vantage its letters line up in perspective, one size on one baseline. Near a vantage the cube is drawn toward it and inside `snap` degrees it locks on springs.snap — the word brightens, a rule draws under it and a glint sweeps across it — and leaving the box drifts it home on springs.drift to lock again. It is a slider over the words: arrow keys turn the cube to the next or previous word on springs.glide, Home and End jump.

props.name: words
props.description: The words hidden in the cube, each with the yaw and pitch (degrees) it reads from.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The word the cube shows, by index (controlled / initial).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires when a different word locks, from the pointer, a drag or a key.

props.name: density
props.description: How many loose letters fill the cube besides the words, 0 to 1.

props.name: depth
props.description: How far the letters are spread in depth, 0 (nearly flat) to 1 (the whole cube).

props.name: lag
props.description: How lazily the cube follows the pointer, 0 (at once) to 1 (slow and heavy).

props.name: snap
props.description: How close to a vantage, in degrees, the cube snaps to it and locks.

props.name: range
props.description: How far the cube turns toward the pointer at the box's edge, in degrees.

props.name: perspective
props.description: Viewing distance in cube widths; lower is a stronger wide-angle look.

props.name: glint
props.description: Sweep a glint across a word when it locks.

props.name: edges
props.description: Draw the cube's edges.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds where the letters float.

props.name: onLock
props.description: Fires each time a word locks, including a return to the same word.

props.name: label
props.description: The cube's accessible name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No following, dragging or keys.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the cube's box; give it a height. Defaults to h-52 w-full.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the cube is a slider over its words — Left/Right (or Up/Down) turn to the previous or next word, Home and End jump — and the locked word is announced once; aria-valuetext always names the current word.
Reduced motion: the cube holds still at the current word's vantage, ignores the pointer, and keys swap words with a short cross-fade instead of a turn.

Performance: every letter's 3D place is a static transform computed once from the seed; only the cube's own rotation and a few CSS variables change per frame, and the spring loop stops as soon as the cube settles or leaves the screen.

Choose vantages at least three `snap` widths apart and within `range` (pitch within 0.7 × range) so each is reachable by the pointer; loose letters are placed clear of every word's row so each word reads clean.

The cube is sized from its box with container units, so it renders the same on the server and fits any height; touch and pen drag it 1:1 and a release locks to a vantage near where the throw would land.

items.title: Pillow Print
items.tagline: A puffed vinyl card that dimples where you press.
items.description: An image card printed on an inflated vinyl pillow: a WebGL2 mesh bulges out, draws in at the middle of each edge and wrinkles where the welded seam gathers into the corners, under a softbox gloss that slides across the bulge as the pillow leans toward the pointer on the glide spring. Pressing pushes a soft dimple in under the finger on the snap spring, drawing the print into it while the rest puffs out to keep its air; letting go pops it back on an underdamped spring set by `stiffness`, overshooting into a little bump and wobbling level. It is a real button: Space or Enter held presses at a point the arrow keys move, key up releases, and Escape lets go of a held press.

props.name: src
props.description: An image to print instead of the drawn pass; for WebGL it must be same-origin or CORS.

props.name: alt
props.defaultValue: a description of the drawn pass
props.description: What the print shows, for assistive technology.

props.name: puff
props.description: How inflated the pillow is, 0 (nearly flat) to 1 (fully puffed).

props.name: gloss
props.description: How glossy the vinyl is, 0 (satin) to 1 (wet shine).

props.name: stiffness
props.description: How firm the pillow is: soft and slow with three wobbles (0) to quick with one (1).

props.name: depth
props.description: How deep a press pushes in, 0 to 1.

props.name: radius
props.description: How wide the dimple is, 0 (a fingertip) to 1 (a palm).

props.name: wrinkle
props.description: How much the vinyl wrinkles at its welded seams, 0 to 1.

props.name: tilt
props.description: How far the pillow leans toward the pointer, 0 to 1.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play the vinyl's blups on press and release.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Fires as a press pushes in.

props.name: onRelease
props.description: Fires as a press lets go.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the pillow for assistive technology.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the pillow but takes no presses.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the box (default h-52 w-full); the pillow is the largest 1.42:1 card inside.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the pillow is a button — hold Space or Enter to press at the keyboard point (a ring shows where), move it with the arrow keys, even while held, and let go to release; Escape releases a held press.
Reduced motion: no lean and no wobble; the dimple still appears under a press and eases straight back on a short tween.

Performance: one 72×72 mesh lit per pixel from the same height function, drawn only while a press, a wobble or the lean is moving, on screen and while the tab is visible. DPR is capped at `dpr`; context loss rebuilds it.
Without WebGL2 (and as the server's first frame) the print shows as a CSS pillow card with shading and a dimple drawn where it is pressed, so nothing is lost on older devices.
Sound (`sound`): a low blup as the press goes in and a brighter one as it pops back, panned to where it was pressed.

items.title: Graded Wash
items.tagline: Two colours pulled down a tilted board into one.
items.description: A sheet of cold-press paper on a tilted board receives a graded watercolour wash: a flat brush lays it stroke by stroke, each stroke tops up a bead of wet paint along the bottom of the painted area, and the colour it carries hands over from the first to the second while the bead mixes what it holds, so the change is a true gradation. Between strokes gravity creeps the bead down the slope; dragging tips the board 1:1 in 3D — steeper, flatter or leaning — and the water runs along the bead to the low side, pooling and running further there, before the board settles back on springs.drift with the throw's velocity. Where the bead lingers it leaves soft tide lines, the wash dries lighter than it went on, and the board is focusable: the arrow keys tip it while held and Enter or Space lays a new wash.

props.name: colors
props.description: The two colours, top into bottom: a named pair or two CSS colours.

props.name: wetness
props.description: How much water the wash carries: dry brush and quick to dry (0) to soft, pooling and slow to dry (1).

props.name: tilt
props.description: The board's resting slope in degrees, 0 (the bead stalls) to 30 (it runs).

props.name: lean
props.description: The board's resting lean to the side, −1 (left low) to 1 (right low).

props.name: strokes
props.description: How many strokes lay the wash, 4 to 12.

props.name: pace
props.description: How long one stroke takes to cross the paper, in ms.

props.name: grain
props.description: How much tooth the paper has, 0 (smooth) to 1 (rough and granulating).

props.name: trigger
props.description: When the first wash is laid.

props.name: washKey
props.description: Change it to lay a new wash from outside.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Fires as the wash paints (once per stroke), dries and is dry.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Fires when a wash has dried.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the board for assistive technology.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the wash but takes no input.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the board; give it a height. Defaults to h-52 w-full.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the board is one tab stop — hold Left or Right to lean it, Up or Down to flatten or steepen it, let go to settle it, and press Enter or Space to lay a new wash; painting, drying and dry are announced politely.
Reduced motion: no brush travel and no board movement — each wash is computed to dry at once with the current tilt and cross-fades in.

Performance: the paper is a Canvas 2D grid at half the CSS size, composed with one putImageData and one scaled drawImage per frame, only while paint is wet, on screen and while the tab is visible; a dry wash is a still canvas. DPR is capped at `dpr`.

Colour: pixels are light through the two pigments mixed in absorbance on the paper's own colour, so the hand-over passes through a real subtractive middle; the paper and paints are pigments from the theme tokens at fixed lightness, the same in light and dark themes.
Before the first wash (and on the server) the paper shows a finished CSS wash of the same two colours, so the card never looks blank.

items.title: Fog Cloche
items.tagline: Fog under glass that spills out when lifted.
items.description: A glass cloche over a cushion of moss in a small vitrine lit from above, with fog slowly swirling under the glass: soft puffs circle the vertical axis, rising in the middle and sinking at the sides. A press lifts the glass on springs.snap and the fog rolls out from under the rim, lowest first, over the wooden base and across the floor to both sides, spreading and thinning away; pressing again brings the glass down on springs.glide, it settles with a small springs.recoil rock, and new fog breathes up out of the moss until the dome is full. The glass is a real toggle button with aria-pressed, so Space and Enter lift and lower it.

props.name: lifted / defaultLifted
props.description: Whether the glass is lifted (controlled / initial).

props.name: onLiftedChange
props.description: Fires from the press or key that lifted or lowered the glass.

props.name: density
props.description: How much fog the glass holds, 0 (a few wisps) to 1 (thick).

props.name: swirl
props.description: How fast the fog turns under the glass, 0 (still) to 1 (a slow whirl).

props.name: spill
props.description: How far the fog runs across the floor when it spills, 0 (pools at the base) to 1 (to the edges).

props.name: light
props.description: How strong the light from above is, 0 to 1.

props.name: fogColor
props.description: The fog's colour, any CSS colour.

props.name: gather
props.description: How long the fog takes to gather again under the lowered glass, in ms.

props.name: autoLower
props.description: Lower the glass by itself this many ms after it is lifted; 0 never.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freeze the fog.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the fog and the moss.

props.name: label
props.description: The glass's accessible name, completed with lift or lower.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No lifting or lowering.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the vitrine; give it a height. Defaults to h-52 w-full.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the glass is a native toggle button — Space or Enter lifts and lowers it, aria-pressed reports lifted, its name says what pressing will do, and each change is announced once.
Reduced motion: the glass cross-fades between down and up instead of travelling, and the fog is a still cloud that fades out when lifted and back in over `gather` when lowered.

Performance: the fog is up to 180 soft puffs drawn from one cached sprite on a Canvas 2D layer; it animates only while on screen, visible and not `paused`, and once lifted the loop stops as soon as the spilled fog has thinned away. DPR is capped at `dpr`.
The vitrine is a dim alcove in both themes (fixed art from the theme tokens at fixed lightness), so the fog reads on a light page and a dark one; `fogColor` can tint it.
Before the live fog is drawn (and on the server) the dome shows a soft still fog, so the first frame is finished.

items.title: Etched Bricks
items.tagline: An image laid in glass bricks, one letter each.
items.description: A wall of glass blocks, each etched with one character chosen from a density ramp by the brightness of the picture behind it, so clear glass, light marks and dense letters together read as the picture, with every block glowing warm in proportion as if lit from behind. Every few seconds a slow diagonal band of light sweeps through the wall and each block it crosses turns once on its vertical axis on the springs.snap constants, thinning to a sliver over its dark slot, swapping to another character of the same weight at the halfway point and glinting along its bevel while edge-on; the pointer carries a lamp of its own whose core turns the blocks it reaches, once each. The wall is a real button: arrow keys move the lamp and Enter or Space sends a sweep.

props.name: src
props.description: A picture of your own to lay in the wall (same origin, or served with CORS). Without one, scene is drawn.

props.name: scene
props.description: The picture drawn in code when there is no src: a sun half risen over the sea, a snow peak under the moon, or a crescent moon over hills.

props.name: alt
props.description: What the picture shows; it names the wall for assistive technology.

props.name: ramp
props.description: The density ramp, darkest first: one entry per level, its characters the alternates a brick turns between.

props.name: brick
props.description: Brick width in px; rows and columns are fitted to the box and the bricks stretched a little to fill it.

props.name: bevel
props.description: How deep the bevel and the pillowed face read, 0 (flat glass) to 1.

props.name: glow
props.description: How strongly the backlight and the lamp light the glass, 0 to 1.

props.name: light
props.description: The backlight's colour; lit glass is the glass plus this light, summed in linear light.

props.name: glass
props.defaultValue: a deep --accent pigment mixed into the page
props.description: The glass's own tint where no light comes through.

props.name: sweep
props.description: Send a slow sweep of light through the wall every sweepEvery ms.

props.name: sweepEvery
props.description: Time between sweeps, in ms.

props.name: sweepDuration
props.description: How long one sweep takes to cross the wall, in ms.

props.name: radius
props.description: The pointer lamp's radius, in px.

props.name: flip
props.description: Bricks turn over to a new character as light passes them.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the wall still: no sweeps, though the lamp still lights it.

props.name: onSweep
props.description: Fires as a sweep starts, whether from the timer, a click or a key.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the wall but takes no input.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the wall; it fills its parent by default.

usageNotes: The wall is a transparent native button over the canvas, named by alt and described by a hint. Keyboard focus lights a lamp at the centre with a ring round it; arrow keys move it a brick at a time (Shift for three), and Enter, Space or a click sends a sweep. Touch lights the lamp under the finger while vertical scrolling stays with the page.

Under reduced motion nothing travels or turns: the wall rests under a still diagonal wash, the lamp lights it directly, a block the lamp reaches changes its character on a 150 ms cross-fade, and a click or key brightens the whole wall and fades it back.

Canvas 2D drawn from sprites made once per size (bevel, glint and a glyph atlas) and a 64-step colour ramp, so a frame allocates nothing. The loop runs only while a sweep crosses, a block turns or the lamp eases; between sweeps a timer waits, and both stop off screen and in a hidden tab.

Colours are the canvas's own computed colours, re-read when the theme changes; the glass mixes into the page so the wall sits in light and dark themes, and the light is a pigment that looks the same in both.
A src picture is sampled once per layout (three by three samples per brick); it must be same-origin or served with CORS, or the drawn scene stays.

items.title: Flip Sequins
items.tagline: Brush the sequins and they flip to the other side.
items.description: A panel of glossy two-faced sequins in overlapping rows that you draw on by brushing: the sequins under the brush turn over in the direction of travel, each disc squashing along the stroke, changing face at 90° and opening out again on its own spring at the springs.snap constants (ζ 0.83, loosened toward a flutter by wobble), with a glint running along its axis while edge-on. Brushing with the fabric's nap turns them over and brushing back smooths them home, so pictures and words can be drawn and erased; a long still press sends a ring out from the finger that turns every flipped sequin home inside one 600 ms beat. Arrow keys brush, Shift lifts the brush, Enter or Space turns the sequins under it and Backspace smooths the panel.

props.name: sequin
props.description: Sequin diameter, in px.

props.name: flipColor
props.description: The colour of the other face: a named pigment or any CSS colour.

props.name: shine
props.description: How glossy the faces are and how bright the glint is as one turns, 0 to 1.

props.name: color
props.description: The home face's colour.

props.name: fabric
props.description: The fabric showing between the sequins.

props.name: nap
props.description: The fabric's nap in degrees: brushing along it turns sequins over, brushing against it smooths them home; strokes across it do nothing.

props.name: brushOn
props.description: A mouse brushes on hover, or only while its button is down. Touch and pen always brush while pressed.

props.name: radius
props.description: The brush's reach, in sequins.

props.name: wobble
props.description: How loose each turn is, 0 (one crisp overshoot) to 1 (a fluttering settle).

props.name: holdToSmooth
props.description: How long a still press must be held to smooth the whole field, in ms.

props.name: text
props.description: A word turned over into the field when it is laid out, fitted to its width, so the first frame says something.

props.name: onFlipChange
props.description: Fires from the stroke, press or key that changed the field (and once when it is laid out), with how many sequins show their other face.

props.name: onSmooth
props.description: Fires when a long press or Backspace smooths the field.

props.name: sound
props.description: A shimmer as sequins turn, pitched up for over and down for home, after a visitor's stroke or key.

props.name: label
props.description: The field's accessible name.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the field but takes no input.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the panel; it fills its parent by default.

usageNotes: The panel is a transparent native button over the canvas, named by label and described by a hint written from the nap. Arrow keys move a ringed brush one sequin and brush the way they move; Shift with an arrow lifts the brush, Enter or Space turns the sequins under it, and Backspace or Delete smooths the panel. The flipped count is spoken after a key, never per pointer move.
Touch draws exactly as a pressed mouse does, so the panel takes touch-action: none while enabled; a disabled panel hands scrolling back to the page.

Under reduced motion nothing turns or travels: a brushed sequin cross-fades between its faces in 150 ms and smoothing is one 240 ms fade; the gloss stops following the pointer. Drawing works exactly the same.

Canvas 2D from an atlas of both faces at four gloss levels, built once per size and colour; still sequins are one drawImage each and only turning ones take a transform. The loop runs only while a sequin turns or the smoothing ring travels, and never off screen or in a hidden tab.
Sound plays only for the visitor's own strokes, presses and keys, and never before the page has had a click, tap or key press, so a hover across a fresh page stays silent.

items.title: Catenary Glow
items.tagline: Sagging wires at dusk with warmth running along.
items.description: Power lines strung between wooden poles across a dusk sky, hanging in true catenary sags and glowing faintly, while every few seconds a warm current runs along each wire in turn, top line first: a short bright pulse with a long fading tail whose halo widens as it passes. Every span is a string held at both insulators and integrated as a damped wave at 120 Hz, so a pointer brushing across a wire strikes the node it crossed with the stroke's own speed and a gentle travelling wave runs out both ways, reflects at the poles and dies away, the wire brightening while it moves. Arrow keys choose a wire and a point along it, Enter or Space plucks it, and a tap or click near a wire plucks it there.

props.name: children
props.description: Content over the sky, in its own layer: a headline, a reading, a call to action.

props.name: wires
props.description: How many lines are strung between the poles, 2 to 6.

props.name: sag
props.description: How deep the catenaries hang, 0 (taut) to 1 (slack); the lowest line always clears the hills.

props.name: warmth
props.description: The colour of the current and the glow: 0 a cool white, 1 deep amber.

props.name: span
props.description: Distance between poles in px; by default fitted so two to four poles show.

props.name: interval
props.description: Time between currents, in ms.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast a current runs along a wire, in px per second.

props.name: sway
props.description: How readily a brush or pluck sets the wires swinging, 0 to 1.

props.name: stars
props.description: A few faint early stars.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer and keys can set the wires swaying.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the currents; the wires still sway when brushed.

props.name: onPluck
props.description: Fires when a tap, click or key plucks a wire, with its index from the top.

props.name: label
props.description: The scene's accessible name, for the keyboard's way in.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the scene but takes no input.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the scene; it fills its parent by default.

usageNotes: A transparent native button behind the children is the keyboard's way in: Up and Down choose a wire (its halo brightens and a ring marks the pluck point), Left and Right move along it, Enter or Space plucks it, and Escape lets go, handled so a surrounding dialog stays open. Children render above in their own layer and keep their own semantics.

Under reduced motion nothing travels or sways: each wire's warm glow fades in where it hangs and out again at the same cadence, and a brush, tap or pluck brightens the wire for a moment instead of moving it.

One SVG whose sky, hills, poles and stars are static server-rendered markup. Per frame only the moving wires' paths and the pulse gradients' ends are written straight to their nodes, with no React render; the loop runs only while a current travels or a wire moves, and both it and the interval timer stop off screen and in a hidden tab.
The dusk is fixed art built from token hues at fixed lightness, so it reads the same on light and dark pages; put light text over it (text-primary-foreground reads on the sky and hills).
Touch keeps vertical scrolling (touch-action: pan-y): a tap near a wire plucks it, and a short brush sways the wires before the page takes the gesture.

items.title: Bias Stripes
items.tagline: Diagonal stripes that stretch toward your hand.
items.description: Bands of colour run across the frame at an angle like fabric cut on the bias, and the cloth reaches for the hand: a Gaussian pull draws every point toward the pointer, so the stripes bend toward it, the band under the hand is drawn thin, its neighbours bunch beside it and the bands further out stretch to reach in, while a moving hand drags the bias along a little. The hand follows the pointer on the springs.glide constants and the pull rises on them; when the hand leaves, the pull relaxes on a softer spring that swings past flat by springiness and settles, and a click snaps a ripple through as a wave packet that kinks every band it crosses. Arrow keys move a ringed hand, Enter or Space ripples from it and Escape lets go.

props.name: children
props.description: Content on top of the cloth, in its own layer; its controls keep their presses.

props.name: angle
props.description: The bias: the stripes' angle from horizontal, in degrees.

props.name: pull
props.description: How hard the hand draws the cloth, and how big a ripple is, 0 to 1; held short of folding the cloth through itself.

props.name: palette
props.description: The dye set, four pigments repeating, the same in either theme.

props.name: colors
props.description: Colours of your own, repeating in order; overrides palette.

props.name: stripe
props.description: Band width, in px.

props.name: reach
props.description: How far the pull reaches, in px; held under 45 % of the shorter side.

props.name: drag
props.description: How much a moving hand drags the bias along with it, 0 to 1.

props.name: springiness
props.description: How far the cloth overshoots past flat when the hand lets go, 0 (none) to 1 (a visible bounce).

props.name: ripple
props.description: A click or tap snaps a ripple through the cloth.

props.name: texture
props.description: A fine twill over the bands and soft fold shading where the cloth is pulled.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer and keys pull the cloth.

props.name: onRipple
props.description: Fires when a click, tap or key sends a ripple, with its centre in px from the top left.

props.name: label
props.description: The cloth's accessible name, for the keyboard's way in.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the cloth but takes no input.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the cloth; it fills its parent by default.

usageNotes: A transparent native button behind the children is the keyboard's way in: focus places a ringed hand at the centre, arrow keys move it (Shift for larger steps), Enter or Space sends a ripple from it, and Escape lets go, handled so a surrounding dialog stays open; blur lets go too.

The pointer is read from the container, so children stay fully interactive and a press on one of their controls never ripples the cloth. Touch pulls while the finger is down, so an enabled cloth takes touch-action: none.

Under reduced motion there are no springs and nothing travels: the cloth takes the pull's exact shape at the hand on each move and lets go at once, and a click draws a ring that fades in 240 ms instead of a ripple.

One SVG polygon per band. Boundaries are sampled every 8 px and pushed through the field only while the hand, the pull or a ripple moves, and only near the hand unless a ripple is travelling; settled bands are exact four-point polygons and the loop stops, and it never runs off screen or in a hidden tab.
Palettes are pigments at fixed lightness taken from the theme's hues, so a cloth reads the same on light and dark pages; pass colors for a brand's own dyes.

items.title: Interlace Load
items.tagline: An image arriving the old way, pass by pass.
items.description: An image that arrives the way old progressive images did: coarse blocks first, then each pass fills the gaps at a finer resolution behind a faint scan line running down the frame, the picture above the line at the new resolution and below it still at the last, with the freshly arrived rows briefly brighter, until the last pass lands the sharp picture with one small lift of light that settles away. The scheme is interlaced rows stretched over the rows still missing, a halving grid of up to seven passes, or a coarse-to-fine averaged scan, and each pass's time follows how much data it carries. It starts when half in view, on mount, from a Load button or from the play prop, and a Load again button fades in on an enter tween once it has landed.

props.name: src
props.description: The picture to load, cover-fitted. Without one, a lake valley at first light is drawn in code.

props.name: alt
props.description: What the picture shows.

props.name: scheme
props.description: How the passes arrive: interlaced rows, a halving grid (width, then height), or a coarse-to-fine averaged scan.

props.name: passes
props.description: How many passes, 3 to 7; the first is coarser the more there are, and the last is always the sharp picture.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the data arrives, as a multiple of a 3.2 s load.

props.name: trigger
props.description: What starts the load: being half in view, mounting, a Load button over the placeholder, or the play prop alone.

props.name: play
props.description: Starts the load when it turns true and clears back to waiting when it turns false; overrides trigger.

props.name: delay
props.description: A wait before the first pass, in ms.

props.name: scanLine
props.description: The faint scan line the data arrives behind, and the brighter fresh rows above it.

props.name: replayButton
props.description: A small Load again button once the picture has landed.

props.name: onPassChange
props.description: Fires as each pass begins, counting from 1.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Fires when the last pass lands.

props.name: caption
props.description: A caption laid over the lower left of the picture, shown in every phase.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the frame; it fills its parent by default.

usageNotes: The picture is a role="img" element named by alt and aria-busy while it loads; a polite live region says "Loading image." and "Image loaded.", never once per pass. The Load and Load again buttons sit outside the image as native buttons with names, h-8 boxes and solid focus rings.

Under reduced motion there is no scan line and nothing travels: each pass appears whole on a 150 ms cross-fade from the last and holds for its share of the time, because the passes are the information; the landing is a fade.

Canvas 2D. The picture is drawn or decoded once per size, and every pass's picture is a small canvas scaled up without smoothing, so a frame is two drawImage calls, a gradient band and a line. The loop runs only while loading; off screen or in a hidden tab its clock stops and the load resumes where it was.

A src image needs no CORS: its pixels are drawn, never read. Changing scheme, passes or speed once a load has started replays it on the new schedule, so the change is seen at once; before it starts nothing moves.
The placeholder is the server's first frame: the surface token with a hairline hatch and a small mono mark, so it sits in either theme until the picture arrives.

items.title: Carriage Windows
items.tagline: Drag the carriage; the view slides past each window.
items.description: A carousel built as the side of a railway carriage seen from the platform, a painted body with a cream window band, rounded windows each holding a view, and wheelsets on a rail. Dragging moves the carriage 1:1 while each view slides more slowly behind its glass, offset by the window's distance from the middle times the parallax, so every window has depth and the glass's reflection slides the other way with the speed; a flick is projected to where it would rest and the carriage runs to the nearest window on the springs.glide constants seeded with the release velocity. Rail joints lie every 96 px, and each time a wheel rolls over one the body dips and recovers on springs.recoil and, with sound on, a soft clack plays, so a fast flick clatters and an arrival gives one last clack; arrow keys step a window, Home and End go to the ends.

props.name: items
props.type: { src?: string; alt: string; caption?: string }[]
props.description: The views, one per window; without a src each is drawn in code (six views along a coast line by default).

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The window at the centre, controlled or initial.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the drag, flick, click or key that brought a new window to the centre.

props.name: parallax
props.description: How far behind the views seem, 0 (painted on the glass) to 1 (far away).

props.name: gap
props.description: The panel between windows, in px.

props.name: radius
props.description: The windows' corner radius, in px.

props.name: windowWidth
props.description: Window width in px; by default fitted to the height and held to 72 % of the box.

props.name: livery
props.description: The carriage's paint, pigments that read the same in either theme.

props.name: friction
