props.name: palette
props.description: The scene's colours: an overcast day on a light page and a night with a lit window on a dark one, or fixed.

props.name: windowLight
props.description: Light the cottage window.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer sets the wind, a click sends a gust, and the keys do both.

props.name: sound
props.description: Plips as a gust's spray and the next drips land; silent until a visitor clicks or presses a key.

props.name: onGust
props.description: Fires when a gust is sent, with the way it blows.

props.name: onWindChange
props.description: Fires when the wind settles to a new value, rounded to one decimal.

props.name: onPuddleChange
props.description: How full the puddle is, 0 to 1, rounded to two decimals, at most twice a second.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freeze the rain.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the tiles, the hills and the rain.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the scene.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the scene is one focusable group with a hint. Left and Right step the wind a quarter at a time (announced), Enter or Space sends a gust the way the wind blows, so a keyboard reaches everything a pointer does. A gust is announced from the click or key that sent it.

Sound only answers a visitor: with `sound`, a gust arms plips for under two seconds, timed to the spray and the drips landing in the puddle and panned by where they land; the ambient rain is always silent.

Performance: the canvas is the size of the grid (about 240 × 70 cells in a 720 × 208 box) and CSS scales it up with `image-rendering: pixelated`, so there is no pixel-ratio cost. The still scene is rasterised once into a buffer; each frame copies it and writes only the moving cells from fixed-size pools, then one putImageData. Nothing runs off screen, in a hidden tab or while `paused`.

With `palette="auto"` the scene follows the page: an overcast day on a light page, a night with a warm lit window on a dark one; captions inside take matching tokens. Fixed palettes put their content under the matching theme so it stays readable.

Under reduced motion it is a still frame: the rain is frozen at the wind's angle (and redrawn when the wind changes), the puddle shows two rings, and a gust shows a still sheet of spray that clears after 400 ms.

items.title: Card Stunt
items.tagline: A stand of flip cards making waves and pictures.
items.description: A grandstand of tiny seated figures, each holding a card at the chest, together making a mosaic that steps through a routine of pictures and words. Each change arrives as a wave of flips: every card turns half over about its horizontal axis as the front reaches its holder — sweeping, rising, bursting from the centre or running on the diagonal, each holder a few hundredths early or late — darkening as it goes edge-on so you glimpse the face behind it, and landing on the snap spring showing its other side; between frames a stadium ripple sometimes rolls across. Pointing at a section makes it jump the gun and flip early; a click steps on, and with the stand focused Right and Left step the routine (back runs the wave the other way), Home and End jump and Space pauses it.

props.name: frames
props.description: The pictures and words, in order: each `{ text }` (set in a 3 × 5 pixel font), `{ picture }` (rows of 0–3) or `{ draw(col, row, cols, rows) }`, with an optional `label` and `wave` ("sweep" | "rise" | "burst" | "diagonal").

props.name: rows
props.description: Tiers of seats, 4 to 12; the columns follow the width so seats stay near square.

props.name: wave
props.description: Speed of the flip front across the stand, 0.25 to 3.

props.name: palette
props.description: Four card pigments: entries 0 (field), 1 (light), 2 (accent) and 3 (deep).

props.name: colors
props.description: Four CSS colours for entries 0–3; overrides `palette`.

props.name: interval
props.description: Time from one frame to the next while auto-playing, the wave included, ms.

props.name: index / defaultIndex
props.description: The frame shown, controlled or not.

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Fires from the key, click or timer that moved it, with the new index.

props.name: autoPlay
props.description: Step through the frames on its own while in view.

props.name: ripple
props.description: Let a stadium ripple roll across the stand between frames.

props.name: earlyFlip
props.description: Seats near the pointer jump the gun and flip to the next frame early.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Clicks, hover and the keys.

props.name: sound
props.description: Swishes that travel with a step's wave and a quiet one for an early flip; silent until a visitor clicks or presses a key.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the current frame.

props.name: onPausedChange
props.description: Fires when Space pauses or resumes auto-play.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds faces, hair, shirts and each holder's timing.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the stand.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the stand is one focusable group. Right/Down step to the next frame, Left/Up to the previous one with the wave reversed, Home and End jump, and Space pauses or resumes auto-play (the pause moving content needs). Each step a visitor makes is announced with the frame's label ("Frame 2 of 4: GO"); timed steps are not announced.

Give each frame a `label`: it is what assistive technology hears. Text frames use a built-in 3 × 5 pixel font (A–Z, 0–9 and a few marks) scaled to the stand, so keep words short enough for narrow stands (two or three letters at a phone's width).

Performance: the stand and its people are drawn once per size to an offscreen layer; a frame redraws only the cards (a rect each) and only while a wave, ripple or flip is live, then the loop stops. The auto-play timer runs only in view and while the tab is shown, and the backing store is capped at `dpr`.

Card colours are pigments (the same in both themes); the stand behind them takes `--secondary`, so it sits in a light or a dark page. Pass `colors` to use your own tokens, e.g. `["var(--accent-bright)", "var(--card)", "var(--signal)", "var(--ink)"]`.
Under reduced motion there are no waves, flips or ripples: a step cross-fades the whole mosaic in 150 ms and early flips change colour at once.

items.title: Ant Column
items.tagline: Pixel ants that find their way to your pointer.
items.description: A pixel-art colony on a Canvas 2D grid, run as a two-scent forager model: ants pour out of the nest, follow food scent with three sensors and a seeded wander, and an ant that reaches the pointer's scent or a crumb walks home on the home scent and its own bearing, laying food scent, so within seconds the search condenses into a neat single-file column round every pebble and every element marked data-obstacle. The scent follows the pointer on springs.glide, so the column's head swings after it and the body wobbles as the ants re-route; a click drops a crumb that lands on springs.recoil and is carried home a bit at a time while the nest's rim flicks bright. The keyboard's way in is one focus stop: arrow keys move the scent, Enter or Space drops a crumb at it, Escape lifts it.

props.name: ants
props.description: How many ants live in the nest, 10 to 400.

props.name: pheromone
props.description: How strong and how lasting the scent trails are, 0 (faint, quick to fade, loose paths) to 1 (bold, lasting, a tight column).

props.name: pixel
props.description: The size of one pixel of the colony, in px, 2 to 6. Ants are two pixels long.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the ants walk, 0 to 1.

props.name: wander
props.description: How much each ant meanders off its line, 0 (marching) to 1 (dithering).

props.name: nest
props.description: Where the nest's mouth sits, as fractions of the box.

props.name: crumbs
props.description: Crumbs already on the ground when the colony starts, as fractions of the box.

props.name: crumbSize
props.description: How many bits a crumb breaks into: one ant carries one bit home.

props.name: obstacles
props.description: Pebbles the ants walk round: centres as fractions of the box, radii in px.

props.name: avoidContent
props.description: Ants also walk round any element inside the colony marked data-obstacle, such as a card in your content.

props.name: antColor
props.description: The ants' colour, any CSS colour; resolved on the element so it follows the theme.

props.name: trailColor
props.description: The scent trails' colour.

props.name: crumbColor
props.description: The crumbs' colour: a pigment at a fixed lightness, so it reads the same in both themes.

props.name: earthColor
props.description: The nest mound's and the pebbles' colour.

props.name: children
props.description: Content above the colony: a heading, a card, a call to action. Mark a card data-obstacle and the column routes round it.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer leaves a scent the ants seek and a click drops a crumb; the keys do both.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the colony where it is.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the colony for assistive technology.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds every ant's wander and every crumb's shape, so two colonies never walk alike.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: onCarry
props.description: Fires each time an ant brings a bit home, with the colony's total so far.

props.name: onCrumb
props.description: Fires when a crumb is dropped, with its place in px from the box's top left.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the colony at work but takes no input.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the box.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the colony is one focus stop (a button behind your content). Focus puts the scent down in a free spot; arrow keys move it (Shift for bigger steps), Enter or Space drops a crumb at it, Escape lifts it. A click or tap drops a crumb where it lands; a touch drag moves the scent.

Reduced motion: the column is laid at once along the shortest route round every obstacle (a grid search pulled taut) and holds still; a dropped crumb still empties into the nest a bit a second, so the count keeps climbing.

Performance: a fixed 60 Hz step on small typed arrays, one putImageData and one scaled drawImage a frame, nothing allocated per frame. The loop runs only while the colony is on screen, the tab is visible and something lives; once every ant is home and the scent has gone, it stops until the next input.
Content: children sit above the colony and stay fully interactive. Mark a card or heading with data-obstacle and the ants route round it; the colony re-reads its outline whenever it resizes.
Theming: every colour is resolved on the element and re-read when the theme changes; crumbs are a pigment at a fixed lightness so they read the same on light and dark pages.

items.title: Readout Skew
items.tagline: A scan band that bends anything moving fast.
items.description: A small studio seen through a rolling-shutter camera, drawn per pixel in one WebGL2 pass: a band sweeps down the frame every readout and each row shows the scene as it was when the band last crossed it, so a spinning propeller bends into curved petals that re-form every sweep and the puck, whose position is kept for four seconds at 60 Hz, leans and wobbles like jelly when it moves fast, while the static grid and floor never bend. The puck is a real slider: a drag follows 1:1 and rubber-bands past the stops, a release slides on with friction and bounces off them, and a click on the track or the arrow, Page, Home and End keys send it on springs.snap, quick enough to lean; a puck released past a stop returns on springs.glide.

props.name: readout
props.description: How long the band takes to read the frame top to bottom, in ms, 200 to 2000. Slower readout, stronger bends.

props.name: bands
props.description: How many strips the sensor reads at once, 1 to 4: the bends repeat strip by strip with a seam between.

props.name: skew
props.description: How far each row's moment is pushed, 0 (no distortion: every row now) to 2 (twice the honest skew).

props.name: spin
props.description: How fast the propeller turns, in revolutions a second, 0 to 6.

props.name: blades
props.description: How many blades the propeller has, 2 to 6.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The puck's place along its track, 0 to 1: controlled, or where it starts when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the drag, click or key that moved the puck, with where it will come to rest, 0 to 1.

props.name: glow
props.description: How bright the scan band's roll of light is, 0 to 1.

props.name: bladeColor
props.description: The propeller's colour, any CSS colour; resolved on the element so it follows the theme.

props.name: puckColor
props.description: The puck's colour: a pigment at a fixed lightness.

props.name: bandColor
props.description: The scan band's colour.

props.name: hud
props.description: Show the viewfinder's corner marks and readout label.

props.name: children
props.description: Content above the scene: a caption, a heading, a call to action.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The puck can be dragged, thrown and moved with the keys.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the band and the propeller where they are; the puck still answers.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the puck's slider for assistive technology.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the scene but takes no input.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the box.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the puck is a real slider (0 to 100 percent along its track). Arrow keys move it 5 percent, Page Up and Page Down 25, Home and End to the stops, each on the snap spring, fast enough that the shutter leans it on the way.

Reduced motion: the band and the clock stop and the frame becomes one still capture whose rows keep their readout ages, so the propeller still shows its petals; the puck moves straight to each new place with no lean, and readout, bands and skew still redraw the still.

Performance: one fragment pass with no loops over the scene; the puck's history is a preallocated 256-sample buffer uploaded as 64 vec4 uniforms. The loop runs only while the scene is on screen, the tab is visible and it is not paused; a paused scene draws only when the puck moves.
Fallback: without WebGL2 the server's still stays, a capture traced row by row in JS with the same readout maths, and the slider still works.
Theming: colours are resolved on the element and re-read on theme change; on dark pages the band adds light, on light pages it tints.

items.title: Fascicle Run
items.tagline: Fly down a nerve bundle as signals race past.
items.description: An endless flight down the inside of a nerve bundle, drawn per pixel in one WebGL2 pass with your content on top: every view ray is intersected with four concentric layers of a curving tube, so soft translucent fibres spiral along the walls with real parallax between layers, narrow at regular nodes, and carry signals racing past in both directions that flare at the nodes they jump between; at intervals a branch opens in the wall and the nearest fibres bend toward it and peel away. The pointer steers the camera across the bundle on springs.drift's constants with a gentle bank, and a held press speeds the flight up on the same spring, widening the view and stretching the signals into streaks. The keyboard's way in is a button behind your content: arrow keys steer, holding Space or Enter speeds up, Escape recentres.

props.name: strands
props.description: How many fibres line the bundle, across all its layers, 8 to 48.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the flight cruises, 0 (hovering) to 2.

props.name: pulse
props.description: How often signals race along each fibre, 0 (a rare pulse) to 1 (a busy bundle).

props.name: boost
props.description: How many times faster the flight goes while a press is held, 1 to 6.

props.name: curve
props.description: How much the bundle bends, 0 (dead straight) to 1.

props.name: branches
props.description: How often a side branch opens and fibres peel away into it, 0 (never) to 1 (often).

props.name: steer
props.description: How far the pointer steers the camera within the bundle, 0 to 1.

props.name: fiberColor
props.description: The fibres' colour, any CSS colour; resolved on the element so it follows the theme.

props.name: pulseColor
props.description: The signals' colour.

props.name: children
props.description: Content above the flight: a hero line, a heading, a call to action.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer steers and a held press speeds up; the keys do both.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the flight and the signals where they are; steering still answers.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the flight for assistive technology.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the fibres' places, the signals and the branches, so two bundles never match.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: onBoostChange
props.description: Fires when the visitor's hold speeds the flight up (true) or lets it ease back (false).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the flight but takes no input.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the box.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the flight is one focus stop (a button behind your content). Arrow keys steer the camera within the bundle, holding Space or Enter speeds the flight up until the key is released, and Escape recentres. A polite status says when it speeds up and when it cruises again.
Reduced motion: the flight is one still frame with a branch opening just ahead and signals held mid-race; steering and the hold are switched off and the hint says so.

Performance: one fragment pass, four layers with three fibre lookups each and analytic depth. Large boxes render at three-quarter resolution; the loop runs only while the flight is on screen, the tab is visible and it is not paused. Context loss is handled and rebuilt on restore.

Theming: the tissue's tone comes from the page: a dark page gives a deep, self-lit bundle with glowing fibres, a light page a pale milky one where fibres read as soft blue lines and signals as saturated light. Colours are re-read when the theme changes.
Without WebGL2 the server's still stays: fibres converging on a soft glow, drawn with CSS gradients in the theme's colours.

items.title: Tidal Bore
items.tagline: One long wave running upriver at dusk.
items.description: A river seen from above at an angle at dusk, drawn per pixel in one WebGL2 pass with your content on top: screen points are cast onto the water so the meandering river narrows into a hazy far reach between dark banks, and the water mirrors the dusk sky more at grazing angles, with the low sun's glitter. A single long wave runs upriver against the current, a steep front with its crest and a train of whelps; the low sun shines through the thin crest as a glowing thread, it breaks into lace-white foam at the banks and outer bends, and the next bore enters every interval. The pointer sets the bore's height on springs.glide and leaving eases it back on springs.drift; a click sends a bore at once. The height is a real slider: Up and Down set it, Enter or Space sends a bore, Escape hands it back to the prop.

props.name: height
props.description: How tall the bore stands, 0 (a ripple) to 1 (a breaking wall). The pointer and keys set it live; leaving returns here.

props.name: glow
props.description: How strongly the crest glows where the low sun shines through it, 0 to 1.

props.name: interval
props.description: Seconds between one bore and the next, 4 to 20.

props.name: current
props.description: How fast the river runs down toward you, 0 (still) to 1.

props.name: meander
props.description: How hard the river bends, 0 (a straight channel) to 1.

props.name: foam
props.description: How much white water breaks at the banks and bends, 0 to 1.

props.name: dusk
props.description: How late in the evening it is, 0 (golden hour) to 1 (the last light).

props.name: sunColor
props.description: The low sun's colour: a pigment at a fixed lightness, so it reads the same in both themes.

props.name: waterColor
props.description: The water's own tone, any CSS colour; resolved on the element so it follows the theme.

props.name: gauge
props.description: Show the tide gauge at the right edge, which reads the bore's height.

props.name: children
props.description: Content above the river: a hero line, a heading, a call to action.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer sets the height and a click sends a bore; the keys do both.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the river and its bores where they are.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the height control for assistive technology.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the river's bends, so two rivers never match.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: onBore
props.description: Fires when a bore starts upriver, with how many have run so far.

props.name: onHeightChange
props.description: Fires from the pointer or key that set a new height, 0 to 1.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the river running but takes no input.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the box.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the river is one focus stop, a vertical slider for the bore's height. Up and Down move it 5 percent, Page Up and Page Down 20, Home and End to the ends; Enter or Space sends the next bore at once; Escape hands the height back to the prop. A tap sends a bore and a vertical touch drag sets the height.

Reduced motion: one still frame with a bore held two-fifths up the river, its crest lit and its whitecaps at the banks; a new height redraws it at once, and a bore sent is counted and announced with a single fade of the crest's light.

Performance: one fragment pass with an analytic bore profile and short noise for the current and the foam; large boxes render at three-quarter resolution. The loop runs only while the river is on screen, the tab is visible and it is not paused.

Theming: the sky, the water and the banks are mixed from the page's tone, the water colour and the sun pigment, so a dark page shows the last light and a light page golden hour; colours are re-read when the theme changes.
Without WebGL2 the server's still stays: dark banks closing on the river in perspective, a warm haze and one glowing crest.

items.title: Drip Clock
items.tagline: One drop a second, each ring keeping time.
items.description: A minimal water clock seen from above, in Canvas 2D: a drop falls into a dark stone basin every second, seen shrinking as it falls with its shadow sliding in, flicks a small crown of spray and sends one thin ring outward, a lit crest over a dark trough; when the ring reaches the lip it lights that second's tick, so the sixty ticks fill round the rim, and in lively water a fainter reflection runs back in to the centre. At the sixtieth tick the rim drains in one cascade and the minute's drop lands with a double ring; tempo can follow the wall clock or a prop. A click drops a drop of your own whose ring crosses the clock's and sounds a plip; the basin is a real button whose aim follows the arrow keys on springs.snap, with Enter or Space dropping at it and Escape hiding it.

props.name: tempo
props.description: What sets the drops: "clock" lands one on every second of the wall clock; "slow" (40 a minute), "fast" (120 a minute) or a number of drops a minute follow this prop instead.

props.name: damping
props.description: How quickly a ring loses its light, 0 (lively water: rings reach the lip bright and run back in) to 1 (still, heavy water).

props.name: tone
props.description: The basin's stone and the rings' light, as pigments that read the same in both themes; also the drop's pitch.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a plip when your own drop lands. The clock's drops are always silent.

props.name: ringSpeed
props.description: How fast a ring runs outward, in px a second at a 94 px basin, 40 to 300.

props.name: ticks
props.description: Show the sixty ticks on the lip that the rings light.

props.name: basinColor
props.description: The basin's colour, overriding the tone.

props.name: ringColor
props.description: The rings' colour, overriding the tone.

props.name: interactive
props.description: A click (or Enter at the aim) adds a drop of your own.

props.name: paused
props.description: Stop the drops; rings already in the water run out.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the clock for assistive technology.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: onTick
props.description: Fires when a ring reaches the lip and lights its tick, with the second it counts, 0 to 59.

props.name: onMinute
props.description: Fires when the sixtieth tick lights and the minute rolls over.

props.name: onDrop
props.description: Fires when your drop lands, with its place in px from the basin's centre.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the clock keeping time but takes no drops.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the box; the basin is the largest circle that fits.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the basin is a real button. Arrow keys move an aim on the water (Shift for bigger steps), Enter or Space drops a drop at it, Escape hides the aim. A hidden timer reads the seconds counted; a polite status says "Drop added." and "Minute complete." and nothing every second.
Sound: only your own drops sound, a plip pitched by the tone and panned by where it lands, and only when sound is on; the clock's drops never make a sound.

Reduced motion: no ring travels or reflects and no drop is seen falling: each drop shows a still ring that fades, the ticks still light each second and still drain at the minute, and your drops show where they land.

Performance: Canvas 2D with at most 24 rings and one cached light gradient; one timer at a time sets the next drop and it is cleared while the clock is off screen or the tab is hidden, then re-aligned to the wall clock on return. DPR is capped.

Theming: each tone is a pair of pigments taken from the theme's hues at fixed lightness, so the stone and its light read the same on a light page and a dark one; basinColor and ringColor override them.

items.title: Lotus Beads
items.tagline: Water beads on a leaf that merge as they meet.
items.description: Beads of water on a waxy leaf, drawn per pixel in one WebGL2 pass as one smooth field, so two that come close join with a neck; each is shaded as water on a leaf that repels it, with the veined leaf beneath magnified and turned over, a dark rim, a sharp highlight, light gathered on the far side and the bright caustic it focuses into its own shadow. Dragged, a bead follows the finger 1:1 and rolls on with little friction when let go; nearing another it stretches a neck toward it, and past the merge distance the two snap into one larger bead, volume and momentum kept, that jiggles with the springs.recoil damping ratio and settles round, while a throw faster than splitSpeed splits it into droplets that fan out and roll apart. Every bead is a real button: Tab moves between them, arrow keys roll the focused one, Enter or Space flicks it so it splits, and focus stays with the bead you rolled through a merge.

props.name: beads
props.description: How many beads sit on the leaf at the start, 3 to 14.

props.name: tension
props.description: Surface tension, 0 (soft, flat beads that reach for each other from far off) to 1 (tight, round beads that hold apart until they touch).

props.name: tint
props.description: How much colour the water carries, 0 (clear) to 1 (deeply tinted).

props.name: sound
props.description: Play the beads' sounds: a blup as two merge, a higher one as a bead splits.

props.name: friction
props.description: How soon a rolling bead stops, 0 (it glides on and on) to 1 (it stops short).

props.name: splitSpeed
props.description: How fast a throw must be to split a bead into droplets, in px a second, 500 to 3000.

props.name: leafColor
props.description: The leaf's colour: a pigment at a fixed lightness, so it reads the same in both themes.

props.name: waterColor
props.description: The colour the water takes on as tint rises.

props.name: lightAngle
props.description: Where the light comes from, in degrees: 0 from the right, 90 from below, 225 from the upper left.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Beads can be dragged, thrown and rolled with the keys.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the leaf but takes no input.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds where the beads sit and how big they are.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: onMerge
props.description: Fires when two beads merge, with how many beads are left.

props.name: onSplit
props.description: Fires when a bead splits, with how many droplets it made.

props.name: onBeadsChange
props.description: Fires whenever the number of beads changes, with the new count.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the group of beads for assistive technology.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the box.

usageNotes: Keyboard: every bead is a button in a labelled group. Tab moves between beads, arrow keys roll the focused one (Shift for a harder push), Enter or Space flicks it so it splits; focus stays with the bead you rolled when it merges into another. A polite status reports each merge and split with the new count.

Reduced motion: drags still follow the finger, but nothing rolls on or wobbles. A bead let go near another merges at once, arrow keys move a bead one step, and a split sets its droplets down around it.
Sound: a blup as two beads merge, lower for a bigger bead, and a higher one as a bead splits; only with sound on and only after the visitor has touched the page.

Performance: one fragment pass over at most 24 beads; the physics steps at 120 Hz only while a bead moves, wobbles or is held, and the frame is drawn on demand once the leaf is still. Bead buttons are positioned by direct style writes, not by React state.
To start again, remount with a new key (the demo's Reset does this) or change seed or beads.

items.title: Table Spread
items.tagline: Sweep a deck across the table, then turn it over.
items.description: A deck squared on a felt table that sweeps into a long, even line under the hand: every card the hand passes is left at its slot while the rest ride on beneath it, and a release commits by projection on springs.glide carrying the hand's velocity. Flicking the first card sends a turnover wave down the spread — each card lifting, turning about its long edge in perspective and landing as the front passes, at turnSpeed cards a second — while a hovered card raises its edge on springs.flick and a picked card steps out of the line and flips face up on springs.snap. The cards are real buttons in a roving tabindex: arrows and Home/End move, Enter picks, T turns the spread over and Escape gathers the deck.

props.name: cards
props.description: The deck, bottom card first: { id, rank, suit }. Fifteen seeded cards by default.

props.name: spacing
props.description: How much of each card shows in the spread, as a fraction of its width; a narrow table tightens it to fit.

props.name: turnSpeed
props.description: How fast the turnover wave runs along the spread, in cards per second.

props.name: felt
props.description: The cloth: a preset pigment or any CSS colour.

props.name: backColor
props.description: The colour printed on the card backs, any CSS colour.

props.name: spread / defaultSpread
props.description: Whether the deck lies spread across the table.

props.name: onSpreadChange
props.description: Fires from the sweep, tap or key that spread or gathered the deck.

props.name: faceUp / defaultFaceUp
props.description: Whether the spread lies face up. A host that changes it gets the same wave a flick would.

props.name: onFaceUpChange
props.description: Fires when a turnover wave the visitor started has turned the whole spread.

props.name: picked / defaultPicked
props.description: The id of the card picked out of the line, or null.

props.name: onPickedChange
props.description: Fires from the tap or key that picked a card or put it back.

props.name: lift
props.description: How far a hovered card's edge rises, px.

props.name: intro
props.description: Spread the deck by itself the first time it comes into view, silently.

props.name: label
props.description: The table's accessible name.

props.name: sound
props.description: Paper sounds for the sweep, each card the wave lands and the pick.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the table as it is; nothing sweeps, turns or picks.

props.name: className
props.description: Size the table with a height class; the cards follow its height and the spacing tightens to fit its width.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the squared deck is a button (Enter, Space or Right spreads it and focus moves to the first card); in the spread the cards are a roving tabindex — Left/Right and Home/End move, Enter or Space picks or puts back, T turns the whole spread over, Escape gathers it and returns focus to the deck.

Pointer: drag the deck right to sweep it out (left to gather); flick the first card toward the rest to start the turnover wave — once about four cards are over it carries on by itself; a tap picks a card. The table is touch-pan-y, so vertical page scrolling still works over it.

Reduced motion: nothing travels or turns — the spread appears laid with a short fade, a turnover swaps every card's face with a cross-fade and a pick steps out of the line at once; values and announcements are unchanged.

Accessibility: a face-down card is named only by its place (“Card 4 of 15, face down”); its rank and suit are spoken once it is face up or picked. Spread, gather, turn and pick are announced politely.
Performance: there is no loop — motion values only move during a gesture or a commit, as transforms on composited cards; the felt's fibre is a static SVG filter painted once.
Theming: the felt, card stock and inks are fixed pigments so the table reads the same in light and dark; pass any CSS colour to felt or backColor.

items.title: Glassine Album
items.tagline: An old album, tissue leaves and all, turned by hand.
items.description: A photo album opened flat, its heavy card pages holding mounted prints with a sheet of cobweb-printed glassine between every leaf. Drag a page toward the spine and its edge stays under the finger; the tissue lying on it floats over first on springs.drift, its outer panels billowing on light under-damped springs while the print beneath mists or clears, then the page turns on a spring sprung from weight and lands with a slight bounce. The album is a carousel region: arrows and Page Up/Down turn, Home and End jump, and Enter or Space lifts or lays the tissue.

props.name: photos
props.description: The prints in order, one per page on both sides of every leaf: { src?, alt, caption? }. Eight sepia and silver prints drawn in code by default.

props.name: title
props.description: The album's name, lettered on the bookplate inside the front cover.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The open spread: 0 is inside the front cover, the last shows the back endpaper.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the drag, tap or key that turned to a new spread.

props.name: weight
props.description: How heavy the card pages are, 0 to 1: heavy pages turn slower and carry more momentum into their landing.

props.name: tissue
props.description: How opaque the glassine is, 0 to 1, and so how misted a print beneath it looks.

props.name: paperTone
props.description: The card the pages are made of, with a caption ink to match.

props.name: flutter
props.description: How much the tissue billows as it floats over, 0 to 1; 0 turns it as one flat sheet.

props.name: corners
props.description: Mount the prints with photo corners.

props.name: printed
props.description: Print the faint cobweb on the tissue.

props.name: label
props.description: The album's accessible name.

props.name: sound
props.description: Paper sounds: a light one as a tissue lifts, a heavier one as a page lifts, a low one as it lands.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the album as it is; nothing turns.

props.name: className
props.description: Size the album by its width; its height follows (open left and right from 560px, top and bottom below).

usageNotes: Keyboard: the album is one focusable carousel region — Right and Page Down turn forward, Left and Page Up back (Down and Up too when it opens top and bottom), Home and End jump to the covers, Enter or Space lifts or lays the tissue; every turn announces the pages and their captions.

Pointer: drag a page's free edge toward the spine (a flick commits by projection); a tap on a page lifts or lays its tissue, or turns the page when the tissue is already clear of it. The album is touch-pan-y open wide and touch-pan-x open tall, so the page still scrolls the other way.
Reduced motion: nothing rotates or billows — a turn cross-fades the spread and a tissue fades from one page to the other, while the misting of the print beneath still follows it.

Performance: only the tissue's panel flutter runs a frame loop, and only while it moves, on screen, in a visible page; pages and tissues are separate layers carrying their own transforms, and the misted print is a copy blurred once by an SVG filter, cross-faded by opacity.
Theming: the board, card stock, inks and glassine are fixed pigments, so the album reads the same in light and dark; prints are plain images (any src), drawn in code by default.
Layout: the album lays itself out by its own width with a container query, so it can sit in a narrow card (top-bound) and a wide plate (left and right) without a prop.

items.title: Coaster Track
items.tagline: A sentence riding a coaster through its loops.
items.description: A marquee drawn as a roller coaster in fine line work, its sentence riding one letter to a car: towed up the chain lift, slowed by gravity on every climb and hurried down every drop, eased by rolling friction and stopped on the brake run, so the sentence bunches over the crests, stretches on the drops and rides upside down through the loop. Holding the lift hill grabs the chain, which runs up to towBoost times faster on springs.snap and eases back on springs.drift when let go; a drag along it tows at the finger's pace. The chain is a real button — hold Space or Enter to tow — and the sentence is read once from an sr-only copy.

props.name: text
props.description: The sentence the cars carry, split by grapheme so emoji and accents ride whole.

props.name: as
props.description: The element that carries the sentence, once, for assistive technology.

props.name: track
props.description: A preset ride built to the box — classic (drop, hump, loop), camel (falling humps), twin (two loops) — or your own { x, y, lift? } points in 0–1 of the box, smoothed into a curve.

props.name: gravity
props.description: How hard the drops pull, 0.4 to 2: more gravity, faster drops, more bunching and stretching.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Car spacing at the station, in em.

props.name: speed
props.description: Station speed in em per second; the chain lift runs a little slower.

props.name: towBoost
props.description: How many times faster the chain tows while it is held.

props.name: friction
props.description: Rolling friction, 0 to 1.

props.name: separator
props.description: Ridden between one pass of the sentence and the next.

props.name: cars
props.description: Draw the little cars under the letters; off, the letters ride bare.

props.name: supports
props.description: Draw the support struts down to the ground.

props.name: trackColor
props.description: The track's colour, any CSS colour.

props.name: carColor
props.description: The cars' colour, and the chain's while it tows.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Ride whenever the track is on screen, or only while it is hovered or holds focus.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold every car where it is.

props.name: onLap
props.description: Fires each time a whole pass of the sentence has left the track, with the count.

props.name: onTowChange
props.description: Fires when the chain is grabbed and when it is let go.

props.name: className
props.description: Size the ride with a height class; the letters take the inherited font size and the track is rebuilt to the box.

usageNotes: Accessibility: the sentence is read once from an sr-only copy in the `as` element; the drawing and every riding letter are hidden from assistive technology. The chain lift is a real button (aria-pressed while towing): hold Space or Enter to tow, an assistive click tows for a moment.
Pointer: press and hold anywhere over the lift hill to grab the chain; drag along it to tow at your own pace. The handle is touch-none, so a tow never scrolls the page.
Reduced motion: nothing rides — the sentence is parked along the station and the lift, letters standing on the track — and holding the chain changes only its state.

Performance: one frame loop moves the cars, writing one transform per visible car, and only while the ride is on screen, the page visible and not paused (or hovered, with trigger="hover"). The track is sampled once per size; each fresh ride is pre-rolled silently to steady flow, so it never starts bunched at the platform.

Layout: the ride is rebuilt to its box — on a narrow box the drop shrinks and optional humps and loops drop out rather than running off the edge; on a wide one drops and humps stretch to ride it edge to edge.
Theming: track and cars default to tokens and letters use the foreground colour, so it reads in light and dark; the server renders the parked frame and the live ride cross-fades in over it.

items.title: Heat Putty
items.tagline: Soft putty that blushes colour where you warm it.
items.description: A soft blob of thermochromic putty on a stone slab: a resting pointer warms the spot beneath it and a halo of colour spreads outward through the palette as the heat diffuses in a small WebGL2 field, while the putty slumps wider and lower on springs.drift's constants as it warms. Moving away lets it cool fastest where it is thin, so the colour draws back from its edges inward and a rested hand leaves a fading print; a press squashes it on springs.snap and lets it go on springs.recoil with two wobbles. The putty is a button: focus puts a hand on it, arrow keys move the hand and Space or Enter held presses.

props.name: warmth
props.description: How quickly a resting hand warms the putty, 0.2 to 2; a moving hand warms it far less.

props.name: cooling
props.description: How quickly it cools back, 0.2 to 2.

props.name: palette
props.description: The thermochromic pigment from cool to hot: a preset, or 2–5 CSS colours mixed in linear light.

props.name: handprints
props.description: How long a rested hand's print lingers, 0 (gone at once) to 1 (a long while).

props.name: slump
props.description: How much warmth softens the putty so it slumps wider and lower, 0 to 1.

props.name: squash
props.description: How far a press flattens it, 0 to 1.

props.name: hand
props.description: The radius of a warm touch, px; a press warms a palm half as wide again.

props.name: seed
props.description: The blob's outline: any number gives its own lump.

props.name: slab
props.description: Draw the stone slab it rests on (the page's own surface colour); off, it sits on whatever is behind with its contact shadow.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Pointer, touch and keys warm and press it.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the putty as it is: no warming, no cooling.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Device-pixel-ratio cap for the canvas, at most 2.

props.name: onHeatChange
props.description: Fires with the putty's mean warmth, in tenths, as it changes.

props.name: label
props.description: The putty's accessible name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the putty as it is; nothing warms or presses it.

props.name: className
props.description: Size with a height class; the putty fits the box's height.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the putty is a button — keyboard focus puts a hand (a ring) on it that warms where it rests, arrow keys move it (Shift for longer steps), Space or Enter held presses; Warm, Hot and Cooled are announced politely as the mean warmth crosses them.
Pointer and touch: resting warms, moving barely does, pressing squashes and warms a palm-sized print. The putty is touch-none, so pressing and moving on it never scrolls the page.
Reduced motion: the putty never slumps, squashes or wobbles; the colour still spreads and cools, because the colour is the information.

Performance: one small WebGL2 heat field (at most 128 cells wide, half-float where supported) and one shading pass, drawn only while there is heat, a hand or a spring moving, on screen and in a visible page; it stops when the putty has cooled and settled. DPR is capped at 2, context loss is handled and everything is disposed on unmount.
Fallback: without WebGL2 a drawn blob in the palette's coolest pigment stands in; the server renders the same stand-in, so the first paint is never blank.
Theming: the palette is fixed pigment so the colours read the same in both themes; the slab is the page's surface token, re-read when the theme changes.

items.title: Picket Arc
items.tagline: A narrow violet arc with a green picket fence.
items.description: A night sky as a background, drawn in one WebGL2 pass behind its content: deep blue-black over a low ridge with faint airglow and sparse twinkling stars, crossed by a single narrow arc of violet light with a row of short green streaks hanging beneath it like a picket fence, each flickering on its own and drifting along the arc as the arc sweeps slowly across. The pointer bends the part of the arc nearest it toward itself on springs.glide's constants, and a horizontal drag carries the arc 1:1 and lets a throw coast on before the slow sweep resumes. The sky is aria-hidden and never takes a click from the content; the keyboard's way in is a transparent button behind it, where Left and Right sweep the arc and Up and Down bend it.

props.name: children
props.description: Content shown above the sky, in its own layer; its links and buttons keep their clicks.

props.name: sweep
props.description: How fast the arc sweeps across the sky, 0 (still) to 2.

props.name: pickets
props.description: How many green pickets hang beneath the arc, 8 to 64; a narrow sky shows proportionally fewer.

props.name: hue
props.description: The arc's hue, degrees on the OKLCH wheel.

props.name: fenceHue
props.description: The fence's hue, degrees.

props.name: arcWidth
props.description: How thick the arc and its halo are, 0.5 to 2.

props.name: flicker
props.description: How much the pickets flicker, 0 to 1.

props.name: stars
props.description: How many stars, 0 to 1.

props.name: bend
props.description: How far the pointer bends the arc toward itself, 0 to 1.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer bends the arc, a drag sweeps it, and the keyboard control is present.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the sky still.

props.name: seed
props.description: Places the stars and shapes the ridge.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Device-pixel-ratio cap for the canvas, at most 2.

props.name: label
props.description: The keyboard control's accessible name.

props.name: className
props.description: Size the sky; it fills its box, so give it a height.

usageNotes: Keyboard: a transparent button behind the content is the sky's way in — Left and Right sweep the arc (Shift for a long sweep), Up and Down bend it; it shows a focus ring inset on the sky and never sits above the content.

Pointer: the hovering pointer bends the arc toward itself and it relaxes when the pointer leaves; a horizontal drag anywhere on the sky (not on the content's links and buttons) carries the arc 1:1 and a throw coasts on. The sky is touch-pan-y, so the page still scrolls.
Reduced motion: a still frame — no sweep, flicker or drift — redrawn only when the size, a prop or a key changes it; a drag or key moves the arc in one step.

Performance: one fragment pass, drawn only while on screen and in a visible page (and not paused); DPR is capped at 2 with a 0.75 render scale on dense screens, context loss is handled, and a CSS-drawn sky stands in on the server and without WebGL2.
Theming: the night is fixed pigment and reads the same in light and dark; put light text over it. The arc and fence take any hue.

items.title: Passing Cumulus
items.tagline: Busy is a cloud drifting over a field of dots.
items.description: A loading and thinking indicator: a field of soft dots shaded like beads in sunlight, with a small cumulus's shadow passing over it. While busy the cloud gathers, its puffs swelling in one after another on springs.drift's constants, and drifts across; the dots beneath swell and dim, each easing toward its own shade with a lag so a soft wake trails behind, and the next cloud gathers as one leaves. When the state turns done the cloud thins away and the whole field lifts evenly to full sun on the same spring. It is a polite status region that says the state in words; it takes no input.

props.name: state
props.description: What the work is doing: a cloud drifts while busy and thins away when done, and the field lifts to full sun.

props.name: cloud
props.description: The cloud's size relative to the field's height, 0.4 to 1.6.

props.name: dotSize
props.description: Dot diameter, px, 3 to 12; the field fills its box with whole rows and columns.

props.name: pitch
props.description: Dot spacing as a multiple of the dot size.

props.name: drift
props.description: How fast the cloud drifts across, as a multiple of its natural pace.

props.name: swell
props.description: How much a shaded dot grows, 0 to 1.

props.name: dim
props.description: How much a shaded dot darkens toward the shade colour, 0 to 1.

props.name: sunColor
props.description: The dots in sunlight, any CSS colour; their highlight and rim are mixed from it.

props.name: shadeColor
props.description: The dots in the cloud's shadow, any CSS colour.

props.name: label
props.description: What the work is, spoken while busy (“Working…”).

props.name: labels
props.description: What the status says in each state, replacing “Ready.”, “<label>…” and “Done.”.

props.name: seed
props.description: Shapes the clouds; each new cloud is a variation on it.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the field as it is.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Device-pixel-ratio cap for the canvas, at most 2.

props.name: onSettle
props.description: Fires once a state's change has finished drawing — for done, when the field is fully lit.

props.name: className
props.description: Size the field with a height class.

usageNotes: Accessibility: the component is a polite status region whose text says the state (“Working…”, “Done.”, “Ready.” or your labels); the field is aria-hidden. It takes no input and never holds focus.
Reduced motion: no cloud drifts — its shadow rests in the middle of the field and breathes by opacity alone while busy, and done still lifts the field to full sun.

Performance: Canvas 2D with two dot sprites painted once per size or colour; the loop runs only while busy or while a change settles, on screen and in a visible page, then stops (onSettle). DPR is capped at 2; the server renders the same dots in CSS so the first paint is never blank.
Theming: the sun and shade pigments are taken from tokens at fixed lightness, so the beads read the same in light and dark; colours are re-read when the theme changes.
Usage: drive `state` from your request — busy while it runs, done when it returns — and keep it mounted; it costs nothing at rest.

items.title: Flute Bubbles
items.tagline: Fine bubbles rising from points in the glass.
items.description: A tall flute of sparkling wine seen side-on: fine bubbles rise in steady strings from nucleation points on the walls and the point of the bowl, each born tiny, growing as it climbs and quickening with its size, catching the light on the way up and popping at the surface in a small ring that now and then flicks a droplet above the wine. Tapping the glass shivers its surface on springs.recoil and releases a burst of fresh streams from the wall nearest the press; left alone the wine slowly goes flat until Top up pours a thin stream in and a mousse swells on springs.glide and settles. The glass and Top up are real buttons, so Space and Enter tap the walls in turn and top it up.

props.name: streams
props.description: How many points on the glass give off a stream of bubbles, 2 to 16.

props.name: fizz
props.description: How lively the wine is, 0 (slow, sparse strings) to 1 (tight, quick ones).

props.name: tint
props.description: The wine's colour, a pigment that looks the same in both themes.

props.name: liquidColor
props.description: Any CSS colour for the wine; it deepens toward the point of the bowl. Overrides tint.

props.name: fill
props.description: How full the bowl is, 0.5 to 0.92.

props.name: bubbleSize
props.description: Bubble size, 0 (the finest bead) to 1 (coarser).

props.name: glint
props.description: How brightly bubbles catch the light, 0 to 1.

props.name: burst
props.description: How many fresh streams a tap on the glass releases, 0 to 1.

props.name: flatAfter
props.description: ms for the glass to go flat after a top-up; 0 keeps it lively for ever.

props.name: mousse
props.description: A foam head swells on a top-up and settles.

props.name: onTap
props.description: Fires when the glass is tapped, with the wall the fresh streams rise from.

props.name: onTopUp
props.description: Fires when the glass is topped up.

props.name: onFizzChange
props.description: Fires when the wine turns lively, starts settling or goes flat.

props.name: sound
props.description: A sizzle after each tap and top-up — only for the visitor's own press.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold every bubble where it is.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds where the streams start and how every bubble is born.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: label
props.description: The glass's accessible name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The glass takes no taps and cannot be topped up.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the piece; the flute keeps its shape and centres in it.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the glass is a button — Space or Enter taps it, alternating the left wall, the right wall and the point of the bowl; Top up is a second button. A polite status says where the fresh streams rose and when the glass goes flat.
Reduced motion shows a still photograph of the glass: every stream frozen mid-rise. A tap redraws it with the fresh streams, a top-up shows the mousse for a moment, and nothing travels.

Bubbles are a pooled 2D canvas (no allocation per frame) over crisp SVG glass; the loop runs only while the glass is on screen, the page visible and not paused, and the backing store is capped at `dpr`.
The glass and the room are token colours and re-read on a theme change; the wine is pigment (fixed lightness from the warn, danger or accent hue) so it looks the same in light and dark.
Give the piece a height: it is a size container and fits the 160 × 460 flute inside whatever box it gets.
Sound is a single sizzle loop after each tap or top-up, only for the visitor's own press, and it always stops.

items.title: Quilted Fields
items.tagline: A low flight over fields stitched like a quilt.
items.description: An endless low flight over farmland laid out like a patchwork quilt, drawn per pixel in one WebGL2 pass: irregular plots of furrows, drilled rows, pasture, flowering crops and fallow, each padded a little toward its middle and divided by hedgerows drawn as stitching — a wandering dark seam with a pale running stitch beside it and trees at the corners — fading into a soft haze at the horizon. The pointer banks the flight on the springs.drift constants, the horizon rolling with it while the flight turns and the quilt sweeps sideways, and a new season re-dyes the fields one by one from the horizon in. The bank chip at the foot is a real slider: arrows bank 5°, Page keys 10°, Home and End to the limits.

props.name: children
props.description: Content over the flight: a hero line, a caption. It stays fully interactive.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the flight goes, 0 (hovering) to 1 (brisk).

props.name: altitude
props.description: How high the flight is, 0 (hedge-top) to 1 (high over the quilt).

props.name: season
props.description: The fields' palette; a change re-dyes the quilt field by field from the horizon in.

props.name: bank / defaultBank
props.description: The bank angle in degrees, −18 (left) to 18 (right); controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onBankChange
props.description: Fires from the hover, drag or key that banked the flight, with whole degrees.

props.name: followPointer
props.description: A hovering mouse or pen banks the flight; a finger drags sideways.

props.name: levelOnLeave
props.description: Level the wings when the pointer leaves.

props.name: fieldSize
props.description: How big the fields are, 0 (small plots) to 1 (broad fields).

props.name: hedgerows
props.description: How heavy the hedgerow stitching is, 0 (none) to 1 (thick seams with trees).

props.name: haze
props.description: How much the distance fades into the haze, 0 (clear) to 1 (soft).

props.name: palette
props.description: Four CSS colours for the fields, overriding the season's own.

props.name: skyColor
props.defaultValue: a pale (light) or dusk (dark) tint of the accent token
props.description: The sky over the horizon, any CSS colour; a dark sky turns the light to evening.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the flight where it is.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the plots, their crops and where the flight starts.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: label
props.description: The bank control's accessible name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The flight cannot be banked.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the piece; it fills its parent by default.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the bank chip is a role="slider" with an aria-valuetext such as "Banking 10 degrees left"; arrows bank 5°, Page Up and Down 10°, Home and End to the limits, and the shown bank eases there exactly as it does under the pointer.
Reduced motion holds one still frame: no flight, the bank applied at once and a season change in a single recolour.

One fragment pass at a reduced render scale above DPR 1.5, run only while on screen, visible and flying, banking or re-dyeing; a paused or reduced-motion flight draws only when something changes. Context loss is handled and a projected-quad SVG still stands in without WebGL2 (and on the server).
Field colours are pigment, the same in both themes; the sky defaults to an accent tint, and a dark sky (the dark theme) lowers and warms the light into an evening flight.
Children render above the flight and stay interactive; give long headlines a soft scrim, since the horizon rolls under them as the flight banks.

items.title: Rack Aisle
items.tagline: A row of racks, status lights blinking with load.
items.description: A dark aisle of server racks seen down its length in one-point perspective: cabinets on both sides lined with servers and tiny status lights, a ruled raised floor running to a lit doorway and a cable tray overhead. Every activity light blinks at a rate that follows its rack's load from data, a slow band of light sweeps down the aisle, and a rack whose data spikes flickers amber and pools amber light on the floor in front of it. Hovering a rack lifts it on springs.snap with a tooltip of its name and load and the pointer sways the view on springs.drift; the racks are a roving set of buttons — Up and Down walk the aisle, Left and Right cross it, Home and End jump to its ends, Enter pins and Escape unpins.

props.name: items
props.description: The racks, two per row: even indices on the left, odd on the right, nearest row first; each { id, name?, load?, spike? }.

props.name: racks
props.description: How many racks stand on each side of the aisle, 3 to 10.

props.name: load
props.description: The aisle's load, 0 (idle winks) to 1 (busy chatter), for racks whose data gives none.

props.name: sweep
props.description: How bright the light sweeping down the aisle is, 0 (off) to 1.

props.name: sweepPeriod
props.description: ms for one pass of the sweep down the aisle.

props.name: spikeAt
props.description: A load at or above this counts as a spike, 0 to 1.

props.name: units
props.description: Servers per rack, 6 to 16.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The pinned rack's id; controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the click or key that pinned or unpinned a rack.

props.name: parallax
props.description: How far the pointer sways the view down the aisle, 0 to 1.

props.name: ledColor
props.defaultValue: a green pigment from the signal token
props.description: Activity lights, any CSS colour.

props.name: spikeColor
props.defaultValue: an amber pigment from the warn token
props.description: A spiking rack's lights, any CSS colour.

props.name: roomColor
props.defaultValue: a dim tint of the accent token, by theme
props.description: The room, any CSS colour; racks and floor are shaded from it.

props.name: site
props.description: Printed before a rack's name in its tooltip.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold every light where it is.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the loads of racks without data and every light's rhythm.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: label
props.description: The aisle's accessible name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No hover, pin or keys.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the aisle; it fills its parent by default.

usageNotes: Keyboard: one tab stop; Up and Down walk along the aisle, Left and Right cross it, Home and End jump to the nearest and farthest rack on that side. Focus lifts the rack and shows its tooltip, Enter or Space pins it (aria-pressed), Escape unpins.
Each rack button is named with its load ("R07, 61% load, load spike"), and a polite status announces a spike once, at its onset in the data.
Reduced motion holds every light steady (lit in proportion to load), sets the sweep as a still band mid-aisle and shows spiking racks in steady amber; lifts and tooltips appear at once.

A 2D canvas: the room, racks and bezels are cached on an offscreen layer rebuilt only when the size, theme, layout or sway changes, and the lights run at 30 frames a second, only on screen and visible.
Feed it live data by passing new items: loads ease to their new values and a spike flag (or a load past spikeAt) flips a rack to amber with a floor glow that eases in and out.

items.title: Nacreous Sky
items.tagline: Thin cloud edges catching pastel colour.
items.description: A pale dusk sky crossed by thin, high clouds drifting in two veils, drawn per pixel in one WebGL2 pass with the sun hidden behind them: wherever a cloud thins near the sun its edge diffracts into soft iridescent bands of rose, green and blue, laid as contours of angular distance from the sun over a droplet size that wanders across the cloud, while denser cloud near the sun takes a silver lining. Moving the pointer moves the sun along its arc on the springs.glide constants, so the colour slides along every thinning edge, and when the pointer leaves the sun drifts home to its resting angle on springs.drift. The sun marker on the rail at the foot is a real slider: arrows move it 3°, Page keys 15°, Home and End to either end of the arc.

props.name: children
props.description: Content over the sky: a hero line, a caption. It stays fully interactive.

props.name: sunAngle
props.description: Where the sun rests behind the clouds, in degrees from −60 (left) to 60 (right). The pointer moves it from here.

props.name: onSunAngleChange

props.name: thinness
props.description: How thin the clouds are, 0 (heavy veils) to 1 (gossamer, with more edge to colour).

props.name: saturation
props.description: How strong the iridescent colour is, 0 (pearl-white) to 1 (vivid pastel).

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the clouds drift, 0 (still) to 1 (a brisk high wind).

props.name: coverage
props.description: How much of the sky the clouds cover, 0 to 1.

props.name: followPointer
props.description: A hovering mouse or pen moves the sun; a finger drags along the rail or taps.

props.name: returnOnLeave
props.description: When the pointer leaves, the sun drifts back to sunAngle.

props.name: skyColors
props.defaultValue: pale dusk tints (light) or a deep twilight (dark) from the tokens
props.description: The sky's top and horizon, CSS colours.

props.name: sunColor
props.defaultValue: a warm near-white from the warn hue
props.description: The sun's light, any CSS colour.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the clouds where they are.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the clouds' shapes.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: label
props.description: The sun control's accessible name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The sun does not move.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the sky; it fills its parent by default.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the sun marker is a role="slider" (−60…60, aria-valuetext such as "Sun 20 degrees left of centre"); arrows move it 3°, Page Up and Down 15°, Home and End to the ends, and the sun eases there exactly as under the pointer.
sunAngle is the sun's resting place: the pointer moves the sun from it and, with returnOnLeave, it drifts back; a new sunAngle moves the sun there without firing onSunAngleChange.
Reduced motion holds one still frame: the clouds do not drift and the sun moves at once to each new angle.

Soft cloud renders at half (DPR ≥ 1.5) or three-quarter scale, at 30 frames a second while only drifting and every frame while the sun eases, only on screen and visible. Context loss is handled and an SVG still stands in without WebGL2 (and on the server).
The sky defaults to token tints chosen by theme — a pale dusk on a light page, a deep twilight on a dark one — and re-reads them on a theme change; pass skyColors and sunColor to set your own.

items.title: Spooled Prints
items.tagline: Pictures wound between spools, gliding as you scroll.
items.description: Paper ribbons of printed pictures run between pairs of flanged spools, each roll leaning its own way down the piece: scrolling the page winds every roll at its own pace and in its own direction, the push coasting down so the ribbons glide on and settle while the marks on each spool's wound paper turn with them, and a slow drift keeps them winding at rest. A ribbon drags 1:1 along its length and flicks with the release velocity; hovering slows it and lifts the print under the pointer on springs.snap, and clicking opens the print in a viewer inside the piece that straightens from the roll's lean on springs.glide. It is a carousel with one tab stop: Left and Right step along a roll and wind it so the print comes to the middle on springs.glide, Up and Down change rolls, Home and End jump, Enter opens and Escape closes.

props.name: items
props.description: The pictures, in order ({ src?, alt, caption? }); every roll carries them all, each starting at its own place. Without src a drawn scene stands in.

props.name: tilt
props.description: How far the rolls lean, in degrees, 0 (flat strips) to 24 (steep, crossing ribbons).

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the rolls wind, 0 to 2 ×: their pace at rest and how far a scroll carries them.

props.name: spools
props.description: How many rolls run down the piece, 2 to 4.

props.name: spoolSize
props.description: How big the spools are, 0 (slim bobbins) to 1 (fat reels).

props.name: drift
props.description: How briskly the rolls wind on their own at rest, 0 (still) to 1.

props.name: hoverSlow
props.description: How much a hovered roll slows, 0 (not at all) to 1 (it stops).

props.name: lift
props.description: How far the print under the pointer lifts toward you, 0 to 1.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The index of the print open in the viewer, or null; controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the click or key that opened, stepped or closed the viewer.

props.name: paperColor
props.description: The ribbons' paper, any CSS colour.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the gallery for assistive technology.

props.name: seed

props.name: disabled

usageNotes: Keyboard: the piece is one tab stop (region, aria-roledescription="carousel"); Left and Right step along a roll and wind it so that print comes to the middle, Up and Down move between rolls, Home and End jump to the first and last print, Enter or Space opens the viewer. A focused print holds its roll still.
The viewer is a modal dialog inside the piece: focus moves to Close, Tab is trapped, Left and Right step prints, Escape closes (and is not passed on) and focus returns to the print that opened it.
Reduced motion holds the rolls still: scrolling does not wind them, a flick does not coast, keyboard steps jump and hover marks the print with a ring instead of lifting it; the viewer cross-fades.

One frame loop drives every roll through motion values (no React state per frame) and stops when nothing moves; scrolling is read by one passive capture listener and only counted while the piece is on screen.

Prints are pigment and paper, the same in both themes; pass items with src for real photographs — roll slots that repeat a picture are hidden from assistive technology, so each picture is announced once.

items.title: Skyline Brush
items.tagline: Brush the plan and the blocks rise into towers.
items.description: A seeded city plan seen from above at an angle — a street grid of blocks cut into plots, parks, a river across one corner and district names lying on the ground in the plan's own perspective. Brushing the pointer across it raises every block it passes into a tower that springs up on the springs.snap constants with one crisp overshoot, its floors appearing lit from the bottom up, and casts a long shadow across the streets from a low sun; after a moment the towers sink back to their footprints on a soft ease, so a stroke leaves a ridge that subsides like a wake. The districts are a listbox: keyboard focus raises the active district and traces it on the ground, arrows move between districts, Enter pins one so it stays raised and Escape clears it.

props.name: districts
props.description: The districts the plan is divided into, 2 to 8; each { id, name, height? }, height 0–1 setting how tall it builds.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: The tallest a tower can rise, in floors, 8 to 60. A change replays the preview stroke.

props.name: falloff
props.description: How far the brush's raise reaches, 0 (a fine pen: only the blocks under it) to 1 (a broad swell).

props.name: lights
props.description: The share of windows lit, 0 (dark glass) to 1 (every window).

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The pinned district's id, or null; a pinned district stays raised. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the tap or key that pinned or cleared a district.

props.name: radius
props.description: The brush's reach on screen, px.

props.name: hold
props.description: ms a brushed tower stands before it starts to sink.

props.name: sinkDuration
props.description: ms a tower takes to sink back to its footprint.

props.name: shadow
props.description: How long the low sun's shadows run, 0 (none) to 2.

props.name: intro
props.description: On first view, one stroke raises a band across the plan and lets it sink.

props.name: groundColor
props.defaultValue: a paper (light) or night (dark) tint of the accent token
props.description: The ground, any CSS colour; streets and blocks are shaded from it.

props.name: buildingColor
props.defaultValue: a pale (light) or slate (dark) tint of the accent token
props.description: The towers' facades, any CSS colour; the shaded face, roofs and dark windows follow from it.

props.name: windowColor
props.defaultValue: a warm pigment from the warn token
props.description: Lit windows, any CSS colour.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the plan: streets, plots, parks, the river and every window.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: label
props.description: The plan's accessible name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No brushing, taps or keys.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the plan; it fills its parent by default.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the plan is a listbox with one tab stop and aria-activedescendant on its districts; focus raises the active district and traces it, arrows move to the next or previous, Home and End jump, Enter or Space pins it (it stays raised after focus leaves) and Escape clears the pin. A polite status names the district, its towers and the tallest.
Touch: a sideways drag brushes (the piece is touch-action: pan-y, so vertical swipes still scroll the page) and a tap pins the district under it.
Reduced motion changes heights at once: brushed towers stand for the same hold and sinking time and then drop in one step, and the intro stroke does not run.

Canvas 2D: the ground (streets, blocks, parks, river, names and every resting footprint) is cached on an offscreen layer and only redrawn on a resize, theme or plan change; windows are drawn per face through one affine transform, and nothing runs once every tower has settled or while the plan is off screen.

The plan is laid out for its box: wide, square and tall boxes get their own seeded plan, and in narrow boxes the towers are drawn taller than true scale so the skyline still fills the sky above the plan.
Changing maxHeight, falloff or lights after mount replays the one-stroke preview, so a new height, reach or lighting shows at once rather than on the next brush.

items.title: Flicker Prints
items.tagline: Postcards that move as they turn past you.
items.description: A carousel of lenticular postcards on a shallow drum, where each card's viewing angle picks its frame, so as a card turns through the curve its few frames of motion play: a door opens, a heron lifts, a wave breaks. Frames hold then flip over a narrow band of angles, interleaved strip by strip under visible ridges while a highlight rides every ridge crest and a broad sheen sweeps the card. Dragging turns the drum 1:1 and scrubs every card at once, settling on the card the throw was heading for on springs.glide with the release velocity; a mouse tilts the front card toward it, and a tap or Space rocks it through its motion on snap and back on recoil. Left and Right step, Home and End jump.

props.name: items
