props.description: The postcards, front to back. `frames` plays real frame images; a single `src` becomes a depth flip; otherwise a drawn scene.

props.name: frames
props.description: How many frames each card holds, 2 to 8: two flip, eight play.

props.name: ridges
props.description: Lenticular ridges across a card, 12 to 60: chunky bands to a fine screen.

props.name: curve
props.description: How deeply the drum curves, 0 to 1: a flat strip to a deep drum whose cards swing hard.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The card in front, controlled or initial.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the drag, tap or key that brought a new card to the front.

props.name: blend
props.description: How long a flip between frames lasts, 0 to 1: a snap to a long banded blend.

props.name: sheen
props.description: How strongly the ridges catch the light, 0 to 1.

props.name: tilt
props.description: How far the front card tilts toward a hovering pointer, 0 to 1, playing its own frames.

props.name: paper
props.description: The card stock, any CSS colour.

props.name: captions
props.description: Print the front card's caption under the carousel.

props.name: label
props.description: The carousel's accessible name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No turning, tilting or stepping.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root; it fills its container's width and sizes its cards from it.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the carousel is one focusable region; Left and Right step one card, Home and End jump, Space or Enter rocks the front card through its motion. The new card is announced politely.
Reduced motion: the drum steps without travel, there is no hover tilt or rock, and every card holds the frame its resting angle shows, so the row still reads as a sequence of moments.

Performance: DOM and SVG only, no canvas and no loop; one motion value drives the drum and its change handler writes each card's transform, frame and sheen directly, only when they change. Nothing runs once settled.
The cards are printed objects in fixed pigments, so they look the same in light and dark themes; captions and dots use the theme tokens.
Card geometry is in units of the card width, sized by container query (58% of the width on phones, 44% up to 340px wider), so it fits any column without measuring.

items.title: Filing Tray
items.tagline: Each card files itself on the pile as you read.
items.description: A scroll-linked stack: inside whatever scrolls it, each card slides up and files itself onto a tray near the top, and as the next card slides over it the filed card tilts a little to one side, sinks a hair and dims, so a small untidy pile grows above the card being read, every older card's top edge peeking above the next while the tray's label counts the pile. Each card's cover depth is measured from the scroll and the shown depth follows it on a critically damped spring with the springs.glide constants, so tilts settle like paper a breath behind the scroll, and a landing card presses the pile on the springs.recoil constants. Scrolling back lifts the cards off in order; Tab or Arrow Down moves to the next card and files the one before, Arrow Up lifts it back.

props.name: cards
props.type: { id: string; title: string; body?: ReactNode; meta?: string; tag?: string }[]
props.description: The cards, in reading order.

props.name: tilt
props.description: How far a filed card tilts, 0 to 8 degrees, alternating sides: a square stack to a loose pile.

props.name: fade
props.description: How far a filed card dims as more land on it, 0 to 1.

props.name: offset
props.description: How much of each filed card's top edge peeks above the next, 0 to 16 px.

props.name: inset
props.description: Where the first filed card sticks, px below the top of the scroll container; the tray's label sits above it.

props.name: maxDepth
props.description: How many filed cards keep peeking; deeper ones sink out of sight.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between cards that are still to be read, px.

props.name: settle
props.description: A card that lands presses the pile and settles with a small bounce.

props.name: tray
props.description: Draw the tray behind the pile, with its count on a label strip.

props.name: trayLabel
props.description: The word on the tray's label before the count.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds which way and how far each card tilts.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level of the card titles.

props.name: onFiledChange
props.description: Fires from the scroll that filed or lifted a card, with how many are filed.

props.name: label
props.description: The stack's accessible name.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root; it takes the width of its column.

usageNotes: Place it inside the element that scrolls (an overflow-y: auto box, or the page): it sticks its cards with CSS position: sticky and reads that container's scroll, so no ancestor between them may clip with overflow: hidden.

Keyboard: every card is focusable; Tab or Arrow Down (J) moves to the next card and scrolls it to the reading position, filing the one before; Arrow Up (K) lifts it back; Home and End jump. The filed count is announced politely once the scroll rests.
Reduced motion: the pile still forms and filed cards still dim, because filed is information; there is no tilt, sink, landing press or spring lag, and keyboard moves jump instead of smooth-scrolling.

Performance: one passive scroll listener; positions are read in one batch and styles written in one animation frame; the spring loop stops as soon as every card has settled, and nothing runs while the stack is off screen.
Cards take any content as `body`; their heights are measured each frame, so text that wraps differently at narrow widths still stacks correctly.

items.title: Thumb Flipbook
items.tagline: Scroll to riffle the pages and the drawing moves.
items.description: A pocket flipbook lying on the table, taped at its spine, a thumb on the bottom-right corner holding the waiting pages' corners curled into a fan. Riffling lets the pages go one after another: each top page curls up past the thumb and turns away over the spine, revealing the next drawing, so the ink drawing in view moves (a boat on a rolling swell under a gull, a seamless loop) and a fast riffle keeps several pages in the air. Every page's peel springs toward the hand: the page under a drag tracks the finger on springs.flick and released pages flick past on springs.snap at the riffle rate, a flick coasts to where the throw would rest, and scrolling the page riffles forward and back; it is a slider, so arrows turn a page, Page Up and Page Down a loop, Home and End riffle to either end and Space riffles one loop.

props.name: images
props.description: One picture per frame, drawn on the pages in order; replaces the drawn loop.

props.name: frames
props.description: Drawings in the loop, 6 to 24: a choppy loop to a fluid one. Ignored with `images`.

props.name: pages
props.description: Pages in the book, 12 to 120.

props.name: bend
props.description: How far the thumb curls the waiting pages, 0 to 1: a slight lift to a tall fan.

props.name: riffle
props.description: Riffle speed, 0 to 1: a slow heavy peel to a quick flutter — pages per px of drag or scroll, and how fast each page flicks past.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Pages turned, 0 to `pages`, controlled or initial; a new value riffles to it.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the drag, scroll or key that turned a page, with the pages turned.

props.name: scroll
props.description: Scrolling the page (or any scroll container) riffles the book forward and back.

props.name: thumb
props.description: Draw the thumb holding the pages.

props.name: paper
props.description: The pages, any CSS colour.

props.name: ink
props.defaultValue: from the ink token at a fixed lightness
props.description: The drawing's ink, any CSS colour.

props.name: accent
props.defaultValue: a red pigment from the danger token
props.description: The drawing's one colour, any CSS colour.

props.name: sound
props.description: A paper crinkle as each page leaves the thumb. Off unless asked for.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: label
props.description: The book's accessible name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No riffling by hand, scroll or key.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the book's box; 8:5 and the full width by default.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the book is a slider (pages turned, with the drawing number in its value text); Right and Up turn a page, Left and Down turn back, Page Up and Page Down turn a whole loop, Home and End riffle to either end, Space or Enter riffles one loop.
Reduced motion: pages change in place with no flight or curl spring, scrolling leaves the book alone, and keys and drags still turn whole pages; the book rests with a gentle held curl.

Performance: Canvas 2D at a device pixel ratio capped at 2; page textures are drawn once per size and colour, each curled strip draws only its own slice, and the animation loop runs only while a page is in the air — never off screen or in a hidden tab.
Scroll riffling reads how far the book moves on screen, so it works inside any scroll container or the page without configuration; turn it off with `scroll={false}`.
Sound is silent until the visitor has clicked, tapped or pressed a key, since a scroll is not a user activation.

items.title: Counter Dive
items.tagline: Scroll through the hole in a letter into the picture.
items.description: A giant word in a geometric monoline alphabet drawn in code, its strokes filled with a picture on a plain ground; as its scroll container scrolls through the section, the pinned stage magnifies the word around one letter's hole (the O of BROOK by default) and slides it to the middle of the frame. The hole is a window: the ground inside it thins away to show the picture beyond at its own depth, the strokes rush out past the edges as a flat ink, and you pass through into the picture, where the caption rises in; scrolling back pulls you out through the same hole. The shown progress follows the scroll on a critically damped spring with the springs.glide constants and the scale is exponential in progress, so the dive keeps a steady speed through depth; on the focused stage Down, Page Down and Space dive deeper, Up and Page Up back out, and Home and End jump to either end.

props.name: word
props.description: The word, in capitals A–Z and spaces; other characters are dropped.

props.name: letter
props.description: Which letter to dive through, by its index in the word, or the most central letter with a hole.

props.name: weight
props.description: Stroke weight of the letters, 0 to 1: hairline letters with wide counters to heavy ones with portholes.

props.name: zoom
props.description: How far the word magnifies, 40 to 200: a gentle dive to a rush through the hole.

props.name: range
props.description: Scroll distance the dive takes, px (400 to 1600).

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the pinned stage, px. Give it the height of the scroll container it sits in.

props.name: src
props.description: The picture: in the letters, and beyond the hole.

props.name: alt
props.description: Describes the picture for assistive technology.

props.name: ground
props.description: The plain ground the word sits on, any CSS colour.

props.name: ink
props.description: The flat colour the strokes become as they magnify past you, any CSS colour.

props.name: as
props.description: The element that carries the word for assistive technology.

props.name: children
props.description: Shown in the picture once you are through.

props.name: onProgressChange
props.description: Fires as the dive progresses, 0 to 1, from the scroll that moved it.

props.name: onPhaseChange
props.description: Fires when the dive moves between the word, diving and through.

props.description: Classes for the section; it takes the width of its column and the height of `height` plus `range`.

usageNotes: Place it inside the element that scrolls (an overflow-y: auto box, or the page) with no clipping ancestor in between: the stage pins with position: sticky and the dive reads that container's scroll. Set `height` to the container's visible height so the stage fills it.

Keyboard: the stage is focusable; Down, Page Down and Space dive deeper, Up and Page Up back out, Home and End jump to the start or the end by scrolling the container, so pointer and keyboard reach the same states. Arriving in the picture and returning to the word are announced politely.
Accessibility: the word is a real heading (visually hidden; the SVG is decoration) and `alt` describes the picture.
Reduced motion: nothing zooms; the word holds still and, past half the range, the picture and the caption cross-fade in over it, and back out before half.
Performance: one SVG; each frame writes only the transforms and opacities that changed, rounded, and the smoothing loop stops as soon as the dive catches up with the scroll; nothing runs off screen.

items.title: Peg Migration
items.tagline: Pegs hop hole to hole to make the next picture.
items.description: A backlit pegboard whose translucent coloured pegs glow with the light behind the board and make a picture: a drawn one, a word in a 5 × 7 peg alphabet, or any image reduced to pegs. To change pictures the pegs migrate: pegs already right stay put, the rest are matched to the nearest hole that needs their colour and travel there hole to hole in up to five short arcs, leaving the light and casting a shadow as they lift and landing with a flash and the springs.recoil squash, their departures staggered by distance from where you clicked so the board changes in a wave while spare pegs hop off the nearer side and new ones hop in. A click, Enter, Space or Right shows the next picture, Left the previous, and Home and End the first and last.

props.name: images
props.type: { alt: string; src?: string; text?: string; color?: number; draw?: (u: number, v: number, aspect: number) => number }[]
props.defaultValue: a sun on the sea, a koi, a moon over a ridge, a tulip
props.description: The pictures, in order: an image reduced to pegs, a word in the peg alphabet, or a drawing function returning a colour index (or -1) for each hole.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The picture showing, controlled or initial.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the click or key that asked for another picture.

props.name: pitch
props.description: Distance between holes, px (9 to 21): a fine board to a chunky toy.

props.name: hopSpeed
props.description: How quickly pegs hop, 0.5 to 2.

props.name: glow
props.description: How far each peg's light blooms around it, 0 to 1.

props.name: colors
props.description: The peg colours, any CSS colours; pictures index into them.

props.name: board
props.description: The board's colour, any CSS colour.

props.name: hopHeight
props.description: How high pegs arc as they hop, 0 to 1.

props.name: spread

props.name: interval

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the small differences in each peg's timing.

props.name: sound

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: label
props.description: The board's accessible name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No changing pictures.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the board; 3:1 and the full width by default.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the board is one focusable group named with the picture it shows; Enter, Space or Right shows the next picture (Right sweeps from the left edge), Left the previous, Home and End the first and last. The new picture is announced politely.
Reduced motion: no hops; the old picture fades out where it stands and the new one fades in, because the picture is the information.

Performance: Canvas 2D at a device pixel ratio capped at 2; the board and every peg and glow sprite are drawn once per size and colour, a settled board is one blit, and the loop runs only while pegs are moving — never off screen or in a hidden tab. Auto-advance pauses off screen, in a hidden tab, and while hovered or focused.

Images are reduced on the client: each hole samples the picture and takes the nearest peg colour, and dark or transparent areas leave holes empty, so a high-contrast image on black reads best. Images from another origin need CORS.
Text uses a 5 × 7 peg alphabet, doubled when the board is big enough and set in 3 × 5 when it is narrow.

items.title: Second Contact
items.tagline: Drag the moon over the sun and wait for the ring.
items.description: A solar eclipse you drive: drag the dark moon (anywhere on the sky moves it 1:1; a tap glides it there on springs.glide) and as it covers more of the sun the sky deepens through twilight to night, a ring of sunset lights the horizon and stars come out. The moon's limb is a seeded profile of mountains and valleys, so near totality the last crescent breaks into Baily's beads of light through the valleys, then one diamond ring with the inner corona already showing, then totality: a pearly corona with long helmet streamers and fine striations drifting in colour around the hue, and pink prominences on the limb. One WebGL2 pass draws the scene while the light is measured on the CPU (the visible share of the disc, and the gaps at 720 angles round the limb gathered into beads); the moon is a slider of how much of the sun is covered, so arrow keys move it in fine steps near the sun, Home sets it at totality and End back where it began, and releasing leaves it where it is.

props.name: value / defaultValue

props.name: onValueChange

props.name: onPhaseChange
props.description: Fires when the eclipse moves between clear, partial, beads, the diamond ring and totality.

props.name: corona
props.description: How far the corona reaches, 0 to 1: a tight bright collar to streamers past three radii.

props.name: beads
props.description: How bright the last light is, 0 to 1: faint pinpricks to blazing beads and a big diamond.

props.name: hue
props.description: The corona's tint, a hue in degrees.

props.name: sunSize
props.description: The sun's radius as a share of the shorter side, 0.12 to 0.32.

props.name: prominences
props.description: How many pink prominences stand on the limb at totality, 0 to 1.

props.name: stars
props.description: Stars come out as the sky darkens.

props.name: sky
props.defaultValue: a pigment from the accent token
props.description: The daytime sky, any CSS colour.

props.name: night
props.description: The sky at totality, any CSS colour.

props.name: shimmer
props.description: How much the beads and the corona shimmer, 0 to 1.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the moon's mountains and valleys and the corona's streamers.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: label
props.description: The scene's accessible name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No dragging or keys.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the scene; it fills its parent by default.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the moon is a focusable slider whose value is the share of the sun covered, with the phase in its value text; arrow keys move it in their direction (in fine steps near the sun, where the beads and the ring are, and big steps with Shift), Home sets it at totality and End back where it began. Phase changes are announced politely.
Reduced motion: the scene is still — no corona drift and no shimmer — and a tap moves the moon at once instead of gliding; the moon still follows a drag 1:1 and every phase still renders.

Performance: one WebGL2 pass at a 0.75 render scale on dense screens with the device pixel ratio capped at 2; it draws only when the moon moves, plus a slow loop while the corona or beads show on screen. Context loss is handled and the scene redraws on restore; without WebGL2 a CSS scene of sky, sun, corona and moon follows the same value and phases.
Give it a height: it fills its parent, and the sun's size is a share of the shorter side, so it suits a square card or a wide hero.

items.title: Room Within
items.tagline: Scroll into a window that holds the next room.
items.description: A story told as one long zoom: the stage is its own scroll container, each picture holds an opening exactly the stage's shape, and scrolling zooms into it until it fills the stage and becomes the next picture, which holds the next opening. The camera is one transform written straight from the scroll — a pure geometric scale about the opening's fixed point, so it grows from one steady spot and every level boundary is seamless — while the glass sheen slides off the window, the far room's haze lifts and the captions cross-fade with the zoom; a click on the opening, the depth gauge or Page Down travels there on springs.drift. Page Down, Space and Enter go in a level, Page Up, Shift+Space and Backspace come back out, Home and End jump to the ends.

props.name: items
props.description: The pictures, outermost first, each { id?, src?, alt, caption?, detail?, art?, window? }; each one's opening holds the next.

props.name: depth
props.description: How many levels deep the story goes, 2 to 6 (and no more than items).

props.name: frame
props.description: How each opening is framed: a painted casement with a sill, a gilt frame, a paper mat, or a seamless cut.

props.name: easing
props.description: How scrolling maps to the zoom: steady, holding each picture still for a beat, or snapping every scroll to a picture.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The level shown. A new controlled value travels there.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the scroll, key or click that brought a new level nearest, with that level.

props.name: scrollLength
props.description: Scroll for one level, as a share of the stage's height, 0.5 to 3.

props.name: loop
props.description: The deepest picture's opening holds the first room again.

props.name: captions
props.description: Show each level's caption and detail over the picture.

props.name: rail
props.description: Show the depth gauge on the right edge; its ticks travel to a level.

props.name: hint
props.description: On first view the camera leans a little way into the window and back, and a cue says to scroll.

props.name: height
props.description: The stage's height: px, or any CSS length. A className height works too.

props.name: label
props.description: The story's accessible name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No scrolling, keys or clicks; the stage dims.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the stage.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the stage is a focusable region (aria-roledescription "zooming story"); Page Down, Space and Enter travel one level in, Page Up, Shift+Space and Backspace one level out, Home and End to the ends, digits 1–9 to a level, and the arrow keys scroll natively in small steps. A polite live region announces "Level 2 of 5: Across the courtyard." as each level arrives.
Reduced motion: no zoom — the pictures cross-fade full-frame at the same scroll positions, the current picture's opening still shows the next one, and keyed or clicked travel jumps at once.

Performance: there is no animation loop. The camera, glass, haze, captions and gauge are written straight from scroll events; motion animates only a keyed or clicked travel. At most five pictures are in the DOM, as flat siblings laid into each other by CSS, so moving deeper never remounts one.

Openings (window: { x, y, size }) are placed in the art's 1000 × 1000 box, which is a square covering the stage, and keep the stage's aspect, so the zoom is seamless from a 316px phone to a 1200px plate and the server's first paint is already right.
Wheel and touch scrolling inside the stage drive the story and chain on to the page at either end; give it a height in the layout (height prop or a className) since it is its own scroll container.

items.title: Zellige Wall
items.tagline: A picture set in glazed tiles that tilt to light.
items.description: A picture rebuilt from small glazed tiles, each an unevenly cut square set a hair askew in grout, its colour box-averaged from the picture and pulled toward the picture's own glazes, lit per pixel in one instanced WebGL2 draw with a pillowed face, a rolled rim that catches the light and a hairline of bare clay. Every tile has its own tilt spring, between the springs.snap and springs.recoil constants by wobble: tiles under the pointer lean toward it so a ring of glints follows the hand and rings back as it passes, and a click sends a ripple across the whole wall that kicks each tile outward as the front reaches it. Arrow keys move a keyboard lamp the tiles lean toward, and Enter or Space sends the ripple from it.

props.name: src
props.description: A picture to set in tiles (same-origin, or served with CORS). Without one, a drawn courtyard door is used.

props.name: alt
props.defaultValue: a description of the drawn courtyard
props.description: Describes the picture.

props.name: tile
props.description: Tile size, px, 8 to 28.

props.name: glaze
props.description: Glaze shine, 0 (matte clay) to 1 (wet glass): the strength and tightness of every highlight.

props.name: tilt
props.description: How far a tile leans toward the pointer, degrees, 0 to 35.

props.name: radius
props.description: How far from the pointer tiles lean, px.

props.name: rippleSpeed
props.description: How fast a click's ripple crosses the wall, px per second.

props.name: wobble
props.description: How the tiles settle, 0 (one crisp overshoot, springs.snap) to 1 (a ringing wobble, springs.recoil).

props.name: jitter
props.description: How unevenly the tiles are cut, 0 (machine-square) to 1 (hand-cut).

props.name: askew
props.description: How far a tile is set off square, degrees.

props.name: grout
props.defaultValue: a mix of the page background and ink
props.description: The grout between the tiles, any CSS colour.

props.name: light
props.description: The key light's direction, degrees (−135 is from the upper left).

props.name: interactive
props.description: Tiles answer the pointer and keys; off, the wall is a still picture with role="img".

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the cut and set of every tile.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: onRipple
props.description: Fires from the click or key that sent a ripple, with its origin as shares of the wall (0–1).

props.name: label
props.description: The wall's accessible name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No pointer, clicks or keys; the wall dims.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the wall; it fills its parent by default.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the wall is a focusable group (aria-roledescription "tile wall"); the arrow keys move a lamp the tiles lean toward, exactly as they do to the pointer, Home recentres it, and Enter or Space sends the ripple from it. A polite live region says where each ripple came from; the picture's alt is read once.

Reduced motion: no tile ever tilts or rings — the wall is a still glazed mosaic; the pointer's lamp still lights a soft glint where it is, and a click or Enter brightens the glaze briefly instead of sending a wave.

Performance: one instanced draw (plus a shadow pass) for every tile; tilts live in a Float32Array uploaded with bufferSubData. The loop runs only while tiles move or a ripple travels, on screen and visible, and stops on a settled frame. DPR is capped, context loss is handled, and without WebGL2 the server's still — the picture under a grout grid — stays.

A src picture must be readable back (same origin or CORS); if it is not, the wall falls back to the drawn courtyard. Tiles are pulled less toward the palette for your own pictures so their colours survive.
The grout follows the page theme (re-read on a theme change); the glazes are pigments, so the mosaic itself looks the same on a light or a dark page.

items.title: Thought Avalanche
items.tagline: Seed a thought and watch how far it spreads.
items.description: A dark field of a few hundred nodes joined by faint, bowed filaments, where a click fires the nearest node and each firing sends glowing pulses on to its neighbours with a chance set by the branching ratio — counted over the neighbours that are not still resting — so an avalanche fizzles out below 1, swings between a handful and most of the field near it, and storms across everything above it. Pulses run along the curves at the conduction speed with short bright tails, the filaments they crossed keep an afterglow, fired nodes flash and then rest for the refractory time, and a ring blooms on the clicked node on the springs.snap constants. Arrow keys move a selection ring from node to node, Home returns it to the middle, and Enter or Space fires it.

props.name: branching
props.description: How many neighbours a firing sets off on average, 0.5 (fizzles) to 2 (storms); about 1 is critical.

props.name: refractory
props.description: How long a fired node rests before it can fire again, ms.

props.name: hue
props.description: The glow's hue, degrees 0–360; the dark field takes a trace of it.

props.name: density
props.description: Nodes per 100 × 100 px of field, 2 to 40.

props.name: connections
props.description: Each node's nearest neighbours it is joined to, 2 to 8.

props.name: conduction
props.description: How fast a pulse runs along a filament, px per second.

props.name: glow
props.description: How bright the pulses, afterglow and flashes are, 0 to 1.

props.name: intro
props.description: The first time the field is in view, one avalanche starts by itself; it is silent and reports nothing.

props.name: spontaneous
props.description: Stray firings a minute while the field is in view, 0 for none.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freeze every pulse where it is.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the network's layout and the chances.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: onAvalanche
props.description: Fires as a visitor's avalanche starts, at each new generation, and when it ends, with { size, reach, generations, active, phase: "spreading" | "fizzled" | "faded" | "storm" }.

props.name: label
props.description: The field's accessible name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No clicks or keys; the field dims.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the field; it fills its parent by default.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the field is a focusable group (aria-roledescription "thought field"); a keyboard focus shows a selection ring on the middle node, the arrow keys move it to the nearest node in that direction, Home brings it back, and Enter or Space fires it. A polite live region announces each avalanche once, when it ends: "48 thoughts over 6 steps, spread and faded."

Reduced motion: nothing travels — a firing resolves the whole cascade at once and draws its map (every node that fired and every filament it used) over the field, which holds and then fades on a CSS opacity transition; the sizes and steps still report.

Performance: Canvas 2D with the faint network painted once per size and colour; a frame draws only lit filaments, live pulses (a preallocated typed-array pool) and node flashes (one pre-rendered glow sprite). The loop runs only while something is lit or resting, on screen and visible, and stops after; DPR is capped.

The field is always dark — a night panel in both themes — with the glow from hue; give it a size (it fills its parent). A seeded thought always reaches at least one neighbour, so a click never does nothing; after that the branching ratio decides.
Within one avalanche a node tires (each further firing passes on half as much), so even a storm ends; spontaneous firings run on a timer only while the field is in view.

items.title: Planetarium Roof
items.tagline: Lie back and drag a ceiling of pictures.
items.description: A gallery seen from the floor of a planetarium: prints pinned to the inside of a dome overhead in loose constellations of three, over a faint graticule, pricked stars and constellation lines, each print posed by the Jacobian of an equisolid fisheye at its centre so the ones near the edge compress and turn as the dome curves away. Dragging turns the whole dome 1:1 under the finger and a release coasts on with the throw's velocity, decaying by inertia, while keyboard moves turn it to each print on the springs.glide constants. Clicking a print flies it down into focus — its pose decomposed into rotation, scales, shear and centre and tweened to an upright, centred print on springs.glide as the dome dims and the caption rises — and Escape, Close or a click on the dome flies it home.

props.name: items
props.description: The prints, { id?, src?, alt, caption?, detail?, art? }, hung in constellations of three in order.

props.name: fov
props.description: Field of view across the dome, degrees, 70 to 150: a close dome or a wide sweep.

props.name: spacing
props.description: How far apart the constellations and their prints sit, 0.6 to 1.6.

props.name: inertia
props.description: How long a throw coasts, 0 (stops dead) to 1 (coasts long).

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The print in focus, or null for none.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the click or key that brought a print into focus or sent it back.

props.name: drift
props.description: How fast the dome turns by itself while idle, degrees a second; 0 holds it still.

props.name: altitude
props.description: Where the view starts, degrees above the horizon (90 looks straight up).

props.name: cardSize
props.description: Each print's width on the dome, degrees.

props.name: graticule
props.description: Draw the dome's altitude rings and meridians.

props.name: lines
props.description: Join each constellation's prints with thin lines.

props.name: stars
props.description: How many stars are pricked into the dome.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the constellations' shapes and the stars.

props.name: height
props.description: The stage's height, px.

props.name: label
props.description: The gallery's accessible name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No turning, clicks or keys; the dome dims.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the stage.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the prints are buttons with one tab stop (roving tabindex) inside a region with aria-roledescription "carousel"; Left and Right move between prints, Up and Down between constellations, Home and End to the first and last, and the dome turns to each. Enter or Space brings a print into focus and moves focus to Close; Left and Right switch prints in focus; Escape (handled, so the page never sees it) sends it back and returns focus to its print.
Reduced motion: the dome never drifts or coasts and keyboard moves turn it at once; a drag still turns it 1:1 under the finger, and a print in focus cross-fades in at the centre instead of flying.

Performance: one loop that runs only while the dome moves (a coast, a keyboard turn, or drift), on screen and visible; it writes each print's CSS matrix directly and redraws a small Canvas 2D layer of rings, stars and lines (DPR-capped). With drift 0 it is idle until touched.

The dome takes the page's surfaces and ink, so it is a pale plaster ceiling on a light page and a night sky on a dark one; the prints are pigment art or your src images, and the server renders every print already posed.
Touch turns the dome horizontally and leaves vertical swipes to the page (touch-action pan-y); mouse and pen turn it both ways.

items.title: Slot Canyon
items.tagline: Fly the narrow slot, lit from a crack of sky.
items.description: An endless flight down a narrow sandstone slot canyon, raymarched in one WebGL2 pass: the walls are a distance field around a meandering centreline whose lean changes with height, so the slot winds one way at the floor and another overhead, banded with strata and carved with flowing flutes, glowing with light bounced down from a thin crack of sky — warm high up, violet-brown below. Where the crack opens, sun falls in shafts gathered by a short volumetric march through drifting dust, so the beams hang in the air and light the floor where they land. The pointer steers sideways and up toward the crack on the springs.glide constants, banking the camera so the canyon twists around you, and drifts home on springs.drift when it leaves; the arrow keys steer the same way, Home recentres and Space pauses the flight.

props.name: children
props.description: Content over the flight: a hero line, a call to action. It stays fully interactive.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast you fly, 0 (hanging still) to 1 (a fast run).

props.name: width
props.description: How wide the slot is, 0.6 (a squeeze) to 1.4 (a wider passage).

props.name: shafts
props.description: Sunlight through the crack, 0 (none) to 1 (bright shafts and lit floor).

props.name: steer
props.description: How far the pointer and arrow keys steer, 0 to 1.

props.name: twist
props.description: How much the camera banks with the steer and the slot's own bends, 0 to 1.

props.name: dust
props.description: Dust hanging and glinting in the shafts, 0 to 1.

props.name: strata
props.description: How strongly the rock is banded, 0 (plain) to 1 (bold strata).

props.name: colors
props.defaultValue: sandstone pigments from the warn, danger and accent tokens
props.description: The lit rock, the shade, and the sky, as CSS colours.

props.name: paused / defaultPaused
props.description: The flight holds where it is.

props.name: onPausedChange
props.description: Fires from the Space key that paused or resumed the flight.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the canyon's course and its cracks.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Cap on the canvas's device pixel ratio, at most 2.

props.name: label
props.description: The scene's accessible name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No steering or keys.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizes the scene; it fills its parent by default.

usageNotes: Keyboard: the scene is a focusable group (aria-roledescription "canyon flight"); the arrow keys steer left and right and look up and down exactly as the pointer does, Home recentres, and Space pauses and resumes the flight (announced politely). Children above it stay interactive and keep their own keys.
Reduced motion: one still frame from a fixed place in the canyon — no flight, no drifting dust; the arrow keys still turn the view and redraw it once.

Performance: the raymarch renders at half (DPR ≥ 1.5) or three-quarter scale with DPR capped; the loop runs only while flying or the steer settles, on screen and visible, and stops when paused. Context loss is handled, and without WebGL2 (and on the server) an SVG still of layered strata walls under a shaft stands in.

The canyon is painted from pigments, so it looks the same on a light or a dark page; pass colors to recolour the rock, the shade and the sky. A wide stage looks through a longer lens so the slot keeps its depth.
Give it a size (it fills its parent) and put your hero copy in children with a text shadow; the walls run dark at the bottom, where copy reads best.

items.title: Switchback Trails
items.tagline: Hold the shutter over a winding mountain road.
items.description: A dusk view across a valley to a mountain road zigzagging down a slope in hairpins, its legs smaller and thinner the higher they climb, with cars driving it both ways — warm-white headlights coming down, red tail lights going up — slowing into every hairpin. Press and hold to open the shutter: an iris opens on the springs.snap constants, a readout counts the seconds, and each car's lights are drawn from where they were to where they are into an additive exposure layer, so white and red trails build along the hairpins, brightest where the cars slow, while the sky lifts as a long exposure does. Release and the iris closes on the exit ease as the photograph develops with a halation bloom, holds, and slowly fades; Space opens it while held, Enter toggles it, Escape closes it.

props.name: traffic

props.name: dusk
props.description: The light, 0 (last warm light) to 1 (deep blue hour with stars).

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: The shutter is open.

props.name: onOpenChange

props.name: onExpose
